## common/s05_assemble_Hgg_completed_pairs.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-27", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 11927, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_assemble_Hgg_completed_pairs.wls", "sha256": "849cbecf55c4b8f9e0a6765e1c4396ae12b5beb67500fcd043d3bf57d21e71f8"} -->
```wolfram
(* Assemble completed native pairs once; retain the original tensor acceptance gates. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
assemblyDispatchPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_assemble_Hgg_completed_pairs.wls"}];
assemblyBasePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response_Hgg_components.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[assemblyBasePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "000061ea5ba381c3dd6be3d21ec2a613e6dd56c555fe8ec6d414717595abd9a7", Quit[1]];
assemblyBaseText = StringTrim[Import[assemblyBasePath, "Text"]];
assemblyTerminal = "ToExpression[componentRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[assemblyBaseText, assemblyTerminal] || !SyntaxQ[assemblyBaseText] ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[assemblyDispatchPath, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
assemblyBootstrap = StringDrop[assemblyBaseText, -StringLength[assemblyTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[assemblyBootstrap], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[assemblyBootstrap, InputForm];
assemblyManifestPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_Hgg_completed_pair_inputs.json"}];
assemblyManifest = Import[assemblyManifestPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["completed-pair assembly manifest", assemblyManifest["schema"] ===
  "polarized-sidis-completed-pair-assembly-inputs-v1" && assemblyManifest["channel"] === "Hgg"];

assembleCompletedPairs[] := Module[
  {paths, expectedPaths, record, scalarValues, controlValues = {}, control, controlBinding,
   sumPaths, sumKeys, sumRecords, key, value, binding, saved, checkpointDirectory,
   start = AbsoluteTime[], before, released, timings = {}, evidence, proofDirectory, proofPath},
  gate["serial completed-pair assembly", channel === "Hgg" && workerCount === 0 && !validationOnly];
  paths = Lookup[assemblyManifest["pairs"], "file"];
  expectedPaths = (StringDrop[FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_" <> ToString[First[#]] <>
    "_" <> ToString[Last[#]] <> ".wl"}], StringLength[root] + 1] &) /@ pairs;
  gate["complete generated pair inventory pinned", Sort[paths] === Sort[expectedPaths] && DuplicateFreeQ[paths]];
  Do[gate["completed pair file " <> row["file"], IntegerString[
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, row["file"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]],
    {row, assemblyManifest["pairs"]}];
  gate["own native assembled control pinned", IntegerString[FileHash[
    FileNameJoin[{root, assemblyManifest["sum_control"]["file"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    assemblyManifest["sum_control"]["sha256"]];
  proofDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_completed_assembly_result"}];
  proofPath = FileNameJoin[{proofDirectory, "s05_result.wl"}];
  If[FileExistsQ[proofPath],
    evidence = Get[proofPath];
    If[AssociationQ[evidence] && evidence["SourceHash"] === FileHash[assemblyDispatchPath, "SHA256"] &&
      evidence["InputManifestHash"] === FileHash[assemblyManifestPath, "SHA256"],
      gate["accepted own completed assembly checkpoint", evidence["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
        evidence["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && evidence["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
        TrueQ[evidence["ExactOwnAcceptedSumComparison"]] && TrueQ[evidence["Accepted"]] &&
        evidence["ControlHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, assemblyManifest["sum_control"]["file"]}], "SHA256"] &&
        AssociationQ[evidence["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[evidence["Checks"]]];
      scalarKeys = evidence["ScalarKeys"]; scalarValues = <||>;
      matrix = ConstantArray[0, {Length[photonSymbols], Length[photonSymbols]}];
      Do[
        gate["own sum checkpoint file " <> row["Key"], FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}], "SHA256"] === row["FileHash"]];
        saved = bounded[Get[FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}]], {"saved assembly reader", row["Key"]}];
        gate["own sum checkpoint binding", saved["InputHash"] === inputHash && saved["Key"] === row["Key"] &&
          saved["CompletedPairSumInputHash"] === row["CompletedPairSumInputHash"] && And @@ Values[saved["Checks"]]];
        If[StringStartsQ[row["Key"], "Photon_"],
          matrix = ReplacePart[matrix, (FromDigits /@ Rest[StringSplit[row["Key"], "_"]]) -> saved["Value"]],
          AssociateTo[scalarValues, StringDrop[row["Key"], StringLength["Scalar_"]] -> saved["Value"]]];
        Clear[saved]; ClearSystemCache[]; Share[], {row, evidence["SumFiles"]}];
      gate["complete saved assembly scalar inventory", Keys[scalarValues] === scalarKeys];
      scalarModes = Join[scalarValues, <|"PhotonWard" -> wardProof["ScalarValue"]|>];
      pairValues = evidence["PairMetadata"]; sumEvidence = evidence["SumFiles"];
      completedPairAssemblyEvidence = evidence;
      Print["REUSED_COMPLETE_PAIR_ASSEMBLY memory ", MemoryInUse[]]; Return[]]];
  (* The contraction installers have consumed these packets; their file identities remain bound. *)
  Clear[componentPacket, componentProof]; ClearSystemCache[]; Share[];
  pairValues = {}; matrix = ConstantArray[0, {Length[photonSymbols], Length[photonSymbols]}];
  scalarValues = <||>;
  Do[
    Print["COMPLETED_PAIR_ASSEMBLY ", pair, " memory ", MemoryInUse[]];
    record = bounded[pairTask[pair], {label, pair, "completed pair reader"}];
    gate["accepted completed pair input and checks", AssociationQ[record] &&
      record["InputHash"] === inputHash && record["SectorWardComparisonHash"] === wardProofHash &&
      AssociationQ[record["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[record["Checks"]] &&
      Dimensions[record["PhotonMatrix"]] === Dimensions[matrix]];
    before = MemoryInUse[]; released = Share[];
    AssociateTo[record, "ScalarModes" -> KeyDrop[record["ScalarModes"], "PhotonWard"]];
    If[pairValues === {}, scalarKeys = Keys[record["ScalarModes"]];
      scalarValues = AssociationThread[scalarKeys, ConstantArray[0, Length[scalarKeys]]]];
    gate["common completed-pair scalar inventory", Keys[record["ScalarModes"]] === scalarKeys];
    AppendTo[controlValues, record["PhotonMatrix"][[1, 1]]];
    matrix = MapThread[Plus, {matrix, record["PhotonMatrix"]}, 2];
    scalarValues = Association@Table[key -> (scalarValues[key] + record["ScalarModes"][key]), {key, scalarKeys}];
    AppendTo[pairValues, KeyDrop[record, {"PhotonMatrix", "ScalarModes"}]];
    Clear[record]; ClearSystemCache[]; Share[];
    AppendTo[timings, <|"Pair" -> pair, "MemoryBeforeSharing" -> before,
      "SharedBytesReleased" -> released, "MemoryAfterAssembly" -> MemoryInUse[],
      "ElapsedSeconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - start|>];
    Print["COMPLETED_PAIR_ASSEMBLED ", InputForm[Last[timings]]], {pair, pairs}];
  gate[label <> " all diagram pairs complete", Length[pairValues] === Length[pairs] && AllTrue[pairValues, AssociationQ]];
  gate[label <> " all pair checks accepted", And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ pairValues]];
  gate["all pairs share complete-sector proof", AllTrue[pairValues, #["SectorWardComparisonHash"] === wardProofHash &]];
  controlBinding = bounded[Hash[{inputHash, label, "Photon_1_1", controlValues}, "SHA256"], "own original sum binding"];
  control = bounded[Get[FileNameJoin[{root, assemblyManifest["sum_control"]["file"]}]], "own accepted sum reader"];
  Share[];
  gate["own original assembled sum identity", control["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
    control["Key"] === "Photon_1_1" && control["SumInputHash"] === controlBinding &&
    AssociationQ[control["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]]];
  gate["entire own accepted sum exactly reproduced", matrix[[1, 1]] === control["Value"] &&
    linearComponentSum[<|"Key" -> "Photon_1_1", "Values" -> controlValues|>] === control["Value"]];
  evidence = <|"SourceHash" -> FileHash[assemblyDispatchPath, "SHA256"],
    "InputManifestHash" -> FileHash[assemblyManifestPath, "SHA256"],
    "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "ControlHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, assemblyManifest["sum_control"]["file"]}], "SHA256"],
    "ControlSumInputHash" -> controlBinding, "ExactOwnAcceptedSumComparison" -> True,
    "Measurements" -> timings, "ElapsedSeconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - start|>;
  Clear[control, controlValues]; ClearSystemCache[]; Share[];
  checkpointDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s05_shared_assembly", channel,
    IntegerString[Hash[{inputHash, evidence["SourceHash"], evidence["InputManifestHash"]}, "SHA256"], 16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[checkpointDirectory], CreateDirectory[checkpointDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  sumKeys = Join[Flatten[Table["Photon_" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b],
    {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}]], ("Scalar_" <> # &) /@ scalarKeys];
  sumPaths = AssociationThread[sumKeys, (FileNameJoin[{checkpointDirectory, # <> ".wl"}] &) /@ sumKeys];
  sumRecords = Table[
    Print["SHARED_COMPONENT_SAVE ", key, " memory ", MemoryInUse[]];
    value = If[StringStartsQ[key, "Photon_"],
      Extract[matrix, FromDigits /@ Rest[StringSplit[key, "_"]]], scalarValues[StringDrop[key, StringLength["Scalar_"]]]];
    If[StringContainsQ[key, "Ward"], value = bounded[algebraicReduce[value], {label, key, "Ward sum"}]];
    binding = Hash[{inputHash, label, key, evidence["SourceHash"], evidence["InputManifestHash"]}, "SHA256"];
    saved = <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "CompletedPairSumInputHash" -> binding, "Key" -> key,
      "Value" -> value, "Checks" -> checks|>;
    put[saved, sumPaths[key]];
    If[StringStartsQ[key, "Scalar_"], AssociateTo[scalarValues, StringDrop[key, StringLength["Scalar_"]] -> value]];
    Clear[value, saved]; ClearSystemCache[]; Share[];
    <|"Key" -> key, "CompletedPairSumInputHash" -> binding,
      "File" -> StringDrop[sumPaths[key], StringLength[root] + 1], "FileHash" -> FileHash[sumPaths[key], "SHA256"]|>,
    {key, sumKeys}];
  scalarModes = Join[scalarValues, <|"PhotonWard" -> wardProof["ScalarValue"]|>];
  sumEvidence = sumRecords; completedPairAssemblyEvidence = Join[evidence,
    <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-completed-pair-assembly-v1", "Accepted" -> True,
      "SumFiles" -> sumRecords, "PairMetadata" -> pairValues, "ScalarKeys" -> scalarKeys, "Checks" -> checks|>];
  If[!DirectoryQ[proofDirectory], CreateDirectory[proofDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  put[completedPairAssemblyEvidence, proofPath];
  gate["complete own assembly evidence reload", Get[proofPath] === completedPairAssemblyEvidence];
  gate[label <> " all component sums complete", Length[sumEvidence] === Length[sumKeys]];
  gate[label <> " component sum checks accepted", And @@ Values[checks]];
  Share[]; Print["COMPLETED_PAIR_ASSEMBLY_MEMORY ", MemoryInUse[]]];

assemblyFirst = "  ownPackedPairComparison=verifyOwnPackedPair[];finishPackedPreflight[];";
assemblyLast = "  Clear[sums, sumValues, sumTasks];";
gate["unique complete-pair assembly boundaries", StringCount[componentRunTail, assemblyFirst] === 1 &&
  StringCount[componentRunTail, assemblyLast] === 1];
```

```wolfram
originalScalarDefinitions = DownValues[reduceScalar];

originalAngularDefinitions = {DownValues[angularAverage], DownValues[angularAverageOne]};

angularFirstReduce[value_] := Module[{rows, powers, monomials, coefficients, reconstructed, moments, averaged, seconds, answer},
  If[FreeQ[value, normalDot], Return[algebraicReduce[value]]];
  gate["angular variable independent of transverse constraint", FreeQ[transverseConstraint, normalDot]];
  gate["restored coefficient polynomial in angular variable", PolynomialQ[value, normalDot]];
  gate["all explicit denominators independent of angular variable", And @@
    (FreeQ[#, normalDot] & /@ Cases[value, Power[base_, exponent_Integer /; exponent < 0] :> base, {0, Infinity}])];
  {seconds, averaged} = AbsoluteTiming[
    rows = CoefficientRules[value, {normalDot}];
    powers = First /@ (First /@ rows); coefficients = Last /@ rows;
    monomials = normalDot^# & /@ powers;
    reconstructed = Total[MapThread[Times, {coefficients, monomials}]];
    gate["entire angular polynomial coefficient reconstruction", CoefficientRules[reconstructed, {normalDot}] === rows];
    gate["angular coefficients independent of angular variable", FreeQ[coefficients, normalDot]];

    "AveragingSeconds" -> seconds, "AverageIsZero" -> TrueQ[averaged === 0], "ExactReconstruction" -> True|>];

saveExact[value_, path_] := Module[{serialized},

  Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];

  record = Get[recordPath];

    Hash[{record["InputHash"], record["CoefficientAlgorithmHash"], record["ScalarInput"]}, "SHA256"] === record["ArgumentHash"]];
```

```wolfram
    coefficients = terms /. normalDot -> 1;
    monomials = normalDot^# & /@ powers;

comparisonRows = Table[

  gate["entire accepted projection reproduced " <> entry["name"], candidate === accepted["Value"] ||

  evidence = <|"Name" -> entry["name"], "Pair" -> trace["Pair"], "PhotonIndices" -> trace["PhotonIndices"],
```

```wolfram
(* Compare the reference's early Ward substitution on the actual Hgg amplitudes. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;

productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];

prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];

sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];

ToExpression[sectorCode];
controlPair = First[pairs]; gate["own diagonal control pair", SameQ @@ controlPair];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_" <> ToString[First[controlPair]] <> "_" <> ToString[Last[controlPair]] <> ".wl"}];
gate["pinned own accepted control", IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "16e98e475d6b9922b571ea98bc9b6c6a8d2fe473b2a12a221986e4cc443f1a9b"];
control = Get[controlPath];
gate["complete control input and checks", control["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]]];
referencePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_result", "reference", "s05_early_ward_reference.wl"}];
referenceText = Import[referencePath, "Text"];
gate["reference substitutes Ward momentum before spin sum", StringContainsQ[referenceText,
  "\"PhotonWard\", a = a /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q; b = b /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q"] &&
  StringContainsQ[referenceText, "expression = FermionSpinSum[a ComplexConjugate[b]"]];
conservationEquation = Total[generated["incoming"]] == Total[generated["outgoing"]];
wardSolutions = Solve[conservationEquation, q];
gate["unique generated momentum conservation rule", Length[wardSolutions] === 1 &&
  FreeQ[wardSolutions, _ConditionalExpression | _Real | $Failed]];
wardMomentumRule = First[wardSolutions];
gate["generated momentum relation reconstructs", Expand[(conservationEquation /. Equal -> Subtract) /. wardMomentumRule] === 0];
originalDefinitions = {DownValues[buildPair], DownValues[reduceScalar], DownValues[restoredScalarComponent],
  DownValues[algebraicReduceOne], DownValues[angularAverageOne]};
earlyWardAmplitude[index_] := earlyWardAmplitude[index] = Module[{projected, value, seconds},
  projected = (amplitudes[[index]] /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q) /. wardMomentumRule;
  gate["early Ward removes only the photon polarization", FreeQ[projected, Polarization[q, ___]]];
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[DiracSimplify[Contract[projected]], {"early Ward amplitude", index}]];
  Print["EARLY_WARD_AMPLITUDE ", index, " seconds ", seconds, " before bytes ", ByteCount[projected], " after bytes ", ByteCount[value]];
  value];

    b = b /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], ___] -> LorentzIndex[gluonRight[leg], D], {leg, gluons}];
  value = FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit[a ComplexConjugate[b, FCRenameDummyIndices -> True]];
  value = FermionSpinSum[value, Head -> keptSpinSum, DotSimplify -> False, FCTraceFactor -> False];

    If[mom === p, quarkIn, quarkOut];

  Do[value *= densities[leg], {leg, gluons}]; tensorWeight value/normalization];
{controlSeconds, controlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
  traceScalar[earlyWardPair @@ controlPair], "early Ward own control"]];
gate["entire own accepted Ward spin polynomial reproduced", controlValue === control["ScalarModes"]["PhotonWard"] ||
  bounded[algebraicReduce[controlValue - control["ScalarModes"]["PhotonWard"]] === 0, "early Ward control equality"]];
candidatePair = {2, 6}; gate["actual slow pair belongs to generated inventory", MemberQ[pairs, candidatePair]];

gate["complete exact scalar candidate", FreeQ[candidateValue, _Spinor | _DiracTrace | _DiracGamma | _Pair |

result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-early-ward-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,

  "ReferenceSourceHash" -> FileHash[referencePath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "ControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],

resultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_early_ward_cached_result"}];

resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s05_result.wl"}];

Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["exact early Ward native result reload", Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];

  "control_seconds" -> controlSeconds, "candidate_seconds" -> candidateSeconds,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse the exact defining coordinate routine, as for compact scalar products. *)

productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!= settings["production_source_sha256"],

productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];

prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];

If[!SyntaxQ[productionPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete inherited initialization syntax"]; Quit[1]];

gate["own channel and scalar definitions", channel === settings["channel"] && channel === "Hqg" &&
  useRestoredScalar && useFactoredPair];
label = First[labels];
gate["one native real sector", labels === {label}];
sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["complete unchanged pair definitions syntax", SyntaxQ[sectorCode]];
ToExpression[sectorCode];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, settings["control"]["file"]}];
gate["pinned own accepted projection", IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === settings["control"]["sha256"]];
controlRecord = Get[controlPath];
gate["own accepted projection input binding", controlRecord["InputHash"] === inputHash && KeyExistsQ[controlRecord, "Value"]];
controlNumbers = FromDigits /@ StringCases[FileBaseName[controlPath], DigitCharacter ..];
gate["complete control coordinate inventory", Length[controlNumbers] === 4];
controlPair = Take[controlNumbers, 2]; controlIndices = Take[controlNumbers, -2];

originalScalarDefinitions = DownValues[reduceScalar];
originalAlgebraDefinitions = DownValues[algebraicReduceOne];
DownValues[uncachedCoordinates] = originalCoordinateDefinitions /. coordinates -> uncachedCoordinates;
gate["unchanged complete coordinate equation", (DownValues[uncachedCoordinates] /. uncachedCoordinates -> coordinates) ===
  originalCoordinateDefinitions];
coordinateCache = <||>; coordinateHits = 0; coordinateMisses = 0; coordinateBytes = 0;
cachedCoordinates[v_] := Module[{key = HoldComplete[v], answer},
  If[KeyExistsQ[coordinateCache, key], coordinateHits++; Return[coordinateCache[key]]];
  coordinateMisses++;

  If[Length[coordinateCache] < 256 && coordinateBytes + ByteCount[answer] < 16*1024^2,
    AssociateTo[coordinateCache, key -> answer]; coordinateBytes += ByteCount[answer]];
  answer];
DownValues[coordinates] = DownValues[cachedCoordinates] /. cachedCoordinates -> coordinates;
gate["coordinate caching leaves scalar algebra unchanged", DownValues[reduceScalar] === originalScalarDefinitions &&
  DownValues[algebraicReduceOne] === originalAlgebraDefinitions];
Print["ACTUAL_TRANSVERSE_CONSTRAINT ", InputForm[transverseConstraint]];
Print["ACTUAL_COORDINATE_EQUATIONS ", InputForm[originalCoordinateDefinitions]];
comparisonHash = Hash[{FileHash[comparisonPath, "SHA256"], inputHash, FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
comparisonCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s05_coordinate_check", channel, IntegerString[comparisonHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[comparisonCache], CreateDirectory[comparisonCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
saveExact[value_, path_] := Module[{serialized},
  serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[value], "coordinate comparison compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded coordinate comparison file", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
  gate["coordinate comparison exact file reload", bounded[Get[path <> ".tmp"] === value, "coordinate comparison reload"]];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
runProjection[pair_, indices_, purpose_] := Module[
  {binding, prefix, tracePath, projectionPath, record, tensor, projected, traced, traceSeconds,

    And @@ (Between[#, {1, Length[photonSymbols]}] & /@ indices)];

  record = If[FileExistsQ[projectionPath], Get[projectionPath], <||>];
  If[Lookup[record, "Binding", None] === binding && KeyExistsQ[record, "Value"] &&

  record = If[FileExistsQ[tracePath], Get[tracePath], <||>];
  If[Lookup[record, "Binding", None] === binding && KeyExistsQ[record, "TracedExpression"],
    traced = record["TracedExpression"]; traceSeconds = record["TraceSeconds"],
    tensor = bounded[buildPair[First[pair], Last[pair], None], {purpose, pair, "native spin closure"}];

    {traceSeconds, traced} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[Contract[DiracSimplify[projected, DiracTraceEvaluate -> True]],
      {purpose, pair, indices, "unchanged native trace"}]];
    saveExact[<|"Binding" -> binding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices,
      "TracedExpression" -> traced, "TraceSeconds" -> traceSeconds|>, tracePath]];
  Print["COORDINATE_CHECK_TRACE ", InputForm[<|"Purpose" -> purpose, "Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices,
    "Seconds" -> traceSeconds, "Bytes" -> ByteCount[traced]|>]];
  initialHits = coordinateHits; initialMisses = coordinateMisses;
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[reduceScalar[traced], {purpose, pair, indices, "unchanged scalar reduction"}]];
  record = <|"Binding" -> binding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices, "Value" -> value,
    "TraceSeconds" -> traceSeconds, "ScalarSeconds" -> seconds, "CacheHits" -> coordinateHits - initialHits,
    "CacheMisses" -> coordinateMisses - initialMisses, "CacheBytes" -> coordinateBytes, "Checks" -> checks|>;
  saveExact[record, projectionPath]; Print["COORDINATE_PROJECTION_COMPLETE ", InputForm[KeyDrop[record, {"Value", "Checks"}]]]; record];
control = runProjection[controlPair, controlIndices, "own accepted control"];
gate["entire own accepted projection unchanged", control["Value"] === controlRecord["Value"] ||
  bounded[algebraicReduce[control["Value"] - controlRecord["Value"]] === 0, "own accepted projection comparison"]];
candidate = runProjection[settings["pair"], settings["photon_indices"], "previously timed-out projection"];
gate["actual coordinate cache bounds", Length[coordinateCache] <= 256 && coordinateBytes <= 16*1024^2];
gate["coordinate caching retained every algebra equation", DownValues[reduceScalar] === originalScalarDefinitions &&
  DownValues[algebraicReduceOne] === originalAlgebraDefinitions &&
  (DownValues[uncachedCoordinates] /. uncachedCoordinates -> coordinates) === originalCoordinateDefinitions];
Print["ACTUAL_CACHED_COORDINATES ", InputForm[coordinateCache]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-coordinate-cache-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[comparisonPath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"],
  "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[configPath, "SHA256"], "ControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "OriginalCoordinateDefinitions" -> originalCoordinateDefinitions, "UncachedCoordinateDefinitions" -> DownValues[uncachedCoordinates],
  "CachedCoordinateDefinitions" -> DownValues[cachedCoordinates], "CoordinateDefinitions" -> DownValues[coordinates],
  "CoordinateValues" -> coordinateCache, "TransverseConstraint" -> transverseConstraint,
  "Control" -> KeyDrop[control, "Value"], "Candidate" -> candidate, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_coordinate_cache_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
saveExact[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "control" -> KeyDrop[control, {"Value", "Checks"}],
  "candidate" -> KeyDrop[candidate, {"Value", "Checks"}], "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
```

```wolfram
wardMomentumRule = First[wardSolutions];

  DownValues[algebraicReduceOne], DownValues[angularAverageOne]};
earlyWardAmplitude[index_] := earlyWardAmplitude[index] = Module[{projected, value, seconds},
  projected = (amplitudes[[index]] /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q) /. wardMomentumRule;

  Print["EARLY_WARD_AMPLITUDE ", index, " seconds ", seconds, " before bytes ", ByteCount[projected], " after bytes ", ByteCount[value]];

  bounded[algebraicReduce[controlValue - control["ScalarModes"]["PhotonWard"]] === 0, "early Ward control equality"]];

    DownValues[algebraicReduceOne], DownValues[angularAverageOne]}];
gate["complete exact scalar candidate", FreeQ[candidateValue, _Spinor | _DiracTrace | _DiracGamma | _Pair |

result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-early-ward-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,

  "ConservationEquation" -> conservationEquation, "WardMomentumRule" -> wardMomentumRule,

resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s05_result.wl"}];

  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
```

```wolfram
  gate["Hermiticity time bound " <> description, False]], 4*1024^3,
  gate["Hermiticity memory bound " <> description, False]];

  {controlSeconds, controlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[hermiticityBounded[factoredHermiticity[control["PhotonMatrix"]], "own factorized pair"]];
  gate["own complete original Hermiticity reproduced " <> label, TrueQ[originalValue] && controlValue === originalValue];
  negativeValue = hermiticityBounded[factoredHermiticity[control["PhotonMatrix"] + I IdentityMatrix[Length[control["PhotonMatrix"]]]], "negative control"];
  gate["changed own Hermiticity control rejected " <> label, negativeValue === False];

    path = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_assembled_" <> key <> ".wl"}];

    packet["Value"]], hermiticityKeys, {2}];

  gate["complete own sector Hermiticity " <> label, TrueQ[value]];

    "OriginalControlPassed" -> originalValue, "NegativeControlRejected" -> (negativeValue === False), "Accepted" -> value|>;

  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[hermiticityStudyPath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[hermiticityBasePath, "SHA256"],
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "PhysicalInputHashes" -> inputHashes, "EquationInputHashes" -> hermiticityInputHashes,
  "ConjugationProofHash" -> FileHash[pairProofPath, "SHA256"], "ConjugationDefinitions" -> DownValues[factoredRealConjugate],
```

```wolfram
If[!SyntaxQ[productionPrefix], Print["FAIL: inherited initialization syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];

gate["own channel and unchanged scalar interfaces", channel === "Hqg" &&

label = First[labels]; gate["one real comparison sector", labels === {label}];

originalReductionDefinitions = DownValues[algebraicReduceOne];

gate["unchanged original scalar reducer", (DownValues[unslicedScalar] /. unslicedScalar -> algebraicReduceOne) === originalReductionDefinitions];
DownValues[uncachedCoordinates] = originalCoordinateDefinitions /. coordinates -> uncachedCoordinates;
coordinateCache = <||>; coordinateHits = 0; coordinateMisses = 0; coordinateBytes = 0;
cachedCoordinates[v_] := Module[{key = HoldComplete[v], answer},
  If[KeyExistsQ[coordinateCache, key], coordinateHits++; Return[coordinateCache[key]]];

  variables = Select[{D, normalDot}, !FreeQ[value, #] && FreeQ[denominators, #] &];

  gate["slice variables absent from transverse constraint", And @@ (FreeQ[transverseConstraint, #] & /@ variables)];
  gate["polynomial scalar slice domain", PolynomialQ[value, variables]];
  If[inputBytes > largestScalarBytes, largestScalarBytes = inputBytes; largestScalarInput = value];
  Print["POLYNOMIAL_SCALAR_BEGIN ", InputForm[<|"InputBytes" -> inputBytes, "Variables" -> variables|>]];
  {seconds, answer} = AbsoluteTiming[
    rows = CoefficientRules[value, variables];
    monomials = (Times @@ MapThread[Power, {variables, First[#]}]) & /@ rows;
    reconstruction = Total[MapThread[Times, {Last /@ rows, monomials}]];
    gate["exact inverse polynomial coefficient map", CoefficientRules[reconstruction, variables] === rows];
    gate["slice coefficients independent of selected variables", FreeQ[Last /@ rows, Alternatives @@ variables]];
    reduced = Table[Print["POLYNOMIAL_SCALAR_SLICE ", n, " of ", Length[rows]];
      unslicedScalar[Last[rows[[n]]]], {n, Length[rows]}];
    Total[MapThread[Times, {reduced, monomials}]]];
  AppendTo[slicingMeasurements, <|"InputHash" -> Hash[value, "SHA256"], "InputBytes" -> inputBytes,
    "Variables" -> variables, "Powers" -> (First /@ rows), "Slices" -> Length[rows],
    "Seconds" -> seconds, "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[answer], "ExactCoefficientMap" -> True|>];
  Print["POLYNOMIAL_SCALAR_COMPLETE ", InputForm[Last[slicingMeasurements]]]; answer];
DownValues[algebraicReduceOne] = DownValues[polynomialScalar] /. polynomialScalar -> algebraicReduceOne;
gate["scalar restoration and angular equations unchanged", DownValues[reduceScalar] === originalScalarDefinitions &&
  {DownValues[angularAverage], DownValues[angularAverageOne]} === originalAngularDefinitions];
studyDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_polynomial_scalar_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[studyDirectory], CreateDirectory[studyDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
saveExact[value_, path_] := Module[{serialized},
  serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[value], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["comparison output file bound", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
  gate["comparison exact native reload", Get[path <> ".tmp"] === value];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
comparisonRows = Table[
  tracePath = FileNameJoin[{root, entry["trace_file"]}];
  acceptedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, entry["accepted_file"]}];

  gate["pinned accepted projection " <> entry["name"], IntegerString[FileHash[acceptedPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === entry["accepted_sha256"]];
  trace = Get[tracePath]; accepted = Get[acceptedPath];
  gate["same native projection inputs " <> entry["name"], trace["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
    accepted["InputHash"] === inputHash && trace["Pair"] === entry["pair"] &&
    trace["PhotonIndices"] === entry["photon_indices"] && KeyExistsQ[trace, "TracedExpression"] && KeyExistsQ[accepted, "Value"]];
  Print["SAVED_NATIVE_TRACE ", InputForm[<|"Pair" -> trace["Pair"], "PhotonIndices" -> trace["PhotonIndices"],
    "TraceBytes" -> ByteCount[trace["TracedExpression"]], "TraceSeconds" -> trace["TraceSeconds"]|>]];
  initialMeasurements = Length[slicingMeasurements]; initialHits = coordinateHits; initialMisses = coordinateMisses;
  {projectionSeconds, candidate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[reduceScalar[trace["TracedExpression"]], {entry["name"], "polynomial scalar comparison"}]];
  gate["entire accepted projection reproduced " <> entry["name"], candidate === accepted["Value"] ||
    bounded[algebraicReduce[candidate - accepted["Value"]] === 0, {entry["name"], "exact accepted projection comparison"}]];
  evidence = <|"Name" -> entry["name"], "Pair" -> trace["Pair"], "PhotonIndices" -> trace["PhotonIndices"],
    "Seconds" -> projectionSeconds, "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[candidate], "SlicesUsed" -> Length[slicingMeasurements] - initialMeasurements,
    "CoordinateHits" -> coordinateHits - initialHits, "CoordinateMisses" -> coordinateMisses - initialMisses,
    "TraceHash" -> FileHash[tracePath, "SHA256"], "AcceptedHash" -> FileHash[acceptedPath, "SHA256"], "ExactComparison" -> True|>;
  saveExact[<|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "Evidence" -> evidence, "Value" -> candidate, "Checks" -> checks|>,
    FileNameJoin[{studyDirectory, "s05_" <> entry["name"] <> ".wl"}]];
  Print["POLYNOMIAL_PROJECTION_ACCEPTED ", InputForm[evidence]]; Clear[trace, accepted, candidate]; evidence,
  {entry, studyConfig["comparisons"]}];
gate["polynomial reduction exercised", Length[slicingMeasurements] > 0 && largestScalarInput =!= None];
gate["bounded coordinate reuse", Length[coordinateCache] <= 256 && coordinateBytes < 16*1024^2];
gate["original scalar and angular definitions retained", DownValues[reduceScalar] === originalScalarDefinitions &&
  {DownValues[angularAverage], DownValues[angularAverageOne]} === originalAngularDefinitions &&
  (DownValues[unslicedScalar] /. unslicedScalar -> algebraicReduceOne) === originalReductionDefinitions];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-polynomial-scalar-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[studyPath, "SHA256"], "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[studyConfigPath, "SHA256"],
  "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "OriginalReductionDefinitions" -> originalReductionDefinitions,
  "UnslicedDefinitions" -> DownValues[unslicedScalar], "PolynomialDefinitions" -> DownValues[polynomialScalar],
  "InstalledReductionDefinitions" -> DownValues[algebraicReduceOne], "OriginalCoordinateDefinitions" -> originalCoordinateDefinitions,
  "CachedCoordinateDefinitions" -> DownValues[cachedCoordinates], "CoordinateDefinitions" -> DownValues[coordinates],
  "OriginalScalarDefinitions" -> originalScalarDefinitions, "OriginalAngularDefinitions" -> originalAngularDefinitions,
  "TransverseConstraint" -> transverseConstraint, "CoordinateValues" -> coordinateCache,
  "LargestScalarInput" -> largestScalarInput, "Measurements" -> slicingMeasurements, "Comparisons" -> comparisonRows,
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;

Export[FileNameJoin[{studyDirectory, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "comparisons" -> comparisonRows,
  "slice_operations" -> Length[slicingMeasurements], "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_check_polynomial_scalar"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Save completed scalar coefficients without changing their defining reduction. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;

productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];

  "24fe8bc812f0a7306ee73ab9346d0e772d6d0bba77839feee131da55142f5c65", Print["FAIL: reviewed scalar source"]; Quit[1]];

prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
prefix = StringTake[productionText, prefixEnd - 1];
prefix = StringReplace[prefix, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" ->
  "If[!MemberQ[$Packages, \"FeynCalc`\"], Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix], Print["FAIL: scalar initialization syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[prefix];
gate["complete scalar checkpoint comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[comparisonPath, "Text"]]];
gate["own scalar checkpoint comparison channel", channel === "Hgg" && useRestoredScalar && useFactoredPair];
label = First[labels]; gate["single comparison sector", labels === {label}];
sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["unchanged complete pair initialization syntax", SyntaxQ[sectorCode]];
ToExpression[sectorCode];
controlPair = First[pairs];
gate["control pair is diagonal", SameQ @@ controlPair];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_" <> ToString[First[controlPair]] <> "_" <> ToString[Last[controlPair]] <> ".wl"}];
gate["pinned accepted own control pair", IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "16e98e475d6b9922b571ea98bc9b6c6a8d2fe473b2a12a221986e4cc443f1a9b"];
control = Get[controlPath];
gate["complete own control input binding", control["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]]];
originalRestorationDefinitions = DownValues[restoredScalarComponent];
originalReductionDefinitions = {DownValues[algebraicReduce], DownValues[algebraicReduceOne], DownValues[angularAverage], DownValues[angularAverageOne]};
coefficientAlgorithmHash = Hash[{originalRestorationDefinitions, originalReductionDefinitions, transverseConstraint}, "SHA256"];
coefficientDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s05_coefficients", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16], IntegerString[coefficientAlgorithmHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[coefficientDirectory], CreateDirectory[coefficientDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
coefficientCacheHits = 0; coefficientCacheWrites = 0;
checkpointedScalarComponent[component_] := Module[{restored, argumentHash, path, saved, answer, seconds, record, serialized, temporary},
  restored = (component /. epsilonRule) /. scalarRestore;
  argumentHash = Hash[{inputHash, coefficientAlgorithmHash, restored}, "SHA256"];
  path = FileNameJoin[{coefficientDirectory, IntegerString[argumentHash, 16, 64] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[path], Get[path], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] === inputHash && Lookup[saved, "ArgumentHash", None] === argumentHash && KeyExistsQ[saved, "Value"],
    coefficientCacheHits++; Print["REUSED_SCALAR_COEFFICIENT ", IntegerString[argumentHash, 16, 64]]; Return[saved["Value"]]];
  {seconds, answer} = AbsoluteTiming[algebraicReduce[restored]];
  record = <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "ArgumentHash" -> argumentHash, "Value" -> answer|>;
```

```wolfram
originalRestorationDefinitions = coefficientProof["OriginalRestorationDefinitions"];

gate["restoration code unchanged before scalar reduction",
  (DownValues[restoreOnly] /. {restoreOnly -> restoredScalarComponent, Identity -> algebraicReduce}) === originalRestorationDefinitions];
exactAngularZero[value_] := Module[{expanded, terms, powers, coefficients, monomials, distinctPowers, momentValues, moments},
  If[FreeQ[value, normalDot], Return[If[value === 0, value, Missing["UnchangedReduction"]]]];
  gate["normal coordinate independent of on-shell constraint", FreeQ[transverseConstraint, normalDot]];
  gate["polynomial normal coordinate", PolynomialQ[value, normalDot]];
  gate["normal coordinate absent from every denominator", And @@
    (FreeQ[#, normalDot] & /@ Cases[value, Power[base_, exponent_Integer /; exponent < 0] :> base, {0, Infinity}])];
  expanded = Expand[value, normalDot];
  gate["selective expansion exact input reconstruction", Expand[value - expanded, normalDot] === 0];
  terms = If[Head[expanded] === Plus, List @@ expanded, {expanded}];
  powers = Exponent[#, normalDot] & /@ terms;
  gate["integral nonnegative normal powers", AllTrue[powers, IntegerQ[#] && # >= 0 &]];
  coefficients = terms /. normalDot -> 1; monomials = normalDot^# & /@ powers;
  gate["every angular term exactly reconstructed", MapThread[Times, {coefficients, monomials}] === terms];
  distinctPowers = DeleteDuplicates[powers]; momentValues = normalMoment /@ distinctPowers;

checkpointGuard = "  With[{zeroValue = exactAngularZero[restored]}, If[!MissingQ[zeroValue], Print[\"ZERO_ANGULAR_COEFFICIENT \", IntegerString[argumentHash, 16, 64]]; Return[zeroValue]]];\n";
gate["one original coefficient evaluation boundary", StringCount[checkpointBlock, checkpointNeedle] === 1];

studyDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_zero_angular_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[studyDirectory], CreateDirectory[studyDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
coefficientDirectory = FileNameJoin[{studyDirectory, "isolated_cache"}];
```

## common/s05_chunked_result_io.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-50", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3841, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_chunked_result_io.wls", "sha256": "6c3cf6deedd7de13c79b0f363cc2010c4ab6b6b12a2b10862283459b478c45ea"} -->
```wolfram
(* Lossless native storage with a small, hash-verifying Get entry point. *)
writeChunkedNativeResult[value_, resultPath_, chunkCharacters_Integer, relativeBase_String] := Module[
  {directory, compressed, count, parts, names, hashes, chunk, path, reader,
   manifestPath, manifest, started, roundTrip, totalBytes},
  gate["valid native payload chunk bound", 0 < chunkCharacters <= 32*1024^2];
  directory = DirectoryName[resultPath]; started = AbsoluteTime[];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  Print["RESULT_STORAGE_INPUT_BYTES ", ByteCount[value]];
  compressed = MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[Compress[value], 1800,
    gate["native payload compression time bound", False]], 8*1024^3,
    gate["native payload compression memory bound", False]];
  gate["native payload is text", StringQ[compressed] && StringLength[compressed] > 0];
  count = Ceiling[StringLength[compressed]/chunkCharacters];
  parts = Table[
    chunk = StringTake[compressed, {(index - 1)*chunkCharacters + 1, Min[index*chunkCharacters, StringLength[compressed]]}];
    path = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_payload_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".txt"}];
    Export[path <> ".tmp", chunk, "Text"];
    gate["native payload part below file bound", FileByteCount[path <> ".tmp"] < 128*1024^2];
    gate["native payload text round trip", Import[path <> ".tmp", "Text"] === chunk];
    RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True];
    Print["NATIVE_PAYLOAD_PART ", index, "/", count, " bytes ", FileByteCount[path]];
    <|"file" -> relativeBase <> "/" <> FileNameTake[path], "name" -> FileNameTake[path],
      "bytes" -> FileByteCount[path], "sha256" -> IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64]|>,
    {index, count}];
  names = Lookup[parts, "name"]; hashes = FromDigits[#, 16] & /@ Lookup[parts, "sha256"];
  reader = "Module[{paths = FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[$InputFileName], #}] & /@ " <>
    ToString[names, InputForm] <> ", hashes = " <> ToString[hashes, InputForm] <>
    "}, If[And @@ (FileExistsQ /@ paths) && (FileHash[#, \"SHA256\"] & /@ paths) === hashes, " <>
    "Uncompress[StringJoin[Import[#, \"Text\"] & /@ paths]], Print[\"FAIL: native payload identity\"]; $Failed]]\n";
  gate["complete native payload reader syntax", SyntaxQ[reader]];
  Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", reader, "Text"];
  gate["native payload reader below file bound", FileByteCount[resultPath <> ".tmp"] < 128*1024^2];
  Clear[compressed, chunk]; ClearSystemCache[];
  roundTrip = MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === value, 1800,
    gate["native payload reload time bound", False]], 8*1024^3,
    gate["native payload reload memory bound", False]];
  gate["complete native payload exact round trip", roundTrip];
  RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
  totalBytes = Total[Lookup[parts, "bytes"]];
  manifest = <|"schema" -> "polarized-sidis-chunked-wolfram-result-v1", "result" -> relativeBase <> "/" <> FileNameTake[resultPath],
    "result_sha256" -> IntegerString[FileHash[resultPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64], "payloads" -> parts,
    "expression_bytes" -> ByteCount[value], "payload_bytes" -> totalBytes,
    "exact_round_trip" -> roundTrip, "serialization_seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started|>;
  manifestPath = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_payload_manifest.json"}];
  Export[manifestPath <> ".tmp", manifest, "RawJSON"];
  gate["native payload manifest round trip", KeyDrop[Import[manifestPath <> ".tmp", "RawJSON"], "serialization_seconds"] ===
    KeyDrop[manifest, "serialization_seconds"]];
  RenameFile[manifestPath <> ".tmp", manifestPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
  Print["RESULT_STORAGE payload_bytes ", totalBytes, " parts ", count,
    " serialization_seconds ", manifest["serialization_seconds"]]; manifest];
```

```wolfram
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete pair storage syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];

archiveCode = "from pathlib import Path\nimport sys,json,gzip,hashlib,shutil\np=Path(sys.argv[1]);a=Path(sys.argv[2]);expected=sys.argv[3]\ndef digest(path):\n h=hashlib.sha256()\n with path.open('rb') as f:\n  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b)\n return h.hexdigest()\nassert digest(p)==expected and not a.exists()\na.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);t=a.with_name(a.name+'.tmp')\nwith p.open('rb') as f,gzip.open(str(t),'wb',compresslevel=1) as o:shutil.copyfileobj(f,o,1024**2)\nh=hashlib.sha256();n=0\nwith gzip.open(str(t),'rb') as f:\n for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b);n+=len(b)\nassert h.hexdigest()==expected and n==p.stat().st_size and digest(p)==expected\nassert t.stat().st_size<128*1024**2\nt.rename(a)\nprint(json.dumps({'sha256':digest(a),'bytes':a.stat().st_size,'source_sha256':expected,'source_bytes':n}))\n";
outputDirectory = DirectoryName[inputPath]; rows = {}; archives = {};
Do[

    FileByteCount[path] === item["bytes"]];

  original = Get[path];

    original["InputHash"] === FromDigits[FileNameTake[DirectoryName[path]], 16] &&

  {seconds, serialized} = AbsoluteTiming["Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[original], InputForm] <> "]\n"];
  gate["bounded native checkpoint " <> relative, StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
  temporary = path <> ".native.tmp"; Export[temporary, serialized, "Text"];
  gate["exact native checkpoint reload " <> relative, Get[temporary] === original];
  archiveRelative = "Hgg/s05_pair_storage_result/s05_sources/" <> FileNameTake[path] <> ".gz";
  archivePath = FileNameJoin[{root, archiveRelative}];
  process = RunProcess[{"python3", "-c", archiveCode, path, archivePath, item["sha256"]}];
  gate["lossless original byte archive " <> relative, process["ExitCode"] === 0];
  archive = ImportString[process["StandardOutput"], "RawJSON"];
  gate["verified original bytes " <> relative, archive["source_sha256"] === item["sha256"] && archive["source_bytes"] === item["bytes"]];
  gate["unchanged checkpoint before publication " <> relative, IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === item["sha256"]];
  RenameFile[temporary, path, OverwriteTarget -> True];
  row = <|"file" -> relative, "original_sha256" -> item["sha256"], "original_bytes" -> item["bytes"],

    "source_archive" -> archiveRelative, "exact_native_reload" -> True, "compression_seconds" -> seconds|>;
  AppendTo[rows, row]; AppendTo[archives, Join[archive, <|"file" -> archiveRelative|>]];
  manifest = <|"schema" -> "polarized-sidis-native-pair-storage-v1", "channel" -> "Hgg", "files" -> rows,
    "archives" -> archives, "protected_paths" -> settings["protected_paths"], "complete" -> False,
    "source_archives_verified" -> True, "exact_native_reload" -> True|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory, "s05_cache_manifest.json"}], manifest, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PAIR_STORAGE_ACCEPTED ", relative, " bytes ", row["bytes"], " archive bytes ", archive["bytes"]];
```

```wolfram
  "Hash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"]|>;

  wardValues = <||>, metricRow, pairMetadata = {}, cdrRules, cdrAverage, cdrPg, cdr, pWeights,
  expected, sumReceipt, sumKey, component, generic, genericCoefficients, scalarValue, sector,
  metadata, metadataPath, reader, resultPath, loaded, actual, expectedResponse, payloadRows,

  gate["bounded complete Hgg export setup", channel === "Hgg" && labels === {label} && workerCount === 0 && !validationOnly];

    Total[MapThread[Times, {genericCoefficients, basis["PhotonBasis"]}]]] === ConstantArray[0, Dimensions[generic]]];
  pWeights = (pComponents.#.pComponents &) /@ basis["PhotonBasis"];

    pComponents.generic.pComponents - pWeights.genericCoefficients] === 0];

    relative = channel <> "/s05_projected_components_result/Photon_" <> ToString[component] <> "/s05_result.wl";
    record = hggReadAccepted[relative, "polarized-sidis-complete-photon-spin-component-v1"];
    gate["complete photon component " <> ToString[component], record["Component"] === component &&
      record["PhotonLabel"] === basis["PhotonLabels"][[component]] && record["SourceHash"] === FileHash[projectionSource, "SHA256"] &&

      record["IncomingVariables"] === inVariables && record["OutgoingVariables"] === outVariables &&
      Dimensions[record["Response"]] === {Length[outVariables], Length[inVariables]} &&
      TrueQ[record["Reconstruction"]["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[record["Reconstruction"]["Checks"]]];
    gate["all native photon acceptance predicates " <> ToString[component], And @@
      (TrueQ[record["Checks"][#]] & /@ {"entire actual spin polynomial reconstructed",
        "own complete original reconstruction reproduced", "own original Hermiticity reproduced",
        "original photon inverse for every matrix entry", "actual photon support reproduces original trace"})];
    expected = Position[Transpose[basis["PhotonDual"][[component]]], v_ /; v =!= 0, {2}, Heads -> False];

    expected = (channel <> "/s05_component_sums_result/Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ #, "_"] <> "/s05_result.wl" &) /@ expected;
    gate["complete native photon support " <> ToString[component], Sort[Keys[record["SumInputHashes"]]] === Sort[expected]];
    KeyValueMap[Function[{name, hash},
      sumReceipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, DirectoryName[name], "s05_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
      gate["accepted assembled parent " <> name, TrueQ[sumReceipt["passed"]] &&
        sumReceipt["result_sha256"][name] === IntegerString[hash, 16, 64] &&
        sumReceipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s05_assemble_Hgg_component_sum.wls"] === IntegerString[FileHash[hggExportBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64]];
      If[KeyExistsQ[covered, name], gate["same reused assembled parent " <> name, covered[name] === hash]];

    row = hggFileRow[relative]; AppendTo[records, row]; AppendTo[cdrPhotons, record["CDRPhotonCoefficient"]];
    MapIndexed[Function[{value, index}, If[value =!= 0,
      AppendTo[taskMetadata, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "ExtendedResponse", "Index" -> Prepend[index, component]|>];
      AppendTo[taskRows, <|"Payload" -> row, "Field" -> "Response", "Index" -> index|>]]], record["Response"], {2}];
    Clear[record]; ClearSystemCache[], {component, Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]]}];
  expected = Flatten[Table[channel <> "/s05_component_sums_result/Photon_" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b] <> "/s05_result.wl",
    {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}]];
  gate["all matrix entries covered by native Hermiticity checks", Sort[Keys[covered]] === Sort[expected]];
  scalarKeys = Select[Import[FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_component_sums_result", "Photon_1_1", "s05_checks.json"}], "RawJSON"]["all_component_keys"], StringStartsQ[#, "Scalar_"] &];
  cdrRules = Thread[Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]] ->
    (If[MemberQ[{eIn, eOut}, #], 1, 0] & /@ Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]])];
  cdrAverage = If[incomingQuark, 1, basis["IncomingDensityNormalization"]/gluonDimensions[p]];
  Do[
    relative = channel <> "/s05_component_sums_result/" <> sumKey <> "/s05_result.wl";

    gate["complete scalar input " <> sumKey, record["Key"] === sumKey && record["SourceHash"] === FileHash[hggExportBase, "SHA256"] &&

    If[pairMetadata === {}, pairMetadata = record["PairMetadata"]];

  AssociateTo[wardValues, "PhotonWard" -> wardProof["ScalarValue"]];
  KeyValueMap[gate[label <> " " <> #1, #2 === 0] &, wardValues];
  AppendTo[taskMetadata, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "PhotonMetricD", "Index" -> {}|>];
  AppendTo[taskRows, <|"Payload" -> metricRow, "Field" -> "Value", "Index" -> {}|>];
  cdr = <|"Pg" -> cdrPg, "Ppp" -> bounded[algebraicReduce[pWeights.cdrPhotons], "original CDR momentum contraction"]|>;

  Do[scalarValue = If[core, reference["Contractions"][mode], reference[If[mode === "Pg", "g", "pp"]] /. {Nc -> SUNN, gs -> 1}];
    gate[label <> " reference " <> mode, bounded[algebraicReduce[cdr[mode] - (scalarValue /. coordinateRules)], {"original reference", mode}] === 0],
    {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
  gate["executed complete real photon definition", DownValues[photonProject] ===
    (interfaceProof["ProjectionDefinitions"] /. completePhotonProject -> photonProject)];
  sector = <|"CDRContractions" -> cdr, "WardChecks" -> wardValues, "TagWeight" -> tagWeight,
    "TagWeightAppliedToTensor" -> core, "OutgoingFields" -> outgoingFields,
    "IncomingSpinLabels" -> If[incomingQuark, basis["SpinLabels"], Append[basis["SpinLabels"], "E"]],
    "OutgoingSpinLabels" -> If[outgoingQuark, basis["SpinLabels"], Append[basis["SpinLabels"], "E"]],

    "CutMomenta" -> {k2, p + q - k1 - k2}, "CutEnergySupport" -> {energy[k2] > 0, energy[p + q - k1 - k2] > 0},
    "ResidualAngularAverageApplied" -> True, "PhaseSpaceIntegrated" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False,
    "CouplingsRemoved" -> If[core, "e_q^2 g_s^4; distinct-charge ratio retained", "ee^2 gs^4; flavor charges retained"],
    "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "CalculationSourceHash" -> calculationSourceHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> inputHash,
    "InterfaceValidationHash" -> FileHash[interfaceProofPath, "SHA256"], "SpinExtractionValidationHash" -> FileHash[spinExtractionProofPath, "SHA256"],
    "ComponentExportSourceHash" -> FileHash[hggExportSource, "SHA256"], "ComponentProjectionSourceHash" -> FileHash[projectionSource, "SHA256"],
    "ComponentStorage" -> <|"Sector" -> label, "PhotonFiles" -> records, "MetricFile" -> metricRow,
      "PhotonBasis" -> basis["PhotonBasis"], "IncomingVariables" -> inVariables, "OutgoingVariables" -> outVariables|>,
    "MappingTaskMetadata" -> taskMetadata, "MappingTaskSources" -> taskRows,
    "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
  directory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_result"}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  metadataPath = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_metadata.wl"}]; put[metadata, metadataPath];
  reader = "Module[{base=DirectoryName[$InputFileName,3],fetch,data,storage},\n" <>
    "fetch=With[{taskRoot=base},Function[row,Module[{p=FileNameJoin[{taskRoot,row[\"File\"]}]}," <>
    "If[!FileExistsQ[p]||FileHash[p,\"SHA256\"]=!=row[\"Hash\"],Print[\"FAIL: component payload identity\"];Abort[]];Get[p]]]];\n" <>
    "data=fetch[" <> ToString[hggFileRow[channel <> "/s05_result/s05_metadata.wl"], InputForm] <> "];storage=data[\"ComponentStorage\"];\n" <>
    "With[{read=fetch,rows=storage[\"PhotonFiles\"],pg=storage[\"MetricFile\"],pb=storage[\"PhotonBasis\"]," <>

    "Join[all,<|\"Sectors\"-><|lab->Join[small,<|" <>
    "\"ExtendedResponse\":>Table[read[rows[[a]]][\"Response\"],{a,Length[rows]}]," <>
    "\"Response\":>Table[read[rows[[a]]][\"Response\"][[1;;ns,1;;ns]],{a,Length[rows]}]," <>

    "\"PhotonMatrix\":>Total[Table[With[{rr=read[rows[[a]]][\"Response\"]},pb[[a]] Sum[iv[[i]] ov[[j]] rr[[j,i]],{i,Length[iv]},{j,Length[ov]}]],{a,Length[rows]}]]," <>
    "\"PhotonMetricD\":>read[pg][\"Value\"]|>]|>|>]]]\n";
  gate["native component reader syntax", SyntaxQ[reader]];
  resultPath = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_result.wl"}];
  Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", reader, "Text"];

  gate["exact complete metadata interface", KeyDrop[loaded, "Sectors"] === KeyDrop[metadata, "Sectors"] &&
    KeyTake[loaded["Sectors"][label], Keys[sector]] === sector];
  Do[
    expectedResponse = bounded[Get[FileNameJoin[{root, records[[component]]["File"]}]]["Response"], "accepted response reload"];

    gate["exact accepted response through loader " <> ToString[component], actual === expectedResponse];

  scalarValue = bounded[Get[FileNameJoin[{root, metricRow["File"]}]]["Value"], "accepted metric reload"];
  gate["exact dimensional metric through loader", bounded[loaded["Sectors"][label]["PhotonMetricD"], "actual dimensional metric reader"] === scalarValue];
  Clear[scalarValue, loaded]; ClearSystemCache[];

  payloadRows = Join[records, scalarRows, {hggFileRow[channel <> "/s05_result/s05_metadata.wl"]}];
  manifest = <|"schema" -> "polarized-sidis-component-native-result-v1", "result" -> channel <> "/s05_result/s05_result.wl",
    "result_sha256" -> IntegerString[FileHash[resultPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64], "exact_component_round_trips" -> True,
    "payloads" -> (<|"file" -> #["File"], "sha256" -> IntegerString[#["Hash"], 16, 64],
      "bytes" -> FileByteCount[FileNameJoin[{root, #["File"]}]]|> & /@ payloadRows)|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_component_manifest.json"}], manifest, "RawJSON"];
  report = <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks, "sectors" -> labels,
    "component_count" -> Length[records], "mapping_task_count" -> Length[taskRows],
    "elapsed_seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started, "peak_kernel_memory_bytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[],
    "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_checks.json"}], report, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s05_export_Hgg_components"]; Quit[0]];
ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];
```

```wolfram
(* Publish the accepted components through the original real-tensor interface. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
hggExportSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_export_Hgg_weighted_components.wls"}];

If[IntegerString[FileHash[hggExportBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=

hggExportTerminal = "ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];";

If[!SyntaxQ[hggExportPrefix], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[hggExportPrefix, InputForm];

hggWeightedEvidence = {};
SetAttributes[hggExportRead, HoldFirst];
hggExportRead[expression_, context_] := MemoryConstrained[
  TimeConstrained[expression, 1200, gate[ToString[{context, "native read time"}, InputForm], False]],
  16*1024^3, gate[ToString[{context, "native read memory"}, InputForm], False]];
hggKeepCDR[coefficient_, weight_, component_] := Module[{retained, originalWeighted, retainedWeighted},
  retained = If[weight === 0, 0, coefficient];
  originalWeighted = weight coefficient; retainedWeighted = weight retained;
  gate["exact original weighted CDR coefficient " <> ToString[component], originalWeighted === retainedWeighted];
  AppendTo[hggWeightedEvidence, <|"Component" -> component, "Weight" -> weight,
    "OriginalBytes" -> ByteCount[coefficient], "RetainedBytes" -> ByteCount[retained], "ExactEquality" -> True|>];
  Print["HGG_WEIGHTED_CDR ", InputForm[Last[hggWeightedEvidence]]]; retained];

    "\"ExtendedResponseComponent\"->Function[a,read[rows[[a]]][\"Response\"]]," <>
    "\"PhotonMatrix\":>Total[Table[With[{rr=read[rows[[a]]][\"Response\"]},pb[[a]] Sum[iv[[i]] ov[[j]] rr[[j,i]],{i,Length[iv]},{j,Length[ov]}]],{a,Length[rows]}]]," <>
    "\"PhotonMetricD\":>read[pg][\"Value\"]|>]|>|>]]]\n";
  gate["native component reader syntax", SyntaxQ[reader]];
  resultPath = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_result.wl"}];
  Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", reader, "Text"];
  loaded = Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"];
  gate["exact complete metadata interface", KeyDrop[loaded, "Sectors"] === KeyDrop[metadata, "Sectors"] &&
    KeyTake[loaded["Sectors"][label], Keys[sector]] === sector];
  Do[
    expectedResponse = hggExportRead[Get[FileNameJoin[{root, records[[component]]["File"]}]]["Response"], "accepted response reload"];
    actual = hggExportRead[loaded["Sectors"][label]["ExtendedResponseComponent"][component], "actual component reader"];
    gate["exact accepted response through loader " <> ToString[component], actual === expectedResponse];
    Clear[actual, expectedResponse]; ClearSystemCache[], {component, Length[records]}];
  scalarValue = hggExportRead[Get[FileNameJoin[{root, metricRow["File"]}]]["Value"], "accepted metric reload"];
  gate["exact dimensional metric through loader", hggExportRead[loaded["Sectors"][label]["PhotonMetricD"], "actual dimensional metric reader"] === scalarValue];
  Clear[scalarValue, loaded]; ClearSystemCache[];
  RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
  payloadRows = Join[records, scalarRows, {hggFileRow[channel <> "/s05_result/s05_metadata.wl"]}];
  manifest = <|"schema" -> "polarized-sidis-component-native-result-v1", "result" -> channel <> "/s05_result/s05_result.wl",
    "result_sha256" -> IntegerString[FileHash[resultPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64], "exact_component_round_trips" -> True,
    "payloads" -> (<|"file" -> #["File"], "sha256" -> IntegerString[#["Hash"], 16, 64],
      "bytes" -> FileByteCount[FileNameJoin[{root, #["File"]}]]|> & /@ payloadRows)|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_component_manifest.json"}], manifest, "RawJSON"];
  report = <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks, "sectors" -> labels,
    "component_count" -> Length[records], "mapping_task_count" -> Length[taskRows],
    "elapsed_seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started, "peak_kernel_memory_bytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[],
    "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_checks.json"}], report, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s05_export_Hgg_weighted_components"]; Quit[0]];
ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];

```

## common/s05_export_native_equation.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-55", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 1985, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_export_native_equation.wls", "sha256": "96a5db3f959bacde469fcb71afef0d5ed19f030f72f237693fab2325badeadbb"} -->
```wolfram
(* Read an existing native checkpoint as a bounded, human-readable equation. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];
sourcePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s05_export_native_equation.wls"}];
channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
relative=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_EQUATION_FILE"];
expected=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_EQUATION_SHA256"];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["own compute allocation",channel==="Hgg"&&StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&
  !StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["complete native reader syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath,"Text"]]];
gate["own scalar checkpoint path",StringQ[relative]&&
  StringStartsQ[relative,"cache/s05_spin_components/"<>channel<>"/"]&&
  FreeQ[FileNameSplit[relative],".."]&&StringEndsQ[relative,".wl"]];
path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
gate["exact saved scalar equation",IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===expected];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
record=Get[path];
gate["native scalar checkpoint schema",AssociationQ[record]&&
  ContainsAll[Keys[record],{"InputHash","ArgumentHash","Value"}]];
result=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"],"Checkpoint"->relative,
  "CheckpointHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],"Record"->record,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"NewContractionEvaluated"->False|>;
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s05_angular_equation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
output=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s05_result.wl"}];
serialized=ToString[result,InputForm]<>"\n";
gate["bounded readable native output",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[output<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
gate["exact readable native reload",Get[output<>".tmp"]===result];
RenameFile[output<>".tmp",output,OverwriteTarget->True];
Print["PASS: s05_export_native_equation"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s05_inspect_scalar_equation.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-58", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 11328, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_inspect_scalar_equation.wls", "sha256": "c50e8339a083c3bf2d60490eaa280e0aa5560edb1f63726b67c4ac44cf6a9a85"} -->
```wolfram
(* Inspect actual timed-out scalar equations without changing production algebra. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
inspectionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_inspect_scalar_equation.wls"}];
inspectionConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_scalar_inspection_inputs.json"}];
inspectionConfig = Import[inspectionConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!= inspectionConfig["production_source_sha256"],
  Print["FAIL: pinned scalar-inspection source"]; Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
productionPrefix = StringTake[productionText, prefixEnd - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[productionPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete production prefix syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];
gate["complete scalar inspection syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[inspectionPath, "Text"]]];
gate["known scalar inspection contract", inspectionConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-inspection-inputs-v1" &&
  channel === inspectionConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hqg" && useRestoredScalar && useFactoredPair];
label = First[labels];
gate["one inspected real sector", labels === {label}];
sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["complete unchanged pair definitions syntax", SyntaxQ[sectorCode]];
ToExpression[sectorCode];
pair = inspectionConfig["pair"]; indices = inspectionConfig["photon_indices"];
gate["actual native projection inventory", MemberQ[pairs, pair] && Length[indices] === 2 &&
  And @@ (Between[#, {1, Length[photonSymbols]}] & /@ indices)];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, inspectionConfig["control"]["file"]}];
gate["pinned own accepted projection", IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === inspectionConfig["control"]["sha256"]];
control = Get[controlPath];
gate["own accepted projection input binding", control["InputHash"] === inputHash && KeyExistsQ[control, "Value"]];
Clear[control];
inspectionDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_scalar_equation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[inspectionDir], CreateDirectory[inspectionDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
measurements = {}; lastScalarEquation = Missing["NoScalarEquation"];
SetAttributes[inspectOperation, HoldRest];
inspectOperation[name_, expression_] := Module[{seconds, answer, status},
  Print["SCALAR_NATIVE_BEGIN ", name];
  {seconds, answer} = AbsoluteTiming[TimeConstrained[MemoryConstrained[expression, realMemoryLimit,
    Missing["OperationMemoryLimit"]], inspectionConfig["operation_seconds"], Missing["OperationTimeLimit"]]];
  status = If[MissingQ[answer], answer, "Completed"];
  AppendTo[measurements, <|"Operation" -> name, "Seconds" -> seconds, "Status" -> status,
    "ResultBytes" -> ByteCount[answer], "KernelMemoryBytes" -> MemoryInUse[]|>];
  Print["SCALAR_NATIVE_END ", InputForm[Last[measurements]]];
  If[MissingQ[answer], Throw[<|"Status" -> status, "Operation" -> name|>, "ScalarInspection"]]; answer];
originalAlgebraCode = sourceSection[productionText, "algebraicReduceOne[value_] :=", "\npVector ="]; 
instrumentation = {
  "Together[value]" -> "inspectOperation[\"Together input\", Together[value]]",
  "PolynomialExtendedGCD[den, transverseConstraint, transverseK]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"transverse Bezout\", PolynomialExtendedGCD[den, transverseConstraint, transverseK]]",
  "Together[num inverse]" -> "inspectOperation[\"Together inverse product\", Together[num inverse]]",
  "PolynomialReduce[Numerator[work], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"transverse polynomial division\", PolynomialReduce[Numerator[work], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]]",
  "Factor[Last[division]/Denominator[work]]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"Factor on-shell answer\", Factor[Last[division]/Denominator[work]]]",
  "Last[PolynomialReduce[Numerator[Together[rational - answer]], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"complete rational reconstruction\", Last[PolynomialReduce[Numerator[Together[rational - answer]], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]]]",
  "zero[gcd - bezout.{den, transverseConstraint}]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"Bezout equality\", zero[gcd - bezout.{den, transverseConstraint}]]",
  "zero[Numerator[work] - First[First[division]] transverseConstraint - Last[division]]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"division equality\", zero[Numerator[work] - First[First[division]] transverseConstraint - Last[division]]]",
  "zero[proof]" -> "inspectOperation[\"reconstruction equality\", zero[proof]]"};
gate["unique native-operation instrumentation", And @@ (StringCount[originalAlgebraCode, First[#]] === 1 & /@ instrumentation)];
instrumentedAlgebraCode = StringReplace[originalAlgebraCode, instrumentation];
gate["all production equations and checks unchanged", StringReplace[instrumentedAlgebraCode, Reverse /@ instrumentation] === originalAlgebraCode];
instrumentedAlgebraCode = StringReplace[instrumentedAlgebraCode,
  "algebraicReduceOne[value_] :=" -> "inspectedAlgebraicReduceOne[value_] :="];
gate["complete instrumented scalar definition syntax", SyntaxQ[instrumentedAlgebraCode]];
ToExpression[instrumentedAlgebraCode];
ToExpression[StringReplace[originalAlgebraCode,
  "algebraicReduceOne[value_] :=" -> "unprofiledAlgebraicReduceOne[value_] :="]];
algebraicReduceOne[value_] := If[TrueQ[inspectRestoredCoefficient],
  lastScalarEquation = value; inspectedAlgebraicReduceOne[value], unprofiledAlgebraicReduceOne[value]];
restorationCode = sourceSection[Import[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_spin_map_check.wls"}], "Text"],
  "restoredScalarComponent[component_] :=", "\nscalarCode ="];
gate["exact accepted restoration body for scoped profiling", StringCount[restorationCode, "algebraicReduce[restored]"] === 1];
scopedRestorationCode = StringReplace[restorationCode,
  "algebraicReduce[restored]" -> "Block[{inspectRestoredCoefficient = True}, algebraicReduce[restored]]"];
gate["restoration unchanged apart from profiling scope", StringReplace[scopedRestorationCode,
  "Block[{inspectRestoredCoefficient = True}, algebraicReduce[restored]]" -> "algebraicReduce[restored]"] === restorationCode];
ToExpression[restorationCode];
gate["scoped profiling starts from accepted restoration definition", DownValues[restoredScalarComponent] === scalarProof["RestoredScalarDefinitions"]];
ToExpression[scopedRestorationCode];
traceBinding = Hash[{inputHash, pair, indices, FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
traceDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s05_scalar_inspection", channel, IntegerString[traceBinding, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[traceDirectory], CreateDirectory[traceDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
tracePath = FileNameJoin[{traceDirectory, "s05_trace.wl"}];
traceRecord = If[FileExistsQ[tracePath], Get[tracePath], <||>];
If[Lookup[traceRecord, "Binding", None] === traceBinding && KeyExistsQ[traceRecord, "TracedExpression"],
  traced = traceRecord["TracedExpression"]; traceSeconds = traceRecord["TraceSeconds"],
  tensor = bounded[buildPair[First[pair], Last[pair], None], {"inspection", pair, "spin closure"}];
  projected = photonProject[tensor, photonSymbols[[First[indices]]], photonSymbols[[Last[indices]]]];
  {traceSeconds, traced} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[Contract[DiracSimplify[projected, DiracTraceEvaluate -> True]],
    {"inspection", pair, indices, "native trace"}]];
  traceRecord = <|"Binding" -> traceBinding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "Pair" -> pair,
    "PhotonIndices" -> indices, "TraceSeconds" -> traceSeconds, "TracedExpression" -> traced,
    "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"]|>;
  traceSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[traceRecord], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded trace checkpoint", StringLength[traceSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[tracePath <> ".tmp", traceSerialized, "Text"];
  gate["native trace exact checkpoint reload", Get[tracePath <> ".tmp"] === traceRecord];
  RenameFile[tracePath <> ".tmp", tracePath, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
Print["ACTUAL_SCALAR_TRACE ", InputForm[<|"Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices,
  "Seconds" -> traceSeconds, "Bytes" -> ByteCount[traced]|>]];
inspectionOutcome = Catch[TimeConstrained[
  <|"Status" -> "ProjectionCompleted", "Value" -> reduceScalar[traced]|>,
  inspectionConfig["projection_seconds"], <|"Status" -> "ProjectionTimeLimit"|>], "ScalarInspection"];
gate["saved actual scalar equation", !MissingQ[lastScalarEquation] &&
  FreeQ[lastScalarEquation, _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Aborted | $Failed]];
denominatorBases = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[lastScalarEquation, Power[base_, power_Integer /; power < 0] :> base, {0, Infinity}]];
inventory = <|"InputBytes" -> ByteCount[lastScalarEquation], "InputLeaves" -> LeafCount[lastScalarEquation],
  "TopLevelHead" -> ToString[Head[lastScalarEquation], InputForm],
  "TopLevelTerms" -> If[Head[lastScalarEquation] === Plus, Length[lastScalarEquation], 1],
  "DenominatorBases" -> denominatorBases,
  "PolynomialInTransverseCoordinate" -> TimeConstrained[PolynomialQ[lastScalarEquation, transverseK], 30, Missing["NotMeasured"]]|>;
Print["ACTUAL_SCALAR_INVENTORY ", InputForm[KeyDrop[inventory, "DenominatorBases"]]];
Print["ACTUAL_SCALAR_DENOMINATORS ", InputForm[denominatorBases]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-scalar-equation-inspection-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[inspectionPath, "SHA256"], "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[inspectionConfigPath, "SHA256"],
  "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices, "TraceSeconds" -> traceSeconds, "TracedExpression" -> traced,
  "ScalarEquation" -> lastScalarEquation, "TransverseConstraint" -> transverseConstraint,
  "Outcome" -> inspectionOutcome, "Inventory" -> inventory, "Measurements" -> measurements,
  "OriginalAlgebraCode" -> originalAlgebraCode, "InstrumentedAlgebraCode" -> instrumentedAlgebraCode,
  "TraceCheckpoint" -> tracePath, "TraceCheckpointHash" -> FileHash[tracePath, "SHA256"],
  "OriginalControlPath" -> inspectionConfig["control"]["file"], "OriginalControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s05_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[result], "scalar inspection compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded equation artifact", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["actual scalar equation exact round trip", bounded[Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result, "scalar inspection reload"]];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "outcome" -> ToString[KeyDrop[inspectionOutcome, "Value"], InputForm],
  "inventory" -> ToString[inventory, InputForm], "measurements" -> ToString[measurements, InputForm],
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_inspect_scalar_equation"]; Quit[0];
```
