## common/s05_interface_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-59", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4770, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_interface_check.wls", "sha256": "b3452147d90346bf2e793be9508096df2dd382d56e99f7ec713b075809f5b959"} -->
```wolfram
(* Validate real coordinate and photon interfaces on their actual saved inputs. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
ownSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_interface_check.wls"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "d34991466b6c4677600840ae1c837fab5879e2483932e778096134f8784c4d84", Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
sectorBegin = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "Do[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
ToExpression[StringTake[productionText, sectorBegin - 1]];
gate["interface source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[ownSource, "Text"]]];
gate["comparison owns saved real pair", channel === "Hqqprime"];
label = First[labels];
sectorEnd = First[First[Select[StringPosition[productionText, "  slots ="], First[#] > sectorBegin &]]];
ToExpression[StringTake[productionText, {sectorBegin + StringLength["Do[\n"], sectorEnd - 1}]];
coordinateBegin = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "(* Derive the old coordinate conversion"]]];
coordinateEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "Do[\n  cdr = sectorResults"]]];
coordinateCode = StringTake[productionText, {coordinateBegin, coordinateEnd - 1}];
oldSolve = "solutions = Solve[Thread[(oldValues /. Thread[oldVariables -> temporary]) == targetValues], temporary];";
newSolve = "solutions = Block[{$Assumptions = True}, Solve[Thread[(oldValues /. Thread[oldVariables -> temporary]) == targetValues], temporary]];";
gate["single coordinate interface change", StringCount[coordinateCode, oldSolve] === 1];
coordinateCode = StringReplace[coordinateCode, oldSolve -> newSolve];
ToExpression[coordinateCode];
diagnosticPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_coordinate_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
diagnostic = Get[diagnosticPath];
gate["coordinate diagnostic source binding", diagnostic["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash];
gate["same saved coordinate equations", diagnostic["OldRows"] === oldRows && diagnostic["TargetValues"] === targetValues];
diagnosticRules = Thread[diagnostic["OldVariables"] ->
  (diagnostic["TemporaryVariables"] /. First[diagnostic["Solutions"]])];
gate["coordinate solutions agree on physical domain", zeroArray[simplify[
  (oldVariables /. diagnosticRules) - (oldVariables /. coordinateRules)]]];
projectionProofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqq", "s07_photon_projection_result", "s07_result.wl"}];
projectionProof = Get[projectionProofPath];
gate["accepted native projection definition", projectionProof["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-complete-photon-projection-v1" &&
  And @@ Values[projectionProof["Checks"]]];
gate["same spin and angular inputs", And @@ Table[
  projectionProof["InputHashes"][relative] === inputHashes[relative],
  {relative, {"common/s02_result/s02_result.wl", "common/s04_result/s04_result.wl"}}]];
DownValues[completePhotonProject] = projectionProof["ProjectionDefinitions"];
baselinePath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_" <> ToString[First[First[pairs]]] <> "_" <> ToString[Last[First[pairs]]] <> ".wl"}];
baseline = Get[baselinePath];
gate["accepted real pair input binding", baseline["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[baseline["Checks"]]];
tensor = bounded[buildPair[Sequence @@ First[pairs], None], "real projection comparison closure"];
axes = Join[photonSymbols, {p, q}];
Do[gate["real projection unchanged " <> ToString[{a, b}, InputForm],
  bounded[DiracSimplify[Contract[completePhotonProject[tensor, a, b] - photonProject[tensor, a, b]]],
    "real projection equality"] === 0], {a, axes}, {b, axes}];
newMatrix = Table[bounded[traceScalar[completePhotonProject[tensor, a, b]], {"complete real projection", a, b}],
  {a, photonSymbols}, {b, photonSymbols}];
gate["complete accepted real photon matrix unchanged", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[newMatrix - baseline["PhotonMatrix"]]]];
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_interface_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[<|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-interface-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[ownSource, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "CoordinateCode" -> coordinateCode, "ReferenceCoordinateRules" -> coordinateRules,
  "CoordinateDiagnosticHash" -> FileHash[diagnosticPath, "SHA256"],
  "ProjectionDefinitions" -> DownValues[completePhotonProject],
  "ProjectionProofHash" -> FileHash[projectionProofPath, "SHA256"],
  "BaselinePath" -> baselinePath, "BaselineHash" -> FileHash[baselinePath, "SHA256"],
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_result.wl"}]];
Print["PASS: s05_interface_check"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s05_pair_assembly_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-60", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9103, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_pair_assembly_check.wls", "sha256": "47d405b7553fd93f3f4df63a008027e0b6b7500cc3041c59f5e8b7682be57900"} -->
```wolfram
(* Check factored pair assembly against an actual accepted complete pair. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
validationSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_pair_assembly_check.wls"}];
validationConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_pair_assembly_inputs.json"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
validationConfig = Import[validationConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!= validationConfig["production_source_sha256"],
  Print["FAIL: pinned pair-assembly production source"]; Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
productionPrefix = StringTake[productionText, prefixEnd - 1];
If[StringCount[productionPrefix, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"] =!= 1,
  Print["FAIL: unique inherited package loader"]; Quit[1]];
productionPrefix = StringReplace[productionPrefix,
  "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "If[!MemberQ[$Packages, \"FeynCalc`\"], Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"];
If[!SyntaxQ[productionPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete inherited prefix syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];
gate["complete pair-assembly comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[validationSourcePath, "Text"]]];
gate["known pair-assembly comparison contract",
  validationConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-pair-assembly-comparison-inputs-v1" &&
  channel === validationConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hgg"];
label = First[labels];
gate["single real comparison sector", labels === {label}];
sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["complete inherited pair definitions syntax", SyntaxQ[sectorCode]];
ToExpression[sectorCode];
pair = validationConfig["pair"];
gate["comparison uses an actual generated off-diagonal pair", MemberQ[pairs, pair] && First[pair] =!= Last[pair]];
validationInputHashes = Association@Table[
  gate["pinned pair input " <> relative, IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    validationConfig["files"][relative]];
  relative -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], {relative, Keys[validationConfig["files"]]}];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, validationConfig["control_file"]}];
gate["complete control included in reviewed inputs", KeyExistsQ[validationInputHashes, validationConfig["control_file"]]];
controlRecord = Get[controlPath];
gate["accepted complete pair exact physical input binding", AssociationQ[controlRecord] &&
  controlRecord["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[controlRecord["Checks"]] &&
  MatrixQ[controlRecord["PhotonMatrix"]] && AssociationQ[controlRecord["ScalarModes"]]];
projectionPrefix = FileNameDrop[validationConfig["control_file"], -1] <> "/" <>
  FileBaseName[validationConfig["control_file"]];
readProjection[suffix_] := Module[{relative, record},
  relative = projectionPrefix <> suffix <> ".wl";
  gate["projection included in reviewed pair inputs " <> suffix, KeyExistsQ[validationInputHashes, relative]];
  record = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]];
  gate["projection shares exact physical input " <> suffix,
    AssociationQ[record] && record["InputHash"] === inputHash && KeyExistsQ[record, "Value"]];
  record["Value"]];
rawMatrix = Table[readProjection["_P" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b]],
  {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}];
rawModes = Association@Table[key -> readProjection["_" <> key], {key, Keys[controlRecord["ScalarModes"]]}];
gate["complete raw photon inventory", Dimensions[rawMatrix] === Dimensions[controlRecord["PhotonMatrix"]]];

factoredRealConjugate[value_] := Module[{variables, heads, integerPowers, answer},
  variables = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, _Symbol, {0, Infinity}]];
  heads = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, (expression_ /; !AtomQ[expression]) :> Head[expression], {0, Infinity}]];
  integerPowers = FreeQ[value, Power[_, exponent_ /; !IntegerQ[exponent]]];
  Print["PAIR_CONJUGATION_SUPPORT heads ", heads, " integer_powers ", integerPowers,
    " variables ", variables, " input_bytes ", ByteCount[value]];
  gate["pair inputs have exact rational head support", Complement[heads, {Plus, Times, Power}] === {} &&
    FreeQ[value, _Real] && integerPowers];
  gate["native inherited real-symbol convention", And @@ (ComplexExpand[Conjugate[#]] === # & /@ variables)];
  answer = value /. coefficient_Complex :> ComplexExpand[Conjugate[coefficient]];
  gate["native real-symbol conjugation is explicit", FreeQ[answer,
    _Conjugate | _Re | _Im | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | $Failed | $Aborted]];
  answer];
factoredPhotonPair[matrix_] := matrix + Transpose[Map[factoredRealConjugate, matrix, {2}]];
factoredScalarPair[value_] := value + factoredRealConjugate[value];
pairEvidence = {};
candidateMatrix = Table[
  Print["PAIR_ASSEMBLY_ENTRY ", {a, b}];
  {entrySeconds, entryValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    rawMatrix[[a, b]] + factoredRealConjugate[rawMatrix[[b, a]]], {"factored pair", a, b}]];
  {comparisonSeconds, comparisonValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    algebraicReduce[entryValue - controlRecord["PhotonMatrix"][[a, b]]], {"accepted pair comparison", a, b}]];
  gate["complete accepted photon entry " <> ToString[{a, b}, InputForm], comparisonValue === 0];
  AppendTo[pairEvidence, <|"Kind" -> "Photon", "Index" -> {a, b}, "Seconds" -> entrySeconds,
    "ComparisonSeconds" -> comparisonSeconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[{rawMatrix[[a, b]], rawMatrix[[b, a]]}],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[entryValue]|>];
  entryValue, {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}];
candidateModes = Association@Table[
  Print["PAIR_ASSEMBLY_SCALAR ", key];
  {entrySeconds, entryValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[factoredScalarPair[rawModes[key]], {"factored scalar pair", key}]];
  {comparisonSeconds, comparisonValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    algebraicReduce[entryValue - controlRecord["ScalarModes"][key]], {"accepted scalar pair comparison", key}]];
  gate["complete accepted scalar entry " <> key, comparisonValue === 0];
  AppendTo[pairEvidence, <|"Kind" -> "Scalar", "Key" -> key, "Seconds" -> entrySeconds,
    "ComparisonSeconds" -> comparisonSeconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[rawModes[key]],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[entryValue]|>];
  key -> entryValue, {key, Keys[rawModes]}];
gate["complete pair assembly function matches measured entries",
  bounded[factoredPhotonPair[rawMatrix] === candidateMatrix, "pair assembly function comparison"]];
gate["complete scalar assembly function matches measured entries",
  bounded[Map[factoredScalarPair, rawModes] === candidateModes, "scalar assembly function comparison"]];
candidateRecord = Join[controlRecord, <|"PhotonMatrix" -> candidateMatrix, "ScalarModes" -> candidateModes,
  "Checks" -> Join[controlRecord["Checks"], checks], "ElapsedSeconds" -> Total[Lookup[pairEvidence, "Seconds"]],
  "ElapsedIncludesProjectionRecomputation" -> False, "ComparedCheckpoint" -> controlPath,
  "ComparedCheckpointHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],
  "PairAssemblyComparisonSourceHash" -> FileHash[validationSourcePath, "SHA256"]|>];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-pair-assembly-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[validationSourcePath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"],
  "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[validationConfigPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash,
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "ValidationInputHashes" -> validationInputHashes,
  "Pair" -> pair, "ControlFile" -> validationConfig["control_file"], "ControlElapsedSeconds" -> controlRecord["ElapsedSeconds"],
  "ConjugationDefinitions" -> DownValues[factoredRealConjugate],
  "PhotonPairDefinitions" -> DownValues[factoredPhotonPair], "ScalarPairDefinitions" -> DownValues[factoredScalarPair],
  "Evidence" -> pairEvidence, "Candidate" -> candidateRecord, "Checks" -> checks,
  "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[], "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_pair_assembly_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[result], "pair comparison compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["pair comparison output below file bound", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["pair comparison exact native round trip", bounded[Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result, "pair comparison reload"]];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "pair" -> pair, "evidence" -> pairEvidence, "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_pair_assembly_check"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s05_prepare_Hgg_trace_inputs.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-63", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3359, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_prepare_Hgg_trace_inputs.wls", "sha256": "ea8ce663c1583a1ff42005fd309f2961ede4a22303826c778a85ad32abeb1733"} -->
```wolfram
(* Save the actual native inputs of the slow trace calls without evaluating them. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
traceInputPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s05_prepare_Hgg_trace_inputs.wls"}];
traceBasePath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s05_real_spin_response_cached_scalar.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[traceBasePath,"SHA256"],16,64]=!="ee4189f1cc6b6e1aa618ffc9ff40878a8cb6bd806ed880679d16bb7c209e68ff",Quit[1]];
traceBaseText=Import[traceBasePath,"Text"];
traceBoundary="\nDo[\n  amplitudes =";
If[StringCount[traceBaseText,traceBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[traceInputPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
tracePrefix=First[StringSplit[traceBaseText,traceBoundary]];
If[StringCount[tracePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"] =!= 1,Quit[1]];
tracePrefix=StringReplace[tracePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"If[!MemberQ[$Packages,\"FeynCalc`\"],Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;$LoadAddOns={"FeynArts"};Get["FeynCalc`"];
If[!SyntaxQ[tracePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[tracePrefix,InputForm];
gate["own Hgg trace inputs",channel==="Hgg" && labels==={"Real"}];
label=First[labels];
traceSector=StringDrop[sourceSection[traceBaseText,traceBoundary,"\n  slots ="],StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["unchanged complete native sector syntax",SyntaxQ[traceSector]];
ToExpression[traceSector,InputForm];
traceRows=Table[
  pair=First[target];indices=Last[target];
  gate["requested own projection exists",MemberQ[pairs,pair] &&
    Length[indices]===2 && AllTrue[indices,IntegerQ[#] && 1<=#<=Length[photonSymbols]&]];
  tracePair=bounded[buildPair[First[pair],Last[pair],None],{"trace input",pair}];
  traceExpression=photonProject[tracePair,photonSymbols[[First[indices]]],photonSymbols[[Last[indices]]]];
  gate["closed projected trace input",FreeQ[traceExpression,_Spinor|keptSpinSum] && !FreeQ[traceExpression,_DiracTrace]];
  Print["TRACE_INPUT_SAVED ",InputForm[pair]," ",InputForm[indices]," bytes ",ByteCount[traceExpression]];
  <|"Pair"->pair,"PhotonIndices"->indices,"Expression"->traceExpression,"ExpressionHash"->Hash[traceExpression,"SHA256"]|>,
  {target,{{{1,1},{1,1}},{{6,6},{1,3}}}}];
traceResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-native-trace-inputs-v1","Channel"->channel,"InputHash"->inputHash,
  "InputHashes"->inputHashes,"SourceHash"->FileHash[traceInputPath,"SHA256"],"ProductionSourceHash"->FileHash[traceBasePath,"SHA256"],
  "Rows"->traceRows,"ScalarRestore"->scalarRestore,"SpinVariables"->{outVariables,inVariables},
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"TracesEvaluated"->False|>;
traceDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s05_trace_input_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[traceDirectory],CreateDirectory[traceDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
traceText=ToString[traceResult,InputForm]<>"\n";
gate["bounded native trace equations",StringLength[traceText]<128*1024^2];
traceResultFile=FileNameJoin[{traceDirectory,"s05_result.wl"}];
Export[traceResultFile<>".tmp",traceText,"Text"];
gate["exact native trace input reload",Get[traceResultFile<>".tmp"]===traceResult];
RenameFile[traceResultFile<>".tmp",traceResultFile,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{traceDirectory,"s05_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"traces_evaluated"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_prepare_Hgg_trace_inputs"];Quit[0];
```

## common/s05_project_Hgg_component_sum.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-65", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9825, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_project_Hgg_component_sum.wls", "sha256": "8da952ed338e8def5ff361a70cb26d6836433e69e0e0858e474830fb35d609b6"} -->
```wolfram
(* Project one accepted complete photon sum with the original spin equations. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
projectSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_project_Hgg_component_sum.wls"}];
projectBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_assemble_Hgg_component_sum.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[projectBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "67f4b5daf66d9ef7a7413eff9d64f61adcec1776a1d2679937355f797dae781f", Quit[1]];
projectBaseText = StringTrim[Import[projectBase, "Text"]];
projectTerminal = "ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[projectBaseText, projectTerminal] || !SyntaxQ[Import[projectSource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
projectBootstrap = StringDrop[projectBaseText, -StringLength[projectTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[projectBootstrap], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[projectBootstrap, InputForm];

assembleCompletedPairs[] := Module[{setting, component, dual, shape, generic, genericCoefficients,
  positions, required, entries = <||>, sumHashes = <||>, record, receipt, relative, path, key,
  controlPath, control, controlPhoton, controlResponse, originalPassed, candidate, proof, proofPath,
  originalSeconds, candidateSeconds, ownConjugate, conjugationSeconds, photon, response,
  reconstruction, responseSeconds, reconstructed, cdrRules, cdrAverage, directory, result, report,
  started = AbsoluteTime[]},
  gate["bounded own projection setup", channel === "Hgg" && labels === {label} && workerCount === 0 && !validationOnly];
  setting = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_PROJECT_COMPONENT"];
  gate["integer requested photon component", StringQ[setting] && StringMatchQ[setting, DigitCharacter ..]];
  component = FromDigits[setting];
  gate["requested photon component belongs to basis", 1 <= component <= Length[basis["PhotonDual"]]];
  dual = basis["PhotonDual"][[component]]; shape = Dimensions[dual];
  gate["complete square photon basis", shape === {Length[photonSymbols], Length[photonSymbols]}];
  generic = Table[Unique["sidisPhotonEntry"], {shape[[1]]}, {shape[[2]]}];
  genericCoefficients = Tr[#.generic] & /@ basis["PhotonDual"];
  gate["original photon inverse for every matrix entry", Expand[generic -
    Total[MapThread[Times, {genericCoefficients, basis["PhotonBasis"]}]]] === ConstantArray[0, shape]];
  positions = Position[Transpose[dual], value_ /; value =!= 0, {2}, Heads -> False];
  gate["nonempty actual photon support", positions =!= {} && AllTrue[positions,
    MatchQ[#, {_Integer, _Integer}] && And @@ MapThread[1 <= #1 <= #2 &, {#, shape}] &]];
  required = Union[positions, Reverse /@ positions];
  gate["actual photon support reproduces original trace", Expand[genericCoefficients[[component]] -
    Total[(Extract[Transpose[dual], #] Extract[generic, #] &) /@ positions]] === 0];

  proofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqq", "s05_structural_reconstruction_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
  gate["pinned reusable reconstruction algorithm", IntegerString[FileHash[proofPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    "b8d397e29a9b9210e2d4db1aabf361eb5ece0c338bbe0c93d0fd846fc8be44de"];
  proof = Get[proofPath];
  gate["accepted reconstruction implementation and extraction", TrueQ[proof["Accepted"]] &&
    And @@ Values[proof["Checks"]] && proof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
    proof["ExtractionDefinitions"] === DownValues[compactSpinResponse]];
  DownValues[structuralSpinReconstruction] = proof["CandidateDefinitions"];
  gate["unchanged executed structural algorithm", DownValues[structuralSpinReconstruction] === proof["CandidateDefinitions"]];
  Clear[componentPacket, componentProof]; ClearSystemCache[];
  controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, First[assemblyManifest["pairs"]]["file"]}];
  gate["own accepted first diagonal pair identity", First[pairs][[1]] === First[pairs][[2]] &&
    FileBaseName[controlPath] === label <> "_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ First[pairs], "_"] &&
    IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === First[assemblyManifest["pairs"]]["sha256"]];
  control = bounded[Get[controlPath], "own projection control reader"];
  gate["own accepted control conventions", control["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
    control["SectorWardComparisonHash"] === wardProofHash && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]]];
  controlPhoton = Tr[dual.control["PhotonMatrix"]];
  controlResponse = First[bounded[compactSpinResponse[{controlPhoton}, inVariables, outVariables], "own original spin extraction"]];
  {originalSeconds, originalPassed} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[zero[controlPhoton -
    Sum[inVariables[[i]] outVariables[[j]] controlResponse[[j, i]],
      {i, Length[inVariables]}, {j, Length[outVariables]}]], "own original spin reconstruction"]];
  {candidateSeconds, candidate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[structuralSpinReconstruction[
    controlPhoton, controlResponse, inVariables, outVariables], "own structural reconstruction comparison"]];
  gate["own complete original reconstruction reproduced", TrueQ[originalPassed] &&
    candidate["Accepted"] === originalPassed && And @@ Values[candidate["Checks"]]];
  {conjugationSeconds, ownConjugate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    zeroArray[control["PhotonMatrix"] - Transpose[Map[factoredRealConjugate, control["PhotonMatrix"], {2}]]],
    "own factored Hermiticity comparison"]];
  gate["own original Hermiticity reproduced", TrueQ[ownConjugate] && ownConjugate === bounded[
    zeroArray[algebraicReduce[ComplexExpand[control["PhotonMatrix"] - ConjugateTranspose[control["PhotonMatrix"]]]]],
    "own original Hermiticity"]];
  Clear[control, controlPhoton, controlResponse, proof]; ClearSystemCache[];

  Do[
    key = "Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ position, "_"];
    relative = channel <> "/s05_component_sums_result/" <> key <> "/s05_result.wl";
    path = FileNameJoin[{root, relative}];
    receipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path], "s05_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
    gate["accepted complete sum file " <> key, TrueQ[receipt["passed"]] &&
      receipt["result_sha256"][relative] === IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64]];
    record = bounded[Get[path], {key, "complete sum reader"}];
    gate["complete sum conventions " <> key, record["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-complete-component-sum-v1" &&
      record["InputHash"] === inputHash && record["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && record["Key"] === key &&
      record["SourceHash"] === FileHash[projectBase, "SHA256"] &&
      record["ManifestHash"] === FileHash[assemblyManifestPath, "SHA256"] &&
      record["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} && And @@ Values[record["Checks"]]];
    AssociateTo[entries, key -> record["Value"]]; AssociateTo[sumHashes, relative -> FileHash[path, "SHA256"]];
    Clear[record]; ClearSystemCache[], {position, required}];
  Do[
    key = "Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ position, "_"];
    gate["complete sum Hermiticity " <> key, bounded[zeroArray[entries[key] - factoredRealConjugate[
      entries["Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ Reverse[position], "_"]]]], {key, "full native Hermiticity"}]],
    {position, positions}];
  photon = Total[(Extract[Transpose[dual], #] entries["Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ #, "_"]] &) /@ positions];
  Clear[entries]; ClearSystemCache[];
  {responseSeconds, response} = AbsoluteTiming[First[bounded[
    compactSpinResponse[{photon}, inVariables, outVariables], "complete original spin extraction"]]];
  reconstruction = bounded[structuralSpinReconstruction[photon, response, inVariables, outVariables],
    "complete native spin reconstruction"];
  gate["entire actual spin polynomial reconstructed", TrueQ[reconstruction["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[reconstruction["Checks"]]];
  cdrRules = Thread[Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]] ->
    (If[MemberQ[{eIn, eOut}, #], 1, 0] & /@ Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]])];
  cdrAverage = If[incomingQuark, 1, basis["IncomingDensityNormalization"]/gluonDimensions[p]];
  reconstructed = cdrAverage (photon /. cdrRules);
  Clear[photon]; ClearSystemCache[];
  directory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_projected_components_result", "Photon_" <> ToString[component]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-complete-photon-spin-component-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "Component" -> component, "PhotonLabel" -> basis["PhotonLabels"][[component]], "Response" -> response,
    "CDRPhotonCoefficient" -> reconstructed, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SumInputHashes" -> sumHashes, "SourceHash" -> FileHash[projectSource, "SHA256"],
    "BasisHash" -> FileHash[basisPath, "SHA256"], "ControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],
    "ReconstructionAlgorithmHash" -> FileHash[proofPath, "SHA256"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "IncomingVariables" -> inVariables, "OutgoingVariables" -> outVariables, "Reconstruction" -> reconstruction,
    "OriginalControlSeconds" -> originalSeconds, "CandidateControlSeconds" -> candidateSeconds,
    "ResponseSeconds" -> responseSeconds, "ElapsedSeconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started,
    "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[], "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  put[result, FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_result.wl"}]];
  report = <|"channel" -> channel, "component" -> component, "checks" -> checks,
    "response_bytes" -> ByteCount[response], "original_control_seconds" -> originalSeconds,
    "candidate_control_seconds" -> candidateSeconds, "response_seconds" -> responseSeconds,
    "elapsed_seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started, "peak_kernel_memory_bytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[],
    "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_checks.json"}], report, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s05_project_Hgg_component_sum"]; Quit[0]];
ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-66", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5690, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_project_Hgg_entrywise_spin.wls", "sha256": "cf900acf03c03f50f365d844143f7c8107b34d15e80d180c2aa05fb295f7c1b9"} -->
```wolfram
(* Extract accepted sum entries before applying the inherited photon weights. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
entrywiseSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s05_project_Hgg_entrywise_spin.wls"}];
entrywiseParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s05_project_Hgg_streamed_terms.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[entrywiseParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "ee3d71aefbbd86bf1f766573062db602b685ef94ae8285c8cf64d35ce84a2c83"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[entrywiseSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
entrywiseText=StringTrim[Import[entrywiseParent,"Text"]];
entrywiseTerminal="ToExpression[streamedStructuralRun,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[entrywiseText,entrywiseTerminal],Quit[1]];
entrywisePrefix=StringDrop[entrywiseText,-StringLength[entrywiseTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[entrywisePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[entrywisePrefix,InputForm];

entrywiseSpinProjection[values_,weights_,incoming_,outgoing_] := Module[
 {variables,shape,symbolic,contract,linearCheck,packets,evidence,response,started=AbsoluteTime[]},
 variables=DeleteCases[Join[incoming,outgoing],1];shape={Length[outgoing],Length[incoming]};
 gate["actual photon weights independent of spin",Length[values]===Length[weights]&&
   Length[values]>0&&FreeQ[weights,Alternatives@@variables]];
 symbolic=Table[Unique["entrywiseCoefficient"],{k,Length[values]},{j,Length[outgoing]},{i,Length[incoming]}];
 contract[m_] := Sum[incoming[[i]]outgoing[[j]]m[[j,i]],{j,Length[outgoing]},{i,Length[incoming]}];
 linearCheck=Expand[Total[MapThread[Times,{weights,contract/@symbolic}]]-
   contract[Total[MapThread[Times,{weights,symbolic}]]]]===0;
 gate["exact photon and spin projection linearity",linearCheck];
 packets=Table[Print["ENTRYWISE_SPIN_INPUT ",k,"/",Length[values]," bytes ",ByteCount[values[[k]]]];
   streamedStructuralExtract[values[[k]],incoming,outgoing],{k,Length[values]}];
 evidence=KeyDrop[#,"Response"]&/@packets;
 gate["every complete entry reconstructed",And@@Lookup[evidence,"Accepted"]&&
   And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@evidence]];
 response=Total[MapThread[Times,{weights,Lookup[packets,"Response"]}]];
 gate["complete weighted spin shape",Dimensions[response]===shape];
 Clear[packets,symbolic];ClearSystemCache[];
 <|"Response"->response,"Accepted"->True,"Checks"-><|"ExactPhotonSpinLinearity"->linearCheck,
   "EveryEntryReconstructed"->And@@Lookup[evidence,"Accepted"],"CompleteShape"->(Dimensions[response]===shape)|>,
   "EntryEvidence"->evidence,"Seconds"->AbsoluteTime[]-started,"ResponseBytes"->ByteCount[response],
   "PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];

entrywiseOld= "  photon = Total[(Extract[Transpose[dual], #] entries[\"Photon_\" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ #, \"_\"]] &) /@ positions];\n  Clear[entries]; ClearSystemCache[];\n"<>streamedStructuralReplacement;
entrywiseNew="  entrywiseWeights=Extract[Transpose[dual],#]&/@positions;\n  entrywiseValues=entries[\"Photon_\"<>StringRiffle[ToString/@#,\"_\"]]&/@positions;\n  {responseSeconds,entrywisePacket}=AbsoluteTiming[entrywiseSpinProjection[entrywiseValues,entrywiseWeights,inVariables,outVariables]];\n  response=entrywisePacket[\"Response\"];reconstruction=KeyDrop[entrywisePacket,\"Response\"];Clear[entrywisePacket];\n  cdrRules=Thread[Join[Rest[inVariables],Rest[outVariables]]->(If[MemberQ[{eIn,eOut},#],1,0]&/@Join[Rest[inVariables],Rest[outVariables]])];\n  entrywiseCDR=Total[MapThread[Times,{entrywiseWeights,(#/.cdrRules)&/@entrywiseValues}]];\n  Clear[entries,entrywiseValues,entrywiseWeights];ClearSystemCache[];";
entrywiseControl="  Clear[control, controlPhoton, controlResponse, proof]; ClearSystemCache[];";
entrywiseControlNew="  entrywiseControlPacket=entrywiseSpinProjection[Extract[control[\"PhotonMatrix\"],#]&/@positions,Extract[Transpose[dual],#]&/@positions,inVariables,outVariables];\n  gate[\"own original weighted response exactly reproduced\",TrueQ[entrywiseControlPacket[\"Accepted\"]]&&bounded[zeroArray[algebraicReduce[entrywiseControlPacket[\"Response\"]-controlResponse]],\"own weighted response comparison\"]];Clear[entrywiseControlPacket];\n"<>entrywiseControl;
entrywiseHermiticity="    gate[\"complete sum Hermiticity \" <> key, bounded[hggReducedHermiticity[entries[key],\n      entries[\"Photon_\" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ Reverse[position], \"_\"]]], {key, \"full native Hermiticity\"}]],";
entrywiseHermiticityNew="    gate[\"complete sum Hermiticity \" <> key, hggReducedHermiticity[entries[key],\n      entries[\"Photon_\" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ Reverse[position], \"_\"]]]],";
entrywiseChanges={entrywiseOld->entrywiseNew,entrywiseControl->entrywiseControlNew,
 entrywiseHermiticity->entrywiseHermiticityNew,
 "answer = Total[termConjugate /@ parts];"->"answer = Total[(bounded[termConjugate[#],\"native conjugation term\"]&) /@ parts];",
 "{seconds,reduced}=AbsoluteTiming[algebraicReduce[difference]];"->"{seconds,reduced}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[algebraicReduce[difference],\"native Hermiticity residual reduction\"]];",
 "  reconstructed = cdrAverage (photon /. cdrRules);"->"  reconstructed = cdrAverage entrywiseCDR;Clear[entrywiseCDR];",
 "\"StreamingDispatchHash\"->FileHash[streamedStructuralSource,\"SHA256\"],"->
 "\"StreamingDispatchHash\"->FileHash[streamedStructuralSource,\"SHA256\"],\n    \"EntrywiseDispatchHash\"->FileHash[entrywiseSource,\"SHA256\"],"};
If[!And@@(StringCount[streamedStructuralRun,First[#]]===1&/@entrywiseChanges),
 Print["FAIL: unique entrywise projection interfaces"];Quit[1]];
entrywiseRun=StringReplace[streamedStructuralRun,entrywiseChanges];
If[!SyntaxQ[entrywiseRun]||StringReplace[entrywiseRun,Reverse/@entrywiseChanges]=!=streamedStructuralRun,
 Print["FAIL: unchanged remaining projection and output equations"];Quit[1]];
ToExpression[entrywiseRun,InputForm];
```

## common/s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-67", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7092, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls", "sha256": "fc9e17ee0bb7d4cfa7ae517dfcc166c1c273dac1177c8d21d153cc6bfdf1acaa"} -->
```wolfram
(* Keep projection equations unchanged; compress native response entries separately. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
piecewiseSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls"}];
piecewiseParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s05_project_Hgg_entrywise_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[piecewiseParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "cf900acf03c03f50f365d844143f7c8107b34d15e80d180c2aa05fb295f7c1b9"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[piecewiseSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
piecewiseText=StringTrim[Import[piecewiseParent,"Text"]];
piecewiseTerminal="ToExpression[entrywiseRun,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[piecewiseText,piecewiseTerminal],Quit[1]];
piecewisePrefix=StringDrop[piecewiseText,-StringLength[piecewiseTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[piecewisePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[piecewisePrefix,InputForm];

writePiecewiseProjection[value_,resultPath_,relativeBase_] := Module[
 {shape,keys,metadata,positions,piece,compressed,chunk,parts={},groups={},indices,path,directory,
 reader,roundTrip,manifest,manifestPath,started=AbsoluteTime[],before=MemoryInUse[],n=0},
 shape=Dimensions[value["Response"]];keys=Keys[value];metadata=KeyDrop[value,{"Response","CDRPhotonCoefficient"}];
 gate["complete piecewise projection schema",AssociationQ[value]&&Length[shape]===2&&
   MemberQ[keys,"Response"]&&MemberQ[keys,"CDRPhotonCoefficient"]];
 positions=Tuples[Range/@shape];directory=DirectoryName[resultPath];
 If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 Print["PIECEWISE_STORAGE_INPUT ",InputForm[<|"Bytes"->ByteCount[value],"ResponseBytes"->ByteCount[value["Response"]],
   "CDRBytes"->ByteCount[value["CDRPhotonCoefficient"]],"MemoryBytes"->before,"Shape"->shape|>]];
 Do[
   piece=Which[k===1,metadata,k===Length[positions]+2,value["CDRPhotonCoefficient"],True,Extract[value["Response"],positions[[k-1]]]];
   compressed=bounded[Compress[piece],{"projection piece compression",k}];
   gate["exact individual native piece round trip",bounded[Uncompress[compressed]===piece,{"projection piece reload",k}]];
   indices={};
   Do[n++;AppendTo[indices,n];
     chunk=StringTake[compressed,{offset,Min[offset+32*1024^2-1,StringLength[compressed]]}];
     path=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s05_payload_"<>IntegerString[n,10,4]<>".txt"}];
     Export[path<>".tmp",chunk,"Text"];
     gate["bounded exact native payload text",FileByteCount[path<>".tmp"]<128*1024^2&&Import[path<>".tmp","Text"]===chunk];
     RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True];
     AppendTo[parts,<|"file"->relativeBase<>"/"<>FileNameTake[path],"name"->FileNameTake[path],
       "bytes"->FileByteCount[path],"sha256"->IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]|>],
     {offset,1,StringLength[compressed],32*1024^2}];
   AppendTo[groups,indices];Clear[piece,compressed,chunk];ClearSystemCache[];
```

```wolfram
  answers=Table[
    {seconds,packet}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[structuralSpinExtraction[parts[[k]],incoming,outgoing],
      {"structural spin term",k}]];
    gate["exact structural term reconstruction",TrueQ[packet["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]&&
      Dimensions[packet["Response"]]===shape];
    AppendTo[evidence,Join[KeyDrop[packet,"Response"],<|"Term"->k,"TermHash"->Hash[parts[[k]],"SHA256"],"Seconds"->seconds|>]];
    If[Mod[k,100]===0||k===Length[parts],Print["STREAMED_STRUCTURAL_PROGRESS ",k,"/",Length[parts]," memory ",MemoryInUse[]]];

  <|"Response"->answer,"Accepted"->And@@Values[checks],"Checks"->checks,"TermEvidence"->evidence,

    "KernelMemoryBytes"->MemoryInUse[],"PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];
streamedStructuralOriginal="  {responseSeconds, response} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[hggProjectionExtractOne[photon, inVariables, outVariables], \"complete structural spin extraction\"]];\n  reconstruction = bounded[structuralSpinReconstruction[photon, response, inVariables, outVariables],\n    \"complete native spin reconstruction\"];";

streamedStructuralControlReplacement="  streamedStructuralControlPacket=streamedStructuralExtract[controlPhoton,inVariables,outVariables];\n  gate[\"own accepted response equals streamed structural response\",TrueQ[streamedStructuralControlPacket[\"Accepted\"]]&&And@@Values[streamedStructuralControlPacket[\"Checks\"]]&&streamedStructuralControlPacket[\"Response\"]===controlResponse];Clear[streamedStructuralControlPacket];\n"<>streamedStructuralControl;
streamedStructuralMetadata="\"ReductionDispatchHash\" -> FileHash[reducedProjectionSource,\"SHA256\"],";
streamedStructuralChanges={streamedStructuralOriginal->streamedStructuralReplacement,
  streamedStructuralControl->streamedStructuralControlReplacement,
  streamedStructuralMetadata->(streamedStructuralMetadata<>"\n    \"StreamingDispatchHash\"->FileHash[streamedStructuralSource,\"SHA256\"],")};
If[!And@@(StringCount[reducedProjectionRun,First[#]]===1&/@streamedStructuralChanges),
  Print["FAIL: unique complete structural extraction interfaces"];Quit[1]];
streamedStructuralRun=StringReplace[reducedProjectionRun,streamedStructuralChanges];
If[!SyntaxQ[streamedStructuralRun]||StringReplace[streamedStructuralRun,Reverse/@streamedStructuralChanges]=!=reducedProjectionRun,
  Print["FAIL: unchanged photon projection and acceptance gates"];Quit[1]];
ToExpression[streamedStructuralRun,InputForm];
```

```wolfram
If[StringCount[equationReaderPrefix, equationReaderPackage] =!= 1,

PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
equationReaderPrefix = StringReplace[equationReaderPrefix, equationReaderPackage ->
  "gate[\"native package already loaded\", ValueQ[$FeynCalcVersion]];"];

ToExpression[equationReaderPrefix, InputForm];
label = "RealSame";

equationFieldSetup = sourceSection[equationReaderText, "\n  amplitudes =", "  quarkIn ="];
gate["unchanged complete field setup", SyntaxQ[equationFieldSetup]];
ToExpression[equationFieldSetup, InputForm];
equationComponents = {8, 9};
gate["components belong to actual photon inventory", And @@ (MemberQ[Range[Length[basis["PhotonDual"]]], #] & /@ equationComponents)];
equationSymbolicMatrix = Array[reconstructionEntry, Dimensions[First[basis["PhotonDual"]]]];
equationDefinitions = Tr[#.equationSymbolicMatrix] & /@ basis["PhotonDual"][[equationComponents]];
equationEntries = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[equationDefinitions, _reconstructionEntry, Infinity]];
equationInputHashes = <||>;
equationRules = Table[
  equationKey = "Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ (List @@ entry), "_"];
  equationPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_assembled_" <> equationKey <> ".wl"}];
  equationPacket = Get[equationPath];
  gate["saved equation identity " <> equationKey, AssociationQ[equationPacket] &&
    equationPacket["InputHash"] === inputHash && equationPacket["Key"] === equationKey &&
    AssociationQ[equationPacket["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[equationPacket["Checks"]]];
  AssociateTo[equationInputHashes, StringDrop[equationPath, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[equationPath, "SHA256"]];
  entry -> equationPacket["Value"], {entry, equationEntries}];

gate["complete actual photon equations", FreeQ[equationValues, _reconstructionEntry | _Missing | $Failed | $Aborted]];

equationBindings = MapThread[Hash[{inputHash, label, {#1, #2, #3}, inVariables, outVariables}, "SHA256"] &,
  {equationComponents, equationValues, equationResponses}];
equationControlPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_spin_reconstruction_" <> ToString[First[equationComponents]] <> ".wl"}];
equationControl = Get[equationControlPath];
gate["own accepted reconstruction control", equationControl["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
  equationControl["Binding"] === First[equationBindings] && TrueQ[equationControl["Accepted"]] &&
  AssociationQ[equationControl["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[equationControl["Checks"]]];
AssociateTo[equationInputHashes, StringDrop[equationControlPath, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[equationControlPath, "SHA256"]];
equationResultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_reconstruction_equation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[equationResultDirectory], CreateDirectory[equationResultDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
equationFiles = Table[
  equationFile = FileNameJoin[{equationResultDirectory, "s05_input_" <> IntegerString[equationComponents[[i]], 10, 2] <> ".wl"}];
  put[equationValues[[i]], equationFile];
  gate["bounded readable equation " <> ToString[equationComponents[[i]]], FileByteCount[equationFile] < 128*1024^2];
  gate["readable equation exact reload " <> ToString[equationComponents[[i]]], Get[equationFile] === equationValues[[i]]];
  <|"Component" -> equationComponents[[i]], "File" -> StringDrop[equationFile, StringLength[root] + 1],
    "SHA256" -> IntegerString[FileHash[equationFile, "SHA256"], 16, 64], "FileBytes" -> FileByteCount[equationFile],
    "NativeBytes" -> ByteCount[equationValues[[i]]]|>, {i, Length[equationComponents]}];

  "Components" -> equationComponents, "Equations" -> equationValues, "Responses" -> equationResponses,

  "AcceptedControl" -> equationControl, "Files" -> equationFiles, "InputHash" -> inputHash,
  "PhysicalInputHashes" -> inputHashes, "EquationInputHashes" -> equationInputHashes,
  "ExtractionDefinitions" -> DownValues[compactSpinResponse], "ReconstructionDefinitions" -> DownValues[spinPolynomialZero],

equationResultPath = FileNameJoin[{equationResultDirectory, "s05_result.wl"}];

gate["bounded equation packet", StringLength[equationSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[equationResultPath, equationSerialized, "Text"];
gate["complete equation packet exact reload", Get[equationResultPath] === equationResult];
Export[FileNameJoin[{equationResultDirectory, "s05_checks.json"}],
  <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks, "equation_files" -> equationFiles,
    "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_read_reconstruction_equations"]; Quit[0];
```
