```wolfram
(* Check the saved spin polynomial while retaining exact kinematic coefficients. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[]; checks = <||>;
source = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_check_structural_reconstruction.wls"}];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test], Print["PASS: ", name]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete comparison source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[source, "Text"]]];
inputRelative = "Hqq/s05_reconstruction_equation_result/s05_result.wl";
inputPath = FileNameJoin[{root, inputRelative}];
receiptPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqq", "s05_reconstruction_equation_result", "s05_execution.json"}];
gate["pinned actual equation packet", IntegerString[FileHash[inputPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "5e8e0d77dd233652180a509771ac8e770a80a99d4105ae651806e90dcc29d8ba"];
gate["pinned accepted equation receipt", IntegerString[FileHash[receiptPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "c97606f20b945ee4f8c023b4b4c2a935d2ad323a901efffc25a85440458a08ba"];
receipt = Import[receiptPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["equation reader accepted", TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]];
KeyValueMap[gate["reader artifact " <> #1, IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === #2] &,
  receipt["result_sha256"]];
input = Get[inputPath];
gate["actual channel and equation schema", input["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-reconstruction-equations-v1" &&
  input["Channel"] === "Hqq" && input["Sector"] === "RealSame" && input["Components"] === {8, 9} &&
  And @@ Values[input["Checks"]] && input["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
gate["equation reader source identity", input["SourceHash"] === FileHash[
  FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_read_reconstruction_equations.wls"}], "SHA256"]];
gate["unchanged production source", input["ProductionSourceHash"] === FileHash[
  FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_real_spin_response_cached_scalar.wls"}], "SHA256"]];
KeyValueMap[gate["physical input " <> #1, FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}], "SHA256"] === #2] &, input["PhysicalInputHashes"]];
KeyValueMap[gate["saved equation input " <> #1, FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}], "SHA256"] === #2] &, input["EquationInputHashes"]];
DownValues[compactSpinResponse] = input["ExtractionDefinitions"];
gate["unchanged native extraction installed", DownValues[compactSpinResponse] === input["ExtractionDefinitions"]];

structuralSpinReconstruction[expression_, response_, incoming_, outgoing_] := Module[
  {variables, pattern, replacements = {}, atom, shrink, opaque, extracted, reconstructed, restored,
   evidence, started = AbsoluteTime[]},
  variables = DeleteCases[Join[incoming, outgoing], 1]; pattern = Alternatives @@ variables;
  atom[value_] := atom[value] = Module[{symbol = Unique["sidisSpinCoefficient"]},
    AppendTo[replacements, symbol -> value]; symbol];
  shrink[value_] := If[FreeQ[value, pattern], If[AtomQ[value], value, atom[value]], Map[shrink, value]];
  opaque = shrink[expression];
  evidence = <|"DistinctSpinVariables" -> DuplicateFreeQ[variables],
    "SpinIndependentCoefficients" -> FreeQ[Last /@ replacements, pattern],
    "ExactExpressionRestoration" -> ((opaque /. replacements) === expression),
    "PolynomialSpinDependence" -> PolynomialQ[opaque, variables]|>;
  extracted = First[compactSpinResponse[{opaque}, incoming, outgoing]];
  reconstructed = Sum[incoming[[i]] outgoing[[j]] extracted[[j, i]], {i, Length[incoming]}, {j, Length[outgoing]}];
  restored = extracted /. replacements;
  AssociateTo[evidence, "ExactAbstractReconstruction" -> (Expand[opaque - reconstructed] === 0),
    "ExactExistingResponse" -> (restored === response)];
  <|"Accepted" -> (And @@ Values[evidence]), "Checks" -> evidence,
    "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[expression], "AbstractBytes" -> ByteCount[opaque],
    "CoefficientCount" -> Length[replacements], "Seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started,
    "KernelMemoryBytes" -> MemoryInUse[], "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];

measurements = Table[
  Print["STRUCTURAL_RECONSTRUCTION ", input["Components"][[i]]];
  binding = Hash[{input["InputHash"], input["Sector"],
    {input["Components"][[i]], input["Equations"][[i]], input["Responses"][[i]]},
    input["IncomingVariables"], input["OutgoingVariables"]}, "SHA256"];
  gate["exact task binding " <> ToString[input["Components"][[i]]], binding === input["Bindings"][[i]]];
  candidate = MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[
    structuralSpinReconstruction[input["Equations"][[i]], input["Responses"][[i]],
      input["IncomingVariables"], input["OutgoingVariables"]], 600, gate["comparison time bound", False]],
    4*1024^3, gate["comparison memory bound", False]];
  KeyValueMap[gate[ToString[input["Components"][[i]]] <> " " <> #1, #2] &, candidate["Checks"]];
  gate["complete reconstruction accepted " <> ToString[input["Components"][[i]]], candidate["Accepted"]];
  If[i === 1, gate["own accepted reconstruction comparison", candidate["Accepted"] === input["AcceptedControl"]["Accepted"] &&
    input["AcceptedControl"]["Binding"] === binding]];
  row = Join[candidate, <|"Component" -> input["Components"][[i]], "Binding" -> binding|>];
  Print["STRUCTURAL_RECONSTRUCTION_MEASUREMENT ", InputForm[row]]; ClearSystemCache[]; row,
  {i, Length[input["Components"]]}];
controlResponse = First[input["Responses"]];
controlPositions = Position[controlResponse, value_ /; value =!= 0, {2}];
gate["nonzero saved response control", controlPositions =!= {}];
perturbation = Unique["incorrectSpinCoefficient"];
incorrectResponse = ReplacePart[controlResponse, First[controlPositions] ->
  (Extract[controlResponse, First[controlPositions]] + perturbation)];
negativeControl = MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[
  structuralSpinReconstruction[First[input["Equations"]], incorrectResponse,
    input["IncomingVariables"], input["OutgoingVariables"]], 600, gate["negative control time bound", False]],
  4*1024^3, gate["negative control memory bound", False]];
gate["changed response rejected", negativeControl["Accepted"] === False &&
  negativeControl["Checks"]["ExactExistingResponse"] === False &&
  And @@ Values[KeyDrop[negativeControl["Checks"], "ExactExistingResponse"]]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-structural-reconstruction-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> input["Channel"],
  "Sector" -> input["Sector"], "SourceHash" -> FileHash[source, "SHA256"],
  "EquationResultHash" -> FileHash[inputPath, "SHA256"], "EquationReceiptHash" -> FileHash[receiptPath, "SHA256"],
  "InputHash" -> input["InputHash"], "InputHashes" -> input["PhysicalInputHashes"],
  "EquationInputHashes" -> input["EquationInputHashes"], "IncomingVariables" -> input["IncomingVariables"],
  "OutgoingVariables" -> input["OutgoingVariables"], "Measurements" -> measurements,
  "NegativeControl" -> negativeControl, "CandidateDefinitions" -> DownValues[structuralSpinReconstruction],
  "ExtractionDefinitions" -> DownValues[compactSpinResponse], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqq", "s05_structural_reconstruction_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDirectory], CreateDirectory[resultDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s05_result.wl"}];
Put[result, resultPath]; gate["exact comparison result reload", Get[resultPath] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> input["Channel"], "checks" -> checks,
  "measurements" -> measurements, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_check_structural_reconstruction"]; Quit[0];
```

## common/s05_result/reference/s05_compact_checkpoints_before_native_initialization.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-97", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3460, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_result/reference/s05_compact_checkpoints_before_native_initialization.wls", "sha256": "774ce6aba315283d971d64c25cde8f319437b62df9ce7281c2d99cd2434848ca"} -->
```wolfram
(* Retain the accepted cached-scalar calculation with lossless checkpoint storage. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
checkpointDispatchPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response_compact_checkpoints.wls"}];
checkpointBasePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response_cached_scalar.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[checkpointBasePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ee4189f1cc6b6e1aa618ffc9ff40878a8cb6bd806ed880679d16bb7c209e68ff",
  Print["FAIL: immutable cached-scalar implementation"]; Quit[1]];
checkpointCode = Import[checkpointBasePath, "Text"];
checkpointOld = "put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> \".tmp\"];\n  RenameFile[path <> \".tmp\", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);";
checkpointNew = "put[value_, path_] := Module[{serialized, temporary},\n  serialized = \"Uncompress[\" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[value], \"checkpoint compression\"], InputForm] <> \"]\\n\";\n  gate[\"compressed checkpoint below file bound\", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];\n  temporary = path <> \".\" <> ToString[$ProcessID] <> \".tmp\";\n  Export[temporary, serialized, \"Text\"];\n  gate[\"compressed checkpoint exact native reload\", bounded[Get[temporary] === value, \"checkpoint reload\"]];\n  RenameFile[temporary, path, OverwriteTarget -> True]];";
checkpointInitialization = "$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {\"FeynArts\"}; Get[\"FeynCalc`\"];\ngate[\"complete source syntax\", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, \"Text\"]]];";
checkpointProofCode = "\ncheckpointProofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, \"Hgg\", \"s05_pair_storage_result\", \"s05_result.wl\"}];\ncheckpointProofSHA = Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_STORAGE_PROOF_SHA256\"];\ngate[\"pinned complete own checkpoint storage proof\", channel === \"Hgg\" && StringQ[checkpointProofSHA] &&\n  IntegerString[FileHash[checkpointProofPath, \"SHA256\"], 16, 64] === checkpointProofSHA];\ncheckpointProof = Get[checkpointProofPath];\ngate[\"accepted native checkpoint representation\", checkpointProof[\"Schema\"] === \"polarized-sidis-native-pair-storage-v1\" &&\n  checkpointProof[\"SourceHash\"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, \"common\", \"s05_compact_pair_checkpoints.wls\"}], \"SHA256\"] &&\n  checkpointProof[\"NativeVersions\"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} && Length[checkpointProof[\"Files\"]] > 0 &&\n  And @@ Values[checkpointProof[\"Checks\"]] && And @@ Lookup[checkpointProof[\"Files\"], \"exact_native_reload\"]];\ngate[\"complete checkpoint dispatch syntax\", SyntaxQ[Import[checkpointDispatchPath, \"Text\"]]];\n";
checkpointMetadata = "AssociateTo[result, \"ScalarCheckpointValidationHash\" -> FileHash[coefficientProofPath, \"SHA256\"]];";
If[StringCount[checkpointCode, checkpointOld] =!= 1 ||
  StringCount[checkpointCode, checkpointInitialization] =!= 1 ||
  StringCount[checkpointCode, checkpointMetadata] =!= 1,
  Print["FAIL: unique unchanged checkpoint interfaces"]; Quit[1]];
checkpointCode = StringReplace[checkpointCode, {
  checkpointOld -> checkpointNew,
  checkpointInitialization -> (checkpointInitialization <> checkpointProofCode),
  checkpointMetadata -> (checkpointMetadata <>
    "\nAssociateTo[result, {\"CheckpointStorageValidationHash\" -> FileHash[checkpointProofPath, \"SHA256\"],\n  \"CheckpointStorageDispatchHash\" -> FileHash[checkpointDispatchPath, \"SHA256\"]}];")}];
If[!SyntaxQ[checkpointCode], Print["FAIL: complete compact-checkpoint calculation syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[checkpointCode, InputForm];
```

## common/s05_result/reference/s05_early_ward_reference.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-98", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6580, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_result/reference/s05_early_ward_reference.wl", "sha256": "58d7024296a43684ec66162dac1fd76b5843083d20d566f6b0db82c0d2ef1a94"} -->
```wolfram
(* Independent, pairwise physical-polarization contraction of gamma* q -> g q g. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
Get["FeynCalc`"];
root = DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
ClearAll[gate, setKinematics, dot, scalarPair, bounded, cachedPair];
gate[name_, condition_] := If[TrueQ[condition], Print["PASS: ", name], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[work_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[work, 900,
  Print["Time limit: ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["Memory limit: ", label, "; earlier checkpoints are retained."]; Quit[3]];
gate["amplitude and Born inputs exist", And @@ (FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{root, #}]] & /@
 {"s02_result.wl", "s04_result.wl"})];
raw = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s04_result.wl"}]];
born = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}]];
bornAmplitudes = raw["Born"] /. {SMP["e"] -> 1, SMP["g_s"] -> 1};
realAmplitudes = raw["Real"] /. {SMP["e"] -> 1, SMP["g_s"] -> 1};
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "s05_cache"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache]];
inputHash = Hash[{FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s04_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
                  FileHash[$InputFileName, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];

(* All scalar products follow from invariant definitions and momentum conservation. *)
setKinematics[isReal_] := Module[{basis, gram, unknowns, remainder, equations, solution, momenta, rows},
 FCClearScalarProducts[];
 If[isReal,
  basis = {p, q, k1, k2};
  gram = {{0, pq, pk1, pk2}, {pq, -Q2, qk1, qk2},
          {pk1, qk1, 0, k1k2}, {pk2, qk2, k1k2, 0}};
  unknowns = {pq, pk1, pk2, qk1, qk2, k1k2};
  remainder = p + q - k1 - k2,
  basis = {p, q, k1};
  gram = {{0, pq, pk1}, {pq, -Q2, qk1}, {pk1, qk1, 0}};
  unknowns = {pq, pk1, qk1};
  remainder = p + q - k1];
 dot[v_, w_] := Expand[(Coefficient[v, #] & /@ basis).gram.(Coefficient[w, #] & /@ basis)];
 equations = {dot[p + q, p + q] == s, dot[q - k1, q - k1] == t, dot[remainder, remainder] == 0};
 If[isReal, equations = Join[equations, {
    dot[p + q - k1, p + q - k1] == s23,
    dot[k1 + k2, k1 + k2] == a12, dot[p - remainder, p - remainder] == u3}]];
 solution = First[Solve[equations, unknowns]];
 momenta = If[isReal, {p, q, k1, k2, k3}, {p, q, k1, k2}];
 rows = Flatten[Table[{momenta[[i]], momenta[[j]],
    Factor[dot[momenta[[i]] /. If[isReal, k3 -> remainder, k2 -> remainder],
               momenta[[j]] /. If[isReal, k3 -> remainder, k2 -> remainder]] /. solution]},
   {i, Length[momenta]}, {j, i, Length[momenta]}], 1];
 Scan[Function[row, With[{v = row[[1]], w = row[[2]], val = row[[3]]}, SPD[v, w] = val; SP[v, w] = val]], rows];
 rows];

scalarPair[left_, right_, mode_, gluons_] := Module[{a = left, b = right, expression},
 Switch[mode,
  "Ppp", a = a /. Polarization[q, ___] -> p; b = b /. Polarization[q, ___] -> p,
  "PhotonWard", a = a /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q; b = b /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q,
  "Gluon1Ward", a = a /. Polarization[k1, ___] -> k1; b = b /. Polarization[k1, ___] -> k1,
  "Gluon3Ward", a = a /. Polarization[k3, ___] -> k3; b = b /. Polarization[k3, ___] -> k3];
 expression = FermionSpinSum[a ComplexConjugate[b], ExtraFactor -> 1/(2 SUNN)];
 expression = SUNSimplify[expression, Explicit -> True, SUNNToCACF -> False];
 If[MemberQ[{"Pg", "Gluon1Ward", "Gluon3Ward"}, mode],
   expression = -DoPolarizationSums[expression, q, 0, VirtualBoson -> True]];
 Do[If[!((mode == "Gluon1Ward" && momentum === k1) ||
          (mode == "Gluon3Ward" && momentum === k3)),
   expression = DoPolarizationSums[expression, momentum, p]], {momentum, gluons}];
 expression = DiracSimplify[expression, DiracTraceEvaluate -> True] // Contract;
 expression = expression // FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit // ExpandScalarProduct;
 Factor[expression]];

bornScalarProducts = setKinematics[False];
bornComputed = Table[bounded[scalarPair[Total[bornAmplitudes], Total[bornAmplitudes], mode, {k1}], mode],
                     {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
ratios = Factor /@ (bornComputed/{born["BornPg"], born["BornPpp"]});
gate["FeynArts Born agrees with the independently constructed current", SameQ @@ ratios &&
 FreeQ[ratios, s | t | Q2 | D | SUNN | _Pair | _DiracTrace | _Spinor]];
chargeSquared = First[ratios];
gate["model charge normalization is a positive exact constant", TrueQ[chargeSquared > 0] && FreeQ[chargeSquared, _Real]];
Print["Model charge squared = ", InputForm[chargeSquared]];

realScalarProducts = setKinematics[True];
(* Labeled diagrams; sum over the two possible gluon tags and divide by 2!. *)
finalSpecies = {gluon, quark, gluon};
tagWeight = Count[finalSpecies, gluon]/Times @@ (Factorial /@ Values[Counts[finalSpecies]]);
Print["Measured tagged phase-space weight = ", tagWeight];
cachedPair[mode_, i_, j_] := Module[{file, saved, value},
 file = FileNameJoin[{cache, mode <> "_" <> IntegerString[i, 10, 2] <> "_" <> IntegerString[j, 10, 2] <> ".wl"}];
 If[FileExistsQ[file], saved = Get[file]; If[AssociationQ[saved] && saved["InputHash"] === inputHash, Return[saved["Value"]]]];
 Print[mode, " pair ", i, ",", j, "; memory = ", MemoryInUse[], " bytes."];
 value = bounded[scalarPair[realAmplitudes[[i]], realAmplitudes[[j]], mode, {k1, k3}], {mode, i, j}];
 If[i != j, value = Factor[ComplexExpand[value + Conjugate[value]]]];
 value = Factor[tagWeight value/chargeSquared];
 If[AssociationQ[saved], gate["reordered contraction equals saved pair", Factor[value - saved["Value"]] === 0]];
 gate["pair is a scalar rational expression", FreeQ[value,
  _Spinor | _DiracTrace | _DiracGamma | _SUNTF | _SUNTrace | _Pair | _Polarization | _Real]];
 Put[<|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "Value" -> value|>, file];
 value];

results = <||>;
Do[
 pairs = Flatten[Table[cachedPair[mode, i, j], {i, Length[realAmplitudes]}, {j, i, Length[realAmplitudes]}]];
 Print[mode, ": combining checkpointed pairs."];
 value = bounded[Factor[Total[pairs]], mode <> " sum"];
 If[StringContainsQ[mode, "Ward"], gate[mode, value === 0]];
 Put[value, FileNameJoin[{root, "s05_" <> mode <> ".wl"}]];
 AssociateTo[results, mode -> value];
 Print[mode, " complete; leaves = ", LeafCount[value]],
 {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp", "PhotonWard", "Gluon1Ward", "Gluon3Ward"}}];
Put[<|"Contractions" -> results, "BornScalarProducts" -> bornScalarProducts,
 "RealScalarProducts" -> realScalarProducts, "ModelChargeSquared" -> chargeSquared,
 "TagWeight" -> tagWeight, "Inputs" -> "s02 independent current and s04 generated amplitudes",
 "CouplingsRemoved" -> "eq^2 gs^4", "Dimension" -> D|>, FileNameJoin[{root, "s05_result.wl"}]];
Print["Wrote s05_result.wl; peak memory = ", MaxMemoryUsed[], " bytes."];
Quit[];

```

```wolfram
(* Inspect actual timed-out scalar equations without changing production algebra. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
inspectionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_inspect_scalar_equation.wls"}];
inspectionConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_scalar_inspection_inputs.json"}];
inspectionConfig = Import[inspectionConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!= inspectionConfig["production_source_sha256"],
  Print["FAIL: pinned scalar-inspection source"]; Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
productionPrefix = StringTake[productionText, prefixEnd - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[productionPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete production prefix syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];
gate["complete scalar inspection syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[inspectionPath, "Text"]]];
gate["known scalar inspection contract", inspectionConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-inspection-inputs-v1" &&
  channel === inspectionConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hqg" && useRestoredScalar && useFactoredPair];
label = First[labels];
gate["one inspected real sector", labels === {label}];
sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["complete unchanged pair definitions syntax", SyntaxQ[sectorCode]];
ToExpression[sectorCode];
pair = inspectionConfig["pair"]; indices = inspectionConfig["photon_indices"];
gate["actual native projection inventory", MemberQ[pairs, pair] && Length[indices] === 2 &&
  And @@ (Between[#, {1, Length[photonSymbols]}] & /@ indices)];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, inspectionConfig["control"]["file"]}];
gate["pinned own accepted projection", IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === inspectionConfig["control"]["sha256"]];
control = Get[controlPath];
gate["own accepted projection input binding", control["InputHash"] === inputHash && KeyExistsQ[control, "Value"]];
Clear[control];
inspectionDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_scalar_equation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[inspectionDir], CreateDirectory[inspectionDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
measurements = {}; lastScalarEquation = Missing["NoScalarEquation"];
SetAttributes[inspectOperation, HoldRest];
inspectOperation[name_, expression_] := Module[{seconds, answer, status},
  Print["SCALAR_NATIVE_BEGIN ", name];
  {seconds, answer} = AbsoluteTiming[TimeConstrained[MemoryConstrained[expression, realMemoryLimit,
    Missing["OperationMemoryLimit"]], inspectionConfig["operation_seconds"], Missing["OperationTimeLimit"]]];
  status = If[MissingQ[answer], answer, "Completed"];
  AppendTo[measurements, <|"Operation" -> name, "Seconds" -> seconds, "Status" -> status,
    "ResultBytes" -> ByteCount[answer], "KernelMemoryBytes" -> MemoryInUse[]|>];
  Print["SCALAR_NATIVE_END ", InputForm[Last[measurements]]];
  If[MissingQ[answer], Throw[<|"Status" -> status, "Operation" -> name|>, "ScalarInspection"]]; answer];
originalAlgebraCode = sourceSection[productionText, "algebraicReduceOne[value_] :=", "\npVector ="]; 
instrumentation = {
  "Together[value]" -> "inspectOperation[\"Together input\", Together[value]]",
  "PolynomialExtendedGCD[den, transverseConstraint, transverseK]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"transverse Bezout\", PolynomialExtendedGCD[den, transverseConstraint, transverseK]]",
  "Together[num inverse]" -> "inspectOperation[\"Together inverse product\", Together[num inverse]]",
  "PolynomialReduce[Numerator[work], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"transverse polynomial division\", PolynomialReduce[Numerator[work], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]]",
  "Factor[Last[division]/Denominator[work]]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"Factor on-shell answer\", Factor[Last[division]/Denominator[work]]]",
  "Last[PolynomialReduce[Numerator[Together[rational - answer]], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"complete rational reconstruction\", Last[PolynomialReduce[Numerator[Together[rational - answer]], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]]]",
  "zero[gcd - bezout.{den, transverseConstraint}]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"Bezout equality\", zero[gcd - bezout.{den, transverseConstraint}]]",
  "zero[Numerator[work] - First[First[division]] transverseConstraint - Last[division]]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"division equality\", zero[Numerator[work] - First[First[division]] transverseConstraint - Last[division]]]",
  "zero[proof]" -> "inspectOperation[\"reconstruction equality\", zero[proof]]"};
gate["unique native-operation instrumentation", And @@ (StringCount[originalAlgebraCode, First[#]] === 1 & /@ instrumentation)];
instrumentedAlgebraCode = StringReplace[originalAlgebraCode, instrumentation];
gate["all production equations and checks unchanged", StringReplace[instrumentedAlgebraCode, Reverse /@ instrumentation] === originalAlgebraCode];
instrumentedAlgebraCode = StringReplace[instrumentedAlgebraCode,
  "algebraicReduceOne[value_] :=" -> "inspectedAlgebraicReduceOne[value_] :="];
gate["complete instrumented scalar definition syntax", SyntaxQ[instrumentedAlgebraCode]];
ToExpression[instrumentedAlgebraCode];
algebraicReduceOne[value_] := (lastScalarEquation = value; inspectedAlgebraicReduceOne[value]);
tensor = bounded[buildPair[First[pair], Last[pair], None], {"inspection", pair, "spin closure"}];
projected = photonProject[tensor, photonSymbols[[First[indices]]], photonSymbols[[Last[indices]]]];
{traceSeconds, traced} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[Contract[DiracSimplify[projected, DiracTraceEvaluate -> True]],
  {"inspection", pair, indices, "native trace"}]];
Print["ACTUAL_SCALAR_TRACE ", InputForm[<|"Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices,
  "Seconds" -> traceSeconds, "Bytes" -> ByteCount[traced]|>]];
inspectionOutcome = Catch[TimeConstrained[
  <|"Status" -> "ProjectionCompleted", "Value" -> reduceScalar[traced]|>,
  inspectionConfig["projection_seconds"], <|"Status" -> "ProjectionTimeLimit"|>], "ScalarInspection"];
gate["saved actual scalar equation", !MissingQ[lastScalarEquation] &&
  FreeQ[lastScalarEquation, _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Aborted | $Failed]];
denominatorBases = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[lastScalarEquation, Power[base_, power_Integer /; power < 0] :> base, {0, Infinity}]];
inventory = <|"InputBytes" -> ByteCount[lastScalarEquation], "InputLeaves" -> LeafCount[lastScalarEquation],
  "TopLevelHead" -> ToString[Head[lastScalarEquation], InputForm],
  "TopLevelTerms" -> If[Head[lastScalarEquation] === Plus, Length[lastScalarEquation], 1],
  "DenominatorBases" -> denominatorBases,
  "PolynomialInTransverseCoordinate" -> TimeConstrained[PolynomialQ[lastScalarEquation, transverseK], 30, Missing["NotMeasured"]]|>;
Print["ACTUAL_SCALAR_INVENTORY ", InputForm[KeyDrop[inventory, "DenominatorBases"]]];
Print["ACTUAL_SCALAR_DENOMINATORS ", InputForm[denominatorBases]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-scalar-equation-inspection-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[inspectionPath, "SHA256"], "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[inspectionConfigPath, "SHA256"],
  "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices, "TraceSeconds" -> traceSeconds, "TracedExpression" -> traced,
  "ScalarEquation" -> lastScalarEquation, "TransverseConstraint" -> transverseConstraint,
  "Outcome" -> inspectionOutcome, "Inventory" -> inventory, "Measurements" -> measurements,
  "OriginalAlgebraCode" -> originalAlgebraCode, "InstrumentedAlgebraCode" -> instrumentedAlgebraCode,
  "OriginalControlPath" -> inspectionConfig["control"]["file"], "OriginalControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s05_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[result], "scalar inspection compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded equation artifact", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["actual scalar equation exact round trip", bounded[Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result, "scalar inspection reload"]];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "outcome" -> ToString[KeyDrop[inspectionOutcome, "Value"], InputForm],
  "inventory" -> ToString[inventory, InputForm], "measurements" -> ToString[measurements, InputForm],
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_inspect_scalar_equation"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Check factored pair assembly against an actual accepted complete pair. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
validationSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_pair_assembly_check.wls"}];
validationConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_pair_assembly_inputs.json"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
validationConfig = Import[validationConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!= validationConfig["production_source_sha256"],
  Print["FAIL: pinned pair-assembly production source"]; Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
productionPrefix = StringTake[productionText, prefixEnd - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[productionPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete inherited prefix syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];
gate["complete pair-assembly comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[validationSourcePath, "Text"]]];
gate["known pair-assembly comparison contract",
  validationConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-pair-assembly-comparison-inputs-v1" &&
  channel === validationConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hgg"];
label = First[labels];
gate["single real comparison sector", labels === {label}];
sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["complete inherited pair definitions syntax", SyntaxQ[sectorCode]];
ToExpression[sectorCode];
pair = validationConfig["pair"];
gate["comparison uses an actual generated off-diagonal pair", MemberQ[pairs, pair] && First[pair] =!= Last[pair]];
validationInputHashes = Association@Table[
  gate["pinned pair input " <> relative, IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    validationConfig["files"][relative]];
  relative -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], {relative, Keys[validationConfig["files"]]}];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, validationConfig["control_file"]}];
gate["complete control included in reviewed inputs", KeyExistsQ[validationInputHashes, validationConfig["control_file"]]];
controlRecord = Get[controlPath];
gate["accepted complete pair exact physical input binding", AssociationQ[controlRecord] &&
  controlRecord["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[controlRecord["Checks"]] &&
  MatrixQ[controlRecord["PhotonMatrix"]] && AssociationQ[controlRecord["ScalarModes"]]];
projectionPrefix = FileNameDrop[validationConfig["control_file"], -1] <> "/" <>
  FileBaseName[validationConfig["control_file"]];
readProjection[suffix_] := Module[{relative, record},
  relative = projectionPrefix <> suffix <> ".wl";
  gate["projection included in reviewed pair inputs " <> suffix, KeyExistsQ[validationInputHashes, relative]];
  record = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]];
  gate["projection shares exact physical input " <> suffix,
    AssociationQ[record] && record["InputHash"] === inputHash && KeyExistsQ[record, "Value"]];
  record["Value"]];
rawMatrix = Table[readProjection["_P" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b]],
  {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}];
rawModes = Association@Table[key -> readProjection["_" <> key], {key, Keys[controlRecord["ScalarModes"]]}];
gate["complete raw photon inventory", Dimensions[rawMatrix] === Dimensions[controlRecord["PhotonMatrix"]]];

factoredRealConjugate[value_] := Module[{variables, heads, answer},
  variables = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, _Symbol, {0, Infinity}]];
  heads = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, (expression_ /; !AtomQ[expression]) :> Head[expression], {0, Infinity}]];
  gate["pair inputs have exact rational head support", Complement[heads, {Plus, Times, Power}] === {} &&
    FreeQ[value, _Real | Power[_, exponent_ /; !IntegerQ[exponent]]]];
  gate["native inherited real-symbol convention", And @@ (ComplexExpand[Conjugate[#]] === # & /@ variables)];
  Print["PAIR_CONJUGATION_SUPPORT heads ", heads, " input_bytes ", ByteCount[value]];
  answer = value /. coefficient_Complex :> ComplexExpand[Conjugate[coefficient]];
  gate["native real-symbol conjugation is explicit", FreeQ[answer,
    _Conjugate | _Re | _Im | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | $Failed | $Aborted]];
  answer];

factoredScalarPair[value_] := value + factoredRealConjugate[value];
pairEvidence = {};
candidateMatrix = Table[
  Print["PAIR_ASSEMBLY_ENTRY ", {a, b}];
  {entrySeconds, entryValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    rawMatrix[[a, b]] + factoredRealConjugate[rawMatrix[[b, a]]], {"factored pair", a, b}]];
  {comparisonSeconds, comparisonValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    algebraicReduce[entryValue - controlRecord["PhotonMatrix"][[a, b]]], {"accepted pair comparison", a, b}]];
  gate["complete accepted photon entry " <> ToString[{a, b}, InputForm], comparisonValue === 0];
  AppendTo[pairEvidence, <|"Kind" -> "Photon", "Index" -> {a, b}, "Seconds" -> entrySeconds,
    "ComparisonSeconds" -> comparisonSeconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[{rawMatrix[[a, b]], rawMatrix[[b, a]]}],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[entryValue]|>];
  entryValue, {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}];
candidateModes = Association@Table[
  Print["PAIR_ASSEMBLY_SCALAR ", key];
  {entrySeconds, entryValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[factoredScalarPair[rawModes[key]], {"factored scalar pair", key}]];
  {comparisonSeconds, comparisonValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    algebraicReduce[entryValue - controlRecord["ScalarModes"][key]], {"accepted scalar pair comparison", key}]];
  gate["complete accepted scalar entry " <> key, comparisonValue === 0];
  AppendTo[pairEvidence, <|"Kind" -> "Scalar", "Key" -> key, "Seconds" -> entrySeconds,
    "ComparisonSeconds" -> comparisonSeconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[rawModes[key]],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[entryValue]|>];
  key -> entryValue, {key, Keys[rawModes]}];
gate["complete pair assembly function matches measured entries",
  bounded[factoredPhotonPair[rawMatrix] === candidateMatrix, "pair assembly function comparison"]];
gate["complete scalar assembly function matches measured entries",
  bounded[Map[factoredScalarPair, rawModes] === candidateModes, "scalar assembly function comparison"]];
candidateRecord = Join[controlRecord, <|"PhotonMatrix" -> candidateMatrix, "ScalarModes" -> candidateModes,
  "Checks" -> Join[controlRecord["Checks"], checks], "ElapsedSeconds" -> Total[Lookup[pairEvidence, "Seconds"]],
  "ElapsedIncludesProjectionRecomputation" -> False, "ComparedCheckpoint" -> controlPath,

  "PairAssemblyComparisonSourceHash" -> FileHash[validationSourcePath, "SHA256"]|>];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-pair-assembly-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[validationSourcePath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"],
  "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[validationConfigPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash,
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "ValidationInputHashes" -> validationInputHashes,
  "Pair" -> pair, "ControlFile" -> validationConfig["control_file"], "ControlElapsedSeconds" -> controlRecord["ElapsedSeconds"],
  "ConjugationDefinitions" -> DownValues[factoredRealConjugate],
  "PhotonPairDefinitions" -> DownValues[factoredPhotonPair], "ScalarPairDefinitions" -> DownValues[factoredScalarPair],
  "Evidence" -> pairEvidence, "Candidate" -> candidateRecord, "Checks" -> checks,
  "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[], "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;

If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[result], "pair comparison compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["pair comparison output below file bound", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["pair comparison exact native round trip", bounded[Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result, "pair comparison reload"]];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "pair" -> pair, "evidence" -> pairEvidence, "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_pair_assembly_check"]; Quit[0];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-102", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 28432, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_result/reference/s05_real_spin_response_before_coefficient_reduction.wls", "sha256": "376fd639b0624d1b0aab627969077213468cdd9811fd6b141960e7c831fa8a3a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Spin-resolved real tensors in the unchanged high-transverse-momentum SIDIS measurement. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
FCSetDiracGammaScheme["BMHV"];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  Print["FAIL: time bound ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["FAIL: memory bound ", label]; Quit[3]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
zeroArray[value_] := And @@ (TrueQ[# === 0] & /@ Flatten[{value}]);
config = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s01_inputs.json"}], "RawJSON"];
realConfig = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_inputs.json"}], "RawJSON"];
gate["known channel", KeyExistsQ[config["channel_contracts"], channel]];
contract = config["channel_contracts"][channel];
core = contract["amplitude_schema"] === "core";
ampPath = FileNameJoin[{root, contract["amplitude_file"]}];
referenceRelative = realConfig["channels"][channel]["unpolarized_real_file"];
referencePath = FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRelative}];
Do[row = SelectFirst[packet[[1]]["files"], #["destination"] === packet[[2]] &];
  gate["pinned input " <> packet[[2]], IntegerString[
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, packet[[2]]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]],
  {packet, {{config, contract["amplitude_file"]}, {realConfig, referenceRelative}}}];
generated = Get[ampPath]; reference = Get[referencePath];
basisPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}];
angularPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s04_result", "s04_result.wl"}];
basis = Get[basisPath]; angular = Get[angularPath];
gate["accepted spin basis", basis["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-spin-basis-v1" && And @@ Values[basis["Checks"]]];
gate["accepted angular moments", angular["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-transverse-average-v1" && And @@ Values[angular["Checks"]]];
$Assumptions = Q > 0 && s > s23 > 0 && s23 - Q^2 - s < t < -Q^2 s23/s && SUNN > 1;
simplify[value_] := FullSimplify[value, Assumptions -> $Assumptions];
metric = DiagonalMatrix[{1, -1, -1, -1}];
dot4[a_, b_] := Expand[a.metric.b];
linearSolution[polynomials_, variables_, label_] := Module[{arrays, rules},
  arrays = Normal /@ CoefficientArrays[polynomials, variables];
  gate[label <> " linear", Length[arrays] === 2];
  gate[label <> " nonsingular", simplify[Det[arrays[[2]]] != 0]];
  rules = Thread[variables -> (Factor /@ LinearSolve[arrays[[2]], -arrays[[1]]])];
  gate[label <> " reconstructs", And @@ (zero /@ (polynomials /. rules))]; rules];
pTrial = {ep, 0, 0, ep}; qTrial = {0, 0, 0, -Q};
kTrial = {ek, Sqrt[kxSquared], 0, kz}; recoilTrial = pTrial + qTrial - kTrial;
equations = {dot4[pTrial + qTrial, pTrial + qTrial] == s,
  dot4[qTrial - kTrial, qTrial - kTrial] == t,
  dot4[kTrial, kTrial] == 0, dot4[recoilTrial, recoilTrial] == s23};
polynomials = equations /. Equal -> Subtract;
longitudinalRules = linearSolution[{polynomials[[1]], Expand[polynomials[[2]] - polynomials[[3]]]}, {ep, kz}, "real longitudinal frame"];
energyRules = linearSolution[{Expand[(polynomials[[4]] - polynomials[[3]]) /. longitudinalRules]}, {ek}, "real energy"];
transverseRules = linearSolution[{Expand[polynomials[[3]] /. longitudinalRules /. energyRules]}, {kxSquared}, "real transverse coordinate"];
frameSolution = Join[longitudinalRules, energyRules, transverseRules];
gate["real frame invariants", And @@ simplify[equations /. frameSolution]];
transverseSquared = Factor[kxSquared /. frameSolution];
gate["positive measured transverse momentum", simplify[transverseSquared > 0]];
transverseConstraint = transverseK^2 - transverseSquared;
transverseRule = transverseK -> Sqrt[transverseSquared];
algebraicReduce[values_List] := algebraicReduce /@ values;
algebraicReduce[value_] := Module[{rational, num, den, inverse, gcd, bezout, work, division, answer, proof},
  gate["unconditional exact algebra", FreeQ[value, _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Aborted | $Failed]];
  rational = Together[value]; num = Numerator[rational]; den = Denominator[rational];
  gate["transverse rational function", PolynomialQ[num, transverseK] && PolynomialQ[den, transverseK]];
  If[FreeQ[den, transverseK], inverse = 1/den,
    {gcd, bezout} = PolynomialExtendedGCD[den, transverseConstraint, transverseK];
    gate["denominator Bezout reconstruction", zero[gcd - bezout.{den, transverseConstraint}]];
    gate["invertible transverse denominator", FreeQ[gcd, transverseK] && gcd =!= 0];
    inverse = First[bezout]/gcd];
  work = Together[num inverse];
  gate["rationalized transverse denominator", FreeQ[Denominator[work], transverseK]];
  division = PolynomialReduce[Numerator[work], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}];
  gate["polynomial division reconstruction", zero[Numerator[work] - First[First[division]] transverseConstraint - Last[division]]];
  answer = Factor[Last[division]/Denominator[work]];
  proof = Last[PolynomialReduce[Numerator[Together[rational - answer]], {transverseConstraint}, {transverseK}]];
  gate["complete rational reconstruction on shell", zero[proof]]; answer];
pVector = Factor[pTrial /. frameSolution]; qVector = qTrial;
kVector = Factor[{ek, transverseK, 0, kz} /. frameSolution];
outZ = Factor[Rest[kVector]/First[kVector]]; outY = {0, 1, 0}; outX = Factor[Cross[outY, outZ]];
frame = <|p -> pVector, q -> qVector, k1 -> kVector,
  eL -> {1, 0, 0, 0}, eX -> {0, 1, 0, 0}, eY -> {0, 0, 1, 0}, eZ -> {0, 0, 0, 1},
  eOutX -> Prepend[outX, 0], eOutY -> Prepend[outY, 0]|>;
physicalKeys = Keys[frame];
gate["measured spin axes", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[{dot4[frame[eOutX], frame[k1]], dot4[frame[eOutY], frame[k1]],
  dot4[frame[eOutX], frame[eOutY]], dot4[frame[eOutX], frame[eOutX]] + 1, dot4[frame[eOutY], frame[eOutY]] + 1}]]];
invariantRules = angular["InvariantMap"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
gramD = {{0, pq, pk1, pk2}, {pq, -Q^2, qk1, qk2}, {pk1, qk1, 0, k1k2}, {pk2, qk2, k1k2, 0}} /. invariantRules;
momentumBasis = {p, q, k1, k2};
momentumCoordinates[v_] := Coefficient[Expand[v /. k3 -> p + q - k1 - k2], #] & /@ momentumBasis;
dotD[a_, b_] := Factor[momentumCoordinates[a].gramD.momentumCoordinates[b]];
normalFrameMatrix = (frame /@ {p, q, k1, eY}).metric;
normalProducts = Join[(dotD[k2, #] & /@ {p, q, k1}), {normalDot}];
k2Vector = algebraicReduce[LinearSolve[normalFrameMatrix, normalProducts]];
gate["unresolved physical projections", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[normalFrameMatrix.k2Vector - normalProducts]]];
AssociateTo[frame, {k2 -> k2Vector, k3 -> algebraicReduce[pVector + qVector - kVector - k2Vector]}];
hatRules = linearSolution[{dot4[k2Vector, k2Vector] + hatSquared}, {hatSquared}, "evanescent on-shell norm"];
hatNorm = algebraicReduce[hatSquared /. hatRules];
cutRadius = angular["CutEuclideanRadiusSquared"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
parallelVector = Total[MapThread[Times, {(angular["ParallelCoefficients"] /. Q2 -> Q^2), frame /@ {p, q, k1}}]];
gate["inherited cut radius", algebraicReduce[dot4[parallelVector, parallelVector] - cutRadius] === 0];
normalProjection = dot4[k2Vector, frame[eY]] frame[eY]/dot4[frame[eY], frame[eY]];
gate["one remaining physical normal coordinate", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[k2Vector - parallelVector - normalProjection]]];
gate["positive-energy support independent of normal angle", FreeQ[{First[frame[k2]], First[frame[k3]]}, normalDot]];
allMomenta = {p, q, k1, k2, k3};
realScalarProducts = Flatten[Table[{allMomenta[[i]], allMomenta[[j]], dotD[allMomenta[[i]], allMomenta[[j]]]},
  {i, Length[allMomenta]}, {j, i, Length[allMomenta]}], 1];
FCClearScalarProducts[];
Do[With[{a = aKey, b = bKey, v = algebraicReduce[dot4[frame[aKey], frame[bKey]]]}, SP[a, b] = v; SPD[a, b] = v],
  {aKey, physicalKeys}, {bKey, physicalKeys}];
Do[With[{a = leg, b = key, v = algebraicReduce[dot4[frame[leg], frame[key]]]}, SP[a, b] = v; SPD[a, b] = v],
  {leg, {k2, k3}}, {key, physicalKeys}];
Do[With[{a = left, b = right, full = dotD[left, right],
    extra = Factor[Coefficient[left /. k3 -> p + q - k1 - k2, k2] Coefficient[right /. k3 -> p + q - k1 - k2, k2] hatNorm]},
  SPD[a, b] = full; SPE[a, b] = extra; SP[a, b] = algebraicReduce[full - extra]],
  {left, {k2, k3}}, {right, {k2, k3}}];
Do[With[{a = key}, Momentum[a, D - 4] = 0], {key, physicalKeys}];
coordinates[v_] := algebraicReduce[Total[(Coefficient[Expand[v], #] frame[#]) & /@ Keys[frame]]];
physical[expr_] := expr /. HoldPattern[Momentum[mom_, D]] :>
  If[FreeQ[mom, k2 | k3 | _Polarization], Momentum[mom], Momentum[mom, D]];
epsilonRule = HoldPattern[Eps[Momentum[a_], Momentum[b_], Momentum[c_], Momentum[d_]]] :>
  basis["LeviCivitaSign"] Det[coordinates /@ {a, b, c, d}];
normalMoment[n_Integer] := normalMoment[n] = Module[{value},
  value = If[KeyExistsQ[angular["MomentTable"], {n, 0}], angular["MomentTable"][{n, 0}],
    If[OddQ[n], 0, FunctionExpand[angular["GenericEvenMoment"] /. {aPower -> n/2, bPower -> 0}]]];
  value = Factor[value /. {dimension -> D, radiusSquared -> cutRadius}];
  gate["evaluated angular moment", FreeQ[value, _Gamma | _Beta | _Integrate | _ConditionalExpression]]; value];
angularAverage[values_List] := angularAverage /@ values;
angularAverage[value_] := Module[{rational, num, den, rows, reconstructed},
  rational = Together[algebraicReduce[value]]; num = Numerator[rational]; den = Denominator[rational];
  gate["denominators independent of normal angle", FreeQ[den, normalDot]];
  gate["polynomial angular numerator", PolynomialQ[num, normalDot]];
  rows = CoefficientRules[num, {normalDot}];
  reconstructed = Total[(Last[#] normalDot^First[First[#]]) & /@ rows];
  gate["angular numerator reconstruction", zero[num - reconstructed]];
  algebraicReduce[Total[(Last[#] normalMoment[First[First[#]]]) & /@ rows]/den]];
reduceScalar[expression_] := Module[{value},
  value = EpsEvaluate[ExpandScalarProduct[FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit[Contract[physical[expression]]]]];
  value = algebraicReduce[value /. epsilonRule];
  gate["fully scalar real contraction", FreeQ[value, _Pair | _Eps | _Spinor | _DiracGamma | _DiracTrace |
    _LorentzIndex | _Polarization | _SUNTF | _SUNTrace | _SUNF | _SUNDelta | _SUNFDelta | _FeynAmpDenominator]]; angularAverage[value]];

(* The imported graph process supplies species where older packets omit them. *)
graphProcess[graphs_] := FirstCase[List @@ Head[graphs],
  HoldPattern[Rule[key_Symbol, process_Rule] /; SymbolName[key] === "Process"] :> process,
  Missing["GeneratedProcess"]];
additionalInputs = {};
If[channel === "Hqg",
  diagramRelative = SelectFirst[Lookup[config["files"], "destination"],
    StringStartsQ[#, "Hqg/"] && StringEndsQ[#, "/s04_diagrams.wl"] &];
  graphData = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, diagramRelative}]]["Real"]["Diagrams"];
  AppendTo[additionalInputs, diagramRelative]];
If[!core,
  kinematicRelative = SelectFirst[Lookup[config["files"], "destination"],
    StringStartsQ[#, channel <> "/"] && StringEndsQ[#, "/kinematics.wl"] &];
  kinematics = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, kinematicRelative}]];
  AppendTo[additionalInputs, kinematicRelative]];
labels = If[channel === "Hqq", generated["RealSectors"], {"Real"}];
referenceCharge = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, config["channel_contracts"]["Hqq"]["unpolarized_born_file"]}]]["ModelChargeSquared"];
photonSymbols = {eL, eX, eY};
photonFrameMatrix = Transpose[frame /@ Append[photonSymbols, q]];
pExpansion = LinearSolve[photonFrameMatrix, frame[p]];
gate["incoming photon-basis projection", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[photonFrameMatrix.pExpansion - frame[p]]]];
pComponents = Take[pExpansion, Length[photonSymbols]];
spinNumerator[mom_, variables_, axes_, anti_] := FCI[Total[MapThread[Times, {Take[variables, Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]],
  basis[If[anti, "AntiquarkSpinNumerators", "QuarkSpinNumerators"]] /. {spinMomentum -> mom, spinX -> axes[[1]], spinY -> axes[[2]]}}]]];
photonDegree[amp_] := Module[{chains, degrees},
  chains = Cases[amp, chain_Dot /; !FreeQ[chain, Polarization[q, ___]], {0, Infinity}];
  degrees = DeleteDuplicates[Map[Function[chain, Which[
    !FreeQ[{First[chain], Last[chain]}, Spinor[Momentum[p, ___], ___]] &&
      !FreeQ[{First[chain], Last[chain]}, Spinor[Momentum[k1, ___], ___]], Exponent[1, chargeRatio],
    !FreeQ[{First[chain], Last[chain]}, Spinor[Momentum[k2, ___], ___]] &&
      !FreeQ[{First[chain], Last[chain]}, Spinor[-Momentum[k3, ___], ___]], Exponent[chargeRatio, chargeRatio],
    True, Missing["PhotonCurrent"]]], chains]];
  gate["identified distinct-flavor photon current", Length[degrees] === 1 && FreeQ[degrees, _Missing]]; First[degrees]];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputFiles = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{"common/s01_inputs.json", "common/s05_inputs.json",
  contract["amplitude_file"], referenceRelative, "common/s02_result/s02_result.wl",
  "common/s04_result/s04_result.wl", config["channel_contracts"]["Hqq"]["unpolarized_born_file"]}, additionalInputs]];
inputHashes = Association[(# -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #}], "SHA256"]) & /@ inputFiles];
Do[row = SelectFirst[config["files"], #["destination"] === relative &];
  gate["pinned input " <> relative, IntegerString[inputHashes[relative], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]],
  {relative, Join[additionalInputs, {config["channel_contracts"]["Hqq"]["unpolarized_born_file"]}]}];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
previousSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_result", "reference",
  "s05_real_spin_response_before_projection.wls"}];
gate["reviewed previous contraction source", IntegerString[FileHash[previousSourcePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "899cf6d588e4a2186c8e0312a7361c6c99796bd414ff948a2d4ceee98129967d"];
previousInputHash = Hash[{FileHash[previousSourcePath, "SHA256"], inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s05", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
sectorResults = <||>;

Do[
  amplitudes = If[core, generated[label], generated["amplitudes"]];
  process = Which[KeyExistsQ[generated, "Requests"],
      generated["Requests"][label]["Incoming"] -> generated["Requests"][label]["Outgoing"],
    channel === "Hqg", graphProcess[graphData],
    KeyExistsQ[generated, "outgoing_fields"], generated["incoming_fields"] -> generated["outgoing_fields"],
    True, graphProcess[generated["graphs"]]];
  gate[label <> " generated process fields", MatchQ[process, _List -> _List]];
  outgoingFields = (Last[process] /. Index[Colour | Gluon, _] :> Sequence[]) /. V[n_, {}] :> V[n];
  outgoingMomenta = If[core, {k1, k2, k3}, generated["outgoing"]];
  gate[label <> " generated momentum-field correspondence", Length[outgoingFields] === Length[outgoingMomenta] && Count[outgoingMomenta, k1] === 1];
  observedField = outgoingFields[[First[FirstPosition[outgoingMomenta, k1]]]];
  tagWeight = Count[outgoingFields, observedField]/(Times @@ (Factorial /@ Values[Counts[outgoingFields]]));
  If[KeyExistsQ[generated, "symmetry_weight"], gate[label <> " inherited spectator weight", tagWeight === generated["symmetry_weight"]]];
  degrees = If[channel === "Hqq" && label === "RealDistinct", photonDegree /@ amplitudes, ConstantArray[0, Length[amplitudes]]];
  amplitudes = MapThread[Times, {amplitudes, chargeRatio^degrees}];
  couplingAmplitudes = amplitudes /. {SMP["e"] -> couplingEM, SMP["g_s"] -> couplingStrong,
    ee -> couplingEM, gs -> couplingStrong};
  couplingPowers = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[(First /@ CoefficientRules[#, {couplingEM, couplingStrong}]) & /@ couplingAmplitudes, 1]];
  gate[label <> " unique coupling degree", Length[couplingPowers] === 1 && VectorQ[First[couplingPowers], IntegerQ]];
  gate[label <> " tree coupling reconstruction", And @@ (TrueQ[Expand[# -
    (couplingEM^First[First[couplingPowers]] couplingStrong^Last[First[couplingPowers]])
      (# /. {couplingEM -> 1, couplingStrong -> 1})] === 0] & /@ couplingAmplitudes)];
  amplitudes = amplitudes /. {SMP["e"] -> 1, SMP["g_s"] -> 1, ee -> 1, gs -> 1};
  spinorDimensions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amplitudes,
    Spinor[sign_. Momentum[mom_, dim_:4], ___] :> dim, Infinity]];
  gate[label <> " uniform native spinor dimension", Length[spinorDimensions] === 1];
  fermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amplitudes, Spinor[sign_. Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
  antifermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amplitudes, Spinor[-Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
  incomingQuark = MemberQ[fermions, p]; outgoingQuark = MemberQ[fermions, k1];
  gluons = DeleteCases[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amplitudes, Polarization[mom_, ___] :> mom, Infinity]], q];
  inVariables = If[incomingQuark, {1, xIn, yIn, hIn}, {1, xIn, yIn, hIn, eIn}];
  outVariables = If[outgoingQuark, {1, xOut, yOut, hOut}, {1, xOut, yOut, hOut, eOut}];
  quarkIn = spinNumerator[p, inVariables, {eX, eY}, MemberQ[antifermions, p]];
  quarkOut = spinNumerator[k1, outVariables, {eOutX, eOutY}, MemberQ[antifermions, k1]];
  initialColor = SUNSimplify[If[incomingQuark, SUNFDelta[ci, ci], SUNDelta[ca, ca]], SUNNToCACF -> False];
  normalization = basis["IncomingDensityNormalization"] initialColor If[core, referenceCharge, 1];
  tensorWeight = If[core, tagWeight, 1];
  densities = <||>; gluonDimensions = <||>;
  Do[
    leftIndex = gluonLeft[leg]; rightIndex = gluonRight[leg];
    fullSum = physical[DoPolarizationSums[FVD[Polarization[leg, I], leftIndex] FVD[Polarization[leg, -I], rightIndex], leg, If[leg === p, k1, p]]];
    AssociateTo[gluonDimensions, leg -> reduceScalar[-fullSum MTD[leftIndex, rightIndex]]];
    If[MemberQ[{p, k1}, leg],
      vars = If[leg === p, inVariables, outVariables]; axes = If[leg === p, {eX, eY}, {eOutX, eOutY}];
      stokes = Total[MapThread[Times, {Take[vars, Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]], (#[[{2, 3}, {2, 3}]] &) /@ basis["GluonStokesTensorsCanonical"]}]];
      If[leg === k1, stokes = Transpose[stokes]];
      density = Sum[stokes[[i, j]] FV[axes[[i]], leftIndex] FV[axes[[j]], rightIndex], {i, Length[axes]}, {j, Length[axes]}];
      density += Last[vars] Contract[fullSum - ChangeDimension[fullSum, 4]], density = fullSum];
    AssociateTo[densities, leg -> density], {leg, gluons}];
  buildPair[i_, j_, wardLeg_] := Module[{a, b, value, replacements},
    a = amplitudes[[i]] /. Momentum[Polarization[q, ___], ___] -> LorentzIndex[mu, D];
    b = amplitudes[[j]] /. Momentum[Polarization[q, ___], ___] -> LorentzIndex[nu, D];
    Do[a = a /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], ___] -> LorentzIndex[gluonLeft[leg], D];
      b = b /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], ___] -> LorentzIndex[gluonRight[leg], D], {leg, gluons}];
    value = FermionSpinSum[a ComplexConjugate[b, FCRenameDummyIndices -> True],
      Head -> keptSpinSum, DotSimplify -> False, FCTraceFactor -> False];
    value = value /. HoldPattern[keptSpinSum[DiracGamma[Momentum[mom_, ___], ___]] /; MemberQ[{p, k1}, mom]] :>
      If[mom === p, quarkIn, quarkOut];
    value = value /. keptSpinSum[other_] :> other;
    gate["real spin closures", FreeQ[value, keptSpinSum | _Spinor]];
    value = physical[value];
    value = SUNSimplify[value, Explicit -> True, SUNNToCACF -> False];
    Do[value *= If[leg === wardLeg, FVD[leg, gluonLeft[leg]] FVD[leg, gluonRight[leg]], densities[leg]], {leg, gluons}];
    tensorWeight value/normalization];
  traceScalar[expression_] := reduceScalar[
    Contract[DiracSimplify[DotSimplify[Contract[expression]], DiracTraceEvaluate -> True]]];
  pairs = Flatten[Table[{i, j}, {i, Length[amplitudes]}, {j, i, Length[amplitudes]}], 1];
  pairValues = {};
  Do[
    {left, right} = pair;
    pairPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_" <> ToString[left] <> "_" <> ToString[right] <> ".wl"}];
    saved = If[FileExistsQ[pairPath], Get[pairPath], <||>];
    previousPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s05", channel, IntegerString[previousInputHash, 16],
      label <> "_" <> ToString[left] <> "_" <> ToString[right] <> ".wl"}];
    If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash && FileExistsQ[previousPath],
      previous = Get[previousPath];
      gate["reused pair exact input binding", previous["InputHash"] === previousInputHash];
      saved = Join[previous, <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "ReusedCheckpoint" -> previousPath,
        "ReusedCheckpointHash" -> FileHash[previousPath, "SHA256"]|>];
      put[saved, pairPath]; Print["REUSED_REAL_PAIR ", channel, " ", label, " ", pair]];
    If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash,
      Print["REAL_PAIR ", channel, " ", label, " ", pair];
      tensor = bounded[buildPair[left, right, None], {label, pair, "spin trace"}];
      matrix = Table[Print["REAL_PHOTON ", pair, " ", a, " ", b];
        bounded[traceScalar[tensor FV[photonSymbols[[a]], mu] FV[photonSymbols[[b]], nu]], {label, pair, a, b}],
        {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}];
      scalarModes = <|"PgD" -> bounded[traceScalar[tensor MTD[mu, nu]], {label, pair, "PgD"}],
        "PhotonWard" -> bounded[traceScalar[tensor FV[q, mu] FV[q, nu]], {label, pair, "photon Ward"}]|>;
      Do[wardTensor = bounded[buildPair[left, right, leg], {label, pair, leg, "Ward trace"}];
        AssociateTo[scalarModes, "GluonWard_" <> ToString[leg] -> bounded[traceScalar[
          wardTensor Total[FV[#, mu] FV[#, nu] & /@ photonSymbols]], {label, pair, leg, "Ward contraction"}]], {leg, gluons}];
      If[left =!= right, matrix = algebraicReduce[ComplexExpand[matrix + ConjugateTranspose[matrix]]];
        scalarModes = Map[algebraicReduce[ComplexExpand[# + Conjugate[#]]] &, scalarModes]];
      saved = <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "PhotonMatrix" -> matrix, "ScalarModes" -> scalarModes|>;
      put[saved, pairPath]; Clear[tensor, wardTensor]; ClearSystemCache[]];
    AppendTo[pairValues, saved], {pair, pairs}];
  matrix = bounded[algebraicReduce[Total[Lookup[pairValues, "PhotonMatrix"]]], {label, "pair sum"}];
  scalarModes = Merge[Lookup[pairValues, "ScalarModes"], algebraicReduce[Total[#]] &];
  gate[label <> " photon Hermiticity", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[ComplexExpand[matrix - ConjugateTranspose[matrix]]]]];
  KeyValueMap[If[StringContainsQ[#1, "Ward"], gate[label <> " " <> #1, #2 === 0]] &, scalarModes];
  photonCoefficients = algebraicReduce[Tr[#.matrix]] & /@ basis["PhotonDual"];
  gate[label <> " photon reconstruction", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[matrix - Total[MapThread[Times, {photonCoefficients, basis["PhotonBasis"]}]]]]];
  coefficient[expr_, vars_, index_] := If[index === 1, expr /. Thread[Rest[vars] -> 0],
    Coefficient[Expand[expr], vars[[index]], 1] /. Thread[DeleteCases[Rest[vars], vars[[index]]] -> 0]];
  response = Table[algebraicReduce[coefficient[coefficient[photonCoefficients[[a]], inVariables, i], outVariables, j]],
    {a, Length[photonCoefficients]}, {j, Length[outVariables]}, {i, Length[inVariables]}];
  gate[label <> " spin reconstruction", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[photonCoefficients - Table[
    Sum[inVariables[[i]] outVariables[[j]] response[[a, j, i]], {i, Length[inVariables]}, {j, Length[outVariables]}], {a, Length[photonCoefficients]}]]]];
  cdrVariables = Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]];
  cdrRules = Thread[cdrVariables -> (If[MemberQ[{eIn, eOut}, #], 1, 0] & /@ cdrVariables)];
  cdrAverage = If[incomingQuark, 1, basis["IncomingDensityNormalization"]/gluonDimensions[p]];
  cdr = <|"Pg" -> algebraicReduce[cdrAverage (scalarModes["PgD"] /. cdrRules)],
    "Ppp" -> algebraicReduce[cdrAverage pComponents.(matrix /. cdrRules).pComponents]|>;
  AssociateTo[sectorResults, label -> <|"Response" -> response[[All, 1 ;; Length[basis["SpinLabels"]], 1 ;; Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]]],
    "ExtendedResponse" -> response, "PhotonMatrix" -> matrix, "CDRContractions" -> cdr,
    "PhotonMetricD" -> scalarModes["PgD"], "WardChecks" -> KeySelect[scalarModes, StringContainsQ[#, "Ward"] &],
    "TagWeight" -> tagWeight, "TagWeightAppliedToTensor" -> core, "OutgoingFields" -> outgoingFields,
    "IncomingSpinLabels" -> If[incomingQuark, basis["SpinLabels"], Append[basis["SpinLabels"], "E"]],
    "OutgoingSpinLabels" -> If[outgoingQuark, basis["SpinLabels"], Append[basis["SpinLabels"], "E"]],
    "ChargeDegrees" -> degrees, "AmplitudeCouplingPowers" -> First[couplingPowers], "DiagramPairs" -> pairs,
    "ReusedPairCheckpoints" -> (KeyTake[#, {"ReusedCheckpoint", "ReusedCheckpointHash"}] & /@
      Select[pairValues, KeyExistsQ[#, "ReusedCheckpoint"] &])|>];
  Clear[pairValues]; ClearSystemCache[], {label, labels}];

(* Derive the old coordinate conversion from every saved scalar product. *)
If[core, oldRows = reference["RealScalarProducts"],
  oldRows = Flatten[Table[{kinematics["momenta"][[i]], kinematics["momenta"][[j]], kinematics["gram"][[i, j]]},
    {i, Length[kinematics["momenta"]]}, {j, i, Length[kinematics["momenta"]]}], 1]];
oldValues = oldRows[[All, 3]];
oldVariables = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[oldValues, symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]];
temporary = Table[Unique["referenceInvariant"], {Length[oldVariables]}];
targetValues = dotD[#[[1]], #[[2]]] & /@ oldRows;
solutions = Solve[Thread[(oldValues /. Thread[oldVariables -> temporary]) == targetValues], temporary];
gate["unique reference coordinate conversion", Length[solutions] === 1 && FreeQ[solutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
coordinateRules = Thread[oldVariables -> (temporary /. First[solutions])];
gate["all reference scalar products reconstruct", zeroArray[algebraicReduce[(oldValues /. coordinateRules) - targetValues]]];
Do[
  cdr = sectorResults[label]["CDRContractions"];
  If[channel === "Hqq",
    degrees = Union[Flatten[Outer[Plus, sectorResults[label]["ChargeDegrees"], sectorResults[label]["ChargeDegrees"]]]];
    Do[gate[label <> " reference " <> mode <> " charge " <> ToString[degree], algebraicReduce[
      Coefficient[cdr[mode], chargeRatio, degree] - (reference["Contractions"][label <> "_Charge" <> ToString[degree] <> "__" <> mode] /. coordinateRules)] === 0],
      {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}, {degree, degrees}],
    Do[referenceValue = If[core, reference["Contractions"][mode], reference[If[mode === "Pg", "g", "pp"]] /. {Nc -> SUNN, gs -> 1}];
      gate[label <> " reference " <> mode, algebraicReduce[cdr[mode] - (referenceValue /. coordinateRules)] === 0], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}]], {label, labels}];
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-response-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "PhotonLabels" -> basis["PhotonLabels"], "SpinLabels" -> basis["SpinLabels"],
  "IndexOrder" -> {"photon component", "outgoing spin", "incoming spin"}, "Sectors" -> sectorResults,
  "RealScalarProducts" -> realScalarProducts, "ReferenceCoordinateRules" -> coordinateRules,
  "Frame" -> frame, "TransverseSubstitution" -> transverseRule, "TransverseConstraint" -> transverseConstraint,
  "PhysicalRegion" -> $Assumptions, "Dimension" -> D, "Gamma5Scheme" -> "BMHV",
  "CutMomenta" -> {k2, p + q - k1 - k2}, "CutEnergySupport" -> {energy[k2] > 0, energy[p + q - k1 - k2] > 0},
  "ResidualAngularAverageApplied" -> True, "PhaseSpaceIntegrated" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False,
  "CouplingsRemoved" -> If[core, "e_q^2 g_s^4; distinct-charge ratio retained", "ee^2 gs^4; flavor charges retained"],
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> inputHash,
  "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "sectors" -> labels, "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_real_spin_response"]; Quit[0];
```
