(* Validate compact spin extraction against complete, input-bound matrix checkpoints. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[]; checks = <||>;
validationSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_spin_extraction_check.wls"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_result", "reference", "s05_real_spin_response_before_spin_extraction.wls"}];
validationConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_spin_extraction_inputs.json"}];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["reviewed production generation", IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "f6ba07013100d854647bc3d1677f58ba2b7b0dd50fd0b0397366e16361873d33"];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
productionPrefix = StringTake[productionText, prefixEnd - 1];
oldSourceAssignment = "sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, \"common\", \"s05_real_spin_response.wls\"}];";
gate["one archived source assignment", StringCount[productionPrefix, oldSourceAssignment] === 1];
oldPackageInitialization = "$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {\"FeynArts\"}; Get[\"FeynCalc`\"];";
gate["one inherited package initialization", StringCount[productionPrefix, oldPackageInitialization] === 1];
productionPrefix = StringReplace[productionPrefix, {
  oldSourceAssignment -> "sourcePath = productionPath;",
  oldPackageInitialization -> "gate[\"native package already initialized\", ValueQ[$FeynCalcVersion]];"}];
gate["complete prefix syntax", SyntaxQ[productionPrefix]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];
gate["complete validation source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[validationSourcePath, "Text"]]];
gate["bound archived production generation", IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "f6ba07013100d854647bc3d1677f58ba2b7b0dd50fd0b0397366e16361873d33"];
validationConfig = Import[validationConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["matrix fixture contract", validationConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-spin-extraction-inputs-v1" &&
  channel === validationConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hqqprime"];
fixtureHashes = <||>;
records = Table[
  fixturePath = FileNameJoin[{root, row["path"]}];
  gate["pinned matrix fixture " <> FileNameTake[fixturePath], FileByteCount[fixturePath] === row["bytes"] &&
    IntegerString[FileHash[fixturePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]];
  AssociateTo[fixtureHashes, row["path"] -> FileHash[fixturePath, "SHA256"]];
  record = bounded[Get[fixturePath], "read matrix fixture"];
  gate["accepted matrix fixture " <> FileNameTake[fixturePath], AssociationQ[record] &&
    record["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[record["Checks"]]]; record,
  {row, validationConfig["files"]}];
gate["distinct saved matrix entries", DuplicateFreeQ[Lookup[records, "Key"]]];
sumValues = AssociationThread[Lookup[records, "Key"], Lookup[records, "Value"]];
matrix = Table[sumValues["Photon_" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b]],
  {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}];
gate["complete saved photon matrix", Dimensions[matrix] === {Length[photonSymbols], Length[photonSymbols]} && FreeQ[matrix, _Missing]];
scalarModes = <|"PgD" -> sumValues["Scalar_PgD"], "PhotonWard" -> sumValues["Scalar_PhotonWard"]|>;
fermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[generated["amplitudes"], Spinor[sign_. Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
incomingQuark = MemberQ[fermions, p]; outgoingQuark = MemberQ[fermions, k1];
gate["fixture native quark species", incomingQuark && outgoingQuark];
inVariables = {1, xIn, yIn, hIn}; outVariables = {1, xOut, yOut, hOut};
gate["fixture photon Ward identity", scalarModes["PhotonWard"] === 0];
gate["fixture photon Hermiticity", zeroArray[bounded[algebraicReduce[ComplexExpand[matrix - ConjugateTranspose[matrix]]], "matrix Hermiticity"]]];
(* Compare exact linear component assembly with an accepted reduced sum. *)
label = First[labels];
gate["single fixture sector", labels === {label}];
pairs = Flatten[Table[{i, j}, {i, Length[generated["amplitudes"]]}, {j, i, Length[generated["amplitudes"]]}], 1];
pairFixtureHashes = <||>;
pairValues = Table[
  pairPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_" <> ToString[First[pair]] <> "_" <> ToString[Last[pair]] <> ".wl"}];
  pairRelative = StringDrop[pairPath, StringLength[root] + 1];
  pairRow = SelectFirst[validationConfig["pair_files"], #["path"] === pairRelative &];
  gate["pinned pair fixture " <> ToString[pair, InputForm], AssociationQ[pairRow] &&
    FileByteCount[pairPath] === pairRow["bytes"] &&
    IntegerString[FileHash[pairPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === pairRow["sha256"]];
  savedPair = Get[pairPath];
  gate["accepted pair fixture " <> ToString[pair, InputForm], savedPair["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[savedPair["Checks"]]];
  AssociateTo[pairFixtureHashes, StringDrop[pairPath, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[pairPath, "SHA256"]]; savedPair,
  {pair, pairs}];
sumTaskCode = sourceSection[productionText, "\n  scalarKeys = Keys[First[pairValues]", "\n  sumTask[task_]"];
gate["inherited sum input construction syntax", SyntaxQ[sumTaskCode]];
ToExpression[sumTaskCode];
linearComponentSum[task_] := If[StringContainsQ[task["Key"], "Ward"],
  algebraicReduce[Total[task["Values"]]], Total[task["Values"]]];
probeTask = First[MinimalBy[Select[sumTasks, StringStartsQ[#["Key"], "Photon_"] &], ByteCount[#["Values"]] &]];
{linearSeconds, linearValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[linearComponentSum[probeTask], "linear sum candidate"]];
gate["linear sum accepted checkpoint reconstruction", bounded[
  algebraicReduce[linearValue - sumValues[probeTask["Key"]]] === 0, "linear sum own-output comparison"]];
Do[gate["linear assembly Ward " <> task["Key"], bounded[
  linearComponentSum[task] === sumValues[task["Key"]], "linear assembly Ward comparison"]],
  {task, Select[sumTasks, StringContainsQ[#["Key"], "Ward"] &]}];
sumEvidence = <|"Component" -> probeTask["Key"], "LinearSeconds" -> linearSeconds,
  "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[probeTask["Values"]], "LinearBytes" -> ByteCount[linearValue],
  "AcceptedBytes" -> ByteCount[sumValues[probeTask["Key"]]], "ExactComparisonPassed" -> True|>;
Print["LINEAR_SUM_EVIDENCE ", InputForm[sumEvidence]];
Clear[pairValues, sumTasks, savedPair, probeTask, linearValue]; ClearSystemCache[];
photon = Tr[#.matrix] & /@ basis["PhotonDual"];
coefficientRulesResponse[photon_, incoming_, outgoing_] := Module[
  {variables, keys, monomialRows, rows},
  variables = DeleteCases[Join[incoming, outgoing], 1];
  gate["distinct spin polynomial variables", DuplicateFreeQ[variables]];
  keys = Table[
    monomialRows = CoefficientRules[incoming[[i]] outgoing[[j]], variables];
    gate["unit component spin monomial", Length[monomialRows] === 1 && Last[First[monomialRows]] === 1];
    First[First[monomialRows]], {j, Length[outgoing]}, {i, Length[incoming]}];
  gate["distinct component monomials", DuplicateFreeQ[Flatten[keys, 1]]];
  Table[
    gate["polynomial photon spin dependence", PolynomialQ[expression, variables]];
    rows = Association[CoefficientRules[expression, variables]];
    gate["all spin monomials represented", Complement[Keys[rows], Flatten[keys, 1]] === {}];
    Table[If[KeyExistsQ[rows, keys[[j, i]]], rows[keys[[j, i]]], 0],
      {j, Length[outgoing]}, {i, Length[incoming]}], {expression, photon}]];
compactSpinResponse[photon_, incoming_, outgoing_] := Module[
  {variables, incomingComponents, incomingZero, outgoingZero},
  variables = DeleteCases[Join[incoming, outgoing], 1];
  gate["distinct spin polynomial variables", DuplicateFreeQ[variables]];
  incomingZero = Thread[DeleteCases[incoming, 1] -> 0];
  outgoingZero = Thread[DeleteCases[outgoing, 1] -> 0];
  Table[
    gate["polynomial photon spin dependence", PolynomialQ[expression, variables]];
    incomingComponents = Table[If[incoming[[i]] === 1,
      expression /. incomingZero, D[expression, incoming[[i]]] /. incomingZero], {i, Length[incoming]}];
    Table[If[outgoing[[j]] === 1, incomingComponents[[i]] /. outgoingZero,
      D[incomingComponents[[i]], outgoing[[j]]] /. outgoingZero],
      {j, Length[outgoing]}, {i, Length[incoming]}], {expression, photon}]];
{ruleSeconds, ruleCandidate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
  coefficientRulesResponse[Take[photon, 1], inVariables, outVariables], "prior first-component extraction"]];
ruleResidual = First[photon] - Sum[inVariables[[i]] outVariables[[j]] ruleCandidate[[1, j, i]],
  {i, Length[inVariables]}, {j, Length[outVariables]}];
ruleExpanded = bounded[Expand[ruleResidual], "prior reconstruction diagnostic"];
ruleRationalZero = bounded[zero[ruleResidual], "prior rational reconstruction diagnostic"];
priorEvidence = <|"ResponseBytes" -> ByteCount[ruleCandidate], "ExtractionSeconds" -> ruleSeconds,
  "ExpansionIdenticallyZero" -> TrueQ[ruleExpanded === 0], "RationallyIdenticallyZero" -> ruleRationalZero,
  "ExpandedResidualBytes" -> ByteCount[ruleExpanded]|>;
Print["PRIOR_EXTRACTION_DIAGNOSTIC ", InputForm[priorEvidence]];
Clear[ruleCandidate, ruleResidual, ruleExpanded]; ClearSystemCache[];

{extractionSeconds, candidate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
  compactSpinResponse[photon, inVariables, outVariables], "compact spin extraction"]];
gate["complete response dimensions", Dimensions[candidate] === {Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]], Length[outVariables], Length[inVariables]}];
reconstructedPhoton = Table[Sum[inVariables[[i]] outVariables[[j]] candidate[[a, j, i]],
  {i, Length[inVariables]}, {j, Length[outVariables]}], {a, Length[photon]}];
Do[gate["exact spin polynomial " <> ToString[a], bounded[zero[photon[[a]] - reconstructedPhoton[[a]]],
    {"spin reconstruction", a}]], {a, Length[photon]}];
reconstructedMatrix = Total[MapThread[Times, {reconstructedPhoton, basis["PhotonBasis"]}]];
Do[gate["exact saved matrix " <> ToString[{a, b}, InputForm],
  bounded[zero[matrix[[a, b]] - reconstructedMatrix[[a, b]]], {"matrix reconstruction", a, b}]],
  {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}];
cdrRules = Thread[Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]] -> 0];
cdr = <|"Pg" -> algebraicReduce[scalarModes["PgD"] /. cdrRules],
  "Ppp" -> algebraicReduce[pComponents.(matrix /. cdrRules).pComponents]|>;
Do[referenceValue = reference[If[mode === "Pg", "g", "pp"]] /. {Nc -> SUNN, gs -> 1};
  gate["complete original reference " <> mode, bounded[
    algebraicReduce[cdr[mode] - (referenceValue /. coordinateRules)] === 0, {"CDR comparison", mode}]],
  {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
oldCoefficientCode = sourceSection[productionText, "\n  coefficient[expr_", "\n  response = Table[bounded"];
gate["saved extraction definition syntax", SyntaxQ[oldCoefficientCode]];
ToExpression[oldCoefficientCode];
indices = Tuples[Range /@ Dimensions[candidate]];
polarizedIndices = Select[indices, (#[[2]] > 1 || #[[3]] > 1) && Extract[candidate, #] =!= 0 &];
gate["nonzero polarized comparison exists", Length[polarizedIndices] > 0];
comparisonIndex = First[MaximalBy[polarizedIndices, ByteCount[Extract[candidate, #]] &]];
{oldExtractionSeconds, oldComponent} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
  coefficient[coefficient[photon[[First[comparisonIndex]]], inVariables, Last[comparisonIndex]],
    outVariables, comparisonIndex[[2]]], "legacy representative extraction"]];
compactComponent = Extract[candidate, comparisonIndex];
gate["exact legacy polarized component", bounded[zero[oldComponent - compactComponent], "legacy component comparison"]];
gate["smaller measured polarized component", ByteCount[compactComponent] < ByteCount[oldComponent]];
evidence = <|"ExtractionSeconds" -> extractionSeconds, "MatrixBytes" -> ByteCount[matrix],
  "CandidateResponseBytes" -> ByteCount[candidate], "ComponentCount" -> Length[indices],
  "ComparisonIndex" -> comparisonIndex, "LegacyComponentBytes" -> ByteCount[oldComponent],
  "CompactComponentBytes" -> ByteCount[compactComponent], "LegacyComponentSeconds" -> oldExtractionSeconds,
  "CompleteMatrixReconstructionPassed" -> True|>;
Print["EXTRACTION_EVIDENCE ", InputForm[evidence]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-spin-extraction-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[validationSourcePath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"],
  "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[validationConfigPath, "SHA256"], "BaselineMatrixInputHashes" -> fixtureHashes,
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "BasisInputHash" -> FileHash[basisPath, "SHA256"],
  "ExtractionDefinitions" -> DownValues[compactSpinResponse], "Evidence" -> evidence, "PriorExtractionDiagnostic" -> priorEvidence,
  "LinearSumDefinitions" -> DownValues[linearComponentSum], "LinearSumEvidence" -> sumEvidence, "PairFixtureHashes" -> pairFixtureHashes,
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_spin_extraction_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "evidence" -> evidence,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_spin_extraction_check"]; Quit[0];

## common/s05_spin_map_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-134", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7674, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_spin_map_check.wls", "sha256": "50da84aeb699f0d1ccf15f1bcf49a313774e82a9e3cffe2817fd391ae24e2fcf"} -->
```wolfram
(* Compare compact spin decomposition at the unchanged scalar-reduction boundary. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
validationSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_spin_map_check.wls"}];
validationConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_spin_map_inputs.json"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
validationConfig = Import[validationConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!= validationConfig["production_source_sha256"],
  Print["FAIL: pinned spin-map production source"]; Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
prefixEnd = First[First[StringPosition[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes ="]]];
productionPrefix = StringTake[productionText, prefixEnd - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[productionPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete inherited prefix syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];
gate["complete spin-map comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[validationSourcePath, "Text"]]];
gate["known spin-map comparison contract", validationConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-spin-map-comparison-inputs-v1" &&
  channel === validationConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hgg"];
label = First[labels];
gate["single real comparison sector", labels === {label}];
sectorCode = StringDrop[sourceSection[productionText, "\nDo[\n  amplitudes =", "\n  slots ="], StringLength["\nDo["]];
gate["complete inherited pair definitions syntax", SyntaxQ[sectorCode]];
ToExpression[sectorCode];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, validationConfig["control"]["file"]}];
gate["pinned accepted projection", IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  validationConfig["control"]["sha256"]];
controlRecord = Get[controlPath];
gate["accepted projection exact physical input binding", AssociationQ[controlRecord] &&
  controlRecord["InputHash"] === inputHash && KeyExistsQ[controlRecord, "Value"]];

derivativeSpinMap[function_, value_] := Module[{variables, rows, monomials, coefficients, reconstruction},
  variables = Select[spinSymbols, !FreeQ[value, #] &];
  If[variables === {}, Return[function[value]]];
  gate["scalar spin variables have declared axes", Complement[variables, DeleteCases[Join[inVariables, outVariables], 1]] === {}];
  rows = First[compactSpinResponse[{value}, inVariables, outVariables]];
  monomials = Flatten[Outer[Times, outVariables, inVariables]];
  coefficients = Flatten[rows];
  gate["complete scalar spin coefficient inventory", Length[coefficients] === Length[monomials] &&
    FreeQ[coefficients, Alternatives @@ spinSymbols]];
  reconstruction = Total[MapThread[Times, {coefficients, monomials}]];
  gate["exact derivative scalar spin decomposition", zero[value - reconstruction]];
  Print["COMPACT_SCALAR_SPIN input_bytes ", ByteCount[value], " coefficient_bytes ", ByteCount[coefficients]];
  Total[MapThread[Times, {function /@ coefficients, monomials}]]];
originalSpinMapDefinitions = DownValues[spinMap];
DownValues[spinMap] = DownValues[derivativeSpinMap] /. derivativeSpinMap -> spinMap;
gate["installed exact candidate definition", DownValues[spinMap] === (DownValues[derivativeSpinMap] /. derivativeSpinMap -> spinMap)];
originalReduceScalarDefinitions = DownValues[reduceScalar];
SetAttributes[profiledNative, HoldRest];
profiledNative[name_, expression_] := Module[{seconds, answer},
  Print["SCALAR_OPERATION_BEGIN ", name];
  {seconds, answer} = AbsoluteTiming[expression];
  Print["SCALAR_OPERATION_END ", name, " seconds ", seconds, " bytes ", ByteCount[answer]]; answer];
restoredScalarComponent[component_] := Module[{restored},
  restored = profiledNative["restore defining scalar products", (component /. epsilonRule) /. scalarRestore];
  profiledNative["on-shell reduction of restored coefficient", algebraicReduce[restored]]];
scalarCode = sourceSection[productionText, "reduceScalar[expression_]", "(* The imported graph process"];
scalarOld = "spinMap[Function[component, algebraicReduce[\n    Factor[component /. epsilonRule] /. scalarRestore]], value]";
scalarNew = "spinMap[restoredScalarComponent, value]";
gate["unique scalar-restoration ordering change", StringCount[scalarCode, scalarOld] === 1];
scalarCandidateCode = StringReplace[scalarCode, scalarOld -> scalarNew];
gate["complete scalar-restoration candidate syntax", SyntaxQ[scalarCandidateCode]];
ToExpression[scalarCandidateCode, InputForm];
runProjection[row_, purpose_] := Module[{pair, indices, tensor, value, seconds, startMemory},
  pair = row["pair"]; indices = row["photon_indices"];
  gate[purpose <> " valid native diagram pair", MemberQ[pairs, pair] &&
    And @@ (Between[#, {1, Length[photonSymbols]}] & /@ indices)];
  tensor = bounded[buildPair[First[pair], Last[pair], None], {purpose, "spin closure"}];
  startMemory = MemoryInUse[];
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[traceScalar[
    photonProject[tensor, photonSymbols[[First[indices]]], photonSymbols[[Last[indices]]]]], {purpose, pair, indices}]];
  <|"Pair" -> pair, "PhotonIndices" -> indices, "Value" -> value,
    "Seconds" -> seconds, "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[value], "MemoryBeforeBytes" -> startMemory,
    "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];
control = runProjection[validationConfig["control"], "accepted control"];
gate["complete accepted scalar projection unchanged", bounded[
  algebraicReduce[control["Value"] - controlRecord["Value"]] === 0, "exact accepted scalar projection comparison"]];
Print["SPIN_MAP_CONTROL_EVIDENCE ", InputForm[KeyDrop[control, "Value"]]];
Clear[controlRecord]; ClearSystemCache[];
candidate = runProjection[validationConfig["resource_failure"], "previous memory-bound projection"];
Print["SPIN_MAP_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE ", InputForm[KeyDrop[candidate, "Value"]]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-spin-map-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[validationSourcePath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"],
  "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[validationConfigPath, "SHA256"], "ControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "OriginalSpinMapDefinitions" -> originalSpinMapDefinitions,
  "SpinMapDefinitions" -> DownValues[spinMap], "ExtractionDefinitions" -> DownValues[compactSpinResponse],
  "OriginalReduceScalarDefinitions" -> originalReduceScalarDefinitions,
  "ReduceScalarDefinitions" -> DownValues[reduceScalar], "RestoredScalarDefinitions" -> DownValues[restoredScalarComponent],
  "ProfilingDefinitions" -> DownValues[profiledNative], "ProfilingAttributes" -> Attributes[profiledNative],
  "ControlEvidence" -> KeyDrop[control, "Value"], "Candidate" -> candidate, "Checks" -> checks,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_spin_map_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[result], "comparison result compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["comparison output below file bound", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["comparison output exact round trip", bounded[Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result, "comparison result reload"]];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s05_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "control" -> KeyDrop[control, "Value"], "candidate" -> KeyDrop[candidate, "Value"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_spin_map_check"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s05_spin_reconstruction_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-136", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10953, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s05_spin_reconstruction_check.wls", "sha256": "4283708ea806d88f7f4e2dc6532f4f7de9f90c1673ef030f73d0ce277b6e939d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Inspect and check the actual Hgq spin polynomials without a whole-expression common denominator. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
studyRoot = Directory[];
studySource = FileNameJoin[{studyRoot, "common", "s05_spin_reconstruction_check.wls"}];
studyInputPath = FileNameJoin[{studyRoot, "common", "s05_spin_reconstruction_inputs.json"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{studyRoot, "common", "s05_real_spin_response.wls"}];
studyAssert[name_, test_] := If[!TrueQ[test], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
studyAssert["study source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]]];
studyAssert["reviewed production source", IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "24fe8bc812f0a7306ee73ab9346d0e772d6d0bba77839feee131da55142f5c65"];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
prefixBoundary = StringPosition[productionText, "Do[\n  amplitudes ="];
studyAssert["unique production boundary", Length[prefixBoundary] === 1];
productionPrefix = StringTake[productionText, First[First[prefixBoundary]] - 1];
studyAssert["complete production initialization", SyntaxQ[productionPrefix]];
ToExpression[productionPrefix];
gate["study owns actual Hgq tensor", channel === "Hgq" && Length[labels] === 1];
gate["single allocated study kernel", Environment["NSLOTS"] === "1" || Environment["NSLOTS"] === $Failed];
label = First[labels];
fieldSetup = sourceSection[productionText, "\n  amplitudes =", "  Do[\n    leftIndex ="];
gate["complete inherited field setup", SyntaxQ[fieldSetup]];
ToExpression[fieldSetup];
studyInputs = Import[studyInputPath, "RawJSON"]["inputs"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative, identity}, gate["pinned equation " <> FileNameTake[relative],
  FileByteCount[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]] === identity["bytes"] &&
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === identity["sha256"]]], studyInputs];
equationPacket[a_, b_] := Module[{path, relative, packet},
  path = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_assembled_Photon_" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b] <> ".wl"}];
  relative = StringDrop[path, StringLength[root] + 1];
  gate["equation present in pinned inventory", KeyExistsQ[studyInputs, relative]];
  packet = Get[path];
  gate["equation has original input identity", packet["InputHash"] === inputHash];
  gate["equation has original photon index", packet["Key"] === "Photon_" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b]];
  gate["equation checkpoint checks", AssociationQ[packet["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[packet["Checks"]]];
  packet["Value"]];
{loadSeconds, matrix} = AbsoluteTiming[Table[equationPacket[a, b],
  {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}]];
photonCode = "  photonCoefficients = Tr[#.matrix] & /@ basis[\"PhotonDual\"];";
gate["inherited complete photon conversion", StringCount[productionText, photonCode] === 1];
ToExpression[photonCode];
{extractionSeconds, response} = AbsoluteTiming[
  bounded[compactSpinResponse[photonCoefficients, inVariables, outVariables], "study spin extraction"]];
variables = DeleteCases[Join[inVariables, outVariables], 1];
gate["native spin variable inventory", DuplicateFreeQ[variables] && AllTrue[variables, MatchQ[#, _Symbol] &]];
Print["SAVED_EQUATION_INVENTORY ", InputForm[<|"Channel" -> channel, "PhotonComponents" -> Length[photonCoefficients],
  "IncomingVariables" -> inVariables, "OutgoingVariables" -> outVariables, "MatrixBytes" -> ByteCount[matrix],
  "ResponseBytes" -> ByteCount[response], "LoadSeconds" -> loadSeconds, "ExtractionSeconds" -> extractionSeconds|>]];
studyAlgorithmPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_result", "reference",
  "s05_spin_reconstruction_check_before_checkpoints.wls"}];
gate["pinned unchanged reconstruction algorithm", IntegerString[FileHash[studyAlgorithmPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "ba1dbaf4529a3fb83156d028b163d98d3a2ab186f24c137ac29ea45a208abd53"];
studyPredicateSection[text_] := StringTake[text, {
  First[First[StringPosition[text, "\nspinPolynomialZero[value_, spinVariables_] :="]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[text, "\nstudyRows ="]]] - 1}];
gate["complete reconstruction predicate unchanged", studyPredicateSection[Import[studySource, "Text"]] ===
  studyPredicateSection[Import[studyAlgorithmPath, "Text"]]];
studyCacheInputHash = Hash[{FileHash[studyAlgorithmPath, "SHA256"], FileHash[studyInputPath, "SHA256"],
  inputHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
studyCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s05_spin_reconstruction_check", channel, IntegerString[studyCacheInputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[studyCache], CreateDirectory[studyCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];

(* Every operation and monomial is derived by the native polynomial tools from the saved expression. *)
spinPolynomialZero[value_, spinVariables_] := Module[{expanded, rows, monomials, reconstructed},
  gate["spin check polynomial", PolynomialQ[value, spinVariables]];
  expanded = Expand[value, Alternatives @@ spinVariables];
  If[expanded === 0, Return[True]];
  rows = CoefficientRules[expanded, spinVariables];
  monomials = (Times @@ MapThread[Power, {spinVariables, First[#]}]) & /@ rows;
  reconstructed = Total[MapThread[Times, {Last /@ rows, monomials}]];
  gate["spin check full polynomial reconstruction", Collect[expanded - reconstructed, spinVariables,
    Factor[Together[#]] &] === 0];
  And @@ (TrueQ[Factor[Together[#]] === 0] & /@ (Last /@ rows))];

studyRows = {}; acceptedComparisons = {};
Do[
  task = {a, photonCoefficients[[a]], response[[a]]};
  binding = Hash[{inputHash, label, task, inVariables, outVariables}, "SHA256"];
  checkpointPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_spin_reconstruction_" <> ToString[a] <> ".wl"}];
  checkpointRelative = StringDrop[checkpointPath, StringLength[root] + 1];
  acceptedCheckpoint = If[KeyExistsQ[studyInputs, checkpointRelative], Get[checkpointPath], <||>];
  If[acceptedCheckpoint =!= <||>,
    gate["own accepted component binding " <> ToString[a], acceptedCheckpoint["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
      acceptedCheckpoint["Binding"] === binding && TrueQ[acceptedCheckpoint["Accepted"]] &&
      AssociationQ[acceptedCheckpoint["Checks"]] && Length[acceptedCheckpoint["Checks"]] > 0 &&
      And @@ Values[acceptedCheckpoint["Checks"]]]];
  studyCheckpointPath = FileNameJoin[{studyCache, "component_" <> IntegerString[a, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}];
  studyCheckpoint = If[FileExistsQ[studyCheckpointPath], Get[studyCheckpointPath], <||>];
  If[Lookup[studyCheckpoint, "StudyInputHash", None] === studyCacheInputHash &&
      Lookup[studyCheckpoint, "Binding", None] === binding &&
      AssociationQ[Lookup[studyCheckpoint, "Checks", None]] && Length[studyCheckpoint["Checks"]] > 0 &&
      And @@ Values[studyCheckpoint["Checks"]] && TrueQ[studyCheckpoint["Measurement"]["ExactReconstruction"]],
    gate["comparison checkpoint retains original comparison " <> ToString[a],
      studyCheckpoint["ComparedAcceptedOutput"] === (acceptedCheckpoint =!= <||>)];
    checks = Join[checks, studyCheckpoint["Checks"]];
    If[TrueQ[studyCheckpoint["ComparedAcceptedOutput"]], AppendTo[acceptedComparisons, a]];
    AppendTo[studyRows, studyCheckpoint["Measurement"]];
    Print["REUSED_SPIN_CHECK ", a]; Clear[task, acceptedCheckpoint, studyCheckpoint]; Continue[]];
  gate["saved photon is a spin polynomial " <> ToString[a], PolynomialQ[task[[2]], variables]];
  observedDegrees = Exponent[task[[2]], #] & /@ variables;
  Print["ACTUAL_SPIN_EQUATION ", InputForm[<|"Component" -> a, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[task[[2]]],
    "InputLeafCount" -> LeafCount[task[[2]]], "SpinDegrees" -> observedDegrees,
    "PriorAccepted" -> (acceptedCheckpoint =!= <||>)|>]];
  residual = task[[2]] - Sum[inVariables[[i]] outVariables[[j]] task[[3, j, i]],
    {i, Length[inVariables]}, {j, Length[outVariables]}];
  memoryBefore = MemoryInUse[];
  {candidateSeconds, candidateValue} = AbsoluteTiming[MemoryConstrained[
    TimeConstrained[spinPolynomialZero[residual, variables], 1200, gate["study time limit", False]],
    4*1024^3, gate["study operation memory limit", False]]];
  gate["complete exact reconstruction " <> ToString[a], candidateValue];
  If[acceptedCheckpoint =!= <||>,
    gate["own accepted output comparison " <> ToString[a], candidateValue === acceptedCheckpoint["Accepted"]];
    AppendTo[acceptedComparisons, a]];
  row = <|"Component" -> a, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[task[[2]]], "ResidualBytes" -> ByteCount[residual],
    "SpinDegrees" -> observedDegrees, "Seconds" -> candidateSeconds, "MemoryBeforeBytes" -> memoryBefore,
    "MemoryAfterBytes" -> MemoryInUse[], "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[], "ExactReconstruction" -> candidateValue,
    "AcceptedOriginalSeconds" -> Lookup[acceptedCheckpoint, "ElapsedSeconds", Missing["NotCompleted"]]|>;
  studyCheckpoint = <|"StudyInputHash" -> studyCacheInputHash, "Binding" -> binding, "Measurement" -> row,
    "ComparedAcceptedOutput" -> (acceptedCheckpoint =!= <||>), "Checks" -> checks|>;
  put[studyCheckpoint, studyCheckpointPath];
  gate["comparison component exact checkpoint reload " <> ToString[a], Get[studyCheckpointPath] === studyCheckpoint];
  AppendTo[studyRows, row]; Print["SPIN_CHECK_MEASUREMENT ", InputForm[row]];
  Clear[task, residual, acceptedCheckpoint]; ClearSystemCache[], {a, Length[photonCoefficients]}];
gate["own accepted comparisons available", Length[acceptedComparisons] > 0];
gate["every photon component checked", Length[studyRows] === Length[photonCoefficients] && And @@ Lookup[studyRows, "ExactReconstruction"]];
studyResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-spin-reconstruction-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[studySource, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"],
  "ConfigurationHash" -> FileHash[studyInputPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "AlgorithmSourceHash" -> FileHash[studyAlgorithmPath, "SHA256"], "StudyCacheInputHash" -> studyCacheInputHash,
  "CheckpointDirectory" -> studyCache,
  "EquationFiles" -> studyInputs, "IncomingVariables" -> inVariables, "OutgoingVariables" -> outVariables,
  "CandidateDefinitions" -> DownValues[spinPolynomialZero], "OriginalPredicateDefinitions" -> DownValues[zero],
  "AcceptedComparisons" -> acceptedComparisons, "Measurements" -> studyRows, "Checks" -> checks,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
studyResultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_spin_reconstruction_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[studyResultDir], CreateDirectory[studyResultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
studyResultPath = FileNameJoin[{studyResultDir, "s05_result.wl"}];
put[studyResult, studyResultPath];
gate["study exact saved round trip", Get[studyResultPath] === studyResult];
Export[FileNameJoin[{studyResultDir, "s05_checks.json"}],
  <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks, "accepted_comparisons" -> acceptedComparisons,
    "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s05_spin_reconstruction_check"]; Quit[0];

```
<!-- END SOURCE -->

## common/s06_result/reference/sources/s02_definitions.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-140", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8465, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s06_result/reference/sources/s02_definitions.wl", "sha256": "39d5225662b92b1f9ecd654e6edb721f9f6ad1b52facf2e0a9ba59f616145eed"} -->
```wolfram
(* Common SIDIS invariant definitions and the two physical cut propagators. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
Get["FeynCalc`"];
root = DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test], Print["PASS: ", name],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
zero[expression_] := Factor[Together[expression]] === 0;
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[expression_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[expression, 900,
  gate["time limit: " <> label, False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory limit: " <> label, False]];
channels = {"Hqq", "Hqg", "Hgq", "Hgg", "Hqqbar", "Hqqprime"};
sourceHash = FileHash[$InputFileName, "SHA256"];

(* These are defining on-shell and Mandelstam equations, not stored solutions. *)
basis = {p, q, k1, r};
gram = Table[scalar[Min[i, j], Max[i, j]], {i, Length[basis]}, {j, Length[basis]}];
unknowns = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[gram]];
vector[v_] := Coefficient[Expand[v], #] & /@ basis;
dot[v_, u_] := Expand[vector[v].gram.vector[u]];
recoil = p + q - k1;
definitions = {dot[p, p] == 0, dot[q, q] == -Q2, dot[k1, k1] == 0,
  dot[p + q, p + q] == s, dot[q - k1, q - k1] == t,
  dot[recoil, recoil] == w, dot[r, r] == z1,
  dot[recoil - r, recoil - r] == z2, dot[p - r, p - r] == a,
  dot[k1 + r, k1 + r] == b};
solutions = Solve[definitions, unknowns];
gate["unique common invariant solution", Length[solutions] === 1];
solution = First[solutions];
gate["all defining equations reconstruct", And @@ (TrueQ[Simplify[# /. solution]] & /@ definitions)];
gram = Map[Factor, gram /. solution, {2}];
cutRules = {z1 -> 0, z2 -> 0};
cutMomenta = {r, recoil - r};
gate["cut propagators have their declared coordinates",
  And @@ MapThread[zero[#1 - #2] &, {dot[#, #] & /@ cutMomenta, {z1, z2}}]];

(* Candidate uncut lines are taken from the tree-propagator routings. S03
   must match every actual nonconstant denominator to this catalog. *)
uncutMomenta = {p - r, p - (recoil - r), k1 + r, k1 + (recoil - r),
  q - r, q - (recoil - r)};
uncutFull = Factor[dot[#, #]] & /@ uncutMomenta;
uncutOnCuts = Factor[# /. cutRules] & /@ uncutFull;
directions = ({Coefficient[#, a], Coefficient[#, b]} & /@ uncutOnCuts);
gate["uncut propagators are affine on both cuts",
  And @@ (PolynomialQ[#, {a, b}] && Exponent[#, a] <= 1 &&
      Exponent[#, b] <= 1 && zero[Coefficient[#, a b]] & /@ uncutOnCuts)];
independentPairs = Select[Subsets[Range[Length[uncutMomenta]], {2}],
  !zero[Det[directions[[#]]]] &];
gate["independent cut families exist", Length[independentPairs] > 0];
families = Association@Table[With[{pair = independentPairs[[i]],
    id = "R" <> IntegerString[i, 10, 2]},
  id -> Module[{momenta, forms, determinant, coordinateMap},
    momenta = Join[cutMomenta, uncutMomenta[[pair]]];
    forms = Factor[dot[#, #]] & /@ momenta;
    determinant = Factor[Det[Table[D[forms[[j]], variable],
      {j, Length[forms]}, {variable, {z1, z2, a, b}}]]];
    gate[id <> " independent full loop basis", determinant =!= 0];
    coordinateMap = Solve[Thread[uncutOnCuts[[pair]] == {v3, v4}], {a, b}];
    gate[id <> " unique uncut coordinate map", Length[coordinateMap] === 1];
    <|"UncutIndices" -> pair, "LoopMomenta" -> {r},
      "PropagatorMomenta" -> momenta, "PropagatorMassesSquared" -> ConstantArray[0, Length[momenta]],
      "Propagators" -> forms, "CutPositions" -> Range[Length[cutMomenta]],
      "OnCutUncutPropagators" -> uncutOnCuts[[pair]],
      "UncutCoordinateRules" -> First[coordinateMap],
      "BasisDeterminant" -> determinant|>]], {i, Length[independentPairs]}];

oldToCommon[rows_List] := Module[{values, oldVariables, temporaryVariables,
    renamed, target, equations, answers, rules},
  values = rows[[All, 3]];
  oldVariables = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[values,
    symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]]];
  temporaryVariables = Table[Unique["oldInvariant"], {Length[oldVariables]}];
  renamed = values /. Thread[oldVariables -> temporaryVariables];
  target = Map[Function[row, Factor[dot[
      row[[1]] /. {k2 -> r, k3 -> recoil - r},
      row[[2]] /. {k2 -> r, k3 -> recoil - r}] /. cutRules]], rows];
  equations = Thread[renamed == target];
  answers = Solve[equations, temporaryVariables];
  gate["unique source-to-common invariant map", Length[answers] === 1];
  rules = Thread[oldVariables -> (temporaryVariables /. First[answers])];
  gate["every inherited scalar product reconstructs in common coordinates",
    And @@ MapThread[zero[#1 - #2] &, {values /. rules, target}]];
  rules];

channelResults = <||>;
Do[
  directory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel}];
  inputDirectory = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s01_inputs"}];
  manifest = Import[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s01_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
  gate[channel <> " accepted byte-preserved import", TrueQ[manifest["accepted"]]];
  Scan[Function[entry, gate[channel <> " input hash " <> FileNameTake[entry["path"]],
    IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, entry["path"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
      entry["sha256"]]], manifest["files"]];
  If[MemberQ[{"Hqq", "Hqg", "Hgq"}, channel],
    sourceResult = If[channel === "Hqg", "s05_result.wl", "s03_result.wl"];
    data = Get[FileNameJoin[{inputDirectory, sourceResult}]];
    rows = data["RealScalarProducts"];
    contractions = data["Contractions"];
    If[channel === "Hqq",
      wards = data["WardChecks"],
      wards = KeySelect[contractions, StringContainsQ[#, "Ward"] &]];
    contractions = KeySelect[contractions, !StringContainsQ[#, "Ward"] &];
    bookkeeping = KeyDrop[data, {"Contractions", "RealScalarProducts", "WardChecks"}],
    sourceResult = "s02_result/real.wl";
    data = Get[FileNameJoin[{inputDirectory, sourceResult}]];
    kinematics = Get[FileNameJoin[{inputDirectory, "s02_result", "kinematics.wl"}]];
    momenta = kinematics["momenta"];
    rows = Flatten[Table[{momenta[[i]], momenta[[j]], kinematics["gram"][[i, j]]},
      {i, Length[momenta]}, {j, i, Length[momenta]}], 1];
    wards = <|"PhotonWard" -> data["qq"]|>;
    contractions = KeyTake[data, {"g", "pp"}];
    bookkeeping = <|"BornQG" -> "s01_inputs/s02_result/born_qg.wl",
      "BornGQ" -> "s01_inputs/s02_result/born_gq.wl",
      "GeneratedReal" -> "s01_inputs/s01_result/real.wl",
      "TensorCouplingsKept" -> True, "SpectatorWeightAppliedToTensor" -> False|>
  ];
  gate[channel <> " inherited Ward checks", Length[wards] > 0 && And @@ (zero /@ Values[wards])];
  coordinateRules = bounded[oldToCommon[rows], channel <> " invariant map"];
  tensors = Map[Function[value, value /. coordinateRules], contractions];
  gate[channel <> " exact unintegrated scalar tensors", FreeQ[tensors,
    _Real | _Integrate | _SeriesData | _FeynAmpDenominator | _PaVe | $Failed | $Aborted]];
  put[<|"Channel" -> channel, "CoordinateRules" -> coordinateRules,
    "Contractions" -> tensors, "OriginalContractionKeys" -> Keys[contractions],
    "Bookkeeping" -> bookkeeping, "WardChecks" -> wards,
    "OriginalRealResult" -> "s01_inputs/" <> sourceResult,
    "SourceHash" -> sourceHash,
    "ImportManifestHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s01_result.json"}], "SHA256"]|>,
    FileNameJoin[{directory, "s02_result.wl"}]];
  AssociateTo[channelResults, channel -> <|"File" -> channel <> "/s02_result.wl",
    "SHA256" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s02_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
    "TensorKeys" -> Keys[tensors], "CoordinateRules" -> coordinateRules|>];
  Print["CHANNEL_READY ", channel, " tensor keys ", Keys[tensors]];
  Clear[data, tensors, contractions, kinematics, bookkeeping]; ClearSystemCache[],
  {channel, channels}];

put[<|"ExternalMomenta" -> Take[basis, 3], "LoopMomenta" -> {r},
  "CommonGram" -> gram, "BasisMomenta" -> basis,
  "DefiningEquations" -> definitions, "DefiningSolution" -> solution,
  "RecoilMomentum" -> recoil, "CutMomenta" -> cutMomenta,
  "CutRules" -> cutRules, "CutEnergyConditions" -> {energy[r] > 0, energy[recoil - r] > 0},
  "UncutMomenta" -> uncutMomenta, "UncutPropagators" -> uncutFull,
  "OnCutUncutPropagators" -> uncutOnCuts, "UncutDirections" -> directions,
  "Families" -> families, "Channels" -> channelResults,
  "Dimension" -> D, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "IntegralEvaluationPerformed" -> False, "Accepted" -> True|>,
  FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}]];
Print["S02_SUCCESS: ", Length[families], " candidate cut families; all channel maps checked."];
Quit[0];

```
<!-- END SOURCE -->

<a id="source-141"></a>

## common/s06_result/reference/sources/s04_reduce_real.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-141", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8902, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s06_result/reference/sources/s04_reduce_real.wl", "sha256": "7fb2a8373395b2e6d85812186abe3d7394c47ed76722e30c212c262e232a0b03"} -->
```wolfram
(* Kira reduction of the exact two-cut targets generated by S03. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
Get["FeynCalc`"];
root = DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
gate[name_, condition_] := If[TrueQ[condition], Print["PASS: ", name],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
put[value_, file_] := (Put[value, file <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[file <> ".tmp", file, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
geometry = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}]];
mapping = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s03_result.wl"}]];
gate["accepted real mapping and geometry identity", TrueQ[mapping["Accepted"]] &&
  mapping["GeometryHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}], "SHA256"] &&
  mapping["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s03_real_families.wl"}], "SHA256"]];
kira = FileNameJoin[{root, "software", "kira-3.1"}];
fermat = FileNameJoin[{root, "software", "fermat", "Ferl7", "fer64"}];
gate["dedicated Kira and Fermat binaries exist", FileExistsQ[kira] && FileExistsQ[fermat]];
SetEnvironment["FERMATPATH" -> fermat];
sourceHash = FileHash[$InputFileName, "SHA256"];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s03_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
  mapping["GeometryHash"], FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
work = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s04_kira_real", IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
config = FileNameJoin[{work, "config"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[config], CreateDirectory[config, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
targets = mapping["Targets"];
names = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[targets[[All, 1]]]];
families = KeyTake[geometry["Families"], names];
text[expression_] := StringReplace[ToString[InputForm[expression]], Whitespace -> ""];
csv[list_] := "[" <> StringRiffle[text /@ list, ","] <> "]";
integralText[integral_] := integral[[1]] <> csv[integral[[2]]];
external = Take[geometry["BasisMomenta"], Length[geometry["BasisMomenta"]] -
  Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]] + 1];
externalGram = geometry["CommonGram"][[Range[Length[external]], Range[Length[external]]]];
invariants = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[externalGram,
  symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]]];
(* Fermat requires lower-case variable names. This is a name change only. *)
exportRules = {Q2 -> q2};
importRules = Reverse /@ exportRules;
gate["invariant rename is invertible", (invariants /. exportRules /. importRules) === invariants];
kinematics = {"kinematics:", "  incoming_momenta: " <> csv[external],
  "  outgoing_momenta: []", "  kinematic_invariants:"};
kinematics = Join[kinematics, ("    - [" <> text[# /. exportRules] <> ", 2]" & /@ invariants),
  {"  scalarproduct_rules:"}, Flatten[Table[
    "    - [[" <> text[external[[i]]] <> "," <> text[external[[j]]] <> "], " <>
      text[externalGram[[i, j]] /. exportRules] <> "]",
    {i, Length[external]}, {j, i, Length[external]}]]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "kinematics.yaml"}], StringRiffle[kinematics, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
familyLines = {"integralfamilies:"};
reductions = {};
preferred = {};
bounds = <||>;
Do[
  spec = families[name];
  actual = Select[targets, #[[1]] === name &][[All, 2]];
  positiveSums = Total[Select[#, # > 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  negativeSums = -Total[Select[#, # < 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  sectors = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Total[MapIndexed[
    If[#1 > 0, 2^(First[#2] - 1), 0] &, #]] & /@ actual]];
  topSectors = Select[sectors, Function[sector, !AnyTrue[DeleteCases[sectors, sector],
    BitAnd[sector, #] === sector &]]];
  rBound = Max[positiveSums] + Length[spec["LoopMomenta"]];
  sBound = Max[negativeSums];
  AssociateTo[bounds, name -> <|"r" -> rBound, "s" -> sBound,
    "Sectors" -> sectors, "TopSectors" -> topSectors, "TargetCount" -> Length[actual]|>];
  familyLines = Join[familyLines, {"  - name: " <> name,
    "    loop_momenta: " <> csv[spec["LoopMomenta"]],
    "    top_level_sectors: " <> csv[topSectors], "    propagators:"},
    MapThread["      - [\"" <> text[#1] <> "\", " <> text[#2] <> "]" &,
      {spec["PropagatorMomenta"], spec["PropagatorMassesSquared"]}],
    {"    cut_propagators: " <> csv[spec["CutPositions"]]}];
  AppendTo[reductions, "        - {topologies: [" <> name <> "], sectors: " <>
    csv[topSectors] <> ", r: " <> text[rBound] <> ", s: " <> text[sBound] <> "}"];
  preferred = Join[preferred, Table[CutIntegral[name,
    Table[If[MemberQ[spec["CutPositions"], i] || MemberQ[support, i], 1, 0],
      {i, Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]}]],
    {support, Subsets[Complement[Range[Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]], spec["CutPositions"]]]}]],
  {name, names}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "integralfamilies.yaml"}], StringRiffle[familyLines, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "targets"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ targets, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "preferred"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ preferred, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
jobs = Join[{"jobs:", "  - reduce_sectors:", "      reduce:"}, reductions,
  {"      select_integrals:", "        select_mandatory_list:", "          - [targets]",
   "      preferred_masters: preferred", "      run_initiate: true",
   "      run_triangular: true", "      run_back_substitution: true",
   "  - kira2math:", "      target:", "        - [targets]"}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "jobs.yaml"}], StringRiffle[jobs, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
put[<|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "Bounds" -> bounds,
  "Families" -> families, "Targets" -> targets, "PreferredCandidates" -> preferred,
  "ExportRules" -> exportRules, "ImportRules" -> importRules,
  "CutEnergyConditions" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]|>, FileNameJoin[{work, "s04_configuration.wl"}]];
Print["KIRA_START ", work, " target count ", Length[targets], " bounds ", InputForm[bounds]];
run = RunProcess[{kira, "--parallel=2", "jobs.yaml"}, All, ProcessDirectory -> work];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s04_kira_stdout.log"}], run["StandardOutput"], "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s04_kira_stderr.log"}], run["StandardError"], "Text"];
Print[StringTake[run["StandardOutput"], -Min[12000, StringLength[run["StandardOutput"]]]]];
If[run["StandardError"] =!= "", Print[run["StandardError"]]];
gate["Kira completed", run["ExitCode"] === 0];
ruleFiles = Sort[FileNames["kira_*.m", FileNameJoin[{work, "results"}], Infinity]];
gate["Kira exported symbolic rules", Length[ruleFiles] > 0];
rules = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ ruleFiles]];
gate["Kira output consists of rules", MatchQ[rules, {__Rule}]];
heads = Symbol /@ names;
toCut[expression_] := expression /. (HoldPattern[h_[indices__Integer]] /; MemberQ[heads, h]) :>
  CutIntegral[SymbolName[h], {indices}];
masterFile = FileNameJoin[{work, "tmp", Last[names], "masters"}];
gate["final Kira master inventory exists", FileExistsQ[masterFile]];
declaredMasters = toCut[ToExpression /@ StringCases[Import[masterFile, "Text"],
  RegularExpression["R[0-9]+\\[[0-9, -]+\\]"]]];
gate["nonempty final Kira master inventory", MatchQ[declaredMasters, {__CutIntegral}]];
rules = toCut[rules] /. importRules /. d -> D;
missingTargets = Complement[targets, First /@ rules];
gate["targets without explicit rules are declared masters",
  Complement[missingTargets, declaredMasters] === {}];
rules = Join[rules, (# -> # & /@ missingTargets)];
gate["each target has a reduction rule", Complement[targets, First /@ rules] === {}];
gate["rules have unique targets", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ rules]];
masters = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules, _CutIntegral, Infinity]]];
gate["every rule ends in Kira's final master inventory",
  Complement[masters, declaredMasters] === {}];
gate["both cut propagators survive in every master", And @@
  (And @@ (# > 0 & /@ #[[2, families[#[[1]]]["CutPositions"]]]) & /@ masters)];
gate["rule coefficients are rational in symbolic dimension and invariants",
  FreeQ[rules, _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
resultFile = FileNameJoin[{root, "s04_result.wl"}];
put[<|"Rules" -> rules, "Masters" -> masters, "Targets" -> targets,
  "Bounds" -> bounds, "Families" -> families, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "MappingHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s03_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
  "KiraHash" -> FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], "FermatHash" -> FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"],
  "RuleFiles" -> ruleFiles, "WorkDirectory" -> work, "Accepted" -> True,
  "CutEnergyConditions" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],
  "MasterEvaluationPerformed" -> False|>, resultFile];
Do[put[<|"Channel" -> channel, "RealMappingHash" -> mapping["Channels"][channel]["SHA256"],
  "SharedReduction" -> "../s04_result.wl", "SharedReductionHash" -> FileHash[resultFile, "SHA256"],
  "Accepted" -> True, "MasterEvaluationPerformed" -> False|>,
  FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s04_result.wl"}]], {channel, Keys[mapping["Channels"]]}];
Print["S04_SUCCESS: ", Length[targets], " targets reduced to ", Length[masters], " cut masters."];
Print["MASTERS ", InputForm[masters]];
Quit[0];

```

## common/s06_result/reference/sources/s08_cut_master_inputs.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-142", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9341, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s06_result/reference/sources/s08_cut_master_inputs.wl", "sha256": "13b120a7d7d79a1aca6b360dddd5f2e1f8170f7fcc6b2650effcf7145898bc70"} -->
```wolfram
(* Positive-energy Euler representations of the actual Kira cut masters. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
gate[name_, condition_] := If[TrueQ[condition], Print["PASS: ", name],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 900,
  gate[label <> " time limit", False]], 2*1024^3, gate[label <> " memory limit", False]];
geometry = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}]];
reduction = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s04_result.wl"}]];
gate["accepted real reduction", TrueQ[reduction["Accepted"]]];
sourceHash = FileHash[$InputFileName, "SHA256"];
basis = geometry["BasisMomenta"]; gram = geometry["CommonGram"];
vector[momentum_] := Coefficient[Expand[momentum], #] & /@ basis;
dot[left_, right_] := Factor[vector[left].gram.vector[right]];
cut[value_] := Factor[value /. geometry["CutRules"]];
recoil = geometry["RecoilMomentum"];
dimension = 4 - 2 eps;

(* Geometry only: the Gaussian definition fixes the continued sphere area. *)
gaussian = Integrate[Exp[-xx^2], {xx, -Infinity, Infinity}];
radialGaussian = Integrate[Exp[-rr^2] rr^(nn - 1), {rr, 0, Infinity},
  Assumptions -> nn > 0];
sphereArea[n_] := (gaussian^nn/radialGaussian) /. nn -> n;
cutEquations = {en^2 - rad^2 == 0, (Sqrt[w] - en)^2 - rad^2 == 0};
cutSolutions = Solve[cutEquations, {en, rad}];
positiveSolutions = Select[cutSolutions,
  TrueQ[FullSimplify[en > 0 && Sqrt[w] - en > 0 && rad > 0 /. #, w > 0]] &];
gate["unique positive-energy cut solution", Length[positiveSolutions] === 1];
cutSolution = First[positiveSolutions];
cutPolynomials = Subtract @@@ cutEquations;
cutJacobian = Det[Table[D[polynomial, variable],
  {polynomial, cutPolynomials}, {variable, {en, rad}}]] /. cutSolution;
radialPrefactor = FullSimplify[(rad^(dimension - 2) /. cutSolution)/Abs[cutJacobian],
  w > 0 && Element[eps, Reals]];
gate["both defining cuts vanish", And @@ (TrueQ[Simplify[# /. cutSolution, w > 0]] & /@ cutEquations)];

(* These changes of variables produce densities; only SubTropica evaluates them. *)
cosine = (1 - u)/(1 + u);
cosineJacobian = FullSimplify[Abs[D[cosine, u]], u > 0];
cosineDensity = FullSimplify[(1 - cosine^2)^((dimension - 4)/2) cosineJacobian,
  u > 0 && Element[eps, Reals]];
bubbleTuple = {1, cosineDensity, {u}, {}};
betaParameter = (1 - zz)/(1 + zz);
triangleDensity = FullSimplify[cosineDensity/(1 - betaParameter cosine),
  u > 0 && zz > 0 && Element[eps, Reals]];
triangleTuple = {1, triangleDensity, {u}, {zz}};

(* Eq. (56) and its unevaluated Appell Euler definition, arXiv:1101.3557.
   j refers to the possibly massive direction; k to the null direction. *)
omegaPrefactor = 2^(2 - jj - kk - 2 eps) Pi^(1 - eps)*
  Gamma[1 - kk - eps]/Gamma[2 - kk - 2 eps];
appellParameters = {aa -> jj, bb -> 1 - kk - eps, cc -> 2 - kk - 2 eps};
eulerPrefactor = Gamma[cc]/(Gamma[aa] Gamma[cc - aa]) /. appellParameters;
eulerDensity = (tau^(aa - 1) (1 - tau)^(cc - aa - 1)
  (1 - (1 - zm) tau)^(-bb) (1 - (1 - zp) tau)^(-bb)) /. appellParameters;
eulerMap = tau -> u/(1 + u);
pairDensity = FullSimplify[(eulerDensity /. eulerMap) D[u/(1 + u), u],
  u > 0 && zm > 0 && zp > 0 && Element[{eps, jj, kk}, Reals]];
pairPrefactor = Cancel[omegaPrefactor eulerPrefactor];
normalizationInputs = <|
  "normalization_direct_null" -> <|"SubTropicaInput" -> {1,
    FullSimplify[cosineDensity/(1-cosine),u>0 && Element[eps,Reals]], {u},{}},
    "Order" -> 1, "RegulatedPrefactor" -> ((radialPrefactor sphereArea[dimension-2]) /. w->1)|>,
  "normalization_pair_rest" -> <|"SubTropicaInput" -> {1,
    FullSimplify[pairDensity /. {jj->1,kk->1,zm->1,zp->1},u>0 && Element[eps,Reals]], {u},{}},
    "Order" -> 1, "RegulatedPrefactor" -> ((radialPrefactor pairPrefactor (1/2)^(-jj)) /. {jj->1,kk->1,w->1})|>|>;

(* Bound the needed series using actual rational reduction coefficients. *)
valuation[expression_] := Module[{value = Together[expression /. D -> dimension]},
  If[zero[value], Infinity, Exponent[Numerator[value], eps, Min] -
    Exponent[Denominator[value], eps, Min]]];
masters = reduction["Masters"];
ruleValues = Expand[Last /@ reduction["Rules"]];
orders = Association@Table[master -> (1 - Min[0,
  Min[valuation /@ DeleteCases[Coefficient[#, master] & /@ ruleValues, 0]]]), {master, masters}];
gate["finite nonnegative requested regulator orders", And @@ (IntegerQ[#] && # >= 0 & /@ Values[orders])];

entries = <||>; tuples = <||>;
Do[
  family = reduction["Families"][master[[1]]];
  gate["unit cut master indices", Complement[master[[2]], {0, 1}] === {}];
  active = Select[Complement[Range[Length[master[[2]]]], family["CutPositions"]], master[[2, #]] > 0 &];
  effective = Table[
    momentum = family["PropagatorMomenta"][[i]];
    sign = Coefficient[momentum, r];
    shift = Expand[momentum/sign - r];
    alpha = alpha /. First[Solve[cut[dot[momentum, momentum] - 2 dot[r, shift + alpha recoil]] == 0, alpha]];
    effectiveVector = Expand[shift + alpha recoil]; Clear[alpha];
    gate["effective vector reconstructs " <> ToString[master, InputForm],
      zero[cut[dot[momentum, momentum] - 2 dot[r, effectiveVector]]]];
    scale = dot[effectiveVector, recoil];
    <|"Position" -> i, "Vector" -> effectiveVector, "Scale" -> scale,
      "NormalizedMassSquared" -> Factor[w dot[effectiveVector, effectiveVector]/scale^2],
      "Power" -> master[[2, i]]|>, {i, active}];
  Switch[Length[effective],
    0,
      id = "cut_volume"; tuple = bubbleTuple;
      prefactor = radialPrefactor sphereArea[dimension - 2]; physicalRules = {},
    1,
      id = "cut_single_massive"; tuple = triangleTuple;
      velocity = Sqrt[1 - effective[[1]]["NormalizedMassSquared"]];
      physicalRules = {zz -> (1 - velocity)/(1 + velocity)};
      prefactor = radialPrefactor sphereArea[dimension - 2]/effective[[1]]["Scale"],
    2,
      nullPositions = Select[Range[Length[effective]], zero[effective[[#]]["NormalizedMassSquared"]] &];
      gate["pair has a null direction", Length[nullPositions] > 0];
      nullPosition = Last[nullPositions]; otherPosition = First[Complement[Range[Length[effective]], {nullPosition}]];
      {first, second} = effective[[{otherPosition, nullPosition}]];
      pairInvariant = Factor[w dot[first["Vector"], second["Vector"]]/
        (2 first["Scale"] second["Scale"])];
      betaSquared = Factor[1 - first["NormalizedMassSquared"]];
      rootRules = {zm -> (1 - Sqrt[betaSquared])/(2 pairInvariant),
        zp -> (1 + Sqrt[betaSquared])/(2 pairInvariant)};
      exponentRules = {jj -> first["Power"], kk -> second["Power"]};
      If[Length[nullPositions] === 2,
        id = "cut_pair_massless";
        tuple = {1, FullSimplify[(pairDensity /. exponentRules) /. zm -> 0,
          u > 0 && zp > 0 && Element[eps, Reals]], {u}, {zp}};
        physicalRules = DeleteCases[rootRules, HoldPattern[zm -> _]],
        id = "cut_pair_one_massive";
        tuple = {1, pairDensity /. exponentRules, {u}, {zm, zp}};
        physicalRules = rootRules];
      prefactor = radialPrefactor (pairPrefactor /. exponentRules)/
        (first["Scale"]^first["Power"] second["Scale"]^second["Power"] pairInvariant^first["Power"]),
    _, gate["supported scalar cut-master class", False]];
  If[KeyExistsQ[tuples, id], gate["shared class has the same defining tuple", tuples[id]["SubTropicaInput"] === tuple]];
  previousOrder = If[KeyExistsQ[tuples, id], tuples[id]["Order"], 0];
  AssociateTo[tuples, id -> <|"SubTropicaInput" -> tuple,
    "Order" -> Max[previousOrder, orders[master]], "SourceHash" -> sourceHash|>];
  AssociateTo[entries, master -> <|"Class" -> id, "EffectiveVectors" -> effective,
    "RegulatedPrefactor" -> prefactor, "PhysicalSubstitutions" -> physicalRules,
    "RequiredOrder" -> orders[master], "CutEnergyConditions" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],
    "ParameterConditions" -> And @@ (# >= 0 & /@ (tuple[[4]] /. physicalRules)),
    "AcceptedRepresentation" -> True, "IntegralEvaluationPerformed" -> False|>];
  Print["CUT_INPUT ", InputForm[master], " class ", id, " order ", orders[master]], {master, masters}];
directory = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_cut_inputs"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
KeyValueMap[put[#2, FileNameJoin[{directory, #1 <> ".wl"}]] &, tuples];
put[<|"Masters" -> entries, "Classes" -> tuples, "NormalizationInputs" -> normalizationInputs, "PositiveCutSolution" -> cutSolution,
  "CutJacobian" -> cutJacobian, "RadialPrefactor" -> radialPrefactor,
  "SphereAreaDefinition" -> sphereArea[nn], "CosineMap" -> cosine,
  "AppellEulerDefinition" -> {omegaPrefactor, eulerPrefactor, eulerDensity},
  "MasterMeasure" -> "d^D r delta_plus(r^2) delta_plus((P-r)^2); no 2 pi factors",
  "RepresentationReference" -> "https://arxiv.org/abs/1101.3557 Eqs (7),(56), Appendix B",
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "ReductionHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s04_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
  "AcceptedRepresentations" -> True, "IntegralEvaluationPerformed" -> False|>, FileNameJoin[{root, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Print["S08_SUCCESS: ", Length[masters], " positive-energy cut masters mapped to ", Length[tuples], " Euler classes."];
Quit[0];

```

## common/s06_result/reference/sources/s09_reduce_virtual.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-143", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 12601, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s06_result/reference/sources/s09_reduce_virtual.wl", "sha256": "5e9ddee07997d6584ae3e9f7762a8d2f82986c7cdb124257cc51b09f3257ba26"} -->
```wolfram
(* Kira reduction of the new, exactly reconstructed virtual scalar integrands. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
Get["FeynCalc`"];
root = DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
gate[name_, condition_] := If[TrueQ[condition], Print["PASS: ", name],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
put[value_, file_] := (Put[value, file <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[file <> ".tmp", file, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
geometry = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}]];
mapping = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s05_result.wl"}]];
gate["accepted virtual scalar maps", TrueQ[mapping["Accepted"]] &&
  mapping["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s05_virtual_families.wl"}], "SHA256"]];
external = geometry["ExternalMomenta"];
externalGram = Take[geometry["CommonGram"], {1, Length[external]}, {1, Length[external]}] /. w -> 0;
FCClearScalarProducts[];
Do[With[{left = external[[i]], right = external[[j]], value = externalGram[[i,j]]},
  SPD[left,right] = value], {i,Length[external]}, {j,i,Length[external]}];
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[ExpandScalarProduct[value]]] === 0;
coordinates[value_] := Coefficient[Expand[value], #] & /@ external;
familyKeys = <||>; families = <||>; changes = <||>;
Do[
  gate["massless unit standard virtual propagators", MatchQ[topology[[2]],
    {FeynAmpDenominator[StandardPropagatorDenominator[Momentum[_,D],0,0,{1,1}]]..}]];
  momenta = #[[1,1,1]] & /@ topology[[2]];
  signs = Coefficient[#,ell] & /@ momenta;
  gate["unit virtual loop routing", And @@ (MemberQ[{-1,1},#] & /@ signs)];
  shifts = MapThread[Expand[#1/#2-ell] &, {momenta,signs}];
  candidates = Flatten[Table[
    shifted = Expand[orientation (#-anchor)] & /@ shifts;
    permutation = Ordering[coordinates /@ shifted];
    <|"Shifts" -> shifted[[permutation]], "Permutation" -> permutation,
      "Orientation" -> orientation, "Anchor" -> anchor|>,
    {anchor,shifts}, {orientation,{-1,1}}],1];
  canonical = First[SortBy[candidates, Flatten[coordinates /@ #["Shifts"]] &]];
  key = canonical["Shifts"];
  If[!KeyExistsQ[familyKeys,key],
    name = "V" <> IntegerString[Length[familyKeys]+1,10,2];
    AssociateTo[familyKeys,key -> name];
    AssociateTo[families,name -> <|"LoopMomenta" -> {ell},
      "PropagatorMomenta" -> (ell+# & /@ key),
      "PropagatorMassesSquared" -> ConstantArray[0,Length[key]]|>]];
  name = familyKeys[key];
  Do[
    old = momenta[[canonical["Permutation"][[i]]]] /. ell -> canonical["Orientation"] ell-canonical["Anchor"];
    new = families[name]["PropagatorMomenta"][[i]];
    gate["canonical routing reconstructs " <> topology[[1]], zero[FCI[SPD[old,old]-SPD[new,new]]]],
    {i,Length[key]}];
  AssociateTo[changes,topology[[1]] -> Join[canonical,<|"Family" -> name|>]],
  {topology,mapping["Topologies"]}];
canonicalize[GLI[id_String,indices_List]] := GLI[changes[id]["Family"],indices[[changes[id]["Permutation"]]]];
canonicalRules = (# -> canonicalize[#] & /@ mapping["Targets"]);
targets = Union[Last /@ canonicalRules];
names = Sort[Keys[families]];
Print["CANONICAL_VIRTUAL_FAMILIES ",Length[names]," targets ",Length[targets]];
kira = FileNameJoin[{root, "software", "kira-3.1"}];
fermat = FileNameJoin[{root, "software", "fermat", "Ferl7", "fer64"}];
gate["dedicated Kira and Fermat binaries exist", FileExistsQ[kira] && FileExistsQ[fermat]];
SetEnvironment["FERMATPATH" -> fermat];
sourceHash = FileHash[$InputFileName, "SHA256"];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s05_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}], "SHA256"], FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
work = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s09_kira_virtual", IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
config = FileNameJoin[{work, "config"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[config], CreateDirectory[config, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
text[expression_] := StringReplace[ToString[InputForm[expression]], Whitespace -> ""];
csv[list_] := "[" <> StringRiffle[text /@ list, ","] <> "]";
integralText[integral_] := integral[[1]] <> csv[integral[[2]]];
invariants = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[externalGram,
  symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]]];
(* Fermat requires lower-case variable names. This is a name change only. *)
exportRules = {Q2 -> q2};
importRules = Reverse /@ exportRules;
gate["invariant rename is invertible", (invariants /. exportRules /. importRules) === invariants];
kinematics = {"kinematics:", "  incoming_momenta: " <> csv[external],
  "  outgoing_momenta: []", "  kinematic_invariants:"};
kinematics = Join[kinematics, ("    - [" <> text[# /. exportRules] <> ", 2]" & /@ invariants),
  {"  scalarproduct_rules:"}, Flatten[Table[
    "    - [[" <> text[external[[i]]] <> "," <> text[external[[j]]] <> "], " <>
      text[externalGram[[i, j]] /. exportRules] <> "]",
    {i, Length[external]}, {j, i, Length[external]}]]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "kinematics.yaml"}], StringRiffle[kinematics, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
familyLines = {"integralfamilies:"};
reductions = {};
preferred = {};
bounds = <||>;
globalR = Max[Total[Select[#, #>0 &]] & /@ targets[[All,2]]] + Length[First[Values[families]]["LoopMomenta"]];
globalS = Max[-Total[Select[#, #<0 &]] & /@ targets[[All,2]]] + Length[First[Values[families]]["LoopMomenta"]];
Do[
  spec = families[name];
  actual = Select[targets, #[[1]] === name &][[All, 2]];
  positiveSums = Total[Select[#, # > 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  negativeSums = -Total[Select[#, # < 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  sectors = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Total[MapIndexed[
    If[#1 > 0, 2^(First[#2] - 1), 0] &, #]] & /@ actual]];
  topSectors = Select[sectors, Function[sector, !AnyTrue[DeleteCases[sectors, sector],
    BitAnd[sector, #] === sector &]]];
  rBound = globalR;
  sBound = globalS;
  AssociateTo[bounds, name -> <|"r" -> rBound, "s" -> sBound,
    "Sectors" -> sectors, "TopSectors" -> topSectors, "TargetCount" -> Length[actual]|>];
  familyLines = Join[familyLines, {"  - name: " <> name,
    "    loop_momenta: " <> csv[spec["LoopMomenta"]],
    "    top_level_sectors: " <> csv[topSectors], "    propagators:"},
    MapThread["      - [\"" <> text[#1] <> "\", " <> text[#2] <> "]" &,
      {spec["PropagatorMomenta"], spec["PropagatorMassesSquared"]}],
    {}];
  AppendTo[reductions, "        - {topologies: [" <> name <> "], sectors: " <>
    csv[topSectors] <> ", r: " <> text[rBound] <> ", s: " <> text[sBound] <> "}"];
  preferred = Join[preferred, Table[GLI[name,
    Table[If[MemberQ[support, i], 1, 0], {i,Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]}]],
    {support, Subsets[Range[Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]]]}]],
  {name, names}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "integralfamilies.yaml"}], StringRiffle[familyLines, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "targets"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ targets, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "preferred"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ preferred, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
jobs = Join[{"jobs:", "  - reduce_sectors:", "      reduce:"}, reductions,
  {"      select_integrals:", "        select_mandatory_list:", "          - [targets]",
   "      preferred_masters: preferred", "      run_initiate: true",
   "      run_triangular: true", "      run_back_substitution: true",
   "  - kira2math:", "      target:", "        - [targets]"}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "jobs.yaml"}], StringRiffle[jobs, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
put[<|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "Bounds" -> bounds,
  "Families" -> families, "Targets" -> targets, "PreferredCandidates" -> preferred,
  "ExportRules" -> exportRules, "ImportRules" -> importRules,
  "Canonicalization" -> changes, "CanonicalizationRules" -> canonicalRules|>, FileNameJoin[{work, "s09_configuration.wl"}]];
Print["KIRA_START ", work, " target count ", Length[targets], " bounds ", InputForm[bounds]];
run = RunProcess[{kira, "--parallel=2", "jobs.yaml"}, All, ProcessDirectory -> work];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s09_kira_stdout.log"}], run["StandardOutput"], "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s09_kira_stderr.log"}], run["StandardError"], "Text"];
Print[StringTake[run["StandardOutput"], -Min[12000, StringLength[run["StandardOutput"]]]]];
If[run["StandardError"] =!= "", Print[run["StandardError"]]];
gate["Kira completed", run["ExitCode"] === 0];
ruleFiles = Sort[FileNames["kira_*.m", FileNameJoin[{work, "results"}], Infinity]];
gate["Kira exported symbolic rules", Length[ruleFiles] > 0];
rules = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ ruleFiles]];
gate["Kira output consists of rules", MatchQ[rules, {__Rule}]];
heads = Symbol /@ names;
toIntegral[expression_] := expression /. (HoldPattern[h_[indices__Integer]] /; MemberQ[heads, h]) :>
  GLI[SymbolName[h], {indices}];
masterFile = FileNameJoin[{work, "tmp", Last[names], "masters"}];
gate["final Kira master inventory exists", FileExistsQ[masterFile]];
declaredMasters = toIntegral[ToExpression /@ StringCases[Import[masterFile, "Text"],
  RegularExpression["V[0-9]+\\[[0-9, -]+\\]"]]];
gate["nonempty final Kira master inventory", MatchQ[declaredMasters, {__GLI}]];
rules = toIntegral[rules] /. importRules /. d -> D;
missingTargets = Complement[targets, First /@ rules];
gate["targets without explicit rules are declared masters",
  Complement[missingTargets, declaredMasters] === {}];
rules = Join[rules, (# -> # & /@ missingTargets)];
gate["each target has a reduction rule", Complement[targets, First /@ rules] === {}];
gate["rules have unique targets", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ rules]];
masters = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules, _GLI, Infinity]]];
closureFiles={};closurePass=0;
missingMasters=Complement[masters,declaredMasters];
While[missingMasters=!={} && closurePass<5,
  closurePass++;
  closureName="closure_"<>ToString[closurePass];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,closureName}],StringRiffle[integralText /@ missingMasters,"\n"]<>"\n","Text"];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,closureName<>".yaml"}],
    "jobs:\n  - kira2math:\n      target:\n        - ["<>closureName<>"]\n","Text"];
  Print["KIRA_EXPORT_CLOSURE ",InputForm[missingMasters]];
  closureRun=RunProcess[{kira,closureName<>".yaml"},All,ProcessDirectory->work];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,"s09_"<>closureName<>".log"}],closureRun["StandardOutput"]<>closureRun["StandardError"],"Text"];
  gate["Kira intermediate-integral export completed",closureRun["ExitCode"]===0];
  files=FileNames["kira_"<>closureName<>".m",FileNameJoin[{work,"results"}],Infinity];
  gate["Kira exported the needed intermediate rules",Length[files]>0];
  closureRules=toIntegral[DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ files]]] /. importRules /. d->D;
  gate["every intermediate has a non-identity Kira rule",Complement[missingMasters,First /@ closureRules]==={} &&
    And@@(First[#]=!=Last[#]& /@ closureRules)];
  rules=(First[#]->Expand[Last[#] /. closureRules]& /@ rules);
  closureFiles=Join[closureFiles,files];
  masters=Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules,_GLI,Infinity]]];
  missingMasters=Complement[masters,declaredMasters]];
put[<|"ExportedMasters" -> masters,"FinalInventory" -> declaredMasters,
  "MissingFromInventory" -> Complement[masters,declaredMasters]|>,FileNameJoin[{work,"s09_master_inventory.wl"}]];
gate["every rule ends in Kira's final master inventory",
  Complement[masters, declaredMasters] === {}];
gate["final virtual basis consists of scalar unit-index masters",
  And @@ (Complement[#[[2]],{0,1}] === {} & /@ masters)];
gate["rule coefficients are rational in symbolic dimension and invariants",
  FreeQ[rules, _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
resultFile = FileNameJoin[{root, "s09_result.wl"}];
put[<|"Rules" -> rules, "Masters" -> masters, "Targets" -> targets,
  "Bounds" -> bounds, "Families" -> families, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "MappingHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s05_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
  "KiraHash" -> FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], "FermatHash" -> FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"],
  "RuleFiles" -> ruleFiles, "ClosureRuleFiles" -> closureFiles, "WorkDirectory" -> work, "Accepted" -> True,
  "Canonicalization" -> changes, "CanonicalizationRules" -> canonicalRules,
  "MasterEvaluationPerformed" -> False|>, resultFile];
Do[put[<|"Channel" -> channel,
  "VirtualMappingHash" -> mapping["Channels"][channel]["Hash"],
  "SharedReduction" -> "../s09_result.wl", "SharedReductionHash" -> FileHash[resultFile,"SHA256"],
  "Accepted" -> True, "MasterEvaluationPerformed" -> False|>,
  FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s09_result.wl"}]], {channel,Keys[mapping["Channels"]]}];
Print["S09_SUCCESS: ", Length[targets], " targets reduced to ", Length[masters], " virtual masters."];
Print["MASTERS ",InputForm[masters]];
Quit[0];

```
