## common/s08_cancel_denominator_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-171", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3593, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_cancel_denominator_check.wls", "sha256": "6a8cf24abf16e75d43a787eb50dccc5f001fb2bd00ad9e29a37c147c02f7a020"} -->
```wolfram
(* Cancel only factors measured in the actual coefficient denominators. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
cancelSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_cancel_denominator_check.wls"}];
cancelBaselinePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_denominator_sum_check.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[cancelBaselinePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "c2ba99a0039cbbc295b7aa918d336f697a1cc5a5546f3e670ec4ec9bb01bc47d",
  Print["FAIL: pinned denominator comparison source"]; Quit[1]];

cancelKnownDenominatorFactors[polynomial_, factors_List, powers_List, purpose_] := Module[
  {current, extracted, factor, candidates, variable, division, quotient, remainder, seconds, beforeBytes},
  current = polynomial; extracted = {};
  gate["matched measured denominator inventory", Length[factors] === Length[powers]];
  Do[
    factor = factors[[index]];
    candidates = Select[Variables[factor],
      Function[symbol, NumberQ[Coefficient[factor, symbol, Exponent[factor, symbol]]]]];
    gate["known denominator has constant leading coefficient", candidates =!= {}];
    variable = First[MinimalBy[candidates, Exponent[factor, #] &]];
    Do[
      beforeBytes = ByteCount[current];
      {seconds, division} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
        PolynomialQuotientRemainder[current, factor, variable], {purpose, "known-factor division", index, power}]];
      {quotient, remainder} = division;
      remainder = bounded[Expand[remainder], {purpose, "exact division remainder", index, power}];
      gate["exact known-factor quotient and remainder", bounded[
        Expand[current - factor quotient - remainder] === 0, {purpose, "division reconstruction", index, power}]];
      Print["KNOWN_FACTOR_DIVISION ", purpose, " factor ", InputForm[factor], " variable ", variable,
        " seconds ", seconds, " input_bytes ", beforeBytes, " quotient_bytes ", ByteCount[quotient],
        " divides ", remainder === 0];
      If[remainder =!= 0, Break[]];
      current = quotient; AppendTo[extracted, factor], {power, powers[[index]]}],
    {index, Length[factors]}];
  (Times @@ extracted) current];

cancelBaselineText = Import[cancelBaselinePath, "Text"];
cancelReplacements = {
  "denominatorSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], \"common\", \"s08_denominator_sum_check.wls\"}];" ->
    "denominatorSource = cancelSourcePath;",
  "factoredNumerator = bounded[Factor[numerator], {purpose, \"final numerator factorization\"}];" ->
    "factoredNumerator = cancelKnownDenominatorFactors[numerator, allFactors, commonPowers, purpose];",
  "\"cache\", \"s08_denominator_sum\"" -> "\"cache\", \"s08_cancel_denominator_sum\"",
  "\"s08_denominator_result\"" -> "\"s08_cancel_denominator_result\"",
  "\"polarized-sidis-denominator-sum-validation-v1\"" -> "\"polarized-sidis-known-denominator-validation-v1\"",
  "\"Definitions\" -> DownValues[factoredDenominatorSum]" ->
    "\"Definitions\" -> DownValues[factoredDenominatorSum], \"CancellationDefinitions\" -> DownValues[cancelKnownDenominatorFactors], \"DenominatorSourceHash\" -> FileHash[cancelBaselinePath, \"SHA256\"]",
  "\"PASS: s08_denominator_sum_check\"" -> "\"PASS: s08_cancel_denominator_check\""};
Do[If[StringCount[cancelBaselineText, First[replacement]] =!= 1,
  Print["FAIL: unique reviewed denominator replacement ", First[replacement]]; Quit[1]],
  {replacement, cancelReplacements}];
cancelProgram = StringReplace[cancelBaselineText, cancelReplacements];
If[!SyntaxQ[cancelProgram] || !SyntaxQ[Import[cancelSourcePath, "Text"]],
  Print["FAIL: complete known-denominator source syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[cancelProgram, InputForm];
```

```wolfram
If[!DirectoryQ[additiveDirectory],CreateDirectory[additiveDirectory]];

saveNative[additiveInput,FileNameJoin[{additiveDirectory,"s08_input_equation.wl"}]];

additiveSharedEdits={"saved=If[FileExistsQ[path],Get[path],<||>];"->"saved=sharedReadPiece[path,binding];",
 "And@@Values[saved[\"Checks\"]],Return[saved]];"->"And@@Values[saved[\"Checks\"]],Null,",
 "seconds];saved]]],pieces];"->"seconds]];saved]]],pieces];"};
gate["unique accepted shared-reader edits",And@@(StringCount[additivePieceSource,First[#]]===1&/@additiveSharedEdits)];
```

## common/s08_check_Hgg_affine_cancel.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-174", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6834, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_check_Hgg_affine_cancel.wls", "sha256": "8d907ac032714de63957955887333c9fb2b448646c081c5e63895c7703659aa4"} -->
```wolfram
(* Apply the accepted affine basis before the original scalar-map Cancel. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
cancelSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_Hgg_affine_cancel.wls"}];
cancelSetup=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_Hgg_polynomial_content.wls"}];
If[!SyntaxQ[ReadString[cancelSource]]||IntegerString[FileHash[cancelSetup,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "6b42c2b8cf22dc736c2dff283bfc703c45ee83cd1a063736daed95a8e0b2dff2",Quit[1]];
cancelText=ReadString[cancelSetup];cancelBoundary=StringPosition[cancelText,"\ncontentFixed="];
If[Length[cancelBoundary]=!=1,Quit[1]];
cancelPrefix=StringTake[cancelText,First[First[cancelBoundary]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[cancelPrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[cancelPrefix,InputForm];
cancelOriginalDefinitions=DownValues[externalOriginalMap];
cancelFixedDefinitions={DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[merge],DownValues[familyRows],
 DownValues[certifyFamilyLaurent],DownValues[certifyScalarReconstruction],DownValues[extractAtoms],DownValues[externalSplit]};
cancelEvidence={};
earlyAffineCancel[expression_]:=Module[{prepared,cancelled,restored,seconds},
 prepared=expression/.basisInverse;
 gate["early affine complete input round trip",(prepared/.basisForward)===expression||
  bounded[zero[(prepared/.basisForward)-expression],"early affine input roundtrip"]];
 Print["EARLY_AFFINE_CANCEL_START bytes ",ByteCount[prepared]];
 {seconds,cancelled}=AbsoluteTiming[Cancel[prepared]];
 gate["early affine cancellation preserves the complete rational input",zero[cancelled-prepared]];
 restored=cancelled/.basisForward;
 gate["early affine cancellation output has only original variables",FreeQ[restored,Alternatives@@basisCoordinates]];
 gate["early affine restored output returns to its exact cancelled form",
  (restored/.basisInverse)===cancelled||zero[(restored/.basisInverse)-cancelled]];
 AppendTo[cancelEvidence,<|"InputBytes"->ByteCount[expression],"PreparedBytes"->ByteCount[prepared],
  "CancelledBytes"->ByteCount[cancelled],"RestoredBytes"->ByteCount[restored],"Seconds"->seconds|>];
 Print["EARLY_AFFINE_CANCEL_DONE ",InputForm[Last[cancelEvidence]]];restored];
gate["one original Cancel call in the complete scalar mapper",
 Count[cancelOriginalDefinitions,HoldPattern[Cancel[_]],Infinity]===1];
cancelCandidateDefinitions=cancelOriginalDefinitions/.Cancel->earlyAffineCancel;
gate["complete original scalar mapper restored by reversing only Cancel",
 (cancelCandidateDefinitions/.earlyAffineCancel->Cancel)===cancelOriginalDefinitions];
DownValues[externalOriginalMap]=cancelCandidateDefinitions;
gate["exact early affine scalar mapper installed",DownValues[externalOriginalMap]===cancelCandidateDefinitions];
cancelGroup[value_,label_]:=Module[{parts,packets,rows},
 parts=polynomialAdditivePieces[value];
 gate["complete early affine additive input "<>label,basisPieceCertificate[value,parts]];
 packets=MapIndexed[Function[{piece,index},Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{seconds,rows},
  Print["EARLY_AFFINE_MAP_START ",label," ",First[index],"/",Length[parts]];
  {seconds,rows}=AbsoluteTiming[MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[
   mapExpression[piece],600,gate["early affine piece time bound",False]],4*1024^3,gate["early affine piece memory bound",False]]];
  Print["EARLY_AFFINE_MAP_DONE ",label," ",First[index]," seconds ",seconds];
  <|"Coefficients"->rows,"Seconds"->seconds,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>]]],parts];
 gate["every complete early affine piece accepted "<>label,And@@Lookup[packets,"Accepted"]&&And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@packets]];
 rows=bounded[merge[Lookup[packets,"Coefficients"]],"early affine full merge"];
 gate["complete early affine group merge reconstructs "<>label,certifyGroupMerge[packets,rows]];
 <|"Coefficients"->rows,"PieceSeconds"->Lookup[packets,"Seconds"],"Checks"->Lookup[packets,"Checks"]|>];
cancelSame[actual_,expected_]:=Sort[Keys[actual]]===Sort[Keys[expected]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===expected[#1]||bounded[zero[#2-expected[#1]],{"early affine coefficient",#1}])&,actual];
{cancelOwnSeconds,cancelOwn}=AbsoluteTiming[cancelGroup[contentKnown["OwnAcceptedEquation"],"own"]];
gate["early affine mapper preserves every independently accepted own coefficient",cancelSame[cancelOwn["Coefficients"],contentAffine["OwnCoefficients"]]];
{cancelKnownSeconds,cancelKnown}=AbsoluteTiming[cancelGroup[contentKnown["Equation"],"accepted38"]];
gate["early affine mapper preserves every accepted component38 group coefficient",cancelSame[cancelKnown["Coefficients"],contentAffine["ActualCoefficients"]]];
{cancelActualSeconds,cancelActual}=AbsoluteTiming[cancelGroup[contentSlow["Equation"],"actual37"]];
gate["all remaining affine mapping and scalar certificates unchanged",cancelFixedDefinitions===
 {DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[merge],DownValues[familyRows],DownValues[certifyFamilyLaurent],
 DownValues[certifyScalarReconstruction],DownValues[extractAtoms],DownValues[externalSplit]}&&
 (DownValues[externalOriginalMap]/.earlyAffineCancel->Cancel)===cancelOriginalDefinitions];
cancelInputPaths={"Hgg/s08_affine_piece_basis_result/s08_result.wl","Hgg/s08_slow_group_input_result/s08_result.wl",
 "Hgg/s08_failed_group_input_result/s08_result.wl"};
cancelResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-early-affine-cancel-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[cancelSource,"SHA256"],"InputHashes"->record["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->record["TargetInputHash"],
 "ProofHashes"->Association[(#->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#}],"SHA256"])&/@cancelInputPaths],
 "NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"KnownAcceptedComparison"->True,
 "OwnCoefficients"->cancelOwn["Coefficients"],"KnownCoefficients"->cancelKnown["Coefficients"],
 "ActualCoefficients"->cancelActual["Coefficients"],"PieceChecks"->Lookup[{cancelOwn,cancelKnown,cancelActual},"Checks"],
 "OwnSeconds"->cancelOwnSeconds,"KnownSeconds"->cancelKnownSeconds,"ActualSeconds"->cancelActualSeconds,
 "Evidence"->cancelEvidence,"CancelDefinitions"->DownValues[earlyAffineCancel],
 "OriginalMappingDefinitions"->cancelOriginalDefinitions,"CandidateMappingDefinitions"->DownValues[externalOriginalMap],
 "FixedDefinitions"->cancelFixedDefinitions,"Checks"->checks,"PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
cancelDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_affine_cancel_exact_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cancelDirectory],CreateDirectory[cancelDirectory]];
saveNative[cancelResult,FileNameJoin[{cancelDirectory,"s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{cancelDirectory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"own_seconds"->cancelOwnSeconds,
 "known_seconds"->cancelKnownSeconds,"actual_seconds"->cancelActualSeconds,"evidence"->cancelEvidence,
```

```wolfram
(* Compare the saved native affine proof with the exact production artifact chain. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];checks=<||>;

gate["native allocation and complete source",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]&&SyntaxQ[ReadString[contractSource]]];
contractRead[relative_]:=Module[{path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],receipt},
 receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s08_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted native artifact "<>relative,TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];Get[path]];
zero[value_]:=Factor[Together[value]]===0;
sameGeometry[left_Association,right_Association]:=Keys[left]===Keys[right]&&And@@KeyValueMap[sameGeometry[#2,right[#1]]&,left];
sameGeometry[left_List,right_List]:=Length[left]===Length[right]&&And@@MapThread[sameGeometry,{left,right}];
sameGeometry[left_Rule,right_Rule]:=First[left]===First[right]&&sameGeometry[Last[left],Last[right]];
sameGeometry[left_,right_]:=left===right||(FreeQ[{left,right},_String|_Association|_Rule|_List,{1,Infinity}]&&zero[left-right]);

contractProof=contractRead["Hgg/s08_affine_piece_basis_result/s08_result.wl"];
contractInput=contractRead["Hgg/s08_failed_group_input_result/s08_result.wl"];
contractExternal=contractRead["Hgg/s08_external_factor_result/s08_result.wl"];
contractScalar=contractRead["Hgg/s08_scalar_certificate_result/s08_result.wl"];
contractAtoms=contractRead["Hgg/s08_factored_atom_certificate_result/s08_result.wl"];
contractGeometry=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s06_result","reference","s02_result.wl"}]]/.{Q2->Q^2,w->s23};
contractFixed={contractExternal["MappingDefinitions"],contractExternal["OriginalAliasDefinitions"],
 contractExternal["MergeDefinitions"],contractScalar["FamilyCertificateDefinitions"],
 contractScalar["MappingCertificateDefinitions"],contractAtoms["DispatchDefinitions"]};
contractFlags=<|"Schema"->(contractProof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-affine-family-basis-v1"),
 "Channel"->(contractProof["Channel"]==="Hgg"),"Accepted"->TrueQ[contractProof["Accepted"]],
 "OwnAcceptedComparison"->TrueQ[contractProof["OwnAcceptedComparison"]],
 "Checks"->(Length[contractProof["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[contractProof["Checks"]]),
 "SourceHash"->(contractProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_check_Hgg_affine_family_basis.wls"}],"SHA256"]),

contractDifferences=<|

 "FixedDefinitions"->MapThread[If[#1===#2,Nothing,<|"Saved"->#1,"Production"->#2|>]&,
```

```wolfram
phasePrepare[expression_]:=Module[{outer,splits,terms,factors,flat,candidate,atoms,scalars,left,right,rules},

 atoms=Map[Function[list,Table[Unique["phaseAtom$"],{Length[list]}]],terms];
 scalars=Table[Unique["phaseScalar$"],{Length[factors]}];
 left=Total[MapThread[Times,{scalars,Total/@atoms}]];
 right=Total[Flatten[MapThread[Function[{c,list},Map[c #&,list]],{scalars,atoms}],1]];
 gate["native full scalar distributivity identity",Expand[left-right]===0];
 flat=Flatten[MapThread[Function[{c,list},Map[c #&,list]],{factors,terms}],1];
 candidate=Total[flat];

 gate["scalar identity specializes to entire original input",(left/.rules)===expression];
 gate["scalar identity specializes to entire prepared input",(right/.rules)===candidate];
 <|"Value"->candidate,"Flattened"->True,"ExactReconstruction"->True,
```

```wolfram
 And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@ownGroupedProof["Components"]]&&TrueQ[First[ownGroupedProof["Components"]]["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 ownGroupedProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 ownGroupedProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_check_certified_denominator_mapping.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
 ownGroupedProof["ConfigurationHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_certified_denominator_inputs.json"}],"SHA256"]&&
 KeyDrop[ownGroupedProof["InputHashes"],"Hgq/s05_result/s05_result.wl"]===KeyDrop[inputHashes,"Hqg/s05_result/s05_result.wl"]];
```

## common/s08_check_Hqg_loop_expansion.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-186", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6000, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_check_Hqg_loop_expansion.wls", "sha256": "98d5a83138273ba65fa178370516b0886e32974c8b66c4afd8e2bcabf6e6b9e0"} -->
```wolfram
(* Restrict the reference numerator expansion to its declared loop coordinates. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
loopSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_Hqg_loop_expansion.wls"}];
loopBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_map_Hqg_grouped_packets.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[loopBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "0c3865a2abab5cce425c7c00d878852e9e47a3c1f31f830b24bc776796a63838" ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[loopSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
loopText=Import[loopBase,"Text"];
loopBoundary=StringPosition[loopText,"\ngroupPacketOriginalTask="];
If[Length[loopBoundary]=!=1,Quit[1]];
loopPrefix=StringTake[loopText,First[First[loopBoundary]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[loopPrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[loopPrefix,InputForm];
gate["own loop expansion comparison channel",channel==="Hqg"];
loopProof=groupPacketProof;loopProofPath=groupPacketProofPath;
loopTask=loopProof["Task"];loopExpression=loopTask["Value"]/.coordinateRules;
gate["complete actual accepted equation",loopExpression===loopProof["ActualExpression"] &&
  loopProof["Denominators"]===denominators];
loopReference=loopProof["Coefficients"];
loopOriginalDefinitions=DownValues[familyRows];
loopVariableLists=Cases[loopOriginalDefinitions,HoldPattern[CoefficientRules[_,vars_List]]:>vars,Infinity];
gate["unique original polynomial variable declaration",Length[loopVariableLists]===1 &&
  DuplicateFreeQ[First[loopVariableLists]] && AllTrue[First[loopVariableLists],Head[#]===Symbol&]];
loopVariables=First[loopVariableLists];
loopStart=StringPosition[targetMapperText,"familyRows[expression_, family_]"];
loopEnd=StringPosition[targetMapperText,"\nmapExpression[expression_]"];
gate["complete unique original family function",Length[loopStart]===1 && Length[loopEnd]===1];
loopDefinition=StringTake[targetMapperText,{First[First[loopStart]],First[First[loopEnd]]-1}];
loopOld="numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]];";
loopNew="numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed], "<>ToString[Alternatives@@loopVariables,InputForm]<>"];";
gate["one original numerator expansion",StringCount[loopDefinition,loopOld]===1];
loopCandidateDefinition=StringReplace[loopDefinition,loopOld->loopNew];
gate["only declared-coordinate expansion differs",SyntaxQ[loopCandidateDefinition] &&
  StringReplace[loopCandidateDefinition,loopNew->loopOld]===loopDefinition];
ToExpression[loopDefinition,InputForm];
gate["exact original native family definition",DownValues[familyRows]===loopOriginalDefinitions];
ToExpression[loopCandidateDefinition,InputForm];loopCandidateDefinitions=DownValues[familyRows];
gate["unchanged complete native mapper and merge",DownValues[mapExpression]===
  loopProof["AlgorithmDefinitions"]["OriginalMappingDefinitions"] && DownValues[merge]===
  loopProof["AlgorithmDefinitions"]["OriginalMergeDefinitions"]];
groupInputHash=Hash[{FileHash[loopSource,"SHA256"],FileHash[loopProofPath,"SHA256"],
  inputHashes,targetInputHash,loopOriginalDefinitions,loopCandidateDefinitions,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
groupCache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_Hqg_loop_expansion",IntegerString[groupInputHash,16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[groupCache],CreateDirectory[groupCache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
Clear[spin,sector,tasks,groupPacketProof];ClearSystemCache[];
Print["LOOP_EXPANSION_INPUT ",InputForm[<|"Task"->KeyDrop[loopTask,"Value"],
  "Variables"->loopVariables,"EquationBytes"->ByteCount[loopExpression],"Denominators"->denominators|>]];
{loopSeconds,loopCoefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[groupedMapExpression[loopExpression,"own_complete_control"]];
{loopEqualitySeconds,loopEqual}=AbsoluteTiming[loopCoefficients===loopReference ||
  bounded[zero[pairReconstruct[loopCoefficients]-pairReconstruct[loopReference]],"entire own loop-expansion map comparison"]];
gate["entire own accepted grouped map reproduced",loopEqual];
loopResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-loop-coordinate-expansion-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[loopSource,"SHA256"],"BaseHash"->FileHash[loopBase,"SHA256"],
  "OwnComparisonFile"->groupPacketProofRelative,"OwnComparisonHash"->FileHash[loopProofPath,"SHA256"],
  "OwnReceiptHash"->FileHash[groupPacketReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "TargetInputHash"->targetInputHash,"InputHash"->groupInputHash,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "Variables"->loopVariables,"Task"->KeyDrop[loopTask,"Value"],"ExpressionHash"->Hash[loopExpression,"SHA256"],
  "OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->loopOriginalDefinitions,"CandidateFamilyDefinitions"->loopCandidateDefinitions,
  "Coefficients"->loopCoefficients,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,
  "PriorGroupedSeconds"->loopProof["CandidateSeconds"],"PriorJobId"->groupPacketReceipt["job_id"],
  "PriorNode"->groupPacketReceipt["node"],"CandidateSeconds"->loopSeconds,"EqualitySeconds"->loopEqualitySeconds,
  "CurrentNode"->$MachineName,"PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],"Checks"->checks,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
loopDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_loop_expansion_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[loopDirectory],CreateDirectory[loopDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
loopResultPath=FileNameJoin[{loopDirectory,"s08_result.wl"}];
loopSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[loopResult],"loop comparison compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded loop comparison export",StringLength[loopSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[loopResultPath<>".tmp",loopSerialized,"Text"];
gate["exact saved loop comparison",Get[loopResultPath<>".tmp"]===loopResult];
RenameFile[loopResultPath<>".tmp",loopResultPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{loopDirectory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "prior_grouped_seconds"->loopProof["CandidateSeconds"],"prior_node"->groupPacketReceipt["node"],
  "candidate_seconds"->loopSeconds,"current_node"->$MachineName,"equality_seconds"->loopEqualitySeconds,
  "own_complete_comparison"->loopEqual,"peak_kernel_memory_bytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],
  "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_Hqg_loop_expansion"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Compare complete own rational maps through their derived loop polynomial. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
polynomialEqualitySource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_Hqg_polynomial_equality.wls"}];
polynomialEqualityParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_Hqg_grouped_mapping.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[polynomialEqualityParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "186ba59d98cdc9c5ad8c4c107243085cdd3537f1a4325b63d54be1ddc76dba12"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[polynomialEqualitySource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
polynomialEqualityText=Import[polynomialEqualityParent,"Text"];
polynomialEqualityBoundary=StringPosition[polynomialEqualityText,"\n{ownSeconds,ownCoefficients}="];
If[Length[polynomialEqualityBoundary]=!=1,Quit[1]];
polynomialEqualityPrefix=StringTake[polynomialEqualityText,First[First[polynomialEqualityBoundary]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[polynomialEqualityPrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[polynomialEqualityPrefix,InputForm];

completePolynomialEquality[left_,right_] := Module[{keys,coefficients,powerRows,commonPowers,commonDenominator,
 positions,familyDenominators,exponents,powers,kernel,cleared,rows,reconstruction,polynomialRows,packets={},
 count=0,residuals=<||>,seconds,residual,formal,formalReconstruction},
 keys=Union[Keys[left],Keys[right]];
 coefficients=Association@Table[key->(Lookup[left,key,0]-Lookup[right,key,0]),{key,keys}];
 gate["complete own comparison integral inventory",Keys[coefficients]===keys&&AssociationQ[left]&&AssociationQ[right]];
 gate["all map coefficients independent of loop coordinates",FreeQ[Values[coefficients],a|b]];
 powerRows=Association@Table[
   familyDenominators=families[key[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"];
   exponents=Drop[key[[2]],Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]];
   gate["own mapped cuts and complete family powers",Take[key[[2]],Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]===
     ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]&&Length[exponents]===Length[familyDenominators]&&VectorQ[exponents,IntegerQ]];
   positions=Table[SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]],denominators[[#]]===propagator&,Missing["Propagator"]],
     {propagator,familyDenominators}];
   gate["every actual family propagator is the identical common propagator",FreeQ[positions,_Missing]];
   powers=ConstantArray[0,Length[denominators]];
   MapThread[(powers[[#1]]+=#2)&,{positions,exponents}];
   kernel=Times@@MapThread[Power,{familyDenominators,-exponents}];
   gate["every complete own integral kernel reconstructed",bounded[
     zero[kernel-Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,-powers}]],"own integral kernel identity"]];
   key->powers,{key,keys}];
 commonPowers=Max/@Transpose[Prepend[Values[powerRows],ConstantArray[0,Length[denominators]]]];
 commonDenominator=Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,commonPowers}];
 gate["derived common denominator is a nonzero loop polynomial",commonDenominator=!=0&&PolynomialQ[commonDenominator,{a,b}]];
 Do[
   powers=commonPowers-powerRows[key];
   gate["cleared own kernel has nonnegative integer powers",VectorQ[powers,IntegerQ[#]&&#>=0&]];
   cleared=Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,powers}];
   gate["exact common-denominator clearing of own kernel",bounded[
     zero[cleared/commonDenominator-Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,-powerRows[key]}]],"own denominator clearing"]];
   rows=CoefficientRules[Expand[cleared],{a,b}];
   reconstruction=Total[Map[(Last[#] Times@@MapThread[Power,{{a,b},First[#]}])&,rows]];
   gate["every complete cleared kernel polynomial reconstructs",Expand[cleared-reconstruction]===0&&FreeQ[Last/@rows,a|b]];
   AppendTo[packets,Association[Map[First[#]->coefficients[key]Last[#]&,rows]]],{key,keys}];
 polynomialRows=Merge[packets,Total];
 formal=Table[Unique["ownMapCoefficient"],{Length[keys]}];
 formalReconstruction=Total[MapThread[#1 Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,commonPowers-#2}]&,{formal,Values[powerRows]}]];
 gate["all own map terms retained by polynomial collection",Length[packets]===Length[keys]&&
   Expand[formalReconstruction-Total[MapThread[#1 Sum[Last[row] Times@@MapThread[Power,{{a,b},First[row]}],
      {row,CoefficientRules[Expand[Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,commonPowers-#2}]],{a,b}]}]&,
     {formal,Values[powerRows]}]]]===0];
 Print["OWN_POLYNOMIAL_INPUT ",InputForm[<|"MapTerms"->Length[keys],"CommonPowers"->commonPowers,
   "PolynomialCoefficients"->Length[polynomialRows],"CoefficientBytes"->ByteCount[polynomialRows]|>]];
 KeyValueMap[Function[{monomial,coefficient},
   count++;Print["OWN_POLYNOMIAL_COEFFICIENT ",count,"/",Length[polynomialRows]," ",monomial];
   {seconds,residual}=AbsoluteTiming[If[coefficient===0,0,bounded[Factor[Together[coefficient]],
      {"own full map polynomial coefficient",monomial}]]];
   AssociateTo[residuals,monomial->residual];
   gate["own complete map polynomial coefficient zero "<>ToString[monomial,InputForm],residual===0];
   Print["OWN_POLYNOMIAL_COEFFICIENT_SECONDS ",seconds]],polynomialRows];
 polynomialEqualityEvidence=<|"CommonDenominator"->commonDenominator,"CommonPowers"->commonPowers,
   "IntegralPowers"->powerRows,"CoefficientCount"->Length[polynomialRows],"ExactResiduals"->residuals,
   "AllOwnCoefficientsCompared"->True|>;
 And@@(#===0&/@Values[residuals])];

polynomialEqualityTail=StringDrop[polynomialEqualityText,First[First[polynomialEqualityBoundary]]-1];
polynomialEqualityEdits={
 "zero[pairReconstruct[ownCoefficients]-pairReconstruct[ownControl[\"Coefficients\"]]]"->
   "completePolynomialEquality[ownCoefficients,ownControl[\"Coefficients\"]]",
 "\"Checks\"->checks,\"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed\"->False|>;"->
   "\"Checks\"->checks,\"PolynomialComparison\"->polynomialEqualityEvidence,\"ComparisonDispatchHash\"->FileHash[polynomialEqualitySource,\"SHA256\"],\"EqualityDefinitions\"->DownValues[completePolynomialEquality],\"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed\"->False|>;",
 "\"s08_grouped_comparison_result\""->"\"s08_polynomial_comparison_result\""
};
gate["unique own polynomial comparison edits",And@@(StringCount[polynomialEqualityTail,First[#]]===1&/@polynomialEqualityEdits)];
polynomialEqualityRun=StringReplace[polynomialEqualityTail,polynomialEqualityEdits];
gate["all own mapping equations and acceptance gates retained",SyntaxQ[polynomialEqualityRun]&&
 StringReplace[polynomialEqualityRun,Reverse/@polynomialEqualityEdits]===polynomialEqualityTail];
polynomialEqualityEvidence=<|"IdenticalCompleteMaps"->True|>;
ToExpression[polynomialEqualityRun,InputForm];
```

```wolfram
(* Exact expansion before the inherited rational zero test. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
sumSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_Hqq_pair_sum.wls"}];
sumBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_same_sector_pair_mapping.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[sumBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "bce641c29f3a4ea773e1f8539284913b56717f2d90a0c0e936c2c4f4f8cfced6", Quit[1]];
sumText = Import[sumBase, "Text"];
If[StringCount[sumText, "\nslots ="] =!= 1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[sumSource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
sumPrefix = First[StringSplit[sumText, "\nslots ="]];
If[!SyntaxQ[sumPrefix], Quit[1]]; ToExpression[sumPrefix, InputForm];
sumInputDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_pair_sum_equation_result"}];
sumInputPath = FileNameJoin[{sumInputDir, "s08_result.wl"}];
sumReceipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{sumInputDir, "s08_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
gate["accepted native equation export", TrueQ[sumReceipt["passed"]] &&
  sumReceipt["result_sha256"][channel <> "/s08_pair_sum_equation_result/s08_result.wl"] ===
    IntegerString[FileHash[sumInputPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64]];
sumInput = Get[sumInputPath];
gate["exact source input and runtime identities", sumInput["Channel"] === channel &&
  sumInput["PairSourceHash"] === FileHash[sumBase, "SHA256"] &&
  sumInput["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && sumInput["TargetInputHash"] === targetInputHash &&
  sumInput["PairInputHash"] === pairStudyHash && sumInput["PairFileHashes"] === pairConfig["files"] &&
  sumInput["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
sumIndex = sumInput["Component"];
gate["saved task exactly matches production", sumInput["Task"] === tasks[[sumIndex]]];
sumEquation = Total[sumInput["PairValues"]] - sumInput["Task"]["Value"];
gate["exact saved cancellation equation", Hash[sumEquation, "SHA256"] === sumInput["EquationHash"]];
expandedPairZero[value_] := Module[{expanded = Expand[value]},
  If[expanded === 0, True, zero[expanded]]];
{sumSeconds, sumExpanded} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[Expand[sumEquation], "saved cancellation expansion"]];
gate["saved failed cancellation is exactly zero after expansion", sumExpanded === 0];
sumControlTask = tasks[[pairControlIndex]];
sumControlValues = bounded[pairExpression[#, sumControlTask] & /@ pairInputs, "own control extraction"];
sumControlEquation = Total[sumControlValues] - sumControlTask["Value"];
{sumOldSeconds, sumOldValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[zero[sumControlEquation], "own original zero test"]];
{sumNewSeconds, sumNewValue} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[expandedPairZero[sumControlEquation], "own expanded zero test"]];
gate["own accepted control cancellation reproduced", TrueQ[sumOldValue] && sumNewValue === sumOldValue];
sumMapProofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_same_pair_mapping_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
sumMapReceipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_same_pair_mapping_result", "s08_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
sumMapProof = Get[sumMapProofPath];
gate["reuse unchanged accepted full map comparison", TrueQ[sumMapReceipt["passed"]] &&
  sumMapReceipt["result_sha256"][channel <> "/s08_same_pair_mapping_result/s08_result.wl"] ===
    IntegerString[FileHash[sumMapProofPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
  sumMapProof["SourceHash"] === FileHash[sumBase, "SHA256"] &&
  sumMapProof["InputHash"] === pairStudyHash && sumMapProof["TargetInputHash"] === targetInputHash &&
  sumMapProof["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && sumMapProof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  sumMapProof["OriginalMappingDefinitions"] === DownValues[mapExpression] &&
  sumMapProof["OriginalMergeDefinitions"] === DownValues[merge] &&
  TrueQ[sumMapProof["Checks"]["entire own accepted control map reproduced"]] &&
  And @@ Values[sumMapProof["Checks"]]];
sumDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_pair_sum_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[sumDir], CreateDirectory[sumDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
sumResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-pair-sum-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[sumSource, "SHA256"], "PairSourceHash" -> FileHash[sumBase, "SHA256"],
  "EquationResultHash" -> FileHash[sumInputPath, "SHA256"], "EquationHash" -> Hash[sumEquation, "SHA256"],
  "AcceptedMapComparisonHash" -> FileHash[sumMapProofPath, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "TargetInputHash" -> targetInputHash, "PairInputHash" -> pairStudyHash,
  "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "Component" -> sumIndex,
  "OriginalZeroDefinitions" -> DownValues[zero], "ExpandedZeroDefinitions" -> DownValues[expandedPairZero],
  "OriginalMappingDefinitions" -> DownValues[mapExpression], "OriginalMergeDefinitions" -> DownValues[merge],
  "Seconds" -> <|"SavedExpansion" -> sumSeconds, "OriginalControl" -> sumOldSeconds, "ExpandedControl" -> sumNewSeconds|>,
  "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[sumEquation], "ExpandedBytes" -> ByteCount[sumExpanded],
  "ControlIndex" -> pairControlIndex, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
pairSave[sumResult, FileNameJoin[{sumDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{sumDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "seconds" -> sumResult["Seconds"], "input_bytes" -> ByteCount[sumEquation],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_Hqq_pair_sum"]; Quit[0];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-190", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 11117, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_check_certified_denominator_mapping.wls", "sha256": "92b48ef6d8503188c58059cf9d7eb1ade32250ec5632d1ccdda3b695245d603e"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse executed term and merge certificates on the actual Hgq denominator groups. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
comparisonPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_certified_denominator_mapping.wls"}];
comparisonConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_certified_denominator_inputs.json"}];
comparisonBasePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_targets_by_denominator.wls"}];
comparisonRequire[name_, test_] := If[!TrueQ[test], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
comparisonConfig = Import[comparisonConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
comparisonRequire["comparison input schema", comparisonConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-certified-denominator-inputs-v1"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative, identity}, comparisonRequire["pinned comparison input " <> relative,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{Directory[], relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === identity]], comparisonConfig["files"]];
comparisonBaseText = Import[comparisonBasePath, "Text"];
comparisonBoundary = StringPosition[comparisonBaseText, "\ngroupPreviousTargetHash ="];
comparisonRequire["unique unchanged initialization boundary", Length[comparisonBoundary] === 1];
comparisonPrefix = StringTake[comparisonBaseText, First[First[comparisonBoundary]] - 1];
comparisonRequire["complete initialization syntax", SyntaxQ[comparisonPrefix]];
ToExpression[comparisonPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete certified denominator comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[comparisonPath, "Text"]]];
gate["own accepted gluon-quark tensor", channel === "Hgq"];
groupCertificatePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqbar", "s08_group_certificate_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
mergeCertificatePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqbar", "s08_pair_merge_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
groupCertificate = Get[groupCertificatePath]; mergeCertificate = Get[mergeCertificatePath];
gate["accepted grouping certificate definitions", groupCertificate["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-group-reconstruction-comparison-v1" &&
  And @@ Values[groupCertificate["Checks"]] && groupCertificate["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  groupCertificate["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_check_group_reconstruction.wls"}], "SHA256"] &&
  groupCertificate["GroupingProofHash"] === FileHash[groupProofPath, "SHA256"] &&
  groupCertificate["OriginalGroupingDefinitions"] === DownValues[groupDenominators] &&
  KeyDrop[groupCertificate["InputHashes"], "Hqqbar/s05_result/s05_result.wl"] === KeyDrop[inputHashes, channel <> "/s05_result/s05_result.wl"]];
gate["accepted original merge and native certificate", mergeCertificate["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-pair-merge-linearity-v1" &&
  And @@ Values[mergeCertificate["Checks"]] && mergeCertificate["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  mergeCertificate["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_check_pair_merge_linearity.wls"}], "SHA256"] &&
  mergeCertificate["OriginalMappingDefinitions"] === DownValues[mapExpression] &&
  mergeCertificate["OriginalMergeDefinitions"] === DownValues[merge]];
originalMappingDefinitions = DownValues[mapExpression]; originalMergeDefinitions = DownValues[merge];
DownValues[certifyGrouping] = groupCertificate["CertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[groupDenominators] = groupCertificate["GroupingDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyPairMerge] = mergeCertificate["CertificateDefinitions"];
pairSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_check_quark_pair_mapping.wls"}];
pairSourceText = Import[pairSourcePath, "Text"];
pairReconstructionText = StringTake[pairSourceText, {
  First[First[StringPosition[pairSourceText, "pairReconstruct[coefficients_]"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[pairSourceText, "\nslots ="]]] - 1}];
gate["original pair reconstruction syntax", SyntaxQ[pairReconstructionText]];
ToExpression[pairReconstructionText];
certifyGroupMerge[packets_, coefficients_] := Module[{maps, grouped},
  maps = Lookup[packets, "Coefficients"]; grouped = Merge[maps, Identity];
  gate["every merged group coefficient equals its full input sum", And @@ KeyValueMap[
    bounded[zero[Lookup[coefficients, #1, 0] - Total[#2]], {"merged group coefficient reconstruction", #1}] &, grouped]];
  certifyPairMerge[maps, grouped, coefficients]];
groupCheckText = Import[groupCheckPath, "Text"];
groupMappingText = StringTake[groupCheckText, {
  First[First[StringPosition[groupCheckText, "groupedMapExpression[expression_, key_]"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[groupCheckText, "\ngroupControlExpression ="]]] - 1}];
originalPredicate = "zero[reconstruction - expression]";
candidatePredicate = "certifyGroupMerge[packets, rows]";
gate["unique final reconstruction replacement", StringCount[groupMappingText, originalPredicate] === 1];
candidateMappingText = StringReplace[groupMappingText, originalPredicate -> candidatePredicate];
gate["all grouping and mapping operations otherwise unchanged",
  StringReplace[candidateMappingText, candidatePredicate -> originalPredicate] === groupMappingText];
gate["complete candidate mapping syntax", SyntaxQ[candidateMappingText]];
ToExpression[candidateMappingText];
groupInputHash = Hash[{FileHash[comparisonPath, "SHA256"], FileHash[comparisonConfigPath, "SHA256"],
  inputHashes, targetInputHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
groupCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_certified_denominator", channel, IntegerString[groupInputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[groupCache], CreateDirectory[groupCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
comparisonSave[value_, path_] := Module[{temporary, serialized},
  temporary = path <> "." <> ToString[$ProcessID] <> ".tmp";
  serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[value], "comparison compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded comparison native file", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[temporary, serialized, "Text"];
  gate["exact comparison native reload", bounded[Get[temporary] === value, "comparison reload"]];
  RenameFile[temporary, path, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
controls = Association@Table[
  controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]; control = Get[controlPath];
  controlIndex = FromDigits[First[StringCases[FileBaseName[relative], DigitCharacter ..]]];
  gate["complete own control binding " <> ToString[controlIndex], control["InputHash"] === targetInputHash &&
    TrueQ[control["ReconstructionPassed"]] && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]] &&
    KeyTake[control, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}] === KeyDrop[tasks[[controlIndex]], "Value"]];
  controlIndex -> <|"File" -> relative, "Hash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], "Record" -> control|>,
  {relative, comparisonConfig["own_controls"]}];
controlIndex = First[MinimalBy[Keys[controls], controls[#]["Record"]["Seconds"] &]];
candidateIndices = Complement[Range[Length[tasks]], Keys[controls]];
```

```wolfram
 {factor,core}];
```

```wolfram
(* Compare a single family-input normalization with the accepted full scalar map. *)
```

```wolfram
(* Compare polynomial family collection with the reference on its actual inputs. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
polynomialSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_family_polynomials.wls"}];
polynomialBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_map_certified_group_targets.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[polynomialBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "f38a83d6b7080e4acbd9919f05a38ce602800f445e3bd594263f18bb8e4a091c",Quit[1]];
polynomialBaseText=Import[polynomialBase,"Text"];
If[StringCount[polynomialBaseText,"\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]=!=1||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[polynomialSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
polynomialPrefix=First[StringSplit[polynomialBaseText,"\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]];
If[!SyntaxQ[polynomialPrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[polynomialPrefix,InputForm];
polynomialInspectionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_map_equation_result","s08_result.wl"}];
polynomialInspectionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_inspect_group_map.wls"}];
polynomialReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_map_equation_result","s08_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted operation inspection receipt",TrueQ[polynomialReceipt["passed"]]&&
  polynomialReceipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s08_map_equation_result/s08_result.wl"]===
    IntegerString[FileHash[polynomialInspectionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
polynomialInspection=Get[polynomialInspectionPath];
gate["actual operation input identity",polynomialInspection["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-group-map-inspection-v1"&&
  polynomialInspection["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[polynomialInspection["Checks"]]&&
  polynomialInspection["SourceHash"]===FileHash[polynomialInspectionSource,"SHA256"]&&
  polynomialInspection["BaseSourceHash"]===FileHash[polynomialBase,"SHA256"]&&
  polynomialInspection["InputHashes"]===inputHashes&&polynomialInspection["TargetInputHash"]===targetInputHash&&
  polynomialInspection["MappingInputHash"]===inputHash&&polynomialInspection["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
polynomialOriginalFamily=DownValues[familyRows];
polynomialOriginalMap=DownValues[mapExpression];
gate["unchanged inspected family and mapping definitions",
  polynomialInspection["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"]===polynomialOriginalFamily&&
  polynomialInspection["OriginalMappingDefinitions"]===polynomialOriginalMap];

polynomialFamilyRows[transformed_,family_] := Module[
  {variables={v3,v4},pattern,numerator,denominator,powers,coefficient,polynomial,rows,
   reconstruction,residual,residualRows,collectionResidual,collectionRows},
  pattern=Alternatives@@variables;
  denominator=bounded[Factor[Denominator[transformed]],{family,"outer family denominator"}];
  numerator=bounded[Expand[Numerator[transformed],pattern],{family,"selective family numerator expansion"}];
  gate["family numerator remains polynomial",PolynomialQ[numerator,variables]];
  powers=Exponent[denominator,#]&/@variables;
  gate["integer nonnegative family denominator powers",AllTrue[powers,IntegerQ[#]&&#>=0&]];
  coefficient=bounded[Cancel[denominator/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,powers}])],
    {family,"family denominator coefficient"}];
  gate["family denominator remains a Laurent monomial",FreeQ[coefficient,pattern]];
  gate["exact outer family denominator reconstruction",
    bounded[Expand[denominator-coefficient Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,powers}],pattern],
      {family,"denominator reconstruction"}]===0];
  polynomial=bounded[CoefficientRules[numerator,variables],{family,"family polynomial coefficients"}];
  gate["family coefficients independent of integration variables",FreeQ[Last/@polynomial,pattern]];
  collectionResidual=bounded[Expand[numerator-
    Total[(Last[#] Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,First[#]}])&/@polynomial],pattern],
    {family,"native polynomial reconstruction"}];
  gate["collection residual remains polynomial",PolynomialQ[collectionResidual,variables]];
  collectionRows=bounded[CoefficientRules[collectionResidual,variables],{family,"collection residual coefficients"}];
  If[collectionRows=!={},Print["COLLECTION_RESIDUAL_SAMPLE ",
    StringTake[ToString[First[collectionRows],InputForm],UpTo[2500]]]];
  gate["exact native family polynomial collection",And@@
    (bounded[zero[Last[#]],{family,First[#],"reference exact collection residual"}]&/@collectionRows)];
  Print["COLLECTION_RESIDUAL_COEFFICIENTS_VERIFIED ",Length[collectionRows]];
  rows=Association[Map[Function[entry,
    CutIntegral[family,Join[ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],powers-First[entry]]] ->
      bounded[Factor[Last[entry]/coefficient],{family,First[entry],"family coefficient factor"}]],polynomial]];
  reconstruction=Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral,value},
    value Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,-Drop[integral[[2]],2]}]],rows]];
  residual=bounded[Expand[denominator reconstruction-numerator,pattern],{family,"family polynomial residual"}];
  gate["complete family residual is polynomial",PolynomialQ[residual,variables]];
  residualRows=bounded[CoefficientRules[residual,variables],{family,"residual polynomial collection"}];
  gate["complete family Laurent coefficients reconstruct",And@@
    (bounded[zero[Last[#]],{family,First[#],"exact residual coefficient"}]&/@residualRows)];
  gate["both cut powers unchanged in polynomial family",
    And@@(Take[#[[2]],Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]===ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]&/@Keys[rows])];
  rows];

familyRows[expression_,family_] := polynomialFamilyRows[expression/.families[family]["UncutCoordinateRules"],family];
polynomialDispatch=DownValues[familyRows];
gate["only family collection changed",DownValues[mapExpression]===polynomialOriginalMap];
polynomialControlTimed=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[targetControlTask["Value"]/.coordinateRules],
  "complete accepted reference map with polynomial families"]];
polynomialControl=polynomialControlTimed[[2]];
gate["same complete accepted control target inventory",Sort[Keys[polynomialControl]]===Sort[Keys[targetFixture["Coefficients"]]]];
gate["complete accepted control coefficients agree",And@@KeyValueMap[
  Function[{key,value},bounded[zero[value-targetFixture["Coefficients"][key]],{"own reference control",key}]],polynomialControl]];
Print["POLYNOMIAL_REFERENCE_CONTROL_SECONDS ",polynomialControlTimed[[1]]];

polynomialActualRows=Table[
  gate["captured family-coordinate operation",row["Outcome"]["Operation"]==="family coordinates Together"&&
    !MissingQ[row["OperationInput"]]];
  atoms=bounded[extractAtoms[row["Equation"]],{row["ComponentIndex"],"actual group atoms"}];
  decomposition=decompose[First[atoms]];firstKey=First[Keys[decomposition]];
  support=Flatten[Position[List@@firstKey,_?(#>0&)]];
  family=SelectFirst[familyNames,Complement[support,families[#]["UncutIndices"]]==={}&,Missing["NoFamily"]];
  gate["actual captured family identified",!MissingQ[family]];
  familyInput=bounded[Cancel[Last[atoms] decomposition[firstKey]/
    (Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,List@@firstKey}])],"actual reference family input"]/.families[family]["UncutCoordinateRules"];
  gate["exact captured operation input reproduced",familyInput===row["OperationInput"]];
  Print["ACTUAL_POLYNOMIAL_FAMILY ",row["ComponentIndex"]," family ",family," input bytes ",ByteCount[familyInput]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[polynomialFamilyRows[familyInput,family]];
  Print["ACTUAL_POLYNOMIAL_FAMILY_SECONDS ",timed[[1]]," targets ",Length[timed[[2]]]];
  <|"ComponentIndex"->row["ComponentIndex"],"Family"->family,"Seconds"->timed[[1]],
    "InputBytes"->ByteCount[familyInput],"Coefficients"->timed[[2]]|>,{row,polynomialInspection["Rows"]}];
polynomialProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-family-polynomial-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[polynomialSource,"SHA256"],"InspectionHash"->FileHash[polynomialInspectionPath,"SHA256"],
  "BaseSourceHash"->FileHash[polynomialBase,"SHA256"],"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "TargetInputHash"->targetInputHash,"MappingInputHash"->inputHash,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->polynomialOriginalFamily,"OriginalMappingDefinitions"->polynomialOriginalMap,
  "Definitions"->DownValues[polynomialFamilyRows],"DispatchDefinitions"->polynomialDispatch,
  "ControlSeconds"->polynomialControlTimed[[1]],"ControlCoefficients"->polynomialControl,
  "ActualRows"->polynomialActualRows,"Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
polynomialDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_family_polynomial_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[polynomialDir],CreateDirectory[polynomialDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
polynomialOutput=FileNameJoin[{polynomialDir,"s08_result.wl"}];
polynomialSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[polynomialProof],"polynomial proof compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["polynomial proof file bound",StringLength[polynomialSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[polynomialOutput<>".tmp",polynomialSerialized,"Text"];
gate["polynomial proof exact native reload",Get[polynomialOutput<>".tmp"]===polynomialProof];
RenameFile[polynomialOutput<>".tmp",polynomialOutput,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{polynomialDir,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_family_polynomials"];Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_check_gluon_pair_mapping.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-195", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 11938, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_check_gluon_pair_mapping.wls", "sha256": "33f4502f58f1c6a6143cbdcd6f99d54a7bed110cb23abbf48123a819350676b6"} -->
```wolfram
(* Retain the reference order: map each accepted diagram pair, then sum. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
pairStudyPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_gluon_pair_mapping.wls"}];
pairConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_gluon_pair_mapping_inputs.json"}];
pairConfig = Import[pairConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
pairBasePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_real_targets.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[pairBasePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "8700fb675c4a0196d1a6f7aa7d1710e25a9210b0de85bd902990e2e7589772a9",
  Print["FAIL: pinned reference target mapper"]; Quit[1]];
pairBaseText = Import[pairBasePath, "Text"];
pairBoundary = StringPosition[pairBaseText, "\nmapTargetTask[index_]"];
If[Length[pairBoundary] =!= 1, Print["FAIL: unique target initialization"]; Quit[1]];
pairPrefix = StringTake[pairBaseText, First[First[pairBoundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[pairPrefix], Print["FAIL: target initialization syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[pairPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete pair comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[pairStudyPath, "Text"]]];
gate["pair comparison channel", channel === pairConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hgq"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative, identity}, gate["pinned pair input " <> relative,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === identity]], pairConfig["files"]];
pairBasisPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}];
pairBasis = Get[pairBasisPath];
pairExtractionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqprime", "s05_spin_extraction_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
pairExtraction = Get[pairExtractionPath];
gate["accepted complete spin extraction", pairExtraction["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-spin-extraction-validation-v1" &&
  And @@ Values[pairExtraction["Checks"]] && pairExtraction["BasisInputHash"] === FileHash[pairBasisPath, "SHA256"]];
gate["same accepted spin basis", spin["InputHashes"]["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"] === FileHash[pairBasisPath, "SHA256"] &&
  pairBasis["PhotonLabels"] === spin["PhotonLabels"] && pairBasis["SpinLabels"] === spin["SpinLabels"]];
DownValues[compactSpinResponse] = pairExtraction["ExtractionDefinitions"];
gate["unchanged accepted spin extraction definition", DownValues[compactSpinResponse] === pairExtraction["ExtractionDefinitions"]];
pairLabel = First[Keys[spin["Sectors"]]];
gate["single inherited real sector", Keys[spin["Sectors"]] === {pairLabel}];
pairSector = spin["Sectors"][pairLabel];
pairNames = pairConfig["pair_files"];
pairIndices = (FromDigits /@ StringCases[FileBaseName[#], DigitCharacter ..]) & /@ pairNames;
gate["complete inherited diagram-pair inventory", pairIndices === pairSector["DiagramPairs"] && DuplicateFreeQ[pairNames]];
pairInputs = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, #}]] & /@ pairNames;
gate["every pair belongs to accepted real tensor", AllTrue[pairInputs,
  #["InputHash"] === spin["InputHash"] && AssociationQ[#["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[#["Checks"]] &]];
pairVariablesIn = Take[{1, xIn, yIn, hIn, eIn}, Length[pairSector["IncomingSpinLabels"]]];
pairVariablesOut = Take[{1, xOut, yOut, hOut, eOut}, Length[pairSector["OutgoingSpinLabels"]]];
gate["inherited gluon and quark spin axes", pairSector["IncomingSpinLabels"] === Append[pairBasis["SpinLabels"], "E"] &&
  pairSector["OutgoingSpinLabels"] === pairBasis["SpinLabels"]];
pairOwnControlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, pairConfig["own_control"]}];
pairOwnControl = Get[pairOwnControlPath];
gate["accepted same-channel target control", pairOwnControl["InputHash"] === targetInputHash &&
  TrueQ[pairOwnControl["ReconstructionPassed"]] && And @@ Values[pairOwnControl["Checks"]]];
pairControlIndex = First[FirstPosition[KeyDrop[#, "Value"] & /@ tasks,
  KeyTake[pairOwnControl, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}]]];
pairEIndex = SelectFirst[Range[Length[tasks]], tasks[[#]]["Kind"] === "ExtendedResponse" &&
  Last[tasks[[#]]["Index"]] === Length[pairVariablesIn] &, Missing["NoGluonComplement"]];
gate["gluon complement present in actual tensor", IntegerQ[pairEIndex]];
pairSelected = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{pairControlIndex, pairEIndex}, pairConfig["component_indices"]]];
gate["selected actual components", AllTrue[pairSelected, IntegerQ[#] && Between[#, {1, Length[tasks]}] &]];
pairStudyHash = Hash[{FileHash[pairStudyPath, "SHA256"], FileHash[pairConfigPath, "SHA256"], inputHashes,
  targetInputHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
pairCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_pair_mapping", channel, IntegerString[pairStudyHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[pairCache], CreateDirectory[pairCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
pairSave[value_, path_] := Module[{serialized},
  serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[value], "pair-map compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["pair-map file bound", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
  gate["pair-map exact native reload", bounded[Get[path <> ".tmp"] === value, "pair-map reload"]];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
pairExpression[record_, task_] := Module[{photon, response},
  Switch[task["Kind"],
    "ExtendedResponse",
      photon = Tr[#.record["PhotonMatrix"]] & /@ pairBasis["PhotonDual"];
      response = compactSpinResponse[photon, pairVariablesIn, pairVariablesOut];
      Extract[response, task["Index"]],
    "PhotonMetricD", record["ScalarModes"]["PgD"],
    _, gate["inherited task kind", False]]];
pairMap[packet_] := Catch[Block[{checks = <||>}, Module[{path, saved, coefficients, seconds},
  path = FileNameJoin[{pairCache, "component_" <> ToString[packet["Component"]] <> "_pair_" <> ToString[packet["PairIndex"]] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[path], Get[path], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "Binding", None] === packet["Binding"] && TrueQ[Lookup[saved, "ReconstructionPassed", False]] &&
    AssociationQ[Lookup[saved, "Checks", None]] && Length[saved["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[saved["Checks"]], Return[saved]];
  Print["REFERENCE_PAIR_MAP ", packet["Component"], " pair ", packet["PairIndex"], " bytes ", ByteCount[packet["Value"]]];
  {seconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[packet["Value"]],
    {"reference pair mapping", packet["Component"], packet["PairIndex"]}]];
  If[packet["Value"] === 0, gate["exact zero pair retains empty map", coefficients === <||>]];
  saved = <|"Binding" -> packet["Binding"], "Component" -> packet["Component"], "PairIndex" -> packet["PairIndex"],
    "Coefficients" -> coefficients, "Seconds" -> seconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[packet["Value"]],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[coefficients], "Checks" -> checks, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True|>;
  pairSave[saved, path]; ClearSystemCache[]; saved]], "TargetMapFailure"];
pairReconstruct[coefficients_] := Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient}, coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
  {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], coefficients]];
slots = Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]], 1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1]; CloseKernels[];
If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];
workers = Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers > 0,
  gate["pair workers share allocated node", And @@ (SameQ[#, $MachineName] & /@ ParallelEvaluate[$MachineName])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; checks = <||>; PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
    $FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  gate["pair worker native versions agree", And @@ (SameQ[#, {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}] & /@
    ParallelEvaluate[{$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}])];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate, bounded, targetTimeLimit, targetMemoryLimit, pairSave, pairMap, pairCache,
    zero, merge, decompose, extractAtoms, familyRows, mapExpression, denominators, directions, families, familyNames, geometry]];
$DistributedContexts = None;
pairComponents = {};
Do[
  task = tasks[[index]];
  gate["selected task belongs to inherited sector", task["Sector"] === pairLabel];
  {extractionSeconds, values} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[pairExpression[#, task] & /@ pairInputs, {index, "pair spin extraction"}]];
  gate["complete accepted component reconstructed from pairs " <> ToString[index],
    bounded[zero[Total[values] - task["Value"]], {index, "original pair sum"}]];
  packets = MapIndexed[Function[{value, position}, <|"Component" -> index, "PairIndex" -> First[position],
    "Value" -> (value /. coordinateRules), "Binding" -> Hash[{pairStudyHash, index, First[position], value}, "SHA256"]|>], values];
  records = If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[pairMap, packets, Method -> "FinestGrained"], pairMap /@ packets];
  gate["all selected pair maps accepted " <> ToString[index], AllTrue[records, AssociationQ] &&
    And @@ Lookup[records, "ReconstructionPassed"] && And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ records]];
  {mergeSeconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[merge[Lookup[records, "Coefficients"]], {index, "original map merge"}]];
  reconstruction = pairReconstruct[coefficients];
  gate["complete merged map reconstructs accepted input " <> ToString[index],
    bounded[zero[reconstruction - (task["Value"] /. coordinateRules)], {index, "complete mapped reconstruction"}]];
  gate["merged map preserves both physical cuts " <> ToString[index], And @@
    (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[coefficients])];
  If[index === pairControlIndex, gate["entire own accepted control map reproduced",
    bounded[zero[reconstruction - pairReconstruct[pairOwnControl["Coefficients"]]], "own accepted pair-map control"]]];
  component = Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], <|"ComponentIndex" -> index, "Coefficients" -> coefficients,
```

```wolfram
If[Length[pairBoundary] =!= 1, Print["FAIL: unique target initialization"]; Quit[1]];
pairPrefix = StringTake[pairBaseText, First[First[pairBoundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[pairPrefix], Print["FAIL: target initialization syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[pairPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete pair comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[pairStudyPath, "Text"]]];
gate["pair comparison channel", channel === pairConfig["channel"] && channel === "Hqqprime"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative, identity}, gate["pinned pair input " <> relative,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === identity]], pairConfig["files"]];
pairBasisPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}];
pairBasis = Get[pairBasisPath];
pairExtractionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_spin_extraction_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
pairExtraction = Get[pairExtractionPath];
gate["accepted complete spin extraction", pairExtraction["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-spin-extraction-validation-v1" &&
  And @@ Values[pairExtraction["Checks"]] && pairExtraction["BasisInputHash"] === FileHash[pairBasisPath, "SHA256"]];
gate["same accepted spin basis", spin["InputHashes"]["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"] === FileHash[pairBasisPath, "SHA256"] &&
  pairBasis["PhotonLabels"] === spin["PhotonLabels"] && pairBasis["SpinLabels"] === spin["SpinLabels"]];
DownValues[compactSpinResponse] = pairExtraction["ExtractionDefinitions"];
gate["unchanged accepted spin extraction definition", DownValues[compactSpinResponse] === pairExtraction["ExtractionDefinitions"]];
pairLabel = First[Keys[spin["Sectors"]]];
gate["single inherited real sector", Keys[spin["Sectors"]] === {pairLabel}];
pairSector = spin["Sectors"][pairLabel];
pairNames = pairConfig["pair_files"];
pairIndices = (FromDigits /@ StringCases[FileBaseName[#], DigitCharacter ..]) & /@ pairNames;
gate["complete inherited diagram-pair inventory", pairIndices === pairSector["DiagramPairs"] && DuplicateFreeQ[pairNames]];
pairInputs = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, #}]] & /@ pairNames;
gate["every pair belongs to accepted real tensor", AllTrue[pairInputs,
  #["InputHash"] === spin["InputHash"] && AssociationQ[#["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[#["Checks"]] &]];
pairVariablesIn = {1, xIn, yIn, hIn}; pairVariablesOut = {1, xOut, yOut, hOut};
gate["inherited quark spin axes", pairSector["IncomingSpinLabels"] === pairBasis["SpinLabels"] &&
  pairSector["OutgoingSpinLabels"] === pairBasis["SpinLabels"]];
pairControlIndex = First[FirstPosition[KeyDrop[#, "Value"] & /@ tasks, targetFixture["Task"]]];
pairSelected = DeleteDuplicates[Prepend[pairConfig["component_indices"], pairControlIndex]];
gate["selected actual components", AllTrue[pairSelected, IntegerQ[#] && Between[#, {1, Length[tasks]}] &]];
pairStudyHash = Hash[{FileHash[pairStudyPath, "SHA256"], FileHash[pairConfigPath, "SHA256"], inputHashes,
  targetInputHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];

If[!DirectoryQ[pairCache], CreateDirectory[pairCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];

  gate["pair-map file bound", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];

If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];

  gate["complete accepted component reconstructed from pairs " <> ToString[index],
    bounded[zero[Total[values] - task["Value"]], {index, "original pair sum"}]];
  packets = MapIndexed[Function[{value, position}, <|"Component" -> index, "PairIndex" -> First[position],
    "Value" -> (value /. coordinateRules), "Binding" -> Hash[{pairStudyHash, index, First[position], value}, "SHA256"]|>], values];
  records = If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[pairMap, packets, Method -> "FinestGrained"], pairMap /@ packets];
  gate["all selected pair maps accepted " <> ToString[index], AllTrue[records, AssociationQ] &&

  {mergeSeconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[merge[Lookup[records, "Coefficients"]], {index, "original map merge"}]];
  reconstruction = pairReconstruct[coefficients];
  gate["complete merged map reconstructs accepted input " <> ToString[index],
    bounded[zero[reconstruction - (task["Value"] /. coordinateRules)], {index, "complete mapped reconstruction"}]];
  gate["merged map preserves both physical cuts " <> ToString[index], And @@
    (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[coefficients])];
  If[index === pairControlIndex, gate["entire own accepted control map reproduced",
    bounded[zero[reconstruction - pairReconstruct[targetFixture["Coefficients"]]], "own accepted pair-map control"]]];
  component = Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], <|"ComponentIndex" -> index, "Coefficients" -> coefficients,
    "MissingTargets" -> Complement[Keys[coefficients], ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]], "InputHash" -> targetInputHash,
    "StudyInputHash" -> pairStudyHash, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True, "Checks" -> checks,
    "ExtractionSeconds" -> extractionSeconds, "MergeSeconds" -> mergeSeconds,
    "PairEvidence" -> (KeyDrop[#, {"Coefficients", "Checks"}] & /@ records)|>];
  pairSave[component, FileNameJoin[{pairCache, "component_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]];
  AppendTo[pairComponents, component]; Print["REFERENCE_PAIR_COMPONENT_ACCEPTED ", index];
  Clear[values, packets, records, coefficients, reconstruction]; ClearSystemCache[], {index, pairSelected}];
CloseKernels[];
pairResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-pair-mapping-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Components" -> pairComponents, "ControlIndex" -> pairControlIndex, "SelectedIndices" -> pairSelected,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[pairStudyPath, "SHA256"], "ConfigurationHash" -> FileHash[pairConfigPath, "SHA256"],
  "OriginalMapperHash" -> FileHash[originalMapperPath, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "TargetInputHash" -> targetInputHash, "MappingInputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHash" -> pairStudyHash,
  "PairFiles" -> pairNames, "PairInputHashes" -> pairConfig["files"], "OriginalMappingDefinitions" -> DownValues[mapExpression],
  "OriginalMergeDefinitions" -> DownValues[merge], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "WorkerCount" -> workers, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
pairResultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_pair_mapping_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[pairResultDir], CreateDirectory[pairResultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
pairSave[pairResult, FileNameJoin[{pairResultDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{pairResultDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "component_indices" -> pairSelected, "workers" -> workers, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_pair_mapping"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
pairOwnControl = Get[pairOwnControlPath];
```

```wolfram
  Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
  gate["pair-map exact native reload", bounded[Get[path <> ".tmp"] === value, "pair-map reload"]];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
pairExpression[record_, task_] := Module[{photon, response},
  Switch[task["Kind"],
    "ExtendedResponse",
      photon = Tr[#.record["PhotonMatrix"]] & /@ pairBasis["PhotonDual"];
      response = compactSpinResponse[photon, pairVariablesIn, pairVariablesOut];
      Extract[response, task["Index"]],
    "PhotonMetricD", record["ScalarModes"]["PgD"],
    _, gate["inherited task kind", False]]];
pairMap[packet_] := Catch[Block[{checks = <||>}, Module[{path, saved, coefficients, seconds},
  path = FileNameJoin[{pairCache, "component_" <> ToString[packet["Component"]] <> "_pair_" <> ToString[packet["PairIndex"]] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[path], Get[path], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "Binding", None] === packet["Binding"] && TrueQ[Lookup[saved, "ReconstructionPassed", False]] &&
    AssociationQ[Lookup[saved, "Checks", None]] && Length[saved["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[saved["Checks"]], Return[saved]];
  Print["REFERENCE_PAIR_MAP ", packet["Component"], " pair ", packet["PairIndex"], " bytes ", ByteCount[packet["Value"]]];
  {seconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[packet["Value"]],
    {"reference pair mapping", packet["Component"], packet["PairIndex"]}]];
  If[packet["Value"] === 0, gate["exact zero pair retains empty map", coefficients === <||>]];
  saved = <|"Binding" -> packet["Binding"], "Component" -> packet["Component"], "PairIndex" -> packet["PairIndex"],
    "Coefficients" -> coefficients, "Seconds" -> seconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[packet["Value"]],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[coefficients], "Checks" -> checks, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True|>;
  pairSave[saved, path]; ClearSystemCache[]; saved]], "TargetMapFailure"];
pairReconstruct[coefficients_] := Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient}, coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
  {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], coefficients]];
slots = Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]], 1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1]; CloseKernels[];
If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];
workers = Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers > 0,
  gate["pair workers share allocated node", And @@ (SameQ[#, $MachineName] & /@ ParallelEvaluate[$MachineName])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; checks = <||>; PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
    $FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  gate["pair worker native versions agree", And @@ (SameQ[#, {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}] & /@
    ParallelEvaluate[{$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}])];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate, bounded, targetTimeLimit, targetMemoryLimit, pairSave, pairMap, pairCache,
    zero, merge, decompose, extractAtoms, familyRows, mapExpression, denominators, directions, families, familyNames, geometry]];
$DistributedContexts = None;
pairComponents = {};
Do[
  task = tasks[[index]];
  gate["selected task belongs to inherited sector", task["Sector"] === pairLabel];
  {extractionSeconds, values} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[pairExpression[#, task] & /@ pairInputs, {index, "pair spin extraction"}]];
  gate["complete accepted component reconstructed from pairs " <> ToString[index],
    bounded[zero[Total[values] - task["Value"]], {index, "original pair sum"}]];
  packets = MapIndexed[Function[{value, position}, <|"Component" -> index, "PairIndex" -> First[position],
    "Value" -> (value /. coordinateRules), "Binding" -> Hash[{pairStudyHash, index, First[position], value}, "SHA256"]|>], values];
  records = If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[pairMap, packets, Method -> "FinestGrained"], pairMap /@ packets];
  gate["all selected pair maps accepted " <> ToString[index], AllTrue[records, AssociationQ] &&
    And @@ Lookup[records, "ReconstructionPassed"] && And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ records]];
  {mergeSeconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[merge[Lookup[records, "Coefficients"]], {index, "original map merge"}]];
  reconstruction = pairReconstruct[coefficients];
  gate["complete merged map reconstructs accepted input " <> ToString[index],
    bounded[zero[reconstruction - (task["Value"] /. coordinateRules)], {index, "complete mapped reconstruction"}]];
  gate["merged map preserves both physical cuts " <> ToString[index], And @@
    (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[coefficients])];
  If[index === pairControlIndex, gate["entire own accepted control map reproduced",
    bounded[zero[reconstruction - pairReconstruct[pairOwnControl["Coefficients"]]], "own accepted pair-map control"]]];
  component = Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], <|"ComponentIndex" -> index, "Coefficients" -> coefficients,
    "MissingTargets" -> Complement[Keys[coefficients], ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]], "InputHash" -> targetInputHash,
    "StudyInputHash" -> pairStudyHash, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True, "Checks" -> checks,
    "ExtractionSeconds" -> extractionSeconds, "MergeSeconds" -> mergeSeconds,
    "PairEvidence" -> (KeyDrop[#, {"Coefficients", "Checks"}] & /@ records)|>];
  pairSave[component, FileNameJoin[{pairCache, "component_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]];
  AppendTo[pairComponents, component]; Print["REFERENCE_PAIR_COMPONENT_ACCEPTED ", index];
  Clear[values, packets, records, coefficients, reconstruction]; ClearSystemCache[], {index, pairSelected}];
CloseKernels[];
pairResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-pair-mapping-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Components" -> pairComponents, "ControlIndex" -> pairControlIndex, "SelectedIndices" -> pairSelected,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[pairStudyPath, "SHA256"], "ConfigurationHash" -> FileHash[pairConfigPath, "SHA256"],
  "OriginalMapperHash" -> FileHash[originalMapperPath, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "TargetInputHash" -> targetInputHash, "MappingInputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHash" -> pairStudyHash,
  "PairFiles" -> pairNames, "PairInputHashes" -> pairConfig["files"], "OriginalMappingDefinitions" -> DownValues[mapExpression],
  "OriginalMergeDefinitions" -> DownValues[merge], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "WorkerCount" -> workers, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
pairResultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_same_pair_mapping_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[pairResultDir], CreateDirectory[pairResultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
pairSave[pairResult, FileNameJoin[{pairResultDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{pairResultDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "component_indices" -> pairSelected, "workers" -> workers, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_same_sector_pair_mapping"]; Quit[0];
```
