## common/s08_check_scalar_reconstruction_certificates.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-204", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 15289, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_check_scalar_reconstruction_certificates.wls", "sha256": "af45a3609fbbeaa1417bb2022a7b562cf9f3597563a455d3e4302c32471468f1"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse exact atom and merge certificates without expanding the complete spin numerator. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
certificateSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_scalar_reconstruction_certificates.wls"}];
certificateBootstrapPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_map_saved_terms.wls"}];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[certificateSource,"Text"]]||IntegerString[FileHash[certificateBootstrapPath,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "1d7679bf634e5dc0fa6d5301de2137becfc0bdcbe336a63fd528bb78b0a76d72",Quit[1]];
certificateBootstrapText=Import[certificateBootstrapPath,"Text"];
certificateBoundary=StringPosition[certificateBootstrapText,"\nIf[channel===\"Hgg\","];
If[Length[certificateBoundary]=!=1,Quit[1]];
certificateBootstrap=StringTake[certificateBootstrapText,First[First[certificateBoundary]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[certificateBootstrap],Quit[1]];ToExpression[certificateBootstrap,InputForm];
gate["own Hgg scalar reconstruction comparison",channel==="Hgg"];
certificateOriginalFamily=DownValues[familyRows];certificateOriginalMap=DownValues[mapExpression];
certificateOriginalMerge=DownValues[merge];
certificateAtomRelative="Hgg/s08_factored_atom_certificate_result/s08_result.wl";
certificateAtomPath=FileNameJoin[{root,certificateAtomRelative}];
certificateAtomReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[certificateAtomPath],"s08_execution.json"}];
certificateAtomReceipt=Import[certificateAtomReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact atom certificates",TrueQ[certificateAtomReceipt["passed"]]&&
 certificateAtomReceipt["result_sha256"][certificateAtomRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[certificateAtomPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
certificateAtomProof=Get[certificateAtomPath];
gate["same complete atom mapping contract",TrueQ[certificateAtomProof["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 And@@Values[certificateAtomProof["Checks"]]&&certificateAtomProof["InputHashes"]===record["InputHashes"]&&
 certificateAtomProof["TargetInputHash"]===record["TargetInputHash"]&&
 certificateAtomProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 certificateAtomProof["OriginalExtractionDefinitions"]===DownValues[extractAtoms]&&
 certificateAtomProof["NativeInputHash"]===FileHash[inputPath,"SHA256"]&&
 certificateAtomProof["NativeInputReceiptHash"]===FileHash[inputReceiptPath,"SHA256"]&&
 certificateAtomProof["MapperHash"]===FileHash[mapper,"SHA256"]&&
 certificateAtomProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_extract_factored_atom_certificate.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
atomVariables=certificateAtomProof["Variables"];
DownValues[factoredAtoms]=certificateAtomProof["FactoredExtractionDefinitions"];
DownValues[extractAtoms]=certificateAtomProof["DispatchDefinitions"];
DownValues[factoredAtomCertificate]=certificateAtomProof["AtomCertificateDefinitions"];

certifyFamilyLaurent[polynomial_Association,rows_Association,powers_List,constant_,family_]:=Module[
 {keys,cutCount,integrals,symbols,formalInput,formalRows,inverseRules},
 keys=Keys[polynomial];cutCount=Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]];
 gate["complete polynomial exponent inventory",DuplicateFreeQ[keys]&&
  AllTrue[keys,Length[#]===Length[polynomialVariables]&&VectorQ[#,IntegerQ[#]&&#>=0&]&]];
 gate["Laurent certificate denominator is loop independent",FreeQ[constant,Alternatives@@polynomialVariables]];
 gate["Laurent certificate coefficients are loop independent",FreeQ[Values[polynomial],Alternatives@@polynomialVariables]];
 inverseRules=Thread[polynomialVariables->families[family]["OnCutUncutPropagators"]];
 gate["family coordinates invert to original loop coordinates",And@@(
  zero[First[#]-(Last[#]/.inverseRules)]&/@families[family]["UncutCoordinateRules"])];
 integrals=CutIntegral[family,Join[ConstantArray[1,cutCount],powers-#]]&/@keys;
 gate["Laurent integral inventory is one to one",DuplicateFreeQ[integrals]&&Complement[Keys[rows],integrals]==={}];
 gate["each complete family coefficient reconstructs",And@@MapThread[
  Function[{key,integral},bounded[zero[Lookup[rows,integral,0]-polynomial[key]/constant],{"family coefficient",integral}]],
  {keys,integrals}]];
 symbols=Table[Unique["laurentCoefficient"],{Length[keys]}];
 formalInput=Total[MapThread[#1 Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,#2}]&,{symbols,keys}]]/
  (Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,powers}]);
 formalRows=Total[MapThread[#1 Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,-Drop[#2[[2]],cutCount]}]&,{symbols,integrals}]];
 gate["native full Laurent exponent identity",zero[formalRows-formalInput]];True];

certifyScalarReconstruction[expression_,powers_,prefactor_,decomposition_,pieces_,rows_]:=Module[
 {unitInput,unitDecomposition},
 gate["exact actual atom reconstruction",factoredAtomCertificate[expression,{powers,prefactor}]];
 unitInput=1/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,powers}]);
 unitDecomposition=Total[KeyValueMap[#2/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,List@@#1}])&,decomposition]];
 gate["complete spin-independent partial fraction identity",bounded[zero[unitDecomposition-unitInput],"unit denominator reconstruction"]];
 gate["complete family merge reconstructs coefficient by coefficient",
  certifyGroupMerge[(<|"Coefficients"->#|>&/@pieces),rows]];True];

certificateFamilySource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hqg_polynomial_group.wls"}];
certificateFamilyText=Import[certificateFamilySource,"Text"];
certificateFamilyBegin=StringPosition[certificateFamilyText,"\nfamilyRows[expression_,family_]"];
certificateFamilyEnd=StringPosition[certificateFamilyText,"\ncandidateFamilyDefinitions="];
gate["unique accepted complete family implementation",Length[certificateFamilyBegin]===1&&Length[certificateFamilyEnd]===1];
certificateFamilyOriginal=StringTake[certificateFamilyText,{First[First[certificateFamilyBegin]],First[First[certificateFamilyEnd]]-1}];
gate["complete original family implementation syntax",SyntaxQ[certificateFamilyOriginal]];
ToExpression[certificateFamilyOriginal,InputForm];
gate["exact accepted family implementation restored",DownValues[familyRows]===certificateOriginalFamily];
certificateFamilyEdits={
 "reconstruction=Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral,coefficient},coefficient Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,-Drop[integral[[2]],2]}]],rows]];"->
 "(* Complete Laurent identity is checked coefficient by coefficient below. *)",
 "zero[reconstruction-(expression/.spec[\"UncutCoordinateRules\"])]"->
 "certifyFamilyLaurent[polynomial,rows,powers,constant,family]"};
gate["unique family reconstruction substitutions",And@@(StringCount[certificateFamilyOriginal,First[#]]===1&/@certificateFamilyEdits)];
certificateFamilyCandidate=StringReplace[certificateFamilyOriginal,certificateFamilyEdits];
gate["all family coefficient algebra unchanged",SyntaxQ[certificateFamilyCandidate]&&
 StringReplace[certificateFamilyCandidate,Reverse/@certificateFamilyEdits]===certificateFamilyOriginal];
ToExpression[certificateFamilyCandidate,InputForm];
certificateMapBegin=StringPosition[mappingBlock,"\nmapExpression[expression_]"];
gate["unique complete original scalar mapping function",Length[certificateMapBegin]===1];
certificateMapOriginal=StringDrop[mappingBlock,First[First[certificateMapBegin]]-1];
gate["complete original scalar mapping syntax",SyntaxQ[certificateMapOriginal]];
ToExpression[certificateMapOriginal,InputForm];
gate["exact original scalar mapping definition restored",DownValues[mapExpression]===certificateOriginalMap];
certificateMapEdits={
 "  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},\n    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,\n      {families[integral[[1]]][\"OnCutUncutPropagators\"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];"->
 "  (* The same complete identity uses the accepted atom and merge certificates. *)",
 "zero[reconstruction - expression]"->
 "certifyScalarReconstruction[expression,powers,prefactor,decomposition,pieces,rows]"};
gate["unique complete scalar reconstruction substitutions",And@@(StringCount[certificateMapOriginal,First[#]]===1&/@certificateMapEdits)];
certificateMapCandidate=StringReplace[certificateMapOriginal,certificateMapEdits];
gate["all scalar mapping algebra and cut gates unchanged",SyntaxQ[certificateMapCandidate]&&
 StringReplace[certificateMapCandidate,Reverse/@certificateMapEdits]===certificateMapOriginal];
ToExpression[certificateMapCandidate,InputForm];

certificateOwnRelative="Hgg/s08_termwise_comparison_result/s08_result.wl";
certificateOwnPath=FileNameJoin[{root,certificateOwnRelative}];
certificateOwnReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[certificateOwnPath],"s08_execution.json"}];
certificateOwnReceipt=Import[certificateOwnReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete own original-term map",TrueQ[certificateOwnReceipt["passed"]]&&
 certificateOwnReceipt["result_sha256"][certificateOwnRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[certificateOwnPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
certificateOwn=Get[certificateOwnPath];
gate["identical complete own map inputs",TrueQ[certificateOwn["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 And@@Values[certificateOwn["Checks"]]&&certificateOwn["InputHash"]===record["TargetInputHash"]&&
 certificateOwn["InputHashes"]===record["InputHashes"]&&certificateOwn["NativeInputHash"]===FileHash[inputPath,"SHA256"]&&
 certificateOwn["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}];
certificateGroupIndex=16;
certificateActual=SelectFirst[certificateAtomProof["ActualGroups"],#["Component"]===1&];
certificateGroups=certificateActual["Groups"];
certificateGroupValue=Values[certificateGroups][[certificateGroupIndex]]/
 (Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,Keys[certificateGroups][[certificateGroupIndex]]}]);
certificateProductionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hgg_factored_inputs.wls"}];
certificateAlgorithmPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgq","s08_certified_denominator_result","s08_result.wl"}];
certificateGroupHash=Hash[{FileHash[certificateProductionSource,"SHA256"],FileHash[certificateAlgorithmPath,"SHA256"],
 record["InputHashes"],record["TargetInputHash"],component,Hash[record["Expression"],"SHA256"],$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
certificateGroupPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_Hgg_grouped",IntegerString[certificateGroupHash,16],
 "component_1_group_"<>IntegerString[certificateGroupIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}];
certificateGroupReference=Get[certificateGroupPath];
gate["accepted exact production group checkpoint",TrueQ[certificateGroupReference["Accepted"]]&&
 And@@Values[certificateGroupReference["Checks"]]&&certificateGroupReference["Binding"]===
 Hash[{certificateGroupHash,"component_1",certificateGroupIndex,certificateGroupValue},"SHA256"]];

certificateTerms=If[Head[record["Expression"]]===Plus,List@@record["Expression"],{record["Expression"]}];
gate["complete own original input inventory",Total[certificateTerms]===record["Expression"]];
certificatePackets=MapIndexed[Function[{term,index},Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{seconds,coefficients},
 Print["CERTIFIED_SCALAR_TERM_START ",First[index],"/",Length[certificateTerms]];
 {seconds,coefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[term],{"own certified scalar term",First[index]}]];
 Print["CERTIFIED_SCALAR_TERM_DONE ",First[index]," seconds ",seconds];
 <|"Index"->First[index],"Coefficients"->coefficients,"Seconds"->seconds,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>]]],certificateTerms];
gate["every own original term accepted",Lookup[certificatePackets,"Index"]===Range[Length[certificateTerms]]&&
 And@@Lookup[certificatePackets,"Accepted"]&&And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@certificatePackets]];
{certificateMergeSeconds,certificateOwnCoefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[merge[Lookup[certificatePackets,"Coefficients"]],"complete own scalar certificate merge"]];
gate["complete own merge certificate",certifyGroupMerge[certificatePackets,certificateOwnCoefficients]];
gate["entire own accepted map unchanged",Sort[Keys[certificateOwnCoefficients]]===Sort[Keys[certificateOwn["Coefficients"]]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===certificateOwn["Coefficients"][#1]||zero[#2-certificateOwn["Coefficients"][#1]])&,certificateOwnCoefficients]];

Print["CERTIFIED_SCALAR_ACTUAL_START group ",certificateGroupIndex," bytes ",ByteCount[certificateGroupValue]];
{certificateActualSeconds,certificateActualCoefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[certificateGroupValue],"complete actual production group"]];
gate["entire accepted actual group map unchanged",Sort[Keys[certificateActualCoefficients]]===Sort[Keys[certificateGroupReference["Coefficients"]]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===certificateGroupReference["Coefficients"][#1]||zero[#2-certificateGroupReference["Coefficients"][#1]])&,certificateActualCoefficients]];
Print["CERTIFIED_SCALAR_ACTUAL_DONE seconds ",certificateActualSeconds," saved_seconds ",certificateGroupReference["Seconds"]];
gate["original coefficient merge unchanged",DownValues[merge]===certificateOriginalMerge];
certificateResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-scalar-reconstruction-certificates-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[certificateSource,"SHA256"],"MapperHash"->FileHash[mapper,"SHA256"],
 "PolynomialProofHash"->FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],"AtomProofHash"->FileHash[certificateAtomPath,"SHA256"],
 "AtomReceiptHash"->FileHash[certificateAtomReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"OwnProofHash"->FileHash[certificateOwnPath,"SHA256"],
 "OwnReceiptHash"->FileHash[certificateOwnReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"ActualGroupFile"->StringDrop[certificateGroupPath,StringLength[root]+1],
 "ActualGroupHash"->FileHash[certificateGroupPath,"SHA256"],"ActualGroupBinding"->certificateGroupReference["Binding"],
 "InputHashes"->record["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->record["TargetInputHash"],"NativeInputHash"->FileHash[inputPath,"SHA256"],
 "NativeInputReceiptHash"->FileHash[inputReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},
 "OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->certificateOriginalFamily,"OriginalMappingDefinitions"->certificateOriginalMap,
 "FamilyDefinitions"->DownValues[familyRows],"MappingDefinitions"->DownValues[mapExpression],
 "FamilyCertificateDefinitions"->DownValues[certifyFamilyLaurent],"MappingCertificateDefinitions"->DownValues[certifyScalarReconstruction],
 "OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"ActualAcceptedComparison"->True,"OwnCoefficients"->certificateOwnCoefficients,
 "ActualCoefficients"->certificateActualCoefficients,"OwnTermEvidence"->(KeyDrop[#,"Coefficients"]&/@certificatePackets),
 "OwnMappingSeconds"->Total[Lookup[certificatePackets,"Seconds"]],"OwnMergeSeconds"->certificateMergeSeconds,
 "ActualMappingSeconds"->certificateActualSeconds,"PreviousActualSeconds"->certificateGroupReference["Seconds"],
 "Checks"->checks,"PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
certificateDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_scalar_certificate_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[certificateDirectory],CreateDirectory[certificateDirectory]];
saveNative[certificateResult,FileNameJoin[{certificateDirectory,"s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{certificateDirectory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
 "own_mapping_seconds"->certificateResult["OwnMappingSeconds"],"own_merge_seconds"->certificateMergeSeconds,
 "actual_seconds"->certificateActualSeconds,"previous_actual_seconds"->certificateGroupReference["Seconds"],
 "native_peak_memory_bytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_scalar_reconstruction_certificates"];Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_check_selected_entry_read.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-205", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9153, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_check_selected_entry_read.wls", "sha256": "c05455bfbfda6dc1270da95a6278c74bc449cd84bb4219ae81221f96dbad8379"} -->
```wolfram
(* Compare the existing selected-entry reader with accepted Hoffman2 inputs. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel="Hgg";checks=<||>;
source=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_check_selected_entry_read.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,gate["operation time "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],4*1024^3,gate["operation memory "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
SetAttributes[hggMapRead,HoldFirst];
hggMapRead[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,gate["read time "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],16*1024^3,gate["read memory "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]&&StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
gate["complete comparison syntax",SyntaxQ[ReadString[source]]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
readAccepted[relative_,receiptName_:"s08_execution.json"]:=Module[{path,receipt,value},
 path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],receiptName}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted native identity "<>relative,TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 value=bounded[Get[path],{"accepted input",relative}];
 gate["accepted native checks "<>relative,AssociationQ[value]&&AssociationQ[value["Checks"]]&&Length[value["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[value["Checks"]]];value];
sourceBlock[path_,first_,last_]:=Module[{text,begin,end,value},
 text=ReadString[path];begin=StringPosition[text,first];end=StringPosition[text,last];
 gate["unique complete source block "<>FileNameTake[path],Length[begin]===1&&Length[end]===1];
 value=StringTake[text,{First[First[begin]],First[First[end]]-1}];
 gate["complete source block syntax "<>FileNameTake[path],SyntaxQ[value]];value];
record=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_mapping_inputs_result/s08_component_0008.wl","s08_recovery_execution.json"];
gate["own native mapping input",record["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-native-mapping-input-v1"&&record["Channel"]===channel&&record["Component"]===8&&record["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}];
importedNativeVersions=record["NativeVersions"];localRoot=root;coordinateRules=record["CoordinateRules"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},gate["same scientific input "<>relative,FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"]===identity]],record["InputHashes"]];
reader=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_response_read_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["same accepted response reader",reader["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&TrueQ[reader["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 reader["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_check_Hgg_response_read.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
 reader["StorageSourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
DownValues[responseOnlyRead]=reader["ReaderDefinitions"];
hggResponseNativeGet[path_]:=responseOnlyRead[path,FileHash[path,"SHA256"]];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-207", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9621, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_check_streamed_numerator.wls", "sha256": "b5acb3cc1469a293ba8f1d6fdc045a22d0e1bd67bdae5a82cd6997faa344bff6"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve the accepted denominator equations while accumulating one row at a time. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
streamSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_streamed_numerator.wls"}];
streamBaseline = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[streamBaseline, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "e42c8bec95f9e856911436024b9b39cf2f1b6fd8bac4c3f345dbfaa63c173fdc", Quit[1]];
streamText = Import[streamBaseline, "Text"];
streamStop = First[First[StringPosition[streamText, "\nslots = Quiet["]]];
streamPrefix = StringTake[streamText, streamStop - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[streamPrefix], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[streamPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete streamed numerator source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[streamSource, "Text"]]];
originalSumDefinitions = DownValues[factoredDenominatorSum];
originalCancellationDefinitions = DownValues[cancelKnownDenominatorFactors];

cancelAvailableDenominatorFactors[polynomial_, factors_List, powers_List, purpose_] := Module[
  {current, extracted, factor, candidates, variable, division, quotient, remainder, seconds, beforeBytes},
  current = polynomial; extracted = {};
  gate["matched measured denominator inventory", Length[factors] === Length[powers]];
  Do[
    factor = factors[[index]];
    candidates = Select[Variables[factor],
      Function[symbol, NumberQ[Coefficient[factor, symbol, Exponent[factor, symbol]]]]];
    If[candidates === {},
      Print["RETAINED_DENOMINATOR_FACTOR ", purpose, " ", InputForm[factor]]; Continue[]];
    variable = First[MinimalBy[candidates, Exponent[factor, #] &]];
    Do[
      beforeBytes = ByteCount[current];
      {seconds, division} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
        PolynomialQuotientRemainder[current, factor, variable], {purpose, "known-factor division", index, power}]];
      {quotient, remainder} = division;
      remainder = bounded[Expand[remainder], {purpose, "exact division remainder", index, power}];
      gate["exact known-factor quotient and remainder", bounded[
        Expand[current - factor quotient - remainder] === 0, {purpose, "division reconstruction", index, power}]];
      Print["KNOWN_FACTOR_DIVISION ", purpose, " factor ", InputForm[factor], " variable ", variable,
        " seconds ", seconds, " input_bytes ", beforeBytes, " quotient_bytes ", ByteCount[quotient],
        " divides ", remainder === 0];
      If[remainder =!= 0, Break[]];
      current = quotient; AppendTo[extracted, factor], {power, powers[[index]]}],
    {index, Length[factors]}];
  (Times @@ extracted) current];

streamedDenominatorSum[terms_List, purpose_] := Module[
  {nonzero, packets, expression, rational, factors, numerical, symbolic, unit, factorMap,
   allFactors, commonPowers, commonDenominator, row, multiplier, numerator, next,
   factoredNumerator, answer, seconds, evidence, rowCount = 0, peakRowBytes = 0},
  nonzero = DeleteCases[terms, 0];
  If[nonzero === {}, Return[<|"Value" -> 0, "Evidence" -> <|"TermCount" -> 0|>|>]];
  packets = Table[
    expression = nonzero[[i]];
    rational = bounded[Together[expression], {purpose, "individual rational term", i}];
    factors = bounded[FactorList[Denominator[rational]], {purpose, "denominator factors", i}];
    numerical = Select[factors, NumberQ[First[#]] &];
    symbolic = Select[factors, !NumberQ[First[#]] &];
    unit = Times @@ (Power @@@ numerical);
    factorMap = Association[Rule @@@ symbolic];
    gate["exact individual denominator factorization", zero[Denominator[rational] - unit (Times @@ (Power @@@ symbolic))]];
    gate["unique positive denominator factor powers", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ symbolic] &&
      AllTrue[Values[factorMap], IntegerQ[#] && # > 0 &] && unit =!= 0];
    <|"Numerator" -> Numerator[rational], "Denominator" -> Denominator[rational], "Unit" -> unit,
      "FactorPowers" -> factorMap, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[expression]|>, {i, Length[nonzero]}];
  allFactors = Union[Flatten[Keys[#["FactorPowers"]] & /@ packets]];
  commonPowers = Table[Max[Lookup[#["FactorPowers"], factor, 0] & /@ packets], {factor, allFactors}];
  commonDenominator = Times @@ MapThread[Power, {allFactors, commonPowers}];
  evidence = <|"TermCount" -> Length[nonzero], "FactorCount" -> Length[allFactors],
    "FactorPowers" -> AssociationThread[allFactors, commonPowers],
    "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[terms], "CommonDenominatorBytes" -> ByteCount[commonDenominator]|>;
  Print["DENOMINATOR_SUPPORT ", purpose, " ", InputForm[evidence]];
  numerator = 0;
  seconds = First[AbsoluteTiming[Do[
    multiplier = (Times @@ MapThread[Power, {allFactors,
      commonPowers - (Lookup[packets[[i]]["FactorPowers"], #, 0] & /@ allFactors)}])/packets[[i]]["Unit"];
    gate["exact common-denominator embedding", bounded[
      zero[packets[[i]]["Denominator"] multiplier/commonDenominator - 1], {purpose, "denominator embedding", i}]];
    row = bounded[Expand[packets[[i]]["Numerator"] multiplier], {purpose, "polynomial numerator", i}];
    peakRowBytes = Max[peakRowBytes, ByteCount[row]];
    next = bounded[numerator + row, {purpose, "streamed numerator addition", i}];
    gate["exact streamed numerator addition", bounded[Expand[next - numerator - row] === 0,
      {purpose, "streamed addition reconstruction", i}]];
    numerator = next; Clear[next, row]; rowCount++;
    If[Mod[i, 16] === 0 || i === Length[packets],
      Print["STREAMED_NUMERATOR ", purpose, " row ", i, "/", Length[packets],
        " numerator_bytes ", ByteCount[numerator], " kernel_memory ", MemoryInUse[]]; ClearSystemCache[]],
    {i, Length[packets]}]]];
  gate["exact complete numerator assembly", rowCount === Length[packets]];
  Print["DENOMINATOR_NUMERATOR ", purpose, " bytes ", ByteCount[numerator], " seconds ", seconds];
  Clear[packets]; ClearSystemCache[];
  factoredNumerator = cancelAvailableDenominatorFactors[numerator, allFactors, commonPowers, purpose];
  gate["exact final numerator factorization", bounded[Expand[numerator - factoredNumerator] === 0,
    {purpose, "final numerator reconstruction"}]];
  answer = factoredNumerator/commonDenominator;
  gate["exact final denominator reconstruction", bounded[zero[answer commonDenominator - factoredNumerator],
    {purpose, "final denominator reconstruction"}]];
  <|"Value" -> answer, "Evidence" -> Join[evidence, <|"NumeratorBytes" -> ByteCount[numerator],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[answer], "PeakRowBytes" -> peakRowBytes, "NumeratorAssemblySeconds" -> seconds,
    "ExactTermwiseReconstructionPassed" -> True|>]|>];

streamInputHash = Hash[{FileHash[streamSource, "SHA256"], inputHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
streamDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_streamed_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[streamDir], CreateDirectory[streamDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
streamControl = streamedDenominatorSum[controlTerms, "own accepted original control"];
gate["streamed own accepted original coefficient equality", bounded[
  zero[streamControl["Value"] - controlValue], "streamed control equality"]];
streamIndex = SelectFirst[Range[Length[tasks]],
  !FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[#, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]] &];
gate["actual unfinished component selected", IntegerQ[streamIndex]];
streamRaw = rawTargetComponents[[streamIndex]];
gate["actual component exact reconstruction accepted", TrueQ[streamRaw["ReconstructionPassed"]] &&
  And @@ Values[streamRaw["Checks"]]];
streamRules = Association[reduction["Rules"]];
gate["actual component complete Kira coverage", Complement[Keys[streamRaw["Coefficients"]], Keys[streamRules]] === {}];
streamMasters = Union[Cases[Values[KeyTake[streamRules, Keys[streamRaw["Coefficients"]]]], _CutIntegral, Infinity]];
streamMaster = First[streamMasters];
streamTerms = KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[streamRules[#1], streamMaster] &, streamRaw["Coefficients"]];
Print["ACTUAL_COEFFICIENT ", streamIndex, " ", InputForm[streamMaster], " bytes ", ByteCount[streamTerms]];
Print["SMALLEST_NONZERO_INPUT_TERM ", InputForm[First[MinimalBy[DeleteCases[streamTerms, 0], ByteCount]]]];
{streamSeconds, streamPacket} = AbsoluteTiming[streamedDenominatorSum[streamTerms, {streamIndex, streamMaster}]];
gate["actual coefficient exact streamed reconstruction", TrueQ[streamPacket["Evidence"]["ExactTermwiseReconstructionPassed"]]];
streamResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-streamed-numerator-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[streamSource, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[streamBaseline, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> streamInputHash, "ProductionInputHash" -> inputHash,
  "Definitions" -> DownValues[streamedDenominatorSum], "OriginalDefinitions" -> originalSumDefinitions,
  "CancellationDefinitions" -> DownValues[cancelAvailableDenominatorFactors],
  "OriginalCancellationDefinitions" -> originalCancellationDefinitions,
  "ControlMaster" -> controlMaster, "ControlValue" -> streamControl["Value"],
  "ComponentIndex" -> streamIndex, "Task" -> KeyDrop[tasks[[streamIndex]], "Value"],
  "Master" -> streamMaster, "Coefficient" -> streamPacket, "Seconds" -> streamSeconds,
  "Checks" -> checks, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[], "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
putCompressed[streamResult, FileNameJoin[{streamDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{streamDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "component_index" -> streamIndex, "seconds" -> streamSeconds,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_streamed_numerator"]; Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_coefficient_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-208", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6190, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_coefficient_check.wls", "sha256": "46e5b7ae4c248c82cffe2e5e8d9dd5d789224fbb05365cc71dbc369eae2aa84d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Inspect the actual timed-out real coefficient and validate on-shell compaction. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
profileRoot = Directory[];
profileSource = FileNameJoin[{profileRoot, "common", "s08_coefficient_check.wls"}];
profileMapper = FileNameJoin[{profileRoot, "common", "s08_map_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[profileMapper, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "e23a79589bfce183535a6f1166eda799a9f119168feb9cff1b13feb669c8b21f", Quit[1]];
profileText = Import[profileMapper, "Text"];
profileStop = First[First[StringPosition[profileText, "\ncomponents = {}; targets = {};"]]];
ToExpression[StringTake[profileText, profileStop - 1], InputForm];
gate["complete coefficient check syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[profileSource, "Text"]]];
gate["comparison uses accepted Hqqprime tensor", channel === "Hqqprime" &&
  IntegerString[FileHash[spinPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    "07679643127071c38d0522479236858ff7fd1f4e770d22d65572072f56e03d9f"];
profileReductionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_result", "reference",
  "s05_real_spin_response_before_parallel_spin_checks.wls"}];
gate["accepted on-shell reduction source", IntegerString[FileHash[profileReductionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "46c45f60a0f97c18d430cd8a3ee05182bc5e10f5deb424e8b69487d76e75e500"];
profileReductionText = Import[profileReductionPath, "Text"];
profileReductionBegin = First[First[StringPosition[profileReductionText, "algebraicReduceOne[value_] := Module["]]];
profileReductionEnd = First[First[StringPosition[profileReductionText, "\npVector = Factor["]]];
profileReductionCode = StringTake[profileReductionText, {profileReductionBegin, profileReductionEnd - 1}];
ToExpression[profileReductionCode, InputForm];
transverseConstraint = spin["TransverseConstraint"];
gate["saved transverse constraint has no cut coordinates", FreeQ[transverseConstraint, a | b]];
profileHash = Hash[{FileHash[profileSource, "SHA256"], inputHashes,
  FileHash[profileReductionPath, "SHA256"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
profileCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_coefficient_check", IntegerString[profileHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[profileCache], CreateDirectory[profileCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
profileTask = First[tasks];
Print["COEFFICIENT_INPUT ", KeyDrop[profileTask, "Value"]];
profileValue = profileTask["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
{profileMapSeconds, profileCoefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[profileValue], "actual failed raw map"]];
put[<|"InputHash" -> profileHash, "Task" -> KeyDrop[profileTask, "Value"],
  "Coefficients" -> profileCoefficients, "MappingChecks" -> checks|>,
  FileNameJoin[{profileCache, "s08_raw_map.wl"}]];
profileMaster = First[Sort[reduction["Masters"]]];
profileRuleMap = Association[reduction["Rules"]];
profileMissing = Complement[Keys[profileCoefficients], Keys[profileRuleMap]];
profileRuleMap = Join[profileRuleMap, AssociationThread[profileMissing, profileMissing]];
profileTerms = KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[profileRuleMap[#1], profileMaster] &, profileCoefficients];
profileInputEvidence = <|"InputBytes" -> ByteCount[profileValue], "RawMapSeconds" -> profileMapSeconds,
  "RawCoefficientBytes" -> ByteCount[profileCoefficients], "RawTargetCount" -> Length[profileCoefficients],
  "Master" -> profileMaster, "MasterTermBytes" -> ByteCount[profileTerms],
  "NonzeroMasterTerms" -> Count[profileTerms, Except[0]],
  "TransverseDegrees" -> DeleteDuplicates[Exponent[#, transverseK] & /@ Values[profileCoefficients]],
  "CoefficientSymbols" -> globalSymbols[Values[profileCoefficients]]|>;
Print["COEFFICIENT_INPUT_EVIDENCE ", InputForm[profileInputEvidence]];
put[profileInputEvidence, FileNameJoin[{profileCache, "s08_input_evidence.wl"}]];
profileCompact = <||>; profileTimings = {};
KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, value}, Module[{seconds, compact},
  Print["COMPACT_CUT_COEFFICIENT ", InputForm[integral], " bytes ", ByteCount[value]];
  {seconds, compact} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[algebraicReduceOne[value], {"native on-shell compaction", integral}]];
  AssociateTo[profileCompact, integral -> compact];
  AppendTo[profileTimings, <|"Integral" -> integral, "Seconds" -> seconds,
    "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[value], "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[compact]|>]]], profileCoefficients];
gate["compaction retains complete cut inventory", Keys[profileCompact] === Keys[profileCoefficients]];
put[<|"InputHash" -> profileHash, "Coefficients" -> profileCompact, "Timings" -> profileTimings,
  "Checks" -> checks|>, FileNameJoin[{profileCache, "s08_compact_map.wl"}]];
profileRemaining = Union[Cases[Total[KeyValueMap[Times, profileCompact]] /. reduction["Rules"], _CutIntegral, Infinity]];
{profileAssemblySeconds, profileReduced} = AbsoluteTiming[
  referenceCoefficients[profileCompact, profileRemaining, "on-shell coefficient comparison"]];
gate["compacted reduction exactly reconstructs", bounded[zero[
  (Total[KeyValueMap[Times, profileCompact]] /. reduction["Rules"]) -
  Total[KeyValueMap[Times, profileReduced]]], "compacted master reconstruction"]];
profileResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-coefficient-compaction-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[profileSource, "SHA256"], "MapperSourceHash" -> FileHash[profileMapper, "SHA256"],
  "ReductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[profileReductionPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> profileHash,
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "Task" -> KeyDrop[profileTask, "Value"],
  "InputEvidence" -> profileInputEvidence, "Timings" -> profileTimings,
  "CompactCoefficientBytes" -> ByteCount[profileCompact], "MasterAssemblySeconds" -> profileAssemblySeconds,
  "ReducedCoefficients" -> profileReduced, "OnShellReductionCode" -> profileReductionCode,
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
profileDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_coefficient_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[profileDir], CreateDirectory[profileDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[profileResult, FileNameJoin[{profileDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{profileDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel,
  "checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_coefficient_check"]; Quit[0];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-209", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7217, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_collect_compatible_reductions.wls", "sha256": "d66084511920128f7cff8d91d2e2df6a1bfcbc2152310903cb9b60ad271ab2b9"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse native Kira rules only with identical geometry, cuts and master basis. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];checks=<||>;
source=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_collect_compatible_reductions.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,name],Print["PASS: ",name]];
 AssociateTo[checks,name->True],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[source,"Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,900,
 gate["time bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],2*1024^3,
 gate["memory bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
zero[value_]:=Factor[Together[value]]===0;
paths={source};
read[relative_]:=(AppendTo[paths,FileNameJoin[{root,relative}]];
 If[StringEndsQ[relative,".json"],Import[Last[paths],"RawJSON"],Get[Last[paths]]]);
library=read["common/s06_result/s06_result.wl"];
gate["accepted common scalar library",library["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1"&&And@@Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_]:=Module[{row=library["Library"][stage],path},
 path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["File"]}];
 gate[stage<>" exact common scalar input",IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["SHA256"]];read[row["File"]]];
geometry=readLibrary["s02"];baseline=readLibrary["s04"];
gate["accepted baseline and physical cut support",TrueQ[geometry["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[baseline["Accepted"]]&&
 baseline["CutEnergyConditions"]===geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]];
geometryHash=FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,library["Library"]["s02"]["File"]}],"SHA256"];
baselineHash=FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]}],"SHA256"];
extensionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_extend_real_reduction.wls"}];AppendTo[paths,extensionSource];
ruleMap=Association[baseline["Rules"]];
gate["unique baseline rules",Length[ruleMap]===Length[baseline["Rules"]]];
owners=<||>;overlapCounts=<||>;acceptedResults=<||>;
Do[relative=owner<>"/s08_reduction_result/s08_reduction.wl";
 receipt=read[owner<>"/s08_reduction_result/s08_execution.json"];
 gate[owner<>" authentic accepted reduction",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  receipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s08_extend_real_reduction.wls"]===IntegerString[FileHash[extensionSource,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 native=read[relative];
 gate[owner<>" same complete scalar reduction contract",native["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-real-reduction-extension-v1"&&
  native["Channel"]===owner&&TrueQ[native["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[native["Checks"]]&&
  native["SourceHash"]===FileHash[extensionSource,"SHA256"]&&native["GeometryHash"]===geometryHash&&
  native["BaselineReductionHash"]===baselineHash&&Sort[native["Masters"]]===Sort[baseline["Masters"]]&&
  native["CutEnergyConditions"]===geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]];
 gate[owner<>" identical native family definitions",KeyTake[geometry["Families"],Keys[native["Families"]]]===native["Families"]];
 incoming=Association[native["Rules"]];
 gate[owner<>" complete unique rule inventory",Length[incoming]===Length[native["Rules"]]&&
  Complement[native["Targets"],Keys[incoming]]==={}&&
  Complement[Cases[Values[incoming],_CutIntegral,Infinity],baseline["Masters"]]==={}];
 common=Intersection[Keys[ruleMap],Keys[incoming]];
 gate[owner<>" exact overlapping reductions",And@@Table[
  ruleMap[key]===incoming[key]||bounded[zero[ruleMap[key]-incoming[key]],{owner,key}],{key,common}]];
 AssociateTo[overlapCounts,owner->Length[common]];
 AssociateTo[ruleMap,Normal[KeyDrop[incoming,Keys[ruleMap]]]];
 AssociateTo[owners,owner-><|"ResultHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"],
  "ReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,owner,"s08_reduction_result","s08_execution.json"}],"SHA256"],
  "KiraHash"->native["KiraHash"],"FermatHash"->native["FermatHash"]|>];
 AssociateTo[acceptedResults,owner->incoming],{owner,{"Hqg","Hgq"}}];
Do[gate[owner<>" entire accepted output reproduced",And@@KeyValueMap[
 (#2===ruleMap[#1]||bounded[zero[#2-ruleMap[#1]],{owner,"complete rule comparison",#1}])&,acceptedResults[owner]]],
 {owner,Keys[acceptedResults]}];
gate["combined rules end only in inherited masters",Complement[Cases[Values[ruleMap],_CutIntegral,Infinity],baseline["Masters"]]==={}];
gate["all inherited masters retained",Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Values[ruleMap],_CutIntegral,Infinity]]]===Sort[baseline["Masters"]]];
relative="Hgg/s08_direct_group_component_result/s08_result.wl";
ownReceipt=read["Hgg/s08_direct_group_component_result/s08_execution.json"];
gate["accepted complete own component13 map",TrueQ[ownReceipt["passed"]]&&
 ownReceipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]];
own=read[relative];
gate["actual own subset identity",own["Channel"]==="Hgg"&&own["SelectedComponentIndices"]==={13}&&
 TrueQ[own["MappingAccepted"]]&&And@@Values[own["Checks"]]];
missing=Complement[own["Targets"],Keys[ruleMap]];
Print["OWN_HGG13_REDUCTION_COVERAGE ",Length[own["Targets"]]-Length[missing],"/",Length[own["Targets"]],
 " missing ",InputForm[missing]];
paths=DeleteDuplicates[paths];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-compatible-cut-reductions-v1","Channel"->"Hgg",
 "Rules"->Normal[ruleMap],"Masters"->baseline["Masters"],"Families"->geometry["Families"],
 "CutEnergyConditions"->geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],"GeometryHash"->geometryHash,"BaselineReductionHash"->baselineHash,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"OriginalExtensionSourceHash"->FileHash[extensionSource,"SHA256"],
 "InputHashes"->Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@paths],
 "Owners"->owners,"OverlapCounts"->overlapCounts,"OwnComparisonPassed"->True,
 "OwnSubsetMappingHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"],
 "OwnSubsetTargetCount"->Length[own["Targets"]],"OwnSubsetMissingTargets"->missing,
 "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_compatible_reductions_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory]];path=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_result.wl"}];
serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[result],"compatible rule serialization"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded compatible rule export",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[path<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
gate["exact compatible rule reload",bounded[Get[path<>".tmp"]===result,"compatible rule reload"]];
RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"rule_count"->Length[ruleMap],
 "overlap_counts"->overlapCounts,"own_subset_target_count"->Length[own["Targets"]],
 "own_subset_missing_count"->Length[missing],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_collect_compatible_reductions"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s08_complete_pair_mapping.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-211", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6986, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_complete_pair_mapping.wls", "sha256": "fc8132ea505476932c1574a53f91194a9638a1082c77d51e23c8ca81b3831887"} -->
```wolfram
(* Complete the original pair-map export with accepted component reconstructions. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
completionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_complete_pair_mapping.wls"}];
completionConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_pair_completion_inputs.json"}];
completionBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_quark_pair_mapping.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[completionBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "890b96aead1f5c9de58b6cc6b8f1bac8d28eabcb5442b79de38da13bf8a9261a", Quit[1]];
completionText = Import[completionBase, "Text"];
If[StringCount[completionText, "\nslots ="] =!= 1 || StringCount[completionText, "\npairResult ="] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
completionPrefix = First[StringSplit[completionText, "\nslots ="]];
If[!SyntaxQ[completionPrefix], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[completionPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete pair completion source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[completionPath, "Text"]]];
completionConfig = Import[completionConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["pair completion input schema", completionConfig["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-pair-completion-inputs-v1"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative, identity}, gate["pinned accepted pair component " <> relative,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === identity]], completionConfig["files"]];
completionProofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_pair_merge_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
completionReceiptPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_pair_merge_result", "s08_execution.json"}];
completionReceipt = Import[completionReceiptPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete pair merge receipt", TrueQ[completionReceipt["passed"]] &&
  completionReceipt["result_sha256"][channel <> "/s08_pair_merge_result/s08_result.wl"] ===
    IntegerString[FileHash[completionProofPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64]];
completionProof = Get[completionProofPath];
completionProofSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_check_pair_merge_linearity.wls"}];
gate["accepted exact pair merge implementation", IntegerString[FileHash[completionProofSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "531822a5be4cf830202ca16a9cfaae1d8d7fd9b53c429cc901867da421c58f72"];
gate["accepted complete merge reconstruction comparison", completionProof["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-pair-merge-linearity-v1" &&
  completionProof["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[completionProof["Checks"]] &&
  TrueQ[completionProof["Checks"]["entire own accepted pair coefficient map identical"]] &&
  And @@ Lookup[completionProof["Components"], "ReconstructionPassed"] &&
  And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ completionProof["Components"]]];
gate["exact merge comparison source and physical input identity", completionProof["SourceHash"] === FileHash[completionProofSource, "SHA256"] &&
  completionProof["ConfigurationHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_pair_merge_inputs.json"}], "SHA256"] &&
  completionProof["PairSourceHash"] === FileHash[completionBase, "SHA256"] && completionProof["PairInputHash"] === pairStudyHash &&
  completionProof["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && completionProof["TargetInputHash"] === targetInputHash &&
  completionProof["MappingInputHash"] === inputHash && completionProof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
gate["original mapping and merge definitions retained", completionProof["OriginalMappingDefinitions"] === DownValues[mapExpression] &&
  completionProof["OriginalMergeDefinitions"] === DownValues[merge]];
completionComponents = Association[(#["ComponentIndex"] -> #) & /@ completionProof["Components"]];
gate["exact comparison component inventory", Length[completionComponents] === Length[completionProof["Components"]] &&
  Keys[completionComponents] === completionProof["SelectedIndices"] &&
  completionProof["ControlIndex"] === pairControlIndex && MemberQ[Keys[completionComponents], pairControlIndex] &&
  Complement[Keys[completionComponents], pairSelected] === {}];
pairComponents = Table[
  componentPath = FileNameJoin[{pairCache, "component_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}];
  componentRelative = StringDrop[componentPath, StringLength[root] + 1];
  If[KeyExistsQ[completionConfig["files"], componentRelative],
    component = Get[componentPath];
    If[KeyExistsQ[completionComponents, index], gate["entire own accepted control map reproduced",
      component["Coefficients"] === completionComponents[index]["Coefficients"]]],
    gate["missing original component supplied by accepted comparison", KeyExistsQ[completionComponents, index]];
    component = completionComponents[index];
    gate["component exact accepted merge binding", component["MergeInputHash"] === completionProof["InputHash"]];
    AssociateTo[component, "MergeComparisonHash" -> FileHash[completionProofPath, "SHA256"]]];
  gate["exact complete component binding " <> ToString[index], component["ComponentIndex"] === index &&
    component["InputHash"] === targetInputHash && component["StudyInputHash"] === pairStudyHash &&
    KeyTake[component, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}] === KeyDrop[tasks[[index]], "Value"] &&
    TrueQ[component["ReconstructionPassed"]] && AssociationQ[component["Checks"]] && Length[component["Checks"]] > 0 &&
    And @@ Values[component["Checks"]]];
  gate["recorded pair component reduction coverage " <> ToString[index], component["MissingTargets"] ===
    Complement[Keys[component["Coefficients"]], ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]]];
  gate["pair component physical cut powers retained " <> ToString[index], And @@
    (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[component["Coefficients"]])];
  component, {index, pairSelected}];
gate["complete original selected pair inventory", Lookup[pairComponents, "ComponentIndex"] === pairSelected && DuplicateFreeQ[pairSelected]];
gate["accepted control included in original file inventory", KeyExistsQ[completionConfig["files"],
  StringDrop[FileNameJoin[{pairCache, "component_" <> IntegerString[pairControlIndex, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}], StringLength[root] + 1]]];
workers = 0;
completionTail = "pairResult =" <> Last[StringSplit[completionText, "\npairResult ="]];
completionBoundary = "pairResultDir = FileNameJoin";
gate["unique original pair export metadata boundary", StringCount[completionTail, completionBoundary] === 1];
completionTail = StringReplace[completionTail, completionBoundary ->
  ("AssociateTo[pairResult, {\"DispatchSourceHash\" -> FileHash[completionPath, \"SHA256\"], \"MergeComparisonHash\" -> FileHash[completionProofPath, \"SHA256\"], \"MergeExecutionHash\" -> FileHash[completionReceiptPath, \"SHA256\"], \"CompletionConfigurationHash\" -> FileHash[completionConfigPath, \"SHA256\"], \"ReusedComponentFiles\" -> completionConfig[\"files\"]}];\n" <> completionBoundary)];
completionTail = StringReplace[completionTail, "PASS: s08_check_quark_pair_mapping" -> "PASS: s08_complete_pair_mapping"];
gate["complete original pair export syntax", SyntaxQ[completionTail]];
ToExpression[completionTail, InputForm];
```

## common/s08_denominator_sum_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-212", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7513, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_denominator_sum_check.wls", "sha256": "c2ba99a0039cbbc295b7aa918d336f697a1cc5a5546f3e670ec4ec9bb01bc47d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Exact rational summation from the factor supports of the actual saved cut coefficients. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
denominatorSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_denominator_sum_check.wls"}];
denominatorBaseline = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_rational_sum_check.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[denominatorBaseline, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "7057bd25031c8032c05ba486395032e46c5e5dd10db004c4ce1c96f32779603f", Quit[1]];
denominatorText = Import[denominatorBaseline, "Text"];
denominatorStop = First[First[StringPosition[denominatorText, "\nsumValues = <||>; sumTimings = {};"]]];
denominatorPrefix = StringTake[denominatorText, denominatorStop - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[denominatorPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete comparison prefix syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[denominatorPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete denominator-sum comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[denominatorSource, "Text"]]];

factoredDenominatorSum[terms_List, purpose_] := Module[
  {nonzero, packets, expression, rational, factors, numerical, symbolic, unit, factorMap,
   allFactors, commonPowers, commonDenominator, rows, multiplier, numerator, factoredNumerator,
   answer, seconds, evidence},
  nonzero = DeleteCases[terms, 0];
  If[nonzero === {}, Return[<|"Value" -> 0, "Evidence" -> <|"TermCount" -> 0|>|>]];
  packets = Table[
    expression = nonzero[[i]];
    rational = bounded[Together[expression], {purpose, "individual rational term", i}];
    factors = bounded[FactorList[Denominator[rational]], {purpose, "denominator factors", i}];
    numerical = Select[factors, NumberQ[First[#]] &];
    symbolic = Select[factors, !NumberQ[First[#]] &];
    unit = Times @@ (Power @@@ numerical);
    factorMap = Association[Rule @@@ symbolic];
    gate["exact individual denominator factorization", zero[Denominator[rational] - unit (Times @@ (Power @@@ symbolic))]];
    gate["unique positive denominator factor powers", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ symbolic] &&
      AllTrue[Values[factorMap], IntegerQ[#] && # > 0 &] && unit =!= 0];
    <|"Numerator" -> Numerator[rational], "Denominator" -> Denominator[rational], "Unit" -> unit,
      "FactorPowers" -> factorMap, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[expression]|>, {i, Length[nonzero]}];
  allFactors = Union[Flatten[Keys[#["FactorPowers"]] & /@ packets]];
  commonPowers = Table[Max[Lookup[#["FactorPowers"], factor, 0] & /@ packets], {factor, allFactors}];
  commonDenominator = Times @@ MapThread[Power, {allFactors, commonPowers}];
  evidence = <|"TermCount" -> Length[nonzero], "FactorCount" -> Length[allFactors],
    "FactorPowers" -> AssociationThread[allFactors, commonPowers],
    "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[terms], "CommonDenominatorBytes" -> ByteCount[commonDenominator]|>;
  Print["DENOMINATOR_SUPPORT ", purpose, " ", InputForm[evidence]];
  rows = Table[
    multiplier = (Times @@ MapThread[Power, {allFactors,
      commonPowers - (Lookup[packets[[i]]["FactorPowers"], #, 0] & /@ allFactors)}])/packets[[i]]["Unit"];
    gate["exact common-denominator embedding", bounded[
      zero[packets[[i]]["Denominator"] multiplier/commonDenominator - 1], {purpose, "denominator embedding", i}]];
    bounded[Expand[packets[[i]]["Numerator"] multiplier], {purpose, "polynomial numerator", i}],
    {i, Length[packets]}];
  {seconds, numerator} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[Total[rows], {purpose, "polynomial numerator sum"}]];
  gate["exact complete numerator assembly", bounded[Expand[numerator - Total[rows]] === 0, {purpose, "numerator reconstruction"}]];
  Print["DENOMINATOR_NUMERATOR ", purpose, " bytes ", ByteCount[numerator], " seconds ", seconds];
  Clear[rows]; ClearSystemCache[];
  factoredNumerator = bounded[Factor[numerator], {purpose, "final numerator factorization"}];
  gate["exact final numerator factorization", bounded[Expand[numerator - factoredNumerator] === 0,
    {purpose, "final numerator reconstruction"}]];
  answer = factoredNumerator/commonDenominator;
  gate["exact final denominator reconstruction", bounded[zero[answer commonDenominator - factoredNumerator],
    {purpose, "final denominator reconstruction"}]];
  <|"Value" -> answer, "Evidence" -> Join[evidence, <|"NumeratorBytes" -> ByteCount[numerator],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[answer], "ExactTermwiseReconstructionPassed" -> True|>]|>];

denominatorControl = factoredDenominatorSum[sumControl["Terms"], "original same-channel control"];
gate["own accepted original coefficient comparison", bounded[
  zero[denominatorControl["Value"] - sumControlValue[sumControl["Master"]]], "original control equality"]];

denominatorCacheHash = Hash[{FileHash[denominatorSource, "SHA256"], FileHash[denominatorBaseline, "SHA256"],
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, sumConfig["raw_map"]}], "SHA256"], inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
denominatorCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_denominator_sum", IntegerString[denominatorCacheHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[denominatorCache], CreateDirectory[denominatorCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
sumValues = <||>; denominatorEvidence = {};
Do[
  sumMaster = sumPacket["Master"];
  packetPath = FileNameJoin[{denominatorCache, "master_" <> IntegerString[Hash[sumMaster, "SHA256"], 16] <> ".wl"}];
  packet = If[FileExistsQ[packetPath], Get[packetPath], <||>];
  If[Lookup[packet, "InputHash", None] =!= denominatorCacheHash,
    Print["FACTORED_DENOMINATOR_SUM ", InputForm[sumMaster]];
    {denominatorSeconds, packet} = AbsoluteTiming[factoredDenominatorSum[sumPacket["Terms"], sumMaster]];
    packet = Join[packet, <|"InputHash" -> denominatorCacheHash, "Master" -> sumMaster, "Seconds" -> denominatorSeconds|>];
    put[packet, packetPath]];
  If[sumMaster === sumControl["Master"], gate["original same-channel coefficient unchanged",
    bounded[zero[packet["Value"] - sumControlValue[sumMaster]], "original coefficient comparison"]]];
  AssociateTo[sumValues, sumMaster -> packet["Value"]];
  AppendTo[denominatorEvidence, KeyDrop[packet, {"Value", "InputHash"}]];
  Print["FACTORED_DENOMINATOR_SUM_ACCEPTED ", InputForm[sumMaster], " seconds ", packet["Seconds"]],
  {sumPacket, sumPackets}];
gate["complete factored-denominator coefficient inventory", Keys[sumValues] === sumMasters];
gate["fully scalar exact denominator-sum coefficients", FreeQ[sumValues, _CutIntegral | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted | _Integrate | _SeriesData]];
denominatorResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-denominator-sum-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[denominatorSource, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[denominatorBaseline, "SHA256"],
  "MapperSourceHash" -> FileHash[sumMapper, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "RawMapHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, sumConfig["raw_map"]}], "SHA256"],
  "InputHash" -> denominatorCacheHash, "Task" -> sumRaw["Task"],
  "Definitions" -> DownValues[factoredDenominatorSum], "ControlMaster" -> sumControl["Master"],
  "ReducedCoefficients" -> sumValues, "Evidence" -> denominatorEvidence, "Checks" -> checks,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
denominatorDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_denominator_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[denominatorDir], CreateDirectory[denominatorDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[denominatorResult, FileNameJoin[{denominatorDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{denominatorDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_denominator_sum_check"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s08_export_Hgg_active_equations.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-214", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3885, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_export_Hgg_active_equations.wls", "sha256": "77dda1fcb3481b6df37ceb18575d5220e9645b619e85ffe34343128b6b507295"} -->
```wolfram
(* Read the two active Hgg target equations without changing their algebra. *)
$HistoryLength=0; root=Directory[]; checks=<||>;
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]&&StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
source=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_export_Hgg_active_equations.wls"}];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[source,"Text"]]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
acceptedRead[relative_,receiptRelative_]:=Module[{path,receipt},
 path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,receiptRelative}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted input "<>relative,TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 Get[path]];
controlRelative="Hgg/s08_mapping_inputs_result/s08_component_0008.wl";
controlReceipt="Hgg/s08_mapping_inputs_result/s08_recovery_execution.json";
control=acceptedRead[controlRelative,controlReceipt];
gate["accepted own coordinate conventions",control["Channel"]==="Hgg"&&control["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-native-mapping-input-v1"&&control["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&And@@Values[control["Checks"]]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{name,identity},gate["unchanged scientific input "<>name,FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,name}],"SHA256"]===identity]],control["InputHashes"]];
relative="Hgg/s05_projected_components_result/Photon_1/s05_result.wl";
receiptRelative="Hgg/s05_projected_components_result/Photon_1/s05_execution.json";
packet=acceptedRead[relative,receiptRelative];
gate["accepted original photon response",packet["Channel"]==="Hgg"&&packet["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-complete-photon-spin-component-v1"&&packet["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]];
metadata=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s05_result","s05_metadata.wl"}]];
gate["metadata belongs to accepted scalar input",metadata["Channel"]==="Hgg"&&And@@Values[metadata["Checks"]]];
selected=Take[metadata["MappingTaskMetadata"],2];sources=Take[metadata["MappingTaskSources"],2];
gate["two active tasks use the exact loaded response",And@@(#["Payload"]["File"]===relative&&#["Payload"]["Hash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"]&&#["Field"]==="Response"&/@sources)];
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_active_equations_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory]];
files=<||>;measurements={};
Do[Module[{value,text,path},
 value=Extract[packet["Response"],sources[[index]]["Index"]]/.control["CoordinateRules"];
 path=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_component_"<>IntegerString[index,10,4]<>"_equation.wl"}];
 text=ToString[value,InputForm,PageWidth->120];
 gate["bounded readable equation "<>ToString[index],StringLength[text]<128*1024^2];
 Export[path,text,"Text"];
 gate["entire saved equation reloads unchanged "<>ToString[index],Get[path]===value];
 AssociateTo[files,StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1]->IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 AppendTo[measurements,<|"Component"->index,"Task"->ToString[selected[[index]],InputForm],"ExpressionBytes"->ByteCount[value],"FileBytes"->FileByteCount[path]|>];
 Print["EXPORTED_ACTIVE_EQUATION ",InputForm[Last[measurements]]]],{index,Length[selected]}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"files"->files,"measurements"->measurements,"input_sha256"->AssociationMap[IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#}],"SHA256"],16,64]&,{relative,receiptRelative,controlRelative,controlReceipt,"Hgg/s05_result/s05_metadata.wl"}],"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_export_Hgg_active_equations"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s08_export_Hgg_blocked_equations.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-215", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5800, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_export_Hgg_blocked_equations.wls", "sha256": "bbfb708b088e1c36934afe5ede6303140160760a2e910a61aa4babe9bf7b1a77"} -->
```wolfram
(* Export the exact failed mapping inputs with the accepted response-only reader. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];checks=<||>;
source=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_export_Hgg_blocked_equations.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[readBound,HoldFirst];
readBound[value_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,gate["input export time bound",False]],16*1024^3,gate["input export memory bound",False]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]&&StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[source,"Text"]]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];

 path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,receiptRelative}],"RawJSON"];
```

```wolfram
(* Read the exact native equation at the failed pair-sum boundary. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
readerSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_export_Hqq_pair_sum.wls"}];
readerBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_same_sector_pair_mapping.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[readerBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "bce641c29f3a4ea773e1f8539284913b56717f2d90a0c0e936c2c4f4f8cfced6", Quit[1]];
readerText = Import[readerBase, "Text"];
If[StringCount[readerText, "\nslots ="] =!= 1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[readerSource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
readerPrefix = First[StringSplit[readerText, "\nslots ="]];
If[!SyntaxQ[readerPrefix], Quit[1]]; ToExpression[readerPrefix, InputForm];
index = 57; task = tasks[[index]];
gate["actual failed task belongs to the selected sector", task["Sector"] === pairLabel];
values = bounded[pairExpression[#, task] & /@ pairInputs, "original pair equation extraction"];
equation = Total[values] - task["Value"];
directory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_pair_sum_equation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
equationPath = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s08_equation.wl"}];
serialized = ToString[equation, InputForm] <> "\n";
gate["bounded readable equation", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[equationPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["exact original equation native reload", Get[equationPath <> ".tmp"] === equation];
RenameFile[equationPath <> ".tmp", equationPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-pair-sum-equation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Component" -> index, "Task" -> task, "PairValues" -> values, "EquationHash" -> Hash[equation, "SHA256"],
  "ReadableEquationHash" -> FileHash[equationPath, "SHA256"], "SourceHash" -> FileHash[readerSource, "SHA256"],
  "PairSourceHash" -> FileHash[readerBase, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "TargetInputHash" -> targetInputHash, "PairInputHash" -> pairStudyHash,
  "PairFileHashes" -> pairConfig["files"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "EquationBytes" -> ByteCount[equation], "Checks" -> checks, "NewMappingEvaluated" -> False|>;
pairSave[result, FileNameJoin[{directory, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "task" -> ToString[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], InputForm],
  "equation_bytes" -> ByteCount[equation], "readable_bytes" -> FileByteCount[equationPath],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_export_Hqq_pair_sum"]; Quit[0];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-220", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6362, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_extend_Hgg_ready_reduction.wls", "sha256": "2ccd9ba37b0fe8af7157f1ed8dd09dec26ffae2b6ddf779a67eed5bce1bdb7a3"} -->
```wolfram
(* Overlap accepted subset reduction with mapping; reuse it in full reduction. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
readySource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_extend_Hgg_ready_reduction.wls"}];
readyBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_extend_reused_real_reduction.wls"}];
readyOnly=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_REDUCTION_SUBSET_ONLY"]==="1";
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[readySource,"Text"]]||IntegerString[FileHash[readyBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "d5671f76872bc66bbaf3142507e6d919db3205bdbba3845c5cf5311f450c8e22",Quit[1]];
readyChange[text_,edits_]:=Module[{changed},
 If[!And@@(StringCount[text,First[#]]===1&/@edits),Print["FAIL: unique ready-reduction interface"];Quit[1]];
 changed=StringReplace[text,edits];
 If[!SyntaxQ[changed]||StringReplace[changed,Reverse/@edits]=!=text,
  Print["FAIL: unchanged ready-reduction base restored"];Quit[1]];changed];
readyPrefix[text_]:=Module[{changed=text},
 If[readyOnly,changed=readyChange[changed,{
  "mapPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s08_targets_result\", \"s08_result.wl\"}];"->
  "mapPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s08_direct_group_component_result\", \"s08_result.wl\"}];",
  "map[\"Schema\"] === \"polarized-sidis-real-target-map-v1\""->
  "map[\"Schema\"] === \"polarized-sidis-real-target-subset-v1\" && map[\"SelectedComponentIndices\"] === {13}",
  "accepted complete real target map"->"accepted complete supplied component13 target map"}]];
 readyChange[changed,{"reuseSetup[];\ninputHashes = Association["->
  "reuseSetup[];readySetup[];\ninputHashes = Association["}]];
readySetup[]:=Module[{relative,path,receipt,packet,incoming,common},
 gate["ready reduction is Hgg production",channel==="Hgg"&&!reuseControl];
 AppendTo[inputPaths,readySource];readySubsetHash=None;readySubsetReceiptHash=None;readyOverlapCount=0;
 If[readyOnly,
  relative="Hgg/s08_direct_group_component_result/s08_result.wl";
  path=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_direct_group_component_result","s08_execution.json"}];
  receipt=Import[path,"RawJSON"];
  gate["authentic complete component13 map receipt",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
   receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[mapPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
   map["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&Length[map["Components"]]===1&&
   TrueQ[First[map["Components"]]["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&And@@Values[First[map["Components"]]["Checks"]]];
  AppendTo[inputPaths,path];Return[Null]];
 relative="Hgg/s08_ready_reduction_result/s08_reduction.wl";path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
 readyReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s08_execution.json"}];receipt=Import[readyReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
 gate["authentic completed subset reduction",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  receipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s08_extend_Hgg_ready_reduction.wls"]===IntegerString[FileHash[readySource,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 packet=Get[path];
 gate["same accepted subset reduction contract",packet["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-real-reduction-subset-v1"&&
  packet["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[packet["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]&&
  packet["ChannelCoverageComplete"]===False&&packet["SelectedComponentIndices"]==={13}&&
  packet["SubsetDispatchSourceHash"]===FileHash[readySource,"SHA256"]&&
  packet["DispatchSourceHash"]===FileHash[readyBase,"SHA256"]&&packet["SourceHash"]===FileHash[reuseBase,"SHA256"]&&
  packet["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
  packet["MappingInputHashes"]===map["InputHashes"]&&
  packet["GeometryHash"]===reuseProof["GeometryHash"]&&packet["BaselineReductionHash"]===reuseProof["BaselineReductionHash"]&&
  Sort[packet["Masters"]]===Sort[baseline["Masters"]]&&packet["CutEnergyConditions"]===geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]&&
  packet["Families"]===KeyTake[geometry["Families"],Keys[packet["Families"]]]];
 KeyValueMap[gate["unchanged subset reduction input "<>#1,FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"]===#2]&,
  packet["InputHashes"]];
 incoming=Association[packet["Rules"]];
 gate["complete exact subset rule inventory",Length[incoming]===Length[packet["Rules"]]&&
  Complement[packet["Targets"],Keys[incoming]]==={}&&Complement[packet["Targets"],targets]==={}&&
  Complement[Cases[Values[incoming],_CutIntegral,Infinity],baseline["Masters"]]==={}&&
  FreeQ[incoming,_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|_Missing]];
 common=Intersection[Keys[incoming],Keys[reuseRuleMap]];
 gate["all accepted subset and reused overlaps agree",And@@Table[
  incoming[key]===reuseRuleMap[key]||bounded[zero[incoming[key]-reuseRuleMap[key]],
   {"subset rule overlap",key}],{key,common}]];
 AssociateTo[reuseRuleMap,Normal[KeyDrop[incoming,Keys[reuseRuleMap]]]];
 readySubsetHash=FileHash[path,"SHA256"];readySubsetReceiptHash=FileHash[readyReceiptPath,"SHA256"];
 readyOverlapCount=Length[common];inputPaths=Join[inputPaths,{path,readyReceiptPath}];
 Print["ACCEPTED_SUBSET_RULES_REUSED ",Length[incoming]," overlap ",readyOverlapCount]];
readySuffix[text_]:=Module[{changed=text,marker},
 If[readyOnly,changed=readyChange[changed,{
  "resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s08_reduction_result\"}];"->
  "resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s08_ready_reduction_result\"}];",
  "\"Schema\" -> \"polarized-sidis-real-reduction-extension-v1\""->
  "\"Schema\" -> \"polarized-sidis-real-reduction-subset-v1\"",
  "complete actual spin-target coverage"->"complete supplied component13 target coverage"}]];
 marker="\nput[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, \"s08_reduction.wl\"}]];";
 readyChange[changed,{marker->
  "\nresult=Join[result,<|\"SubsetDispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[readySource,\"SHA256\"],\"ChannelCoverageComplete\"->!readyOnly,\"SelectedComponentIndices\"->If[readyOnly,map[\"SelectedComponentIndices\"],All],\"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},\"MappingInputHashes\"->map[\"InputHashes\"],\"AcceptedSubsetReductionHash\"->readySubsetHash,\"AcceptedSubsetReceiptHash\"->readySubsetReceiptHash,\"AcceptedSubsetOverlapCount\"->readyOverlapCount|>];"<>marker}]];
readyText=Import[readyBase,"Text"];
readyRun=readyChange[readyText,{
 "ToExpression[reusePrefixCandidate,InputForm];"->"ToExpression[readyPrefix[reusePrefixCandidate],InputForm];",
 "ToExpression[reuseSuffixCandidate,InputForm];"->"ToExpression[readySuffix[reuseSuffixCandidate],InputForm];"}];
ToExpression[readyRun,InputForm];
```

```wolfram
$HistoryLength = 0;
extensionDispatch = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_extend_pair_reduction.wls"}];

extensionSourceEntry = "\nmapperSource = SelectFirst[mapperSources,";
extensionExportEntry = "\nput[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, \"s08_reduction.wl\"}]];";
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[extensionDispatch, "Text"]] ||
  StringCount[extensionText, extensionSourceEntry] =!= 1 ||

extensionText = StringReplace[extensionText, {
  extensionSourceEntry -> ("\nAppendTo[mapperSources, FileNameJoin[{root, \"common\", \"s08_assemble_quark_pair_targets.wls\"}]];" <> extensionSourceEntry),
  extensionExportEntry -> ("\nresult=Join[result,<|\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[extensionDispatch,\"SHA256\"]|>];" <> extensionExportEntry)}];
```
