## common/s08_extend_real_reduction.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-222", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 14080, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_extend_real_reduction.wls", "sha256": "db9875bb42086b9e52a405bc61b46262661cf91b72681dc57c22c977121a22e7"} -->
```wolfram
(* Extend the actual polarized cut targets with the unchanged GitHub S04 workflow. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[]; checks = <||>;
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_extend_real_reduction.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  gate["time bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"]; RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
mapPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_targets_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_extension_inputs.json"}];
map = Get[mapPath]; library = Get[libraryPath]; settings = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete real target map", map["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-real-target-map-v1" &&
  map["Channel"] === channel && TrueQ[map["MappingAccepted"]] && And @@ Values[map["Checks"]]];
gate["accepted unchanged scalar library", library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
gate["known real extension configuration", settings["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-real-extension-inputs-v1"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{path, hash}, gate["mapped physical input " <> path,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, path}], "SHA256"] === hash]], map["InputHashes"]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
geometry = readLibrary["s02"]; baseline = readLibrary["s04"];
gate["accepted cut geometry and original reduction", TrueQ[geometry["Accepted"]] && TrueQ[baseline["Accepted"]]];
gate["original positive-energy support", baseline["CutEnergyConditions"] === geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]];
originalSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "reference", "sources", "s04_reduce_real.wl"}];
mapperSources = {FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_real_targets.wls"}],
  FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_grouped_real_targets.wls"}],
  FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_certified_group_targets.wls"}],
  FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_assemble_verified_targets.wls"}],
  FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_targets_by_denominator.wls"}],
  FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_result", "reference", "s08_map_real_targets_before_memory_resume.wls"}]};
mapperSource = SelectFirst[mapperSources,
  FileExistsQ[#] && FileHash[#, "SHA256"] === map["SourceHash"] &, Missing["UnboundMapperSource"]];
gate["exact executed target-mapping source retained", StringQ[mapperSource]];
previousMapperSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_result", "reference", "s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}];
gate["original reduction source binding", baseline["SourceHash"] === FileHash[originalSource, "SHA256"]];
gate["accepted target-mapping source binding", map["SourceHash"] === FileHash[mapperSource, "SHA256"] &&
  map["MapperSourceHash"] === FileHash[previousMapperSource, "SHA256"]];
targets = Union[baseline["Targets"], First /@ baseline["Rules"], baseline["Masters"], map["Targets"]];
names = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[targets[[All, 1]]]];
gate["every requested target has an inherited cut family", Complement[names, Keys[geometry["Families"]]] === {}];
families = KeyTake[geometry["Families"], names];
gate["all new spin targets requested", Complement[map["Targets"], targets] === {}];
kira = settings["kira"]["path"]; fermat = settings["fermat"]["path"];
Do[gate["reviewed executable " <> name, IntegerString[FileHash[settings[name]["path"], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === settings[name]["sha256"]],
  {name, {"kira", "fermat"}}];
SetEnvironment["FERMATPATH" -> fermat];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = Join[{mapPath, libraryPath, configPath, originalSource, mapperSource, previousMapperSource},
  (FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"][#]["File"]}] &) /@ {"s02", "s04"}];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
work = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_extension", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
config = FileNameJoin[{work, "config"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[config], CreateDirectory[config, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
originalText = Import[originalSource, "Text"]; ownText = Import[sourcePath, "Text"];
originalBlock = StringTake[originalText, {First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "text[expression_] :="]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "resultFile = FileNameJoin"]]] - 1}];
ownBlock = StringTake[ownText, {Last[First[StringPosition[ownText, "\n(* BEGIN REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n"]]] + 1,
  First[First[StringPosition[ownText, "\n(* END REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n"]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged complete real Kira configuration and reader", StringTrim[originalBlock] === StringTrim[ownBlock]];
(* BEGIN REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)
text[expression_] := StringReplace[ToString[InputForm[expression]], Whitespace -> ""];
csv[list_] := "[" <> StringRiffle[text /@ list, ","] <> "]";
integralText[integral_] := integral[[1]] <> csv[integral[[2]]];
external = Take[geometry["BasisMomenta"], Length[geometry["BasisMomenta"]] -
  Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]] + 1];
externalGram = geometry["CommonGram"][[Range[Length[external]], Range[Length[external]]]];
invariants = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[externalGram,
  symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]]];
(* Fermat requires lower-case variable names. This is a name change only. *)
exportRules = {Q2 -> q2};
importRules = Reverse /@ exportRules;
gate["invariant rename is invertible", (invariants /. exportRules /. importRules) === invariants];
kinematics = {"kinematics:", "  incoming_momenta: " <> csv[external],
  "  outgoing_momenta: []", "  kinematic_invariants:"};
kinematics = Join[kinematics, ("    - [" <> text[# /. exportRules] <> ", 2]" & /@ invariants),
  {"  scalarproduct_rules:"}, Flatten[Table[
    "    - [[" <> text[external[[i]]] <> "," <> text[external[[j]]] <> "], " <>
      text[externalGram[[i, j]] /. exportRules] <> "]",
    {i, Length[external]}, {j, i, Length[external]}]]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "kinematics.yaml"}], StringRiffle[kinematics, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
familyLines = {"integralfamilies:"};
reductions = {};
preferred = {};
bounds = <||>;
Do[
  spec = families[name];
  actual = Select[targets, #[[1]] === name &][[All, 2]];
  positiveSums = Total[Select[#, # > 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  negativeSums = -Total[Select[#, # < 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  sectors = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Total[MapIndexed[
    If[#1 > 0, 2^(First[#2] - 1), 0] &, #]] & /@ actual]];
  topSectors = Select[sectors, Function[sector, !AnyTrue[DeleteCases[sectors, sector],
    BitAnd[sector, #] === sector &]]];
  rBound = Max[positiveSums] + Length[spec["LoopMomenta"]];
  sBound = Max[negativeSums];
  AssociateTo[bounds, name -> <|"r" -> rBound, "s" -> sBound,
    "Sectors" -> sectors, "TopSectors" -> topSectors, "TargetCount" -> Length[actual]|>];
  familyLines = Join[familyLines, {"  - name: " <> name,
    "    loop_momenta: " <> csv[spec["LoopMomenta"]],
    "    top_level_sectors: " <> csv[topSectors], "    propagators:"},
    MapThread["      - [\"" <> text[#1] <> "\", " <> text[#2] <> "]" &,
      {spec["PropagatorMomenta"], spec["PropagatorMassesSquared"]}],
    {"    cut_propagators: " <> csv[spec["CutPositions"]]}];
  AppendTo[reductions, "        - {topologies: [" <> name <> "], sectors: " <>
    csv[topSectors] <> ", r: " <> text[rBound] <> ", s: " <> text[sBound] <> "}"];
  preferred = Join[preferred, Table[CutIntegral[name,
    Table[If[MemberQ[spec["CutPositions"], i] || MemberQ[support, i], 1, 0],
      {i, Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]}]],
    {support, Subsets[Complement[Range[Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]], spec["CutPositions"]]]}]],
  {name, names}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "integralfamilies.yaml"}], StringRiffle[familyLines, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "targets"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ targets, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "preferred"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ preferred, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
jobs = Join[{"jobs:", "  - reduce_sectors:", "      reduce:"}, reductions,
  {"      select_integrals:", "        select_mandatory_list:", "          - [targets]",
   "      preferred_masters: preferred", "      run_initiate: true",
   "      run_triangular: true", "      run_back_substitution: true",
   "  - kira2math:", "      target:", "        - [targets]"}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "jobs.yaml"}], StringRiffle[jobs, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
put[<|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "Bounds" -> bounds,
  "Families" -> families, "Targets" -> targets, "PreferredCandidates" -> preferred,
  "ExportRules" -> exportRules, "ImportRules" -> importRules,
  "CutEnergyConditions" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]|>, FileNameJoin[{work, "s04_configuration.wl"}]];
Print["KIRA_START ", work, " target count ", Length[targets], " bounds ", InputForm[bounds]];
run = RunProcess[{kira, "--parallel=2", "jobs.yaml"}, All, ProcessDirectory -> work];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s04_kira_stdout.log"}], run["StandardOutput"], "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s04_kira_stderr.log"}], run["StandardError"], "Text"];
Print[StringTake[run["StandardOutput"], -Min[12000, StringLength[run["StandardOutput"]]]]];
If[run["StandardError"] =!= "", Print[run["StandardError"]]];
gate["Kira completed", run["ExitCode"] === 0];
ruleFiles = Sort[FileNames["kira_*.m", FileNameJoin[{work, "results"}], Infinity]];
gate["Kira exported symbolic rules", Length[ruleFiles] > 0];
rules = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ ruleFiles]];
gate["Kira output consists of rules", MatchQ[rules, {__Rule}]];
heads = Symbol /@ names;
toCut[expression_] := expression /. (HoldPattern[h_[indices__Integer]] /; MemberQ[heads, h]) :>
  CutIntegral[SymbolName[h], {indices}];
masterFile = FileNameJoin[{work, "tmp", Last[names], "masters"}];
gate["final Kira master inventory exists", FileExistsQ[masterFile]];
declaredMasters = toCut[ToExpression /@ StringCases[Import[masterFile, "Text"],
  RegularExpression["R[0-9]+\\[[0-9, -]+\\]"]]];
gate["nonempty final Kira master inventory", MatchQ[declaredMasters, {__CutIntegral}]];
rules = toCut[rules] /. importRules /. d -> D;
missingTargets = Complement[targets, First /@ rules];
gate["targets without explicit rules are declared masters",
  Complement[missingTargets, declaredMasters] === {}];
rules = Join[rules, (# -> # & /@ missingTargets)];
gate["each target has a reduction rule", Complement[targets, First /@ rules] === {}];
gate["rules have unique targets", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ rules]];
masters = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules, _CutIntegral, Infinity]]];
gate["every rule ends in Kira's final master inventory",
  Complement[masters, declaredMasters] === {}];
gate["both cut propagators survive in every master", And @@
  (And @@ (# > 0 & /@ #[[2, families[#[[1]]]["CutPositions"]]]) & /@ masters)];
gate["rule coefficients are rational in symbolic dimension and invariants",
  FreeQ[rules, _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];

(* END REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)
gate["unchanged complete original cut-master basis", Sort[masters] === Sort[baseline["Masters"]]];
Do[gate["original Kira rule " <> ToString[First[row], InputForm],
  bounded[zero[(First[row] /. rules) - Last[row]], {"original cut-rule comparison", First[row]}]], {row, baseline["Rules"]}];
gate["complete actual spin-target coverage", Complement[map["Targets"], First /@ rules] === {}];
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_reduction_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-reduction-extension-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Rules" -> rules, "Masters" -> masters, "Targets" -> targets, "AdditionalTargets" -> map["MissingTargets"],
  "Bounds" -> bounds, "Families" -> families, "CutEnergyConditions" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "GeometryHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s02"]["File"]}], "SHA256"],
  "BaselineReductionHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]}], "SHA256"],
  "MappingArtifactHash" -> FileHash[mapPath, "SHA256"],
  "KiraHash" -> FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], "FermatHash" -> FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"],
  "WorkDirectory" -> work, "RuleFiles" -> ruleFiles, "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True,
  "MasterEvaluationPerformed" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s08_reduction.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "additional_target_count" -> Length[map["MissingTargets"]], "target_count" -> Length[targets],
  "missing_target_count" -> Length[Complement[map["Targets"], First /@ rules]],
  "master_count" -> Length[masters], "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_extend_real_reduction"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s08_extend_reused_real_reduction.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-223", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7400, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_extend_reused_real_reduction.wls", "sha256": "d5671f76872bc66bbaf3142507e6d919db3205bdbba3845c5cf5311f450c8e22"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve the reference Kira workflow and reuse accepted covered targets. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
reuseSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_extend_reused_real_reduction.wls"}];
reuseBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_extend_real_reduction.wls"}];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[reuseSource,"Text"]]||IntegerString[FileHash[reuseBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "db9875bb42086b9e52a405bc61b46262661cf91b72681dc57c22c977121a22e7",Quit[1]];
reuseControl=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_REDUCTION_REUSE_CONTROL"]==="1";
reuseSetup[]:=Module[{relative,path,receipt,collector},
 relative="Hgg/s08_compatible_reductions_result/s08_result.wl";path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
 reuseReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s08_execution.json"}];
 receipt=Import[reuseReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted compatible-rule execution",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 reuseProof=Get[path];collector=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_collect_compatible_reductions.wls"}];
 gate["same complete compatible-rule library",reuseProof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-compatible-cut-reductions-v1"&&
  TrueQ[reuseProof["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[reuseProof["OwnComparisonPassed"]]&&And@@Values[reuseProof["Checks"]]&&
  reuseProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[collector,"SHA256"]&&reuseProof["OriginalExtensionSourceHash"]===FileHash[reuseBase,"SHA256"]&&
  reuseProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
  reuseProof["GeometryHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,library["Library"]["s02"]["File"]}],"SHA256"]&&
  reuseProof["BaselineReductionHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]}],"SHA256"]&&
  Sort[reuseProof["Masters"]]===Sort[baseline["Masters"]]&&reuseProof["Families"]===geometry["Families"]&&
  reuseProof["CutEnergyConditions"]===geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]];
 KeyValueMap[gate["unchanged compatible-rule input "<>#1,FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"]===#2]&,
  reuseProof["InputHashes"]];
 reusePath=path;reuseRuleMap=Association[reuseProof["Rules"]];
 gate["unique accepted reusable rule keys",Length[reuseRuleMap]===Length[reuseProof["Rules"]]];
 inputPaths=Join[inputPaths,{reuseSource,path,reuseReceiptPath,collector}]];
reuseText=Import[reuseBase,"Text"];
reuseBegin="\n(* BEGIN REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n";reuseEnd="\n(* END REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n";
```

## common/s08_extract_mapping_inputs.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-227", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10422, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_extract_mapping_inputs.wls", "sha256": "2b02e77744b7792dfcd365a1dc0bd1b46a7ee4fbae0acbe2f68a86a075561031"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve exact pending mapping equations for bounded native continuation. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
extractRoot=Directory[];extractChannel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
extractSource=FileNameJoin[{extractRoot,"common","s08_extract_mapping_inputs.wls"}];
If[!MemberQ[{"Hqg","Hgg"},extractChannel]||!SyntaxQ[Import[extractSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
checks=<||>;
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
extractSameGeometry[left_Association,right_Association]:=Keys[left]===Keys[right]&&And@@KeyValueMap[extractSameGeometry[#2,right[#1]]&,left];
extractSameGeometry[left_List,right_List]:=Length[left]===Length[right]&&And@@MapThread[extractSameGeometry,{left,right}];
extractSameGeometry[left_Rule,right_Rule]:=First[left]===First[right]&&extractSameGeometry[Last[left],Last[right]];
extractSameGeometry[left_,right_]:=left===right||(FreeQ[{left,right},_String|_Association|_Rule|_List,{1,Infinity}]&&Factor[Together[left-right]]===0);
extractWrite[value_,path_]:=Module[{serialized,loaded,changed,normalized},
 serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[value],InputForm]<>"]\n";
 gate["bounded native equation file",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];
 Export[path<>".write.tmp",serialized,"Text"];loaded=Get[path<>".write.tmp"];
 gate["complete saved record keys",AssociationQ[loaded]&&Keys[loaded]===Keys[value]];
 changed=Select[Keys[value],value[#]=!=loaded[#]&];Print["RELOAD_CHANGED_FIELDS ",InputForm[changed]];
 gate["exact saved equation and nongeometry fields",KeyDrop[loaded,{"Families","Geometry"}]===KeyDrop[value,{"Families","Geometry"}]];
 gate["exact saved family geometry",extractSameGeometry[loaded["Families"],value["Families"]]&&extractSameGeometry[loaded["Geometry"],value["Geometry"]]];
 normalized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[loaded],InputForm]<>"]\n";
 gate["bounded normalized native record",StringLength[normalized]<128*1024^2];
 Export[path<>".write.tmp",normalized,"Text"];
 gate["entire normalized record reloads exactly",Get[path<>".write.tmp"]===loaded];
 RenameFile[path<>".write.tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True]];
extractReadable[value_,path_]:=Module[{readable},
 readable=ToString[value,InputForm,PageWidth->120];
 gate["bounded complete readable equation",StringLength[readable]<128*1024^2];
 Export[path,readable,"Text"]];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_RECOVER_INPUT"]==="1",
 gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]&&StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,extractRoot<>"/"]];
 PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;$LoadAddOns={"FeynArts"};Get["FeynCalc`"];
 extractDirectory=FileNameJoin[{extractRoot,extractChannel,"s08_mapping_inputs_result"}];
 extractIndex=If[extractChannel==="Hqg",4,8];
 extractPath=FileNameJoin[{extractDirectory,"s08_component_"<>IntegerString[extractIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}];
```

## common/s08_grouped_mapping_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-229", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9358, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_grouped_mapping_check.wls", "sha256": "4d4f1e8f169dc521809dd37d1f7a704e21759a27ddd478befe1caa171d15bce6"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve the reference cut mapper and map the measured denominator groups separately. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
groupRoot = Directory[];
groupSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{groupRoot, "common", "s08_grouped_mapping_check.wls"}];
groupMapperPath = FileNameJoin[{groupRoot, "common", "s08_map_real_targets.wls"}];
groupAssert[name_, test_] := If[!TrueQ[test], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
groupAssert["grouped comparison source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[groupSourcePath, "Text"]]];
groupAssert["reviewed unchanged target mapper", IntegerString[FileHash[groupMapperPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "8700fb675c4a0196d1a6f7aa7d1710e25a9210b0de85bd902990e2e7589772a9"];
groupMapperText = Import[groupMapperPath, "Text"];
groupBoundary = StringPosition[groupMapperText, "\nmapTargetTask[index_]"];
groupAssert["unique inherited mapping boundary", Length[groupBoundary] === 1];
groupPrefix = StringTake[groupMapperText, First[First[groupBoundary]] - 1];
groupAssert["complete inherited mapping initialization", SyntaxQ[groupPrefix]];
ToExpression[groupPrefix, InputForm];
gate["group comparison owns inspected channel", channel === "Hqqbar"];
groupInspectionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_equation_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
gate["pinned actual equation inspection", IntegerString[FileHash[groupInspectionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "1b22fb16c047be46bd56fa9988873eb4c0e8cd526bd939ca8a5ec3e93d5c6a64"];
groupInspection = Get[groupInspectionPath];
gate["accepted input equation reconstruction", groupInspection["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-mapping-equation-inspection-v1" &&
  groupInspection["Channel"] === channel && groupInspection["InputHashes"] === inputHashes &&
  groupInspection["MappingInputHash"] === targetInputHash && And @@ Values[groupInspection["Checks"]] &&
  And @@ Lookup[groupInspection["Measurements"], "ExactReconstruction"]];
groupCalculationHash = FileHash[groupSourcePath, "SHA256"];
groupInputHash = Hash[{groupCalculationHash, inputHashes, targetInputHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
groupCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_grouped_check", channel, IntegerString[groupInputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[groupCache], CreateDirectory[groupCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];

groupDenominators[expression_] := Module[{terms, atoms, groups, reconstructed},
  terms = If[Head[expression] === Plus, List @@ expression, {expression}];
  gate["complete additive input reconstruction", Total[terms] === expression];
  atoms = extractAtoms /@ terms;
  groups = GroupBy[atoms, First -> Last, Total];
  reconstructed = Total[KeyValueMap[#2/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, #1}]) &, groups]];
  gate["complete denominator-group reconstruction", zero[expression - reconstructed]];
  groups];

(* The reconstruction uses the exact measured propagators and cut powers of the reference mapper. *)
groupedMapExpression[expression_, key_] := Module[
  {groups, groupValues, packets, binding, path, saved, seconds, coefficients, rows, reconstruction},
  groups = bounded[groupDenominators[expression], {key, "derive denominator groups"}];
  groupValues = KeyValueMap[#2/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, #1}]) &, groups];
  Print["GROUPED_MAP_INPUT ", key, " groups ", Length[groupValues], " bytes ", ByteCount[expression]];
  packets = Table[
    binding = Hash[{groupInputHash, key, index, groupValues[[index]]}, "SHA256"];
    path = FileNameJoin[{groupCache, key <> "_group_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}];
    saved = If[FileExistsQ[path], Get[path], <||>];
    If[Lookup[saved, "Binding", None] =!= binding || !TrueQ[Lookup[saved, "Accepted", False]] ||
        !AssociationQ[Lookup[saved, "Checks", None]] || Length[saved["Checks"]] === 0 || !And @@ Values[saved["Checks"]],
      Print["GROUPED_MAP_PIECE ", key, " ", index, "/", Length[groupValues], " powers ", Keys[groups][[index]]];
      saved = Block[{checks = <||>},
        {seconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[groupValues[[index]]], {key, index, "unchanged reference mapping"}]];
        <|"Binding" -> binding, "Accepted" -> True, "Coefficients" -> coefficients, "Checks" -> checks,
          "Seconds" -> seconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[groupValues[[index]]]|>];
      put[saved, path]; ClearSystemCache[]]; saved,
    {index, Length[groupValues]}];
  gate["every denominator group accepted", AllTrue[packets, AssociationQ] && And @@ Lookup[packets, "Accepted"] &&
    And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ packets]];
  rows = bounded[merge[Lookup[packets, "Coefficients"]], {key, "merge exact group maps"}];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["complete grouped cut-family map reconstructs input", bounded[zero[reconstruction - expression], {key, "complete map reconstruction"}]];
  gate["both physical cuts remain to unit power in every grouped target",
    And @@ (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[rows])];
  rows];

groupControlExpression = targetControlTask["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
groupControlPacket = Block[{checks = <||>},
  {groupControlSeconds, groupControlCoefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[
    groupedMapExpression[groupControlExpression, "accepted_control"]];
  groupReferenceExpression = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], targetFixture["Coefficients"]]];
  groupCandidateExpression = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], groupControlCoefficients]];
  gate["complete own accepted control map comparison",
    bounded[zero[groupCandidateExpression - groupReferenceExpression], "own accepted control map comparison"]];
  <|"Seconds" -> groupControlSeconds, "Coefficients" -> groupControlCoefficients,
    "ReferenceHash" -> FileHash[targetFixturePath, "SHA256"],
    "IdenticalRawMap" -> (groupControlCoefficients === targetFixture["Coefficients"]), "Checks" -> checks|>];
gate["accepted control comparison completed", And @@ Values[groupControlPacket["Checks"]]];
Print["GROUPED_MAP_CONTROL seconds ", groupControlSeconds, " identical_raw_map ", groupControlPacket["IdenticalRawMap"]];
groupComponents = Table[Block[{checks = <||>},
  groupTask = tasks[[groupIndex]];
  groupExpression = groupTask["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
  gate["actual inspected component identity", groupExpression === groupInspection["Equations"][groupIndex]["OriginalValue"]];
  {groupSeconds, groupCoefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[groupedMapExpression[groupExpression, "component_" <> ToString[groupIndex]]];
  groupComponent = Join[KeyDrop[groupTask, "Value"], <|"ComponentIndex" -> groupIndex,
    "Coefficients" -> groupCoefficients, "MissingTargets" -> Complement[Keys[groupCoefficients], ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]],
    "InputHash" -> targetInputHash, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True, "Checks" -> checks,
    "Seconds" -> groupSeconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[groupTask["Value"]], "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[groupCoefficients]|>];
  Print["GROUPED_MAP_COMPONENT_ACCEPTED ", groupIndex, " seconds ", groupSeconds,
    " targets ", Length[groupCoefficients], " bytes ", ByteCount[groupCoefficients]];
  groupComponent], {groupIndex, Keys[groupInspection["Equations"]]}];
gate["every inspected component accepted", And @@ Lookup[groupComponents, "ReconstructionPassed"] &&
  And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ groupComponents]];
groupResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-grouped-mapping-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> groupCalculationHash, "MapperSourceHash" -> FileHash[groupMapperPath, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> groupInputHash, "MappingInputHash" -> targetInputHash,
  "InspectionHash" -> FileHash[groupInspectionPath, "SHA256"], "ControlComparison" -> groupControlPacket,
  "Components" -> groupComponents, "GroupingDefinitions" -> DownValues[groupDenominators],
  "MappingDefinitions" -> DownValues[groupedMapExpression], "OriginalMappingDefinitions" -> DownValues[mapExpression],
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
groupResultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_grouped_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[groupResultDir], CreateDirectory[groupResultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
groupResultPath = FileNameJoin[{groupResultDir, "s08_result.wl"}];
groupSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[groupResult], "group comparison compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["group comparison saved-file bound", StringLength[groupSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[groupResultPath <> ".tmp", groupSerialized, "Text"];
gate["group comparison exact saved round trip", bounded[Get[groupResultPath <> ".tmp"] === groupResult, "group comparison reload"]];
RenameFile[groupResultPath <> ".tmp", groupResultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{groupResultDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_grouped_mapping_check"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s08_inspect_group_map.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-231", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6912, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_inspect_group_map.wls", "sha256": "3fe02e959b09fe512ca70fe829670d8500d08c7d7b6cfa7e037a6bada0064ae1"} -->
```wolfram
(* Read and time the actual reference mapping operations in the stalled groups. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
inspectionSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_inspect_group_map.wls"}];
inspectionBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_map_certified_group_targets.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "f38a83d6b7080e4acbd9919f05a38ce602800f445e3bd594263f18bb8e4a091c",Quit[1]];
inspectionBaseText=Import[inspectionBase,"Text"];
If[StringCount[inspectionBaseText,"\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]=!=1||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[inspectionSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
inspectionPrefix=First[StringSplit[inspectionBaseText,"\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]];
If[!SyntaxQ[inspectionPrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[inspectionPrefix,InputForm];
originalMapDefinitions=DownValues[mapExpression];
originalFamilyDefinitions=DownValues[familyRows];
gate["unique original mapping definition boundaries",
  StringCount[targetMapperText,"\nmerge[pieces_List] :="]===1&&
  StringCount[targetMapperText,"\n\ncoefficientPath ="]===1];
inspectionOriginal=StringTake[targetMapperText,{
  First[First[StringPosition[targetMapperText,"\nmerge[pieces_List] :="]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[targetMapperText,"\n\ncoefficientPath ="]]]-1}];
gate["original mapping definition syntax",SyntaxQ[inspectionOriginal]];
inspectionReplacements={
  "{powers, prefactor} = extractAtoms[expression];" ->
    "{powers, prefactor} = inspectOperation[\"extract atoms\",expression,extractAtoms[expression]];",
  "decomposition = decompose[powers];" ->
    "decomposition = inspectOperation[\"partial fractions\",powers,decompose[powers]];",
  "value = Cancel[prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, indices}])];" ->
    "value = inspectOperation[\"family input cancellation\",prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power,{denominators,indices}]),Cancel[prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power,{denominators,indices}])]];",
  "transformed = Together[expression /. spec[\"UncutCoordinateRules\"]];" ->
    "transformed = inspectOperation[\"family coordinates Together\",expression /. spec[\"UncutCoordinateRules\"],Together[expression /. spec[\"UncutCoordinateRules\"]]];",
  "numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]];" ->
    "numerator = inspectOperation[\"family numerator expansion\",Numerator[transformed],Expand[Numerator[transformed]]];",
  "denominator = Factor[Denominator[transformed]];" ->
    "denominator = inspectOperation[\"family denominator factor\",Denominator[transformed],Factor[Denominator[transformed]]];",
  "polynomial = CoefficientRules[numerator, {v3, v4}];" ->
    "polynomial = inspectOperation[\"family polynomial coefficients\",numerator,CoefficientRules[numerator,{v3,v4}]];",
  "Factor[Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"family coefficient factor\",Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient,Factor[Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient]]",
  "zero[reconstruction - transformed]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"family reconstruction\",reconstruction-transformed,zero[reconstruction-transformed]]",
  "rows = merge[pieces];" ->
    "rows = inspectOperation[\"merge family maps\",pieces,merge[pieces]];",
  "zero[reconstruction - expression]" ->
    "inspectOperation[\"complete map reconstruction\",reconstruction-expression,zero[reconstruction-expression]]"};
gate["unique reference operation instrumentation",And@@(StringCount[inspectionOriginal,First[#]]===1&/@inspectionReplacements)];
inspectionInstrumented=StringReplace[inspectionOriginal,inspectionReplacements];
gate["all original mapping equations and gates preserved",
  StringReplace[inspectionInstrumented,Reverse/@inspectionReplacements]===inspectionOriginal];
gate["instrumented mapping syntax",SyntaxQ[inspectionInstrumented]];
SetAttributes[inspectOperation,HoldRest];
inspectOperation[name_,input_,expression_] := Module[{actual=input,seconds,answer},
  Print["MAP_NATIVE_BEGIN ",name," bytes ",ByteCount[actual]];
  {seconds,answer}=AbsoluteTiming[TimeConstrained[MemoryConstrained[expression,4*1024^3,
    Missing["MemoryBound"]],120,Missing["TimeBound"]]];
  AppendTo[inspectionMeasurements,<|"Operation"->name,"Seconds"->seconds,
    "InputBytes"->ByteCount[actual],"OutputBytes"->ByteCount[answer],
    "Status"->If[MissingQ[answer],answer,"Completed"]|>];
  Print["MAP_NATIVE_END ",InputForm[Last[inspectionMeasurements]]];
  If[MissingQ[answer],inspectionFailedInput=actual;
    Throw[KeyTake[Last[inspectionMeasurements],{"Operation","Status"}],"MapInspection"]];answer];
ToExpression[inspectionInstrumented,InputForm];
inspectionRows=Table[
  inspectionMeasurements={};inspectionFailedInput=Missing["NoBoundReached"];
  task=tasks[[index]];equation=task["Value"]/.coordinateRules;
  groups=bounded[groupDenominators[equation],{index,"accepted grouping"}];
  groupEquation=First[KeyValueMap[#2/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,#1}])&,groups]];
  Print["ACTUAL_MAP_GROUP ",index," task ",KeyDrop[task,"Value"]," powers ",First[Keys[groups]],
    " bytes ",ByteCount[groupEquation]];
  outcome=Catch[<|"Status"->"Completed","Coefficients"->mapExpression[groupEquation]|>,"MapInspection"];
  <|"ComponentIndex"->index,"Task"->KeyDrop[task,"Value"],"GroupIndex"->1,
    "Powers"->First[Keys[groups]],"Equation"->groupEquation,"OperationInput"->inspectionFailedInput,
    "Outcome"->outcome,"Measurements"->inspectionMeasurements|>,{index,{25,26}}];
inspectionResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-group-map-inspection-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[inspectionSource,"SHA256"],"BaseSourceHash"->FileHash[inspectionBase,"SHA256"],
  "InputHashes"->inputHashes,"TargetInputHash"->targetInputHash,"MappingInputHash"->inputHash,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"OriginalMappingCode"->inspectionOriginal,
  "OriginalMappingDefinitions"->originalMapDefinitions,"OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->originalFamilyDefinitions,
  "Rows"->inspectionRows,"Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
inspectionDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_map_equation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[inspectionDir],CreateDirectory[inspectionDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
inspectionOutput=FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir,"s08_result.wl"}];
inspectionSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[inspectionResult],"inspection compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["inspection file bound",StringLength[inspectionSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[inspectionOutput<>".tmp",inspectionSerialized,"Text"];
gate["inspection exact native reload",Get[inspectionOutput<>".tmp"]===inspectionResult];
RenameFile[inspectionOutput<>".tmp",inspectionOutput,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "rows"->(ToString[KeyDrop[#,{"Equation","OperationInput"}],InputForm]&/@inspectionRows),
  "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_inspect_group_map"];Quit[0];

```

<a id="source-232"></a>

## common/s08_inspect_grouping_equation.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-232", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5844, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_inspect_grouping_equation.wls", "sha256": "c8b300a59efd7290a72a9420be5e7aa32e8cf792dd3a24d2ba5ea1af88f7d0ea"} -->
```wolfram
(* Capture the native denominator-grouping bottleneck without changing its algebra. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
inspectionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_inspect_grouping_equation.wls"}];
mapperPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_real_targets.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[mapperPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "8700fb675c4a0196d1a6f7aa7d1710e25a9210b0de85bd902990e2e7589772a9",
  Print["FAIL: unchanged grouping-inspection mapper"]; Quit[1]];
mapperText = Import[mapperPath, "Text"];
boundary = First[First[StringPosition[mapperText, "\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]]];
prefix = StringTake[mapperText, boundary - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix], Print["FAIL: complete mapping initialization syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[prefix];
gate["complete grouping-inspection syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[inspectionPath, "Text"]]];
gate["grouping inspection channel", channel === "Hqqbar"];
proofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_grouped_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
gate["pinned accepted grouping proof", IntegerString[FileHash[proofPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "fc69dbab36b65068fde2e89a25ae05a4ac4f166a84bdf03dfde712a93aa66ed0"];
proof = Get[proofPath];
gate["grouping proof shares native inputs", proof["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && And @@ Values[proof["Checks"]]];
source = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_grouped_mapping_check.wls"}];
gate["grouping proof source binding", FileHash[source, "SHA256"] === proof["SourceHash"]];
text = Import[source, "Text"];
begin = First[First[StringPosition[text, "groupDenominators[expression_] :="]]];
end = First[First[StringPosition[text, "\n(* The reconstruction uses"]]];
groupCode = StringTake[text, {begin, end - 1}];
ToExpression[groupCode];
gate["exact original grouping definitions", DownValues[groupDenominators] === proof["GroupingDefinitions"]];
measurements = {}; lastInput = Missing["NoOperation"];
SetAttributes[inspectGroupingOperation, HoldRest];
inspectGroupingOperation[name_, input_, expression_] := Module[{seconds, answer},
  lastInput = input;
  Print["GROUP_NATIVE_BEGIN ", name, " bytes ", ByteCount[lastInput]];
  {seconds, answer} = AbsoluteTiming[TimeConstrained[MemoryConstrained[expression, 4*1024^3,
    Missing["OperationMemoryLimit"]], 180, Missing["OperationTimeLimit"]]];
  AppendTo[measurements, <|"Operation" -> name, "Seconds" -> seconds,
    "Status" -> If[MissingQ[answer], answer, "Completed"], "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[lastInput],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[answer], "MemoryBytes" -> MemoryInUse[]|>];
  Print["GROUP_NATIVE_END ", InputForm[Last[measurements]]];
  If[MissingQ[answer], Throw[KeyTake[Last[measurements], {"Operation", "Status"}], "GroupInspection"]]; answer];
replacements = {
  "atoms = extractAtoms /@ terms;" ->
    "atoms = MapIndexed[inspectGroupingOperation[\"extract term \" <> ToString[First[#2]], #1, extractAtoms[#1]] &, terms];",
  "groups = GroupBy[atoms, First -> Last, Total];" ->
    "groups = inspectGroupingOperation[\"group native atoms\", atoms, GroupBy[atoms, First -> Last, Total]];",
  "zero[expression - reconstructed]" ->
    "inspectGroupingOperation[\"complete group reconstruction\", expression - reconstructed, zero[expression - reconstructed]]"};
gate["unique grouping instrumentation", And @@ (StringCount[groupCode, First[#]] === 1 & /@ replacements)];
instrumentedCode = StringReplace[groupCode, replacements];
gate["complete grouping algebra and checks unchanged", StringReplace[instrumentedCode, Reverse /@ replacements] === groupCode];
gate["complete instrumented grouping syntax", SyntaxQ[instrumentedCode]];
ToExpression[instrumentedCode];
index = 4; task = tasks[[index]]; equation = task["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
inventory = <|"Component" -> index, "Task" -> KeyDrop[task, "Value"], "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[equation],
  "InputLeaves" -> LeafCount[equation], "Head" -> ToString[Head[equation], InputForm],
  "AdditiveTerms" -> If[Head[equation] === Plus, Length[equation], 1]|>;
Print["ACTUAL_GROUP_EQUATION ", InputForm[inventory]];
outcome = Catch[TimeConstrained[<|"Status" -> "GroupingCompleted", "Groups" -> groupDenominators[equation]|>,
  2400, <|"Status" -> "InspectionTimeLimit"|>], "GroupInspection"];
gate["captured actual grouping input", !MissingQ[lastInput]];
```

```wolfram
(* Inspect the actual timed-out mapping inputs with the unchanged native mapper. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;

inspectionAssert[name_, test_] := If[!TrueQ[test], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
inspectionAssert["inspection source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[inspectionPath, "Text"]]];
inspectionAssert["reviewed target mapper", IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionMapperPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "8700fb675c4a0196d1a6f7aa7d1710e25a9210b0de85bd902990e2e7589772a9"];
inspectionMapperText = Import[inspectionMapperPath, "Text"];
inspectionBoundary = StringPosition[inspectionMapperText, "\nmapTargetTask[index_]"];
inspectionAssert["unique mapping initialization boundary", Length[inspectionBoundary] === 1];
inspectionPrefix = StringTake[inspectionMapperText, First[First[inspectionBoundary]] - 1];
inspectionAssert["complete inherited mapping initialization", SyntaxQ[inspectionPrefix]];
ToExpression[inspectionPrefix, InputForm];
gate["inspection owns timed-out channel", channel === "Hqqbar"];
inspectionRows = {};
inspectionEquations = <||>;
Do[
  inspectionTask = tasks[[inspectionIndex]];
  inspectionValue = inspectionTask["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
  inspectionTerms = If[Head[inspectionValue] === Plus, List @@ inspectionValue, {inspectionValue}];
  gate["original additive input reconstructs " <> ToString[inspectionIndex], Total[inspectionTerms] === inspectionValue];
  Print["MAPPING_INPUT_EQUATION ", InputForm[<|"Component" -> inspectionIndex,
    "Task" -> KeyDrop[inspectionTask, "Value"], "Bytes" -> ByteCount[inspectionValue],
    "Leaves" -> LeafCount[inspectionValue], "Head" -> Head[inspectionValue],
    "AdditiveTerms" -> Length[inspectionTerms]|>]];
  {inspectionWholeSeconds, inspectionWholeAtoms} = AbsoluteTiming[
    bounded[extractAtoms[inspectionValue], {inspectionIndex, "actual complete denominator"}]];
  Print["MAPPING_WHOLE_DENOMINATOR ", InputForm[<|"Component" -> inspectionIndex,
    "Powers" -> First[inspectionWholeAtoms], "NumeratorBytes" -> ByteCount[Last[inspectionWholeAtoms]],
    "Seconds" -> inspectionWholeSeconds|>]];
  {inspectionTermSeconds, inspectionAtoms} = AbsoluteTiming[
    bounded[extractAtoms /@ inspectionTerms, {inspectionIndex, "actual term denominators"}]];
  inspectionGroups = GroupBy[inspectionAtoms, First -> Last, Total];
  inspectionGroupedValue = Total[KeyValueMap[
    #2/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, #1}]) &, inspectionGroups]];
  {inspectionReconstructionSeconds, inspectionReconstructed} = AbsoluteTiming[
    bounded[zero[inspectionValue - inspectionGroupedValue], {inspectionIndex, "complete grouped reconstruction"}]];
  gate["complete grouped input reconstructs " <> ToString[inspectionIndex], inspectionReconstructed];
  inspectionRow = <|"Component" -> inspectionIndex, "Task" -> KeyDrop[inspectionTask, "Value"],
    "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[inspectionValue], "InputLeaves" -> LeafCount[inspectionValue],
    "AdditiveTerms" -> Length[inspectionTerms], "WholeDenominatorPowers" -> First[inspectionWholeAtoms],
    "WholeNumeratorBytes" -> ByteCount[Last[inspectionWholeAtoms]], "DenominatorGroups" -> Length[inspectionGroups],
    "GroupPowerInventory" -> Keys[inspectionGroups], "GroupNumeratorBytes" -> (ByteCount /@ Values[inspectionGroups]),
    "WholeExtractionSeconds" -> inspectionWholeSeconds, "TermExtractionSeconds" -> inspectionTermSeconds,
    "ReconstructionSeconds" -> inspectionReconstructionSeconds, "ExactReconstruction" -> inspectionReconstructed,
    "MemoryBytes" -> MemoryInUse[], "PeakMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
  AppendTo[inspectionRows, inspectionRow];
  AssociateTo[inspectionEquations, inspectionIndex -> <|"OriginalValue" -> inspectionValue,
    "WholeAtoms" -> inspectionWholeAtoms, "Groups" -> inspectionGroups|>];
  Print["MAPPING_EQUATION_MEASUREMENT ", InputForm[inspectionRow]];
  Clear[inspectionTask, inspectionValue, inspectionTerms, inspectionAtoms, inspectionGroups,
    inspectionGroupedValue, inspectionWholeAtoms]; ClearSystemCache[], {inspectionIndex, {1, 2}}];
inspectionResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-mapping-equation-inspection-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[inspectionPath, "SHA256"], "MapperSourceHash" -> FileHash[inspectionMapperPath, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "MappingInputHash" -> targetInputHash,
  "Denominators" -> denominators, "Measurements" -> inspectionRows, "Equations" -> inspectionEquations,
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
inspectionDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_equation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[inspectionDir], CreateDirectory[inspectionDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
inspectionResultPath = FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s08_result.wl"}];
inspectionSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[inspectionResult], "inspection compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["inspection saved-file bound", StringLength[inspectionSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[inspectionResultPath <> ".tmp", inspectionSerialized, "Text"];
gate["inspection exact saved round trip", bounded[Get[inspectionResultPath <> ".tmp"] === inspectionResult, "inspection reload"]];
RenameFile[inspectionResultPath <> ".tmp", inspectionResultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_inspect_mapping_equations"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
  hggOwnHash = FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, hggOwnFile}], "SHA256"];
  gate["accepted own native input comparison", TrueQ[hggOwnReceipt["passed"]] &&
    hggOwnReceipt["job_id"] === "14819865" &&
    hggOwnReceipt["result_sha256"][hggOwnFile] === IntegerString[hggOwnHash, 16, 64]];
  hggOwnPacket = bounded[Get[FileNameJoin[{root, hggOwnFile}]], "actual native response"];
  gate["own input comparison native versions", hggOwnPacket["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion} &&
    hggOwnPacket["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-complete-photon-spin-component-v1" &&
    And @@ Values[hggOwnPacket["Checks"]]];
  hggOwnMetadata = {}; hggOwnSources = {};
```

```wolfram
  ParallelTable[body,iterator,Method->"FinestGrained",DistributedContexts->"Global`"];

  HoldPattern[ParallelTable[body_,iterator_,Method->"FinestGrained",DistributedContexts->"Global`"]]:>Table[body,iterator])===original];
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse an accepted complete-response read comparison in the existing mapper. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
hggResponseAdapterPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_map_Hgg_response_inputs.wls"}];
hggResponseMode=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_COMPONENT_STAGE"];
If[!MemberQ[{"targets","coefficients"},hggResponseMode] ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[hggResponseAdapterPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
hggResponseBasePath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common",If[hggResponseMode==="targets",
  "s08_map_Hgg_grouped_inputs.wls","s08_map_Hgg_bounded_reads.wls"]}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[hggResponseBasePath,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=If[hggResponseMode==="targets",
  "08db7db98fe1d07b12742428ea2ea2ea544b86fee60668f529e643ef79753de8",
  "97360f5dc30672b79e763c3623c8761600bcbf58fb214825ee9eefd6f572d7e0"],Quit[1]];

hggResponseNativeGet[path_] := responseOnlyRead[path,FileHash[path,"SHA256"]];
hggResponseInstall[] := Module[{relative,proofPath,receiptPath,receipt,proof,original,candidate},
  relative="Hgg/s08_response_read_result/s08_result.wl";
  proofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
  receiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[proofPath],"s08_execution.json"}];
  receipt=Import[receiptPath,"RawJSON"];
  gate["accepted complete response-read comparison",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]] &&
    receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
  proof=Get[proofPath];
  gate["unchanged own response comparison inputs",proof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-response-only-native-read-v1" &&
    proof["Channel"]===channel && TrueQ[proof["OwnAcceptedComparison"]] && And@@Values[proof["Checks"]] &&
    proof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion} &&
    proof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_check_Hgg_response_read.wls"}],"SHA256"] &&
    proof["OwnHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,proof["OwnFile"]}],"SHA256"] &&
    proof["OwnReceiptHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,DirectoryName[proof["OwnFile"]],"s05_execution.json"}],"SHA256"] &&
    proof["OwnManifestHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,DirectoryName[proof["OwnFile"]],"s05_payload_manifest.json"}],"SHA256"] &&
    proof["StorageSourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
  DownValues[responseOnlyRead]=proof["ReaderDefinitions"];
  gate["exact accepted response reader installed",DownValues[responseOnlyRead]===proof["ReaderDefinitions"]];
  original=DownValues[hggTaskValue];candidate=original/.Get->hggResponseNativeGet;
  gate["only the native task read changes",Count[original,_Get,Infinity]===1 &&
    (candidate/.hggResponseNativeGet->Get)===original];
  DownValues[hggTaskValue]=candidate;
  gate["entire task and inventory contract retained",DownValues[hggTaskValue]===candidate];
  hggResponseEvidence=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[hggResponseAdapterPath,"SHA256"],
    "ComparisonHash"->FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],"ReceiptHash"->FileHash[receiptPath,"SHA256"],
    "OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"OriginalReadSeconds"->proof["OriginalReadSeconds"],
    "CandidateReadSeconds"->proof["CandidateReadSeconds"]|>;
  Print["S08_RESPONSE_READ_COMPARISON ",InputForm[hggResponseEvidence]]];
hggResponseConfigure[] := (
  hggRunText=hggReplace[hggRunText,"DistributeDefinitions[hggMapRead, hggTaskValue",
    "DistributeDefinitions[responseOnlyRead, hggResponseNativeGet, hggMapRead, hggTaskValue"];
  hggRunText=hggReplace[hggRunText,hggOutputStart,
    hggOutputStart<>"\"ComponentResponseReadComparison\"->hggResponseEvidence, "]);

hggResponseText=Import[hggResponseBasePath,"Text"];
hggResponseOld=If[hggResponseMode==="targets",
  "If[!SyntaxQ[hggGroupedPrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[hggGroupedPrefix,InputForm];",
  "ToExpression[hggRunText,InputForm];"];
hggResponseNew=If[hggResponseMode==="targets",
  hggResponseOld<>"\nhggResponseInstall[];hggResponseConfigure[];",
  "hggResponseConfigure[];\nhggRunText=hggReplace[hggRunText,\"hggInitializeTasks[];\",\"hggInitializeTasks[];hggResponseInstall[];\"];\n"<>hggResponseOld];
If[StringCount[hggResponseText,hggResponseOld]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique response reader handoff"];Quit[1]];
hggResponseRun=StringReplace[hggResponseText,hggResponseOld->hggResponseNew];
If[!SyntaxQ[hggResponseRun] || StringReplace[hggResponseRun,hggResponseNew->hggResponseOld]=!=hggResponseText,
  Print["FAIL: unchanged full mapping implementation"];Quit[1]];
ToExpression[hggResponseRun,InputForm];
```

```wolfram
sameGeometry[left_Association,right_Association]:=Keys[left]===Keys[right]&&And@@KeyValueMap[sameGeometry[#2,right[#1]]&,left];
sameGeometry[left_List,right_List]:=Length[left]===Length[right]&&And@@MapThread[sameGeometry,{left,right}];
sameGeometry[left_Rule,right_Rule]:=First[left]===First[right]&&sameGeometry[Last[left],Last[right]];
sameGeometry[left_,right_]:=left===right||(FreeQ[{left,right},_String|_Association|_Rule|_List,{1,Infinity}]&&zero[left-right]);
gate["exact recorded geometry",sameGeometry[denominators,blocked["Denominators"]]&&sameGeometry[families,blocked["Families"]]];
families=blocked["Families"];
mapper=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_result","reference","s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}];
gate["original reference mapper identity",IntegerString[FileHash[mapper,"SHA256"],16,64]==="e23a79589bfce183535a6f1166eda799a9f119168feb9cff1b13feb669c8b21f"];
mapperText=Import[mapper,"Text"];starts=StringPosition[mapperText,"\nmerge[pieces_List]"];ends=StringPosition[mapperText,"\ncoefficientPath ="];
gate["unique original mapping block",Length[starts]===1&&Length[ends]===1];
mappingBlock=StringTake[mapperText,{First[First[starts]],First[First[ends]]-1}];gate["original mapping syntax",SyntaxQ[mappingBlock]];ToExpression[mappingBlock,InputForm];
definitions=own["AlgorithmDefinitions"];
gate["same complete original mapper",DownValues[mapExpression]===definitions["OriginalMappingDefinitions"]&&DownValues[merge]===definitions["OriginalMergeDefinitions"]];
DownValues[groupDenominators]=definitions["GroupingDefinitions"];DownValues[certifyGrouping]=definitions["GroupingCertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyPairMerge]=definitions["MergeCertificateDefinitions"];DownValues[certifyGroupMerge]=definitions["GroupMergeDefinitions"];DownValues[pairReconstruct]=definitions["ReconstructionDefinitions"];
groupInputHash=own["InputHash"];groupCache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_Hqg_grouped_comparison",IntegerString[groupInputHash,16]}];
gate["blocked group exact original binding",Hash[{groupInputHash,"component_"<>ToString[blocked["Component"]],blocked["Group"],blocked["Value"]},"SHA256"]===blocked["GroupBinding"]];
controlGroups=bounded[groupDenominators[own["ActualExpression"]],"own accepted groups"];
controlPositions=Flatten[Position[Keys[controlGroups],blocked["GroupPowers"],{1}]];
gate["own accepted group has same denominator powers",Length[controlPositions]===1];controlIndex=First[controlPositions];
controlValues=KeyValueMap[#2/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,#1}])&,controlGroups];controlValue=controlValues[[controlIndex]];
controlKey="component_"<>ToString[own["ComponentIndex"]];
controlPath=FileNameJoin[{groupCache,controlKey<>"_group_"<>IntegerString[controlIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}];control=Get[controlPath];
gate["original control checkpoint binding",TrueQ[control["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[control["Checks"]]&&control["Binding"]===Hash[{groupInputHash,controlKey,controlIndex,controlValue},"SHA256"]];
originalFamilyDefinitions=DownValues[familyRows];
variableLists=Cases[originalFamilyDefinitions,HoldPattern[CoefficientRules[_,vars_List]]:>vars,Infinity];
gate["original declared polynomial variables",Length[variableLists]===1&&DuplicateFreeQ[First[variableLists]]];polynomialVariables=First[variableLists];
familyRows[expression_,family_]:=Module[{spec,variables,rational,numerator,denominator,powers,constant,inputRules,inputReconstruction,pieces,polynomial,rows,reconstruction},
 spec=families[family];variables=First/@spec["UncutCoordinateRules"];
 Print["POLYNOMIAL_FAMILY_INPUT ",family];
 rational=Together[expression];numerator=Numerator[rational];denominator=Factor[Denominator[rational]/.spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]];
 gate["original family numerator polynomial",PolynomialQ[numerator,variables]];
 powers=Exponent[denominator,#]&/@polynomialVariables;
 constant=Cancel[denominator/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,powers}])];
 gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial",FreeQ[constant,Alternatives@@polynomialVariables]];
 inputRules=CoefficientRules[numerator,variables];
 inputReconstruction=Total[(Last[#] Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,First[#]}])&/@inputRules];
 gate["original numerator coefficients reconstruct",zero[inputReconstruction-numerator]];
 pieces=Map[Function[entry,Module[{monomial,shifted,shiftRules,shiftReconstruction},
   monomial=Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,First[entry]}];shifted=monomial/.spec["UncutCoordinateRules"];
   shiftRules=CoefficientRules[Expand[shifted],polynomialVariables];
   shiftReconstruction=Total[(Last[#] Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,First[#]}])&/@shiftRules];
   gate["loop monomial substitution reconstructs",zero[shiftReconstruction-shifted]];
   Association[(First[#]->Last[entry] Last[#])&/@shiftRules]]],inputRules];
 polynomial=Merge[pieces,Total];
 rows=Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{key,value},CutIntegral[family,Join[ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],powers-key]]->Factor[Together[value/constant]]],polynomial];
 rows=Select[rows,#=!=0&];
 reconstruction=Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral,coefficient},coefficient Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,-Drop[integral[[2]],2]}]],rows]];
 gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct",zero[reconstruction-(expression/.spec["UncutCoordinateRules"])]];rows];
candidateFamilyDefinitions=DownValues[familyRows];
saveNative[value_,path_]:=Module[{serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[value],InputForm]<>"]\n"},gate["native file bound",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[path<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];gate["exact native export",Get[path<>".tmp"]===value];RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True]];
pieceScientificHash=Hash[{FileHash[source,"SHA256"],blocked["TargetInputHash"],blocked["InputHashes"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
polynomialAdditivePieces[expression_]:=Module[{factors,positions,position,prefactor,pieces,loopVariables},
 If[Head[expression]===Plus&&Length[expression]<=8,Return[List@@expression]];
 factors=If[Head[expression]===Times,List@@expression,{expression}];
 loopVariables=First/@families[First[familyNames]]["UncutCoordinateRules"];
 positions=Select[Range[Length[factors]],Head[factors[[#]]]===Plus&&Length[factors[[#]]]<=8&&!FreeQ[factors[[#]],Alternatives@@loopVariables]&];
 If[positions==={},Return[{expression}]];
 position=First[MinimalBy[positions,Length[factors[[#]]]&]];
 prefactor=Times@@Delete[factors,position];
 pieces=(prefactor #)&/@(List@@factors[[position]]);pieces];
polynomialPieceMap[expression_]:=Module[{pieces,packets,rows,directory},
 pieces=polynomialAdditivePieces[expression];
 gate["outer additive pieces reconstruct exactly",Expand[Total[pieces]-expression]===0];
 directory=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_Hqg_polynomial_terms",IntegerString[pieceScientificHash,16],"kernel_"<>ToString[$KernelID]}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 Print["POLYNOMIAL_PIECES ",Length[pieces]," bytes ",ByteCount/@pieces];
 packets=MapIndexed[Function[{piece,index},Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{binding,path,saved,seconds,coefficients},
   binding=Hash[{pieceScientificHash,piece},"SHA256"];path=FileNameJoin[{directory,IntegerString[binding,16]<>".wl"}];
   saved=If[FileExistsQ[path],Get[path],<||>];
   If[Lookup[saved,"Binding",None]===binding&&TrueQ[Lookup[saved,"Accepted",False]]&&AssociationQ[Lookup[saved,"Checks",None]]&&Length[saved["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[saved["Checks"]],Return[saved]];
   Print["POLYNOMIAL_PIECE_START ",First[index],"/",Length[pieces]];
   {seconds,coefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[piece],{"outer additive piece",First[index]}]];
   saved=<|"Binding"->binding,"Accepted"->True,"Coefficients"->coefficients,"Checks"->checks,"Seconds"->seconds|>;
   saveNative[saved,path];Print["POLYNOMIAL_PIECE_DONE ",First[index]," seconds ",seconds];saved]]],pieces];
 rows=merge[Lookup[packets,"Coefficients"]];
 gate["complete linear piece map reconstructs",certifyGroupMerge[packets,rows]];rows];
{controlSeconds,controlCandidate}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[polynomialPieceMap[controlValue],"own polynomial group map"]];
gate["every own accepted group coefficient unchanged",Sort[Keys[controlCandidate]]===Sort[Keys[control["Coefficients"]]]&&And@@KeyValueMap[zero[#2-control["Coefficients"][#1]]&,controlCandidate]];
{blockedSeconds,blockedCoefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[polynomialPieceMap[blocked["Value"]],6000,gate["complete blocked piece-map time",False]],8*1024^3,gate["complete blocked piece-map memory",False]]];
proof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-polynomial-family-group-v1","Channel"->channel,"Accepted"->True,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,
 "InputHashes"->blocked["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->blocked["TargetInputHash"],"GroupBinding"->blocked["GroupBinding"],
 "Component"->blocked["Component"],"Group"->blocked["Group"],"Coefficients"->blockedCoefficients,
 "OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->originalFamilyDefinitions,"CandidateFamilyDefinitions"->candidateFamilyDefinitions,"PolynomialVariables"->polynomialVariables,
 "AdditivePiecesDefinitions"->DownValues[polynomialAdditivePieces],"PieceMappingDefinitions"->DownValues[polynomialPieceMap],"PieceStorageDefinitions"->DownValues[saveNative],"PieceScientificHash"->pieceScientificHash,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"MapperHash"->FileHash[mapper,"SHA256"],"BlockedInputHash"->FileHash[blockedPath,"SHA256"],
 "OwnComparisonHash"->FileHash[ownPath,"SHA256"],"OwnReceiptHash"->FileHash[ownReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"ControlHash"->FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"],
 "OriginalControlSeconds"->control["Seconds"],"ControlSeconds"->controlSeconds,"BlockedSeconds"->blockedSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_polynomial_group_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
proofPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_result.wl"}];saveNative[proof,proofPath];
checkpoint=<|"Binding"->blocked["GroupBinding"],"Accepted"->True,"Coefficients"->blockedCoefficients,"Checks"->checks,"Seconds"->blockedSeconds,"InputBytes"->ByteCount[blocked["Value"]],"PolynomialProofHash"->FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"]|>;
checkpointPath=FileNameJoin[{groupCache,"component_"<>ToString[blocked["Component"]]<>"_group_"<>IntegerString[blocked["Group"],10,4]<>".wl"}];gate["no accepted checkpoint overwritten",!FileExistsQ[checkpointPath]];saveNative[checkpoint,checkpointPath];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,"original_control_seconds"->control["Seconds"],"control_seconds"->controlSeconds,"blocked_seconds"->blockedSeconds,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_map_Hqg_polynomial_group"];Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_map_Hqg_target_packets.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-260", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 15366, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_map_Hqg_target_packets.wls", "sha256": "2be9cfe584e8b1714827d89db0e75c542a31a96bf8e1b413bb767324a61551a4"} -->
```wolfram
(* Complete the unchanged reference cut mapping before master-coefficient assembly. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
packetSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_Hqg_target_packets.wls"}];
targetSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_real_targets.wls"}];
targetMapperPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_result", "reference", "s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[targetMapperPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "e23a79589bfce183535a6f1166eda799a9f119168feb9cff1b13feb669c8b21f", Quit[1]];
targetMapperText = Import[targetMapperPath, "Text"];
targetStop = First[First[StringPosition[targetMapperText, "\ncomponents = {}; targets = {};"]]];
targetPrefix = StringTake[targetMapperText, targetStop - 1];
targetSourceAssignment = "sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, \"common\", \"s08_map_real_spin.wls\"}];";
If[StringCount[targetPrefix, targetSourceAssignment] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
targetPrefix = StringReplace[targetPrefix, targetSourceAssignment -> "sourcePath = targetMapperPath;"];
If[!SyntaxQ[targetPrefix], Print["FAIL: complete target-mapping prefix syntax"]; Quit[1]];
ToExpression[targetPrefix, InputForm];
gate["Hqg assigned-component entry", channel === "Hqg"];
gate["complete assigned-component source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[packetSourcePath, "Text"]]];
gate["complete target mapping source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[targetSourcePath, "Text"]]];
targetCalculationPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_result", "reference", "s08_map_real_targets_before_channel_resume.wls"}];
targetCalculationHash = FileHash[targetCalculationPath, "SHA256"];
gate["pinned unchanged target calculation", IntegerString[targetCalculationHash, 16, 64] ===
  "eaebc31004da122daa275f4d817ba45e84c8ed5db8e5c0bf40a008289791a1ce"];
targetSection[text_] := StringTake[text, {
  First[First[StringPosition[text, "\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[text, "\nslots ="]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged complete target calculation and checkpoint contract",
  targetSection[Import[packetSourcePath, "Text"]] === targetSection[Import[targetCalculationPath, "Text"]]];
targetConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_rational_sum_inputs.json"}];
targetConfig = Import[targetConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
targetFixturePath = FileNameJoin[{root, targetConfig["raw_map"]}];
gate["pinned actual reference target map", IntegerString[FileHash[targetFixturePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === targetConfig["raw_map_sha256"]];
targetFixture = Get[targetFixturePath];
targetControlSpinRelative = "Hqqprime/s05_result/s05_result.wl";
targetControlSpinPath = FileNameJoin[{root, targetControlSpinRelative}];
gate["pinned accepted control tensor", IntegerString[FileHash[targetControlSpinPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "07679643127071c38d0522479236858ff7fd1f4e770d22d65572072f56e03d9f"];
targetControlSpin = If[channel === "Hqqprime", spin, Get[targetControlSpinPath]];
gate["control shares exact measured scalar products", targetControlSpin["RealScalarProducts"] === spin["RealScalarProducts"] &&
  targetControlSpin["TransverseConstraint"] === spin["TransverseConstraint"] && And @@ Values[targetControlSpin["Checks"]]];
targetControlTask = Append[targetFixture["Task"], "Value" -> Extract[
  targetControlSpin["Sectors"][targetFixture["Task"]["Sector"]][targetFixture["Task"]["Kind"]], targetFixture["Task"]["Index"]]];
Clear[targetControlSpin];
targetControlInputs = Association[Map[If[First[#] === StringDrop[spinPath, StringLength[root] + 1],
  targetControlSpinRelative -> FileHash[targetControlSpinPath, "SHA256"], #] &, Normal[inputHashes]]];
targetFixtureHash = Hash[{FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, targetConfig["raw_profile_source"]}], "SHA256"],
  targetControlInputs, FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_result", "reference",
    "s05_real_spin_response_before_parallel_spin_checks.wls"}], "SHA256"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
gate["reference target map exact input identity", targetFixture["InputHash"] === targetFixtureHash &&
  And @@ Values[targetFixture["MappingChecks"]] && KeyDrop[targetControlTask, "Value"] === targetFixture["Task"]];
targetSourceHash = FileHash[targetSourcePath, "SHA256"];
targetInputHash = Hash[{targetCalculationHash, inputHash, FileHash[targetFixturePath, "SHA256"],
  FileHash[targetConfigPath, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
targetCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_targets", channel, IntegerString[targetInputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[targetCache], CreateDirectory[targetCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; If[TrueQ[$KernelID > 0], Throw[$Failed, "TargetMapFailure"], CloseKernels[]; Quit[1]]];
targetResourceLimit[name_, default_, maximum_] := Module[{value = Environment[name]},
  If[value === $Failed || value === "", Return[default]];
  gate["integer resource limit " <> name, StringQ[value] && StringMatchQ[value, DigitCharacter ..]];
  value = FromDigits[value];
  gate["bounded resource limit " <> name, IntegerQ[value] && 0 < value <= maximum]; value];
targetTimeLimit = targetResourceLimit["POLARIZED_SIDIS_TARGET_SECONDS", 3600, 10800];
targetMemoryLimit = targetResourceLimit["POLARIZED_SIDIS_TARGET_MEMORY_GIB", 2, 8]*1024^3;
Print["TARGET_RESOURCE_LIMITS seconds ", targetTimeLimit, " bytes ", targetMemoryLimit];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, targetTimeLimit,
  gate["time bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], targetMemoryLimit,
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
mapTargetTask[index_] := Catch[Block[{checks = <||>}, Module[
  {task, path, saved, coefficients, seconds, missing},
  task = tasks[[index]];
  path = FileNameJoin[{targetCache, "component_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[path], Get[path], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] === targetInputHash && TrueQ[Lookup[saved, "ReconstructionPassed", False]] &&
    AssociationQ[Lookup[saved, "Checks", None]] && Length[saved["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[saved["Checks"]], Return[saved]];
  Print["REAL_TARGET_MAP ", index, "/", Length[tasks], " ", KeyDrop[task, "Value"], " kernel ", $KernelID];
  {seconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[task["Value"] /. coordinateRules],
    {"complete raw cut mapping", index}]];
  missing = Complement[Keys[coefficients], ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]];
  saved = Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], <|"Coefficients" -> coefficients, "MissingTargets" -> missing,
    "InputHash" -> targetInputHash, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True, "Checks" -> checks,
    "Seconds" -> seconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[task["Value"]], "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[coefficients]|>];
  put[saved, path]; ClearSystemCache[]; saved]], "TargetMapFailure"];
slots = Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]], 1]];
(* Preserve the native mapper; change only the data held by each worker. *)
packetInputFootprint = <|"TaskBytesBefore" -> ByteCount[tasks], "SpinBytesBefore" -> ByteCount[spin],
  "MemoryBefore" -> MemoryInUse[]|>;
packetMetadata = KeyDrop[#, "Value"] & /@ tasks;
packetPositions = Select[Range[Length[tasks]], tasks[[#]]["Value"] =!= 0 &];
gate["own nonzero target-map comparison available", packetPositions =!= {}];
packetControlIndex = First[MinimalBy[packetPositions, ByteCount[tasks[[#]]["Value"]] &]];
packetOriginal = mapTargetTask[packetControlIndex];
gate["own original target-map comparison accepted", AssociationQ[packetOriginal] &&
  TrueQ[packetOriginal["ReconstructionPassed"]] && And @@ Values[packetOriginal["Checks"]]];
packetInputs = MapIndexed[{First[#2], #1, Hash[#1, "SHA256"]} &, tasks];
gate["assigned tasks retain original order and values", Map[#[[2]] &, packetInputs] === tasks &&
  Map[First, packetInputs] === Range[Length[tasks]]];
packetControlCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_target_packets", channel,
  IntegerString[Hash[{targetInputHash, FileHash[packetSourcePath, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"], 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[packetControlCache], CreateDirectory[packetControlCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
mapTargetPacket[packet_] := Catch[Module[{index = packet[[1]], assigned = packet[[2]]},
  gate["assigned original component exact identity", Hash[assigned, "SHA256"] === packet[[3]] &&
    KeyDrop[assigned, "Value"] === tasks[[index]]];
  Block[{tasks = ReplacePart[tasks, index -> assigned]}, mapTargetTask[index]]], "TargetMapFailure"];
packetControlFunction[packet_] := Block[{targetCache = packetControlCache}, mapTargetPacket[packet]];
tasks = packetMetadata;
Clear[spin, sector, packetMetadata]; ClearSystemCache[];
AssociateTo[packetInputFootprint, {"TaskBytesAfter" -> ByteCount[tasks],
  "LargestAssignedTaskBytes" -> Max[ByteCount[#[[2]]] & /@ packetInputs], "MemoryAfter" -> MemoryInUse[]}];
Print["S08_TARGET_PACKET_INPUTS ", InputForm[packetInputFootprint]];
targetControlTaskFunction[unused_] := Catch[Block[{checks = <||>}, Module[{value, seconds},
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[targetControlTask["Value"] /. coordinateRules], "reference control mapping"]];
  gate["fresh worker reproduces entire reference map", value === targetFixture["Coefficients"]];
  <|"Checks" -> checks, "Seconds" -> seconds, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True|>]], "TargetMapFailure"];
If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1]; CloseKernels[];
If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];
workers = Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers > 0,
  gate["target workers share compute node", And @@ (SameQ[#, $MachineName] & /@ ParallelEvaluate[$MachineName])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; checks = <||>;
    PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"]; $FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  gate["target worker native versions agree", And @@ (SameQ[#, {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}] & /@
    ParallelEvaluate[{$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}])];
  packetDistributionStart = AbsoluteTime[];
  DistributeDefinitions[mapTargetPacket, packetControlFunction, packetControlCache,
    gate, bounded, targetTimeLimit, targetMemoryLimit, put, zero, merge, decompose, extractAtoms, familyRows, mapExpression,
    mapTargetTask, tasks, targetCache, targetInputHash, coordinateRules, ruleKeys, reduction,
    targetControlTaskFunction, targetControlTask, targetFixture,
    denominators, directions, families, familyNames, geometry];
  packetDistributionSeconds = AbsoluteTime[] - packetDistributionStart;
  Print["S08_TARGET_PACKET_DISTRIBUTION_SECONDS ", packetDistributionSeconds]];
$DistributedContexts = None;
Print["Independent target worker count = ", workers];
targetControlFunction = If[channel === "Hqqprime", mapTargetTask, targetControlTaskFunction];
targetControl = First[If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[targetControlFunction, {1}], targetControlFunction /@ {1}]];
gate["fresh target worker accepted", AssociationQ[targetControl] && And @@ Values[targetControl["Checks"]]];
If[channel === "Hqqprime", gate["entire original target map unchanged", targetControl["Coefficients"] === targetFixture["Coefficients"]]];
packetCandidate = First[If[workers > 0,
  ParallelMap[packetControlFunction, {packetInputs[[packetControlIndex]]}],
  {packetControlFunction[packetInputs[[packetControlIndex]]]}]];
gate["own assigned-component target checks accepted", AssociationQ[packetCandidate] &&
  TrueQ[packetCandidate["ReconstructionPassed"]] && And @@ Values[packetCandidate["Checks"]]];
gate["own complete mapped coefficient unchanged", KeyDrop[packetCandidate, {"Seconds", "Checks"}] === KeyDrop[packetOriginal, {"Seconds", "Checks"}]];
packetComparison = <|"ControlIndex" -> packetControlIndex, "AssignedInputHash" -> packetInputs[[packetControlIndex, 3]],
  "OriginalOutputHash" -> Hash[KeyDrop[packetOriginal, {"Seconds", "Checks"}], "SHA256"],
  "CandidateOutputHash" -> Hash[KeyDrop[packetCandidate, {"Seconds", "Checks"}], "SHA256"],
  "OriginalChecks" -> packetOriginal["Checks"], "CandidateChecks" -> packetCandidate["Checks"],
  "OriginalSeconds" -> packetOriginal["Seconds"], "CandidateSeconds" -> packetCandidate["Seconds"],
  "ExactOwnComparisonPassed" -> True, "InputHash" -> targetInputHash,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[packetSourcePath, "SHA256"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}|>;
Print["S08_TARGET_PACKET_COMPARISON ", InputForm[packetComparison]];
targetRest = Range[If[channel === "Hqqprime", 2, 1], Length[tasks]];
targetComponents = If[workers > 0,
  ParallelMap[mapTargetPacket, packetInputs[[targetRest]], Method -> "FinestGrained"], mapTargetPacket /@ packetInputs[[targetRest]]];
If[channel === "Hqqprime", targetComponents = Prepend[targetComponents, targetControl]];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all real target maps accepted", Length[targetComponents] === Length[tasks] &&
  AllTrue[targetComponents, AssociationQ] && And @@ Lookup[targetComponents, "ReconstructionPassed"] &&
  And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ targetComponents]];
targetInventory = Union[Flatten[Keys[#["Coefficients"]] & /@ targetComponents]];
targetMissing = Union[Flatten[Lookup[targetComponents, "MissingTargets"]]];
targetResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-target-map-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Components" -> targetComponents, "Targets" -> targetInventory, "MissingTargets" -> targetMissing,
  "ReductionCoverageComplete" -> (targetMissing === {}), "Bookkeeping" -> bookkeeping,
  "MapperSourceHash" -> FileHash[targetMapperPath, "SHA256"], "SourceHash" -> targetSourceHash,
  "CalculationSourceHash" -> targetCalculationHash, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "DispatchSourceHash" -> FileHash[packetSourcePath, "SHA256"], "AssignedComponentComparison" -> packetComparison,
  "AssignedComponentFootprint" -> packetInputFootprint,
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> targetInputHash, "MappingInputHash" -> inputHash,
  "ReferenceTargetMapHash" -> FileHash[targetFixturePath, "SHA256"], "Checks" -> checks,
  "WorkerCount" -> workers, "MappingAccepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
targetDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_targets_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[targetDir], CreateDirectory[targetDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
targetResultPath = FileNameJoin[{targetDir, "s08_result.wl"}];
targetSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[targetResult], "target-map compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["target-map output below file bound", StringLength[targetSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[targetResultPath <> ".tmp", targetSerialized, "Text"];
gate["target-map output exact native round trip", bounded[Get[targetResultPath <> ".tmp"] === targetResult, "target-map reload"]];
RenameFile[targetResultPath <> ".tmp", targetResultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{targetDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
```

```wolfram
DownValues[certifyGroupMerge] = certifiedProof["GroupMergeDefinitions"];

gate["all accepted mapping definitions installed", {

groupCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_certified_denominator", channel, IntegerString[groupInputHash, 16]}];

certifiedProofHash = FileHash[certifiedProofPath, "SHA256"];
certifiedComponents = Association[(#["ComponentIndex"] -> #) & /@ certifiedProof["Components"]];
gate["exact compared component inventory", Keys[certifiedComponents] === certifiedProof["SelectedIndices"]];

mapCertifiedPacket[packet_] := Catch[Block[{checks = <||>}, Module[

  saved = If[FileExistsQ[path], Get[path], <||>];

    gate["accepted canonical component exact task", KeyTake[saved, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}] === KeyDrop[task, "Value"]];
```
