## common/s08_read_Hqg_blocked_input.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-287", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5658, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_read_Hqg_blocked_input.wls", "sha256": "6144e16ec9794788b8989945d77331e72b0711ea19d4d56be48a525f384b78e2"} -->
```wolfram
(* Recover the native group input saved before the interrupted export gate. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel="Hqg";checks=<||>;
source=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_read_Hqg_blocked_input.wls"}];
configPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_Hqg_blocked_input_recovery.json"}];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]&&StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;$LoadAddOns={"FeynArts"};Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[source,"Text"]]];
cfg=Import[configPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["recovery contract",cfg["schema"]==="polarized-sidis-blocked-input-recovery-v1"&&cfg["channel"]===channel];
KeyValueMap[Function[{key,row},gate["saved input identity "<>key,IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,row["file"]}],"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]]],cfg["files"]];
prior=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,cfg["files"]["execution"]["file"]}],"RawJSON"];
origin=cfg["files"]["producer"];
gate["recorded interrupted export",prior["job_id"]===cfg["prior_job"]&&!TrueQ[prior["passed"]]&&prior["reason"]==="normal_exit"&&prior["exit_code"]===1&&prior["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s08_read_Hqg_blocked_input.wls"]===origin["sha256"]];
diagnostic=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,cfg["files"]["diagnostic"]["file"]}],"RawJSON"];
diagnosticReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,cfg["files"]["diagnostic_receipt"]["file"]}],"RawJSON"];
gate["executed small-input diagnostic",TrueQ[diagnosticReceipt["passed"]]&&diagnosticReceipt["result_sha256"][cfg["files"]["diagnostic"]["file"]]===cfg["files"]["diagnostic"]["sha256"]&&diagnostic["input_sha256"]===cfg["files"]["input"]["sha256"]&&TrueQ[diagnostic["original_group_binding_matches"]]&&TrueQ[diagnostic["unchanged_after_second_reload"]]];
blockedPath=FileNameJoin[{root,cfg["files"]["input"]["file"]}];
blocked=Get[blockedPath];
gate["saved input complete original checks",blocked["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-blocked-input-v1"&&blocked["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[blocked["Checks"]]&&blocked["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,origin["file"]}],"SHA256"]];
originalConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_Hqg_blocked_input.json"}];
gate["unchanged originating configuration",blocked["ConfigHash"]===FileHash[originalConfigPath,"SHA256"]];
originalConfig=Import[originalConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["exact recorded task position",blocked["Component"]===originalConfig["component"]&&blocked["Group"]===originalConfig["group"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{name,hash},gate["unchanged actual input "<>name,FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,name}],"SHA256"]===hash]],blocked["InputHashes"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{name,hash},gate["unchanged originating failure "<>name,IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,name}],"SHA256"],16,64]===hash]],originalConfig["files"]];
ownPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_grouped_comparison_result","s08_result.wl"}];
ownReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[ownPath],"s08_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted own comparison",TrueQ[ownReceipt["passed"]]&&ownReceipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s08_grouped_comparison_result/s08_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[ownPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
own=Get[ownPath];
gate["unchanged own inputs and native conventions",TrueQ[own["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[own["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&And@@Values[own["Checks"]]&&own["InputHashes"]===blocked["InputHashes"]&&own["TargetInputHash"]===blocked["TargetInputHash"]&&own["Denominators"]===blocked["Denominators"]&&own["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
gate["exact original group binding",Hash[{own["InputHash"],"component_"<>ToString[blocked["Component"]],blocked["Group"],blocked["Value"]},"SHA256"]===blocked["GroupBinding"]];
geometry=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s06_result","reference","s02_result.wl"}]]/.{Q2->Q^2,w->s23};
sameGeometry[left_Association,right_Association]:=Keys[left]===Keys[right]&&And@@KeyValueMap[sameGeometry[#2,right[#1]]&,left];
sameGeometry[left_List,right_List]:=Length[left]===Length[right]&&And@@MapThread[sameGeometry,{left,right}];
sameGeometry[left_Rule,right_Rule]:=First[left]===First[right]&&sameGeometry[Last[left],Last[right]];
sameGeometry[left_,right_]:=left===right||(FreeQ[{left,right},_String|_Association|_Rule|_List,{1,Infinity}]&&Factor[Together[left-right]]===0);
gate["exact fresh family geometry",sameGeometry[geometry["Families"],blocked["Families"]]&&sameGeometry[geometry["OnCutUncutPropagators"],blocked["Denominators"]]];
AssociateTo[blocked,"Recovery"-><|"SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"ConfigHash"->FileHash[configPath,"SHA256"],"SavedInputHash"->FileHash[blockedPath,"SHA256"],"PriorJob"->prior["job_id"],"Checks"->checks|>];
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_blocked_input_result"}];
resultPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_result.wl"}];
serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[blocked],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded native export",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath<>".recovery.tmp",serialized,"Text"];
gate["exact saved blocked input",Get[resultPath<>".recovery.tmp"]===blocked];
RenameFile[resultPath<>".recovery.tmp",resultPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
Put[blocked,FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_readable_input.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,"original_checks"->blocked["Checks"],"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_read_Hqg_blocked_input"];Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_result/reference/s03_real_families.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-288", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 12639, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s03_real_families.wl", "sha256": "af23fd0f16f04dde4897cf92b77a9f6826bfee3442a29f26b9450663c78c0675"} -->
```wolfram
Get[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[$InputFileName],"..","common","s22_paths.wl"}]];
(* Exact real-interference coefficients of two-cut loop integrals. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
Get["FeynCalc`"];
root=sidisRoot;
gate[name_, condition_] := If[!TrueQ[condition], Print["FAIL: ", name];
  If[$KernelID > 0, Throw[$Failed, "S03Failure"], CloseKernels[]; Quit[1]]];
zero[expression_] := Factor[Together[expression]] === 0;
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[expression_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[expression, 1800,
  gate["time limit " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory limit " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
geometry = sidisGet[sidisPath[{root, "s02_result.wl"}]];
gate["S02 acceptance/source", TrueQ[geometry["Accepted"]] &&
  geometry["SourceHash"] === sidisHash[sidisPath[{root, "s02_definitions.wl"}], "SHA256"]];
denominators = geometry["OnCutUncutPropagators"];
directions = geometry["UncutDirections"];
families = geometry["Families"];
familyNames = Keys[families];
sourceHash = sidisHash[$InputFileName, "SHA256"];
geometryHash = sidisHash[sidisPath[{root, "s02_result.wl"}], "SHA256"];

merge[pieces_List] := If[pieces === {}, <||>,
  Select[Merge[pieces, Factor[Together[Total[#]]] &], # =!= 0 &]];

(* All partial-fraction coefficients are solved from the actual affine
   propagators. No angular integral or phase-space formula is used. *)
decompose[powers_List] := decompose[powers] = Module[
  {support, relations, relation, constant, pieces, lowered},
  support = Flatten[Position[powers, _?(# > 0 &)]];
  If[support === {}, Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  If[Length[support] <= 2 && MatrixRank[directions[[support]]] === Length[support],
    Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  relations = NullSpace[Transpose[directions[[support]]]];
  relation = SelectFirst[relations, !zero[#.denominators[[support]]] &, $Failed];
  gate["nonzero affine relation for dependent propagators", relation =!= $Failed];
  constant = Factor[relation.denominators[[support]]];
  gate["relation constant is independent of loop coordinates", FreeQ[constant, a | b]];
  pieces = MapThread[Function[{position, coefficient},
    If[coefficient === 0, <||>,
      lowered = ReplacePart[powers, position -> powers[[position]] - 1];
      Map[Factor[coefficient #/constant] &, decompose[lowered]]]], {support, relation}];
  merge[pieces]];

extractAtoms[expression_] := Module[{rational, factors, powers, found, ratio, prefactor},
  rational = Together[expression];
  factors = Rest[FactorList[Denominator[rational]]];
  powers = ConstantArray[0, Length[denominators]];
  Do[If[!FreeQ[factor[[1]], a | b],
    found = SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]],
      Function[index, ratio = Cancel[factor[[1]]/denominators[[index]]];
        ratio =!= 0 && FreeQ[ratio, a | b]], Missing["UnknownPropagator"]];
    If[MissingQ[found], Print["UNKNOWN_PROPAGATOR ", InputForm[factor[[1]]]]];
    gate["every loop-dependent factor is a generated propagator", !MissingQ[found]];
    powers[[found]] += factor[[2]]], {factor, factors}];
  prefactor = Cancel[rational Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, powers}]];
  gate["atom extraction leaves a polynomial numerator",
    FreeQ[Denominator[Together[prefactor]], a | b]];
  {powers, prefactor}];

familyRows[expression_, family_] := Module[
  {spec, transformed, numerator, denominator, denominatorPowers, denominatorCoefficient,
   polynomial, rows, reconstruction},
  spec = families[family];
  transformed = Together[expression /. spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]];
  numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]];
  denominator = Factor[Denominator[transformed]];
  gate["family numerator is polynomial", PolynomialQ[numerator, {v3, v4}]];
  denominatorPowers = Exponent[denominator, #] & /@ {v3, v4};
  denominatorCoefficient = Cancel[denominator/(Times @@ MapThread[Power,
    {{v3, v4}, denominatorPowers}])];
  gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial", FreeQ[denominatorCoefficient, v3 | v4]];
  polynomial = CoefficientRules[numerator, {v3, v4}];
  rows = Association[Map[Function[entry,
    CutIntegral[family, Join[ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],
      denominatorPowers - First[entry]]] -> Factor[Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient]], polynomial]];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power, {{v3, v4}, -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct", zero[reconstruction - transformed]];
  rows];

mapExpression[expression_] := Module[{powers, prefactor, decomposition, pieces, rows, reconstruction},
  If[expression === 0, Return[<||>]];
  {powers, prefactor} = extractAtoms[expression];
  decomposition = decompose[powers];
  pieces = KeyValueMap[Function[{key, coefficient},
    Module[{indices = List @@ key, support, family, value},
      support = Flatten[Position[indices, _?(# > 0 &)]];
      family = SelectFirst[familyNames,
        Complement[support, families[#]["UncutIndices"]] === {} &, Missing["NoFamily"]];
      gate["every independent denominator set has a family", !MissingQ[family]];
      value = Cancel[prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, indices}])];
      familyRows[value, family]]], decomposition];
  rows = merge[pieces];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["complete cut-family map reconstructs the input tensor", zero[reconstruction - expression]];
  gate["both physical cuts remain to unit power in every target",
    And @@ (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[rows])];
  rows];

mapTask[task_] := Catch[Module[{file, saved, value, rows},
  file = task["CacheFile"];
  If[FileExistsQ[file], saved = sidisGet[file];
    If[AssociationQ[saved] && saved["InputHash"] === task["InputHash"] &&
        TrueQ[saved["ReconstructionPassed"]], Return[saved]]];
  Print["MAP ", task["Channel"], " ", task["TensorKey"], " ", task["Label"],
    " kernel ", $KernelID];
  gate["pair file remains unchanged", sidisHash[task["InputFile"], "SHA256"] === task["FileHash"]];
  value = sidisGet[task["InputFile"]][task["Selector"]] /. task["CoordinateRules"];
  rows = bounded[mapExpression[value], {task["Channel"], task["Label"], task["TensorKey"]}];
  saved = <|"TensorKey" -> task["TensorKey"], "Label" -> task["Label"],
    "Coefficients" -> rows, "InputHash" -> task["InputHash"],
    "InputFileHash" -> task["FileHash"], "ReconstructionPassed" -> True|>;
  put[saved, file]; saved], "S03Failure"];

slots = Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]], 1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1];
CloseKernels[];
configuration = KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots],
  "TimeConstraint" -> 60];
TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[configuration], 60, Null];
workers = Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers > 0,
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; Global`$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  runtime = ParallelEvaluate[{$MachineName, $Version}];
  gate["workers share the allocated compute node", And @@ (First[#] === $MachineName & /@ runtime)];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate, zero, put, bounded, merge, decompose, extractAtoms,
    familyRows, mapExpression, mapTask, root, geometry, denominators, directions, families, familyNames],
  runtime = {}];
$DistributedContexts = None;
allTargets = {}; channelResults = <||>;

Do[
  channelDirectory = sidisPath[{root, channel}];
  inputDirectory = sidisPath[{channelDirectory, "s01_inputs"}];
  channelFile = sidisPath[{channelDirectory, "s02_result.wl"}];
  gate[channel <> " S02 identity", sidisHash[channelFile, "SHA256"] ===
    geometry["Channels"][channel]["SHA256"]];
  data = sidisGet[channelFile]; keys = Keys[data["Contractions"]];
  coordinates = data["CoordinateRules"];
  importManifest = sidisImport[sidisPath[{channelDirectory, "s01_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
  importedHashes = Association[(#["path"] -> FromDigits[#["sha256"], 16]) & /@ importManifest["files"]];
  inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, geometryHash, sidisHash[channelFile, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
  cacheDirectory = sidisPath[{channelDirectory, "s03_cache", IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[cacheDirectory], CreateDirectory[cacheDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  tasks = {}; pairSums = AssociationThread[keys, ConstantArray[{}, Length[keys]]];
  If[MemberQ[{"Hqq", "Hqg", "Hgq"}, channel],
    cacheStage = If[channel === "Hqg", "s05_cache", "s03_cache"];
    files = Sort[FileNames[If[channel === "Hqq", {"*_Pg_*.wl", "*_Ppp_*.wl"},
      {"Pg_*.wl", "Ppp_*.wl"}], sidisPath[{inputDirectory, cacheStage}], Infinity]],
    files = Select[Sort[FileNames["real_*.wl", sidisPath[{inputDirectory, "s02_result"}]]],
      StringMatchQ[FileBaseName[#], RegularExpression["real_[0-9]+"]] &]];
  gate[channel <> " unintegrated pair files exist", Length[files] > 0];
  Do[
    relativeFile = StringTrim[StringDrop[file, StringLength[root]], "/"];
    fileHash = sidisHash[file, "SHA256"];
    gate[channel <> " imported pair identity", fileHash === importedHashes[relativeFile]];
    entry = sidisGet[file];
    If[MemberQ[{"Hqq", "Hgq"}, channel] &&
      entry["InputHash"] =!= data["Bookkeeping"]["InputHash"], Continue[]];
    selectors = If[MemberQ[{"Hqq", "Hqg", "Hgq"}, channel], {"Value"}, {"g", "pp"}];
    Do[
      mode = If[selector === "Value",
        If[StringContainsQ["_" <> FileBaseName[file] <> "_", "_Ppp_"], "Ppp", "Pg"], selector];
      key = If[channel === "Hqq", entry["Component"] <> "__" <> mode, mode];
      gate[channel <> " pair tensor key is inherited", MemberQ[keys, key]];
      AppendTo[pairSums[key], entry[selector] /. coordinates];
      label = FileBaseName[file] <> "_" <> selector;
      AppendTo[tasks, <|"Channel" -> channel, "TensorKey" -> key, "Label" -> label,
        "InputFile" -> file, "FileHash" -> fileHash, "Selector" -> selector,
        "CoordinateRules" -> coordinates,
        "InputHash" -> Hash[{inputHash, fileHash, selector, key}, "SHA256"],
        "CacheFile" -> sidisPath[{cacheDirectory, label <> ".wl"}]|>], {selector, selectors}],
    {file, files}];
  Do[gate[channel <> " exact source-pair sum " <> key,
    bounded[zero[Total[pairSums[key]] - data["Contractions"][key]], channel <> " pair sum"]], {key, keys}];
  Clear[pairSums, entry]; ClearSystemCache[];
  Print["PAIR_SUMS_ACCEPTED ", channel, " mapping tasks ", Length[tasks]];
  mapped = If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[mapTask, tasks, Method -> "FinestGrained"], mapTask /@ tasks];
  gate[channel <> " all pair maps accepted", FreeQ[mapped, $Failed | $Aborted]];
  coefficients = AssociationMap[Function[key, bounded[
    merge[Lookup[Select[mapped, #["TensorKey"] === key &], "Coefficients"]], channel <> " coefficient sum"]], keys];
  targets = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Keys /@ Values[coefficients]]]];
  put[<|"Channel" -> channel, "Coefficients" -> coefficients, "Targets" -> targets,
    "CoordinateRules" -> coordinates, "InputHash" -> inputHash,
    "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "GeometryHash" -> geometryHash,
    "PairCount" -> Length[tasks], "PairSumsAccepted" -> True,
    "ReconstructionPassed" -> True, "IntegralEvaluationPerformed" -> False|>,
    sidisPath[{channelDirectory, "s03_result.wl"}]];
  AssociateTo[channelResults, channel -> <|"File" -> channel <> "/s03_result.wl",
    "SHA256" -> sidisHash[sidisPath[{channelDirectory, "s03_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
    "TargetCount" -> Length[targets], "PairCount" -> Length[tasks]|>];
  allTargets = Union[allTargets, targets];

  {channel, Keys[geometry["Channels"]]}];

Export[sidisPath[{root, "s03_targets"}], StringRiffle[targetText /@ allTargets, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];

  "GeometryHash" -> geometryHash, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash,
```

```wolfram
phasePrepare[expression_]:=Module[{outer,splits,terms,factors,flat,candidate,atoms,scalars,left,right,rules},

 scalars=Table[Unique["phaseScalar$"],{Length[factors]}];
 left=Total[MapThread[Times,{scalars,Total/@atoms}]];
 right=Total[Flatten[MapThread[Function[{c,list},Map[c #&,list]],{scalars,atoms}],1]];
 gate["native full scalar distributivity identity",Expand[left-right]===0];
 flat=Flatten[MapThread[Function[{c,list},Map[c #&,list]],{factors,terms}],1];
 candidate=Total[flat];

 gate["scalar identity specializes to entire original input",(left/.rules)===expression];
 gate["scalar identity specializes to entire prepared input",(right/.rules)===candidate];
```

```wolfram
gate[name_,test_] := If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],
  Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[readBound,HoldFirst];
readBound[value_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate["native read time bound",False]],16*1024^3,gate["native read memory bound",False]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"] &&
  StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[source,"Text"]]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];

responseOnlyRead[path_,identity_] := Module[{text,old,new,candidate,location,literal,value},
  gate["response input native identity",FileExistsQ[path] && FileHash[path,"SHA256"]===identity];
  text=Import[path,"Text"];
  old="cdr=readPiece[Length[groups]];";
  If[StringCount[text,old]===0,Return[Get[path]]];
  gate["unique unused native CDR assignment",StringCount[text,old]===1];
  new="cdr=Missing[\"CDRNotRequestedByResponseConsumer\"];";
  gate["new response-reader marker absent",StringCount[text,new]===0];
  candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
  gate["all original response and payload checks retained",SyntaxQ[candidate] &&
    StringReplace[candidate,new->old]===text];
  location="DirectoryName[$InputFileName]";literal=ToString[DirectoryName[path],InputForm];
  gate["unique native payload directory binding",StringCount[candidate,location]===1 &&
    StringCount[candidate,literal]===0];
  candidate=StringReplace[candidate,location->literal];
  gate["only payload directory and unused field differ",SyntaxQ[candidate] &&
    StringReplace[candidate,{literal->location,new->old}]===text];
  value=ToExpression[candidate,InputForm];
  gate["same accepted piecewise projection writer",AssociationQ[value] &&
    value["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-complete-photon-spin-component-v1" &&
    value["Channel"]==="Hgg" && KeyExistsQ[value,"Response"] &&
    value["StorageDispatchHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common",
      "s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls"}],"SHA256"] &&
    MissingQ[value["CDRPhotonCoefficient"]] && And@@Values[value["Checks"]]];
  value];

relative="Hgg/s05_projected_components_result/Photon_4/s05_result.wl";
path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
receiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s05_execution.json"}];
receipt=Import[receiptPath,"RawJSON"];identity=FileHash[path,"SHA256"];
gate["own complete projection accepted",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]] &&
  receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[identity,16,64]];
manifestPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s05_payload_manifest.json"}];
manifest=Import[manifestPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["own exact native payload round trip",TrueQ[manifest["exact_round_trip"]] &&
  manifest["result_sha256"]===IntegerString[identity,16,64]];
Print["RESPONSE_READ_ORIGINAL ",relative];
{originalSeconds,original}=AbsoluteTiming[readBound[KeyDrop[Get[path],"CDRPhotonCoefficient"]]];
gate["original complete native conventions",AssociationQ[original] &&
  original["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion} && And@@Values[original["Checks"]]];
originalBytes=ByteCount[original];ClearSystemCache[];
Print["RESPONSE_READ_CANDIDATE ",relative];
{candidateSeconds,candidate}=AbsoluteTiming[readBound[KeyDrop[responseOnlyRead[path,identity],"CDRPhotonCoefficient"]]];
gate["entire own response and every retained field reproduced",candidate===original];
gate["unchanged original native file",FileHash[path,"SHA256"]===identity];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-response-only-native-read-v1","Channel"->"Hgg",
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"OwnFile"->relative,"OwnHash"->identity,
  "OwnReceiptHash"->FileHash[receiptPath,"SHA256"],"OwnManifestHash"->FileHash[manifestPath,"SHA256"],
  "StorageSourceHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls"}],"SHA256"],
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"ReaderDefinitions"->DownValues[responseOnlyRead],
  "OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"ResponseHash"->Hash[original["Response"],"SHA256"],
  "RetainedFieldsHash"->Hash[original,"SHA256"],"OriginalReadSeconds"->originalSeconds,
  "CandidateReadSeconds"->candidateSeconds,"RetainedBytes"->originalBytes,
  "PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],"Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
Clear[original,candidate];ClearSystemCache[];
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_response_read_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
resultPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_result.wl"}];Put[result,resultPath<>".tmp"];
gate["exact native comparison reload",Get[resultPath<>".tmp"]===result];
RenameFile[resultPath<>".tmp",resultPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "original_seconds"->originalSeconds,"candidate_seconds"->candidateSeconds,
  "retained_bytes"->originalBytes,"peak_kernel_memory_bytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],
  "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_Hgg_response_read"];Quit[0];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-299", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8688, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s08_check_family_polynomials_before_coefficient_identity.wls", "sha256": "b9a343db5fe8a6dd1f2c2e3cc7b7bd44315b8620fea6a6d29b86d758a6bd34a6"} -->
```wolfram
(* Compare polynomial family collection with the reference on its actual inputs. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
polynomialSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_family_polynomials.wls"}];
polynomialBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_map_certified_group_targets.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[polynomialBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "f38a83d6b7080e4acbd9919f05a38ce602800f445e3bd594263f18bb8e4a091c",Quit[1]];
polynomialBaseText=Import[polynomialBase,"Text"];
If[StringCount[polynomialBaseText,"\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]=!=1||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[polynomialSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
polynomialPrefix=First[StringSplit[polynomialBaseText,"\nmapTargetTask[index_]"]];
If[!SyntaxQ[polynomialPrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[polynomialPrefix,InputForm];
polynomialInspectionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_map_equation_result","s08_result.wl"}];
polynomialInspectionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_inspect_group_map.wls"}];
polynomialReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_map_equation_result","s08_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted operation inspection receipt",TrueQ[polynomialReceipt["passed"]]&&
  polynomialReceipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s08_map_equation_result/s08_result.wl"]===
    IntegerString[FileHash[polynomialInspectionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
polynomialInspection=Get[polynomialInspectionPath];
gate["actual operation input identity",polynomialInspection["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-group-map-inspection-v1"&&
  polynomialInspection["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[polynomialInspection["Checks"]]&&
  polynomialInspection["SourceHash"]===FileHash[polynomialInspectionSource,"SHA256"]&&
  polynomialInspection["BaseSourceHash"]===FileHash[polynomialBase,"SHA256"]&&
  polynomialInspection["InputHashes"]===inputHashes&&polynomialInspection["TargetInputHash"]===targetInputHash&&
  polynomialInspection["MappingInputHash"]===inputHash&&polynomialInspection["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
polynomialOriginalFamily=DownValues[familyRows];
polynomialOriginalMap=DownValues[mapExpression];
gate["unchanged inspected family and mapping definitions",
  polynomialInspection["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"]===polynomialOriginalFamily&&
  polynomialInspection["OriginalMappingDefinitions"]===polynomialOriginalMap];

polynomialFamilyRows[transformed_,family_] := Module[
  {variables={v3,v4},pattern,numerator,denominator,powers,coefficient,polynomial,rows,
   reconstruction,residual,residualRows},
  pattern=Alternatives@@variables;
  denominator=bounded[Factor[Denominator[transformed]],{family,"outer family denominator"}];
  numerator=bounded[Expand[Numerator[transformed],pattern],{family,"selective family numerator expansion"}];
  gate["family numerator remains polynomial",PolynomialQ[numerator,variables]];
  powers=Exponent[denominator,#]&/@variables;
  gate["integer nonnegative family denominator powers",AllTrue[powers,IntegerQ[#]&&#>=0&]];
  coefficient=bounded[Cancel[denominator/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,powers}])],
    {family,"family denominator coefficient"}];
  gate["family denominator remains a Laurent monomial",FreeQ[coefficient,pattern]];
  gate["exact outer family denominator reconstruction",
    bounded[Expand[denominator-coefficient Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,powers}],pattern],
      {family,"denominator reconstruction"}]===0];
  polynomial=bounded[CoefficientRules[numerator,variables],{family,"family polynomial coefficients"}];
  gate["family coefficients independent of integration variables",FreeQ[Last/@polynomial,pattern]];
  gate["exact native family polynomial collection",bounded[Expand[numerator-
    Total[(Last[#] Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,First[#]}])&/@polynomial],pattern],
    {family,"native polynomial reconstruction"}]===0];
  rows=Association[Map[Function[entry,
    CutIntegral[family,Join[ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],powers-First[entry]]] ->
      bounded[Factor[Last[entry]/coefficient],{family,First[entry],"family coefficient factor"}]],polynomial]];
  reconstruction=Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral,value},
    value Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,-Drop[integral[[2]],2]}]],rows]];
  residual=bounded[Expand[denominator reconstruction-numerator,pattern],{family,"family polynomial residual"}];
  gate["complete family residual is polynomial",PolynomialQ[residual,variables]];
  residualRows=bounded[CoefficientRules[residual,variables],{family,"residual polynomial collection"}];
  gate["complete family Laurent coefficients reconstruct",And@@
    (bounded[zero[Last[#]],{family,First[#],"exact residual coefficient"}]&/@residualRows)];
  gate["both cut powers unchanged in polynomial family",
    And@@(Take[#[[2]],Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]===ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]&/@Keys[rows])];
  rows];

familyRows[expression_,family_] := polynomialFamilyRows[expression/.families[family]["UncutCoordinateRules"],family];
polynomialDispatch=DownValues[familyRows];
gate["only family collection changed",DownValues[mapExpression]===polynomialOriginalMap];
polynomialControlTimed=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[targetControlTask["Value"]/.coordinateRules],
  "complete accepted reference map with polynomial families"]];
polynomialControl=polynomialControlTimed[[2]];
gate["same complete accepted control target inventory",Sort[Keys[polynomialControl]]===Sort[Keys[targetFixture["Coefficients"]]]];
gate["complete accepted control coefficients agree",And@@KeyValueMap[
  Function[{key,value},bounded[zero[value-targetFixture["Coefficients"][key]],{"own reference control",key}]],polynomialControl]];
Print["POLYNOMIAL_REFERENCE_CONTROL_SECONDS ",polynomialControlTimed[[1]]];

polynomialActualRows=Table[
  gate["captured family-coordinate operation",row["Outcome"]["Operation"]==="family coordinates Together"&&
    !MissingQ[row["OperationInput"]]];
  atoms=bounded[extractAtoms[row["Equation"]],{row["ComponentIndex"],"actual group atoms"}];
  decomposition=decompose[First[atoms]];firstKey=First[Keys[decomposition]];
  support=Flatten[Position[List@@firstKey,_?(#>0&)]];
  family=SelectFirst[familyNames,Complement[support,families[#]["UncutIndices"]]==={}&,Missing["NoFamily"]];
  gate["actual captured family identified",!MissingQ[family]];
  familyInput=bounded[Cancel[Last[atoms] decomposition[firstKey]/
    (Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,List@@firstKey}])],"actual reference family input"]/.families[family]["UncutCoordinateRules"];
  gate["exact captured operation input reproduced",familyInput===row["OperationInput"]];
  Print["ACTUAL_POLYNOMIAL_FAMILY ",row["ComponentIndex"]," family ",family," input bytes ",ByteCount[familyInput]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[polynomialFamilyRows[familyInput,family]];
  Print["ACTUAL_POLYNOMIAL_FAMILY_SECONDS ",timed[[1]]," targets ",Length[timed[[2]]]];
  <|"ComponentIndex"->row["ComponentIndex"],"Family"->family,"Seconds"->timed[[1]],
    "InputBytes"->ByteCount[familyInput],"Coefficients"->timed[[2]]|>,{row,polynomialInspection["Rows"]}];
polynomialProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-family-polynomial-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[polynomialSource,"SHA256"],"InspectionHash"->FileHash[polynomialInspectionPath,"SHA256"],
  "BaseSourceHash"->FileHash[polynomialBase,"SHA256"],"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "TargetInputHash"->targetInputHash,"MappingInputHash"->inputHash,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->polynomialOriginalFamily,"OriginalMappingDefinitions"->polynomialOriginalMap,
  "Definitions"->DownValues[polynomialFamilyRows],"DispatchDefinitions"->polynomialDispatch,
  "ControlSeconds"->polynomialControlTimed[[1]],"ControlCoefficients"->polynomialControl,
  "ActualRows"->polynomialActualRows,"Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
polynomialDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_family_polynomial_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[polynomialDir],CreateDirectory[polynomialDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
polynomialOutput=FileNameJoin[{polynomialDir,"s08_result.wl"}];
polynomialSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[polynomialProof],"polynomial proof compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["polynomial proof file bound",StringLength[polynomialSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[polynomialOutput<>".tmp",polynomialSerialized,"Text"];
gate["polynomial proof exact native reload",Get[polynomialOutput<>".tmp"]===polynomialProof];
RenameFile[polynomialOutput<>".tmp",polynomialOutput,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{polynomialDir,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_family_polynomials"];Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_result/reference/s08_check_shared_piece_cache_before_fixture_selection.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-301", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9554, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s08_check_shared_piece_cache_before_fixture_selection.wls", "sha256": "8051b73618c0dccc910b2a353f8af7a9792eb72750f06730e489a76df541642e"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse input-bound polynomial packets across worker folders; preserve all algebra. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
reuseSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_shared_piece_cache.wls"}];
reuseSetupPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_check_Hgg_reference_map.wls"}];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[reuseSource,"Text"]]||IntegerString[FileHash[reuseSetupPath,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "4261bb809315d37609ba424f0e59969730cf68374273b5a145e7fe6257180e15",Quit[1]];
reuseSetupText=Import[reuseSetupPath,"Text"];
reuseBoundary=StringPosition[reuseSetupText,"\nreferenceConfigPath="];
If[Length[reuseBoundary]=!=1,Quit[1]];
reuseSetup=StringTake[reuseSetupText,First[First[reuseBoundary]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[reuseSetup],Quit[1]];ToExpression[reuseSetup,InputForm];
DownValues[externalOriginalMap]=referenceProof["OriginalAliasDefinitions"];
DownValues[mapExpression]=referenceProof["MappingDefinitions"];
DownValues[polynomialAdditivePieces]=proof["AdditivePiecesDefinitions"];
DownValues[polynomialPieceMap]=proof["PieceMappingDefinitions"];
reuseOriginalPiece=DownValues[polynomialPieceMap];
reuseAlgebra={DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[familyRows],DownValues[merge],
 DownValues[polynomialAdditivePieces],DownValues[certifyGroupMerge]};
pieceScientificHash=Hash[{proof["PieceScientificHash"],record["TargetInputHash"],
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hgg_factored_inputs.wls"}],"SHA256"]},"SHA256"];
reuseCache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_Hqg_polynomial_terms",IntegerString[pieceScientificHash,16]}];
gate["existing input-bound Hgg polynomial cache",DirectoryQ[reuseCache]&&$KernelID===0];

sharedPieceValid[packet_,binding_]:=AssociationQ[packet]&&
 Lookup[packet,"Binding",None]===binding&&TrueQ[Lookup[packet,"Accepted",False]]&&
 AssociationQ[Lookup[packet,"Checks",None]]&&Length[packet["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]];
sharedReadPiece[path_String,binding_Integer]:=Module[{saved,alternatives,packet},
 saved=If[FileExistsQ[path],Get[path],<||>];
 If[sharedPieceValid[saved,binding],Return[saved]];
 alternatives=DeleteCases[Sort[FileNames[FileNameTake[path],
   FileNames["kernel_*",DirectoryName[DirectoryName[path]]]]],path];
 Do[packet=Get[alternative];If[sharedPieceValid[packet,binding],
   AppendTo[sharedPieceHits,<|"Path"->alternative,"FileHash"->FileHash[alternative,"SHA256"],
     "Binding"->binding,"SavedSeconds"->Lookup[packet,"Seconds",0]|>];
   Print["REUSED_POLYNOMIAL_PIECE ",FileNameTake[DirectoryName[alternative]]," ",FileNameTake[alternative]];
   Return[packet]],{alternative,alternatives}];saved];
sharedPieceHits={};
reusePieceText=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hqg_polynomial_group.wls"}],"Text"];
reuseBegin=StringPosition[reusePieceText,"\npolynomialPieceMap[expression_]"];
reuseEnd=StringPosition[reusePieceText,"\n{controlSeconds,controlCandidate}="];
gate["unique entire original piece function",Length[reuseBegin]===1&&Length[reuseEnd]===1];
reusePieceOriginal=StringTake[reusePieceText,{First[First[reuseBegin]],First[First[reuseEnd]]-1}];
gate["complete original piece syntax",SyntaxQ[reusePieceOriginal]];
ToExpression[reusePieceOriginal,InputForm];
gate["exact accepted original piece function",DownValues[polynomialPieceMap]===reuseOriginalPiece];
reuseEdit="saved=If[FileExistsQ[path],Get[path],<||>];"->"saved=sharedReadPiece[path,binding];";
gate["single cache-read substitution",StringCount[reusePieceOriginal,First[reuseEdit]]===1];
reusePieceCandidate=StringReplace[reusePieceOriginal,reuseEdit];
gate["only checkpoint lookup changes",SyntaxQ[reusePieceCandidate]&&
 StringReplace[reusePieceCandidate,Reverse[reuseEdit]]===reusePieceOriginal];

reuseSelection=Catch[
 Do[Do[Module[{powers,value,pieces,bindings,paths,localPaths,groupPath,packet},
   powers=Keys[actual["Groups"]][[index]];
   value=Values[actual["Groups"]][[index]]/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,powers}]);
   If[ByteCount[value]>512000,Continue[]];
   pieces=polynomialAdditivePieces[value];bindings=Hash[{pieceScientificHash,#},"SHA256"]&/@pieces;
   localPaths=FileNameJoin[{reuseCache,"kernel_0",IntegerString[#,16]<>".wl"}]&/@bindings;
   If[AnyTrue[localPaths,FileExistsQ],Continue[]];
   paths=FileNames[IntegerString[#,16]<>".wl",FileNames["kernel_*",reuseCache]]&/@bindings;
   If[AnyTrue[paths,#==={}&],Continue[]];
   groupPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_Hgg_grouped",IntegerString[certificateGroupHash,16],
     "component_"<>ToString[actual["Component"]]<>"_group_"<>IntegerString[index,10,4]<>".wl"}];
   If[!FileExistsQ[groupPath],Continue[]];packet=Get[groupPath];
   If[!sharedPieceValid[packet,Hash[{certificateGroupHash,"component_"<>ToString[actual["Component"]],index,value},"SHA256"]]||
     !TrueQ[5<Lookup[packet,"Seconds",0]<600],Continue[]];
   Throw[<|"Component"->actual["Component"],"Group"->index,"Equation"->value,"Pieces"->pieces,
     "Bindings"->bindings,"Paths"->paths,"ReferencePath"->groupPath,"Reference"->packet|>,"ActualGroup"]],
  {index,Length[actual["Groups"]]}],{actual,certificateAtomProof["ActualGroups"]}];$Failed,"ActualGroup"];
gate["actual Hgg group has accepted pieces on other workers",AssociationQ[reuseSelection]];
reuseEquation=reuseSelection["Equation"];reuseReference=reuseSelection["Reference"];
Print["ACTUAL_SHARED_CACHE_INPUT ",InputForm[KeyTake[reuseSelection,{"Component","Group","Equation","Bindings"}]]];
reuseDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_shared_piece_cache_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[reuseDirectory],CreateDirectory[reuseDirectory]];
reuseEquationPacket=Join[KeyTake[reuseSelection,{"Component","Group","Equation","Pieces","Bindings"}],
 <|"Denominators"->denominators,"InputHashes"->record["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->record["TargetInputHash"]|>];
Put[reuseEquationPacket,FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_input_equation.wl"}]];
gate["exact readable input equation export",Get[FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_input_equation.wl"}]]===reuseEquationPacket];
reuseScratch=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_shared_piece_comparison",ToString[Environment["JOB_ID"]]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[reuseScratch],CreateDirectory[reuseScratch,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
DownValues[reuseNativeWrite]=DownValues[saveNative]/.saveNative->reuseNativeWrite;
gate["unchanged native comparison writer",(DownValues[reuseNativeWrite]/.reuseNativeWrite->saveNative)===DownValues[saveNative]];
{reuseFreshSeconds,reuseFresh}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{saveNative},
 saveNative[value_,path_]:=reuseNativeWrite[value,FileNameJoin[{reuseScratch,FileNameTake[path]}]];
 bounded[polynomialPieceMap[reuseEquation],"fresh complete actual Hgg group"]]];
gate["fresh complete group matches own accepted output",Sort[Keys[reuseFresh]]===Sort[Keys[reuseReference["Coefficients"]]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===reuseReference["Coefficients"][#1]||zero[#2-reuseReference["Coefficients"][#1]])&,reuseFresh]];
ToExpression[reusePieceCandidate,InputForm];reuseCandidatePiece=DownValues[polynomialPieceMap];
gate["every algebraic implementation remains unchanged",reuseAlgebra==={DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[familyRows],
 DownValues[merge],DownValues[polynomialAdditivePieces],DownValues[certifyGroupMerge]}];
{reuseCachedSeconds,reuseCached}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{saveNative},
 saveNative[value_,path_]:=reuseNativeWrite[value,FileNameJoin[{reuseScratch,FileNameTake[path]}]];
 bounded[polynomialPieceMap[reuseEquation],"shared-cache complete actual Hgg group"]]];
gate["every complete coefficient equals fresh and own accepted output",Sort[Keys[reuseCached]]===Sort[Keys[reuseFresh]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===reuseFresh[#1]||zero[#2-reuseFresh[#1]])&,reuseCached]];
gate["all actual pieces reused from another worker",Length[sharedPieceHits]===Length[reuseSelection["Pieces"]]&&
 Sort[Lookup[sharedPieceHits,"Binding"]]===Sort[reuseSelection["Bindings"]]];
gate["executed shared-cache speedup",reuseCachedSeconds<reuseFreshSeconds];
reuseResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-shared-piece-cache-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[reuseSource,"SHA256"],"SetupSourceHash"->FileHash[reuseSetupPath,"SHA256"],
 "InputHashes"->record["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->record["TargetInputHash"],
 "PolynomialProofHash"->FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],"ExternalProofHash"->FileHash[referenceProofPath,"SHA256"],
 "PieceScientificHash"->pieceScientificHash,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},
 "ActualInput"->reuseEquationPacket,"ReferenceHash"->FileHash[reuseSelection["ReferencePath"],"SHA256"],
 "OriginalPieceDefinitions"->reuseOriginalPiece,"CandidatePieceDefinitions"->reuseCandidatePiece,
 "ValidityDefinitions"->DownValues[sharedPieceValid],"ReadDefinitions"->DownValues[sharedReadPiece],
 "AlgebraDefinitions"->reuseAlgebra,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"SpeedupObserved"->True,
 "FreshSeconds"->reuseFreshSeconds,"CachedSeconds"->reuseCachedSeconds,"ReusedPieces"->sharedPieceHits,
 "FreshCoefficients"->reuseFresh,"CachedCoefficients"->reuseCached,"Checks"->checks,
 "PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
saveNative[reuseResult,FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
 "component"->reuseSelection["Component"],"group"->reuseSelection["Group"],
 "fresh_seconds"->reuseFreshSeconds,"cached_seconds"->reuseCachedSeconds,
 "reused_pieces"->Length[sharedPieceHits],"cache_namespace"->IntegerString[pieceScientificHash,16],
 "peak_kernel_memory_bytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[]|>,"RawJSON"];
DeleteDirectory[reuseScratch,DeleteContents->True];
Print["PASS: s08_check_shared_piece_cache"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
reuseCachedTest=StringReplace[reusePieceCandidate,reuseWorkerEdit];
gate["comparison changes only the empty worker directory",SyntaxQ[reuseFreshTest]&&SyntaxQ[reuseCachedTest]&&
 StringReplace[reuseFreshTest,Reverse[reuseWorkerEdit]]===reusePieceOriginal&&
 StringReplace[reuseCachedTest,Reverse[reuseWorkerEdit]]===reusePieceCandidate];
reuseCompactRelative="Hgg/s08_compact_groups_result/s08_result.wl";
reuseCompactPath=FileNameJoin[{root,reuseCompactRelative}];
reuseCompactReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[reuseCompactPath],"s08_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted own compact grouping",TrueQ[reuseCompactReceipt["passed"]]&&
 reuseCompactReceipt["result_sha256"][reuseCompactRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[reuseCompactPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
reuseCompact=Get[reuseCompactPath];
gate["same own grouping inputs and native versions",reuseCompact["InputHashes"]===record["InputHashes"]&&
 reuseCompact["TargetInputHash"]===record["TargetInputHash"]&&
 reuseCompact["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 TrueQ[reuseCompact["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&And@@Values[reuseCompact["Checks"]]];
DownValues[hggOriginalGrouping]=First[reuseCompact["CandidateDefinitions"]];
DownValues[certifyGrouping]=certificateAtomProof["GroupingCertificateDefinitions"];
reuseActualGroups=Prepend[certificateAtomProof["ActualGroups"],
 <|"Component"->component,"Groups"->bounded[hggOriginalGrouping[record["Expression"]],"own exact grouping"]|>];

reuseSelection=Catch[
 Do[Do[Module[{powers,value,pieces,bindings,paths,groupPath,packet},
   powers=Keys[actual["Groups"]][[index]];
   value=Values[actual["Groups"]][[index]]/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,powers}]);
   pieces=polynomialAdditivePieces[value];bindings=Hash[{pieceScientificHash,#},"SHA256"]&/@pieces;
   paths=FileNames[IntegerString[#,16]<>".wl",FileNames["kernel_*",reuseCache]]&/@bindings;
   If[AnyTrue[paths,#==={}&],Continue[]];
   groupPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_Hgg_grouped",IntegerString[certificateGroupHash,16],
     "component_"<>ToString[actual["Component"]]<>"_group_"<>IntegerString[index,10,4]<>".wl"}];
   If[!FileExistsQ[groupPath],Continue[]];packet=Get[groupPath];
   If[!sharedPieceValid[packet,Hash[{certificateGroupHash,"component_"<>ToString[actual["Component"]],index,value},"SHA256"]],Continue[]];
   Throw[<|"Component"->actual["Component"],"Group"->index,"Equation"->value,"Pieces"->pieces,
     "Bindings"->bindings,"Paths"->paths,"ReferencePath"->groupPath,"Reference"->packet|>,"ActualGroup"]],
  {index,Length[actual["Groups"]]}],{actual,reuseActualGroups}];$Failed,"ActualGroup"];
gate["actual Hgg group has accepted pieces on other workers",AssociationQ[reuseSelection]];
reuseEquation=reuseSelection["Equation"];reuseReference=reuseSelection["Reference"];
Print["ACTUAL_SHARED_CACHE_INPUT ",InputForm[KeyTake[reuseSelection,{"Component","Group","Equation","Bindings"}]]];
reuseDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_shared_piece_cache_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[reuseDirectory],CreateDirectory[reuseDirectory]];
reuseEquationPacket=Join[KeyTake[reuseSelection,{"Component","Group","Equation","Pieces","Bindings"}],
 <|"Denominators"->denominators,"InputHashes"->record["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->record["TargetInputHash"]|>];
Put[reuseEquationPacket,FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_input_equation.wl"}]];
gate["exact readable input equation export",Get[FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_input_equation.wl"}]]===reuseEquationPacket];
reuseScratch=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s08_shared_piece_comparison",ToString[Environment["JOB_ID"]]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[reuseScratch],CreateDirectory[reuseScratch,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
DownValues[reuseNativeWrite]=DownValues[saveNative]/.saveNative->reuseNativeWrite;
gate["unchanged native comparison writer",(DownValues[reuseNativeWrite]/.reuseNativeWrite->saveNative)===DownValues[saveNative]];
ToExpression[reuseFreshTest,InputForm];
{reuseFreshSeconds,reuseFresh}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{saveNative},
 saveNative[value_,path_]:=reuseNativeWrite[value,FileNameJoin[{reuseScratch,FileNameTake[path]}]];
 bounded[polynomialPieceMap[reuseEquation],"fresh complete actual Hgg group"]]];
gate["fresh complete group matches own accepted output",Sort[Keys[reuseFresh]]===Sort[Keys[reuseReference["Coefficients"]]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===reuseReference["Coefficients"][#1]||zero[#2-reuseReference["Coefficients"][#1]])&,reuseFresh]];
ToExpression[reuseCachedTest,InputForm];
gate["every algebraic implementation remains unchanged",reuseAlgebra==={DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[familyRows],
 DownValues[merge],DownValues[polynomialAdditivePieces],DownValues[certifyGroupMerge]}];
{reuseCachedSeconds,reuseCached}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{saveNative},
 saveNative[value_,path_]:=reuseNativeWrite[value,FileNameJoin[{reuseScratch,FileNameTake[path]}]];
 bounded[polynomialPieceMap[reuseEquation],"shared-cache complete actual Hgg group"]]];
gate["every complete coefficient equals fresh and own accepted output",Sort[Keys[reuseCached]]===Sort[Keys[reuseFresh]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===reuseFresh[#1]||zero[#2-reuseFresh[#1]])&,reuseCached]];
gate["all actual pieces reused from another worker",Length[sharedPieceHits]===Length[reuseSelection["Pieces"]]&&
 Sort[Lookup[sharedPieceHits,"Binding"]]===Sort[reuseSelection["Bindings"]]];
gate["executed shared-cache speedup",reuseCachedSeconds<reuseFreshSeconds];
ToExpression[reusePieceCandidate,InputForm];reuseCandidatePiece=DownValues[polynomialPieceMap];
reuseResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-shared-piece-cache-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[reuseSource,"SHA256"],"SetupSourceHash"->FileHash[reuseSetupPath,"SHA256"],
 "InputHashes"->record["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->record["TargetInputHash"],
 "PolynomialProofHash"->FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],"ExternalProofHash"->FileHash[referenceProofPath,"SHA256"],
 "GroupingProofHash"->FileHash[reuseCompactPath,"SHA256"],
 "PieceScientificHash"->pieceScientificHash,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},
 "ActualInput"->reuseEquationPacket,"ReferenceHash"->FileHash[reuseSelection["ReferencePath"],"SHA256"],
 "OriginalPieceDefinitions"->reuseOriginalPiece,"CandidatePieceDefinitions"->reuseCandidatePiece,
 "ValidityDefinitions"->DownValues[sharedPieceValid],"ReadDefinitions"->DownValues[sharedReadPiece],
 "AlgebraDefinitions"->reuseAlgebra,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"SpeedupObserved"->True,
 "FreshSeconds"->reuseFreshSeconds,"CachedSeconds"->reuseCachedSeconds,"ReusedPieces"->sharedPieceHits,
 "FreshCoefficients"->reuseFresh,"CachedCoefficients"->reuseCached,"Checks"->checks,
 "PeakKernelMemoryBytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[],"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
saveNative[reuseResult,FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{reuseDirectory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
 "component"->reuseSelection["Component"],"group"->reuseSelection["Group"],
 "fresh_seconds"->reuseFreshSeconds,"cached_seconds"->reuseCachedSeconds,
 "reused_pieces"->Length[sharedPieceHits],"cache_namespace"->IntegerString[pieceScientificHash,16],
 "peak_kernel_memory_bytes"->MaxMemoryUsed[]|>,"RawJSON"];
DeleteDirectory[reuseScratch,DeleteContents->True];
reuseEmptyWorker=FileNameJoin[{reuseCache,"kernel_comparison_"<>ToString[Environment["JOB_ID"]]}];
If[DirectoryQ[reuseEmptyWorker]&&FileNames["*",reuseEmptyWorker]==={},DeleteDirectory[reuseEmptyWorker]];
Print["PASS: s08_check_shared_piece_cache"];Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_result/reference/s08_check_streamed_numerator_before_factor_support.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-304", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7748, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s08_check_streamed_numerator_before_factor_support.wls", "sha256": "46b759b64158f6de7549420e3ae92bec287b9869df44bc72308a56d7b6ae2bd9"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve the accepted denominator equations while accumulating one row at a time. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
streamSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_check_streamed_numerator.wls"}];
streamBaseline = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[streamBaseline, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "e42c8bec95f9e856911436024b9b39cf2f1b6fd8bac4c3f345dbfaa63c173fdc", Quit[1]];
streamText = Import[streamBaseline, "Text"];
streamStop = First[First[StringPosition[streamText, "\nslots = Quiet["]]];
streamPrefix = StringTake[streamText, streamStop - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[streamPrefix], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[streamPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete streamed numerator source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[streamSource, "Text"]]];
originalSumDefinitions = DownValues[factoredDenominatorSum];

streamedDenominatorSum[terms_List, purpose_] := Module[
  {nonzero, packets, expression, rational, factors, numerical, symbolic, unit, factorMap,
   allFactors, commonPowers, commonDenominator, row, multiplier, numerator, next,
   factoredNumerator, answer, seconds, evidence, rowCount = 0, peakRowBytes = 0},
  nonzero = DeleteCases[terms, 0];
  If[nonzero === {}, Return[<|"Value" -> 0, "Evidence" -> <|"TermCount" -> 0|>|>]];
  packets = Table[
    expression = nonzero[[i]];
    rational = bounded[Together[expression], {purpose, "individual rational term", i}];
    factors = bounded[FactorList[Denominator[rational]], {purpose, "denominator factors", i}];
    numerical = Select[factors, NumberQ[First[#]] &];
    symbolic = Select[factors, !NumberQ[First[#]] &];
    unit = Times @@ (Power @@@ numerical);
    factorMap = Association[Rule @@@ symbolic];
    gate["exact individual denominator factorization", zero[Denominator[rational] - unit (Times @@ (Power @@@ symbolic))]];
    gate["unique positive denominator factor powers", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ symbolic] &&
      AllTrue[Values[factorMap], IntegerQ[#] && # > 0 &] && unit =!= 0];
    <|"Numerator" -> Numerator[rational], "Denominator" -> Denominator[rational], "Unit" -> unit,
      "FactorPowers" -> factorMap, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[expression]|>, {i, Length[nonzero]}];
  allFactors = Union[Flatten[Keys[#["FactorPowers"]] & /@ packets]];
  commonPowers = Table[Max[Lookup[#["FactorPowers"], factor, 0] & /@ packets], {factor, allFactors}];
  commonDenominator = Times @@ MapThread[Power, {allFactors, commonPowers}];
  evidence = <|"TermCount" -> Length[nonzero], "FactorCount" -> Length[allFactors],
    "FactorPowers" -> AssociationThread[allFactors, commonPowers],
    "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[terms], "CommonDenominatorBytes" -> ByteCount[commonDenominator]|>;
  Print["DENOMINATOR_SUPPORT ", purpose, " ", InputForm[evidence]];
  numerator = 0;
  seconds = First[AbsoluteTiming[Do[
    multiplier = (Times @@ MapThread[Power, {allFactors,
      commonPowers - (Lookup[packets[[i]]["FactorPowers"], #, 0] & /@ allFactors)}])/packets[[i]]["Unit"];
    gate["exact common-denominator embedding", bounded[
      zero[packets[[i]]["Denominator"] multiplier/commonDenominator - 1], {purpose, "denominator embedding", i}]];
    row = bounded[Expand[packets[[i]]["Numerator"] multiplier], {purpose, "polynomial numerator", i}];
    peakRowBytes = Max[peakRowBytes, ByteCount[row]];
    next = bounded[numerator + row, {purpose, "streamed numerator addition", i}];
    gate["exact streamed numerator addition", bounded[Expand[next - numerator - row] === 0,
      {purpose, "streamed addition reconstruction", i}]];
    numerator = next; Clear[next, row]; rowCount++;
    If[Mod[i, 16] === 0 || i === Length[packets],
      Print["STREAMED_NUMERATOR ", purpose, " row ", i, "/", Length[packets],
        " numerator_bytes ", ByteCount[numerator], " kernel_memory ", MemoryInUse[]]; ClearSystemCache[]],
    {i, Length[packets]}]]];
  gate["exact complete numerator assembly", rowCount === Length[packets]];
  Print["DENOMINATOR_NUMERATOR ", purpose, " bytes ", ByteCount[numerator], " seconds ", seconds];
  Clear[packets]; ClearSystemCache[];
  factoredNumerator = cancelKnownDenominatorFactors[numerator, allFactors, commonPowers, purpose];
  gate["exact final numerator factorization", bounded[Expand[numerator - factoredNumerator] === 0,
    {purpose, "final numerator reconstruction"}]];
  answer = factoredNumerator/commonDenominator;
  gate["exact final denominator reconstruction", bounded[zero[answer commonDenominator - factoredNumerator],
    {purpose, "final denominator reconstruction"}]];
  <|"Value" -> answer, "Evidence" -> Join[evidence, <|"NumeratorBytes" -> ByteCount[numerator],
    "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[answer], "PeakRowBytes" -> peakRowBytes, "NumeratorAssemblySeconds" -> seconds,
    "ExactTermwiseReconstructionPassed" -> True|>]|>];

streamInputHash = Hash[{FileHash[streamSource, "SHA256"], inputHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
streamDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_streamed_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[streamDir], CreateDirectory[streamDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
streamControl = streamedDenominatorSum[controlTerms, "own accepted original control"];
gate["streamed own accepted original coefficient equality", bounded[
  zero[streamControl["Value"] - controlValue], "streamed control equality"]];
streamIndex = SelectFirst[Range[Length[tasks]],
  !FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[#, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]] &];
gate["actual unfinished component selected", IntegerQ[streamIndex]];
streamRaw = rawTargetComponents[[streamIndex]];
gate["actual component exact reconstruction accepted", TrueQ[streamRaw["ReconstructionPassed"]] &&
  And @@ Values[streamRaw["Checks"]]];
streamRules = Association[reduction["Rules"]];
gate["actual component complete Kira coverage", Complement[Keys[streamRaw["Coefficients"]], Keys[streamRules]] === {}];
streamMasters = Union[Cases[Values[KeyTake[streamRules, Keys[streamRaw["Coefficients"]]]], _CutIntegral, Infinity]];
streamMaster = First[streamMasters];
streamTerms = KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[streamRules[#1], streamMaster] &, streamRaw["Coefficients"]];
Print["ACTUAL_COEFFICIENT ", streamIndex, " ", InputForm[streamMaster], " bytes ", ByteCount[streamTerms]];
Print["SMALLEST_NONZERO_INPUT_TERM ", InputForm[First[MinimalBy[DeleteCases[streamTerms, 0], ByteCount]]]];
{streamSeconds, streamPacket} = AbsoluteTiming[streamedDenominatorSum[streamTerms, {streamIndex, streamMaster}]];
gate["actual coefficient exact streamed reconstruction", TrueQ[streamPacket["Evidence"]["ExactTermwiseReconstructionPassed"]]];
streamResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-streamed-numerator-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[streamSource, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[streamBaseline, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> streamInputHash, "ProductionInputHash" -> inputHash,
  "Definitions" -> DownValues[streamedDenominatorSum], "OriginalDefinitions" -> originalSumDefinitions,
  "ControlMaster" -> controlMaster, "ControlValue" -> streamControl["Value"],
  "ComponentIndex" -> streamIndex, "Task" -> KeyDrop[tasks[[streamIndex]], "Value"],
  "Master" -> streamMaster, "Coefficient" -> streamPacket, "Seconds" -> streamSeconds,
  "Checks" -> checks, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[], "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
putCompressed[streamResult, FileNameJoin[{streamDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{streamDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "component_index" -> streamIndex, "seconds" -> streamSeconds,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_check_streamed_numerator"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s08_result/reference/s08_coefficient_check_before_rational_sum.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-305", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6190, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s08_coefficient_check_before_rational_sum.wls", "sha256": "46e5b7ae4c248c82cffe2e5e8d9dd5d789224fbb05365cc71dbc369eae2aa84d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Inspect the actual timed-out real coefficient and validate on-shell compaction. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
profileRoot = Directory[];
profileSource = FileNameJoin[{profileRoot, "common", "s08_coefficient_check.wls"}];
profileMapper = FileNameJoin[{profileRoot, "common", "s08_map_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[profileMapper, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "e23a79589bfce183535a6f1166eda799a9f119168feb9cff1b13feb669c8b21f", Quit[1]];
profileText = Import[profileMapper, "Text"];
profileStop = First[First[StringPosition[profileText, "\ncomponents = {}; targets = {};"]]];
ToExpression[StringTake[profileText, profileStop - 1], InputForm];
gate["complete coefficient check syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[profileSource, "Text"]]];
gate["comparison uses accepted Hqqprime tensor", channel === "Hqqprime" &&
  IntegerString[FileHash[spinPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    "07679643127071c38d0522479236858ff7fd1f4e770d22d65572072f56e03d9f"];
profileReductionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s05_result", "reference",
  "s05_real_spin_response_before_parallel_spin_checks.wls"}];
gate["accepted on-shell reduction source", IntegerString[FileHash[profileReductionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "46c45f60a0f97c18d430cd8a3ee05182bc5e10f5deb424e8b69487d76e75e500"];
profileReductionText = Import[profileReductionPath, "Text"];
profileReductionBegin = First[First[StringPosition[profileReductionText, "algebraicReduceOne[value_] := Module["]]];
profileReductionEnd = First[First[StringPosition[profileReductionText, "\npVector = Factor["]]];
profileReductionCode = StringTake[profileReductionText, {profileReductionBegin, profileReductionEnd - 1}];
ToExpression[profileReductionCode, InputForm];
transverseConstraint = spin["TransverseConstraint"];
gate["saved transverse constraint has no cut coordinates", FreeQ[transverseConstraint, a | b]];
profileHash = Hash[{FileHash[profileSource, "SHA256"], inputHashes,
  FileHash[profileReductionPath, "SHA256"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
profileCache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_coefficient_check", IntegerString[profileHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[profileCache], CreateDirectory[profileCache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
profileTask = First[tasks];
Print["COEFFICIENT_INPUT ", KeyDrop[profileTask, "Value"]];
profileValue = profileTask["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
{profileMapSeconds, profileCoefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[profileValue], "actual failed raw map"]];
put[<|"InputHash" -> profileHash, "Task" -> KeyDrop[profileTask, "Value"],
  "Coefficients" -> profileCoefficients, "MappingChecks" -> checks|>,
  FileNameJoin[{profileCache, "s08_raw_map.wl"}]];
profileMaster = First[Sort[reduction["Masters"]]];
profileRuleMap = Association[reduction["Rules"]];
profileMissing = Complement[Keys[profileCoefficients], Keys[profileRuleMap]];
profileRuleMap = Join[profileRuleMap, AssociationThread[profileMissing, profileMissing]];
profileTerms = KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[profileRuleMap[#1], profileMaster] &, profileCoefficients];
profileInputEvidence = <|"InputBytes" -> ByteCount[profileValue], "RawMapSeconds" -> profileMapSeconds,
  "RawCoefficientBytes" -> ByteCount[profileCoefficients], "RawTargetCount" -> Length[profileCoefficients],
  "Master" -> profileMaster, "MasterTermBytes" -> ByteCount[profileTerms],
  "NonzeroMasterTerms" -> Count[profileTerms, Except[0]],
  "TransverseDegrees" -> DeleteDuplicates[Exponent[#, transverseK] & /@ Values[profileCoefficients]],
  "CoefficientSymbols" -> globalSymbols[Values[profileCoefficients]]|>;
Print["COEFFICIENT_INPUT_EVIDENCE ", InputForm[profileInputEvidence]];
put[profileInputEvidence, FileNameJoin[{profileCache, "s08_input_evidence.wl"}]];
profileCompact = <||>; profileTimings = {};
KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, value}, Module[{seconds, compact},
  Print["COMPACT_CUT_COEFFICIENT ", InputForm[integral], " bytes ", ByteCount[value]];
  {seconds, compact} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[algebraicReduceOne[value], {"native on-shell compaction", integral}]];
  AssociateTo[profileCompact, integral -> compact];
  AppendTo[profileTimings, <|"Integral" -> integral, "Seconds" -> seconds,
    "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[value], "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[compact]|>]]], profileCoefficients];
gate["compaction retains complete cut inventory", Keys[profileCompact] === Keys[profileCoefficients]];
put[<|"InputHash" -> profileHash, "Coefficients" -> profileCompact, "Timings" -> profileTimings,
  "Checks" -> checks|>, FileNameJoin[{profileCache, "s08_compact_map.wl"}]];
profileRemaining = Union[Cases[Total[KeyValueMap[Times, profileCompact]] /. reduction["Rules"], _CutIntegral, Infinity]];
{profileAssemblySeconds, profileReduced} = AbsoluteTiming[
  referenceCoefficients[profileCompact, profileRemaining, "on-shell coefficient comparison"]];
gate["compacted reduction exactly reconstructs", bounded[zero[
  (Total[KeyValueMap[Times, profileCompact]] /. reduction["Rules"]) -
  Total[KeyValueMap[Times, profileReduced]]], "compacted master reconstruction"]];
profileResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-coefficient-compaction-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[profileSource, "SHA256"], "MapperSourceHash" -> FileHash[profileMapper, "SHA256"],
  "ReductionSourceHash" -> FileHash[profileReductionPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> profileHash,
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "Task" -> KeyDrop[profileTask, "Value"],
  "InputEvidence" -> profileInputEvidence, "Timings" -> profileTimings,
  "CompactCoefficientBytes" -> ByteCount[profileCompact], "MasterAssemblySeconds" -> profileAssemblySeconds,
  "ReducedCoefficients" -> profileReduced, "OnShellReductionCode" -> profileReductionCode,
  "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
profileDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_coefficient_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[profileDir], CreateDirectory[profileDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[profileResult, FileNameJoin[{profileDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{profileDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel,
  "checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_coefficient_check"]; Quit[0];

```
