```wolfram
  gate["native worker write namespaces are disjoint",DuplicateFreeQ[Lookup[workerResults,"Directory"]]&&
   FreeQ[Lookup[workerResults,"Directory"],partitionKernelDirectory[]]&&
   AllTrue[Lookup[workerResults,"Directory"],StringStartsQ[#,"kernel_"<>partitionJobTag<>"_"]&]];
  directory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_partition_interface_result"}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory]];
  result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-partition-interface-v1","Channel"->channel,
   "SourceHash"->FileHash[partitionSource,"SHA256"],"BaseHash"->FileHash[partitionBase,"SHA256"],
   "InputHashes"->inputHashes,"TargetInputHash"->targetInputHash,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},
   "PartitionCount"->partitionCount,"Partitions"->sets,"WorkerResults"->workerResults,

   "worker_directories"->Lookup[workerResults,"Directory"],"miss_seconds"->partitionMissSeconds,
   "hit_seconds"->partitionHitSeconds,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
  CloseKernels[];Print["PASS: s08_Hgg_partition_interface"];Quit[0]]];
```

```wolfram
    receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
  proof=Get[proofPath];
  gate["unchanged own response comparison inputs",proof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-response-only-native-read-v1" &&
    proof["Channel"]===channel && TrueQ[proof["OwnAcceptedComparison"]] && And@@Values[proof["Checks"]] &&
    proof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion} &&
    proof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_check_Hgg_response_read.wls"}],"SHA256"] &&
    proof["OwnHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,proof["OwnFile"]}],"SHA256"] &&

    proof["OwnManifestHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,DirectoryName[proof["OwnFile"]],"s05_payload_manifest.json"}],"SHA256"] &&

hggResponseConfigure[] := (

hggResponseNew=If[hggResponseMode==="targets",

  "hggResponseConfigure[];\nhggRunText=hggReplace[hggRunText,\"hggInitializeTasks[];\",\"hggInitializeTasks[];hggResponseInstall[];\"];\n"<>hggResponseOld];
```

```wolfram
 rational=Together[expression];numerator=Numerator[rational];denominator=Factor[Denominator[rational]/.spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]];
 gate["original family numerator polynomial",PolynomialQ[numerator,variables]];
 powers=Exponent[denominator,#]&/@polynomialVariables;
 constant=Cancel[denominator/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,powers}])];
 gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial",FreeQ[constant,Alternatives@@polynomialVariables]];
 inputRules=CoefficientRules[numerator,variables];
 inputReconstruction=Total[(Last[#] Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,First[#]}])&/@inputRules];
 gate["original numerator coefficients reconstruct",zero[inputReconstruction-numerator]];
 pieces=Map[Function[entry,Module[{monomial,shifted,shiftRules,shiftReconstruction},
   monomial=Times@@MapThread[Power,{variables,First[entry]}];shifted=monomial/.spec["UncutCoordinateRules"];
   shiftRules=CoefficientRules[Expand[shifted],polynomialVariables];
   shiftReconstruction=Total[(Last[#] Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,First[#]}])&/@shiftRules];
   gate["loop monomial substitution reconstructs",zero[shiftReconstruction-shifted]];
   Association[(First[#]->Last[entry] Last[#])&/@shiftRules]]],inputRules];
 polynomial=Merge[pieces,Total];
 rows=Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{key,value},CutIntegral[family,Join[ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],powers-key]]->Factor[Together[value/constant]]],polynomial];
 rows=Select[rows,#=!=0&];
 reconstruction=Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral,coefficient},coefficient Times@@MapThread[Power,{polynomialVariables,-Drop[integral[[2]],2]}]],rows]];
 gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct",zero[reconstruction-(expression/.spec["UncutCoordinateRules"])]];rows];
candidateFamilyDefinitions=DownValues[familyRows];
{controlSeconds,controlCandidate}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[controlValue],"own polynomial group map"]];
gate["every own accepted group coefficient unchanged",Sort[Keys[controlCandidate]]===Sort[Keys[control["Coefficients"]]]&&And@@KeyValueMap[zero[#2-control["Coefficients"][#1]]&,controlCandidate]];
{blockedSeconds,blockedCoefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[blocked["Value"]],"recorded blocked polynomial map"]];
proof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-polynomial-family-group-v1","Channel"->channel,"Accepted"->True,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,
 "InputHashes"->blocked["InputHashes"],"TargetInputHash"->blocked["TargetInputHash"],"GroupBinding"->blocked["GroupBinding"],
 "Component"->blocked["Component"],"Group"->blocked["Group"],"Coefficients"->blockedCoefficients,
 "OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->originalFamilyDefinitions,"CandidateFamilyDefinitions"->candidateFamilyDefinitions,"PolynomialVariables"->polynomialVariables,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"MapperHash"->FileHash[mapper,"SHA256"],"BlockedInputHash"->FileHash[blockedPath,"SHA256"],
 "OwnComparisonHash"->FileHash[ownPath,"SHA256"],"OwnReceiptHash"->FileHash[ownReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"ControlHash"->FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"],
 "OriginalControlSeconds"->control["Seconds"],"ControlSeconds"->controlSeconds,"BlockedSeconds"->blockedSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_polynomial_group_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
saveNative[value_,path_]:=Module[{serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[value],InputForm]<>"]\n"},gate["native file bound",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[path<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];gate["exact native export",Get[path<>".tmp"]===value];RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True]];
proofPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_result.wl"}];saveNative[proof,proofPath];
checkpoint=<|"Binding"->blocked["GroupBinding"],"Accepted"->True,"Coefficients"->blockedCoefficients,"Checks"->checks,"Seconds"->blockedSeconds,"InputBytes"->ByteCount[blocked["Value"]],"PolynomialProofHash"->FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"]|>;
checkpointPath=FileNameJoin[{groupCache,"component_"<>ToString[blocked["Component"]]<>"_group_"<>IntegerString[blocked["Group"],10,4]<>".wl"}];gate["no accepted checkpoint overwritten",!FileExistsQ[checkpointPath]];saveNative[checkpoint,checkpointPath];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,"original_control_seconds"->control["Seconds"],"control_seconds"->controlSeconds,"blocked_seconds"->blockedSeconds,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_map_Hqg_polynomial_group"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s08_result/reference/s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-326", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 15352, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls", "sha256": "e23a79589bfce183535a6f1166eda799a9f119168feb9cff1b13feb669c8b21f"} -->
```wolfram
(* Map new spin numerators with the unchanged accepted real-integral mapper. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_real_spin.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  Print["FAIL: time bound ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["FAIL: memory bound ", label]; Quit[3]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_inputs.json"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
originalMapperPath = FileNameJoin[{root, config["original_mapper"]}];
gate["pinned original mapper", IntegerString[FileHash[originalMapperPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === config["original_mapper_sha256"]];
originalText = Import[originalMapperPath, "Text"];
originalBlock = StringTake[originalText, {First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "merge[pieces_List]"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "mapTask[task_]"]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged mapping functions", StringContainsQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"], originalBlock]];
spinPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
spin = Get[spinPath]; library = Get[libraryPath];
gate["accepted real spin input", spin["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-real-response-v1" &&
  spin["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[spin["Checks"]]];
gate["accepted scalar reuse library", library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
geometryOriginal = readLibrary["s02"]; reductionOriginal = readLibrary["s04"];
gate["accepted geometry and reduction", geometryOriginal["Accepted"] && reductionOriginal["Accepted"]];
scalarConventionRules = {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23};
geometry = geometryOriginal /. scalarConventionRules;
reduction = reductionOriginal /. scalarConventionRules;
denominators = geometry["OnCutUncutPropagators"]; directions = geometry["UncutDirections"];
families = geometry["Families"]; familyNames = Keys[families];
commonBasis = geometry["BasisMomenta"];
commonCoordinates[value_] := Coefficient[Expand[value], #] & /@ commonBasis;
commonDot[left_, right_] := Factor[commonCoordinates[left].geometry["CommonGram"].commonCoordinates[right] /. geometry["CutRules"]];
momentumRules = {k2 -> First[geometry["LoopMomenta"]], k3 -> geometry["RecoilMomentum"] - First[geometry["LoopMomenta"]]};
gate["same cut momenta", And @@ (Expand[#] === 0 & /@ ((spin["CutMomenta"] /. momentumRules) - geometry["CutMomenta"]))];
gate["same positive-energy support", (spin["CutEnergySupport"] /. momentumRules) === geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]];
rows = spin["RealScalarProducts"]; oldValues = rows[[All, 3]];
targetValues = (commonDot[#[[1]] /. momentumRules, #[[2]] /. momentumRules] &) /@ rows;
globalSymbols[value_] := DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]];
coordinateUnknowns = Complement[globalSymbols[oldValues], globalSymbols[geometry["CommonGram"]]];
coordinateSolutions = Solve[Thread[oldValues == targetValues], coordinateUnknowns];
gate["unique loop-coordinate conversion", Length[coordinateSolutions] === 1 && FreeQ[coordinateSolutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
coordinateRules = First[coordinateSolutions];
gate["all scalar products reconstruct", And @@ (zero /@ ((oldValues /. coordinateRules) - targetValues))];
gate["coordinate change preserves measured transverse constraint", FreeQ[spin["TransverseConstraint"], Alternatives @@ coordinateUnknowns]];

merge[pieces_List] := If[pieces === {}, <||>,
  Select[Merge[pieces, Factor[Together[Total[#]]] &], # =!= 0 &]];

(* All partial-fraction coefficients are solved from the actual affine
   propagators. No angular integral or phase-space formula is used. *)
decompose[powers_List] := decompose[powers] = Module[
  {support, relations, relation, constant, pieces, lowered},
  support = Flatten[Position[powers, _?(# > 0 &)]];
  If[support === {}, Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  If[Length[support] <= 2 && MatrixRank[directions[[support]]] === Length[support],
    Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  relations = NullSpace[Transpose[directions[[support]]]];
  relation = SelectFirst[relations, !zero[#.denominators[[support]]] &, $Failed];
  gate["nonzero affine relation for dependent propagators", relation =!= $Failed];
  constant = Factor[relation.denominators[[support]]];
  gate["relation constant is independent of loop coordinates", FreeQ[constant, a | b]];
  pieces = MapThread[Function[{position, coefficient},
    If[coefficient === 0, <||>,
      lowered = ReplacePart[powers, position -> powers[[position]] - 1];
      Map[Factor[coefficient #/constant] &, decompose[lowered]]]], {support, relation}];
  merge[pieces]];

extractAtoms[expression_] := Module[{rational, factors, powers, found, ratio, prefactor},
  rational = Together[expression];
  factors = Rest[FactorList[Denominator[rational]]];
  powers = ConstantArray[0, Length[denominators]];
  Do[If[!FreeQ[factor[[1]], a | b],
    found = SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]],
      Function[index, ratio = Cancel[factor[[1]]/denominators[[index]]];
        ratio =!= 0 && FreeQ[ratio, a | b]], Missing["UnknownPropagator"]];
    If[MissingQ[found], Print["UNKNOWN_PROPAGATOR ", InputForm[factor[[1]]]]];
    gate["every loop-dependent factor is a generated propagator", !MissingQ[found]];
    powers[[found]] += factor[[2]]], {factor, factors}];
  prefactor = Cancel[rational Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, powers}]];
  gate["atom extraction leaves a polynomial numerator",
    FreeQ[Denominator[Together[prefactor]], a | b]];
  {powers, prefactor}];

familyRows[expression_, family_] := Module[
  {spec, transformed, numerator, denominator, denominatorPowers, denominatorCoefficient,
   polynomial, rows, reconstruction},
  spec = families[family];
  transformed = Together[expression /. spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]];
  numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]];
  denominator = Factor[Denominator[transformed]];
  gate["family numerator is polynomial", PolynomialQ[numerator, {v3, v4}]];
  denominatorPowers = Exponent[denominator, #] & /@ {v3, v4};
  denominatorCoefficient = Cancel[denominator/(Times @@ MapThread[Power,
    {{v3, v4}, denominatorPowers}])];
  gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial", FreeQ[denominatorCoefficient, v3 | v4]];
  polynomial = CoefficientRules[numerator, {v3, v4}];
  rows = Association[Map[Function[entry,
    CutIntegral[family, Join[ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],
      denominatorPowers - First[entry]]] -> Factor[Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient]], polynomial]];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power, {{v3, v4}, -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct", zero[reconstruction - transformed]];
  rows];

mapExpression[expression_] := Module[{powers, prefactor, decomposition, pieces, rows, reconstruction},
  If[expression === 0, Return[<||>]];
  {powers, prefactor} = extractAtoms[expression];
  decomposition = decompose[powers];
  pieces = KeyValueMap[Function[{key, coefficient},
    Module[{indices = List @@ key, support, family, value},
      support = Flatten[Position[indices, _?(# > 0 &)]];
      family = SelectFirst[familyNames,
        Complement[support, families[#]["UncutIndices"]] === {} &, Missing["NoFamily"]];
      gate["every independent denominator set has a family", !MissingQ[family]];
      value = Cancel[prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, indices}])];
      familyRows[value, family]]], decomposition];
  rows = merge[pieces];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["complete cut-family map reconstructs the input tensor", zero[reconstruction - expression]];
  gate["both physical cuts remain to unit power in every target",
    And @@ (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[rows])];
  rows];


coefficientPath = FileNameJoin[{root, config["coefficient_source"]}];
gate["pinned GitHub coefficient assembly", IntegerString[FileHash[coefficientPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === config["coefficient_source_sha256"]];
coefficientText = Import[coefficientPath, "Text"];
coefficientBlock = StringTake[coefficientText, {
  First[First[StringPosition[coefficientText, "\n  values=Association@Table["]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[coefficientText, "\n  gate[\"coefficients contain"]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged GitHub coefficient loop", StringContainsQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"], coefficientBlock]];
referenceCoefficients[coefficients_, masterList_, key_] := Module[{ruleMap, missingKeys, values, terms},
  ruleMap = Association[reduction["Rules"]];
  missingKeys = Complement[Keys[coefficients], Keys[ruleMap]];
  ruleMap = Join[ruleMap, AssociationThread[missingKeys, missingKeys]];

  values=Association@Table[
    terms=KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[ruleMap[#1],master] &,coefficients];
    master -> bounded[Factor[Together[Total[terms]]],channel<>" "<>key<>" "<>ToString[master,InputForm]],
    {master,masterList}];
  gate["reduced coefficients are scalar rational expressions", FreeQ[values, _CutIntegral | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted | _Integrate | _SeriesData]];
  values];

sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = {configPath, originalMapperPath, coefficientPath, spinPath, libraryPath,
  FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s02"]["File"]}], FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]}]};
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
tasks = {}; bookkeeping = <||>;
Do[
  sector = spin["Sectors"][label];
  AssociateTo[bookkeeping, label -> KeyTake[sector, {"TagWeight", "TagWeightAppliedToTensor", "OutgoingFields",
    "IncomingSpinLabels", "OutgoingSpinLabels", "ChargeDegrees", "AmplitudeCouplingPowers"}]];
  MapIndexed[Function[{value, index}, If[value =!= 0,
    AppendTo[tasks, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "ExtendedResponse", "Index" -> index, "Value" -> value|>]]], sector["ExtendedResponse"], {3}];
  AppendTo[tasks, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "PhotonMetricD", "Index" -> {}, "Value" -> sector["PhotonMetricD"]|>],
  {label, Keys[spin["Sectors"]]}];
ruleKeys = First /@ reduction["Rules"];
gate["unique saved reduction targets", DuplicateFreeQ[ruleKeys]];
components = {}; targets = {};
Do[
  task = tasks[[index]]; pairPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[pairPath], Get[pairPath], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash,
    Print["REAL_MAP ", channel, " ", index, "/", Length[tasks], " ", task["Sector"], " ", task["Kind"], " ", task["Index"]];
    value = task["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
    coefficients = bounded[mapExpression[value], {index, "real mapping"}];
    ownTargets = Keys[coefficients]; missing = Complement[ownTargets, ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]];
    reducedExpression = Total[KeyValueMap[Times, coefficients]] /. reduction["Rules"];
    remaining = Union[Cases[reducedExpression, _CutIntegral, Infinity]];
    gate["known rules end in saved masters", Complement[remaining, Join[missing, reduction["Masters"]]] === {}];
    reducedCoefficients = referenceCoefficients[coefficients, remaining, task["Sector"] <> " " <> task["Kind"] <> " " <> ToString[task["Index"], InputForm]];
    gate["linear reduced coefficient reconstruction", zero[reducedExpression - Total[KeyValueMap[Times, reducedCoefficients]]]];
    saved = Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], <|"Coefficients" -> coefficients,
      "ReducedCoefficients" -> reducedCoefficients, "MissingTargets" -> missing,
      "InputHash" -> inputHash, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True|>];
    put[saved, pairPath]; Clear[coefficients, reducedExpression, reducedCoefficients, value]; ClearSystemCache[]];
  AppendTo[components, saved]; targets = Union[targets, Keys[saved["Coefficients"]]], {index, Length[tasks]}];
missingTargets = Union[Flatten[Lookup[components, "MissingTargets"]]];
gate["all nonzero components mapped", Length[components] === Length[tasks] && And @@ Lookup[components, "ReconstructionPassed"]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-scalar-map-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Components" -> components, "Targets" -> targets, "MissingTargets" -> missingTargets,
  "SavedMasterInventory" -> reduction["Masters"], "ReductionCoverageComplete" -> (missingTargets === {}),
  "ScalarConventionRules" -> scalarConventionRules, "CoordinateRules" -> coordinateRules,
  "Bookkeeping" -> bookkeeping, "PhotonLabels" -> spin["PhotonLabels"], "SpinLabels" -> spin["SpinLabels"],
  "IndexOrder" -> spin["IndexOrder"], "CutMomenta" -> geometry["CutMomenta"], "CutEnergySupport" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],
  "TransverseSubstitution" -> spin["TransverseSubstitution"], "TransverseConstraint" -> spin["TransverseConstraint"],
  "Gamma5Scheme" -> spin["Gamma5Scheme"], "CouplingsRemoved" -> spin["CouplingsRemoved"],
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "Checks" -> checks, "MappingAccepted" -> True, "MasterExpansionDepthChecked" -> False,
  "PhaseSpaceIntegrated" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "component_count" -> Length[components], "target_count" -> Length[targets], "missing_target_count" -> Length[missingTargets],
  "reduction_coverage_complete" -> (missingTargets === {}), "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_map_real_spin"]; Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
  relations = NullSpace[Transpose[directions[[support]]]];
  relation = SelectFirst[relations, !zero[#.denominators[[support]]] &, $Failed];
  gate["nonzero affine relation for dependent propagators", relation =!= $Failed];
  constant = Factor[relation.denominators[[support]]];
  gate["relation constant is independent of loop coordinates", FreeQ[constant, a | b]];
  pieces = MapThread[Function[{position, coefficient},
    If[coefficient === 0, <||>,
      lowered = ReplacePart[powers, position -> powers[[position]] - 1];
      Map[Factor[coefficient #/constant] &, decompose[lowered]]]], {support, relation}];
  merge[pieces]];

extractAtoms[expression_] := Module[{rational, factors, powers, found, ratio, prefactor},
  rational = Together[expression];
  factors = Rest[FactorList[Denominator[rational]]];
  powers = ConstantArray[0, Length[denominators]];
  Do[If[!FreeQ[factor[[1]], a | b],
    found = SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]],
      Function[index, ratio = Cancel[factor[[1]]/denominators[[index]]];
        ratio =!= 0 && FreeQ[ratio, a | b]], Missing["UnknownPropagator"]];
    If[MissingQ[found], Print["UNKNOWN_PROPAGATOR ", InputForm[factor[[1]]]]];
    gate["every loop-dependent factor is a generated propagator", !MissingQ[found]];
    powers[[found]] += factor[[2]]], {factor, factors}];
  prefactor = Cancel[rational Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, powers}]];
  gate["atom extraction leaves a polynomial numerator",
    FreeQ[Denominator[Together[prefactor]], a | b]];
  {powers, prefactor}];

familyRows[expression_, family_] := Module[
  {spec, transformed, numerator, denominator, denominatorPowers, denominatorCoefficient,
   polynomial, rows, reconstruction},
  spec = families[family];
  transformed = Together[expression /. spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]];
  numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]];
  denominator = Factor[Denominator[transformed]];
  gate["family numerator is polynomial", PolynomialQ[numerator, {v3, v4}]];
  denominatorPowers = Exponent[denominator, #] & /@ {v3, v4};
  denominatorCoefficient = Cancel[denominator/(Times @@ MapThread[Power,
    {{v3, v4}, denominatorPowers}])];
  gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial", FreeQ[denominatorCoefficient, v3 | v4]];
  polynomial = CoefficientRules[numerator, {v3, v4}];
  rows = Association[Map[Function[entry,
    CutIntegral[family, Join[ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],
      denominatorPowers - First[entry]]] -> Factor[Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient]], polynomial]];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power, {{v3, v4}, -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct", zero[reconstruction - transformed]];
  rows];

mapExpression[expression_] := Module[{powers, prefactor, decomposition, pieces, rows, reconstruction},
  If[expression === 0, Return[<||>]];
  {powers, prefactor} = extractAtoms[expression];
  decomposition = decompose[powers];
  pieces = KeyValueMap[Function[{key, coefficient},
    Module[{indices = List @@ key, support, family, value},
      support = Flatten[Position[indices, _?(# > 0 &)]];
      family = SelectFirst[familyNames,
        Complement[support, families[#]["UncutIndices"]] === {} &, Missing["NoFamily"]];
      gate["every independent denominator set has a family", !MissingQ[family]];
      value = Cancel[prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, indices}])];
      familyRows[value, family]]], decomposition];
  rows = merge[pieces];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["complete cut-family map reconstructs the input tensor", zero[reconstruction - expression]];
  gate["both physical cuts remain to unit power in every target",
    And @@ (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[rows])];
  rows];


sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = {configPath, originalMapperPath, spinPath, libraryPath,
  FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s02"]["File"]}], FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]}]};
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
tasks = {}; bookkeeping = <||>;
Do[
  sector = spin["Sectors"][label];
  AssociateTo[bookkeeping, label -> KeyTake[sector, {"TagWeight", "TagWeightAppliedToTensor", "OutgoingFields",
    "IncomingSpinLabels", "OutgoingSpinLabels", "ChargeDegrees", "AmplitudeCouplingPowers"}]];
  MapIndexed[Function[{value, index}, If[value =!= 0,
    AppendTo[tasks, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "ExtendedResponse", "Index" -> index, "Value" -> value|>]]], sector["ExtendedResponse"], {3}];
  AppendTo[tasks, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "PhotonMetricD", "Index" -> {}, "Value" -> sector["PhotonMetricD"]|>],
  {label, Keys[spin["Sectors"]]}];
ruleKeys = First /@ reduction["Rules"];
gate["unique saved reduction targets", DuplicateFreeQ[ruleKeys]];
components = {}; targets = {};
Do[
  task = tasks[[index]]; pairPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[pairPath], Get[pairPath], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash,
    Print["REAL_MAP ", channel, " ", index, "/", Length[tasks], " ", task["Sector"], " ", task["Kind"], " ", task["Index"]];
    value = task["Value"] /. coordinateRules;
    coefficients = bounded[mapExpression[value], {index, "real mapping"}];
    ownTargets = Keys[coefficients]; missing = Complement[ownTargets, ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]];
    reducedExpression = Total[KeyValueMap[Times, coefficients]] /. reduction["Rules"];
    remaining = Union[Cases[reducedExpression, _CutIntegral, Infinity]];
    gate["known rules end in saved masters", Complement[remaining, Join[missing, reduction["Masters"]]] === {}];
    reducedCoefficients = AssociationMap[Factor[Coefficient[Expand[reducedExpression], #]] &, remaining];
    gate["linear reduced coefficient reconstruction", zero[reducedExpression - Total[KeyValueMap[Times, reducedCoefficients]]]];
    saved = Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], <|"Coefficients" -> coefficients,
      "ReducedCoefficients" -> reducedCoefficients, "MissingTargets" -> missing,
      "InputHash" -> inputHash, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True|>];
    put[saved, pairPath]; Clear[coefficients, reducedExpression, reducedCoefficients, value]; ClearSystemCache[]];
  AppendTo[components, saved]; targets = Union[targets, Keys[saved["Coefficients"]]], {index, Length[tasks]}];
missingTargets = Union[Flatten[Lookup[components, "MissingTargets"]]];
gate["all nonzero components mapped", Length[components] === Length[tasks] && And @@ Lookup[components, "ReconstructionPassed"]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-scalar-map-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Components" -> components, "Targets" -> targets, "MissingTargets" -> missingTargets,
  "SavedMasterInventory" -> reduction["Masters"], "ReductionCoverageComplete" -> (missingTargets === {}),
  "ScalarConventionRules" -> scalarConventionRules, "CoordinateRules" -> coordinateRules,
  "Bookkeeping" -> bookkeeping, "PhotonLabels" -> spin["PhotonLabels"], "SpinLabels" -> spin["SpinLabels"],
  "IndexOrder" -> spin["IndexOrder"], "CutMomenta" -> geometry["CutMomenta"], "CutEnergySupport" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],
  "TransverseSubstitution" -> spin["TransverseSubstitution"], "TransverseConstraint" -> spin["TransverseConstraint"],
  "Gamma5Scheme" -> spin["Gamma5Scheme"], "CouplingsRemoved" -> spin["CouplingsRemoved"],
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "Checks" -> checks, "MappingAccepted" -> True, "MasterExpansionDepthChecked" -> False,
  "PhaseSpaceIntegrated" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "component_count" -> Length[components], "target_count" -> Length[targets], "missing_target_count" -> Length[missingTargets],
  "reduction_coverage_complete" -> (missingTargets === {}), "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_map_real_spin"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Map new spin numerators with the unchanged accepted real-integral mapper. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;

checks = <||>;

spinPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];

reduction = reductionOriginal /. scalarConventionRules;
denominators = geometry["OnCutUncutPropagators"]; directions = geometry["UncutDirections"];
families = geometry["Families"]; familyNames = Keys[families];
commonBasis = geometry["BasisMomenta"];
commonCoordinates[value_] := Coefficient[Expand[value], #] & /@ commonBasis;
commonDot[left_, right_] := Factor[commonCoordinates[left].geometry["CommonGram"].commonCoordinates[right] /. geometry["CutRules"]];
momentumRules = {k2 -> First[geometry["LoopMomenta"]], k3 -> geometry["RecoilMomentum"] - First[geometry["LoopMomenta"]]};
gate["same cut momenta", And @@ (Expand[#] === 0 & /@ ((spin["CutMomenta"] /. momentumRules) - geometry["CutMomenta"]))];
gate["same positive-energy support", (spin["CutEnergySupport"] /. momentumRules) === geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]];
rows = spin["RealScalarProducts"]; oldValues = rows[[All, 3]];
targetValues = (commonDot[#[[1]] /. momentumRules, #[[2]] /. momentumRules] &) /@ rows;
globalSymbols[value_] := DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]];

coordinateSolutions = Solve[Thread[oldValues == targetValues], coordinateUnknowns];
gate["unique loop-coordinate conversion", Length[coordinateSolutions] === 1 && FreeQ[coordinateSolutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
coordinateRules = First[coordinateSolutions];

gate["coordinate change preserves measured transverse constraint", FreeQ[spin["TransverseConstraint"], Alternatives @@ coordinateUnknowns]];

merge[pieces_List] := If[pieces === {}, <||>,
  Select[Merge[pieces, Factor[Together[Total[#]]] &], # =!= 0 &]];

(* All partial-fraction coefficients are solved from the actual affine
   propagators. No angular integral or phase-space formula is used. *)
decompose[powers_List] := decompose[powers] = Module[
  {support, relations, relation, constant, pieces, lowered},
  support = Flatten[Position[powers, _?(# > 0 &)]];
  If[support === {}, Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  If[Length[support] <= 2 && MatrixRank[directions[[support]]] === Length[support],
    Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  relations = NullSpace[Transpose[directions[[support]]]];
  relation = SelectFirst[relations, !zero[#.denominators[[support]]] &, $Failed];
  gate["nonzero affine relation for dependent propagators", relation =!= $Failed];
  constant = Factor[relation.denominators[[support]]];
  gate["relation constant is independent of loop coordinates", FreeQ[constant, a | b]];
  pieces = MapThread[Function[{position, coefficient},
    If[coefficient === 0, <||>,
      lowered = ReplacePart[powers, position -> powers[[position]] - 1];
      Map[Factor[coefficient #/constant] &, decompose[lowered]]]], {support, relation}];
  merge[pieces]];

extractAtoms[expression_] := Module[{rational, factors, powers, found, ratio, prefactor},
  rational = Together[expression];
  factors = Rest[FactorList[Denominator[rational]]];
  powers = ConstantArray[0, Length[denominators]];
  Do[If[!FreeQ[factor[[1]], a | b],
    found = SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]],
      Function[index, ratio = Cancel[factor[[1]]/denominators[[index]]];

    gate["every loop-dependent factor is a generated propagator", !MissingQ[found]];
    powers[[found]] += factor[[2]]], {factor, factors}];
  prefactor = Cancel[rational Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, powers}]];
  gate["atom extraction leaves a polynomial numerator",
    FreeQ[Denominator[Together[prefactor]], a | b]];
  {powers, prefactor}];

familyRows[expression_, family_] := Module[
  {spec, transformed, numerator, denominator, denominatorPowers, denominatorCoefficient,
   polynomial, rows, reconstruction},
  spec = families[family];
  transformed = Together[expression /. spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]];
  numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]];
  denominator = Factor[Denominator[transformed]];
  gate["family numerator is polynomial", PolynomialQ[numerator, {v3, v4}]];
  denominatorPowers = Exponent[denominator, #] & /@ {v3, v4};
  denominatorCoefficient = Cancel[denominator/(Times @@ MapThread[Power,
    {{v3, v4}, denominatorPowers}])];
  gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial", FreeQ[denominatorCoefficient, v3 | v4]];
  polynomial = CoefficientRules[numerator, {v3, v4}];
  rows = Association[Map[Function[entry,
    CutIntegral[family, Join[ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],
      denominatorPowers - First[entry]]] -> Factor[Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient]], polynomial]];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power, {{v3, v4}, -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct", zero[reconstruction - transformed]];
  rows];

mapExpression[expression_] := Module[{powers, prefactor, decomposition, pieces, rows, reconstruction},
  If[expression === 0, Return[<||>]];
  {powers, prefactor} = extractAtoms[expression];
  decomposition = decompose[powers];
  pieces = KeyValueMap[Function[{key, coefficient},
    Module[{indices = List @@ key, support, family, value},
      support = Flatten[Position[indices, _?(# > 0 &)]];
      family = SelectFirst[familyNames,
        Complement[support, families[#]["UncutIndices"]] === {} &, Missing["NoFamily"]];
      gate["every independent denominator set has a family", !MissingQ[family]];
      value = Cancel[prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, indices}])];
      familyRows[value, family]]], decomposition];
  rows = merge[pieces];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["complete cut-family map reconstructs the input tensor", zero[reconstruction - expression]];
  gate["both physical cuts remain to unit power in every target",
    And @@ (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[rows])];
  rows];


coefficientPath = FileNameJoin[{root, config["coefficient_source"]}];
gate["pinned GitHub coefficient assembly", IntegerString[FileHash[coefficientPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === config["coefficient_source_sha256"]];
coefficientText = Import[coefficientPath, "Text"];
coefficientBlock = StringTake[coefficientText, {
  First[First[StringPosition[coefficientText, "\n  values=Association@Table["]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[coefficientText, "\n  gate[\"coefficients contain"]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged GitHub coefficient loop", StringContainsQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"], coefficientBlock]];
referenceCoefficients[coefficients_, masterList_, key_] := Module[{ruleMap, missingKeys, values, terms},
  ruleMap = Association[reduction["Rules"]];
  missingKeys = Complement[Keys[coefficients], Keys[ruleMap]];
  ruleMap = Join[ruleMap, AssociationThread[missingKeys, missingKeys]];

  values=Association@Table[

  values];

  "e42c8bec95f9e856911436024b9b39cf2f1b6fd8bac4c3f345dbfaa63c173fdc"];
sourceHash = FileHash[calculationSourcePath, "SHA256"];
dispatchSourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = {configPath, originalMapperPath, coefficientPath, spinPath, libraryPath,
  FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s02"]["File"]}], FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]}]};
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];

tasks = {}; bookkeeping = <||>;
Do[

    "IncomingSpinLabels", "OutgoingSpinLabels", "ChargeDegrees", "AmplitudeCouplingPowers"}]];
  MapIndexed[Function[{value, index}, If[value =!= 0,
    AppendTo[tasks, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "ExtendedResponse", "Index" -> index, "Value" -> value|>]]], sector["ExtendedResponse"], {3}];
  AppendTo[tasks, <|"Sector" -> label, "Kind" -> "PhotonMetricD", "Index" -> {}, "Value" -> sector["PhotonMetricD"]|>],
  {label, Keys[spin["Sectors"]]}];
ruleKeys = First /@ reduction["Rules"];
gate["unique saved reduction targets", DuplicateFreeQ[ruleKeys]];
mappingInputHashes = inputHashes;
previousMapperPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_result", "reference", "s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}];
gate["pinned previous production mapper", IntegerString[FileHash[previousMapperPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "e23a79589bfce183535a6f1166eda799a9f119168feb9cff1b13feb669c8b21f"];
previousMappingHash = Hash[{FileHash[previousMapperPath, "SHA256"], mappingInputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
sumValidationPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqprime", "s08_cancel_denominator_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
gate["pinned complete rational-sum validation", IntegerString[FileHash[sumValidationPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "215afefb5862347917f3db9fecb401e34c59fcd4a858c12731ae55bdecaef0da"];
sumValidation = Get[sumValidationPath];
gate["accepted complete rational-sum validation", sumValidation["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-known-denominator-validation-v1" &&
  And @@ Values[sumValidation["Checks"]] && AllTrue[sumValidation["Evidence"], TrueQ[#["Evidence"]["ExactTermwiseReconstructionPassed"]] &]];
DownValues[factoredDenominatorSum] = sumValidation["Definitions"];
DownValues[cancelKnownDenominatorFactors] = sumValidation["CancellationDefinitions"];
gate["executed rational-sum definitions", DownValues[factoredDenominatorSum] === sumValidation["Definitions"] &&
  DownValues[cancelKnownDenominatorFactors] === sumValidation["CancellationDefinitions"]];
sumFixtureConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_rational_sum_inputs.json"}];
sumFixtureConfig = Import[sumFixtureConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
sumFixturePath = FileNameJoin[{root, sumFixtureConfig["raw_map"]}];
gate["accepted coefficient control raw-map identity", FileHash[sumFixturePath, "SHA256"] === sumValidation["RawMapHash"]];
sumFixture = Get[sumFixturePath];
gate["accepted coefficient control reconstruction", And @@ Values[sumFixture["MappingChecks"]]];
controlRuleMap = Association[reduction["Rules"]];
controlMissing = Complement[Keys[sumFixture["Coefficients"]], Keys[controlRuleMap]];
controlRuleMap = Join[controlRuleMap, AssociationThread[controlMissing, controlMissing]];
controlMaster = sumValidation["ControlMaster"];
controlTerms = KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[controlRuleMap[#1], controlMaster] &, sumFixture["Coefficients"]];
controlValue = sumValidation["ReducedCoefficients"][controlMaster];
gate["validation used these original reduction rules", sumValidation["InputHashes"][library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]] ===
  mappingInputHashes[library["Library"]["s04"]["File"]]];
extendedReductionUsed = False;
extensionRelative = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_REAL_REDUCTION"];
If[StringQ[extensionRelative] && StringLength[extensionRelative] > 0,
  extensionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, extensionRelative}]; extendedReduction = Get[extensionPath];
  gate["accepted real reduction extension", extendedReduction["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-real-reduction-extension-v1" &&
    TrueQ[extendedReduction["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[extendedReduction["Checks"]]];

    mappingInputHashes[library["Library"]["s02"]["File"]] && extendedReduction["BaselineReductionHash"] ===

  gate["real reduction extension retains original masters and cuts", Sort[extendedReduction["Masters"]] ===
    Sort[reductionOriginal["Masters"]] && extendedReduction["CutEnergyConditions"] === geometryOriginal["CutEnergyConditions"]];
  reduction = extendedReduction /. scalarConventionRules; ruleKeys = First /@ reduction["Rules"];
  gate["unique extended reduction targets", DuplicateFreeQ[ruleKeys]];
  AppendTo[inputPaths, extensionPath]; extendedReductionUsed = True];

rawTargetPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_targets_result", "s08_result.wl"}];
rawTargetComponents = {};
If[FileExistsQ[rawTargetPath],
  rawTarget = Get[rawTargetPath];
  gate["accepted complete raw-target map", rawTarget["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-real-target-map-v1" &&
    rawTarget["Channel"] === channel && TrueQ[rawTarget["MappingAccepted"]] && And @@ Values[rawTarget["Checks"]]];
```

```wolfram
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],

  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];

If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1]; CloseKernels[];
If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];

CloseKernels[];

If[!DirectoryQ[targetDir], CreateDirectory[targetDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[targetResult, FileNameJoin[{targetDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{targetDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "component_count" -> Length[targetComponents], "target_count" -> Length[targetInventory],

  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s08_map_real_targets"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];

    AssociationQ[Lookup[saved, "Checks", None]] && Length[saved["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[saved["Checks"]], Return[saved]];
  Print["REAL_TARGET_MAP ", index, "/", Length[tasks], " ", KeyDrop[task, "Value"], " kernel ", $KernelID];
  {seconds, coefficients} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[task["Value"] /. coordinateRules],
    {"complete raw cut mapping", index}]];
  missing = Complement[Keys[coefficients], ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]];
  saved = Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], <|"Coefficients" -> coefficients, "MissingTargets" -> missing,
    "InputHash" -> targetInputHash, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True, "Checks" -> checks,
    "Seconds" -> seconds, "InputBytes" -> ByteCount[task["Value"]], "OutputBytes" -> ByteCount[coefficients]|>];
  put[saved, path]; ClearSystemCache[]; saved]], "TargetMapFailure"];
slots = Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]], 1]];
targetControlTaskFunction[unused_] := Catch[Block[{checks = <||>}, Module[{value, seconds},
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[targetControlTask["Value"] /. coordinateRules], "reference control mapping"]];
  gate["fresh worker reproduces entire reference map", value === targetFixture["Coefficients"]];
  <|"Checks" -> checks, "Seconds" -> seconds, "ReconstructionPassed" -> True|>]], "TargetMapFailure"];
If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1]; CloseKernels[];
If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];
workers = Length[Kernels[]];

  gate["target workers share compute node", And @@ (SameQ[#, $MachineName] & /@ ParallelEvaluate[$MachineName])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; checks = <||>;

  gate["target worker native versions agree", And @@ (SameQ[#, {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}] & /@

targetControl = First[If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[targetControlFunction, {1}], targetControlFunction /@ {1}]];
gate["fresh target worker accepted", AssociationQ[targetControl] && And @@ Values[targetControl["Checks"]]];
If[channel === "Hqqprime", gate["entire original target map unchanged", targetControl["Coefficients"] === targetFixture["Coefficients"]]];

targetComponents = If[workers > 0,

If[channel === "Hqqprime", targetComponents = Prepend[targetComponents, targetControl]];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all real target maps accepted", Length[targetComponents] === Length[tasks] &&

  And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ targetComponents]];
targetInventory = Union[Flatten[Keys[#["Coefficients"]] & /@ targetComponents]];
targetMissing = Union[Flatten[Lookup[targetComponents, "MissingTargets"]]];
targetResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-target-map-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Components" -> targetComponents, "Targets" -> targetInventory, "MissingTargets" -> targetMissing,
  "ReductionCoverageComplete" -> (targetMissing === {}), "Bookkeeping" -> bookkeeping,
```

```wolfram
  "ProofHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],"ReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s08_execution.json"}],"SHA256"],
  "OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"ActualMeasurements"->proof["ActualMeasurements"]|>]];
```

<a id="source-339"></a>

## common/s08_result/reference/s08_standalone_rational_reducer.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-339", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9260, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s08_standalone_rational_reducer.wls", "sha256": "a2d379159eb49df3fdd8ad49db4b437dd18dbccd87f3a2667f91896e167aae30"} -->
```wolfram
(* Production-only scalar post-processing for the directly generated lower
   Born subprocess

       q_i(pa)+qbar_i(pb) -> g(pc observed)+g(pd).

   FeynCalc is deliberately not loaded here.  The only inputs are the exact
   FORM scalars.  A separate live FeynCalc script is an oracle after this
   production artifact has been written. *)
ClearAll[fail, pass, readFormScalar, rationalReduce, exactZero,
  hardEpsilonTuple, sha256, promote];
fail[message_, detail_: Null] := (
  Print["FAIL: ", message];
  If[detail =!= Null, Print["DETAIL=", InputForm[detail]]];
  Quit[1]
);
pass[message_] := Print["PASS: " <> message];
sha256[path_] := ToLowerCase @ IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64];

(* FORM may wrap a product immediately before its `*'.  Converting every
   whitespace run to one ordinary space repairs that continuation without
   concatenating tokens. *)
readFormScalar[path_] := Module[{text, held},
  If[! FileExistsQ[path], fail["missing FORM lower-Born scalar", path]];
  text = StringReplace[Import[path, "Text"],
    {WhitespaceCharacter .. -> " ", "i_" -> "I"}];
  held = Quiet @ Check[
    ToExpression[text, InputForm, HoldComplete], $Failed];
  If[held === $Failed || ! MatchQ[held, HoldComplete[_]],
    fail["cannot parse FORM lower-Born scalar", path]];
  ReleaseHold[held]
];

(* Pairwise rational combination avoids a deep intermediate expression when
   a FORM-expanded axial-gauge result is canonicalized by Mathematica. *)
rationalReduce[expression_] := Module[{terms, batches},
  If[TrueQ[expression === 0], Return[0]];
  terms = If[Head[expression] === Plus, List @@ expression, {expression}];
  While[Length[terms] > 1,
    batches = Partition[terms, UpTo[2]];
    terms = (Cancel[Together[Total[#]]] & /@ batches)
  ];
  Factor[Cancel[Together[First[terms]]]]
];
exactZero[expression_] := rationalReduce[expression];

root = DirectoryName[DirectoryName[$InputFileName]];
formBuild = FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "lower_born_gg"}];
promotionBuild = FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "lower_born"}];
If[! DirectoryQ[promotionBuild],
  CreateDirectory[promotionBuild, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
path[name_] := FileNameJoin[{formBuild, name}];

uSquare = rationalReduce @ readFormScalar[path["math_BornU.m"]];
pSquare = rationalReduce @ readFormScalar[path["math_BornP.m"]];

gateFiles = <|
  "CDR pair reconstruction" -> "math_PairCheckU.m",
  "CDR pc-reference independence" -> "math_GaugeCheckUC.m",
  "CDR pd-reference independence" -> "math_GaugeCheckUD.m",
  "CDR simultaneous-reference independence" -> "math_GaugeCheckUBoth.m",
  "CDR pc Ward identity" -> "math_WardCheckUC.m",
  "CDR pd Ward identity" -> "math_WardCheckUD.m",
  "BMHV pair reconstruction" -> "math_PairCheckP.m",
  "BMHV pc-reference independence" -> "math_GaugeCheckPC.m",
  "BMHV pd-reference independence" -> "math_GaugeCheckPD.m",
  "BMHV simultaneous-reference independence" -> "math_GaugeCheckPBoth.m",
  "BMHV pc Ward identity" -> "math_WardCheckPC.m",
  "BMHV pd Ward identity" -> "math_WardCheckPD.m"
|>;
KeyValueMap[
  Function[{label, file},
    remainder = exactZero @ readFormScalar[path[file]];
    If[remainder =!= 0, fail[label <> " failed", remainder]];
    pass[label <> " is exact"]], gateFiles];

feynmanU = rationalReduce @
  readFormScalar[path["math_FeynmanDiagnosticU.m"]];
feynmanP = rationalReduce @
  readFormScalar[path["math_FeynmanDiagnosticP.m"]];
If[feynmanU === 0 || feynmanP === 0,
  fail["bare simultaneous covariant final-gluon diagnostic unexpectedly vanished"]];
pass["bare simultaneous covariant final-gluon sum is retained only as a nonzero Slavnov--Taylor diagnostic"];

If[! FreeQ[{uSquare, pSquare},
    _DiracGamma | _DiracTrace | _Spinor | _LorentzIndex | _Pair |
    _Momentum | _SUNTF | _SUNF | _FeynAmpDenominator | _Den | _Line |
    _Pol | _Eps4],
  fail["unevaluated tensor/bridge object survived the FORM lower-Born square"]];
If[! FreeQ[{uSquare, pSquare}, NA | CF | CA | alphaS | ep],
  fail["unresolved colour or conversion symbol in FORM lower-Born square"]];
If[FreeQ[uSquare, D] || FreeQ[pSquare, D],
  fail["a lower-Born square lost its exact D dependence"]];

If[exactZero[uSquare - (uSquare /. {t -> u, u -> t})] =!= 0 ||
   exactZero[pSquare - (pSquare /. {t -> u, u -> t})] =!= 0,
  fail["tagged-gluon lower-Born square is not t/u symmetric"]];
pass["both tagged-gluon squares are exactly t/u symmetric"];
If[exactZero[(pSquare + uSquare) /. D -> 4] =!= 0,
  fail["physical double-longitudinal BMHV square is not minus CDR at D=4"]];
pass["D=4 physical helicity identity Polarized=-Unpolarized is exact"];

(* The tagged-parent convention cancels the identical-particle factor:
   (1/2!) times the two possible tagged gluons is one.  Therefore there is
   no extra half in the hard density. *)
toHard[square_] := rationalReduce[
  square/(16 Pi s) /. {
    gs^4 -> (4 Pi alphaS)^2,
    t -> -s (1-v), u -> -s v, Nc -> CA
  }
];
uHardD = toHard[uSquare];
pHardD = toHard[pSquare];
If[FreeQ[uHardD, D] || FreeQ[pHardD, D],
  fail["lower-Born hard density lost D dependence"]];

hardEpsilonTuple[hard_] := Module[{full, tuple, remainder},
  full = rationalReduce[hard /. D -> 4-2 ep];
  tuple = <|
    0 -> rationalReduce[full /. ep -> 0],
    1 -> rationalReduce[Coefficient[full, ep, 1]]
  |>;
  remainder = rationalReduce[
    Normal[Series[full, {ep, 0, 1}]]-tuple[0]-ep tuple[1]];
  If[remainder =!= 0,
    fail["O(ep) tuple does not reconstruct the exact series through ep^1",
      remainder]];
  <|"exact" -> full, "coefficients" -> tuple|>
];
uEp = hardEpsilonTuple[uHardD];
pEp = hardEpsilonTuple[pHardD];
If[uEp["coefficients"][1] === 0 || pEp["coefficients"][1] === 0,
  fail["required Born O(ep) coefficient vanished"]];
pass["exact D hard densities and both nonzero Born O(ep) coefficients are retained"];

metadataPath = path["metadata.json"];
If[! FileExistsQ[metadataPath], fail["lower-Born translation metadata missing"]];
metadata = Import[metadataPath, "RawJSON"];
expectedIDs = Table[
  "GraphID[Topology == 1, Generic == 1, Classes == 1, Number == " <>
    ToString[index] <> "]", {index, 3}];
If[metadata["schema"] =!= "qqbar_annihilation_lower_born_gg_translation_v1" ||
   metadata["diagram_count"] =!= 3 || metadata["conjugate_count"] =!= 3 ||
   metadata["graph_ids"] =!= expectedIDs ||
   metadata["create_feyn_amp_prefactor"] =!= "1" ||
   metadata["fcfaconvert_contract"] =!= False ||
   metadata["tagged_final_combinatoric_factor"] =!= 1,
  fail["direct lower-Born translation metadata changed", metadata]];
pass["three direct FeynArts graph IDs, unit prefactors, and unit tagged-final factor are frozen"];

formFiles = {
  FileNameJoin[{root, "form", "lower_born_gg_unpolarized.frm"}],
  FileNameJoin[{root, "form", "lower_born_gg_bmhv.frm"}]
};
candidate = <|
  "schema" -> "qqbar_to_gg_direct_born_hard_v1",
  "process" -> "q_i qbar_i -> g g",
  "momenta" -> "q_i(pa)+qbar_i(pb)->g(pc observed)+g(pd)",
  "source_role" -> "direct FeynArts--minimal bridge--FORM",
  "direct_generation" -> True,
  "diagram_count" -> 3,
  "graph_ids" -> expectedIDs,
  "create_feyn_amp_prefactor" -> "1",
  "fcfaconvert_contract" -> False,
  "scheme" -> "physical CDR and explicit same-trace two-gamma5 BMHV",
  "initial_spin_colour_average" -> "1/(4 Nc^2)",
  "hard_normalization" -> "square/(16 Pi s)",
  "tagged_final_gluon_convention" ->
    "1/2! phase space times two tagged-gluon choices equals one",
  "tagged_final_combinatoric_factor" -> 1,
  "official_FORM_color_package" -> "configured NLO_FORM_COLOR_HEADER",
  "gamma5_implementation" ->
    "two independent explicit barred epsilons on the same incoming trace; native gamma5 forbidden",
  "ward_gate" -> True,
  "axial_reference_gate" -> True,
  "pair_reconstruction_gate" -> True,
  "physical_D4_P_equals_minus_U" -> True,
  "includes_Born_Oep" -> True,
  "unpolarized_square_D" -> uSquare,
  "polarized_square_D" -> pSquare,
  "unpolarized_hard_D" -> uHardD,
  "polarized_hard_D" -> pHardD,
  "unpolarized_hard_ep" -> uEp["coefficients"],
  "polarized_hard_ep" -> pEp["coefficients"],
  "unpolarized_hard_ep_exact" -> uEp["exact"],
  "polarized_hard_ep_exact" -> pEp["exact"],
  "bare_covariant_diagnostic_nonzero" -> True,
  "translation_metadata_sha256" -> sha256[metadataPath],
  "form_source_sha256" -> AssociationThread[
    FileNameTake /@ formFiles, sha256 /@ formFiles]
|>;

promote[path_, expression_] := Module[{candidatePath, parsed},
  candidatePath = path <> ".candidate";
  Export[candidatePath,
    ToString[InputForm[expression], PageWidth -> Infinity], "Text"];
  parsed = Quiet @ Check[Get[candidatePath], $Failed];
  If[parsed === $Failed || parsed =!= expression,
    fail["lower-Born candidate failed read-back promotion gate", candidatePath]];
  RenameFile[candidatePath, path, OverwriteTarget -> True]
];
artifactPath = FileNameJoin[
  {promotionBuild, "qqbar_to_gg_born_hard.wl"}];
promote[artifactPath, candidate];
pass["promoted direct FORM qqbar->gg lower-Born hard artifact"];
Print["LOWER-BORN-ARTIFACT=", artifactPath];
Print["UNPOLARIZED-SQUARE-D=", InputForm[uSquare]];
Print["POLARIZED-BMHV-SQUARE-D=", InputForm[pSquare]];
Print["UNPOLARIZED-HARD-EP=", InputForm[uEp["coefficients"]]];
Print["POLARIZED-HARD-EP=", InputForm[pEp["coefficients"]]];
Quit[0];
```

## common/s08_result/reference/s11_real_master_coefficients.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-340", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4801, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_result/reference/s11_real_master_coefficients.wl", "sha256": "c453a12bebd4ce2b8dc8aa7ecf14931602aea619889c581f7850db11fc62a03a"} -->
```wolfram
Get[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[$InputFileName],"..","common","s22_paths.wl"}]];
(* Combine each channel's preserved real tensor with the actual Kira rules. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root=sidisRoot;
gate[name_, condition_] := If[!TrueQ[condition], Print["FAIL: ",name];
  If[$KernelID>0,Throw[$Failed,"S11Failure"],CloseKernels[];Quit[1]]];
put[value_,path_] := (Put[value,path<>".tmp"];RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True]);
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[label<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,gate[label<>" memory limit",False]];
valuation[value_,variable_] := If[value===0,Infinity,With[{rational=Together[value]},
  Exponent[Numerator[rational],variable,Min]-Exponent[Denominator[rational],variable,Min]]];
reduction=sidisGet[sidisPath[{root,"s04_result.wl"}]];
sourceManifest=sidisGet[sidisPath[{root,"s03_result.wl"}]];
gate["accepted complete real mapping",TrueQ[sourceManifest["Accepted"]]];
gate["accepted Kira real reduction",TrueQ[reduction["Accepted"]]];
masterList=reduction["Masters"]; ruleMap=Association[reduction["Rules"]];
sourceHash=sidisHash[$InputFileName,"SHA256"];
reductionHash=sidisHash[sidisPath[{root,"s04_result.wl"}],"SHA256"];
task[channel_,key_,coefficients_,mapHash_] := Catch[Module[
  {inputHash,cache,file,saved,result,values,epsOrders,softOrders,terms},
  inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,reductionHash,mapHash,key},"SHA256"];
  cache=sidisPath[{root,channel,"s11_cache",IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[cache],CreateDirectory[cache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
  file=sidisPath[{cache,"s11_result.wl"}];
  If[FileExistsQ[file],saved=sidisGet[file];If[saved["InputHash"]===inputHash&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]],Return[saved]]];
  Print["REAL_COEFFICIENTS ",channel," ",key," kernel ",$KernelID];
  gate["every source target has a Kira rule",Complement[Keys[coefficients],Keys[ruleMap]]==={}];
  values=Association@Table[
    terms=KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[ruleMap[#1],master] &,coefficients];
    master -> bounded[Factor[Together[Total[terms]]],channel<>" "<>key<>" "<>ToString[master,InputForm]],
    {master,masterList}];
  gate["coefficients contain only scalar rational functions",FreeQ[values,
    _CutIntegral|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|_Integrate|_SeriesData]];
  epsOrders=Map[valuation[# /. D->4-2 eps,eps] &,values];
  softOrders=Map[valuation[#,w] &,values];
  result=<|"Channel"->channel,"TensorKey"->key,"Coefficients"->values,
    "EpsilonValuations"->epsOrders,"SoftValuations"->softOrders,
    "InputHash"->inputHash,"SourceHash"->sourceHash,"MappingHash"->mapHash,
    "ReductionHash"->reductionHash,"Accepted"->True,"IntegralEvaluationPerformed"->False|>;
  put[result,file];ClearSystemCache[];Print["REAL_COEFFICIENTS_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",key];result],"S11Failure"];
slots=Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]],1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots]||slots<1,slots=1];CloseKernels[];
If[slots>1,LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost","KernelCommand"->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel","KernelCount"->Min[4,slots],"TimeConstraint"->60]]];
workers=Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers>0,ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength=0];DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,valuation,
  task,root,sourceHash,reductionHash,ruleMap,masterList]];
$DistributedContexts=None;channelResults=<||>;
Do[
  sourceFile=sidisPath[{root,channel,"s03_result.wl"}];mapping=sidisGet[sourceFile];
  gate[channel<>" accepted scalar mapping",TrueQ[mapping["PairSumsAccepted"]] &&
    TrueQ[mapping["ReconstructionPassed"]] &&
    sidisHash[sourceFile,"SHA256"]===sourceManifest["Channels"][channel]["SHA256"]];
  mapHash=sidisHash[sourceFile,"SHA256"];
  tasks=KeyValueMap[{channel,#1,#2,mapHash} &,mapping["Coefficients"]];
  values=If[workers>0,ParallelMap[task@@# &,tasks,Method->"FinestGrained"],task@@# & /@tasks];
  gate[channel<>" all components reduced",FreeQ[values,$Failed|$Aborted]&&And@@Lookup[values,"Accepted"]];
  result=<|"Channel"->channel,"Components"->AssociationThread[Keys[mapping["Coefficients"]],values],
    "SourceHash"->sourceHash,"MappingHash"->mapHash,"ReductionHash"->reductionHash,
    "Accepted"->True,"IntegralEvaluationPerformed"->False|>;
  file=sidisPath[{root,channel,"s11_result.wl"}];put[result,file];
  AssociateTo[channelResults,channel-><|"File"->channel<>"/s11_result.wl","Hash"->sidisHash[file,"SHA256"]|>];
  Clear[mapping,tasks,values,result];ClearSystemCache[],
  {channel,{"Hqq","Hqg","Hgq","Hgg","Hqqbar","Hqqprime"}}];
CloseKernels[];
put[<|"Channels"->channelResults,"SourceHash"->sourceHash,"ReductionHash"->reductionHash,
  "Masters"->masterList,"Accepted"->True|>,sidisPath[{root,"s11_result.wl"}]];
Print["S11_SUCCESS: all six channels expressed in the actual Kira cut masters."];
Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
 gate["two complete saved compact definitions",ListQ[original]&&ListQ[candidate]&&Length[original]===Length[old]&&Length[candidate]===Length[old]];
 gate["saved comparisons use the original scalar entry",FreeQ[{original,candidate},polynomialPieceMap]&&
  Count[original,_mapExpression,Infinity]===1&&Count[candidate,_mapExpression,Infinity]===1];
 new=candidate/.mapExpression->polynomialPieceMap;
 gate["exact inherited polynomial dispatch preserved",(original/.mapExpression->polynomialPieceMap)===old&&
  (old/.polynomialPieceMap->mapExpression)===original&&(new/.polynomialPieceMap->mapExpression)===candidate];
 DownValues[hggOriginalGrouping]=new[[1]];DownValues[groupedMapExpression]=new[[2]];
 gate["exact accepted compact definitions installed",{DownValues[hggOriginalGrouping],DownValues[groupedMapExpression]}===new];
 AssociateTo[hggPolynomialEvidence,"CompactGrouping"-><|"ConsumerSourceHash"->FileHash[compactResumeSource,"SHA256"],
  "ProofHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],"ReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s08_execution.json"}],"SHA256"],
  "OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"ActualMeasurements"->proof["ActualMeasurements"]|>]];
compactResumeText=StringTrim[Import[compactResumeBase,"Text"]];compactResumeTerminal="ToExpression[hggPolynomialRun,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[compactResumeText,compactResumeTerminal],Quit[1]];
compactResumePrefix=StringDrop[compactResumeText,-StringLength[compactResumeTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[compactResumePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[compactResumePrefix,InputForm];
compactResumeOld="hggPolynomialInstall[];";compactResumeNew="hggPolynomialInstall[];compactResumeInstall[];";
If[StringCount[hggPolynomialRun,compactResumeOld]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique compact grouping installation"];Quit[1]];
compactResumeRun=StringReplace[hggPolynomialRun,compactResumeOld->compactResumeNew];
If[!SyntaxQ[compactResumeRun]||StringReplace[compactResumeRun,compactResumeNew->compactResumeOld]=!=hggPolynomialRun,
 Print["FAIL: unchanged full Hgg production contract"];Quit[1]];
ToExpression[compactResumeRun,InputForm];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-348", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5259, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s08_resume_Hqg_timed_component.wls", "sha256": "b0f71dbd652a30739464c441f78e25170217090ac604b0779bfac0764b8d3d3c"} -->
```wolfram
(* Use an already checked family expansion only for the recorded timed-out task. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
loopAdapterPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_resume_Hqg_timed_component.wls"}];
loopBasePath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s08_map_Hqg_grouped_packets.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[loopBasePath,"SHA256"],16,64]=!="0c3865a2abab5cce425c7c00d878852e9e47a3c1f31f830b24bc776796a63838"||!SyntaxQ[Import[loopAdapterPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
loopResumeInstall[]:=Module[{cfg,prior,proofPath,proofReceipt,proof,original},
 cfg=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_Hqg_timed_component_inputs.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["timed-component continuation contract",cfg["schema"]==="polarized-sidis-timed-component-resume-v1"&&channel==="Hqg"&&cfg["channel"]===channel];
 KeyValueMap[Function[{key,row},gate["unchanged interruption input "<>key,IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,row["file"]}],"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]]],cfg["files"]];
 prior=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,cfg["files"]["execution"]["file"]}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["recorded incomplete mapping execution",prior["job_id"]===cfg["prior_job"]&&!TrueQ[prior["passed"]]&&prior["reason"]==="wall_limit"];
 loopComponents=cfg["component_indices"];
 gate["only recorded timed-out tasks selected",loopComponents=!={}&&DuplicateFreeQ[loopComponents]&&AllTrue[loopComponents,IntegerQ[#]&&1<=#<=Length[tasks]&]&&And@@(StringContainsQ[Import[FileNameJoin[{root,cfg["files"]["log"]["file"]}],"Text"],#]&/@cfg["failure_lines"])];
 proofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s08_loop_expansion_result","s08_result.wl"}];
 proofReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[proofPath],"s08_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted full own expansion comparison",TrueQ[proofReceipt["passed"]]&&proofReceipt["result_sha256"]["Hqg/s08_loop_expansion_result/s08_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 proof=Get[proofPath];
 gate["unchanged exact expansion proof inputs",proof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-loop-coordinate-expansion-v1"&&proof["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[proof["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&And@@Values[proof["Checks"]]&&proof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&proof["InputHashes"]===inputHashes&&proof["TargetInputHash"]===targetInputHash&&proof["BaseHash"]===FileHash[loopBasePath,"SHA256"]&&proof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_check_Hqg_loop_expansion.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&proof["OwnComparisonHash"]===FileHash[groupPacketProofPath,"SHA256"]&&proof["OwnReceiptHash"]===FileHash[groupPacketReceiptPath,"SHA256"]&&proof["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"]===DownValues[familyRows]];
 loopFamilyDefinitions=proof["CandidateFamilyDefinitions"];
 original=DownValues[mapTargetTask];DownValues[loopOriginalTarget]=original/.mapTargetTask->loopOriginalTarget;
 gate["complete original target function retained",(DownValues[loopOriginalTarget]/.loopOriginalTarget->mapTargetTask)===original];
 Clear[mapTargetTask];
 mapTargetTask[index_]:=If[MemberQ[loopComponents,index],
   Block[{familyRows},DownValues[familyRows]=loopFamilyDefinitions;loopOriginalTarget[index]],loopOriginalTarget[index]];
 loopResumeEvidence=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[loopAdapterPath,"SHA256"],"ComparisonHash"->FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],"ReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[proofPath],"s08_execution.json"}],"SHA256"],"Components"->loopComponents,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"OriginalFamilyDefinitions"->proof["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"],"CandidateFamilyDefinitions"->loopFamilyDefinitions|>;
 Print["TARGETED_ACCEPTED_EXPANSION ",InputForm[KeyDrop[loopResumeEvidence,{"OriginalFamilyDefinitions","CandidateFamilyDefinitions"}]]]];
loopResumeFinish[]:=Module[{old,new,before},
 old="DistributeDefinitions[groupDenominators, certifyGrouping";
 new="DistributeDefinitions[loopOriginalTarget, loopComponents, loopFamilyDefinitions, groupDenominators, certifyGrouping";
 gate["unique targeted worker distribution",StringCount[groupPacketCandidateTail,old]===1];
 before=groupPacketCandidateTail;groupPacketCandidateTail=StringReplace[before,old->new];
 gate["unchanged worker code beyond accepted definitions",StringReplace[groupPacketCandidateTail,new->old]===before];
 old="\"GroupedMappingComparison\" -> groupPacketEvidence,";
 new=old<>" \"TimedComponentExpansion\" -> loopResumeEvidence,";
 gate["unique continuation evidence export",StringCount[groupPacketCandidateTail,old]===1];
 before=groupPacketCandidateTail;groupPacketCandidateTail=StringReplace[before,old->new];
 gate["unchanged full target output contract",StringReplace[groupPacketCandidateTail,new->old]===before&&SyntaxQ[groupPacketCandidateTail]];
 packetSourcePath=loopAdapterPath];
loopText=Import[loopBasePath,"Text"];
loopEdits={"ToExpression[groupPacketTask,InputForm];"->"ToExpression[groupPacketTask,InputForm];loopResumeInstall[];",
 "packetSourcePath=groupPacketSource;"->"packetSourcePath=groupPacketSource;loopResumeFinish[];"};
If[!And@@(StringCount[loopText,First[#]]===1&/@loopEdits),Print["FAIL: unique targeted continuation hooks"];Quit[1]];
loopRun=StringReplace[loopText,loopEdits];
If[!SyntaxQ[loopRun]||StringReplace[loopRun,Reverse/@loopEdits]=!=loopText,Print["FAIL: unchanged original grouped implementation"];Quit[1]];
ToExpression[loopRun,InputForm];
```
