## common/s09_extend_virtual_reduction.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-350", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 17188, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s09_extend_virtual_reduction.wls", "sha256": "1e60cbbacb7919ca6a57a130cac2fee3ea6aeee2a7ddba14a634c8df9598fd71"} -->
```wolfram
(* Complete only uncovered polarized virtual targets using the original Kira workflow. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[]; checks = <||>;
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s09_extend_virtual_reduction.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  gate["time bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"]; RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
merge[pieces_List] := If[pieces === {}, <||>, Select[Merge[pieces, Factor[Together[Total[#]]] &], # =!= 0 &]];
mapPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s09_result", "s09_result.wl"}];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s09_extension_inputs.json"}];
map = Get[mapPath]; library = Get[libraryPath]; settings = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact virtual map", map["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-virtual-scalar-map-v1" &&
  map["Channel"] === channel && TrueQ[map["MappingAccepted"]] && And @@ Values[map["Checks"]]];
gate["accepted unchanged scalar library", library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
geometry = readLibrary["s02"]; baseline = readLibrary["s09"]; parents = readLibrary["s12"]; evaluations = readLibrary["s13"];
gate["accepted reduction and master inputs", baseline["Accepted"] && parents["Accepted"] && evaluations["AcceptedEuclideanParents"]];
originalSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "reference", "sources", "s09_reduce_virtual.wl"}];
gate["original reduction source binding", baseline["SourceHash"] === FileHash[originalSource, "SHA256"]];
mapperSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s09_map_virtual_spin.wls"}];
gate["original spin mapping source binding", map["SourceHash"] === FileHash[mapperSource, "SHA256"]];
external = geometry["ExternalMomenta"];
externalGram = Take[geometry["CommonGram"], {1, Length[external]}, {1, Length[external]}] /. w -> 0;
families = baseline["Families"]; changes = baseline["Canonicalization"]; canonicalRules = baseline["CanonicalizationRules"];
targets = Union[baseline["Targets"], First /@ baseline["Rules"], baseline["Masters"], map["Targets"]]; names = Sort[Keys[families]];
gate["every polarized target is covered by the requested extension", Complement[map["Targets"], targets, baseline["Masters"]] === {}];
gate["every requested target has an inherited family", Complement[targets[[All, 1]], names] === {}];
kira = settings["kira"]["path"]; fermat = settings["fermat"]["path"];
Do[gate["reviewed executable " <> name, IntegerString[FileHash[settings[name]["path"], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === settings[name]["sha256"]],
  {name, {"kira", "fermat"}}];
SetEnvironment["FERMATPATH" -> fermat];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = Join[{mapPath, libraryPath, configPath, originalSource, mapperSource},
  (FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"][#]["File"]}] &) /@ {"s02", "s09", "s12", "s13"}];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
work = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s09_extension", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
config = FileNameJoin[{work, "config"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[config], CreateDirectory[config, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
originalText = Import[originalSource, "Text"]; ownText = Import[sourcePath, "Text"];
originalBlock = StringTake[originalText, {First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "text[expression_] :="]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "resultFile = FileNameJoin"]]] - 1}];
ownBlock = StringTake[ownText, {Last[First[StringPosition[ownText, "\n(* BEGIN REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n"]]] + 1,
  First[First[StringPosition[ownText, "\n(* END REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n"]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged complete Kira configuration and reader", StringTrim[originalBlock] === StringTrim[ownBlock]];
(* BEGIN REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)
text[expression_] := StringReplace[ToString[InputForm[expression]], Whitespace -> ""];
csv[list_] := "[" <> StringRiffle[text /@ list, ","] <> "]";
integralText[integral_] := integral[[1]] <> csv[integral[[2]]];
invariants = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[externalGram,
  symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]]];
(* Fermat requires lower-case variable names. This is a name change only. *)
exportRules = {Q2 -> q2};
importRules = Reverse /@ exportRules;
gate["invariant rename is invertible", (invariants /. exportRules /. importRules) === invariants];
kinematics = {"kinematics:", "  incoming_momenta: " <> csv[external],
  "  outgoing_momenta: []", "  kinematic_invariants:"};
kinematics = Join[kinematics, ("    - [" <> text[# /. exportRules] <> ", 2]" & /@ invariants),
  {"  scalarproduct_rules:"}, Flatten[Table[
    "    - [[" <> text[external[[i]]] <> "," <> text[external[[j]]] <> "], " <>
      text[externalGram[[i, j]] /. exportRules] <> "]",
    {i, Length[external]}, {j, i, Length[external]}]]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "kinematics.yaml"}], StringRiffle[kinematics, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
familyLines = {"integralfamilies:"};
reductions = {};
preferred = {};
bounds = <||>;
globalR = Max[Total[Select[#, #>0 &]] & /@ targets[[All,2]]] + Length[First[Values[families]]["LoopMomenta"]];
globalS = Max[-Total[Select[#, #<0 &]] & /@ targets[[All,2]]] + Length[First[Values[families]]["LoopMomenta"]];
Do[
  spec = families[name];
  actual = Select[targets, #[[1]] === name &][[All, 2]];
  positiveSums = Total[Select[#, # > 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  negativeSums = -Total[Select[#, # < 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  sectors = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Total[MapIndexed[
    If[#1 > 0, 2^(First[#2] - 1), 0] &, #]] & /@ actual]];
  topSectors = Select[sectors, Function[sector, !AnyTrue[DeleteCases[sectors, sector],
    BitAnd[sector, #] === sector &]]];
  rBound = globalR;
  sBound = globalS;
  AssociateTo[bounds, name -> <|"r" -> rBound, "s" -> sBound,
    "Sectors" -> sectors, "TopSectors" -> topSectors, "TargetCount" -> Length[actual]|>];
  familyLines = Join[familyLines, {"  - name: " <> name,
    "    loop_momenta: " <> csv[spec["LoopMomenta"]],
    "    top_level_sectors: " <> csv[topSectors], "    propagators:"},
    MapThread["      - [\"" <> text[#1] <> "\", " <> text[#2] <> "]" &,
      {spec["PropagatorMomenta"], spec["PropagatorMassesSquared"]}],
    {}];
  AppendTo[reductions, "        - {topologies: [" <> name <> "], sectors: " <>
    csv[topSectors] <> ", r: " <> text[rBound] <> ", s: " <> text[sBound] <> "}"];
  preferred = Join[preferred, Table[GLI[name,
    Table[If[MemberQ[support, i], 1, 0], {i,Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]}]],
    {support, Subsets[Range[Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]]]}]],
  {name, names}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "integralfamilies.yaml"}], StringRiffle[familyLines, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "targets"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ targets, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "preferred"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ preferred, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
jobs = Join[{"jobs:", "  - reduce_sectors:", "      reduce:"}, reductions,
  {"      select_integrals:", "        select_mandatory_list:", "          - [targets]",
   "      preferred_masters: preferred", "      run_initiate: true",
   "      run_triangular: true", "      run_back_substitution: true",
   "  - kira2math:", "      target:", "        - [targets]"}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "jobs.yaml"}], StringRiffle[jobs, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
put[<|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "Bounds" -> bounds,
  "Families" -> families, "Targets" -> targets, "PreferredCandidates" -> preferred,
  "ExportRules" -> exportRules, "ImportRules" -> importRules,
  "Canonicalization" -> changes, "CanonicalizationRules" -> canonicalRules|>, FileNameJoin[{work, "s09_configuration.wl"}]];
Print["KIRA_START ", work, " target count ", Length[targets], " bounds ", InputForm[bounds]];
run = RunProcess[{kira, "--parallel=2", "jobs.yaml"}, All, ProcessDirectory -> work];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s09_kira_stdout.log"}], run["StandardOutput"], "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s09_kira_stderr.log"}], run["StandardError"], "Text"];
Print[StringTake[run["StandardOutput"], -Min[12000, StringLength[run["StandardOutput"]]]]];
If[run["StandardError"] =!= "", Print[run["StandardError"]]];
gate["Kira completed", run["ExitCode"] === 0];
ruleFiles = Sort[FileNames["kira_*.m", FileNameJoin[{work, "results"}], Infinity]];
gate["Kira exported symbolic rules", Length[ruleFiles] > 0];
rules = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ ruleFiles]];
gate["Kira output consists of rules", MatchQ[rules, {__Rule}]];
heads = Symbol /@ names;
toIntegral[expression_] := expression /. (HoldPattern[h_[indices__Integer]] /; MemberQ[heads, h]) :>
  GLI[SymbolName[h], {indices}];
masterFile = FileNameJoin[{work, "tmp", Last[names], "masters"}];
gate["final Kira master inventory exists", FileExistsQ[masterFile]];
declaredMasters = toIntegral[ToExpression /@ StringCases[Import[masterFile, "Text"],
  RegularExpression["V[0-9]+\\[[0-9, -]+\\]"]]];
gate["nonempty final Kira master inventory", MatchQ[declaredMasters, {__GLI}]];
rules = toIntegral[rules] /. importRules /. d -> D;
missingTargets = Complement[targets, First /@ rules];
gate["targets without explicit rules are declared masters",
  Complement[missingTargets, declaredMasters] === {}];
rules = Join[rules, (# -> # & /@ missingTargets)];
gate["each target has a reduction rule", Complement[targets, First /@ rules] === {}];
gate["rules have unique targets", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ rules]];
masters = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules, _GLI, Infinity]]];
closureFiles={};closurePass=0;
missingMasters=Complement[masters,declaredMasters];
While[missingMasters=!={} && closurePass<5,
  closurePass++;
  closureName="closure_"<>ToString[closurePass];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,closureName}],StringRiffle[integralText /@ missingMasters,"\n"]<>"\n","Text"];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,closureName<>".yaml"}],
    "jobs:\n  - kira2math:\n      target:\n        - ["<>closureName<>"]\n","Text"];
  Print["KIRA_EXPORT_CLOSURE ",InputForm[missingMasters]];
  closureRun=RunProcess[{kira,closureName<>".yaml"},All,ProcessDirectory->work];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,"s09_"<>closureName<>".log"}],closureRun["StandardOutput"]<>closureRun["StandardError"],"Text"];
  gate["Kira intermediate-integral export completed",closureRun["ExitCode"]===0];
  files=FileNames["kira_"<>closureName<>".m",FileNameJoin[{work,"results"}],Infinity];
  gate["Kira exported the needed intermediate rules",Length[files]>0];
  closureRules=toIntegral[DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ files]]] /. importRules /. d->D;
  gate["every intermediate has a non-identity Kira rule",Complement[missingMasters,First /@ closureRules]==={} &&
    And@@(First[#]=!=Last[#]& /@ closureRules)];
  rules=(First[#]->Expand[Last[#] /. closureRules]& /@ rules);
  closureFiles=Join[closureFiles,files];
  masters=Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules,_GLI,Infinity]]];
  missingMasters=Complement[masters,declaredMasters]];
put[<|"ExportedMasters" -> masters,"FinalInventory" -> declaredMasters,
  "MissingFromInventory" -> Complement[masters,declaredMasters]|>,FileNameJoin[{work,"s09_master_inventory.wl"}]];
gate["every rule ends in Kira's final master inventory",
  Complement[masters, declaredMasters] === {}];
gate["final virtual basis consists of scalar unit-index masters",
  And @@ (Complement[#[[2]],{0,1}] === {} & /@ masters)];
gate["rule coefficients are rational in symbolic dimension and invariants",
  FreeQ[rules, _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
(* END REFERENCE KIRA WORKFLOW *)
gate["unchanged complete original master basis", Sort[masters] === Sort[baseline["Masters"]]];
Do[gate["original Kira rule " <> ToString[First[row], InputForm],
  bounded[zero[(First[row] /. rules) - Last[row]], {"original reduction comparison", First[row]}]], {row, baseline["Rules"]}];
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s09_reduction_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
reductionPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s09_reduction.wl"}];
put[<|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-virtual-reduction-extension-v1", "Rules" -> rules, "Masters" -> masters,
  "Targets" -> targets, "AdditionalTargets" -> map["MissingTargets"], "Bounds" -> bounds, "Families" -> families,
  "Canonicalization" -> changes, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "BaselineReductionHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"]["s09"]["File"]}], "SHA256"],
  "KiraHash" -> FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], "FermatHash" -> FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"],
  "WorkDirectory" -> work, "RuleFiles" -> ruleFiles, "ClosureRuleFiles" -> closureFiles,
  "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True|>, reductionPath];
completeCoefficients[coefficients_] := Module[{expression, remaining, values},
  expression = Total[KeyValueMap[Times, coefficients]] /. (rules /. Q2 -> Q^2);
  remaining = Union[Cases[expression, _GLI, Infinity]];
  gate["completed component uses only accepted masters", Complement[remaining, baseline["Masters"]] === {}];
  values = AssociationMap[Factor[Coefficient[Expand[expression], #]] &, remaining];
  gate["complete linear reduction reconstruction", zero[expression - Total[KeyValueMap[Times, values]]]];
  Select[values, # =!= 0 &]];
diagrams = Table[Join[diagram, <|"Components" -> Table[
  Join[component, <|"ReducedCoefficients" -> bounded[completeCoefficients[component["ReducedCoefficients"]],
    {diagram["Diagram"], component["Kind"], component["Index"]}], "MissingTargets" -> {}|>],
  {component, diagram["Components"]}]|>], {diagram, map["Diagrams"]}];
(* BEGIN INHERITED COMPONENT ASSEMBLY *)
allComponents = Flatten[Lookup[diagrams, "Components"], 1];
componentKeys = DeleteDuplicates[({#["Kind"], #["Index"]} &) /@ allComponents];
components = Association@Table[key -> merge[Lookup[Select[allComponents, {#["Kind"], #["Index"]} === key &], "ReducedCoefficients"]],
  {key, componentKeys}];
targets = Union[Flatten[Keys /@ Lookup[allComponents, "Coefficients"]]];
missingTargets = Union[Flatten[Lookup[allComponents, "MissingTargets"]]];
valuation[expression_] := If[expression === 0, Infinity, With[{rational = Together[expression /. D -> 4 - 2 eps]},
  Exponent[Numerator[rational], eps, Min] - Exponent[Denominator[rational], eps, Min]]];
requiredOrders = Merge[(Map[If[# === Infinity, 0, Max[0, -#]] &, Map[valuation, #]] &) /@ Values[components], Max];
masterCoverage = missingTargets === {};
depthCoverage = masterCoverage && And @@ KeyValueMap[Function[{master, order},
  With[{series = evaluations["Parents"][parents["VirtualMasterParents"][master]["ParentID"]]["Series"]},
    MatchQ[series, _SeriesData] && series[[5]] > order]], requiredOrders];
(* END INHERITED COMPONENT ASSEMBLY *)
gate["complete spin reduction coverage", masterCoverage];
gate["sufficient existing virtual master depth", depthCoverage];
result = Join[map, <|"Diagrams" -> diagrams, "Components" -> components,
  "MissingTargets" -> missingTargets, "RequiredOrders" -> requiredOrders,
  "ReductionCoverageComplete" -> masterCoverage, "MasterExpansionDepthSufficient" -> depthCoverage,
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash,
  "InputHashes" -> Join[map["InputHashes"], inputHashes], "MappingSourceHash" -> map["SourceHash"],
  "MappingArtifactHash" -> FileHash[mapPath, "SHA256"], "ReductionArtifactHash" -> FileHash[reductionPath, "SHA256"],
  "Checks" -> Join[map["Checks"], checks], "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s09_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s09_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "additional_target_count" -> Length[map["MissingTargets"]], "missing_target_count" -> Length[missingTargets],
  "master_count" -> Length[masters], "master_expansion_depth_sufficient" -> depthCoverage,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s09_extend_virtual_reduction"]; Quit[0];

```

<a id="source-352"></a>

## common/s09_map_virtual_spin.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-352", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 12518, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s09_map_virtual_spin.wls", "sha256": "4d5ef7c92f3a71f9410d8c1fe2c83e26431f23b84b3a0ea83131bb4bd9f072a5"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse the original complete virtual topologies and their Kira reductions. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s09_map_virtual_spin.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  Print["FAIL: time bound ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["FAIL: memory bound ", label]; Quit[3]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
merge[pieces_List] := If[pieces === {}, <||>,
  Select[Merge[pieces, Factor[Together[Total[#]]] &], # =!= 0 &]];

spinPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s07_result", "s07_result.wl"}];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s07_inputs.json"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
referencePath = FileNameJoin[{root, config["channels"][channel]["destination"]}];
gate["pinned original virtual map", IntegerString[FileHash[referencePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === config["channels"][channel]["sha256"]];
spin = Get[spinPath]; reference = Get[referencePath]; library = Get[libraryPath];
gate["accepted virtual spin tensor", spin["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-virtual-response-v1" &&
  spin["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[spin["Checks"]]];
gate["accepted original map and scalar library", reference["Accepted"] &&
  library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
reduction = readLibrary["s09"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
parents = readLibrary["s12"]; evaluations = readLibrary["s13"];
gate["accepted virtual reductions and master values", reduction["Accepted"] && parents["Accepted"] && evaluations["AcceptedEuclideanParents"]];
changes = reduction["Canonicalization"]; families = reduction["Families"];
ruleKeys = First /@ reduction["Rules"];
gate["unique saved rule targets", DuplicateFreeQ[ruleKeys]];
FCClearScalarProducts[];
Scan[Function[row, With[{left = row[[1]], right = row[[2]], value = row[[3]]}, SPD[left, right] = value]],
  Join[spin["BornScalarProducts"], spin["LoopScalarProducts"]]];
loopVariables = spin["LoopScalarProducts"][[All, 3]];
canonicalize[GLI[id_String, indices_List]] := GLI[changes[id]["Family"], indices[[changes[id]["Permutation"]]]];

mapExpression[expression_, topology_] := Module[{id, lines, forms, variables, matrix, constant, coordinateRules,
    transformed, numerator, denominator, denominatorPowers, denominatorCoefficient, polynomial,
    coefficients, reconstructed, change, momenta, old, new, canonicalCoefficients},
  If[expression === 0, Return[<||>]];
  gate["nonzero spin integrand has an inherited topology", MatchQ[topology, _FCTopology]];
  id = topology[[1]]; lines = topology[[2]];
  gate["inherited canonical routing exists", KeyExistsQ[changes, id]];
  forms = ExpandScalarProduct[1/FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit[#]] & /@ lines;
  variables = Array[propagatorCoordinate, Length[forms]];
  matrix = Table[Coefficient[forms[[i]], variable], {i, Length[forms]}, {variable, loopVariables}];
  constant = forms /. Thread[loopVariables -> 0];
  gate["complete affine loop coordinates", Length[forms] === Length[loopVariables] && Det[matrix] =!= 0 &&
    And @@ (zero /@ (forms - matrix.loopVariables - constant))];
  coordinateRules = Thread[loopVariables -> LinearSolve[matrix, variables - constant]];
  gate["loop coordinate reconstruction", And @@ (zero /@ ((forms /. coordinateRules) - variables))];
  transformed = Together[expression /. coordinateRules];
  numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]]; denominator = Factor[Denominator[transformed]];
  gate["polynomial virtual numerator", PolynomialQ[numerator, variables]];
  denominatorPowers = Exponent[denominator, #] & /@ variables;
  denominatorCoefficient = Cancel[denominator/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {variables, denominatorPowers}])];
  gate["inherited topology covers every spin denominator", FreeQ[denominatorCoefficient, Alternatives @@ variables]];
  polynomial = CoefficientRules[numerator, variables];
  coefficients = Association[(GLI[id, denominatorPowers - First[#]] -> Factor[Last[#]/denominatorCoefficient]) & /@ polynomial];
  reconstructed = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power, {forms, -integral[[2]]}]], coefficients]];
  gate["complete virtual integrand reconstruction", zero[reconstructed - expression]];
  gate["native massless standard topology", MatchQ[lines,
    {FeynAmpDenominator[StandardPropagatorDenominator[Momentum[_, D], 0, 0, {1, 1}]]..}]];
  momenta = #[[1, 1, 1]] & /@ lines; change = changes[id];
  Do[
    old = momenta[[change["Permutation"][[i]]]] /. ell -> change["Orientation"] ell - change["Anchor"];
    new = families[change["Family"]]["PropagatorMomenta"][[i]];
    gate["inherited canonical propagator reconstruction", zero[ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[old, old] - SPD[new, new]]]],
    {i, Length[momenta]}];
  canonicalCoefficients = merge[KeyValueMap[(<|canonicalize[#1] -> #2|>) &, coefficients]];
  canonicalCoefficients];

reduceCoefficients[coefficients_] := Module[{missing, expression, remaining, values},
  missing = Complement[Keys[coefficients], ruleKeys, reduction["Masters"]];
  expression = Total[KeyValueMap[Times, coefficients]] /. reduction["Rules"];
  remaining = Union[Cases[expression, _GLI, Infinity]];
  gate["known rules terminate in saved masters", Complement[remaining, Join[missing, reduction["Masters"]]] === {}];
  values = AssociationMap[Factor[Coefficient[Expand[expression], #]] &, remaining];
  gate["linear virtual reduction reconstruction", zero[expression - Total[KeyValueMap[Times, values]]]];
  <|"Coefficients" -> coefficients, "ReducedCoefficients" -> values, "MissingTargets" -> missing|>];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = Join[{spinPath, libraryPath, configPath, referencePath},
  (FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"][#]["File"]}] &) /@ {"s09", "s12", "s13"}];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s09", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
diagrams = {};
Do[
  index = diagram["Diagram"]; pairPath = FileNameJoin[{cache, "diagram_" <> IntegerString[index, 10, 2] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[pairPath], Get[pairPath], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash,
    Print["VIRTUAL_MAP ", channel, " diagram ", index];
    originalMaps = Select[reference["DiagramMaps"], #["Diagram"] === index &];
    topology = SelectFirst[Lookup[originalMaps, "Topology"], MatchQ[#, _FCTopology] &, Missing["ZeroUnpolarizedDiagram"]];
    tasks = {};
    MapIndexed[Function[{value, position}, If[value =!= 0,
      AppendTo[tasks, <|"Kind" -> "ExtendedResponse", "Index" -> position, "Value" -> value|>]]], diagram["ExtendedResponse"], {3}];
    AppendTo[tasks, <|"Kind" -> "PhotonMetricD", "Index" -> {}, "Value" -> diagram["PhotonMetricD"]|>];
    MapIndexed[Function[{value, position}, AppendTo[tasks,
      <|"Kind" -> "PhotonWardLeft", "Index" -> position, "Value" -> value|>]], diagram["PhotonWardLeft"]];
    components = Table[Print["VIRTUAL_COMPONENT ", index, " ", task["Kind"], " ", task["Index"]];
      mapped = bounded[mapExpression[task["Value"], topology], {index, task["Index"], "virtual mapping"}];
      Join[KeyDrop[task, "Value"], bounded[reduceCoefficients[mapped], {index, "virtual reduction"}]], {task, tasks}];
    Do[
      original = SelectFirst[originalMaps, #["Mode"] === mode &];
      ownCDR = reduceCoefficients[bounded[mapExpression[diagram["CDRContractions"][mode], topology], {index, mode, "CDR mapping"}]];
      gate["reference projection reduction is covered", ownCDR["MissingTargets"] === {}];
      originalExpression = (Total[KeyValueMap[Times, original["Coefficients"]]] /.
        integral_GLI :> canonicalize[integral]) /. reduction["Rules"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
      gate["diagram " <> ToString[index] <> " reduced reference " <> mode,
        zero[Total[KeyValueMap[Times, ownCDR["ReducedCoefficients"]]] - originalExpression]], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
    saved = <|"Diagram" -> index, "Components" -> components, "InputHash" -> inputHash,
      "ReconstructionPassed" -> True, "ReducedReferenceChecksPassed" -> True|>;
    put[saved, pairPath]; Clear[components, mapped]; ClearSystemCache[]];
  AppendTo[diagrams, saved], {diagram, spin["Diagrams"]}];
gate["all virtual diagrams mapped", Length[diagrams] === Length[spin["Diagrams"]] &&
  And @@ Lookup[diagrams, "ReconstructionPassed"] && And @@ Lookup[diagrams, "ReducedReferenceChecksPassed"]];
allComponents = Flatten[Lookup[diagrams, "Components"], 1];
componentKeys = DeleteDuplicates[({#["Kind"], #["Index"]} &) /@ allComponents];
components = Association@Table[key -> merge[Lookup[Select[allComponents, {#["Kind"], #["Index"]} === key &], "ReducedCoefficients"]],
  {key, componentKeys}];
targets = Union[Flatten[Keys /@ Lookup[allComponents, "Coefficients"]]];
missingTargets = Union[Flatten[Lookup[allComponents, "MissingTargets"]]];
valuation[expression_] := If[expression === 0, Infinity, With[{rational = Together[expression /. D -> 4 - 2 eps]},
  Exponent[Numerator[rational], eps, Min] - Exponent[Denominator[rational], eps, Min]]];
requiredOrders = Merge[(Map[If[# === Infinity, 0, Max[0, -#]] &, Map[valuation, #]] &) /@ Values[components], Max];
masterCoverage = missingTargets === {};
depthCoverage = masterCoverage && And @@ KeyValueMap[Function[{master, order},
  With[{series = evaluations["Parents"][parents["VirtualMasterParents"][master]["ParentID"]]["Series"]},
    MatchQ[series, _SeriesData] && series[[5]] > order]], requiredOrders];
result = Join[KeyTake[spin, {"Channel", "PhotonLabels", "SpinLabels", "IncomingSpinLabels", "OutgoingSpinLabels", "IndexOrder",
    "TransverseSubstitution", "TransverseConstraint", "BornScalarProducts", "IncomingNormalization", "ModelChargeSquared",
    "CouplingsRemoved", "MasslessQuarkSpecialization", "Gamma5Scheme", "Measure", "LoopPrescription", "InterferenceConvention"}],
  <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-virtual-scalar-map-v1", "Diagrams" -> diagrams, "Components" -> components,
    "Targets" -> targets, "MissingTargets" -> missingTargets, "RequiredOrders" -> requiredOrders,
    "ReductionCoverageComplete" -> masterCoverage, "MasterExpansionDepthSufficient" -> depthCoverage,
    "ScalarConventionRules" -> {Q2 -> Q^2}, "SavedMasterInventory" -> reduction["Masters"],
    "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "Checks" -> checks, "MappingAccepted" -> True, "LoopIntegrated" -> False,
    "IntegratedWardChecksPassed" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s09_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s09_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s09_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "diagram_count" -> Length[diagrams], "component_count" -> Length[components], "target_count" -> Length[targets],
  "missing_target_count" -> Length[missingTargets], "master_expansion_depth_sufficient" -> depthCoverage,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s09_map_virtual_spin"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s10_Hgg_offdiagonal_transfer.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-353", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8845, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s10_Hgg_offdiagonal_transfer.wls", "sha256": "2a3db69ff4f16697fb6b93c603f3d5ef1d8f21266864098e76cf3c91a0e64dcf"} -->
```wolfram
(* Native off-diagonal transfers for Hgg, retaining the accepted S10 conventions. *)
$HistoryLength=0;offDiagonalSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s10_Hgg_offdiagonal_transfer.wls"}];
offDiagonalBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_transfer.wls"}];
offDiagonalText=Import[offDiagonalBase,"Text"];
offDiagonalBegin="a = ChangeDimension[amplitudes[\"qg\"], D]; b = a;";
offDiagonalEnd="inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{dimensionalSource, baselineSource, acceptedPath},";
If[StringCount[offDiagonalText,offDiagonalBegin]=!=1||StringCount[offDiagonalText,offDiagonalEnd]=!=1||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[offDiagonalSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
offDiagonalPrefix=First[StringSplit[offDiagonalText,offDiagonalBegin]];
offDiagonalBody=offDiagonalBegin<>First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[offDiagonalText,offDiagonalBegin]],offDiagonalEnd]];
offDiagonalPrefixChanges={
 "s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_transfer.wls"->"s10_Hgg_offdiagonal_transfer.wls",
 "Environment[\\\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL\\\"] === \\\"Hqg\\\""->"Environment[\\\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL\\\"] === \\\"Hgg\\\""};
If[!And@@(StringCount[offDiagonalPrefix,First[#]]===1&/@offDiagonalPrefixChanges),Print["FAIL: off-diagonal prefix interfaces"];Quit[1]];
offDiagonalPrefixCandidate=StringReplace[offDiagonalPrefix,offDiagonalPrefixChanges];
If[!SyntaxQ[offDiagonalPrefixCandidate]||StringReplace[offDiagonalPrefixCandidate,Reverse/@offDiagonalPrefixChanges]=!=offDiagonalPrefix,Quit[1]];
ToExpression[offDiagonalPrefixCandidate,InputForm];
gate["Hgg off-diagonal owner",Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"]==="Hgg"];
offDiagonalPaths={offDiagonalSource,offDiagonalBase,dimensionalSource,baselineSource,acceptedPath};
offDiagonalRead[relative_]:=Module[{path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}]},AppendTo[offDiagonalPaths,path];
 If[StringEndsQ[relative,".json"],Import[path,"RawJSON"],Get[path]]];
offDiagonalOwnRelative="Hqg/s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_result/s10_result.wl";
offDiagonalOwn=offDiagonalRead[offDiagonalOwnRelative];
offDiagonalOwnReceipt=offDiagonalRead["Hqg/s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_result/s10_execution.json"];
gate["accepted entire native quark-gluon transfer",TrueQ[offDiagonalOwnReceipt["passed"]]&&
 offDiagonalOwnReceipt["result_sha256"][offDiagonalOwnRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,offDiagonalOwnRelative}],"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 offDiagonalOwn["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-quark-gluon-transfer-v1"&&TrueQ[offDiagonalOwn["Accepted"]]&&
 And@@Values[offDiagonalOwn["Checks"]]&&offDiagonalOwn["SourceHash"]===FileHash[offDiagonalBase,"SHA256"]&&
 offDiagonalOwn["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&offDiagonalOwn["IncomingSpinLabels"]===labels&&
 offDiagonalOwn["OutgoingSpinLabels"]===extendedLabels];
KeyValueMap[gate["unchanged native qg input "<>#1,FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"]===#2]&,
 offDiagonalOwn["InputHashes"]];
offDiagonalAntifermions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amplitudes["aqg"],Spinor[-Momentum[mom_,___],___]:>mom,Infinity]];
gate["generated antiquark parent",MemberQ[offDiagonalAntifermions,p]];
offDiagonalBodyChanges={"[\"qg\"]"->"[\"aqg\"]",
 "spinNumerator[p, inVariables, {eX, eY}, False]"->
 "spinNumerator[p, inVariables, {eX, eY}, MemberQ[offDiagonalAntifermions,p]]"};
gate["complete native antiquark interface",StringCount[offDiagonalBody,First[Last[offDiagonalBodyChanges]]]===1];
offDiagonalCandidate=StringReplace[offDiagonalBody,offDiagonalBodyChanges];
gate["unchanged complete native trace and angular integration",SyntaxQ[offDiagonalCandidate]&&
 StringReplace[offDiagonalCandidate,Reverse/@offDiagonalBodyChanges]===offDiagonalBody];
ToExpression[offDiagonalCandidate,InputForm];
offDiagonalFields={"RawDimensionalKernel","PhysicalKernelD","LeadingKernel","CDRKernelD","CDRRegulatorRemainder","MSOperatorD","KernelDifferenceD"};
offDiagonalAnti=AssociationThread[offDiagonalFields,{rawKernel,physicalKernelD,leadingKernel,cdrKernelD,cdrRemainder,msOperatorD,kernelDifferenceD}];
gate["native full-dimensional charge-conjugate output comparison",And@@Table[
 zeroArray[offDiagonalAnti[field]-offDiagonalOwn[field]],{field,offDiagonalFields}]];
offDiagonalFF=<|"qg"->KeyTake[offDiagonalOwn,offDiagonalFields],"aqg"->offDiagonalAnti|>;
offDiagonalPDF=<||>;
offDiagonalPhysical=Flatten[FirstPosition[extendedLabels,#]&/@labels];
offDiagonalExtra=First[FirstPosition[extendedLabels,"E"]];
offDiagonalRank=gram[p][[uPosition,uPosition]];
offDiagonalExtraRank=gram[p][[offDiagonalExtra,offDiagonalExtra]];
offDiagonalAverage=Factor[offDiagonalRank/(offDiagonalRank+offDiagonalExtraRank)];
offDiagonalCompletion=Table[KroneckerDelta[k,offDiagonalPhysical[[i]]]+
 If[labels[[i]]==="U",KroneckerDelta[k,offDiagonalExtra],0],{i,Length[labels]},{k,Length[extendedLabels]}];
offDiagonalIncoming=Transpose[offDiagonalCompletion].DiagonalMatrix[If[#==="U",offDiagonalAverage,1]&/@labels];
Do[
 ffName=First[pair];pdfName=Last[pair];
 fermionLegs=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amplitudes[ffName],Spinor[sign_. Momentum[mom_,___],___]:>mom,Infinity]];
 crossedLegs=Intersection[fermionLegs,{p,k1}];
 crossingSign=(-1)^(Length[crossedLegs]+1);
 crossing=Map[Factor,crossingSign z Transpose[offDiagonalFF[ffName]["RawDimensionalKernel"]/.z->1/z],{2}];
 crossingNormalization=Factor[accepted["Responses"][pdfName]["RealKernel"][[uPosition,uPosition]]/
  Limit[crossing[[uPosition,uPosition]],D->Length[pVector]]];
 gate[pdfName<>" reference-derived crossing normalization",FreeQ[crossingNormalization,z|D|_Real]&&crossingNormalization=!=0];
 crossing=Map[Factor,crossingNormalization crossing,{2}];
 physicalTransfer=crossing[[All,offDiagonalPhysical]];
 leadingTransfer=Map[Factor[Limit[#,D->Length[pVector]]]&,physicalTransfer,{2}];
 gate[pdfName<>" full physical crossing limit",zeroArray[leadingTransfer-accepted["Responses"][pdfName]["RealKernel"]]];
 cdrTransfer=Map[Factor,crossing.offDiagonalIncoming,{2}];
 cdrLimit=Map[Factor[Limit[#,D->Length[pVector]]]&,cdrTransfer,{2}];
 gate[pdfName<>" full CDR physical limit",zeroArray[cdrLimit-leadingTransfer]];
 remainder=Map[Factor,cdrTransfer-cdrLimit,{2}];
 operator=Map[Factor,physicalTransfer-remainder,{2}];
 difference=Map[Factor,operator-leadingTransfer,{2}];
 gate[pdfName<>" exact MS operator reconstruction",zeroArray[operator+remainder-physicalTransfer]];
 gate[pdfName<>" unchanged leading kernels",zeroArray[Map[Limit[#,D->Length[pVector]]&,difference,{2}]]];
 gate[pdfName<>" no new soft endpoint",zeroArray[Map[Limit[(1-z)#,z->1]&,difference,{2}]]];
 gate[pdfName<>" evaluated exact operators",scalarQ[{crossing,operator,difference}]&&
  FreeQ[{crossing,operator,difference},_Limit|_ConditionalExpression|_Piecewise|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
 AssociateTo[offDiagonalPDF,pdfName-><|"CrossedRawDimensionalKernel"->crossing,"PhysicalKernelD"->physicalTransfer,
  "LeadingKernel"->leadingTransfer,"CDRKernelD"->cdrTransfer,"CDRRegulatorRemainder"->remainder,
  "MSOperatorD"->operator,"KernelDifferenceD"->difference,"CrossedFermionLegs"->crossedLegs,
  "CrossingNormalizationDerived"->crossingNormalization|>],{pair,{{"qg","gq"},{"aqg","gaq"}}}];
gate["native crossed charge conjugation",And@@Table[zeroArray[
 offDiagonalPDF["gq"][field]-offDiagonalPDF["gaq"][field]],
 {field,{"CrossedRawDimensionalKernel","MSOperatorD","KernelDifferenceD"}}]];
Print["HGG_NATIVE_OFFDIAGONAL_MS_DIFFERENCES ",InputForm[<|
 "PDF"->Map[#["KernelDifferenceD"]&,offDiagonalPDF],"FF"->Map[#["KernelDifferenceD"]&,offDiagonalFF]|>]];
offDiagonalPaths=DeleteDuplicates[Join[offDiagonalPaths,FileNameJoin[{root,#}]&/@Keys[offDiagonalOwn["InputHashes"]]]];
offDiagonalResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-offdiagonal-transfer-v1","Channel"->"Hgg","SpinLabels"->labels,
 "PDF"->offDiagonalPDF,"FF"->offDiagonalFF,"IncomingCDRAverage"->offDiagonalAverage,
 "CrossingReference"->"arXiv:0807.4424 Eq. (33)","MSReference"->"arXiv:0807.4424 Eqs. (38)-(39)",
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[offDiagonalSource,"SHA256"],"BaseSourceHash"->FileHash[offDiagonalBase,"SHA256"],
 "InputHashes"->Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@offDiagonalPaths],
 "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
offDiagonalDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s10_offdiagonal_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[offDiagonalDirectory],CreateDirectory[offDiagonalDirectory]];
offDiagonalOutput=FileNameJoin[{offDiagonalDirectory,"s10_result.wl"}];put[offDiagonalResult,offDiagonalOutput];
gate["bounded native off-diagonal export",FileByteCount[offDiagonalOutput]<128*1024^2];
gate["exact native off-diagonal reload",Get[offDiagonalOutput]===offDiagonalResult];
Export[FileNameJoin[{offDiagonalDirectory,"s10_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
 "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s10_Hgg_offdiagonal_transfer"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s10_collinear_spin_kernels.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-354", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 15693, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s10_collinear_spin_kernels.wls", "sha256": "4e2e1b0b662948805d939ea52ebd7e227d0719f2d85e03f3843b791b47c09696"} -->
```wolfram
(* LO spin kernels for the reference PDF/FF subtraction convention. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_collinear_spin_kernels.wls"}];
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynCalcLegacy"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
FCSetDiracGammaScheme["BMHV"];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  Print["FAIL: time bound ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["FAIL: memory bound ", label]; Quit[3]];
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
zeroArray[value_] := And @@ (zero /@ Flatten[{value}]);
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);

configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_inputs.json"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
Do[gate["pinned reference " <> row["destination"], IntegerString[
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, row["destination"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]],
  {row, config["files"]}];
referencePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "reference", "s08_result.wl"}];
referenceSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "reference", "s08_collinear_subtraction.wl"}];
basisPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}];
colorPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqq", "s01_result", "reference", "s01_result", "s01_inputs", "s02_result.wl"}];
reference = Get[referencePath]; basis = Get[basisPath]; colorInput = Get[colorPath];
gate["reference subtraction source identity", reference["SourceHash"] === FileHash[referenceSource, "SHA256"]];
gate["reference Born identity", reference["InputHashes"]["s02_result.wl"] === FileHash[colorPath, "SHA256"]];
gate["accepted spin projectors", And @@ Values[basis["Checks"]]];
labels = basis["SpinLabels"]; spinDimension = basis["IncomingDensityNormalization"];
uPosition = First[FirstPosition[labels, "U"]]; hPosition = First[FirstPosition[labels, "H"]];
spinIdentity = Table[Tr[basis["PauliMatrices"][[i]].basis["PauliMatrices"][[j]]]/spinDimension,
  {i, Length[labels]}, {j, Length[labels]}];
gate["endpoint spin identity", spinIdentity === IdentityMatrix[Length[labels]]];
colorNames = <|"CF" -> colorInput["ColorConstants"]["CF"], "CA" -> colorInput["ColorConstants"]["CA"],
  "Tf" -> colorInput["ColorConstants"]["TF"], "Nf" -> Nf|>;
convertKernel[value_] := Module[{converted},
  converted = value /. symbol_Symbol /; KeyExistsQ[colorNames, SymbolName[Unevaluated[symbol]]] :>
    colorNames[SymbolName[Unevaluated[symbol]]];
  converted /.
  {head_[argument_] /; SymbolName[Unevaluated[head]] === "PlusDistribution" :> kernelPlus[argument],
   head_[argument_] /; SymbolName[Unevaluated[head]] === "DeltaFunction" :> kernelDelta[argument]}];
kernelNames = Keys[reference["Kernels"]];
unpolarized = reference["Kernels"] /. x -> z;
helicity = Association@Table[name -> convertKernel[
  reference["KernelNormalization"][name] SplittingFunction[name, z, Polarization -> 1]], {name, kernelNames}];
Do[gate["reference kernel normalization " <> name, zero[unpolarized[name] - convertKernel[
    reference["KernelNormalization"][name] SplittingFunction[name, z, Polarization -> 0]]]], {name, kernelNames}];
gate["native helicity kernels evaluated", FreeQ[helicity, _SplittingFunction]];
ordinary[value_] := value /. {kernelPlus[arg_] :> arg, kernelDelta[_] -> 0};

physical = parentEnergy > 0 && transverseMagnitude > 0 && 0 < z < 1 && Element[azimuth, Reals];
$Assumptions = physical;
metric = DiagonalMatrix[{1, -1, -1, -1}]; dot4[a_, b_] := Expand[a.metric.b];
simplify[value_] := Factor[FullSimplify[TrigReduce[value], Assumptions -> physical]];
pVector = {parentEnergy, 0, 0, parentEnergy}; nVector = {1, 0, 0, -1};
firstTrial = {energy1, transverseMagnitude Cos[azimuth], transverseMagnitude Sin[azimuth], longitudinal1};
secondTrial = {energy2, -transverseMagnitude Cos[azimuth], -transverseMagnitude Sin[azimuth], longitudinal2};
definingEquations = {dot4[firstTrial, nVector] == z dot4[pVector, nVector],
  dot4[secondTrial, nVector] == (1 - z) dot4[pVector, nVector],
  dot4[firstTrial, firstTrial] == 0, dot4[secondTrial, secondTrial] == 0};
solutions = Solve[definingEquations, {energy1, longitudinal1, energy2, longitudinal2}];
gate["unique collinear frame", Length[solutions] === 1 && FreeQ[solutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
firstVector = simplify[firstTrial /. First[solutions]]; secondVector = simplify[secondTrial /. First[solutions]];
gate["collinear frame reconstructs", And @@ FullSimplify[definingEquations /. First[solutions], physical]];
parentVector = firstVector + secondVector; virtuality = simplify[dot4[parentVector, parentVector]];
gate["positive parent virtuality", FullSimplify[virtuality > 0, physical]];
shiftSolutions = Solve[dot4[parentVector - lightlikeShift nVector, parentVector - lightlikeShift nVector] == 0,
  lightlikeShift];
gate["unique lightlike parent projection", Length[shiftSolutions] === 1 && FreeQ[shiftSolutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
gate["reference lightlike parent", zeroArray[simplify[
  (parentVector - lightlikeShift nVector /. First[shiftSolutions]) - pVector]]];
baseX = {0, 1, 0, 0}; baseY = {0, 0, 1, 0};
axis[vector_, base_] := simplify[base - dot4[base, vector] nVector/dot4[nVector, vector]];
frame = <|p -> pVector, n -> nVector, k1 -> firstVector, k2 -> secondVector, parent -> parentVector,
  eX -> baseX, eY -> baseY, outX -> axis[firstVector, baseX], outY -> axis[firstVector, baseY]|>;
gate["daughter transverse axes", zeroArray[simplify[{dot4[frame[outX], firstVector], dot4[frame[outY], firstVector],
  dot4[frame[outX], frame[outY]], dot4[frame[outX], frame[outX]] + 1, dot4[frame[outY], frame[outY]] + 1}]]];
gate["spin axes approach the inherited collinear axes", zeroArray[FullSimplify[
  Limit[{frame[outX] - baseX, frame[outY] - baseY}, transverseMagnitude -> 0], parentEnergy > 0 && 0 < z < 1]]];
FCClearScalarProducts[];
Do[With[{a = aKey, b = bKey, value = simplify[dot4[frame[aKey], frame[bKey]]]}, SP[a, b] = value],
  {aKey, Keys[frame]}, {bKey, Keys[frame]}];
coordinates[value_] := Total[(Coefficient[Expand[value], #] frame[#]) & /@ Keys[frame]];
epsilonRule = HoldPattern[Eps[Momentum[a_], Momentum[b_], Momentum[c_], Momentum[d_]]] :>
  basis["LeviCivitaSign"] Det[coordinates /@ {a, b, c, d}];
inVariables = {1, xIn, yIn, hIn}; outVariables = {1, xOut, yOut, hOut};
spinNumerator[mom_, vars_, axes_, anti_] := FCI[Total[MapThread[Times, {vars,
  basis[If[anti, "AntiquarkSpinNumerators", "QuarkSpinNumerators"]] /.
    {spinMomentum -> mom, spinX -> axes[[1]], spinY -> axes[[2]]}}]]];
coefficient[expr_, vars_, index_] := If[index === 1, expr /. Thread[Rest[vars] -> 0],
  Coefficient[Expand[expr], vars[[index]], 1] /. Thread[DeleteCases[Rest[vars], vars[[index]]] -> 0]];
vertex = QuarkGluonVertex[mu, Dimension -> Length[pVector], CouplingConstant -> 1, Explicit -> True];
amplitudes = <|
  "qq" -> FCI[SpinorUBar[k1, 0].vertex.SpinorU[p, 0] FV[Polarization[k2, I], mu]],
  "gq" -> FCI[SpinorUBar[k1, 0].vertex.SpinorV[k2, 0] FV[Polarization[p, I], mu]],
  "qg" -> FCI[SpinorUBar[k2, 0].vertex.SpinorU[p, 0] FV[Polarization[k1, I], mu]],
  "gg" -> FCI[GluonVertex[{-parent, mu}, {k1, rho}, {k2, sigma}, Dimension -> Length[pVector],
    CouplingConstant -> 1, Explicit -> True] FV[Polarization[p, I], mu]
      FV[Polarization[k1, I], rho] FV[Polarization[k2, I], sigma]],
  "aqaq" -> FCI[SpinorVBar[p, 0].vertex.SpinorV[k1, 0] FV[Polarization[k2, I], mu]],
  "gaq" -> FCI[SpinorUBar[k2, 0].vertex.SpinorV[k1, 0] FV[Polarization[p, I], mu]],
  "aqg" -> FCI[SpinorVBar[p, 0].vertex.SpinorV[k2, 0] FV[Polarization[k1, I], mu]]|>;
referenceNames = <|"qq" -> "Pqq", "gq" -> "Pqg", "qg" -> "Pgq", "gg" -> "Pgg",
  "aqaq" -> "Pqq", "gaq" -> "Pqg", "aqg" -> "Pgq"|>;
gate["native QCD vertices evaluated", FreeQ[amplitudes, _QuarkGluonVertex | _GluonVertex]];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = {configPath, referencePath, referenceSource, basisPath, colorPath};
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
nativeDirectory = "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications/FeynCalc/AddOns/FeynCalcLegacy/LegacyFunctions";
nativeHashes = Association[(# -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{nativeDirectory, #}], "SHA256"]) & /@
  {"SplittingFunction.m", "QuarkGluonVertex.m", "GluonVertex.m"}];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, nativeHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s10", IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
responses = <||>;
Do[
  file = FileNameJoin[{cache, name <> ".wl"}]; saved = If[FileExistsQ[file], Get[file], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash,
    Print["SPLITTING_CHANNEL ", name]; a = amplitudes[name]; b = amplitudes[name];
    gluons = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[a, Polarization[mom_, ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
    antiquarks = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[a, Spinor[-Momentum[mom_], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
    resolvedGluons = Intersection[gluons, {p, k1}];
    Do[a = a /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___]] -> LorentzIndex[leftIndex[leg]];
      b = b /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___]] -> LorentzIndex[rightIndex[leg]], {leg, resolvedGluons}];
    value = FermionSpinSum[a ComplexConjugate[b, FCRenameDummyIndices -> True],
      Head -> keptSpinSum, DotSimplify -> False, FCTraceFactor -> False];
    value = value /. HoldPattern[keptSpinSum[DiracGamma[Momentum[mom_]]] /; MemberQ[{p, k1}, mom]] :>
      spinNumerator[mom, If[mom === p, inVariables, outVariables],
        If[mom === p, {eX, eY}, {outX, outY}], MemberQ[antiquarks, mom]];
    value = value /. keptSpinSum[other_] :> other;
    gate[name <> " complete native spin closure", FreeQ[value, keptSpinSum | _Spinor]];
    Do[value = DoPolarizationSums[value, leg, n], {leg, Complement[gluons, resolvedGluons]}];
    Do[vars = If[leg === p, inVariables, outVariables]; axes = If[leg === p, {eX, eY}, {outX, outY}];
      stokes = Total[MapThread[Times, {vars, (#[[{2, 3}, {2, 3}]] &) /@ basis["GluonStokesTensorsCanonical"]}]];
      If[leg === k1, stokes = Transpose[stokes]];
      value *= Sum[stokes[[i, j]] FV[axes[[i]], leftIndex[leg]] FV[axes[[j]], rightIndex[leg]],
        {i, Length[axes]}, {j, Length[axes]}], {leg, resolvedGluons}];
    value = bounded[Contract[DiracSimplify[value/spinDimension, DiracTraceEvaluate -> True]], {name, "trace"}];
    value = EpsEvaluate[ExpandScalarProduct[value]] /. epsilonRule;
    gate[name <> " scalar exact splitting response", FreeQ[value,
      _Pair | _Eps | _Spinor | _DiracGamma | _DiracTrace | _LorentzIndex | _Polarization | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
    coefficientMatrix = Table[coefficient[coefficient[value, inVariables, i], outVariables, j],
      {j, Length[labels]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
    gate[name <> " complete spin reconstruction", zero[simplify[value -
      outVariables.coefficientMatrix.inVariables]]];
    rawMatrix = Table[Print["SPLITTING_SPIN ", name, " ", j, " ", i]; bounded[Module[{part, averaged},
      part = coefficientMatrix[[j, i]]/virtuality;
      part = Together[TrigReduce[part]];
      gate[name <> " azimuth-independent denominator", FreeQ[Denominator[part], azimuth]];
      averaged = Integrate[part, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}, Assumptions -> physical, GenerateConditions -> False]/
        Integrate[1, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}];
      simplify[Limit[averaged, transverseMagnitude -> 0]]], {name, j, i, "collinear limit"}],
      {j, Length[labels]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
    gate[name <> " evaluated collinear response", FreeQ[rawMatrix,
      _Integrate | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | parentEnergy | transverseMagnitude | azimuth | $Failed | $Aborted]];
    ref = referenceNames[name];
    normalization = Factor[ordinary[unpolarized[ref]]/rawMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]]];
    gate[name <> " reference normalization is kinematics independent", FreeQ[normalization,
      z | parentEnergy | transverseMagnitude | azimuth | _kernelPlus | _kernelDelta | _Real] && normalization =!= 0];
    realMatrix = Map[Factor, normalization rawMatrix, {2}];
    gate[name <> " native unpolarized real kernel", zero[realMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]] - ordinary[unpolarized[ref]]]];
    gate[name <> " native helicity real kernel", zero[realMatrix[[hPosition, hPosition]] - ordinary[helicity[ref]]]];
    softMatrix = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, realMatrix, {2}];
    delta = Factor[Coefficient[Expand[unpolarized[ref] /. {kernelPlus[_] -> plusToken, kernelDelta[_] -> deltaToken}], deltaToken]];
    gate[name <> " reference endpoint coefficient", FreeQ[delta, z | plusToken | deltaToken]];
    kernelMatrix = Map[Factor, realMatrix - softMatrix/(1 - z) +
      softMatrix kernelPlus[1/(1 - z)] + delta spinIdentity kernelDelta[1 - z], {2}];
    gate[name <> " full unpolarized distribution", zero[kernelMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]] - unpolarized[ref]]];
    gate[name <> " full helicity distribution", zero[kernelMatrix[[hPosition, hPosition]] - helicity[ref]]];
    gate[name <> " endpoint spin conservation", zeroArray[softMatrix - softMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]] spinIdentity]];
    gate[name <> " real spin kernel coefficients", zeroArray[ComplexExpand[
      {realMatrix - Conjugate[realMatrix], softMatrix - Conjugate[softMatrix], delta - Conjugate[delta]}]]];
    saved = <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "ReferenceKernel" -> ref, "Kernel" -> kernelMatrix,
      "RealKernel" -> realMatrix, "SoftResidue" -> softMatrix, "DeltaCoefficient" -> delta spinIdentity,
      "ReferenceNormalizationDerived" -> normalization, "NativeReferenceChecksPassed" -> True|>;
    put[saved, file]];
  AssociateTo[responses, name -> saved], {name, Keys[amplitudes]}];
Do[gate["charge conjugation " <> pair[[1]], zeroArray[responses[pair[[1]]]["Kernel"] - responses[pair[[2]]]["Kernel"]]],
  {pair, {{"qq", "aqaq"}, {"gq", "gaq"}, {"qg", "aqg"}}}];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-collinear-kernels-v1", "SpinLabels" -> labels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"daughter spin", "parent spin"}, "ChannelOrder" -> "parent then daughter; aq denotes antiquark",
  "Responses" -> responses, "ReferenceKernelNormalization" -> reference["KernelNormalization"],
  "ReferenceSubtractionPrefactor" -> reference["Prefactor"], "ReferencePlusDefinition" -> reference["PlusDefinition"],
  "KernelFraction" -> z, "Order" -> "LO collinear kernels for NLO hard-coefficient subtraction",
  "EndpointConvention" -> "reference MSbar virtual endpoint times the Pauli spin identity",
  "ConvolutionPerformed" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False,
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "NativeSourceHashes" -> nativeHashes,
  "InputHash" -> inputHash, "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result"}];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s10_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s10_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "channels" -> Keys[responses], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s10_collinear_spin_kernels"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s10_crossed_gluon_transfer.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-355", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10276, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s10_crossed_gluon_transfer.wls", "sha256": "6544029d5db9e010c3b747735a768474b9f7669d668e8ddc08c6447d58770da9"} -->
```wolfram
(* Native intermediate-gluon projectors using the accepted S10 frame and vertex. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
studySource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_crossed_gluon_transfer.wls"}];
baselineSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_collinear_spin_kernels.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "4e2e1b0b662948805d939ea52ebd7e227d0719f2d85e03f3843b791b47c09696", Quit[1]];
baselineText = Import[baselineSource, "Text"];
boundary = StringPosition[baselineText, "sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, \"SHA256\"];"];
If[Length[boundary] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
prefix = StringTake[baselineText, First[First[boundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix] || !SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[prefix, InputForm];
gate["own channel", Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"] === "Hgq"];
acceptedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
accepted = Get[acceptedPath];
gate["accepted physical splitting calculation", accepted["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-collinear-kernels-v1" &&
  accepted["SourceHash"] === FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"] &&
  accepted["SpinLabels"] === labels && And @@ Values[accepted["Checks"]]];
Do[gate["unchanged S10 input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === accepted["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[accepted["InputHashes"]]}];
nativeDirectory = "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications/FeynCalc/AddOns/FeynCalcLegacy/LegacyFunctions";
Do[gate["unchanged native vertex " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{nativeDirectory, name}], "SHA256"] === accepted["NativeSourceHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[accepted["NativeSourceHashes"]]}];
gate["same accepted native runtime", Hash[{FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  accepted["InputHashes"], accepted["NativeSourceHashes"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"] === accepted["InputHash"]];

physicalMomenta[expr_] := expr /. HoldPattern[Momentum[mom_, D]] :>
  If[FreeQ[mom, _Polarization], Momentum[mom], Momentum[mom, D]];
nativeScalar[expr_] := Factor[Together[ExpandScalarProduct[Contract[FCI[physicalMomenta[expr]]]]]];
scalarQ[expr_] := FreeQ[expr, _Pair | _Eps | _LorentzIndex | _Polarization |
  _DiracGamma | _DiracTrace | _Spinor | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted];
fullTransverse[leg_, left_, right_] := physicalMomenta[DoPolarizationSums[
  FVD[Polarization[leg, I], left] FVD[Polarization[leg, -I], right], leg, n]];
projectors[leg_, left_, right_] := projectors[leg, left, right] = Module[{axes, stokes, physicalTensors, full},
  axes = If[leg === p, {eX, eY}, {outX, outY}];
  stokes = (#[[{2, 3}, {2, 3}]] &) /@ basis["GluonStokesTensorsCanonical"];
  If[leg === k1, stokes = Transpose /@ stokes];
  physicalTensors = Table[FCI[Sum[stokes[[a, i, j]] FV[axes[[i]], left] FV[axes[[j]], right],
    {i, Length[axes]}, {j, Length[axes]}]], {a, Length[labels]}];
  full = fullTransverse[leg, left, right];
  Append[physicalTensors, Contract[full - ChangeDimension[full, Length[pVector]]]]];
extendedLabels = Append[labels, "E"];
gram = Association@Table[leg -> bounded[Table[nativeScalar[
    projectors[leg, gramLeft, gramRight][[i]] projectors[leg, gramRight, gramLeft][[j]]],
    {i, Length[extendedLabels]}, {j, Length[extendedLabels]}], {leg, "projector Gram matrix"}],
  {leg, {p, k1}}];
gate["native Gram matrices evaluated", scalarQ[gram]];
duals = Association@Table[leg -> Map[Factor, spinDimension Inverse[gram[leg]], {2}], {leg, {p, k1}}];
Do[gate[ToString[leg] <> " exact projector dual", zeroArray[
    gram[leg].duals[leg] - spinDimension IdentityMatrix[Length[extendedLabels]]]];
  gate[ToString[leg] <> " inherited physical projector normalization", zeroArray[
    gram[leg][[1 ;; Length[labels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]] - spinDimension spinIdentity]];
  gate[ToString[leg] <> " orthogonal dimensional complement", zeroArray[
    Join[gram[leg][[Length[extendedLabels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]],
      gram[leg][[1 ;; Length[labels], Length[extendedLabels]]]]]], {leg, {p, k1}}];

a = ChangeDimension[amplitudes["gg"], D]; b = a;
Do[a = a /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[leftIndex[leg], D];
  b = b /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[rightIndex[leg], D], {leg, {p, k1, k2}}];
openProduct = physicalMomenta[a ComplexConjugate[b, FCRenameDummyIndices -> True]];
gate["native gluon amplitude indices opened", FreeQ[openProduct, _Polarization]];
extendedIn = Append[inVariables, eIn]; extendedOut = Append[outVariables, eOut];
inDensity = extendedIn.projectors[p, leftIndex[p], rightIndex[p]];
outDensity = extendedOut.projectors[k1, leftIndex[k1], rightIndex[k1]];
value = bounded[nativeScalar[openProduct inDensity outDensity
  fullTransverse[k2, leftIndex[k2], rightIndex[k2]]/spinDimension], "extended gg contraction"];
gate["exact scalar extended response", scalarQ[value]];
coefficientMatrix = Table[coefficient[coefficient[value, extendedIn, i], extendedOut, j],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[extendedLabels]}];
gate["exact extended spin reconstruction", zero[simplify[
  value - extendedOut.coefficientMatrix.extendedIn]]];
rawMatrix = Table[Print["GLUON_TRANSFER_COMPONENT ", j, " ", i];
  bounded[Module[{part, averaged},
    part = Together[TrigReduce[coefficientMatrix[[j, i]]/virtuality]];
    gate["inherited azimuth-independent denominator", FreeQ[Denominator[part], azimuth]];
    averaged = Integrate[part, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}, Assumptions -> physical, GenerateConditions -> False]/
      Integrate[1, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}];
    simplify[Limit[averaged, transverseMagnitude -> 0]]], {j, i, "collinear limit"}],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[extendedLabels]}];
gate["evaluated dimensional collinear response", scalarQ[rawMatrix] && FreeQ[rawMatrix,
  _Integrate | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | parentEnergy | transverseMagnitude | azimuth]];
normalization = Factor[ordinary[unpolarized["Pgg"]]/
  Limit[rawMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]], D -> Length[pVector]]];
gate["same reference-derived gg normalization", FreeQ[normalization, z | D | _Real] &&
  zero[normalization - accepted["Responses"]["gg"]["ReferenceNormalizationDerived"]]];
rawKernel = Map[Factor, normalization rawMatrix, {2}];
(* Signer and Stockinger, arXiv:0807.4424, Eq. (33): cross the parent
   and measured daughter before applying the new outgoing projector dual.
   The raw response uses the same fixed physical density normalization on
   both legs; the state-count conversion is retained by the Gram dual. *)
uncrossedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s10_gluon_transfer_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
uncrossed = Get[uncrossedPath];
gate["same accepted unaveraged native splitting tensor", And @@ Values[uncrossed["Checks"]] &&
  uncrossed["RawDimensionalKernel"] === rawKernel && uncrossed["GramMatrices"] === gram &&
  uncrossed["DualMatrices"] === duals && uncrossed["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
crossedFermions = Length[Cases[amplitudes["gg"], _Spinor, Infinity]];
gate["native crossing is purely gluonic", crossedFermions === 0];
crossingSign = (-1)^(crossedFermions + 1);
crossedRawKernel = Map[Factor, crossingSign z Transpose[rawKernel /. z -> 1/z], {2}];
pdfKernelD = Map[Factor, duals[p].crossedRawKernel, {2}];
ffKernelD = Map[Factor, rawKernel.duals[p], {2}];
pdfKernel = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, pdfKernelD, {2}];
ffKernel = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, ffKernelD, {2}];
gate["evaluated dual-normalized leading transitions", FreeQ[{pdfKernel, ffKernel},
  D | _Limit | Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity | _DirectedInfinity | _ConditionalExpression]];
Do[gate[side <> " full accepted physical spin block", zeroArray[
  kernel[[1 ;; Length[labels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]] - accepted["Responses"]["gg"]["RealKernel"]]],
  {pair, {{"PDF", pdfKernel}, {"FF", ffKernel}}}, {side, {First[pair]}}, {kernel, {Last[pair]}}];
pdfSoft = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, pdfKernel, {2}];
ffSoft = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, ffKernel, {2}];
gate["evaluated additional soft limits", FreeQ[{pdfSoft, ffSoft},
  z | D | _Limit | Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity | _DirectedInfinity | _ConditionalExpression]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_PDF_TRANSFER ", InputForm[pdfKernel]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_FF_TRANSFER ", InputForm[ffKernel]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_SOFT_TRANSFER ", InputForm[{pdfSoft, ffSoft}]];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{baselineSource, acceptedPath, uncrossedPath},
  FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Keys[accepted["InputHashes"]]]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-gluon-intermediate-transfer-v1", "SpinLabels" -> extendedLabels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"daughter spin", "parent spin"}, "GramMatrices" -> gram, "DualMatrices" -> duals,
  "RawDimensionalKernel" -> rawKernel, "CrossedRawDimensionalKernel" -> crossedRawKernel,
  "CrossingReference" -> "arXiv:0807.4424 Eq. (33)", "CrossedFermionCount" -> crossedFermions,
  "PDFKernelD" -> pdfKernelD, "FFKernelD" -> ffKernelD,
  "PDFLeadingKernel" -> pdfKernel, "FFLeadingKernel" -> ffKernel,
  "PDFSoftResidue" -> pdfSoft, "FFSoftResidue" -> ffSoft,
  "ReferenceNormalizationDerived" -> normalization, "DimensionLimit" -> Length[pVector],
  "AngularConvention" -> "Original native angular frame; incoming leg obtained by Eq. (33) crossing before Gram dual normalization",
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[studySource, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths],
  "NativeSourceHashes" -> accepted["NativeSourceHashes"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "ConvolutionPerformed" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
out = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s10_crossed_gluon_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out], CreateDirectory[out, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_result.wl"}];
put[result, path]; gate["bounded native export", FileByteCount[path] < 128*1024^2];
gate["exact native result reload", Get[path] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s10_crossed_gluon_transfer"]; Quit[0];
```
