## common/s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-356", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 14105, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer.wls", "sha256": "113b9968a31eec26914c7018515e9ca214bfbc622b9fe7f5a3b539037aef957d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Native intermediate-gluon projectors using the accepted S10 frame and vertex. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
studySource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer.wls"}];
baselineSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_collinear_spin_kernels.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "4e2e1b0b662948805d939ea52ebd7e227d0719f2d85e03f3843b791b47c09696", Quit[1]];
baselineText = Import[baselineSource, "Text"];
boundary = StringPosition[baselineText, "sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, \"SHA256\"];"];
If[Length[boundary] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
prefix = StringTake[baselineText, First[First[boundary]] - 1];
frameChanges = {
  "physical = parentEnergy > 0" -> "physical = D > 4 && 0 < physicalFraction < 1 && parentEnergy > 0",
  "transverseMagnitude Cos[azimuth]" -> "Sqrt[physicalFraction] transverseMagnitude Cos[azimuth]",
  "transverseMagnitude Sin[azimuth]" -> "Sqrt[physicalFraction] transverseMagnitude Sin[azimuth]",
  "dot4[firstTrial, firstTrial] == 0" -> "dot4[firstTrial, firstTrial] == transverseMagnitude^2 (1 - physicalFraction)",
  "dot4[secondTrial, secondTrial] == 0" -> "dot4[secondTrial, secondTrial] == transverseMagnitude^2 (1 - physicalFraction)"};
If[!And @@ (StringContainsQ[prefix, First[#]] & /@ frameChanges), Quit[1]];
prefix = StringReplace[prefix, frameChanges];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix] || !SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[prefix, InputForm];
(* The two daughters carry opposite unresolved transverse components.
   Their physical projections and full-dimensional scalar products are
   fixed by the same defining on-shell equations and momentum conservation. *)
extraMagnitudeSquared = simplify[transverseMagnitude^2 -
  Total[firstVector[[{2, 3}]]^2]];
extraDirections = Association@Table[leg -> simplify[frame[leg][[2]]/firstVector[[2]]], {leg, {k1, k2}}];
Do[With[{left = legA, right = legB,
    value = simplify[dot4[frame[legA], frame[legB]] -
      Lookup[extraDirections, legA, 0] Lookup[extraDirections, legB, 0] extraMagnitudeSquared]}, SPD[left, right] = value],
  {legA, Keys[frame]}, {legB, Keys[frame]}];
gate["opposite unresolved transverse directions", zero[Total[Values[extraDirections]]]];
gate["dimensional daughter mass shells", zeroArray[{SPD[k1, k1], SPD[k2, k2]}]];
gate["dimensional parent virtuality", zero[ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[k1 + k2, k1 + k2]] - virtuality]];
gate["own channel", Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"] === "Hgq"];
acceptedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
accepted = Get[acceptedPath];
gate["accepted physical splitting calculation", accepted["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-collinear-kernels-v1" &&
  accepted["SourceHash"] === FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"] &&
  accepted["SpinLabels"] === labels && And @@ Values[accepted["Checks"]]];
Do[gate["unchanged S10 input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === accepted["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[accepted["InputHashes"]]}];
nativeDirectory = "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications/FeynCalc/AddOns/FeynCalcLegacy/LegacyFunctions";
Do[gate["unchanged native vertex " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{nativeDirectory, name}], "SHA256"] === accepted["NativeSourceHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[accepted["NativeSourceHashes"]]}];
gate["same accepted native runtime", Hash[{FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  accepted["InputHashes"], accepted["NativeSourceHashes"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"] === accepted["InputHash"]];

physicalMomenta[expr_] := MomentumExpand[expr] /. HoldPattern[Momentum[mom_, D]] :>
  If[FreeQ[mom, _Polarization] && FreeQ[mom, k1 | k2], Momentum[mom], Momentum[mom, D]];
nativeScalar[expr_] := Factor[Together[ExpandScalarProduct[Contract[FCI[physicalMomenta[expr]]]]]];
scalarQ[expr_] := FreeQ[expr, _Pair | _Eps | _LorentzIndex | _Polarization |
  _DiracGamma | _DiracTrace | _Spinor | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted];
fullTransverse[leg_, left_, right_] := physicalMomenta[DoPolarizationSums[
  FVD[Polarization[leg, I], left] FVD[Polarization[leg, -I], right], leg, n]];
projectors[leg_, left_, right_] := projectors[leg, left, right] = Module[{axes, stokes, physicalTensors, full},
  axes = If[leg === p, {eX, eY}, {outX, outY}];
  stokes = (#[[{2, 3}, {2, 3}]] &) /@ basis["GluonStokesTensorsCanonical"];
  If[leg === k1, stokes = Transpose /@ stokes];
  physicalTensors = Table[FCI[Sum[stokes[[a, i, j]] FV[axes[[i]], left] FV[axes[[j]], right],
    {i, Length[axes]}, {j, Length[axes]}]], {a, Length[labels]}];
  full = fullTransverse[leg, left, right];
  Append[physicalTensors, Contract[full - physicalTensors[[uPosition]]]]];
extendedLabels = Append[labels, "E"];
gram = Association@Table[leg -> bounded[Table[nativeScalar[
    projectors[leg, gramLeft, gramRight][[i]] projectors[leg, gramRight, gramLeft][[j]]],
    {i, Length[extendedLabels]}, {j, Length[extendedLabels]}], {leg, "projector Gram matrix"}],
  {leg, {p, k1}}];
gate["native Gram matrices evaluated", scalarQ[gram]];
duals = Association@Table[leg -> Map[Factor, spinDimension Inverse[gram[leg]], {2}], {leg, {p, k1}}];
Do[gate[ToString[leg] <> " exact projector dual", zeroArray[
    gram[leg].duals[leg] - spinDimension IdentityMatrix[Length[extendedLabels]]]];
  gate[ToString[leg] <> " inherited physical projector normalization", zeroArray[
    gram[leg][[1 ;; Length[labels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]] - spinDimension spinIdentity]];
  gate[ToString[leg] <> " orthogonal dimensional complement", zeroArray[
    Join[gram[leg][[Length[extendedLabels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]],
      gram[leg][[1 ;; Length[labels], Length[extendedLabels]]]]]], {leg, {p, k1}}];

physicalTransverseRank = gram[p][[uPosition, uPosition]];
extraTransverseRank = gram[p][[Length[extendedLabels], Length[extendedLabels]]];
angularWeight = physicalFraction^(physicalTransverseRank/2 - 1) *
  (1 - physicalFraction)^(extraTransverseRank/2 - 1);
angularMoment[power_] := angularMoment[power] = bounded[FullSimplify[
  Integrate[physicalFraction^power angularWeight, {physicalFraction, 0, 1},
    Assumptions -> D > Length[pVector], GenerateConditions -> False]/
  Integrate[angularWeight, {physicalFraction, 0, 1},
    Assumptions -> D > Length[pVector], GenerateConditions -> False], D > Length[pVector]],
  {"dimensional angular moment", power}];
gate["normalized full transverse angular measure", zero[angularMoment[0] - 1]];
gate["native second moment agrees with dimensional transverse average", zero[
  angularMoment[1]/physicalTransverseRank - 1/(physicalTransverseRank + extraTransverseRank)]];
dimensionalAverage[expression_] := Module[{rational, numerator, denominator, coefficients},
  rational = Together[expression]; numerator = Numerator[rational]; denominator = Denominator[rational];
  gate["polynomial unresolved angular numerator", PolynomialQ[numerator, physicalFraction] &&
    FreeQ[denominator, physicalFraction]];
  coefficients = CoefficientList[numerator, physicalFraction];
  gate["exact unresolved angular reconstruction", Expand[numerator -
    Sum[coefficients[[index]] physicalFraction^(index - 1), {index, Length[coefficients]}]] === 0];
  Factor[Total[MapIndexed[#1 angularMoment[First[#2] - 1] &, coefficients]]/denominator]];

a = ChangeDimension[amplitudes["gg"], D]; b = a;
Do[a = a /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[leftIndex[leg], D];
  b = b /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[rightIndex[leg], D], {leg, {p, k1, k2}}];
openProduct = physicalMomenta[a ComplexConjugate[b, FCRenameDummyIndices -> True]];
gate["native gluon amplitude indices opened", FreeQ[openProduct, _Polarization]];
extendedIn = Append[inVariables, eIn]; extendedOut = Append[outVariables, eOut];
inDensity = extendedIn.projectors[p, leftIndex[p], rightIndex[p]];
outDensity = extendedOut.projectors[k1, leftIndex[k1], rightIndex[k1]];
value = bounded[nativeScalar[openProduct inDensity outDensity
  fullTransverse[k2, leftIndex[k2], rightIndex[k2]]/spinDimension], "extended gg contraction"];
gate["exact scalar extended response", scalarQ[value]];
coefficientMatrix = Table[coefficient[coefficient[value, extendedIn, i], extendedOut, j],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[extendedLabels]}];
gate["exact extended spin reconstruction", zero[simplify[
  value - extendedOut.coefficientMatrix.extendedIn]]];
rawMatrix = Table[Print["GLUON_TRANSFER_COMPONENT ", j, " ", i];
  bounded[Module[{part, averaged},
    part = Together[TrigReduce[coefficientMatrix[[j, i]]/virtuality]];
    gate["inherited azimuth-independent denominator", FreeQ[Denominator[part], azimuth]];
    averaged = Integrate[part, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}, Assumptions -> physical, GenerateConditions -> False]/
      Integrate[1, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}];
    simplify[Limit[dimensionalAverage[averaged], transverseMagnitude -> 0]]], {j, i, "collinear limit"}],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[extendedLabels]}];
gate["evaluated dimensional collinear response", scalarQ[rawMatrix] && FreeQ[rawMatrix,
  _Integrate | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | parentEnergy | transverseMagnitude | azimuth | physicalFraction]];
normalization = Factor[ordinary[unpolarized["Pgg"]]/
  Limit[rawMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]], D -> Length[pVector]]];
gate["same reference-derived gg normalization", FreeQ[normalization, z | D | _Real] &&
  zero[normalization - accepted["Responses"]["gg"]["ReferenceNormalizationDerived"]]];
rawKernel = Map[Factor, normalization rawMatrix, {2}];
(* Signer and Stockinger, arXiv:0807.4424, Eq. (33): cross the parent
   and measured daughter before applying the new outgoing projector dual.
   The raw response uses the same fixed physical density normalization on
   both legs; the state-count conversion is retained by the Gram dual. *)
uncrossedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s10_gluon_transfer_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
uncrossed = Get[uncrossedPath];
gate["same accepted native projectors and physical limit", And @@ Values[uncrossed["Checks"]] &&
  zeroArray[Map[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]] &, rawKernel - uncrossed["RawDimensionalKernel"], {2}]] &&
  uncrossed["GramMatrices"] === gram &&
  uncrossed["DualMatrices"] === duals && uncrossed["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
unpolarizedPositions = {uPosition, Length[extendedLabels]};
fullDimensionalKernel = Factor[spinDimension Total[Flatten[rawKernel[[unpolarizedPositions, unpolarizedPositions]]]]/
  (physicalTransverseRank + extraTransverseRank)];
gate["complete dimensional unpolarized gg kernel", zero[fullDimensionalKernel - ordinary[unpolarized["Pgg"]]]];
crossedFermions = Length[Cases[amplitudes["gg"], _Spinor, Infinity]];
gate["native crossing is purely gluonic", crossedFermions === 0];
crossingSign = (-1)^(crossedFermions + 1);
crossedRawKernel = Map[Factor, crossingSign z Transpose[rawKernel /. z -> 1/z], {2}];
pdfKernelD = Map[Factor, duals[p].crossedRawKernel, {2}];
ffKernelD = Map[Factor, rawKernel.duals[p], {2}];
pdfKernel = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, pdfKernelD, {2}];
ffKernel = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, ffKernelD, {2}];
gate["evaluated dual-normalized leading transitions", FreeQ[{pdfKernel, ffKernel},
  D | _Limit | Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity | _DirectedInfinity | _ConditionalExpression]];
Do[gate[side <> " full accepted physical spin block", zeroArray[
  kernel[[1 ;; Length[labels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]] - accepted["Responses"]["gg"]["RealKernel"]]],
  {pair, {{"PDF", pdfKernel}, {"FF", ffKernel}}}, {side, {First[pair]}}, {kernel, {Last[pair]}}];
pdfSoft = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, pdfKernel, {2}];
ffSoft = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, ffKernel, {2}];
gate["evaluated additional soft limits", FreeQ[{pdfSoft, ffSoft},
  z | D | _Limit | Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity | _DirectedInfinity | _ConditionalExpression]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_PDF_TRANSFER ", InputForm[pdfKernel]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_FF_TRANSFER ", InputForm[ffKernel]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_SOFT_TRANSFER ", InputForm[{pdfSoft, ffSoft}]];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{baselineSource, acceptedPath, uncrossedPath},
  FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Keys[accepted["InputHashes"]]]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-gluon-intermediate-transfer-v1", "SpinLabels" -> extendedLabels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"daughter spin", "parent spin"}, "GramMatrices" -> gram, "DualMatrices" -> duals,
  "RawDimensionalKernel" -> rawKernel, "CrossedRawDimensionalKernel" -> crossedRawKernel,
  "CrossingReference" -> "arXiv:0807.4424 Eq. (33)", "CrossedFermionCount" -> crossedFermions,
  "PDFKernelD" -> pdfKernelD, "FFKernelD" -> ffKernelD,
  "PDFLeadingKernel" -> pdfKernel, "FFLeadingKernel" -> ffKernel,
  "PDFSoftResidue" -> pdfSoft, "FFSoftResidue" -> ffSoft,
  "ReferenceNormalizationDerived" -> normalization, "DimensionLimit" -> Length[pVector],
  "AngularConvention" -> "Full D-2 transverse angular average; incoming crossing before Gram dual normalization",
  "AngularReference" -> "hep-ph/9610553 Eq. (30)", "AngularMoments" -> DownValues[angularMoment],
  "FullDimensionalUnpolarizedKernel" -> fullDimensionalKernel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[studySource, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths],
  "NativeSourceHashes" -> accepted["NativeSourceHashes"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "ConvolutionPerformed" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
out = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s10_dimensional_gluon_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out], CreateDirectory[out, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_result.wl"}];
put[result, path]; gate["bounded native export", FileByteCount[path] < 128*1024^2];
gate["exact native result reload", Get[path] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer"]; Quit[0];
```

## common/s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_transfer.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-357", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7398, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_transfer.wls", "sha256": "16a98ccb008189f631f6da124e602e581219cd7635212f5e9272ef6be7fbf46b"} -->
```wolfram
(* Native q -> g fragmentation transfer in the accepted dimensional frame. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
dimensionalSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[dimensionalSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "113b9968a31eec26914c7018515e9ca214bfbc622b9fe7f5a3b539037aef957d", Quit[1]];
dimensionalText = Import[dimensionalSource, "Text"];
adapterBoundary = StringPosition[dimensionalText, "a = ChangeDimension[amplitudes[\"gg\"], D];"];
If[Length[adapterBoundary] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
originalAdapterPrefix = StringTake[dimensionalText, First[First[adapterBoundary]] - 1];
adapterChanges = {
  "\"s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer.wls\"" -> "\"s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_transfer.wls\"",
  "Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL\"] === \"Hgq\"" ->
    "Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL\"] === \"Hqg\""};
If[!And @@ (StringCount[originalAdapterPrefix, First[#]] === 1 & /@ adapterChanges), Quit[1]];
adapterPrefix = StringReplace[originalAdapterPrefix, adapterChanges];
If[StringReplace[adapterPrefix, Reverse /@ adapterChanges] =!= originalAdapterPrefix, Quit[1]];
ToExpression[adapterPrefix, InputForm];
gate["complete qg entry syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]]];

(* Only the resolved parent gets a physical spin density.  The unobserved
   quark retains the dimensional spin sum from the generated amplitude. *)
a = ChangeDimension[amplitudes["qg"], D]; b = a;
a = a /. Momentum[Polarization[k1, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[leftIndex[k1], D];
b = b /. Momentum[Polarization[k1, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[rightIndex[k1], D];
closed = FermionSpinSum[a ComplexConjugate[b, FCRenameDummyIndices -> True],
  Head -> keptSpinSum, DotSimplify -> False, FCTraceFactor -> False];
closed = closed /. HoldPattern[keptSpinSum[DiracGamma[Momentum[p, ___], ___]]] :>
  spinNumerator[p, inVariables, {eX, eY}, False];
closed = closed /. keptSpinSum[other_] :> other;
gate["complete native quark spin closure", FreeQ[closed, keptSpinSum | _Spinor | _Polarization]];
extendedOut = Append[outVariables, eOut];
outDensity = extendedOut.projectors[k1, leftIndex[k1], rightIndex[k1]];
value = bounded[Contract[DiracSimplify[physicalMomenta[closed outDensity/spinDimension],
    DiracTraceEvaluate -> True]], "dimensional qg trace"];
value = Factor[Together[EpsEvaluate[ExpandScalarProduct[value]] /. epsilonRule]];
gate["exact scalar dimensional qg response", scalarQ[value]];
coefficientMatrix = Table[coefficient[coefficient[value, inVariables, i], extendedOut, j],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
gate["complete dimensional qg spin reconstruction", zero[simplify[
  value - extendedOut.coefficientMatrix.inVariables]]];
rawMatrix = Table[Print["QUARK_GLUON_TRANSFER_COMPONENT ", j, " ", i];
  bounded[Module[{part, averaged},
    part = Together[TrigReduce[coefficientMatrix[[j, i]]/virtuality]];
    gate["inherited qg azimuth-independent denominator", FreeQ[Denominator[part], azimuth]];
    averaged = Integrate[part, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}, Assumptions -> physical, GenerateConditions -> False]/
      Integrate[1, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}];
    simplify[Limit[dimensionalAverage[averaged], transverseMagnitude -> 0]]],
    {j, i, "qg collinear limit"}],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
gate["evaluated dimensional qg collinear response", scalarQ[rawMatrix] && FreeQ[rawMatrix,
  _Integrate | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | parentEnergy |
  transverseMagnitude | azimuth | physicalFraction]];
normalization = Factor[ordinary[unpolarized[referenceNames["qg"]]]/
  Limit[rawMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]], D -> Length[pVector]]];
gate["same reference-derived qg normalization", FreeQ[normalization, z | D | _Real] &&
  zero[normalization - accepted["Responses"]["qg"]["ReferenceNormalizationDerived"]]];
rawKernel = Map[Factor, normalization rawMatrix, {2}];
physicalPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[extendedLabels, #] & /@ labels];
ePosition = First[FirstPosition[extendedLabels, "E"]];
physicalKernelD = rawKernel[[physicalPositions, All]];
leadingKernel = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, physicalKernelD, {2}];
gate["all physical qg spin entries reproduce accepted S10", zeroArray[
  leadingKernel - accepted["Responses"]["qg"]["RealKernel"]]];
gate["extra gluon response has zero physical limit", zeroArray[
  Map[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]] &, rawKernel[[ePosition]]]]];
completion = Table[KroneckerDelta[k, physicalPositions[[i]]] +
    If[labels[[i]] === "U", KroneckerDelta[k, ePosition], 0],
  {i, Length[labels]}, {k, Length[extendedLabels]}];
cdrKernelD = Map[Factor, completion.rawKernel, {2}];
cdrLeading = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, cdrKernelD, {2}];
gate["CDR qg physical limit preserves all spin components", zeroArray[cdrLeading - leadingKernel]];
cdrRemainder = Map[Factor, cdrKernelD - cdrLeading, {2}];
msOperatorD = Map[Factor, physicalKernelD - cdrRemainder, {2}];
kernelDifferenceD = Map[Factor, msOperatorD - leadingKernel, {2}];
gate["native qg MS operator reconstruction", zeroArray[
  msOperatorD + cdrRemainder - physicalKernelD]];
gate["qg MS change has zero physical limit", zeroArray[
  Map[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]] &, kernelDifferenceD, {2}]]];
gate["qg MS change has no soft endpoint", zeroArray[
  Map[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1] &, kernelDifferenceD, {2}]]];
Print["NATIVE_QG_DIMENSIONAL_MATRIX ", InputForm[rawKernel]];
Print["NATIVE_QG_CDR_MATRIX ", InputForm[cdrKernelD]];
Print["NATIVE_QG_MS_DIFFERENCE ", InputForm[kernelDifferenceD]];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{dimensionalSource, baselineSource, acceptedPath},
  FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Keys[accepted["InputHashes"]]]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-quark-gluon-transfer-v1", "Channel" -> "Hqg",
  "IncomingSpinLabels" -> labels, "OutgoingSpinLabels" -> extendedLabels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"daughter spin", "parent spin"},
  "RawDimensionalKernel" -> rawKernel, "PhysicalKernelD" -> physicalKernelD,
  "LeadingKernel" -> leadingKernel, "CDRKernelD" -> cdrKernelD,
  "CDRRegulatorRemainder" -> cdrRemainder, "MSOperatorD" -> msOperatorD,
  "KernelDifferenceD" -> kernelDifferenceD, "MSReference" -> "arXiv:0807.4424 Eqs. (36)-(39)",
  "DimensionLimit" -> Length[pVector], "ReferenceNormalizationDerived" -> normalization,
  "AngularConvention" -> "Full D-2 transverse angular average; same accepted S10 frame and physical axes",
  "AngularMoments" -> DownValues[angularMoment],
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[studySource, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths],
  "NativeSourceHashes" -> accepted["NativeSourceHashes"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "ConvolutionPerformed" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
out = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqg", "s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out], CreateDirectory[out, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_result.wl"}]; put[result, path];
gate["bounded qg native export", FileByteCount[path] < 128*1024^2];
gate["exact qg native result reload", Get[path] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s10_dimensional_quark_gluon_transfer"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Native intermediate-gluon projectors using the accepted S10 frame and vertex. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
studySource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_gluon_evanescent_transfer.wls"}];
baselineSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_collinear_spin_kernels.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "4e2e1b0b662948805d939ea52ebd7e227d0719f2d85e03f3843b791b47c09696", Quit[1]];
baselineText = Import[baselineSource, "Text"];
boundary = StringPosition[baselineText, "sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, \"SHA256\"];"];
If[Length[boundary] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
prefix = StringTake[baselineText, First[First[boundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix] || !SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[prefix, InputForm];
gate["own channel", Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"] === "Hgq"];
acceptedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
accepted = Get[acceptedPath];
gate["accepted physical splitting calculation", accepted["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-collinear-kernels-v1" &&
  accepted["SourceHash"] === FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"] &&
  accepted["SpinLabels"] === labels && And @@ Values[accepted["Checks"]]];
Do[gate["unchanged S10 input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === accepted["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[accepted["InputHashes"]]}];
nativeDirectory = "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications/FeynCalc/AddOns/FeynCalcLegacy/LegacyFunctions";
Do[gate["unchanged native vertex " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{nativeDirectory, name}], "SHA256"] === accepted["NativeSourceHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[accepted["NativeSourceHashes"]]}];
gate["same accepted native runtime", Hash[{FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  accepted["InputHashes"], accepted["NativeSourceHashes"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"] === accepted["InputHash"]];

physicalMomenta[expr_] := expr /. HoldPattern[Momentum[mom_, D]] :>
  If[FreeQ[mom, _Polarization], Momentum[mom], Momentum[mom, D]];
nativeScalar[expr_] := Factor[Together[ExpandScalarProduct[Contract[FCI[physicalMomenta[expr]]]]]];
scalarQ[expr_] := FreeQ[expr, _Pair | _Eps | _LorentzIndex | _Polarization |
  _DiracGamma | _DiracTrace | _Spinor | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted];
fullTransverse[leg_, left_, right_] := physicalMomenta[DoPolarizationSums[
  FVD[Polarization[leg, I], left] FVD[Polarization[leg, -I], right], leg, n]];
projectors[leg_, left_, right_] := projectors[leg, left, right] = Module[{axes, stokes, physicalTensors, full},
  axes = If[leg === p, {eX, eY}, {outX, outY}];
  stokes = (#[[{2, 3}, {2, 3}]] &) /@ basis["GluonStokesTensorsCanonical"];
  If[leg === k1, stokes = Transpose /@ stokes];
  physicalTensors = Table[FCI[Sum[stokes[[a, i, j]] FV[axes[[i]], left] FV[axes[[j]], right],
    {i, Length[axes]}, {j, Length[axes]}]], {a, Length[labels]}];
  full = fullTransverse[leg, left, right];
  Append[physicalTensors, Contract[full - ChangeDimension[full, Length[pVector]]]]];
extendedLabels = Append[labels, "E"];
gram = Association@Table[leg -> bounded[Table[nativeScalar[
    projectors[leg, gramLeft, gramRight][[i]] projectors[leg, gramRight, gramLeft][[j]]],
    {i, Length[extendedLabels]}, {j, Length[extendedLabels]}], {leg, "projector Gram matrix"}],
  {leg, {p, k1}}];
gate["native Gram matrices evaluated", scalarQ[gram]];
duals = Association@Table[leg -> Map[Factor, spinDimension Inverse[gram[leg]], {2}], {leg, {p, k1}}];
Do[gate[ToString[leg] <> " exact projector dual", zeroArray[
    gram[leg].duals[leg] - spinDimension IdentityMatrix[Length[extendedLabels]]]];
  gate[ToString[leg] <> " inherited physical projector normalization", zeroArray[
    gram[leg][[1 ;; Length[labels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]] - spinDimension spinIdentity]];
  gate[ToString[leg] <> " orthogonal dimensional complement", zeroArray[
    Join[gram[leg][[Length[extendedLabels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]],
      gram[leg][[1 ;; Length[labels], Length[extendedLabels]]]]]], {leg, {p, k1}}];

a = ChangeDimension[amplitudes["gg"], D]; b = a;
Do[a = a /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[leftIndex[leg], D];
  b = b /. Momentum[Polarization[leg, ___], D] -> LorentzIndex[rightIndex[leg], D], {leg, {p, k1, k2}}];
openProduct = physicalMomenta[a ComplexConjugate[b, FCRenameDummyIndices -> True]];
gate["native gluon amplitude indices opened", FreeQ[openProduct, _Polarization]];
extendedIn = Append[inVariables, eIn]; extendedOut = Append[outVariables, eOut];
inDensity = extendedIn.projectors[p, leftIndex[p], rightIndex[p]];
outDensity = extendedOut.projectors[k1, leftIndex[k1], rightIndex[k1]];
value = bounded[nativeScalar[openProduct inDensity outDensity
  fullTransverse[k2, leftIndex[k2], rightIndex[k2]]/spinDimension], "extended gg contraction"];
gate["exact scalar extended response", scalarQ[value]];
coefficientMatrix = Table[coefficient[coefficient[value, extendedIn, i], extendedOut, j],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[extendedLabels]}];
gate["exact extended spin reconstruction", zero[simplify[
  value - extendedOut.coefficientMatrix.extendedIn]]];
rawMatrix = Table[Print["GLUON_TRANSFER_COMPONENT ", j, " ", i];
  bounded[Module[{part, averaged},
    part = Together[TrigReduce[coefficientMatrix[[j, i]]/virtuality]];
    gate["inherited azimuth-independent denominator", FreeQ[Denominator[part], azimuth]];
    averaged = Integrate[part, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}, Assumptions -> physical, GenerateConditions -> False]/
      Integrate[1, {azimuth, 0, 2 Pi}];
    simplify[Limit[averaged, transverseMagnitude -> 0]]], {j, i, "collinear limit"}],
  {j, Length[extendedLabels]}, {i, Length[extendedLabels]}];
gate["evaluated dimensional collinear response", scalarQ[rawMatrix] && FreeQ[rawMatrix,
  _Integrate | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | parentEnergy | transverseMagnitude | azimuth]];
normalization = Factor[ordinary[unpolarized["Pgg"]]/
  Limit[rawMatrix[[uPosition, uPosition]], D -> Length[pVector]]];
gate["same reference-derived gg normalization", FreeQ[normalization, z | D | _Real] &&
  zero[normalization - accepted["Responses"]["gg"]["ReferenceNormalizationDerived"]]];
rawKernel = Map[Factor, normalization rawMatrix, {2}];
pdfKernelD = Map[Factor, duals[k1].rawKernel, {2}];
ffKernelD = Map[Factor, rawKernel.duals[p], {2}];
pdfKernel = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, pdfKernelD, {2}];
ffKernel = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> Length[pVector]]] &, ffKernelD, {2}];
gate["evaluated dual-normalized leading transitions", FreeQ[{pdfKernel, ffKernel},
  D | _Limit | Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity | _DirectedInfinity | _ConditionalExpression]];
Do[gate[side <> " full accepted physical spin block", zeroArray[
  kernel[[1 ;; Length[labels], 1 ;; Length[labels]]] - accepted["Responses"]["gg"]["RealKernel"]]],
  {pair, {{"PDF", pdfKernel}, {"FF", ffKernel}}}, {side, {First[pair]}}, {kernel, {Last[pair]}}];
pdfSoft = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, pdfKernel, {2}];
ffSoft = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, ffKernel, {2}];
gate["evaluated additional soft limits", FreeQ[{pdfSoft, ffSoft},
  z | D | _Limit | Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity | _DirectedInfinity | _ConditionalExpression]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_PDF_TRANSFER ", InputForm[pdfKernel]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_FF_TRANSFER ", InputForm[ffKernel]];
Print["NATIVE_GLUON_SOFT_TRANSFER ", InputForm[{pdfSoft, ffSoft}]];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{baselineSource, acceptedPath},
  FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Keys[accepted["InputHashes"]]]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-gluon-intermediate-transfer-v1", "SpinLabels" -> extendedLabels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"daughter spin", "parent spin"}, "GramMatrices" -> gram, "DualMatrices" -> duals,
  "RawDimensionalKernel" -> rawKernel, "PDFKernelD" -> pdfKernelD, "FFKernelD" -> ffKernelD,
  "PDFLeadingKernel" -> pdfKernel, "FFLeadingKernel" -> ffKernel,
  "PDFSoftResidue" -> pdfSoft, "FFSoftResidue" -> ffSoft,
  "ReferenceNormalizationDerived" -> normalization, "DimensionLimit" -> Length[pVector],
  "AngularConvention" -> "Original S10 physical transverse frame; leading dual-normalized transitions",
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[studySource, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths],
  "NativeSourceHashes" -> accepted["NativeSourceHashes"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "ConvolutionPerformed" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
out = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s10_gluon_transfer_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out], CreateDirectory[out, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_result.wl"}];
put[result, path]; gate["bounded native export", FileByteCount[path] < 128*1024^2];
gate["exact native result reload", Get[path] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s10_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s10_gluon_evanescent_transfer"]; Quit[0];
```

## common/s10_result/reference/s08_collinear_subtraction.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-360", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 11585, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s10_result/reference/s08_collinear_subtraction.wl", "sha256": "6b821fc64d1b8b593f6635dd49269a36b62588903c1681763a1e6b034cfe865d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Paper Eq. 46: symbolic PDF and fragmentation convolutions in s23. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
$LoadAddOns = {"FeynCalcLegacy"};
Get["FeynCalc`"];
root = DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
ClearAll[gate, bounded, convolution, mappedBorn];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test], Print["PASS: ", name], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[work_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[work, 900,
  Print["Time limit: ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["Memory limit: ", label]; Quit[3]];
born = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_result.wl"}]];
generated = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, "s01_result.wl"}]];
gate["S02 source identity", born["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s02_born_and_projectors.wl"}], "SHA256"]];
gate["S01 source identity", generated["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, "s01_generate_amplitudes.wl"}], "SHA256"]];
physical = Q2 > 0 && s > s23 > 0 && s23 - Q2 - s < t < -Q2 s23/s && B > 0;
endpointRegion = Q2 > 0 && s > 0 && -Q2 - s < t < 0 && B > 0;

cfValue = born["ColorConstants"]["CF"];
caValue = born["ColorConstants"]["CA"];
tfValue = born["ColorConstants"]["TF"];
colorNames = <|"CF" -> cfValue, "CA" -> caValue, "Tf" -> tfValue, "Nf" -> Nf|>;
libraryKernels = Association@Table[name -> (SplittingFunction[name, x, Polarization -> 0] /.
  symbol_Symbol /; KeyExistsQ[colorNames, SymbolName[Unevaluated[symbol]]] :>
    colorNames[SymbolName[Unevaluated[symbol]]]), {name, {"Pqq", "Pqg", "Pgq", "Pgg"}}];
libraryKernels = libraryKernels /.
  {head_[argument_] /; SymbolName[Unevaluated[head]] === "PlusDistribution" :> kernelPlus[argument],
   head_[argument_] /; SymbolName[Unevaluated[head]] === "DeltaFunction" :> kernelDelta[argument]};
gate["splitting-function tool evaluated", FreeQ[libraryKernels, _SplittingFunction]];
(* Defining reference conventions: paper Eqs. 51-53. *)
paperPqq = 2 cfValue (2 kernelPlus[1/(1 - x)] - 1 - x + 3 kernelDelta[1 - x]/2);
paperPqg = 2 tfValue ((1 - x)^2 + x^2);
paperPgq = 2 cfValue (1 + (1 - x)^2)/x;
normalizations = <|"Pqq" -> Factor[paperPqq/libraryKernels["Pqq"]],
  "Pqg" -> Factor[paperPqg/libraryKernels["Pqg"]],
  "Pgq" -> Factor[paperPgq/libraryKernels["Pgq"]]|>;
kernelMoment[kernel_, test_] := Module[{expression, plus, delta, ordinary},
  expression = Expand[kernel /. {kernelPlus[1/(1 - x)] -> p0, kernelDelta[1 - x] -> d0}];
  plus = Coefficient[expression, p0]; delta = Coefficient[expression, d0];
  ordinary = expression /. {p0 -> 0, d0 -> 0};
  Factor[Integrate[Cancel[test ordinary + plus (test - (test /. x -> 1))/(1 - x)],
    {x, 0, 1}, Assumptions -> SUNN > 1 && Nf >= 0, GenerateConditions -> False] + delta (test /. x -> 1)]];
fermionSpecies = Select[DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Values[generated["OutgoingSpecies"]]]],
  MemberQ[{quark, antiquark}, #] &];
fermionMultiplicity = Length[fermionSpecies];
gluonMomentumEquation = kernelMoment[ggNormalization libraryKernels["Pgg"], x] +
  Nf fermionMultiplicity kernelMoment[paperPqg, x] == 0;
gluonSolutions = Solve[gluonMomentumEquation, ggNormalization];
gate["gluon momentum sum rule fixes one kernel normalization", Length[gluonSolutions] === 1];
AssociateTo[normalizations, "Pgg" -> Factor[ggNormalization /. First[gluonSolutions]]];
gate["kernel normalizations are exact constants", FreeQ[normalizations,
  x | SUNN | Nf | ggNormalization | _kernelPlus | _kernelDelta | _Real | _Integrate]];
kernels = Association@KeyValueMap[(#1 -> Factor[normalizations[#1] #2]) &, libraryKernels];
gate["Pqq agrees with paper Eq. 51", Factor[kernels["Pqq"] - paperPqq] === 0];
gate["Pqg agrees with paper Eq. 52", Factor[kernels["Pqg"] - paperPqg] === 0];
gate["Pgq agrees with paper Eq. 53", Factor[kernels["Pgq"] - paperPgq] === 0];
gate["quark number sum rule", kernelMoment[kernels["Pqq"], 1] === 0];
gate["quark momentum sum rule", kernelMoment[kernels["Pqq"] + paperPgq, x] === 0];
gate["gluon momentum sum rule", Factor[kernelMoment[kernels["Pgg"], x] +
  Nf fermionMultiplicity kernelMoment[kernels["Pqg"], x]] === 0];
Print["Derived kernel normalizations = ", InputForm[normalizations]];

(* Enumerate Eq. 46 using generated incoming and final-state species. *)
splittingName[daughter_, parent_] := Which[
  daughter === gluon && parent === gluon, "Pgg",
  MemberQ[fermionSpecies, daughter] && daughter === parent, "Pqq",
  MemberQ[fermionSpecies, daughter] && parent === gluon, "Pqg",
  daughter === gluon && MemberQ[fermionSpecies, parent], "Pgq", True, Missing["Zero"]];
externalIncoming = First[DeleteCases[generated["IncomingSpecies"]["Born"], photon]];
externalObserved = generated["ObservedSpecies"];
bornProcesses = Table[
  incoming = First[DeleteCases[generated["IncomingSpecies"][key], photon]];
  gate["generated Born observation momentum is k1", First[generated["Requests"][key]["OutgoingMomenta"]] === k1];
  <|"Born" -> key, "Incoming" -> incoming, "Observed" -> First[generated["OutgoingSpecies"][key]]|>,
  {key, generated["BornInputs"]}];
routes = Join[
  Map[Append[#, "Side" -> "PDF"] &, Select[bornProcesses,
    #["Observed"] === externalObserved && !MissingQ[splittingName[#["Incoming"], externalIncoming]] &]],
  Map[Append[#, "Side" -> "FF"] &, Select[bornProcesses,
    #["Incoming"] === externalIncoming && !MissingQ[splittingName[externalObserved, #["Observed"]]] &]]];
routes = Map[Append[#, "Kernel" -> If[#["Side"] === "PDF",
  splittingName[#["Incoming"], externalIncoming], splittingName[externalObserved, #["Observed"]]]] &, routes];
gate["selected routes have generated tagged Born inputs and tool kernels", Length[routes] > 0 &&
  And @@ (KeyExistsQ[kernels, #["Kernel"]] && MemberQ[generated["BornInputs"], #["Born"]] & /@ routes)];
gate["Eq. 46 routes are unique", DuplicateFreeQ[KeyTake[#, {"Side", "Born", "Kernel"}] & /@ routes]];
Print["Generated Eq. 46 routes = ", InputForm[routes]];

FCClearScalarProducts[];
DataType[eta, FCVariable] = True;
DataType[zeta, FCVariable] = True;
Scan[Function[row, With[{v1 = row[[1]], v2 = row[[2]], value = row[[3]]},
  SPD[v1, v2] = value]], born["RealScalarProducts"]];
invariants = <|"s" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q]],
  "t" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[q - k1/zeta]],
  "recoil" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q - k1/zeta]]|>;
gate["scaled invariants contain no unresolved scalar products", FreeQ[invariants, _Pair]];
gate["unscaled recoil is s23", Factor[invariants["recoil"] /. {eta -> 1, zeta -> 1}] === s23];
incomingRoot = eta /. First[Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. zeta -> 1) == 0, eta]];
outgoingRoot = zeta /. First[Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. eta -> 1) == 0, zeta]];
incomingJacobian = FullSimplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], eta] /.
  {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1}], physical];
outgoingJacobian = FullSimplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], zeta] /.
  {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot}], physical];
gate["convolution roots lie inside the partonic support", FullSimplify[
  0 < incomingRoot < 1 && 0 < outgoingRoot < 1, physical]];

(* Derive the pp projector conversion from the tensor definition, Eq. 16. *)
transverse[mu_] := FVD[eta p, mu] - FVD[q, mu] SPD[eta p, q]/SPD[q, q];
tensor = (-MTD[mu, nu] + FVD[q, mu] FVD[q, nu]/SPD[q, q]) f1 +
  transverse[mu] transverse[nu] f2/SPD[eta p, q];
incomingProjectorScale = Factor[Contract[FVD[p, mu] FVD[p, nu] tensor]/
  Contract[FVD[eta p, mu] FVD[eta p, nu] tensor]] // ExpandScalarProduct // Factor;
gate["projector conversion does not depend on the tensor coefficients", FreeQ[
  incomingProjectorScale, f1 | f2 | _Pair]];
bornD = <|"Born" -> <|"Pg" -> born["BornPg"], "Ppp" -> born["BornPpp"]|>,
  "AuxHgqBorn" -> born["AuxHgqBorn"], "AuxHqgBorn" -> born["AuxHqgBorn"]|>;
mappedBorn[mode_, key_] := (bornD[key][mode] /.
  {s -> invariants["s"], t -> invariants["t"]}) *
  If[mode === "Ppp", incomingProjectorScale, 1];

convolution[mode_, key_, kernel_, rootValue_, weight_] := Module[{expandedKernel, plusCoefficient,
  deltaCoefficient, regularKernel, poleFunction, endpointCoefficient, endpointRatio,
  bornEndpoint, mappedDelta, result},
  expandedKernel = Expand[kernel /. {kernelPlus[1/(1 - x)] -> p0, kernelDelta[1 - x] -> d0}];
  plusCoefficient = Coefficient[expandedKernel, p0];
  deltaCoefficient = Coefficient[expandedKernel, d0];
  regularKernel = expandedKernel /. {p0 -> 0, d0 -> 0};
  bornEndpoint = bornD[key][mode];
  If[plusCoefficient =!= 0,
    poleFunction = Factor[weight/(1 - rootValue)];
    endpointCoefficient = FullSimplify[Limit[s23 poleFunction, s23 -> 0], endpointRegion];
    endpointRatio = FullSimplify[Limit[(1 - rootValue)/s23, s23 -> 0], endpointRegion];
    gate["plus mapping has a positive endpoint scale", FullSimplify[endpointRatio > 0, endpointRegion]];
    gate["auxiliary endpoint pole cancels", Factor[endpointCoefficient - bornEndpoint] === 0];
    mappedDelta = FullSimplify[Normal[Series[
      (B^lambdaCut endpointRatio^lambdaCut endpointCoefficient - bornEndpoint)/lambdaCut,
      {lambdaCut, 0, 0}]], endpointRegion],
    poleFunction = 0; endpointCoefficient = 0; mappedDelta = 0];
  result = <|"Delta" -> Factor[deltaCoefficient bornEndpoint + plusCoefficient mappedDelta],
    "L0" -> Factor[plusCoefficient endpointCoefficient],
    "Regular" -> Factor[weight (regularKernel /. x -> rootValue) +
      plusCoefficient (poleFunction - endpointCoefficient/s23)]|>;
  gate["mapped convolution reconstructs its ordinary part", Factor[result["Regular"] +
    result["L0"]/s23 - weight (kernel /. {kernelDelta[_] -> 0, kernelPlus[a_] :> a} /. x -> rootValue)] === 0];
  result];

contributions = Association@Table[mode -> Association@Table[
  key = route["Born"];
  weight = If[route["Side"] === "PDF",
    Factor[incomingJacobian/incomingRoot * (mappedBorn[mode, key] /. {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1})],
    Factor[outgoingJacobian/outgoingRoot^2 * (mappedBorn[mode, key] /. {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot})]];
  StringRiffle[{route["Side"], key, route["Kernel"]}, "_"] -> convolution[mode, key,
    kernels[route["Kernel"]], If[route["Side"] === "PDF", incomingRoot, outgoingRoot], weight],
  {route, routes}], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];

(* Convert the Eq. 46 coupling factor to the same eq^2 gs^4 normalization. *)
alphaRule = First[Solve[gs^2 == 4 Pi alphaS, alphaS]];
prefactor = Factor[(gs^2 alphaS/(4 Pi) (2 Pi)/gs^4) /. alphaRule];
msPole = 1/eps - EulerGamma + Log[4 Pi];
result = Association@Table[mode -> Association@Table[distribution -> bounded[
  Normal[Series[prefactor msPole (Total[(#[distribution] &) /@
    Values[contributions[mode]]] /. D -> 4 - 2 eps), {eps, 0, 0}]], {mode, distribution}],
  {distribution, {"Delta", "L0", "Regular"}}], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
Put[<|"Counterterms" -> result, "ConvolutionsD" -> contributions, "Kernels" -> kernels,
  "KernelNormalization" -> normalizations, "Routes" -> routes,
  "FermionSpeciesMultiplicity" -> fermionMultiplicity, "AuthorsCoefficientsUsed" -> False, "IncomingRoot" -> incomingRoot,
  "OutgoingRoot" -> outgoingRoot, "IncomingJacobian" -> incomingJacobian,
  "OutgoingJacobian" -> outgoingJacobian, "IncomingProjectorScale" -> incomingProjectorScale,
  "Prefactor" -> prefactor, "Regulator" -> eps, "PlusDefinition" -> "L0=[1/s23]_+ on [0,B]",
  "CouplingsRemoved" -> "eq^2 gs^4", "HardTensorNormalization" -> "(2 Pi)^(-4) applied at final assembly",
  "InputHashes" -> Association@Table[name -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"],
    {name, {"s01_result.wl", "s02_result.wl"}}],
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[$InputFileName, "SHA256"]|>, FileNameJoin[{root, "s08_result.wl"}]];
Print["S08_SUCCESS; peak memory = ", MaxMemoryUsed[], " bytes."];
Quit[];
```

## common/s11_check_Hgq_dimensional_operator.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-362", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 15051, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_check_Hgq_dimensional_operator.wls", "sha256": "b9b458f0932eb506d15f332fae1db39536140976ab9311b2db1253d95bed0003"} -->
```wolfram
(* Original S11 convolution with the native intermediate-gluon transfer. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
studySource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_check_Hgq_dimensional_operator.wls"}];
baselineSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "4fa3afa28525d57a63c8aea1dee8a4825d761b504f0cd8192837360ec5b531c6", Quit[1]];
baselineText = Import[baselineSource, "Text"];
boundary = StringPosition[baselineText, "completionPath = FileNameJoin["];
If[Length[boundary] =!= 1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
prefix = StringTake[baselineText, First[First[boundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix], Quit[1]]; ToExpression[prefix, InputForm];
gate["own gluon subtraction channel", channel === "Hgq"];
inputPaths = {baselineSource};
read[relative_] := Module[{path = FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]},
  AppendTo[inputPaths, path]; If[StringEndsQ[path, ".json"], Import[path, "RawJSON"], Get[path]]];
currentRelative = channel <> "/s11_result/reference/before_resolved_gluon/s11_result.wl";
previousRelative = channel <> "/s11_result/reference/before_dimensional_completion/s11_result.wl";
current = read[currentRelative]; previous = read[previousRelative];
previousSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_result", "reference", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions_before_dimensional.wls"}];
AppendTo[inputPaths, previousSource];
gate["same original and completed subtraction inputs", current["Channel"] === channel &&
  previous["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[current["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[previous["Checks"]] &&
  current["SourceHash"] === FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"] &&
  previous["SourceHash"] === FileHash[previousSource, "SHA256"] &&
  current["Routes"] === routes && previous["Routes"] === routes &&
  current["Prefactor"] === previous["Prefactor"] && current["Prefactor"] === reference["Prefactor"] &&
  current["MSPole"] === previous["MSPole"]];
Do[gate["unchanged actual convolution input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === current["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[current["InputHashes"]]}];
nativeRelative = channel <> "/s10_dimensional_gluon_result/s10_result.wl";
native = read[nativeRelative]; nativeReceipt = read[channel <> "/s10_dimensional_gluon_result/s10_execution.json"];
nativeSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer.wls"}];
AppendTo[inputPaths, nativeSource];
gate["accepted native intermediate transfer", TrueQ[nativeReceipt["passed"]] &&
  nativeReceipt["job_id"] === "14816855" && nativeReceipt["result_sha256"][nativeRelative] ===
    IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, nativeRelative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
  native["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-gluon-intermediate-transfer-v1" &&
  native["SourceHash"] === FileHash[nativeSource, "SHA256"] && TrueQ[native["Accepted"]] &&
  And @@ Values[native["Checks"]] && native["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  native["InputHashes"]["common/s10_result/s10_result.wl"] === FileHash[kernelPath, "SHA256"]];
Do[gate["unchanged native transition input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === native["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[native["InputHashes"]]}];
spinBasis = read["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"];
physicalPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[native["SpinLabels"], #] & /@ labels];
ePosition = First[FirstPosition[native["SpinLabels"], "E"]];
selfRoutes = Select[routes, #["KernelKey"] === "gg" &];
gate["unique own intermediate gluon route", Length[selfRoutes] === 1 &&
  First[selfRoutes]["Side"] === "PDF" && First[selfRoutes]["BornChannel"] === channel];
self = First[selfRoutes]; selfName = self["ReferenceName"];
born = borns[channel]; photonLabels = born["PhotonLabels"];
bornInPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[born["ExtendedIncomingLabels"], #] & /@ native["SpinLabels"]];
bornOutPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[born["ExtendedOutgoingLabels"], #] & /@ labels];
extendedBorn = born["ExtendedResponse"][[All, bornOutPositions, bornInPositions]];
mappedBorn = bounded[simplify[extendedBorn /. mapRules["PDF"]], "original mapped extended Born response"];
gate["same physical Born response", zeroArray[
  extendedBorn[[All, All, physicalPositions]] - born["Response"]]];
gate["extra Born component vanishes in physical dimension",
  zeroArray[extendedBorn[[All, All, ePosition]] /. D -> native["DimensionLimit"]]];
leadingPhysical = Table[If[j === ePosition, 0, native["PDFLeadingKernel"][[j, i]]],
  {j, Length[native["SpinLabels"]]}, {i, physicalPositions}];
kernelDifferenceD = Map[Factor, native["PDFKernelD"][[All, physicalPositions]] - leadingPhysical, {2}];
gate["exact dimensional kernel decomposition", zeroArray[
  leadingPhysical + kernelDifferenceD - native["PDFKernelD"][[All, physicalPositions]]]];
gate["unchanged leading physical kernel", zeroArray[Map[
  Limit[#, D -> native["DimensionLimit"]] &, kernelDifferenceD[[physicalPositions]], {2}]]];
softDifference = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, kernelDifferenceD, {2}];
gate["dimensional kernel difference has no soft endpoint", zeroArray[softDifference]];
gate["dimensional unpolarized MS kernel has no regulator term", zero[
  native["FullDimensionalUnpolarizedKernel"] -
    native["PDFLeadingKernel"][[uPosition, uPosition]]]];
extraKernel = kernelDifferenceD /. z -> x;
pieces = Table[
  Print["DIMENSIONAL_OPERATOR_CONVOLUTION ", a, " ", j, " ", i];
  terms = Table[
    If[extraKernel[[k, i]] === 0 ||
        (extendedBorn[[a, j, k]] === 0 && mappedBorn[[a, j, k]] === 0),
      AssociationThread[distributions, ConstantArray[0, Length[distributions]]],
      bounded[convolution[extendedBorn[[a, j, k]], extraKernel[[k, i]], roots["PDF"],
        simplify[measureWeights["PDF"] mappedBorn[[a, j, k]]]],
        {a, j, i, k, "dimensional operator convolution"}]],
    {k, Length[native["SpinLabels"]]}];
  Merge[terms, Factor[Total[#]] &],
  {a, Length[photonLabels]}, {j, Length[labels]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
extraConvolutions = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[#[distribution] &, pieces, {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}];
gate["evaluated additional convolutions", FreeQ[extraConvolutions,
  _Missing | _Integrate | _Limit | _SeriesData | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
gate["native zero endpoint contributions", zeroArray[Lookup[extraConvolutions, {"Delta", "L0"}]]];
candidateRoutes = previous["RouteConvolutionsD"];
AssociateTo[candidateRoutes, selfName -> Association@Table[distribution ->
  Map[Factor, candidateRoutes[selfName][distribution] + extraConvolutions[distribution], {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}]];
candidateConvolutions = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  Total[#[distribution] & /@ Values[candidateRoutes]], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["only the computed native route added", zeroArray[Values[candidateConvolutions] -
  Values[previous["ConvolutionsD"]] - Values[extraConvolutions]]];
candidateCounterterms = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[
  bounded[Normal[Series[reference["Prefactor"] previous["MSPole"] (# /. D -> 4 - 2 eps), {eps, 0, 0}]],
    {distribution, "original counterterm expansion"}] &, candidateConvolutions[distribution], {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}];
correction = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  candidateCounterterms[distribution] - current["Counterterms"][distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
extraCounterterms = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  candidateCounterterms[distribution] - previous["Counterterms"][distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["complete native counterterm change is finite", FreeQ[{correction, extraCounterterms}, eps | D] &&
  FreeQ[candidateCounterterms, _Series | _SeriesData | _Missing | $Failed | $Aborted]];

residualRelative = channel <> "/s11_resolved_gluon_result/s11_result.wl";
residualPacket = read[residualRelative]; residualReceipt = read[channel <> "/s11_resolved_gluon_result/s11_execution.json"];
residualSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_check_Hgq_resolved_gluon.wls"}];
AppendTo[inputPaths, residualSource];
gate["exact completed residual calculation", residualReceipt["job_id"] === "14816029" &&
  residualPacket["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-resolved-gluon-subtraction-comparison-v1" &&
  residualPacket["SourceHash"] === FileHash[residualSource, "SHA256"] &&
  residualPacket["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  residualPacket["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[residualPacket["Checks"]] &&
  residualPacket["Counterterms"] === previous["Counterterms"] &&
  residualPacket["ConvolutionsD"] === previous["ConvolutionsD"]];
Do[gate["unchanged residual equation input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === residualPacket["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[residualPacket["InputHashes"]]}];
Do[gate["unchanged accepted finite checkpoint " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === residualPacket["CheckpointHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[residualPacket["CheckpointHashes"]]}];
inspection = read[channel <> "/s14_reference_residual_result/s14_result.wl"];
termProof = read[channel <> "/s14_reference_terms_result/s14_result.wl"];
gate["same original finite assembly", residualPacket["OriginalAssemblyInputHash"] === inspection["InputHash"] &&
  termProof["InspectionHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s14_reference_residual_result", "s14_result.wl"}], "SHA256"] &&
  And @@ Values[inspection["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[termProof["Checks"]]];
assemblyPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}]; AppendTo[inputPaths, assemblyPath];
gate["same finite projection source", inspection["BaselineSourceHash"] === FileHash[assemblyPath, "SHA256"] &&
  termProof["AssemblySourceHash"] === FileHash[assemblyPath, "SHA256"]];
assemblyText = Import[assemblyPath, "Text"];
domainLines = Select[StringSplit[assemblyText, "\n"], StringStartsQ[#, "physical="] || StringStartsQ[#, "softPhysical="] &];
gate["unique original finite domains", Length[domainLines] === 2 && SyntaxQ[StringRiffle[domainLines, "\n"]]];
ToExpression[StringRiffle[domainLines, "\n"], InputForm];
hatConfig = read["common/s14_inputs.json"];
referenceHats = Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{name, relative}, name -> read[relative]],
  hatConfig["channels"][channel]["unpolarized_hats"]];
expectedInventory = Flatten[Table[{name, sign, distribution}, {name, Keys[referenceHats]},
  {sign, Keys[referenceHats[name]["NLO"]]}, {distribution, Keys[referenceHats[name]["NLO"][sign]]}], 2];
gate["every original finite distribution retained", Sort[Lookup[#, {"Hat", "Branch", "Distribution"}] & /@
  residualPacket["Comparisons"]] === Sort[expectedInventory]];
comparisonRows = Table[
  name = row["Hat"]; sign = row["Branch"]; distribution = row["Distribution"];
  weights = inspection["PhotonWeights"][[First[FirstPosition[Keys[referenceHats], name]]]];
  change = If[KeyExistsQ[extraCounterterms, distribution], extraCounterterms[distribution][[All, uPosition, uPosition]],
    ConstantArray[0, Length[weights]]];
  projectedChange = termProof["Normalization"] weights.change /. t -> sign omega - s;
  assumptions = (If[distribution === "Regular", physical, softPhysical] /. t -> sign omega - s) &&
    If[sign === 0, True, omega > 0];
  difference = bounded[Factor[Together[row["Residual"] + projectedChange]], {name, sign, distribution, "native correction"}];
  residual = If[difference === 0, 0, bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[difference, assumptions], assumptions],
    {name, sign, distribution, "physical-domain comparison"}]];
  Print["NATIVE_GLUON_REFERENCE_RESIDUAL ", name, " ", sign, " ", distribution, " ", InputForm[residual]];
  <|"Hat" -> name, "Branch" -> sign, "Distribution" -> distribution, "Residual" -> residual, "Equal" -> (residual === 0)|>,
  {row, residualPacket["Comparisons"]}];
allEqual = And @@ Lookup[comparisonRows, "Equal"];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[inputPaths, FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Keys[current["InputHashes"]]]];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
sourceHash = FileHash[studySource, "SHA256"];
proof = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-native-gluon-convolution-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "NativeTransferHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, nativeRelative}], "SHA256"],
  "OriginalAssemblyInputHash" -> inspection["InputHash"], "CheckpointHashes" -> residualPacket["CheckpointHashes"],
  "OriginalSubtractionHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, currentRelative}], "SHA256"],
  "KernelDifferenceD" -> kernelDifferenceD, "ExtraConvolutionsD" -> extraConvolutions, "ExtraCounterterms" -> extraCounterterms,
  "Correction" -> correction, "Comparisons" -> comparisonRows, "Checks" -> checks,
   "Accepted" -> allEqual, "AcceptedForProduction" -> False,
  "SchemeStatus" -> "Dimensional operator comparison; final spin factorization conversion not certified",
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
out = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s11_dimensional_operator_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out], CreateDirectory[out, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
proofPath = FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_comparison.wl"}]; put[proof, proofPath];
gate["exact native comparison reload", Get[proofPath] === proof];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "all_reference_components_restored" -> allEqual,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
gate["all native-corrected finite reference components match", allEqual];
result = Join[previous, <|"RouteConvolutionsD" -> candidateRoutes, "ConvolutionsD" -> candidateConvolutions,
  "Counterterms" -> candidateCounterterms, "CountertermDifference" -> correction,
  "IntermediateStateConvention" -> "Full dimensional operator before finite spin factorization conversion",
  "AcceptedForProduction" -> False, "SchemeStatus" -> proof["SchemeStatus"],
  "PreviousSubtractionHash" -> proof["OriginalSubtractionHash"], "NativeTransferHash" -> proof["NativeTransferHash"],
  "ConvolutionComparisonHash" -> FileHash[proofPath, "SHA256"],
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "BaseSourceHash" -> FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"],
  "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[result], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded native subtraction export", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"]; gate["exact native subtraction reload", Get[path <> ".tmp"] === result];
RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Print["PASS: s11_check_Hgq_dimensional_operator"]; Quit[0];
```

## common/s11_check_Hgq_resolved_gluon.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-363", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10708, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_check_Hgq_resolved_gluon.wls", "sha256": "83110d1d35ef72aff34c8579c3a3ec54ca9a95c34aedb46f00cd2466337ee0a9"} -->

```wolfram
(* Check the physical resolved-gluon route against the complete saved Hgq reference. *)
```

```wolfram
$HistoryLength=0;completionRoot=Directory[];

gate["residual binds this subtraction",completionResidual["InputHashes"][channel<>"/s11_result/s11_result.wl"]===
  FileHash[completionOldPath,"SHA256"]];
completionDiagnosticPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_dimensional_result","s14_result.wl"}];
gate["dimensional comparison identity",IntegerString[FileHash[completionDiagnosticPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "45e1bb0654442f0446bbf6ac3e8151b93e722904ab5527907a0ad209987014c1"];

gate["full-dimensional metric poles exactly cancel",bounded[zeroArray[Values[
  completionDiagnostic["MetricCDRPoleResiduals"]]],"CDR metric exact pole check"]];

completeIntermediateBorn[data_,side_] := Module[{extended,physicalPositions,intermediateLabels,
  intermediatePositions,conversion,average,answer},
  extended=Join[data["ExtendedResponse"],{data["EvanescentPhotonResponse"]}];
  intermediateLabels=data[If[side==="PDF","ExtendedIncomingLabels","ExtendedOutgoingLabels"]];
  physicalPositions=Flatten[FirstPosition[data[If[side==="PDF","ExtendedOutgoingLabels","ExtendedIncomingLabels"]],#]&/@labels];
  intermediatePositions=Flatten[Position[intermediateLabels,"U"|"E"]];
  average=If[side==="PDF",data["CDRAverageConversion"],1];
  conversion=Table[If[labels[[i]]==="U",If[MemberQ[intermediatePositions,k],average,0],
    Boole[intermediateLabels[[k]]===labels[[i]]]],{k,Length[intermediateLabels]},{i,Length[labels]}];
  answer=If[side==="PDF",(#.conversion&/@extended[[All,physicalPositions,All]]),
    (Transpose[conversion].#&/@extended[[All,All,physicalPositions]])];
  <|"Response"->Map[Factor,answer,{3}],"Conversion"->conversion,
    "IntermediateLabels"->intermediateLabels,"PhysicalPositions"->physicalPositions|>];

Do[key=route["Born"];side=route["Side"];
  completed=completeIntermediateBorn[borns[key],side];
  gate[route["Name"]<>" physical four-dimensional limit unchanged",zeroArray[
    (Take[completed["Response"],Length[photonLabels]]-borns[key]["Response"])/.D->4]];
  mapped=bounded[simplify[completed["Response"]/.mapRules[side]],{route["Name"],"completed Born"}];
  kernelMatrix=kernels["Responses"][route["Kernel"]]["Kernel"]/.z->roots[side];
  value=bounded[Map[Factor,measureWeights[side] If[side==="PDF",
    (Dot[#,kernelMatrix]&/@mapped),(Dot[kernelMatrix,#]&/@mapped)],{3}],route["Name"]];
  gate[route["Name"]<>" completed convolution evaluated",FreeQ[value,_Dot|_Missing|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
  AssociateTo[completionBorns,route["Name"]->completed];
  AssociateTo[completionContributions,route["Name"]->value],{route,routes}];

completionPhysical=Take[completionRegular,Length[photonLabels]];
completionCDRContractions=bornCoupling {
  completionMetricWeights.completionPhysical[[All,uPosition,uPosition]]+Last[completionRegular][[uPosition,uPosition]],
  completionPWeights.completionPhysical[[All,uPosition,uPosition]]};
gate["completed spin contraction reproduces both full-dimensional reference convolutions",
  zeroArray[completionCDRContractions-Lookup[referenceConvolutions,{"g","pp"}]]];
completionDifference=Map[Factor,completionPhysical-completionOld["ConvolutionsD"]["Regular"],{3}];
completionCorrection=Map[bounded[Normal[Series[completionOld["PhaseCT"] bornCoupling (#/.D->4-2eps),
  {eps,0,0}]],"finite dimensional counterterm correction"]&,completionDifference,{3}];
completionCorrection=Map[Factor,completionCorrection,{3}];
gate["dimensional correction changes no pole",FreeQ[completionCorrection,eps|D|_Series|_SeriesData|_Missing|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
completionAssemblySource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
gate["unchanged final assembly source",IntegerString[FileHash[completionAssemblySource,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "9f511361187996d8fef88f8897ba2b40018032d9d4e789ec2cd17d445939a94a"];

  RegularExpression["(?m)^couplingSquare=[^;]+;"]];
gate["unique inherited coupling normalization",Length[completionCouplingDefinitions]===1];

completionNormalize[value_] := Block[{branches,normalization,core=False},
  branches=<|1-><|"Regular"->value|>|>;
  ToExpression[completionResidual["NormalizationSource"],InputForm];branches[1]["Regular"]];
completionHatCorrections=completionNormalize[completionResidual["PhotonWeights"].

completionRemaining=Map[Factor,Lookup[completionResidual["Rows"],"Residual"]+completionHatCorrections];
completionMatches=zeroArray[completionRemaining];
Print["COMPLETED_INTERMEDIATE_STATE_RESTORES_BOTH_HATS ",completionMatches];
Print["COMPLETION_REMAINING ",InputForm[completionRemaining]];
completionResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-dimensional-convolution-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[completionSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->FileHash[completionBaseline,"SHA256"],
  "OriginalSubtractionHash"->FileHash[completionOldPath,"SHA256"],
  "ResidualInspectionHash"->FileHash[completionResidualPath,"SHA256"],
  "DimensionalDiagnosticHash"->FileHash[completionDiagnosticPath,"SHA256"],
  "Definitions"->DownValues[completeIntermediateBorn],"CompletedBornStates"->completionBorns,
  "RouteConvolutionsD"->completionContributions,"RegularConvolutionD"->completionPhysical,
  "CountertermCorrection"->completionCorrection,"RemainingHatResiduals"->completionRemaining,
  "RestoresReferenceHats"->completionMatches,"Accepted"->completionMatches,
  "InputHashes"->completionOld["InputHashes"],"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
completionDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_dimensional_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[completionDir],CreateDirectory[completionDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
completionPath=FileNameJoin[{completionDir,"s11_result.wl"}];
put[completionResult,completionPath];gate["exact completion comparison reload",Get[completionPath]===completionResult];
Export[FileNameJoin[{completionDir,"s11_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
```

```wolfram
(* Spin-matrix PDF/FF convolutions in the pinned reference measurement. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"]; checks = <||>;
```
