```wolfram
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  Print["FAIL: time bound ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["FAIL: memory bound ", label]; Quit[3]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"]; RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
zeroArray[value_] := And @@ (zero /@ Flatten[{value}]);
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_inputs.json"}];
baseConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s01_inputs.json"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"]; baseConfig = Import[baseConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["supported subtraction channel", KeyExistsQ[config["channels"], channel]];
referenceRow = config["channels"][channel];
Do[gate["pinned subtraction input " <> relative, IntegerString[
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    SelectFirst[config["files"], #["destination"] === relative &]["sha256"]], {relative, Values[referenceRow]}];
reference = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["result"]}]];
gate["reference subtraction source binding", reference["SourceHash"] ===
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["source"]}], "SHA256"]];
kernelPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
kernelInput = Get[kernelPath];
gate["accepted spin splitting kernels", kernelInput["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-collinear-kernels-v1" &&
  And @@ Values[kernelInput["Checks"]]];
labels = kernelInput["SpinLabels"]; uPosition = First[FirstPosition[labels, "U"]];
coreChannels = Keys[config["channels"]]; borns = <||>; species = <||>; additionalPaths = {};
Do[bornPath = FileNameJoin[{root, coreChannel, "s03_result", "s03_result.wl"}];
  born = Get[bornPath]; AppendTo[additionalPaths, bornPath];
  gate[coreChannel <> " accepted Born", born["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-born-response-v2" &&
    born["Channel"] === coreChannel && And @@ Values[born["Checks"]]];
  ampRelative = baseConfig["channel_contracts"][coreChannel]["amplitude_file"];
  ampPath = FileNameJoin[{root, ampRelative}]; AppendTo[additionalPaths, ampPath];
  gate[coreChannel <> " pinned open amplitudes", IntegerString[FileHash[ampPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    SelectFirst[baseConfig["files"], #["destination"] === ampRelative &]["sha256"]];
  amp = Get[ampPath]["Born"];
  fermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amp, Spinor[sign_. Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
  anti = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[amp, Spinor[-Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
  gate[coreChannel <> " core resolved species", Intersection[anti, {p, k1}] === {}];
  AssociateTo[species, coreChannel -> (If[MemberQ[fermions, #], "q", "g"] & /@ {p, k1})];
  AssociateTo[borns, coreChannel -> born], {coreChannel, coreChannels}];
gate["unique generated Born species", DuplicateFreeQ[Values[species]]];
gate["shared accepted photon and spin bases", And @@ Table[
  borns[key]["PhotonLabels"] === borns[channel]["PhotonLabels"] && borns[key]["SpinLabels"] === labels,
  {key, coreChannels}]];
originalBornRelative = baseConfig["channel_contracts"]["Hqq"]["unpolarized_born_file"];
originalBornPath = FileNameJoin[{root, originalBornRelative}]; originalBorn = Get[originalBornPath];
AppendTo[additionalPaths, originalBornPath];
gate["pinned real scalar products", IntegerString[FileHash[originalBornPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  SelectFirst[baseConfig["files"], #["destination"] === originalBornRelative &]["sha256"]];
physical = Q > 0 && s > s23 > 0 && s23 - Q^2 - s < t < -Q^2 s23/s && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
endpointRegion = Q > 0 && s > 0 && -Q^2 - s < t < 0 && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
simplify[value_] := FullSimplify[value, Assumptions -> physical];
FCClearScalarProducts[]; DataType[eta, FCVariable] = True; DataType[zeta, FCVariable] = True;
Scan[Function[row, With[{a = row[[1]], b = row[[2]], value = row[[3]] /. Q2 -> Q^2}, SPD[a, b] = value]],
  originalBorn["RealScalarProducts"]];
invariants = <|"s" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q]],
  "t" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[q - k1/zeta]],
  "recoil" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q - k1/zeta]]|>;
gate["scaled invariants evaluated", FreeQ[invariants, _Pair]];
incomingSolutions = Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. zeta -> 1) == 0, eta];
outgoingSolutions = Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. eta -> 1) == 0, zeta];
gate["unique convolution roots", Length[incomingSolutions] === 1 && Length[outgoingSolutions] === 1];
incomingRoot = eta /. First[incomingSolutions]; outgoingRoot = zeta /. First[outgoingSolutions];
incomingJacobian = simplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], eta] /. {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1}]];
outgoingJacobian = simplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], zeta] /. {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot}]];
gate["exact reference roots and Jacobians", zeroArray[
  {incomingRoot, outgoingRoot, incomingJacobian, outgoingJacobian} -
    Lookup[reference, {"IncomingRoot", "OutgoingRoot", "IncomingJacobian", "OutgoingJacobian"}]]];
gate["convolution roots in physical support", simplify[0 < incomingRoot < 1 && 0 < outgoingRoot < 1]];
metric = DiagonalMatrix[{1, -1, -1, -1}]; dot4[a_, b_] := Expand[a.metric.b];
pTrial = {ep, 0, 0, ep}; qTrial = {0, 0, 0, -Q}; kTrial = {ek, Sqrt[kxSquared], 0, kz};
frameEquations = {dot4[pTrial + qTrial, pTrial + qTrial] == s,
  dot4[qTrial - kTrial, qTrial - kTrial] == t, dot4[kTrial, kTrial] == 0,
  dot4[pTrial + qTrial - kTrial, pTrial + qTrial - kTrial] == s23};
frameSolutions = Solve[frameEquations, {ep, ek, kz, kxSquared}];
gate["unique real frame", Length[frameSolutions] === 1 && FreeQ[frameSolutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
frameRules = First[frameSolutions];
realFrame = <|p -> simplify[pTrial /. frameRules], q -> qTrial, k1 -> simplify[kTrial /. frameRules],
  eL -> {1, 0, 0, 0}, eX -> {0, 1, 0, 0}, eY -> {0, 0, 1, 0}|>;
realOutZ = simplify[Rest[realFrame[k1]]/First[realFrame[k1]]];
AssociateTo[realFrame, {eOutX -> Prepend[simplify[Cross[{0, 1, 0}, realOutZ]], 0], eOutY -> {0, 0, 1, 0}}];
gate["real frame defining equations", And @@ simplify[frameEquations /. frameRules]];
rootRules = <|"PDF" -> {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1}, "FF" -> {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot}|>;
mapRules = AssociationMap[Thread[{s, t} -> (Lookup[invariants, {"s", "t"}] /. rootRules[#])] &, Keys[rootRules]];
Do[mappedFrame = borns[key]["Frame"] /. mapRules[side];
  gate[key <> " " <> side <> " mapped physical momenta", zeroArray[simplify[
    {mappedFrame[p] - (eta realFrame[p] /. rootRules[side]), mappedFrame[q] - realFrame[q],
      mappedFrame[k1] - (realFrame[k1]/zeta /. rootRules[side])}]]];
  gate[key <> " " <> side <> " fixed photon and spin axes", zeroArray[simplify[
    (mappedFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, eOutX, eOutY}) - (realFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, eOutX, eOutY})]]],
  {key, coreChannels}, {side, Keys[rootRules]}];
measureWeights = <|"PDF" -> incomingJacobian/incomingRoot, "FF" -> outgoingJacobian/outgoingRoot^2|>;
roots = <|"PDF" -> incomingRoot, "FF" -> outgoingRoot|>;
routes = {};
Do[If[Last[species[key]] === Last[species[channel]], kernelKey = First[species[channel]] <> First[species[key]];
    If[KeyExistsQ[kernelInput["Responses"], kernelKey], AppendTo[routes,
      <|"Side" -> "PDF", "BornChannel" -> key, "KernelKey" -> kernelKey|>]]];
  If[First[species[key]] === First[species[channel]], kernelKey = Last[species[key]] <> Last[species[channel]];
    If[KeyExistsQ[kernelInput["Responses"], kernelKey], AppendTo[routes,
      <|"Side" -> "FF", "BornChannel" -> key, "KernelKey" -> kernelKey|>]]], {key, coreChannels}];
Do[route = routes[[index]]; key = route["BornChannel"]; refKernel = kernelInput["Responses"][route["KernelKey"]]["ReferenceKernel"];
  If[KeyExistsQ[reference, "Routes"], matches = Select[reference["Routes"],
      #["Side"] === route["Side"] && #["Kernel"] === refKernel &&
        ({#["Incoming"], #["Observed"]} /. {quark -> "q", gluon -> "g"}) === species[key] &];
    gate["unique inherited subtraction route", Length[matches] === 1];
    refName = StringRiffle[Lookup[First[matches], {"Side", "Born", "Kernel"}], "_"],
    refName = If[route["Side"] === "PDF", "PDF", If[Last[species[key]] === "g", "GluonFragmentation", "QuarkFragmentation"]]];
  routes[[index]] = Append[route, "ReferenceName" -> refName], {index, Length[routes]}];
gate["complete reference route inventory", Sort[Lookup[routes, "ReferenceName"]] === Sort[Keys[reference["ConvolutionsD"]["Pg"]]]];
Do[gate["same kernel normalization " <> kernelKey, zero[
  kernelInput["Responses"][kernelKey]["Kernel"][[uPosition, uPosition]] -
    (reference["Kernels"][kernelInput["Responses"][kernelKey]["ReferenceKernel"]] /. x -> z)]] ,
  {kernelKey, DeleteDuplicates[Lookup[routes, "KernelKey"]]}];

endpointBranchComparisons = {};
convolution[bornEndpoint_, kernel_, rootValue_, weight_] := Module[{expandedKernel, plusCoefficient,
  deltaCoefficient, regularKernel, poleFunction, endpointCoefficient, endpointRatio,
  mappedDelta, result, endpointDifference, endpointProof},
  expandedKernel = Expand[kernel /. {kernelPlus[1/(1 - x)] -> p0, kernelDelta[1 - x] -> d0}];
  plusCoefficient = Coefficient[expandedKernel, p0];
  deltaCoefficient = Coefficient[expandedKernel, d0];
  regularKernel = expandedKernel /. {p0 -> 0, d0 -> 0};
  If[plusCoefficient =!= 0,
    poleFunction = Factor[weight/(1 - rootValue)];
    endpointCoefficient = FullSimplify[Limit[s23 poleFunction, s23 -> 0], endpointRegion];
    endpointRatio = FullSimplify[Limit[(1 - rootValue)/s23, s23 -> 0], endpointRegion];
    gate["plus mapping has a positive endpoint scale", FullSimplify[endpointRatio > 0, endpointRegion]];
    endpointDifference = Factor[endpointCoefficient - bornEndpoint];
    endpointProof = FullSimplify[endpointDifference, endpointRegion];
    If[endpointProof =!= 0, endpointProof = FullSimplify[
      PowerExpand[endpointDifference, Assumptions -> endpointRegion], endpointRegion]];
    If[endpointDifference =!= 0, AppendTo[endpointBranchComparisons,
      <|"BornEndpoint" -> bornEndpoint, "MappedEndpoint" -> endpointCoefficient,
        "Difference" -> endpointDifference, "PhysicalRegionDifference" -> endpointProof|>];
      Print["ENDPOINT_BRANCH_COMPARISON ", InputForm[endpointProof]]];
    gate["auxiliary endpoint pole cancels", endpointProof === 0];
    endpointCoefficient = bornEndpoint;
    mappedDelta = FullSimplify[Normal[Series[
      (B^lambdaCut endpointRatio^lambdaCut endpointCoefficient - bornEndpoint)/lambdaCut,
      {lambdaCut, 0, 0}]], endpointRegion],
    poleFunction = 0; endpointCoefficient = 0; mappedDelta = 0];
  gate["auxiliary endpoint regulator removed", FreeQ[mappedDelta, lambdaCut]];
  result = <|"Delta" -> Factor[deltaCoefficient bornEndpoint + plusCoefficient mappedDelta],
    "L0" -> Factor[plusCoefficient endpointCoefficient],
    "Regular" -> Factor[weight (regularKernel /. x -> rootValue) +
      plusCoefficient (poleFunction - endpointCoefficient/s23)]|>;
  gate["mapped convolution reconstructs its ordinary part", zero[FullSimplify[result["Regular"] +
    result["L0"]/s23 - weight (kernel /. {kernelDelta[_] -> 0, kernelPlus[a_] :> a} /. x -> rootValue), physical]]];
  result];


distributions = {"Delta", "L0", "Regular"};
(* Check the adapted convolution interface on every saved reference route. *)
referenceChecks = <||>;
Do[key = route["BornChannel"]; side = route["Side"]; refName = route["ReferenceName"];
  unpolarizedKernel = kernelInput["Responses"][route["KernelKey"]]["Kernel"][[uPosition, uPosition]] /. z -> x;
  Do[endpoint = borns[key][If[mode === "Pg", "CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"]];
    weight = Factor[measureWeights[side] (endpoint /. mapRules[side]) If[mode === "Ppp" && side === "PDF",
      reference["IncomingProjectorScale"] /. rootRules[side], 1]];
    converted = bounded[convolution[endpoint, unpolarizedKernel, roots[side], weight], {refName, mode, "reference"}];
    gate[refName <> " distribution inventory", Keys[converted] === Keys[reference["ConvolutionsD"][mode][refName]]];
    differences = Values[converted] - Values[reference["ConvolutionsD"][mode][refName] /. Q2 -> Q^2];
    gate[refName <> " " <> mode <> " original convolution", zeroArray[FullSimplify[differences, endpointRegion && s23 > 0]]];
    AssociateTo[referenceChecks, refName <> "_" <> mode -> True], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}], {route, routes}];
completionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqprime", "s11_dimensional_result", "s11_result.wl"}];
completionSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_check_dimensional_convolution.wls"}];
completionBaseline = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_result", "reference", "s11_small_collinear_spin_before_dimensional.wls"}];
gate["accepted dimensional completion identity", IntegerString[FileHash[completionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "3c76ab221bf3c99ba7c35223b26ca10ec527596dc2f60307d5cc7e508dbc411c"];
completionProof = Get[completionPath];
gate["executed intermediate-state completion", TrueQ[completionProof["Accepted"]] &&
  TrueQ[completionProof["RestoresReferenceHats"]] && And @@ Values[completionProof["Checks"]] &&
  completionProof["SourceHash"] === FileHash[completionSource, "SHA256"] &&
  completionProof["BaselineSourceHash"] === FileHash[completionBaseline, "SHA256"] &&
  completionProof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
DownValues[completeIntermediateBorn] = completionProof["Definitions"];
coreBaseline = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_result", "reference", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions_before_dimensional.wls"}];
previousPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s11_result", "reference", "before_dimensional_completion", "s11_result.wl"}];
previous = Get[previousPath];
gate["archived previous subtraction", previous["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[previous["Checks"]] &&
  previous["SourceHash"] === FileHash[coreBaseline, "SHA256"] && previous["Routes"] === routes];
Do[gate["unchanged inherited subtraction input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === previous["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[previous["InputHashes"]]}];
additionalPaths = Join[additionalPaths, {FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}], completionPath, completionSource, completionBaseline, coreBaseline, previousPath}];
photonLabels = borns[channel]["PhotonLabels"];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{configPath, baseConfigPath, kernelPath}, additionalPaths,
  FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Values[referenceRow]]];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s11", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
contributions = <||>; evanescentContributions = <||>; completedStates = <||>;
Do[key = route["BornChannel"]; side = route["Side"]; refName = route["ReferenceName"];
  completedBorn = completeIntermediateBorn[borns[key], side];
  gate[refName <> " physical D4 Born unchanged", zeroArray[
    (Take[completedBorn["Response"], Length[photonLabels]] - borns[key]["Response"]) /. D -> 4]];
  AssociateTo[completedStates, refName -> KeyDrop[completedBorn, "Response"]];
  file = FileNameJoin[{cache, refName <> ".wl"}]; saved = If[FileExistsQ[file], Get[file], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash,
    Print["SPIN_CONVOLUTION ", channel, " ", refName];
    bornResponse = completedBorn["Response"];
    mappedResponse = bounded[simplify[bornResponse /. mapRules[side]], {refName, "mapped Born"}];
    kernelMatrix = kernelInput["Responses"][route["KernelKey"]]["Kernel"] /. z -> x;
    reusePhysical = completedBorn["IntermediateLabels"] === labels;
    If[reusePhysical, gate[refName <> " unchanged dimensional physical Born",
      zeroArray[Take[bornResponse, Length[photonLabels]] - borns[key]["Response"]]]];
    pieces = Table[If[reusePhysical && a <= Length[photonLabels],
      Association@Table[d -> previous["RouteConvolutionsD"][refName][d][[a, j, i]], {d, distributions}],
      terms = Table[
      kernel = If[side === "PDF", kernelMatrix[[k, i]], kernelMatrix[[j, k]]];
      endpoint = If[side === "PDF", bornResponse[[a, j, k]], bornResponse[[a, k, i]]];
      mapped = If[side === "PDF", mappedResponse[[a, j, k]], mappedResponse[[a, k, i]]];
      If[kernel === 0 || (endpoint === 0 && mapped === 0), AssociationThread[distributions, ConstantArray[0, Length[distributions]]],
        bounded[convolution[endpoint, kernel, roots[side], simplify[measureWeights[side] mapped]], {refName, a, j, i, k}]],
      {k, Length[labels]}]; Merge[terms, Factor[Total[#]] &]],
      {a, Length[bornResponse]}, {j, Length[labels]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
    value = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[#[distribution] &, pieces, {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
    gate[refName <> " exact evaluated spin convolution", FreeQ[value,
      _Missing | _Integrate | _Limit | _Series | _SeriesData | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
    saved = <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "Route" -> route, "ConvolutionsD" -> value|>; put[saved, file]];
  AssociateTo[evanescentContributions, refName -> Map[Last, saved["ConvolutionsD"]]];
  AssociateTo[contributions, refName -> Map[Take[#, Length[photonLabels]] &, saved["ConvolutionsD"]]];
  If[completedBorn["IntermediateLabels"] === labels,
    gate[refName <> " physical route without dimensional intermediate unchanged",
      zeroArray[Flatten[(Values[contributions[refName]] - Values[previous["RouteConvolutionsD"][refName]])]]]], {route, routes}];
convolutionsD = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor, Total[#[distribution] & /@ Values[contributions]], {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}];
If[FreeQ[species[channel], "g"],
  basisPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}];
  spinBasis = Get[basisPath];
  gate["accepted contraction basis", And @@ Values[spinBasis["Checks"]]];
  metricWeights = Tr[spinBasis["PhotonMetric"].#] & /@ spinBasis["PhotonBasis"];
  pComponents = Take[LinearSolve[Transpose[realFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, q}], realFrame[p]], Length[{eL, eX, eY}]];
  pWeights = Factor[pComponents.#.pComponents] & /@ spinBasis["PhotonBasis"];
  Do[value = contributions[route["ReferenceName"]][distribution];
    completedScalar = {metricWeights.value[[All, uPosition, uPosition]] +
      evanescentContributions[route["ReferenceName"]][distribution][[uPosition, uPosition]],
      pWeights.value[[All, uPosition, uPosition]]};
    referenceScalar = Table[reference["ConvolutionsD"][mode][route["ReferenceName"]][distribution] /. Q2 -> Q^2,
      {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
    gate[route["ReferenceName"] <> " " <> distribution <> " actual spin convolution reconstructs dimensional reference",
      bounded[zeroArray[FullSimplify[completedScalar - referenceScalar, endpointRegion && s23 > 0]],
        {route["ReferenceName"], distribution, "actual reference contraction"}]],
    {route, routes}, {distribution, distributions}]];
msPole = 1/eps - EulerGamma + Log[4 Pi];
counterterms = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[
  bounded[Normal[Series[reference["Prefactor"] msPole (# /. D -> 4 - 2 eps), {eps, 0, 0}]],
    {distribution, "epsilon expansion"}] &, convolutionsD[distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["all subtraction coefficients evaluated", FreeQ[counterterms,
  _Missing | _Series | _SeriesData | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
countertermDifference = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  counterterms[distribution] - previous["Counterterms"][distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["intermediate completion changes no regulator pole", FreeQ[countertermDifference, eps | D]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-collinear-convolutions-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "PhotonLabels" -> borns[channel]["PhotonLabels"], "SpinLabels" -> labels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"photon component", "outgoing spin", "incoming spin"},
  "Routes" -> routes, "RouteConvolutionsD" -> contributions, "ConvolutionsD" -> convolutionsD,
  "IntermediateStateConvention" -> "CDR U/E completeness and incoming CDR averaging; physical resolved spin labels",
  "IntermediateStateCompletions" -> completedStates, "EvanescentPhotonConvolutionsD" -> evanescentContributions,
  "DimensionalCompletionValidationHash" -> FileHash[completionPath, "SHA256"],
  "PreviousSubtractionHash" -> FileHash[previousPath, "SHA256"], "CountertermDifference" -> countertermDifference,
  "Counterterms" -> counterterms, "ReferenceConvolutionChecks" -> referenceChecks,
  "EndpointBranchComparisons" -> endpointBranchComparisons,
  "IncomingRoot" -> incomingRoot, "OutgoingRoot" -> outgoingRoot,
  "IncomingJacobian" -> incomingJacobian, "OutgoingJacobian" -> outgoingJacobian,
  "ScaledInvariantRules" -> mapRules, "Prefactor" -> reference["Prefactor"], "MSPole" -> msPole,
  "PlusDefinition" -> reference["PlusDefinition"], "HardTensorNormalization" -> reference["HardTensorNormalization"],
  "Gamma5Scheme" -> "BMHV", "FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied" -> False,
  "CompletePoleCancellationChecked" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False,
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s11_result"}];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s11_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s11_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s11_collinear_spin_convolutions"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s11_complete_collinear_difference.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-366", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4176, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_complete_collinear_difference.wls", "sha256": "4fd168cc9ed75b92592729fd5d00466ed7a812e142dfe3d3e3280acf5fa126e8"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse accepted counterterms and expand only the changed dimensional convolution. *)
$HistoryLength=0;differenceRoot=Directory[];
differenceSource=FileNameJoin[{differenceRoot,"common","s11_complete_collinear_difference.wls"}];
differenceBaseline=FileNameJoin[{differenceRoot,"common","s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[differenceBaseline,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "4fa3afa28525d57a63c8aea1dee8a4825d761b504f0cd8192837360ec5b531c6",Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;$LoadAddOns={"FeynArts"};Get["FeynCalc`"];
differenceText=Import[differenceBaseline,"Text"];
differenceMarker="\ncounterterms = Association@Table";
If[StringCount[differenceText,differenceMarker]=!=1||!SyntaxQ[Import[differenceSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
differencePrefix=First[StringSplit[differenceText,differenceMarker]];
If[StringCount[differencePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
differencePrefix=StringReplace[differencePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[differencePrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[differencePrefix,InputForm];
gate["difference completion channel",channel==="Hqq"];
differenceCounterterms[old_,new_,owner_] := Module[{delta,correction,answer},
  gate[owner<>" unchanged subtraction prefactor",old["Prefactor"]===new["Prefactor"]&&old["MSPole"]===new["MSPole"]];
  delta=Association@Table[d->Map[Factor,new["ConvolutionsD"][d]-old["ConvolutionsD"][d],{3}],
    {d,Keys[new["ConvolutionsD"]]}];
  gate[owner<>" convolution difference has zero D4 limit",zeroArray[Values[delta]/.D->4]];
  correction=Association@Table[
    Print["SUBTRACTION_DIFFERENCE_EXPANSION ",owner," ",d];
    d->MapIndexed[Function[{value,index},
      If[value=!=0,Print["SUBTRACTION_DIFFERENCE_COMPONENT ",owner," ",d," ",index]];
      bounded[Normal[Series[new["Prefactor"] new["MSPole"] (value/.D->4-2eps),{eps,0,0}]],
        {owner,d,index,"difference epsilon expansion"}]],delta[d],{3}],{d,Keys[delta]}];
  gate[owner<>" finite evaluated correction",FreeQ[correction,eps|D|_Missing|_Series|_SeriesData|_Limit|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
  answer=Association@Table[d->old["Counterterms"][d]+correction[d],{d,Keys[correction]}];
  <|"Counterterms"->answer,"Correction"->correction,"ConvolutionDifference"->delta|>];
differenceControls=<||>;
Do[newPath=FileNameJoin[{root,owner,"s11_result","s11_result.wl"}];
  oldPath=FileNameJoin[{root,owner,"s11_result","reference","before_dimensional_completion","s11_result.wl"}];
  controlNew=Get[newPath];controlOld=Get[oldPath];
  gate[owner<>" accepted own comparison tensors",And@@Values[controlNew["Checks"]]&&And@@Values[controlOld["Checks"]]&&
    controlNew["SourceHash"]===FileHash[differenceBaseline,"SHA256"]&&
    controlNew["PreviousSubtractionHash"]===FileHash[oldPath,"SHA256"]];
  timing=AbsoluteTiming[differenceCounterterms[controlOld,controlNew,owner]];
  gate[owner<>" entire accepted counterterm tensor reproduced",zeroArray[
    Values[timing[[2]]["Counterterms"]]-Values[controlNew["Counterterms"]]]];
  AssociateTo[differenceControls,owner-><|"OldHash"->FileHash[oldPath,"SHA256"],"NewHash"->FileHash[newPath,"SHA256"],
    "Seconds"->timing[[1]],"Accepted"->True|>],{owner,{"Hqg","Hgq"}}];
differenceTiming=AbsoluteTiming[differenceCounterterms[previous,
  <|"Prefactor"->reference["Prefactor"],"MSPole"->msPole,"ConvolutionsD"->convolutionsD|>,channel]];
counterterms=differenceTiming[[2]]["Counterterms"];
differenceTailStart=First[First[StringPosition[differenceText,"gate[\"all subtraction coefficients evaluated\""]]];
differenceTail=StringDrop[differenceText,differenceTailStart-1];
differenceExport="put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, \"s11_result.wl\"}]];";
gate["unique original subtraction export",StringCount[differenceTail,differenceExport]===1];
differenceTail=StringReplace[differenceTail,differenceExport->
  "AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[differenceSource,\"SHA256\"],\"DifferenceControls\"->differenceControls,\"DifferenceSeconds\"->differenceTiming[[1]]}];"<>differenceExport];
gate["original subtraction export syntax",SyntaxQ[differenceTail]];
ToExpression[differenceTail,InputForm];

```

## common/s11_convolve_Hgq_dimensional_gluon.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-367", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 14185, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_convolve_Hgq_dimensional_gluon.wls", "sha256": "cbcc03b9a30a803c42af49f8b20f1eab0dc93eba6faaaea1e4bc4b455e379e84"} -->
```wolfram
(* Original S11 convolution with the native intermediate-gluon transfer. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
studySource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_convolve_Hgq_dimensional_gluon.wls"}];
baselineSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "4fa3afa28525d57a63c8aea1dee8a4825d761b504f0cd8192837360ec5b531c6", Quit[1]];
baselineText = Import[baselineSource, "Text"];
boundary = StringPosition[baselineText, "completionPath = FileNameJoin["];
If[Length[boundary] =!= 1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
prefix = StringTake[baselineText, First[First[boundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix], Quit[1]]; ToExpression[prefix, InputForm];
gate["own gluon subtraction channel", channel === "Hgq"];
inputPaths = {baselineSource};
read[relative_] := Module[{path = FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]},
  AppendTo[inputPaths, path]; If[StringEndsQ[path, ".json"], Import[path, "RawJSON"], Get[path]]];
currentRelative = channel <> "/s11_result/reference/before_resolved_gluon/s11_result.wl";
previousRelative = channel <> "/s11_result/reference/before_dimensional_completion/s11_result.wl";
current = read[currentRelative]; previous = read[previousRelative];
previousSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_result", "reference", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions_before_dimensional.wls"}];
AppendTo[inputPaths, previousSource];
gate["same original and completed subtraction inputs", current["Channel"] === channel &&
  previous["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[current["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[previous["Checks"]] &&
  current["SourceHash"] === FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"] &&
  previous["SourceHash"] === FileHash[previousSource, "SHA256"] &&
  current["Routes"] === routes && previous["Routes"] === routes &&
  current["Prefactor"] === previous["Prefactor"] && current["Prefactor"] === reference["Prefactor"] &&
  current["MSPole"] === previous["MSPole"]];
Do[gate["unchanged actual convolution input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === current["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[current["InputHashes"]]}];
nativeRelative = channel <> "/s10_dimensional_gluon_result/s10_result.wl";
native = read[nativeRelative]; nativeReceipt = read[channel <> "/s10_dimensional_gluon_result/s10_execution.json"];

physicalPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[native["SpinLabels"], #] & /@ labels];

gate["unique own intermediate gluon route", Length[selfRoutes] === 1 &&
  First[selfRoutes]["Side"] === "PDF" && First[selfRoutes]["BornChannel"] === channel];

gate["extra Born component vanishes in physical dimension", zeroArray[bornE /. D -> native["DimensionLimit"]]];
nativeIdentity = Map[Factor, native["GramMatrices"][k1].native["DualMatrices"][k1]/
  spinBasis["IncomingDensityNormalization"], {2}];
deltaIdentity = kernelInput["Responses"]["gg"]["DeltaCoefficient"][[uPosition, uPosition]] nativeIdentity;
extraReal = native["PDFLeadingKernel"][[ePosition, physicalPositions]];
extraSoft = native["PDFSoftResidue"][[ePosition, physicalPositions]];
extraDelta = deltaIdentity[[ePosition, physicalPositions]];
gate["native additional transition has no endpoint distributions", zeroArray[{extraSoft, extraDelta}]];
extraKernel = (extraReal - extraSoft/(1 - z) + extraSoft kernelPlus[1/(1 - z)] +

pieces = Table[

gate["evaluated additional convolutions", FreeQ[extraConvolutions,

gate["native zero endpoint contributions", zeroArray[Lookup[extraConvolutions, {"Delta", "L0"}]]];
candidateRoutes = previous["RouteConvolutionsD"];
AssociateTo[candidateRoutes, selfName -> Association@Table[distribution ->
  Map[Factor, candidateRoutes[selfName][distribution] + extraConvolutions[distribution], {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}]];
candidateConvolutions = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  Total[#[distribution] & /@ Values[candidateRoutes]], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["only the computed native route added", zeroArray[Values[candidateConvolutions] -

candidateCounterterms = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[

correction = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  candidateCounterterms[distribution] - current["Counterterms"][distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
extraCounterterms = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  candidateCounterterms[distribution] - previous["Counterterms"][distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["complete native counterterm change is finite", FreeQ[{correction, extraCounterterms}, eps | D] &&
  FreeQ[candidateCounterterms, _Series | _SeriesData | _Missing | $Failed | $Aborted]];

residualRelative = channel <> "/s11_resolved_gluon_result/s11_result.wl";
residualPacket = read[residualRelative]; residualReceipt = read[channel <> "/s11_resolved_gluon_result/s11_execution.json"];
residualSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_check_Hgq_resolved_gluon.wls"}];

gate["exact completed residual calculation", residualReceipt["job_id"] === "14816029" &&

gate["unique original finite domains", Length[domainLines] === 2 && SyntaxQ[StringRiffle[domainLines, "\n"]]];
ToExpression[StringRiffle[domainLines, "\n"], InputForm];
hatConfig = read["common/s14_inputs.json"];
referenceHats = Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{name, relative}, name -> read[relative]],
  hatConfig["channels"][channel]["unpolarized_hats"]];
expectedInventory = Flatten[Table[{name, sign, distribution}, {name, Keys[referenceHats]},

gate["every original finite distribution retained", Sort[Lookup[#, {"Hat", "Branch", "Distribution"}] & /@

    {name, sign, distribution, "physical-domain comparison"}]];

  {row, residualPacket["Comparisons"]}];

  "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_result.wl"}];

gate["bounded native subtraction export", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"]; gate["exact native subtraction reload", Get[path <> ".tmp"] === result];
RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Print["PASS: s11_convolve_Hgq_dimensional_gluon"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[result], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded native subtraction export", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"]; gate["exact native subtraction reload", Get[path <> ".tmp"] === result];
RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Print["PASS: s11_convolve_Hgq_gluon_transfer"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s11_exact_reference_reduction.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-369", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6243, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_exact_reference_reduction.wl", "sha256": "168b4b51f1ff470e33a7a4a7cb1a5727a21a1b6050086a8d3ede67690a2eef7c"} -->
```wolfram
(* Exact equation-driven reduction of large final-reference differences.
   The caller supplies the original domain and bounded/gate functions. *)
Clear[referenceScalarFactor, referenceExactReduce];
referenceScalarFactor[value_, label_] := Module[
  {symbols, variables, aliases, formal, powers, shift, rows, rebuilt, reduced},
  If[value === 0, Return[0]];
  symbols = Select[{SUNN, EulerGamma}, !FreeQ[value, #] &];
  If[symbols === {}, Return[bounded[Factor[value], {label, "rational Factor"}]]];
  variables = Table[Unique["referenceScalar"], {Length[symbols]}];
  aliases = Thread[symbols -> variables]; formal = value /. aliases;
  gate["exact reference scalar aliases", (formal /. Reverse /@ aliases) === value];
  powers = Exponent[formal, #, List] & /@ variables;
  If[MemberQ[powers, {}],
    gate["native zero polynomial has empty coefficient list",
      bounded[CoefficientRules[formal, variables], {label, "zero scalar coefficient"}] === {}];
    Return[0]];
  gate["integer reference Laurent support", And @@ (IntegerQ /@ Flatten[powers])];
  shift = Times @@ MapThread[Power, {variables, -(Min /@ powers)}];
  rows = bounded[CoefficientRules[shift formal, variables], {label, "scalar coefficients"}];
  gate["evaluated scalar coefficients", ListQ[rows] && FreeQ[rows, _CoefficientRules]];
  rebuilt = Total[(Last[#] Times @@ MapThread[Power, {variables, First[#]}]) & /@ rows];
  gate["exact reference scalar reconstruction",
    bounded[CoefficientRules[rebuilt, variables], {label, "scalar reconstruction"}] === rows];
  gate["independent reference scalar coefficients",
    And @@ (FreeQ[Last[#], Alternatives @@ variables] & /@ rows)];
  reduced = Table[
    Print["REFERENCE_SCALAR_COMPONENT ", InputForm[label], " ", index, "/", Length[rows]];
    First[rows[[index]]] -> bounded[Factor[Last[rows[[index]]]], {label, index, "scalar Factor"}],
    {index, Length[rows]}];
  gate["finite evaluated scalar reference coefficients", FreeQ[reduced,
    Indeterminate | _DirectedInfinity | $Failed | $Aborted | _Factor | _CoefficientRules]];
  Factor[(Total[(Last[#] Times @@ MapThread[Power, {variables, First[#]}]) & /@ reduced]/shift) /.
    Reverse /@ aliases]];

referenceExactReduce[input_, conditions_, label_] := Module[
  {started = AbsoluteTime[], functions, logRows, candidate, proof, rules,
   value, roots, rootRules, base, variables, functionRules, coefficientTable,
   abstract, formal, restorationRules, rows, rebuilt, reduced, coefficientValue,
   residual, nonAlgebraic = _Log | _PolyLog | _ArcTan | _ArcTanh | _Re | _Im},
  functions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[input, _Log, Infinity]];
  logRows = Table[
    candidate = PowerExpand[fn /. Log[arg_] :> Log[Factor[arg]], Assumptions -> conditions];
    proof = If[candidate === fn, 0,
      bounded[FullSimplify[fn - candidate, conditions], {label, "log identity"}]];
    <|"Original" -> fn, "Replacement" -> If[proof === 0, candidate, fn],
      "Changed" -> (proof === 0 && candidate =!= fn)|>, {fn, functions}];
  rules = (#["Original"] -> #["Replacement"] & /@ logRows);
  value = input /. Dispatch[rules];
  roots = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, Power[_, _Rational], Infinity]];
  rootRules = Table[
    base = Factor[Together[r[[1]]]];
    gate["exact reference root argument", Together[r[[1]] - base] === 0];
    r -> Refine[base^r[[2]], conditions], {r, roots}];
  value = value /. Dispatch[rootRules];
  functions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, nonAlgebraic, Infinity]];
  If[functions === {},
    residual = referenceScalarFactor[value, label];
    Return[<|"Residual" -> residual, "Seconds" -> (AbsoluteTime[] - started),
      "LogIdentities" -> logRows, "RootRules" -> rootRules, "CoefficientCount" -> 1,
      "ExactReconstruction" -> True|>]];
  variables = Table[Unique["referenceFunction"], {Length[functions]}];
  functionRules = Thread[functions -> variables]; coefficientTable = <||>;
  abstract[expr_] := Which[
    MatchQ[expr, nonAlgebraic], expr /. functionRules,
    NumberQ[expr], expr,
    FreeQ[expr, nonAlgebraic],
      If[KeyExistsQ[coefficientTable, expr], coefficientTable[expr],
        With[{symbol = Unique["referenceKinematic"]},
          AssociateTo[coefficientTable, expr -> symbol]; symbol]],
    Head[expr] === Plus || Head[expr] === Times, Map[abstract, expr],
    Head[expr] === Power && IntegerQ[expr[[2]]], abstract[expr[[1]]]^expr[[2]],
    True, Print["FAIL: unsupported reference polynomial structure ", InputForm[Shallow[expr]]]; Quit[1]];
  formal = bounded[abstract[value], {label, "function polynomial"}];
  restorationRules = Reverse /@ Normal[coefficientTable];
  gate["exact whole reference input restoration",
    (formal /. Dispatch[Reverse /@ functionRules] /. Dispatch[restorationRules]) === value];
  rows = bounded[CoefficientRules[formal, variables], {label, "function coefficients"}];
  gate["evaluated reference function coefficients", ListQ[rows] && FreeQ[rows, _CoefficientRules]];
  rebuilt = Total[(Last[#] Times @@ MapThread[Power, {variables, First[#]}]) & /@ rows];
  gate["exact reference function reconstruction",
    bounded[CoefficientRules[rebuilt, variables], {label, "function reconstruction"}] === rows];
  gate["independent reference function coefficients",
    And @@ (FreeQ[Last[#], Alternatives @@ variables] & /@ rows)];
  reduced = Table[
    Print["REFERENCE_FUNCTION_COMPONENT ", InputForm[label], " ", index, "/", Length[rows]];
    coefficientValue = Last[rows[[index]]] /. Dispatch[restorationRules];
    gate["complete reference coefficient restoration",
      Intersection[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[coefficientValue, _Symbol, Infinity]],
        Join[variables, First /@ restorationRules]] === {}];
    First[rows[[index]]] -> referenceScalarFactor[coefficientValue, {label, index}],
    {index, Length[rows]}];
  residual = Total[(Last[#] Times @@ MapThread[Power, {functions, First[#]}]) & /@ reduced];
  If[residual =!= 0,
    residual = bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[residual, conditions], conditions],
      {label, "remaining native function identities"}]];
  <|"Residual" -> residual, "Seconds" -> (AbsoluteTime[] - started),
    "LogIdentities" -> logRows, "RootRules" -> rootRules, "CoefficientCount" -> Length[rows],
    "ExactReconstruction" -> True|>];

```

## common/s11_finalize_Hgq_subtraction.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-370", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 17618, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_finalize_Hgq_subtraction.wls", "sha256": "9b4189eea1186ae318411f7bb1799ef766d1bcf7ec12c8977ae3f0323efd28eb"} -->
```wolfram
(* Original S11 convolution with the native intermediate-gluon transfer. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
studySource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_finalize_Hgq_subtraction.wls"}];
baselineSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "4fa3afa28525d57a63c8aea1dee8a4825d761b504f0cd8192837360ec5b531c6", Quit[1]];
baselineText = Import[baselineSource, "Text"];
boundary = StringPosition[baselineText, "completionPath = FileNameJoin["];
If[Length[boundary] =!= 1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[studySource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
prefix = StringTake[baselineText, First[First[boundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[prefix], Quit[1]]; ToExpression[prefix, InputForm];
gate["own gluon subtraction channel", channel === "Hgq"];
inputPaths = {baselineSource};
read[relative_] := Module[{path = FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]},
  AppendTo[inputPaths, path]; If[StringEndsQ[path, ".json"], Import[path, "RawJSON"], Get[path]]];
currentRelative = channel <> "/s11_result/reference/before_resolved_gluon/s11_result.wl";
previousRelative = channel <> "/s11_result/reference/before_dimensional_completion/s11_result.wl";
current = read[currentRelative]; previous = read[previousRelative];
previousSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_result", "reference", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions_before_dimensional.wls"}];
AppendTo[inputPaths, previousSource];
gate["same original and completed subtraction inputs", current["Channel"] === channel &&
  previous["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[current["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[previous["Checks"]] &&
  current["SourceHash"] === FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"] &&
  previous["SourceHash"] === FileHash[previousSource, "SHA256"] &&
  current["Routes"] === routes && previous["Routes"] === routes &&
  current["Prefactor"] === previous["Prefactor"] && current["Prefactor"] === reference["Prefactor"] &&
  current["MSPole"] === previous["MSPole"]];
Do[gate["unchanged actual convolution input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === current["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[current["InputHashes"]]}];
nativeRelative = channel <> "/s10_dimensional_gluon_result/s10_result.wl";
native = read[nativeRelative]; nativeReceipt = read[channel <> "/s10_dimensional_gluon_result/s10_execution.json"];
nativeSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_dimensional_gluon_transfer.wls"}];
AppendTo[inputPaths, nativeSource];
gate["accepted native intermediate transfer", TrueQ[nativeReceipt["passed"]] &&
  nativeReceipt["job_id"] === "14816855" && nativeReceipt["result_sha256"][nativeRelative] ===
    IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, nativeRelative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
  native["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-gluon-intermediate-transfer-v1" &&
  native["SourceHash"] === FileHash[nativeSource, "SHA256"] && TrueQ[native["Accepted"]] &&
  And @@ Values[native["Checks"]] && native["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  native["InputHashes"]["common/s10_result/s10_result.wl"] === FileHash[kernelPath, "SHA256"]];
Do[gate["unchanged native transition input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === native["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[native["InputHashes"]]}];
spinBasis = read["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"];
physicalPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[native["SpinLabels"], #] & /@ labels];
ePosition = First[FirstPosition[native["SpinLabels"], "E"]];
selfRoutes = Select[routes, #["KernelKey"] === "gg" &];
gate["unique own intermediate gluon route", Length[selfRoutes] === 1 &&
  First[selfRoutes]["Side"] === "PDF" && First[selfRoutes]["BornChannel"] === channel];
self = First[selfRoutes]; selfName = self["ReferenceName"];
born = borns[channel]; photonLabels = born["PhotonLabels"];
bornInPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[born["ExtendedIncomingLabels"], #] & /@ native["SpinLabels"]];
bornOutPositions = Flatten[FirstPosition[born["ExtendedOutgoingLabels"], #] & /@ labels];
extendedBorn = born["ExtendedResponse"][[All, bornOutPositions, bornInPositions]];
mappedBorn = bounded[simplify[extendedBorn /. mapRules["PDF"]], "original mapped extended Born response"];
gate["same physical Born response", zeroArray[
  extendedBorn[[All, All, physicalPositions]] - born["Response"]]];
gate["extra Born component vanishes in physical dimension",
  zeroArray[extendedBorn[[All, All, ePosition]] /. D -> native["DimensionLimit"]]];
leadingPhysical = Table[If[j === ePosition, 0, native["PDFLeadingKernel"][[j, i]]],
  {j, Length[native["SpinLabels"]]}, {i, physicalPositions}];
(* Complete only the U projector, using the defining S03 CDR density.
   Other physical Stokes projectors keep their accepted native definitions.
   The regulator remainder is removed as in arXiv:0807.4424 Eq. (39). *)
stateGram = native["GramMatrices"][p];
physicalRank = stateGram[[uPosition, uPosition]];
extraRank = stateGram[[ePosition, ePosition]];
incomingAverage = Factor[physicalRank/(physicalRank + extraRank)];
gate["same native S03 dimensional average", zero[incomingAverage - born["CDRAverageConversion"]]];
completion = Table[KroneckerDelta[k, physicalPositions[[i]]] +
    If[labels[[i]] === "U", KroneckerDelta[k, ePosition], 0],
  {i, Length[labels]}, {k, Length[native["SpinLabels"]]}];
incomingCompletion = Transpose[completion].DiagonalMatrix[
  If[# === "U", incomingAverage, 1] & /@ labels];
cdrKernelD = Map[Factor, completion.native["CrossedRawDimensionalKernel"].incomingCompletion, {2}];
cdrLeading = Map[Factor[Limit[#, D -> native["DimensionLimit"]]] &, cdrKernelD, {2}];
gate["all CDR physical limits equal accepted spin kernels", zeroArray[
  cdrLeading - kernelInput["Responses"]["gg"]["RealKernel"]]];
gate["complete CDR unpolarized kernel", zero[
  cdrKernelD[[uPosition, uPosition]] - native["FullDimensionalUnpolarizedKernel"]]];
cdrRegulatorRemainder = Map[Factor, cdrKernelD - cdrLeading, {2}];
gate["CDR regulator remainder has zero physical limit", zeroArray[Map[
  Limit[#, D -> native["DimensionLimit"]] &, cdrRegulatorRemainder, {2}]]];
gate["CDR scheme subtraction preserves unpolarized kernel",
  zero[cdrRegulatorRemainder[[uPosition, uPosition]]]];
embeddedCDRRemainder = Table[If[k === ePosition, 0,
    cdrRegulatorRemainder[[First[FirstPosition[physicalPositions, k]], i]]],
  {k, Length[native["SpinLabels"]]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
msbarOperatorD = Map[Factor, native["PDFKernelD"][[All, physicalPositions]] - embeddedCDRRemainder, {2}];
gate["exact MS scheme operator reconstruction", zeroArray[
  msbarOperatorD + embeddedCDRRemainder - native["PDFKernelD"][[All, physicalPositions]]]];
gate["CDR finite conversion has no soft endpoint", zeroArray[
  Map[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1] &, embeddedCDRRemainder, {2}]]];
Print["NATIVE_CDR_SPIN_KERNEL ", InputForm[cdrKernelD]];
Print["NATIVE_CDR_REGULATOR_REMAINDER ", InputForm[cdrRegulatorRemainder]];
kernelDifferenceD = Map[Factor, msbarOperatorD - leadingPhysical, {2}];
gate["exact dimensional kernel decomposition", zeroArray[
  leadingPhysical + kernelDifferenceD - msbarOperatorD]];
gate["unchanged leading physical kernel", zeroArray[Map[
  Limit[#, D -> native["DimensionLimit"]] &, kernelDifferenceD[[physicalPositions]], {2}]]];
softDifference = Map[Factor[Limit[(1 - z) #, z -> 1]] &, kernelDifferenceD, {2}];
gate["dimensional kernel difference has no soft endpoint", zeroArray[softDifference]];
gate["dimensional unpolarized MS kernel has no regulator term", zero[
  native["FullDimensionalUnpolarizedKernel"] -
    native["PDFLeadingKernel"][[uPosition, uPosition]]]];
extraKernel = kernelDifferenceD /. z -> x;
pieces = Table[
  Print["DIMENSIONAL_OPERATOR_CONVOLUTION ", a, " ", j, " ", i];
  terms = Table[
    If[extraKernel[[k, i]] === 0 ||
        (extendedBorn[[a, j, k]] === 0 && mappedBorn[[a, j, k]] === 0),
      AssociationThread[distributions, ConstantArray[0, Length[distributions]]],
      bounded[convolution[extendedBorn[[a, j, k]], extraKernel[[k, i]], roots["PDF"],
        simplify[measureWeights["PDF"] mappedBorn[[a, j, k]]]],
        {a, j, i, k, "dimensional operator convolution"}]],
    {k, Length[native["SpinLabels"]]}];
  Merge[terms, Factor[Total[#]] &],
  {a, Length[photonLabels]}, {j, Length[labels]}, {i, Length[labels]}];
extraConvolutions = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[#[distribution] &, pieces, {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}];
gate["evaluated additional convolutions", FreeQ[extraConvolutions,
  _Missing | _Integrate | _Limit | _SeriesData | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
gate["native zero endpoint contributions", zeroArray[Lookup[extraConvolutions, {"Delta", "L0"}]]];
candidateRoutes = previous["RouteConvolutionsD"];
AssociateTo[candidateRoutes, selfName -> Association@Table[distribution ->
  Map[Factor, candidateRoutes[selfName][distribution] + extraConvolutions[distribution], {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}]];
candidateConvolutions = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  Total[#[distribution] & /@ Values[candidateRoutes]], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["only the computed native route added", zeroArray[Values[candidateConvolutions] -
  Values[previous["ConvolutionsD"]] - Values[extraConvolutions]]];
candidateCounterterms = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[
  bounded[Normal[Series[reference["Prefactor"] previous["MSPole"] (# /. D -> 4 - 2 eps), {eps, 0, 0}]],
    {distribution, "original counterterm expansion"}] &, candidateConvolutions[distribution], {3}],
  {distribution, distributions}];
correction = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  candidateCounterterms[distribution] - current["Counterterms"][distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
extraCounterterms = Association@Table[distribution -> Map[Factor,
  candidateCounterterms[distribution] - previous["Counterterms"][distribution], {3}], {distribution, distributions}];
gate["complete native counterterm change is finite", FreeQ[{correction, extraCounterterms}, eps | D] &&
  FreeQ[candidateCounterterms, _Series | _SeriesData | _Missing | $Failed | $Aborted]];

residualRelative = channel <> "/s11_resolved_gluon_result/s11_result.wl";
residualPacket = read[residualRelative]; residualReceipt = read[channel <> "/s11_resolved_gluon_result/s11_execution.json"];
residualSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_check_Hgq_resolved_gluon.wls"}];
AppendTo[inputPaths, residualSource];
gate["exact completed residual calculation", residualReceipt["job_id"] === "14816029" &&
  residualPacket["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-resolved-gluon-subtraction-comparison-v1" &&
  residualPacket["SourceHash"] === FileHash[residualSource, "SHA256"] &&
  residualPacket["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  residualPacket["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[residualPacket["Checks"]] &&
  residualPacket["Counterterms"] === previous["Counterterms"] &&
  residualPacket["ConvolutionsD"] === previous["ConvolutionsD"]];
Do[gate["unchanged residual equation input " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === residualPacket["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[residualPacket["InputHashes"]]}];
Do[gate["unchanged accepted finite checkpoint " <> name,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"] === residualPacket["CheckpointHashes"][name]],
  {name, Keys[residualPacket["CheckpointHashes"]]}];
inspection = read[channel <> "/s14_reference_residual_result/s14_result.wl"];
termProof = read[channel <> "/s14_reference_terms_result/s14_result.wl"];
gate["same original finite assembly", residualPacket["OriginalAssemblyInputHash"] === inspection["InputHash"] &&
  termProof["InspectionHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s14_reference_residual_result", "s14_result.wl"}], "SHA256"] &&
  And @@ Values[inspection["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[termProof["Checks"]]];
assemblyPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}]; AppendTo[inputPaths, assemblyPath];
gate["same finite projection source", inspection["BaselineSourceHash"] === FileHash[assemblyPath, "SHA256"] &&
  termProof["AssemblySourceHash"] === FileHash[assemblyPath, "SHA256"]];
assemblyText = Import[assemblyPath, "Text"];
domainLines = Select[StringSplit[assemblyText, "\n"], StringStartsQ[#, "physical="] || StringStartsQ[#, "softPhysical="] &];
gate["unique original finite domains", Length[domainLines] === 2 && SyntaxQ[StringRiffle[domainLines, "\n"]]];
ToExpression[StringRiffle[domainLines, "\n"], InputForm];
hatConfig = read["common/s14_inputs.json"];
referenceHats = Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{name, relative}, name -> read[relative]],
  hatConfig["channels"][channel]["unpolarized_hats"]];
expectedInventory = Flatten[Table[{name, sign, distribution}, {name, Keys[referenceHats]},
  {sign, Keys[referenceHats[name]["NLO"]]}, {distribution, Keys[referenceHats[name]["NLO"][sign]]}], 2];
gate["every original finite distribution retained", Sort[Lookup[#, {"Hat", "Branch", "Distribution"}] & /@
  residualPacket["Comparisons"]] === Sort[expectedInventory]];
comparisonRows = Table[
  name = row["Hat"]; sign = row["Branch"]; distribution = row["Distribution"];
  weights = inspection["PhotonWeights"][[First[FirstPosition[Keys[referenceHats], name]]]];
  change = If[KeyExistsQ[extraCounterterms, distribution], extraCounterterms[distribution][[All, uPosition, uPosition]],
    ConstantArray[0, Length[weights]]];
  projectedChange = termProof["Normalization"] weights.change /. t -> sign omega - s;
  assumptions = (If[distribution === "Regular", physical, softPhysical] /. t -> sign omega - s) &&
    If[sign === 0, True, omega > 0];
  difference = bounded[Factor[Together[row["Residual"] + projectedChange]], {name, sign, distribution, "native correction"}];
  residual = If[difference === 0, 0, bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[difference, assumptions], assumptions],
    {name, sign, distribution, "physical-domain comparison"}]];
  Print["NATIVE_GLUON_REFERENCE_RESIDUAL ", name, " ", sign, " ", distribution, " ", InputForm[residual]];
  <|"Hat" -> name, "Branch" -> sign, "Distribution" -> distribution, "Residual" -> residual, "Equal" -> (residual === 0)|>,
  {row, residualPacket["Comparisons"]}];
allEqual = And @@ Lookup[comparisonRows, "Equal"];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[inputPaths, FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Keys[current["InputHashes"]]]];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
sourceHash = FileHash[studySource, "SHA256"];
proof = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-native-gluon-convolution-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "NativeTransferHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, nativeRelative}], "SHA256"],
  "OriginalAssemblyInputHash" -> inspection["InputHash"], "CheckpointHashes" -> residualPacket["CheckpointHashes"],
  "OriginalSubtractionHash" -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, currentRelative}], "SHA256"],
  "CDRKernelD" -> cdrKernelD, "CDRRegulatorRemainder" -> cdrRegulatorRemainder,
  "MSOperatorD" -> msbarOperatorD, "MSReference" -> "arXiv:0807.4424 Eqs. (36)-(39)",
  "KernelDifferenceD" -> kernelDifferenceD, "ExtraConvolutionsD" -> extraConvolutions, "ExtraCounterterms" -> extraCounterterms,
  "Correction" -> correction, "Comparisons" -> comparisonRows, "Checks" -> checks,
   "Accepted" -> allEqual, "AcceptedForProduction" -> allEqual,
  "SchemeStatus" -> "MS subtraction: complete native operator minus its CDR regulator remainder; quark axial conversion deferred to S15",
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
out = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s11_msbar_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out], CreateDirectory[out, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
proofPath = FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_comparison.wl"}]; put[proof, proofPath];
gate["exact native comparison reload", Get[proofPath] === proof];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "all_reference_components_restored" -> allEqual,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
gate["all native-corrected finite reference components match", allEqual];
result = Join[previous, <|"RouteConvolutionsD" -> candidateRoutes, "ConvolutionsD" -> candidateConvolutions,
  "Counterterms" -> candidateCounterterms, "CountertermDifference" -> correction,
  "IntermediateStateConvention" -> "Native dimensional operator with CDR MS finite conversion",
  "AcceptedForProduction" -> allEqual, "SchemeStatus" -> proof["SchemeStatus"],
  "CDRKernelD" -> cdrKernelD, "CDRRegulatorRemainder" -> cdrRegulatorRemainder,
  "MSOperatorD" -> msbarOperatorD, "FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied" -> True,
  "PreviousSubtractionHash" -> proof["OriginalSubtractionHash"], "NativeTransferHash" -> proof["NativeTransferHash"],
  "ConvolutionComparisonHash" -> FileHash[proofPath, "SHA256"],
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "BaseSourceHash" -> FileHash[baselineSource, "SHA256"],
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"],
  "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>];
path = FileNameJoin[{out, "s11_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[result], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded native subtraction export", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[path <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"]; gate["exact native subtraction reload", Get[path <> ".tmp"] === result];
RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Print["PASS: s11_finalize_Hgq_subtraction"]; Quit[0];
```
