## common/s11_result/reference/s11_small_collinear_spin_before_dimensional.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-375", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 14388, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_result/reference/s11_small_collinear_spin_before_dimensional.wls", "sha256": "44ac7b5470ce54c6d0276bfa685ab88a5fff8d78d90c3835e7548488c48ffc8a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Regular spin-matrix subtraction for the pinned real-only channels. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_small_collinear_spin.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"]; checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  Print["FAIL: time bound ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["FAIL: memory bound ", label]; Quit[3]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"]; RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
zeroArray[value_] := And @@ (zero /@ Flatten[{value}]);
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_small_inputs.json"}];
auxConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s03_auxiliary_inputs.json"}];
kernelPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"]; auxConfig = Import[auxConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["supported subtraction channel", KeyExistsQ[config["channels"], channel]];
referenceRow = config["channels"][channel];
inputPaths = FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Values[referenceRow];
pinned[relative_] := gate["pinned " <> relative, IntegerString[
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  SelectFirst[config["files"], #["destination"] === relative &]["sha256"]];
Scan[pinned, Values[referenceRow]];
reference = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["result"]}]];
gate["accepted original subtraction and source bindings", reference["AcceptedSubtractionInputs"] &&
  reference["Channel"] === channel && reference["SourceHash"] ===
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["assembly_source"]}], "SHA256"] &&
  reference["PreservedSourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["source"]}], "SHA256"]];
kernels = Get[kernelPath];
gate["accepted spin kernels", kernels["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-collinear-kernels-v1" && And @@ Values[kernels["Checks"]]];
labels = kernels["SpinLabels"]; uPosition = First[FirstPosition[labels, "U"]];
bornOwners = <|"qg" -> {channel, "qg"}, "gq" -> {channel, "gq"}|>;
If[channel === "Hgg", AssociateTo[bornOwners, {"aqg" -> {channel, "aqg"}, "gaq" -> {"Hqqbar", "gq"}}]];
borns = <||>; species = <||>;
Do[owner = bornOwners[key]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, First[owner], "s03_result", Last[owner], "s03_result.wl"}];
  born = Get[path]; AppendTo[inputPaths, path];
  gate[key <> " accepted auxiliary Born", born["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-auxiliary-born-response-v1" &&
    born["Channel"] === First[owner] && born["AuxiliaryRoute"] === Last[owner] && And @@ Values[born["Checks"]]];
  incoming = If[MemberQ[born["ExtendedIncomingLabels"], "E"], "g", If[MemberQ[born["AntifermionMomenta"], p], "aq", "q"]];
  outgoing = If[MemberQ[born["ExtendedOutgoingLabels"], "E"], "g", If[MemberQ[born["AntifermionMomenta"], k1], "aq", "q"]];
  AssociateTo[species, key -> {incoming, outgoing}]; AssociateTo[borns, key -> born], {key, Keys[bornOwners]}];
bornKeys = Keys[borns]; photonLabels = borns[First[bornKeys]]["PhotonLabels"];
gate["shared spin and photon bases", AllTrue[Values[borns], #["SpinLabels"] === labels && #["PhotonLabels"] === photonLabels &]];
If[channel === "Hgg", gate["native charge-conjugate routes", species["aqg"] === {"aq", "g"} && species["gaq"] === {"g", "aq"}];
  gate["charge-conjugate CDR Born normalizations", zeroArray[
    Lookup[borns["aqg"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}] - Lookup[borns["qg"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}]] &&
    zeroArray[Lookup[borns["gaq"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}] - Lookup[borns["gq"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}]]]];
realGenerated = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["real_amplitudes"]}]];
realFermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[realGenerated["amplitudes"], Spinor[sign_. Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
realAntifermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[realGenerated["amplitudes"], Spinor[-Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
realSpecies = (If[!MemberQ[realFermions, #], "g", If[MemberQ[realAntifermions, #], "aq", "q"]] &) /@ {p, k1};
flows = reference["FactorizationMetadata"]["flows"] /. {quark -> "q", antiquark -> "aq", gluon -> "g"};
routes = {};
Do[
  If[Last[species[key]] === Last[realSpecies] && MemberQ[flows, First[species[key]]],
    AppendTo[routes, <|"Name" -> "PDF_" <> key, "Side" -> "PDF", "Born" -> key,
      "Kernel" -> First[realSpecies] <> First[species[key]]|>]];
  If[First[species[key]] === First[realSpecies] && MemberQ[flows, Last[species[key]]],
    AppendTo[routes, <|"Name" -> "FF_" <> key, "Side" -> "FF", "Born" -> key,
      "Kernel" -> Last[species[key]] <> Last[realSpecies]|>]], {key, bornKeys}];
routedFlows = Association@Table[side -> Sort[(If[side === "PDF",
  First[species[#["Born"]]], Last[species[#["Born"]]]] &) /@
  Select[routes, #["Side"] === side &]], {side, {"PDF", "FF"}}];
gate["all inherited flavor flows represented once per side", And @@ Table[
  routedFlows[side] === Sort[flows], {side, {"PDF", "FF"}}]];
gate["all route kernels available", AllTrue[routes, KeyExistsQ[kernels["Responses"], #["Kernel"]] &]];
gate["off-diagonal routes have ordinary kernels", FreeQ[
  Lookup[kernels["Responses"], Lookup[routes, "Kernel"]], _kernelPlus | _kernelDelta]];
rawBorns = Association@Table[route -> Module[{relative = auxConfig["channels"][channel][route]["unpolarized_born_file"]},
  pinned[relative]; AppendTo[inputPaths, FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]]; Get[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]]], {route, {"qg", "gq"}}];
couplingPowers = DeleteDuplicates[(Exponent[Numerator[Together[#]], gs] - Exponent[Denominator[Together[#]], gs]) & /@
  Select[Flatten[Values /@ Values[rawBorns]], # =!= 0 &]];
gate["one inherited Born coupling power", Length[couplingPowers] === 1 && IntegerQ[First[couplingPowers]]];
bornCoupling = gs^First[couplingPowers];
gate["removed Born coupling reconstructs every input", FreeQ[Values[Map[Map[Cancel[#/bornCoupling] &], rawBorns]], gs]];
physical = Q > 0 && s > s23 > 0 && s23 - Q^2 - s < t < -Q^2 s23/s && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
endpointRegion = Q > 0 && s > 0 && -Q^2 - s < t < 0 && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
simplify[value_] := FullSimplify[value, Assumptions -> physical];
kin = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["kinematics"]}]];
gate["reference scalar-input identities", reference["InputHashes"]["kinematics.wl"] ===
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["kinematics"]}], "SHA256"] && And @@ Table[
  reference["InputHashes"]["born_" <> route <> ".wl"] === FileHash[
    FileNameJoin[{root, auxConfig["channels"][channel][route]["unpolarized_born_file"]}], "SHA256"], {route, {"qg", "gq"}}]];
FCClearScalarProducts[]; DataType[eta, FCVariable] = True; DataType[zeta, FCVariable] = True;
Do[With[{a = kin["momenta"][[i]], b = kin["momenta"][[j]], value = kin["gram"][[i, j]] /. {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23}},
  SPD[a, b] = value], {i, Length[kin["momenta"]]}, {j, Length[kin["momenta"]]}];
invariants = <|"s" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q]],
  "t" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[q - k1/zeta]],
  "recoil" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q - k1/zeta]]|>;
gate["scaled invariants evaluated", FreeQ[invariants, _Pair]];
incomingSolutions = Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. zeta -> 1) == 0, eta];
outgoingSolutions = Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. eta -> 1) == 0, zeta];
gate["unique convolution roots", Length[incomingSolutions] === 1 && Length[outgoingSolutions] === 1];
incomingRoot = eta /. First[incomingSolutions]; outgoingRoot = zeta /. First[outgoingSolutions];
incomingJacobian = simplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], eta] /. {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1}]];
outgoingJacobian = simplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], zeta] /. {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot}]];
meta = reference["FactorizationMetadata"] /. {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23, Nc -> SUNN};
gate["exact original roots and Jacobians", zeroArray[
  {incomingRoot, outgoingRoot, incomingJacobian, outgoingJacobian} -
  Join[Lookup[meta, {"xi", "zeta"}], 1/meta["jacobians"]]]];
gate["convolution roots in physical support", simplify[0 < incomingRoot < 1 && 0 < outgoingRoot < 1]];
metric = DiagonalMatrix[{1, -1, -1, -1}]; dot4[a_, b_] := Expand[a.metric.b];
pTrial = {ep, 0, 0, ep}; qTrial = {0, 0, 0, -Q}; kTrial = {ek, Sqrt[kxSquared], 0, kz};
frameEquations = {dot4[pTrial + qTrial, pTrial + qTrial] == s,
  dot4[qTrial - kTrial, qTrial - kTrial] == t, dot4[kTrial, kTrial] == 0,
  dot4[pTrial + qTrial - kTrial, pTrial + qTrial - kTrial] == s23};
frameSolutions = Solve[frameEquations, {ep, ek, kz, kxSquared}];
gate["unique real frame", Length[frameSolutions] === 1 && FreeQ[frameSolutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
frameRules = First[frameSolutions];
realFrame = <|p -> simplify[pTrial /. frameRules], q -> qTrial, k1 -> simplify[kTrial /. frameRules],
  eL -> {1, 0, 0, 0}, eX -> {0, 1, 0, 0}, eY -> {0, 0, 1, 0}|>;
realOutZ = simplify[Rest[realFrame[k1]]/First[realFrame[k1]]];
AssociateTo[realFrame, {eOutX -> Prepend[simplify[Cross[{0, 1, 0}, realOutZ]], 0], eOutY -> {0, 0, 1, 0}}];
gate["real frame defining equations", And @@ simplify[frameEquations /. frameRules]];
rootRules = <|"PDF" -> {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1}, "FF" -> {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot}|>;
mapRules = AssociationMap[Thread[{s, t} -> (Lookup[invariants, {"s", "t"}] /. rootRules[#])] &, Keys[rootRules]];
Do[mappedFrame = borns[key]["Frame"] /. mapRules[side];
  gate[key <> " " <> side <> " mapped physical momenta", zeroArray[simplify[
    {mappedFrame[p] - (eta realFrame[p] /. rootRules[side]), mappedFrame[q] - realFrame[q],
      mappedFrame[k1] - (realFrame[k1]/zeta /. rootRules[side])}]]];
  gate[key <> " " <> side <> " fixed photon and spin axes", zeroArray[simplify[
    (mappedFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, eOutX, eOutY}) - (realFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, eOutX, eOutY})]]],
  {key, bornKeys}, {side, Keys[rootRules]}];
measureWeights = <|"PDF" -> incomingJacobian/incomingRoot, "FF" -> outgoingJacobian/outgoingRoot^2|>;
roots = <|"PDF" -> incomingRoot, "FF" -> outgoingRoot|>;

referenceConvolutions = Association@Table[mode -> Factor[Total[Table[
  key = route["Born"]; side = route["Side"];
  endpoint = borns[key][If[mode === "g", "CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"]];
  unpolarizedKernel = kernels["Responses"][route["Kernel"]]["Kernel"][[uPosition, uPosition]];
  measureWeights[side] bornCoupling (endpoint /. mapRules[side]) (unpolarizedKernel /. z -> roots[side])
    If[mode === "pp" && side === "PDF", incomingRoot^-2, 1], {route, routes}]]], {mode, {"g", "pp"}}];
Do[gate[mode <> " original full-dimensional convolution", zero[referenceConvolutions[mode] -
  (reference["Convolutions"][mode] /. {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23, Nc -> SUNN})]], {mode, {"g", "pp"}}];
contributions = <||>;
Do[key = route["Born"]; side = route["Side"];
  Print["SPIN_CONVOLUTION ", channel, " ", route["Name"]];
  mapped = bounded[simplify[borns[key]["Response"] /. mapRules[side]], {key, side, "mapped Born"}];
  kernelMatrix = kernels["Responses"][route["Kernel"]]["Kernel"] /. z -> roots[side];
  value = bounded[Map[Factor, measureWeights[side] If[side === "PDF",
    (Dot[#, kernelMatrix] & /@ mapped), (Dot[kernelMatrix, #] & /@ mapped)], {3}], route["Name"]];
  gate[route["Name"] <> " evaluated spin convolution", FreeQ[value,
    _Missing | _Dot | _Integrate | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
  endpointResidues = bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[s23 value, s23 -> 0], endpointRegion], {route["Name"], "endpoint"}];
  gate[route["Name"] <> " no soft endpoint pole", zeroArray[endpointResidues]];
  AssociateTo[contributions, route["Name"] -> value], {route, routes}];
regular = Map[Factor, Total[Values[contributions]], {3}];
zeros = ConstantArray[0, Dimensions[regular]];
convolutionsD = <|"Delta" -> zeros, "L0" -> zeros, "Regular" -> regular|>;
phaseCT = reference["PhaseCT"];
regularCounterterm = Map[bounded[Normal[Series[phaseCT bornCoupling (# /. D -> 4 - 2 eps),
  {eps, 0, 0}]], "counterterm Laurent expansion"] &, regular, {3}];
counterterms = <|"Delta" -> zeros, "L0" -> zeros, "Regular" -> regularCounterterm|>;
gate["all subtraction coefficients evaluated", FreeQ[counterterms,
  _Missing | _Series | _SeriesData | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{configPath, auxConfigPath, kernelPath}, inputPaths]];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-small-collinear-convolutions-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "PhotonLabels" -> photonLabels, "SpinLabels" -> labels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"photon component", "outgoing spin", "incoming spin"},
  "Routes" -> routes, "NativeSpecies" -> species, "RealSpecies" -> realSpecies, "InheritedFlows" -> flows,
  "RouteConvolutionsD" -> contributions, "ConvolutionsD" -> convolutionsD, "Counterterms" -> counterterms,
  "ReferenceConvolutions" -> referenceConvolutions, "PhaseCT" -> phaseCT, "BornCoupling" -> bornCoupling,
  "CountertermsIncludePhaseAndCouplings" -> True, "IncomingRoot" -> incomingRoot, "OutgoingRoot" -> outgoingRoot,
  "IncomingJacobian" -> incomingJacobian, "OutgoingJacobian" -> outgoingJacobian, "ScaledInvariantRules" -> mapRules,
  "Gamma5Scheme" -> "BMHV", "FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied" -> False,
  "CompletePoleCancellationChecked" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s11_result"}];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s11_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s11_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s11_small_collinear_spin"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s11_result/reference/s16_collinear_inputs.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-377", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3950, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_result/reference/s16_collinear_inputs.wl", "sha256": "ee121b6a83eec08225a20f7cd3dc13faf404f990bcba89142d206f47f7acf52a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Re-evaluate the unchanged real-only collinear convolutions and projectors. *)
$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
root=DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
gate[name_,test_] := If[!TrueQ[test],Print["FAIL: ",name];
  If[$KernelID>0,Throw[$Failed,"S16Failure"],CloseKernels[];Quit[1]]];
put[value_,file_] := (Put[value,file<>".tmp"];RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True]);
sourceHash=FileHash[$InputFileName,"SHA256"];
channelTask[channel_] := Catch[Module[{reference,source,body,phaseDefinition,directory,
    originalHashes,packet,metadata},
  reference=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s01_reference_sources","s05_factorize.wls"}];
  source=Import[reference,"Text"];
  body=StringTake[source,{First[First[StringPosition[source,"physical="]]],
    First[First[StringPosition[source,"If[!FileExistsQ[\"s04_result/real.wl\"]"]]]-1}];
  gate[channel<>" selected block contains only the unchanged subtraction and projectors",
    !AnyTrue[{"TID[","PaVe","s04_result/","Fhats.wl"},StringContainsQ[body,#]&]];
  phaseDefinition=StringCases[source,RegularExpression["phaseCT=[^;]+;"]];
  gate[channel<>" unique source-defined subtraction prefactor",Length[phaseDefinition]===1];
  directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s16_result"}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory]];
  originalHashes=Association@Table[file->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s01_inputs","s02_result",file}],"SHA256"],
    {file,{"kinematics.wl","born_qg.wl","born_gq.wl"}}];
  body=StringReplace[body,{
    "Get[\"s02_result/"->"Get[\""<>FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s01_inputs","s02_result"}]<>"/",
    "\"s05_result/"->"\""<>directory<>"/"}];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s16_extracted_source.txt"}],body<>First[phaseDefinition],"Text"];
  Global`require[test_,message_] := gate[channel<>" "<>message,test];
  Print["COLLINEAR_INPUTS ",channel," kernel ",$KernelID];
  (* Each worker evaluates one channel source in its isolated kernel. *)
  MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[ToExpression[body<>First[phaseDefinition]],900,
    gate[channel<>" subtraction time limit",False]],2*1024^3,
    gate[channel<>" subtraction memory limit",False]];
  metadata=Get[FileNameJoin[{directory,"counterterms.wl"}]];
  packet=<|"Channel"->channel,"Convolutions"->metadata["convolutions"],
    "FactorizationMetadata"->metadata,"Projectors"->Get[FileNameJoin[{directory,"projectors.wl"}]],
    "PhaseCT"->Global`phaseCT,"Scheme"->"MSbar","SourceHash"->sourceHash,
    "PreservedSourceHash"->FileHash[reference,"SHA256"],"InputHashes"->originalHashes,
    "AcceptedSubtractionInputs"->True,"RealIntegrationPerformed"->False|>;
  gate[channel<>" evaluated finite source expressions",FreeQ[packet,$Failed|$Aborted|_Integrate|_ToExpression|_Missing]];
  put[packet,FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s16_result.wl"}]];
  Print["COLLINEAR_INPUTS_ACCEPTED ",channel];packet],"S16Failure"];
slots=Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]],1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots]||slots<1,slots=1];CloseKernels[];
If[slots>1,LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost","KernelCommand"->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel","KernelCount"->Min[4,slots],"TimeConstraint"->60]]];
workers=Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers>0,ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,channelTask,root,sourceHash]];
$DistributedContexts=None;
channels={"Hgg","Hqqbar","Hqqprime"};
values=If[workers>0,ParallelMap[channelTask,channels,Method->"FinestGrained"],channelTask /@channels];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all requested subtraction inputs completed",FreeQ[values,$Failed|$Aborted]&&And@@Lookup[values,"AcceptedSubtractionInputs"]];
put[<|"Channels"->AssociationThread[channels,values],"SourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "AcceptedSubtractionInputs"->True|>,FileNameJoin[{root,"s16_result.wl"}]];
Print["S16_SUCCESS: real-only collinear subtraction and tensor projectors evaluated."];
Quit[0];

```

## common/s11_small_collinear_spin.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-378", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 18220, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s11_small_collinear_spin.wls", "sha256": "b47acf502782cf5da4720163519a419c81a1a7f750679441a32685da2838f1af"} -->
```wolfram
(* Regular spin-matrix subtraction for the pinned real-only channels. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_small_collinear_spin.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"]; checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; $LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"}; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  Print["FAIL: time bound ", label]; Quit[2]], 2*1024^3,
  Print["FAIL: memory bound ", label]; Quit[3]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"]; RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
zeroArray[value_] := And @@ (zero /@ Flatten[{value}]);
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_small_inputs.json"}];
auxConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s03_auxiliary_inputs.json"}];
kernelPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s10_result", "s10_result.wl"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"]; auxConfig = Import[auxConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["supported subtraction channel", KeyExistsQ[config["channels"], channel]];
referenceRow = config["channels"][channel];
inputPaths = FileNameJoin[{root, #}] & /@ Values[referenceRow];
pinned[relative_] := gate["pinned " <> relative, IntegerString[
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  SelectFirst[config["files"], #["destination"] === relative &]["sha256"]];
Scan[pinned, Values[referenceRow]];
reference = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["result"]}]];
gate["accepted original subtraction and source bindings", reference["AcceptedSubtractionInputs"] &&
  reference["Channel"] === channel && reference["SourceHash"] ===
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["assembly_source"]}], "SHA256"] &&
  reference["PreservedSourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["source"]}], "SHA256"]];
kernels = Get[kernelPath];
gate["accepted spin kernels", kernels["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-collinear-kernels-v1" && And @@ Values[kernels["Checks"]]];
labels = kernels["SpinLabels"]; uPosition = First[FirstPosition[labels, "U"]];
bornOwners = <|"qg" -> {channel, "qg"}, "gq" -> {channel, "gq"}|>;
If[channel === "Hgg", AssociateTo[bornOwners, {"aqg" -> {channel, "aqg"}, "gaq" -> {"Hqqbar", "gq"}}]];
borns = <||>; species = <||>;
Do[owner = bornOwners[key]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, First[owner], "s03_result", Last[owner], "s03_result.wl"}];
  born = Get[path]; AppendTo[inputPaths, path];
  gate[key <> " accepted auxiliary Born", born["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-auxiliary-born-response-v1" &&
    born["Channel"] === First[owner] && born["AuxiliaryRoute"] === Last[owner] && And @@ Values[born["Checks"]]];
  incoming = If[MemberQ[born["ExtendedIncomingLabels"], "E"], "g", If[MemberQ[born["AntifermionMomenta"], p], "aq", "q"]];
  outgoing = If[MemberQ[born["ExtendedOutgoingLabels"], "E"], "g", If[MemberQ[born["AntifermionMomenta"], k1], "aq", "q"]];
  AssociateTo[species, key -> {incoming, outgoing}]; AssociateTo[borns, key -> born], {key, Keys[bornOwners]}];
bornKeys = Keys[borns]; photonLabels = borns[First[bornKeys]]["PhotonLabels"];
gate["shared spin and photon bases", AllTrue[Values[borns], #["SpinLabels"] === labels && #["PhotonLabels"] === photonLabels &]];
If[channel === "Hgg", gate["native charge-conjugate routes", species["aqg"] === {"aq", "g"} && species["gaq"] === {"g", "aq"}];
  gate["charge-conjugate CDR Born normalizations", zeroArray[
    Lookup[borns["aqg"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}] - Lookup[borns["qg"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}]] &&
    zeroArray[Lookup[borns["gaq"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}] - Lookup[borns["gq"], {"CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"}]]]];
realGenerated = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["real_amplitudes"]}]];
realFermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[realGenerated["amplitudes"], Spinor[sign_. Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
realAntifermions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[realGenerated["amplitudes"], Spinor[-Momentum[mom_, ___], ___] :> mom, Infinity]];
realSpecies = (If[!MemberQ[realFermions, #], "g", If[MemberQ[realAntifermions, #], "aq", "q"]] &) /@ {p, k1};
flows = reference["FactorizationMetadata"]["flows"] /. {quark -> "q", antiquark -> "aq", gluon -> "g"};
routes = {};
Do[
  If[Last[species[key]] === Last[realSpecies] && MemberQ[flows, First[species[key]]],
    AppendTo[routes, <|"Name" -> "PDF_" <> key, "Side" -> "PDF", "Born" -> key,
      "Kernel" -> First[realSpecies] <> First[species[key]]|>]];
  If[First[species[key]] === First[realSpecies] && MemberQ[flows, Last[species[key]]],
    AppendTo[routes, <|"Name" -> "FF_" <> key, "Side" -> "FF", "Born" -> key,
      "Kernel" -> Last[species[key]] <> Last[realSpecies]|>]], {key, bornKeys}];
routedFlows = Association@Table[side -> Sort[(If[side === "PDF",
  First[species[#["Born"]]], Last[species[#["Born"]]]] &) /@
  Select[routes, #["Side"] === side &]], {side, {"PDF", "FF"}}];
gate["all inherited flavor flows represented once per side", And @@ Table[
  routedFlows[side] === Sort[flows], {side, {"PDF", "FF"}}]];
gate["all route kernels available", AllTrue[routes, KeyExistsQ[kernels["Responses"], #["Kernel"]] &]];
gate["off-diagonal routes have ordinary kernels", FreeQ[
  Lookup[kernels["Responses"], Lookup[routes, "Kernel"]], _kernelPlus | _kernelDelta]];
rawBorns = Association@Table[route -> Module[{relative = auxConfig["channels"][channel][route]["unpolarized_born_file"]},
  pinned[relative]; AppendTo[inputPaths, FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]]; Get[FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]]], {route, {"qg", "gq"}}];
couplingPowers = DeleteDuplicates[(Exponent[Numerator[Together[#]], gs] - Exponent[Denominator[Together[#]], gs]) & /@
  Select[Flatten[Values /@ Values[rawBorns]], # =!= 0 &]];
gate["one inherited Born coupling power", Length[couplingPowers] === 1 && IntegerQ[First[couplingPowers]]];
bornCoupling = gs^First[couplingPowers];
gate["removed Born coupling reconstructs every input", FreeQ[Values[Map[Map[Cancel[#/bornCoupling] &], rawBorns]], gs]];
physical = Q > 0 && s > s23 > 0 && s23 - Q^2 - s < t < -Q^2 s23/s && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
endpointRegion = Q > 0 && s > 0 && -Q^2 - s < t < 0 && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
simplify[value_] := FullSimplify[value, Assumptions -> physical];
kin = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["kinematics"]}]];
gate["reference scalar-input identities", reference["InputHashes"]["kinematics.wl"] ===
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, referenceRow["kinematics"]}], "SHA256"] && And @@ Table[
  reference["InputHashes"]["born_" <> route <> ".wl"] === FileHash[
    FileNameJoin[{root, auxConfig["channels"][channel][route]["unpolarized_born_file"]}], "SHA256"], {route, {"qg", "gq"}}]];
FCClearScalarProducts[]; DataType[eta, FCVariable] = True; DataType[zeta, FCVariable] = True;
Do[With[{a = kin["momenta"][[i]], b = kin["momenta"][[j]], value = kin["gram"][[i, j]] /. {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23}},
  SPD[a, b] = value], {i, Length[kin["momenta"]]}, {j, Length[kin["momenta"]]}];
invariants = <|"s" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q]],
  "t" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[q - k1/zeta]],
  "recoil" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[eta p + q - k1/zeta]]|>;
gate["scaled invariants evaluated", FreeQ[invariants, _Pair]];
incomingSolutions = Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. zeta -> 1) == 0, eta];
outgoingSolutions = Solve[(invariants["recoil"] /. eta -> 1) == 0, zeta];
gate["unique convolution roots", Length[incomingSolutions] === 1 && Length[outgoingSolutions] === 1];
incomingRoot = eta /. First[incomingSolutions]; outgoingRoot = zeta /. First[outgoingSolutions];
incomingJacobian = simplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], eta] /. {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1}]];
outgoingJacobian = simplify[1/Abs[D[invariants["recoil"], zeta] /. {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot}]];
meta = reference["FactorizationMetadata"] /. {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23, Nc -> SUNN};
gate["exact original roots and Jacobians", zeroArray[
  {incomingRoot, outgoingRoot, incomingJacobian, outgoingJacobian} -
  Join[Lookup[meta, {"xi", "zeta"}], 1/meta["jacobians"]]]];
gate["convolution roots in physical support", simplify[0 < incomingRoot < 1 && 0 < outgoingRoot < 1]];
metric = DiagonalMatrix[{1, -1, -1, -1}]; dot4[a_, b_] := Expand[a.metric.b];
pTrial = {ep, 0, 0, ep}; qTrial = {0, 0, 0, -Q}; kTrial = {ek, Sqrt[kxSquared], 0, kz};
frameEquations = {dot4[pTrial + qTrial, pTrial + qTrial] == s,
  dot4[qTrial - kTrial, qTrial - kTrial] == t, dot4[kTrial, kTrial] == 0,
  dot4[pTrial + qTrial - kTrial, pTrial + qTrial - kTrial] == s23};
frameSolutions = Solve[frameEquations, {ep, ek, kz, kxSquared}];
gate["unique real frame", Length[frameSolutions] === 1 && FreeQ[frameSolutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
frameRules = First[frameSolutions];
realFrame = <|p -> simplify[pTrial /. frameRules], q -> qTrial, k1 -> simplify[kTrial /. frameRules],
  eL -> {1, 0, 0, 0}, eX -> {0, 1, 0, 0}, eY -> {0, 0, 1, 0}|>;
realOutZ = simplify[Rest[realFrame[k1]]/First[realFrame[k1]]];
AssociateTo[realFrame, {eOutX -> Prepend[simplify[Cross[{0, 1, 0}, realOutZ]], 0], eOutY -> {0, 0, 1, 0}}];
gate["real frame defining equations", And @@ simplify[frameEquations /. frameRules]];
rootRules = <|"PDF" -> {eta -> incomingRoot, zeta -> 1}, "FF" -> {eta -> 1, zeta -> outgoingRoot}|>;
mapRules = AssociationMap[Thread[{s, t} -> (Lookup[invariants, {"s", "t"}] /. rootRules[#])] &, Keys[rootRules]];
Do[mappedFrame = borns[key]["Frame"] /. mapRules[side];
  gate[key <> " " <> side <> " mapped physical momenta", zeroArray[simplify[
    {mappedFrame[p] - (eta realFrame[p] /. rootRules[side]), mappedFrame[q] - realFrame[q],
      mappedFrame[k1] - (realFrame[k1]/zeta /. rootRules[side])}]]];
  gate[key <> " " <> side <> " fixed photon and spin axes", zeroArray[simplify[
    (mappedFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, eOutX, eOutY}) - (realFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, eOutX, eOutY})]]],
  {key, bornKeys}, {side, Keys[rootRules]}];
measureWeights = <|"PDF" -> incomingJacobian/incomingRoot, "FF" -> outgoingJacobian/outgoingRoot^2|>;
roots = <|"PDF" -> incomingRoot, "FF" -> outgoingRoot|>;

referenceConvolutions = Association@Table[mode -> Factor[Total[Table[
  key = route["Born"]; side = route["Side"];
  endpoint = borns[key][If[mode === "g", "CDRBornPg", "CDRBornPpp"]];
  unpolarizedKernel = kernels["Responses"][route["Kernel"]]["Kernel"][[uPosition, uPosition]];
  measureWeights[side] bornCoupling (endpoint /. mapRules[side]) (unpolarizedKernel /. z -> roots[side])
    If[mode === "pp" && side === "PDF", incomingRoot^-2, 1], {route, routes}]]], {mode, {"g", "pp"}}];
Do[gate[mode <> " original full-dimensional convolution", zero[referenceConvolutions[mode] -
  (reference["Convolutions"][mode] /. {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23, Nc -> SUNN})]], {mode, {"g", "pp"}}];
completionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqprime", "s11_dimensional_result", "s11_result.wl"}];
completionSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_check_dimensional_convolution.wls"}];
completionBaseline = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_result", "reference", "s11_small_collinear_spin_before_dimensional.wls"}];
gate["accepted dimensional completion identity", IntegerString[FileHash[completionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "3c76ab221bf3c99ba7c35223b26ca10ec527596dc2f60307d5cc7e508dbc411c"];
completionProof = Get[completionPath];
gate["executed intermediate-state completion", TrueQ[completionProof["Accepted"]] &&
  TrueQ[completionProof["RestoresReferenceHats"]] && And @@ Values[completionProof["Checks"]] &&
  completionProof["SourceHash"] === FileHash[completionSource, "SHA256"] &&
  completionProof["BaselineSourceHash"] === FileHash[completionBaseline, "SHA256"] &&
  completionProof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
DownValues[completeIntermediateBorn] = completionProof["Definitions"];
previousPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s11_result", "reference", "before_dimensional_completion", "s11_result.wl"}];
previous = Get[previousPath];
gate["archived previous subtraction", previous["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[previous["Checks"]] &&
  previous["SourceHash"] === FileHash[completionBaseline, "SHA256"] && previous["Routes"] === routes];
inputPaths = Join[inputPaths, {completionPath, completionSource, completionBaseline, previousPath}];
contributions = <||>; evanescentContributions = <||>; completedStates = <||>;
Do[key = route["Born"]; side = route["Side"];
  Print["SPIN_CONVOLUTION ", channel, " ", route["Name"]];
  completedBorn = completeIntermediateBorn[borns[key], side];
  gate[route["Name"] <> " physical D4 Born unchanged", zeroArray[
    (Take[completedBorn["Response"], Length[photonLabels]] - borns[key]["Response"]) /. D -> 4]];
  mapped = bounded[simplify[completedBorn["Response"] /. mapRules[side]], {key, side, "mapped Born"}];
  kernelMatrix = kernels["Responses"][route["Kernel"]]["Kernel"] /. z -> roots[side];
  value = bounded[Map[Factor, measureWeights[side] If[side === "PDF",
    (Dot[#, kernelMatrix] & /@ mapped), (Dot[kernelMatrix, #] & /@ mapped)], {3}], route["Name"]];
  gate[route["Name"] <> " evaluated spin convolution", FreeQ[value,
    _Missing | _Dot | _Integrate | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
  endpointResidues = bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[s23 value, s23 -> 0], endpointRegion], {route["Name"], "endpoint"}];
  gate[route["Name"] <> " no soft endpoint pole", zeroArray[endpointResidues]];
  AssociateTo[completedStates, route["Name"] -> KeyDrop[completedBorn, "Response"]];
  AssociateTo[evanescentContributions, route["Name"] -> Last[value]];
  AssociateTo[contributions, route["Name"] -> Take[value, Length[photonLabels]]], {route, routes}];
regular = Map[Factor, Total[Values[contributions]], {3}];
If[FreeQ[realSpecies, "g"],
  basisPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}];
  spinBasis = Get[basisPath]; AppendTo[inputPaths, basisPath];
  gate["accepted contraction basis", And @@ Values[spinBasis["Checks"]]];
  metricWeights = Tr[spinBasis["PhotonMetric"].#] & /@ spinBasis["PhotonBasis"];
  pComponents = Take[LinearSolve[Transpose[realFrame /@ {eL, eX, eY, q}], realFrame[p]], Length[{eL, eX, eY}]];
  pWeights = Factor[pComponents.#.pComponents] & /@ spinBasis["PhotonBasis"];
  completedScalar = bornCoupling {metricWeights.regular[[All, uPosition, uPosition]] +
    Total[Values[evanescentContributions]][[uPosition, uPosition]], pWeights.regular[[All, uPosition, uPosition]]};
  gate["actual completed spin convolutions reproduce both dimensional references",
    zeroArray[completedScalar - Lookup[referenceConvolutions, {"g", "pp"}]]]];
zeros = ConstantArray[0, Dimensions[regular]];
convolutionsD = <|"Delta" -> zeros, "L0" -> zeros, "Regular" -> regular|>;
phaseCT = reference["PhaseCT"];
regularCounterterm = Map[bounded[Normal[Series[phaseCT bornCoupling (# /. D -> 4 - 2 eps),
  {eps, 0, 0}]], "counterterm Laurent expansion"] &, regular, {3}];
counterterms = <|"Delta" -> zeros, "L0" -> zeros, "Regular" -> regularCounterterm|>;
countertermDifference = Map[Factor, counterterms["Regular"] - previous["Counterterms"]["Regular"], {3}];
gate["intermediate completion changes no regulator pole", FreeQ[countertermDifference, eps | D]];
If[channel === "Hqqprime", gate["complete counterterm correction equals executed comparison",
  zeroArray[countertermDifference - completionProof["CountertermCorrection"]]]];
If[AllTrue[Values[completedStates], #["IntermediateLabels"] === labels &],
  gate["routes without dimensional intermediate states remain exactly unchanged", zeroArray[countertermDifference]]];
gate["all subtraction coefficients evaluated", FreeQ[counterterms,
  _Missing | _Series | _SeriesData | _Limit | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
inputPaths = DeleteDuplicates[Join[{configPath, auxConfigPath, kernelPath}, inputPaths]];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-small-collinear-convolutions-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "PhotonLabels" -> photonLabels, "SpinLabels" -> labels,
  "IndexOrder" -> {"photon component", "outgoing spin", "incoming spin"},
  "Routes" -> routes, "NativeSpecies" -> species, "RealSpecies" -> realSpecies, "InheritedFlows" -> flows,
  "RouteConvolutionsD" -> contributions, "ConvolutionsD" -> convolutionsD, "Counterterms" -> counterterms,
  "ReferenceConvolutions" -> referenceConvolutions, "PhaseCT" -> phaseCT, "BornCoupling" -> bornCoupling,
  "IntermediateStateConvention" -> "CDR U/E completeness and incoming CDR averaging; physical resolved spin labels",
  "IntermediateStateCompletions" -> completedStates, "EvanescentPhotonConvolutionsD" -> evanescentContributions,
  "DimensionalCompletionValidationHash" -> FileHash[completionPath, "SHA256"],
  "PreviousSubtractionHash" -> FileHash[previousPath, "SHA256"], "CountertermDifference" -> countertermDifference,
  "CountertermsIncludePhaseAndCouplings" -> True, "IncomingRoot" -> incomingRoot, "OutgoingRoot" -> outgoingRoot,
  "IncomingJacobian" -> incomingJacobian, "OutgoingJacobian" -> outgoingJacobian, "ScaledInvariantRules" -> mapRules,
  "Gamma5Scheme" -> "BMHV", "FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied" -> False,
  "CompletePoleCancellationChecked" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "Checks" -> checks, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s11_result"}];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s11_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s11_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s11_small_collinear_spin"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s12_assemble_real_compact_inputs.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-380", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 12483, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_compact_inputs.wls", "sha256": "755e42e244069df515f43066cc9c331b331e245acd68c8ec6c75e345a837d87c"} -->

```wolfram
(* Reuse the executed standalone rational recurrence after an own-input comparison. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
referenceSeriesPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_compact_inputs.wls"}];
referenceSeriesBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243", Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesText = Import[referenceSeriesBase, "Text"];
referenceSeriesBoundary = "\nslots=";
If[StringCount[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary] =!= 1 ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[referenceSeriesPath, "Text"]], Print["FAIL: complete reference-series source syntax"]; Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesPrefix = First[StringSplit[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary]];
referenceSeriesTail = referenceSeriesBoundary <> Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary]];
referenceSeriesOldCall = "terms=KeyValueMap[Function[{m,c},epsilonSeries[(c/.D->4-2eps)regions[\"OrdinaryMasters\"][m],0,\n    \"ordinary cut coefficient\"]],coefficients];\n  ordinary=Total[terms];";
If[StringCount[referenceSeriesPrefix, referenceSeriesOldCall] =!= 1 ||
  StringCount[referenceSeriesPrefix, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesPrefix = StringReplace[referenceSeriesPrefix, {
  referenceSeriesOldCall -> "ordinary=referenceSeriesOrdinary[component,index];",
  "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "If[!MemberQ[$Packages,\"FeynCalc`\"],Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"}];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
If[!SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesTail], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesPrefix, InputForm];
(* Retain exactly the component fields read by assemble and candidateOrdinary. *)
referenceInputFields = {"Sector", "Kind", "Index", "ReducedCoefficients"};
gate["complete real-assembly component interface", AllTrue[mapped["Components"],
  Function[component, AssociationQ[component] && AllTrue[referenceInputFields, KeyExistsQ[component, #] &]]]];
referenceInputBytes = ByteCount[mapped["Components"]];
referenceInputRecords = KeyTake[#, referenceInputFields] & /@ mapped["Components"];
gate["exact real-assembly consumer values retained", And @@
  (Lookup[referenceInputRecords, #] === Lookup[mapped["Components"], #] & /@ referenceInputFields)];
referenceInputFootprint = <|"OriginalComponentBytes" -> referenceInputBytes,
  "ProjectedComponentBytes" -> ByteCount[referenceInputRecords],
  "ComponentCount" -> Length[referenceInputRecords], "Fields" -> referenceInputFields|>;
AssociateTo[mapped, "Components" -> referenceInputRecords];
Clear[referenceInputRecords]; ClearSystemCache[];
Print["S12_INPUT_PROJECTION ", InputForm[referenceInputFootprint]];
referenceSeriesParentRelative = "Hqqbar/s12_rational_series_result/s12_result.wl";
referenceSeriesParentPath = FileNameJoin[{root, referenceSeriesParentRelative}];
referenceSeriesReceiptPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqbar", "s12_rational_series_result", "s12_execution.json"}];
gate["pinned executed reference recurrence and receipt",
  IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "0724c147d2349bd44183ecb90936a56d1c7790f7ebd6dade58459cd0c1f8373a" &&
  IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesReceiptPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "406139892f2afcce55da23b0c374078dcc99e52d38166406fa06c7cdc2346874"];
referenceSeriesParent = Get[referenceSeriesParentPath];
referenceSeriesReceipt = Import[referenceSeriesReceiptPath, "RawJSON"];
referenceSeriesComparisonPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}];
gate["accepted reference recurrence with unchanged equations", TrueQ[referenceSeriesReceipt["passed"]] &&
  referenceSeriesReceipt["result_sha256"][referenceSeriesParentRelative] === IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-rational-master-product-comparison-v1" &&
  AssociationQ[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] && Length[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] > 0 &&
  And @@ Values[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["SourceHash"] === FileHash[referenceSeriesComparisonPath, "SHA256"] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash &&
  referenceSeriesParent["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  referenceSeriesParent["OriginalDefinitions"] === {DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct],
    DownValues[softRows], DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint]}];
referenceSeriesStandalonePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_result", "reference", "s12_standalone_rational_series.wls"}];
gate["same standalone reference implementation", referenceSeriesParent["ReferenceSourceHash"] === FileHash[referenceSeriesStandalonePath, "SHA256"]];
Do[gate["same accepted scalar master " <> stage,
  referenceSeriesParent["InputHashes"][library["Library"][stage]["File"]] === inputHashes[library["Library"][stage]["File"]]],
  {stage, {"s08", "s10", "s15"}}];
referenceSeriesComparisonText = Import[referenceSeriesComparisonPath, "Text"];
referenceSeriesPredicateStart = "\nzeroCoefficient[value_] := ";
referenceSeriesPredicateEnd = "\ncheckedRationalSeries[";
gate["unique executed recurrence predicate", StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateStart] === 1 &&
  StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateEnd] === 1];
referenceSeriesPredicate = referenceSeriesPredicateStart <>
  First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateStart]], referenceSeriesPredicateEnd]];
gate["native recurrence predicate syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesPredicate]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesPredicate, InputForm];
DownValues[rationalSeries] = referenceSeriesParent["RationalDefinitions"];
DownValues[checkedRationalSeries] = referenceSeriesParent["CheckedRationalDefinitions"];
DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct] = referenceSeriesParent["ProductDefinitions"];
DownValues[candidateOrdinary] = referenceSeriesParent["CandidateDefinitions"];
gate["exact executed recurrence definitions installed",
  DownValues[rationalSeries] === referenceSeriesParent["RationalDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[checkedRationalSeries] === referenceSeriesParent["CheckedRationalDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct] === referenceSeriesParent["ProductDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[candidateOrdinary] === referenceSeriesParent["CandidateDefinitions"]];
referenceSeriesControlCode = "referenceOriginalOrdinary[component_] := Module[{coefficients,terms,ordinary},\n" <>
  "coefficients=Select[component[\"ReducedCoefficients\"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;\n" <>
  referenceSeriesOldCall <> "\nordinary];";
gate["original ordinary coefficient calculation syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesControlCode]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesControlCode, InputForm];
referenceSeriesIndices = Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]], # =!= 0 &] &];
gate["own nonzero ordinary control available", referenceSeriesIndices =!= {}];
referenceSeriesControlIndex = First[MinimalBy[referenceSeriesIndices,
  ByteCount[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]] &]];
referenceSeriesControl = mapped["Components"][[referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
referenceSeriesControlHash = Hash[referenceSeriesControl, "SHA256"];
referenceSeriesStudyDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_reference_series_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory], CreateDirectory[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
referenceSeriesStudyPath = FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
referenceSeriesStudy = If[FileExistsQ[referenceSeriesStudyPath], Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath], <||>];
referenceSeriesBinding = Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], inputHash,
  FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], referenceSeriesControlHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
If[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Binding", None] === referenceSeriesBinding &&
  TrueQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Accepted", False]] && AssociationQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Checks", None]] &&
  Length[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]],
  referenceSeriesControlValue = referenceSeriesStudy["CandidateValue"],
  Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_CONTROL ", channel, " component ", referenceSeriesControlIndex,
    " input_bytes ", ByteCount[referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"]]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  {referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds, referenceSeriesOriginalValue} = AbsoluteTiming[referenceOriginalOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  {referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, referenceSeriesControlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl, referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
  gate["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced", bounded[
    zeroCoefficient[Expand[referenceSeriesControlValue - referenceSeriesOriginalValue, eps]], "own ordinary reference comparison"]];
  referenceSeriesStudy = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-own-reference-series-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "Binding" -> referenceSeriesBinding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SourceHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], "ParentProofHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex" -> referenceSeriesControlIndex, "ControlHash" -> referenceSeriesControlHash,
    "ControlCoefficients" -> referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"], "CandidateValue" -> referenceSeriesControlValue,
    "InputProjectionFootprint" -> referenceInputFootprint,
    "OriginalValue" -> referenceSeriesOriginalValue, "OriginalSeconds" -> referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds,
    "CandidateSeconds" -> referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  referenceSeriesSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[referenceSeriesStudy], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded own recurrence comparison output", StringLength[referenceSeriesSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesSerialized, "Text"];
  gate["exact own recurrence comparison reload", Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp"] === referenceSeriesStudy];
  RenameFile[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesStudyPath, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
gate["own reference recurrence comparison accepted", TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Accepted"]] &&
  TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced"]]];
Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_ACCEPTED ", channel, " ", InputForm[KeyTake[referenceSeriesStudy,
  {"ControlIndex", "OriginalSeconds", "CandidateSeconds"}]]];
referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_, index_] := If[index === referenceSeriesControlIndex,
  gate["reused own ordinary coefficient exact task", Hash[component, "SHA256"] === referenceSeriesControlHash];
  referenceSeriesControlValue, candidateOrdinary[component, index]];
referenceSeriesDistribute = "DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
referenceSeriesOutput = "put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
referenceSeriesChanges = {
  referenceSeriesDistribute -> (referenceSeriesDistribute <>
    "rationalSeries,checkedRationalSeries,ordinaryMasterProduct,candidateOrdinary,zeroCoefficient,referenceSeriesOrdinary,referenceSeriesControlIndex,referenceSeriesControlHash,referenceSeriesControlValue,"),
  referenceSeriesOutput -> ("AssociateTo[result,{\"ReferenceSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,\"SHA256\"],\"OwnReferenceSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesStudyPath,\"SHA256\"],\"InputProjectionFootprint\"->referenceInputFootprint}];\n" <> referenceSeriesOutput)};
gate["unique unchanged integration worker and output interfaces", And @@ (StringCount[referenceSeriesTail, First[#]] === 1 & /@ referenceSeriesChanges)];
referenceSeriesRunTail = StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail, referenceSeriesChanges];
gate["complete original integration tail retained", StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail, Reverse /@ referenceSeriesChanges] === referenceSeriesTail && SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesRunTail]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesRunTail, InputForm];
```

```wolfram
  Print["OWN_REJECTED_ORDINARY_CONTROL ",factoredRejectedIndex];
  {factoredOriginalSeconds,factoredOriginal} = AbsoluteTiming[referenceOriginalOrdinary[mapped["Components"][[factoredRejectedIndex]]]];
  {factoredCandidateSeconds,factoredCandidate} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[mapped["Components"][[factoredRejectedIndex]],factoredRejectedIndex]];
  gate["previously rejected ordinary component matches original Series",bounded[
    zeroCoefficient[Expand[factoredOriginal-factoredCandidate,eps]],"failed ordinary own comparison"]];
  factoredControlCache = FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s12_factored_controls",channel,IntegerString[factoredBinding,16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[factoredControlCache],CreateDirectory[factoredControlCache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
  {factoredControlSeconds,factoredControlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=factoredControlCache},
    assemble[mapped["Components"][[factoredControlIndex]],factoredControlIndex]]];
  gate["own corrected full component accepted",AssociationQ[factoredControlValue] && TrueQ[factoredControlValue["Accepted"]] &&
    And@@Values[factoredControlValue["Checks"]]];
  gate["own complete ordinary unchanged",bounded[zeroCoefficient[factoredControlValue["Ordinary"]-factoredControl["Ordinary"]],"ordinary control"]];
  Do[
    gate["own complete branch assumptions unchanged",factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]===factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own complete branch "<>ToString[{sign,key}],bounded[zeroCoefficient[
      factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign][key]-factoredControl["Branches"][sign][key]],"endpoint own comparison"]],{key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
    factoredRows=factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    originalRows=factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own soft support unchanged",Length[factoredRows]===Length[originalRows] && (Take[#,2]&/@factoredRows)===(Take[#,2]&/@originalRows)];
    gate["own soft coefficients unchanged",And@@MapThread[bounded[zeroCoefficient[Last[#1]-Last[#2]],"own soft comparison"]&,{factoredRows,originalRows}]],
    {sign,{1,-1}}];
  factoredProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-factored-input-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,"Binding"->factoredBinding,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "RecoilProofHash"->FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],"ControlHash"->FileHash[factoredControlPath,"SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex"->factoredControlIndex,"RejectedIndex"->factoredRejectedIndex,"OriginalOrdinary"->factoredOriginal,
    "CandidateOrdinary"->factoredCandidate,"OriginalSeconds"->factoredOriginalSeconds,"CandidateSeconds"->factoredCandidateSeconds,
    "CompleteControl"->factoredControlValue,"ControlSeconds"->factoredControlSeconds,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  factoredSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[factoredProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded corrected comparison output",StringLength[factoredSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact corrected comparison reload",Get[factoredProofPath<>".tmp"]===factoredProof];
  RenameFile[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["complete own factored-input comparison accepted",TrueQ[factoredProof["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredProof["Binding"]===factoredBinding && And@@Values[factoredProof["Checks"]]];
Print["OWN_FACTORED_INPUTS_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",InputForm[KeyTake[factoredProof,{"OriginalSeconds","CandidateSeconds","ControlSeconds"}]]];

referenceSeriesDistribute = "DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
referenceSeriesOutput = "put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
referenceSeriesChanges = {
  referenceSeriesDistribute -> (referenceSeriesDistribute <>
    "recoilData,rationalSeries,checkedRationalSeries,ordinaryMasterProduct,candidateOrdinary,zeroCoefficient,referenceSeriesOrdinary,referenceSeriesControlIndex,referenceSeriesControlHash,referenceSeriesControlValue,"),
  referenceSeriesOutput -> ("AssociateTo[result,{\"ReferenceSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,\"SHA256\"],\"OwnReferenceSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesStudyPath,\"SHA256\"],\"InputProjectionFootprint\"->referenceInputFootprint,\"FactoredInputComparisonHash\"->FileHash[factoredProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n" <> referenceSeriesOutput)};
gate["unique unchanged integration worker and output interfaces", And @@ (StringCount[referenceSeriesTail, First[#]] === 1 & /@ referenceSeriesChanges)];
referenceSeriesRunTail = StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail, referenceSeriesChanges];
gate["complete original integration tail retained", StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail, Reverse /@ referenceSeriesChanges] === referenceSeriesTail && SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesRunTail]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesRunTail, InputForm];

```

## common/s12_assemble_real_factored_series.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-382", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 20537, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_factored_series.wls", "sha256": "7bbecbad4109fd3a2cef0f1d69aeaf8e6050c488427327e941bcaa096be0b44f"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse the executed standalone rational recurrence after an own-input comparison. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
referenceSeriesPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_factored_series.wls"}];
referenceSeriesBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243", Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesText = Import[referenceSeriesBase, "Text"];
referenceSeriesBoundary = "\nslots=";
If[StringCount[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary] =!= 1 ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[referenceSeriesPath, "Text"]], Print["FAIL: complete reference-series source syntax"]; Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesPrefix = First[StringSplit[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary]];
referenceSeriesTail = referenceSeriesBoundary <> Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary]];
referenceSeriesOldCall = "terms=KeyValueMap[Function[{m,c},epsilonSeries[(c/.D->4-2eps)regions[\"OrdinaryMasters\"][m],0,\n    \"ordinary cut coefficient\"]],coefficients];\n  ordinary=Total[terms];";
If[StringCount[referenceSeriesPrefix, referenceSeriesOldCall] =!= 1 ||
  StringCount[referenceSeriesPrefix, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesPrefix = StringReplace[referenceSeriesPrefix, {
  referenceSeriesOldCall -> "ordinary=referenceSeriesOrdinary[component,index];",
  "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "If[!MemberQ[$Packages,\"FeynCalc`\"],Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"}];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
If[!SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesTail], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesPrefix, InputForm];
(* Retain exactly the component fields read by assemble and candidateOrdinary. *)
referenceInputFields = {"Sector", "Kind", "Index", "ReducedCoefficients"};
gate["complete real-assembly component interface", AllTrue[mapped["Components"],
  Function[component, AssociationQ[component] && AllTrue[referenceInputFields, KeyExistsQ[component, #] &]]]];
referenceInputBytes = ByteCount[mapped["Components"]];
referenceInputRecords = KeyTake[#, referenceInputFields] & /@ mapped["Components"];
gate["exact real-assembly consumer values retained", And @@
  (Lookup[referenceInputRecords, #] === Lookup[mapped["Components"], #] & /@ referenceInputFields)];
referenceInputFootprint = <|"OriginalComponentBytes" -> referenceInputBytes,
  "ProjectedComponentBytes" -> ByteCount[referenceInputRecords],
  "ComponentCount" -> Length[referenceInputRecords], "Fields" -> referenceInputFields|>;
AssociateTo[mapped, "Components" -> referenceInputRecords];
Clear[referenceInputRecords]; ClearSystemCache[];
Print["S12_INPUT_PROJECTION ", InputForm[referenceInputFootprint]];
referenceSeriesParentRelative = "Hqqbar/s12_rational_series_result/s12_result.wl";
referenceSeriesParentPath = FileNameJoin[{root, referenceSeriesParentRelative}];
referenceSeriesReceiptPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqbar", "s12_rational_series_result", "s12_execution.json"}];
gate["pinned executed reference recurrence and receipt",
  IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "0724c147d2349bd44183ecb90936a56d1c7790f7ebd6dade58459cd0c1f8373a" &&
  IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesReceiptPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "406139892f2afcce55da23b0c374078dcc99e52d38166406fa06c7cdc2346874"];
referenceSeriesParent = Get[referenceSeriesParentPath];
referenceSeriesReceipt = Import[referenceSeriesReceiptPath, "RawJSON"];
referenceSeriesComparisonPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}];
gate["accepted reference recurrence with unchanged equations", TrueQ[referenceSeriesReceipt["passed"]] &&
  referenceSeriesReceipt["result_sha256"][referenceSeriesParentRelative] === IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-rational-master-product-comparison-v1" &&
  AssociationQ[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] && Length[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] > 0 &&
  And @@ Values[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["SourceHash"] === FileHash[referenceSeriesComparisonPath, "SHA256"] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash &&
  referenceSeriesParent["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  referenceSeriesParent["OriginalDefinitions"] === {DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct],
    DownValues[softRows], DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint]}];
referenceSeriesStandalonePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_result", "reference", "s12_standalone_rational_series.wls"}];
gate["same standalone reference implementation", referenceSeriesParent["ReferenceSourceHash"] === FileHash[referenceSeriesStandalonePath, "SHA256"]];
Do[gate["same accepted scalar master " <> stage,
  referenceSeriesParent["InputHashes"][library["Library"][stage]["File"]] === inputHashes[library["Library"][stage]["File"]]],
  {stage, {"s08", "s10", "s15"}}];
referenceSeriesComparisonText = Import[referenceSeriesComparisonPath, "Text"];
referenceSeriesPredicateStart = "\nzeroCoefficient[value_] := ";
referenceSeriesPredicateEnd = "\ncheckedRationalSeries[";
gate["unique executed recurrence predicate", StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateStart] === 1 &&
  StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateEnd] === 1];
referenceSeriesPredicate = referenceSeriesPredicateStart <>
  First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateStart]], referenceSeriesPredicateEnd]];
gate["native recurrence predicate syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesPredicate]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesPredicate, InputForm];
DownValues[rationalSeries] = referenceSeriesParent["RationalDefinitions"];
DownValues[checkedRationalSeries] = referenceSeriesParent["CheckedRationalDefinitions"];
DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct] = referenceSeriesParent["ProductDefinitions"];
DownValues[candidateOrdinary] = referenceSeriesParent["CandidateDefinitions"];
gate["exact executed recurrence definitions installed",
  DownValues[rationalSeries] === referenceSeriesParent["RationalDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[checkedRationalSeries] === referenceSeriesParent["CheckedRationalDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct] === referenceSeriesParent["ProductDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[candidateOrdinary] === referenceSeriesParent["CandidateDefinitions"]];
(* The recurrence is unchanged. Compare and return the product at its requested order. *)
productOriginalDefinitions = DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct];
productStart = "\nordinaryMasterProduct[";
productEnd = "\ncandidateOrdinary[";
gate["unique complete reference product definition", StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, productStart] === 1 &&
  StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, productEnd] === 1];
productText = productStart <> First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesComparisonText, productStart]], productEnd]];
productOldTail = "  If[!TrueQ[productIdentity], Print[\"MASTER_PRODUCT_RESIDUAL \", StringTake[ToString[residual, InputForm], UpTo[4000]]]];\n  gate[\"complete product matches native polynomial Series\", productIdentity];\n  answer];";
productNewTail = "  gate[\"product agrees through requested regulator order\", TrueQ[productIdentity] || bounded[zeroCoefficient[Normal[Series[residual,{eps,0,order}]]],\"retained product comparison\"]];\n  If[!TrueQ[productIdentity],Print[\"MASTER_PRODUCT_TRUNCATED \",description,\" first_discarded_power \",Exponent[residual,eps,Min],\" requested_order \",order]];\n  gate[\"native product contains no higher regulator powers\", direct===0 || Exponent[Expand[direct,eps],eps]<=order];\n  direct];";
gate["single bounded product correction", StringCount[productText, productOldTail] === 1];
productCorrectedText = StringReplace[productText, productOldTail -> productNewTail];
gate["complete product correction syntax and reversible source", SyntaxQ[productCorrectedText] &&
  StringReplace[productCorrectedText, productNewTail -> productOldTail] === productText];
ToExpression[productCorrectedText, InputForm];
recoilProofRelative = "Hqqbar/s12_recoil_factorization_result/s12_result.wl";
recoilProofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, recoilProofRelative}];
recoilReceiptPath = FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[recoilProofPath], "s12_execution.json"}];
recoilProof = Get[recoilProofPath]; recoilReceipt = Import[recoilReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted reference factorization definitions", TrueQ[recoilReceipt["passed"]] &&
  recoilReceipt["result_sha256"][recoilProofRelative] === IntegerString[FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64] &&
  recoilProof["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-recoil-factorization-comparison-v1" &&
  recoilProof["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_check_recoil_factorization.wls"}],"SHA256"] &&
  And@@Values[recoilProof["Checks"]] && recoilProof["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash &&
  recoilProof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version,$FeynCalcVersion} &&
  First[recoilProof["OriginalDefinitions"]] === DownValues[softRows]];
DownValues[recoilData] = recoilProof["HelperDefinitions"];
DownValues[softRows] = recoilProof["RowDefinitions"];
gate["exact reference endpoint factorization installed", DownValues[recoilData] === recoilProof["HelperDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[softRows] === recoilProof["RowDefinitions"]];

referenceSeriesControlCode = "referenceOriginalOrdinary[component_] := Module[{coefficients,terms,ordinary},\n" <>
  "coefficients=Select[component[\"ReducedCoefficients\"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;\n" <>
  referenceSeriesOldCall <> "\nordinary];";
gate["original ordinary coefficient calculation syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesControlCode]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesControlCode, InputForm];
referenceSeriesIndices = Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]], # =!= 0 &] &];
gate["own nonzero ordinary control available", referenceSeriesIndices =!= {}];
referenceSeriesControlIndex = First[MinimalBy[referenceSeriesIndices,
  ByteCount[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]] &]];
referenceSeriesControl = mapped["Components"][[referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
referenceSeriesControlHash = Hash[referenceSeriesControl, "SHA256"];
referenceSeriesStudyDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_factored_series_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory], CreateDirectory[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
referenceSeriesStudyPath = FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
referenceSeriesStudy = If[FileExistsQ[referenceSeriesStudyPath], Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath], <||>];
referenceSeriesBinding = Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], inputHash,
  FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], referenceSeriesControlHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
If[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Binding", None] === referenceSeriesBinding &&
  TrueQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Accepted", False]] && AssociationQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Checks", None]] &&
  Length[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]],
  referenceSeriesControlValue = referenceSeriesStudy["CandidateValue"],
  Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_CONTROL ", channel, " component ", referenceSeriesControlIndex,
    " input_bytes ", ByteCount[referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"]]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  {referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds, referenceSeriesOriginalValue} = AbsoluteTiming[referenceOriginalOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  {referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, referenceSeriesControlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl, referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
  gate["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced", bounded[
    zeroCoefficient[Expand[referenceSeriesControlValue - referenceSeriesOriginalValue, eps]], "own ordinary reference comparison"]];
  referenceSeriesStudy = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-own-reference-series-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "Binding" -> referenceSeriesBinding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SourceHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], "ParentProofHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex" -> referenceSeriesControlIndex, "ControlHash" -> referenceSeriesControlHash,
    "ControlCoefficients" -> referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"], "CandidateValue" -> referenceSeriesControlValue,
    "InputProjectionFootprint" -> referenceInputFootprint,
    "OriginalValue" -> referenceSeriesOriginalValue, "OriginalSeconds" -> referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds,
    "CandidateSeconds" -> referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  referenceSeriesSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[referenceSeriesStudy], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded own recurrence comparison output", StringLength[referenceSeriesSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesSerialized, "Text"];
  gate["exact own recurrence comparison reload", Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp"] === referenceSeriesStudy];
  RenameFile[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesStudyPath, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
gate["own reference recurrence comparison accepted", TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Accepted"]] &&
  TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced"]]];
Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_ACCEPTED ", channel, " ", InputForm[KeyTake[referenceSeriesStudy,
  {"ControlIndex", "OriginalSeconds", "CandidateSeconds"}]]];
referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_, index_] := If[index === referenceSeriesControlIndex,
  gate["reused own ordinary coefficient exact task", Hash[component, "SHA256"] === referenceSeriesControlHash];
  referenceSeriesControlValue, candidateOrdinary[component, index]];
(* Compare the complete smallest nonzero own component before remaining integration. *)
factoredControlIndex=referenceSeriesControlIndex;
factoredTask=mapped["Components"][[factoredControlIndex]];
factoredControlBinding=Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,"SHA256"],inputHash,Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
  FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
factoredControlRoot=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s12_factored_controls",channel,IntegerString[factoredControlBinding,16]}];
factoredOriginalCache=FileNameJoin[{factoredControlRoot,"original"}];
factoredCandidateCache=FileNameJoin[{factoredControlRoot,"candidate"}];
Do[If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]],
  {directory,{factoredOriginalCache,factoredCandidateCache}}];
factoredCanonicalPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[factoredControlIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}];
If[FileExistsQ[factoredCanonicalPath],
  factoredControl=Get[factoredCanonicalPath];factoredOriginalSeconds=0,
  Print["OWN_ORIGINAL_ENDPOINT_CONTROL ",channel," ",factoredControlIndex];
  {factoredOriginalSeconds,factoredControl}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=factoredOriginalCache,softRows,referenceSeriesOrdinary},
    DownValues[softRows]=referenceSeriesParent["OriginalDefinitions"][[3]];
    referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_,index_]:=referenceOriginalOrdinary[component];
    assemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]]];
gate["accepted own complete original control",AssociationQ[factoredControl] && TrueQ[factoredControl["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredControl["InputHash"]===inputHash && And@@Values[factoredControl["Checks"]] &&
  KeyTake[factoredControl,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]===KeyTake[factoredTask,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]];
factoredProofPath=FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory,"s12_endpoint_comparison.wl"}];
factoredProof=If[FileExistsQ[factoredProofPath],Get[factoredProofPath],<||>];
If[Lookup[factoredProof,"Binding",None]=!=factoredControlBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[factoredProof,"Accepted",False]],
  {factoredControlSeconds,factoredControlValue}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=factoredCandidateCache},assemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]];
  gate["own factored full component accepted",AssociationQ[factoredControlValue] && TrueQ[factoredControlValue["Accepted"]] &&
    And@@Values[factoredControlValue["Checks"]]];
  gate["own complete ordinary unchanged",bounded[zeroCoefficient[factoredControlValue["Ordinary"]-factoredControl["Ordinary"]],"ordinary control"]];
  Do[
    gate["own complete branch assumptions unchanged",factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]===factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own complete branch "<>ToString[{sign,key}],bounded[zeroCoefficient[
      factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign][key]-factoredControl["Branches"][sign][key]],"endpoint own comparison"]],{key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
    factoredRows=factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    originalRows=factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own soft support unchanged",Length[factoredRows]===Length[originalRows] && (Take[#,2]&/@factoredRows)===(Take[#,2]&/@originalRows)];
    gate["own soft coefficients unchanged",And@@MapThread[bounded[zeroCoefficient[Last[#1]-Last[#2]],"own soft comparison"]&,{factoredRows,originalRows}]],
    {sign,{1,-1}}];
  factoredProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-factored-input-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,"Binding"->factoredControlBinding,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "RecoilProofHash"->FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],"ControlIndex"->factoredControlIndex,"ControlTaskHash"->Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
    "OriginalControl"->factoredControl,"CompleteControl"->factoredControlValue,"OriginalSeconds"->factoredOriginalSeconds,
    "ControlSeconds"->factoredControlSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  factoredSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[factoredProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded factored comparison output",StringLength[factoredSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact factored comparison reload",Get[factoredProofPath<>".tmp"]===factoredProof];
  RenameFile[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["complete own factored-input comparison accepted",TrueQ[factoredProof["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredProof["Binding"]===factoredControlBinding && factoredProof["ControlTaskHash"]===Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"] &&
  And@@Values[factoredProof["Checks"]]];
If[!FileExistsQ[factoredCanonicalPath],put[factoredProof["CompleteControl"],factoredCanonicalPath];
  gate["exact accepted own control reused",Get[factoredCanonicalPath]===factoredProof["CompleteControl"]]];
Print["OWN_FACTORED_INPUTS_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",InputForm[KeyTake[factoredProof,{"ControlIndex","OriginalSeconds","ControlSeconds"}]]];

referenceSeriesDistribute = "DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
referenceSeriesOutput = "put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
referenceSeriesChanges = {
  referenceSeriesDistribute -> (referenceSeriesDistribute <>
    "recoilData,rationalSeries,checkedRationalSeries,ordinaryMasterProduct,candidateOrdinary,zeroCoefficient,referenceSeriesOrdinary,referenceSeriesControlIndex,referenceSeriesControlHash,referenceSeriesControlValue,"),
  referenceSeriesOutput -> ("AssociateTo[result,{\"ReferenceSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,\"SHA256\"],\"OwnReferenceSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesStudyPath,\"SHA256\"],\"InputProjectionFootprint\"->referenceInputFootprint,\"FactoredInputComparisonHash\"->FileHash[factoredProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n" <> referenceSeriesOutput)};
gate["unique unchanged integration worker and output interfaces", And @@ (StringCount[referenceSeriesTail, First[#]] === 1 & /@ referenceSeriesChanges)];
referenceSeriesRunTail = StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail, referenceSeriesChanges];
gate["complete original integration tail retained", StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail, Reverse /@ referenceSeriesChanges] === referenceSeriesTail && SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesRunTail]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesRunTail, InputForm];
```

## common/s12_assemble_real_rational.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-383", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6291, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_rational.wls", "sha256": "25de9eb8201f602b83e3e6757adc8adf88c58e3583e01f5dfb1a9188ff836f6f"} -->
```wolfram
(* Original integration with the accepted own-channel rational master products. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
rationalDispatchPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_rational.wls"}];
rationalBaselinePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[rationalBaselinePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243", Quit[1]];
rationalText = Import[rationalBaselinePath, "Text"];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[rationalDispatchPath, "Text"]] || StringCount[rationalText, "\nslots="] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
rationalPrefix = First[StringSplit[rationalText, "\nslots="]];
rationalTail = "\nslots=" <> Last[StringSplit[rationalText, "\nslots="]];
rationalOldCall = "terms=KeyValueMap[Function[{m,c},epsilonSeries[(c/.D->4-2eps)regions[\"OrdinaryMasters\"][m],0,\n    \"ordinary cut coefficient\"]],coefficients];\n  ordinary=Total[terms];";
If[StringCount[rationalPrefix, rationalOldCall] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
rationalPrefix = StringReplace[rationalPrefix, rationalOldCall -> "ordinary=rationalOrdinary[component,index];"];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
rationalPrefix = StringReplace[rationalPrefix, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[rationalPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[rationalTail], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[rationalPrefix, InputForm];
rationalProofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_rational_series_result", "s12_result.wl"}];
rationalExpectedSHA = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_RATIONAL_PROOF_SHA256"];
gate["pinned own rational master comparison", StringQ[rationalExpectedSHA] &&
  IntegerString[FileHash[rationalProofPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === rationalExpectedSHA];
rationalReceipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[rationalProofPath], "s12_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
gate["successful own rational comparison receipt", TrueQ[rationalReceipt["passed"]] &&

rationalComparisonPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}];
rationalConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_rational_series_inputs.json"}];

  rationalProof["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash &&

gate["original endpoint and series equations unchanged", rationalProof["OriginalDefinitions"] ===

rationalPredicateStart = "\nzeroCoefficient[value_] := "; rationalPredicateEnd = "\ncheckedRationalSeries[";
```
