```wolfram
(* Reuse the pinned reference endpoint code only on its native polynomial support. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
referenceRecoilPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_reference_recoil.wls"}];
referenceRecoilBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_factored_series.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[referenceRecoilBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!="7bbecbad4109fd3a2cef0f1d69aeaf8e6050c488427327e941bcaa096be0b44f",Quit[1]];
referenceRecoilText=Import[referenceRecoilBase,"Text"];
referenceRecoilBoundary="\nreferenceSeriesDistribute =";
If[StringCount[referenceRecoilText,referenceRecoilBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[referenceRecoilPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
referenceRecoilPrefix=First[StringSplit[referenceRecoilText,referenceRecoilBoundary]];
referenceRecoilTail=referenceRecoilBoundary<>Last[StringSplit[referenceRecoilText,referenceRecoilBoundary]];
If[!SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilTail],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilPrefix,InputForm];
referenceRecoilReference=Import[referencePath,"Text"];
referenceRecoilStart="\nsoftRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_]";
referenceRecoilEnd="\nassemble[channel_,key_,component_,channelHash_]";
gate["unique pinned native reference endpoint definition",StringCount[referenceRecoilReference,referenceRecoilStart]===1 &&
  StringCount[referenceRecoilReference,referenceRecoilEnd]===1];
referenceRecoilDefinition=referenceRecoilStart<>First[StringSplit[
  Last[StringSplit[referenceRecoilReference,referenceRecoilStart]],referenceRecoilEnd]];
referenceRecoilConverted=StringReplace[referenceRecoilDefinition,{
  RegularExpression["\\bsoftRows\\b"]->"referenceNativeSoftRows",RegularExpression["\\bw\\b"]->"s23"}];
gate["exact reversible native endpoint conversion",SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilConverted] &&
  StringReplace[referenceRecoilConverted,{RegularExpression["\\breferenceNativeSoftRows\\b"]->"softRows",
  RegularExpression["\\bs23\\b"]->"w"}]===referenceRecoilDefinition];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilConverted,InputForm];
referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions=DownValues[softRows];
DownValues[referencePriorSoftRows]=referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions/.HoldPattern[softRows]->referencePriorSoftRows;
gate["exact original nonpolynomial endpoint fallback",
  (DownValues[referencePriorSoftRows]/.HoldPattern[referencePriorSoftRows]->softRows)===referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions];
referenceRecoilLastKey=None;referenceRecoilLastRational=0;
referenceRecoilNativeCount=0;referenceRecoilFallbackCount=0;
referenceRecoilRational[coefficient_,sign_] := Module[{key=Hash[{coefficient,sign},"SHA256"]},
  If[key=!=referenceRecoilLastKey,
    referenceRecoilLastRational=bounded[Cancel[coefficient/.t->sign omega-s],"native reference recoil input"];
    referenceRecoilLastKey=key];referenceRecoilLastRational];
referenceRecoilNativeCall="  rational=Cancel[coefficient/.t->sign omega-s];";
referenceRecoilCachedCall="  rational=referenceRecoilRational[coefficient,sign];";
gate["single native recoil input reuse boundary",StringCount[referenceRecoilConverted,referenceRecoilNativeCall]===1];
referenceRecoilCached=StringReplace[referenceRecoilConverted,referenceRecoilNativeCall->referenceRecoilCachedCall];
gate["all reference endpoint equations retained",SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilCached] &&
  StringReplace[referenceRecoilCached,referenceRecoilCachedCall->referenceRecoilNativeCall]===referenceRecoilConverted];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilCached,InputForm];
Clear[softRows];
softRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_] := Module[{rational,eligible,answer,seconds},
  rational=referenceRecoilRational[coefficient,sign];
  eligible=rational=!=0 && PolynomialQ[Numerator[rational],s23] && PolynomialQ[Denominator[rational],s23];
  {seconds,answer}=AbsoluteTiming[If[eligible,referenceRecoilNativeCount++;gate["native reference polynomial support accepted",True];referenceNativeSoftRows[coefficient,piece,sign],
    referenceRecoilFallbackCount++;referencePriorSoftRows[coefficient,piece,sign]]];
  Print["REFERENCE_RECOIL_ROW branch ",sign," polynomial ",eligible," input_bytes ",ByteCount[coefficient],
    " seconds ",seconds];answer];
referenceRecoilWorkerBoundary="recoilData,rationalSeries,";
referenceRecoilWorkerReplacement="referenceRecoilRational,referenceRecoilLastKey,referenceRecoilLastRational,referenceRecoilNativeCount,referenceRecoilFallbackCount,referenceNativeSoftRows,referencePriorSoftRows,recoilData,rationalSeries,";
referenceRecoilOutputBoundary="\\\"FactoredInputComparisonHash\\\"->FileHash[factoredProofPath,\\\"SHA256\\\"]";
referenceRecoilOutputReplacement=referenceRecoilOutputBoundary<>",\\\"ReferenceRecoilComparisonHash\\\"->FileHash[referenceRecoilProofPath,\\\"SHA256\\\"],\\\"ReferenceRecoilSourceHash\\\"->FileHash[referenceRecoilPath,\\\"SHA256\\\"]";
referenceRecoilChanges={referenceRecoilWorkerBoundary->referenceRecoilWorkerReplacement,
  referenceRecoilOutputBoundary->referenceRecoilOutputReplacement};
gate["unique remaining reference-recoil interfaces",And@@(StringCount[referenceRecoilTail,First[#]]===1&/@referenceRecoilChanges)];
referenceRecoilRun=StringReplace[referenceRecoilTail,referenceRecoilChanges];
gate["all remaining integration equations retained",SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilRun] &&
  StringReplace[referenceRecoilRun,Reverse/@referenceRecoilChanges]===referenceRecoilTail];
referenceRecoilDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_reference_recoil_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[referenceRecoilDirectory],CreateDirectory[referenceRecoilDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
referenceRecoilProofPath=FileNameJoin[{referenceRecoilDirectory,"s12_result.wl"}];
referenceRecoilBinding=Hash[{FileHash[referenceRecoilPath,"SHA256"],inputHash,
  FileHash[referencePath,"SHA256"],factoredControlBinding,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
referenceRecoilProof=If[FileExistsQ[referenceRecoilProofPath],Get[referenceRecoilProofPath],<||>];
referenceRecoilFresh=False;
If[Lookup[referenceRecoilProof,"Binding",None]=!=referenceRecoilBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[referenceRecoilProof,"Accepted",False]],
  referenceRecoilFresh=True;
  referenceRecoilControlCache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s12_reference_recoil",channel,IntegerString[referenceRecoilBinding,16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[referenceRecoilControlCache],CreateDirectory[referenceRecoilControlCache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
  {referenceRecoilSeconds,referenceRecoilControl}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=referenceRecoilControlCache},
    assemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]];
  gate["own complete reference-recoil component accepted",AssociationQ[referenceRecoilControl] &&
    TrueQ[referenceRecoilControl["Accepted"]] && referenceRecoilControl["InputHash"]===inputHash &&
    And@@Values[referenceRecoilControl["Checks"]]];
  gate["own comparison exercises native rational endpoint code",TrueQ[Lookup[referenceRecoilControl["Checks"],
    "native reference polynomial support accepted",False]]];
  gate["own reference-recoil ordinary unchanged",bounded[zeroCoefficient[
    referenceRecoilControl["Ordinary"]-factoredControl["Ordinary"]],"reference recoil ordinary comparison"]];
  Do[
    gate["own reference-recoil branch assumptions unchanged",referenceRecoilControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]===
      factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own reference-recoil distribution "<>ToString[{sign,key}],bounded[zeroCoefficient[
      referenceRecoilControl["Branches"][sign][key]-factoredControl["Branches"][sign][key]],"reference recoil distribution comparison"]],
      {key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
    referenceRecoilRows=referenceRecoilControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    referenceRecoilOldRows=factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own reference-recoil soft support unchanged",Length[referenceRecoilRows]===Length[referenceRecoilOldRows] &&
      (Take[#,2]&/@referenceRecoilRows)===(Take[#,2]&/@referenceRecoilOldRows)];
    gate["own reference-recoil soft values unchanged",And@@MapThread[bounded[zeroCoefficient[Last[#1]-Last[#2]],
      "reference recoil soft comparison"]&,{referenceRecoilRows,referenceRecoilOldRows}]],{sign,{1,-1}}];
  referenceRecoilProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-reference-recoil-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
    "Binding"->referenceRecoilBinding,"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[referenceRecoilPath,"SHA256"],"ReferenceHash"->FileHash[referencePath,"SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex"->factoredControlIndex,"ControlHash"->Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
    "OriginalControl"->factoredControl,"CompleteControl"->referenceRecoilControl,"ControlSeconds"->referenceRecoilSeconds,
    "NativeRows"->referenceRecoilNativeCount,"FallbackRows"->referenceRecoilFallbackCount,
    "OriginalDefinitions"->referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions,"NativeDefinition"->referenceRecoilDefinition,
    "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
  referenceRecoilSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[referenceRecoilProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded reference-recoil comparison",StringLength[referenceRecoilSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[referenceRecoilProofPath<>".tmp",referenceRecoilSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact reference-recoil comparison reload",Get[referenceRecoilProofPath<>".tmp"]===referenceRecoilProof];
  RenameFile[referenceRecoilProofPath<>".tmp",referenceRecoilProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["own complete reference-recoil comparison accepted",referenceRecoilProof["Binding"]===referenceRecoilBinding &&
  TrueQ[referenceRecoilProof["Accepted"]] && And@@Values[referenceRecoilProof["Checks"]]];
If[referenceRecoilFresh || !FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{referenceRecoilDirectory,"s12_checks.json"}]],
Export[FileNameJoin[{referenceRecoilDirectory,"s12_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "channel"->channel,"control_index"->referenceRecoilProof["ControlIndex"],
  "control_seconds"->referenceRecoilProof["ControlSeconds"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"]];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_RECOIL_COMPARISON_ONLY"]==="1",Print["PASS: s12_reference_recoil_comparison"];Quit[0]];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilRun,InputForm];
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse the executed standalone rational recurrence after an own-input comparison. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;

referenceSeriesBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243", Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesText = Import[referenceSeriesBase, "Text"];
referenceSeriesBoundary = "\nslots=";
If[StringCount[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary] =!= 1 ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[referenceSeriesPath, "Text"]], Print["FAIL: complete reference-series source syntax"]; Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesPrefix = First[StringSplit[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary]];
referenceSeriesTail = referenceSeriesBoundary <> Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesText, referenceSeriesBoundary]];
referenceSeriesOldCall = "terms=KeyValueMap[Function[{m,c},epsilonSeries[(c/.D->4-2eps)regions[\"OrdinaryMasters\"][m],0,\n    \"ordinary cut coefficient\"]],coefficients];\n  ordinary=Total[terms];";
If[StringCount[referenceSeriesPrefix, referenceSeriesOldCall] =!= 1 ||
  StringCount[referenceSeriesPrefix, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
referenceSeriesPrefix = StringReplace[referenceSeriesPrefix, {
  referenceSeriesOldCall -> "ordinary=referenceSeriesOrdinary[component,index];",
  "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "If[!MemberQ[$Packages,\"FeynCalc`\"],Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"}];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
If[!SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesTail], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesPrefix, InputForm];
referenceSeriesParentRelative = "Hqqbar/s12_rational_series_result/s12_result.wl";
referenceSeriesParentPath = FileNameJoin[{root, referenceSeriesParentRelative}];
referenceSeriesReceiptPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqqbar", "s12_rational_series_result", "s12_execution.json"}];
gate["pinned executed reference recurrence and receipt",
  IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "0724c147d2349bd44183ecb90936a56d1c7790f7ebd6dade58459cd0c1f8373a" &&
  IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesReceiptPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "406139892f2afcce55da23b0c374078dcc99e52d38166406fa06c7cdc2346874"];
referenceSeriesParent = Get[referenceSeriesParentPath];
referenceSeriesReceipt = Import[referenceSeriesReceiptPath, "RawJSON"];
referenceSeriesComparisonPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}];
gate["accepted reference recurrence with unchanged equations", TrueQ[referenceSeriesReceipt["passed"]] &&
  referenceSeriesReceipt["result_sha256"][referenceSeriesParentRelative] === IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-rational-master-product-comparison-v1" &&
  AssociationQ[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] && Length[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] > 0 &&
  And @@ Values[referenceSeriesParent["Checks"]] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["SourceHash"] === FileHash[referenceSeriesComparisonPath, "SHA256"] &&
  referenceSeriesParent["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash &&
  referenceSeriesParent["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  referenceSeriesParent["OriginalDefinitions"] === {DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct],
    DownValues[softRows], DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint]}];
referenceSeriesStandalonePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_result", "reference", "s12_standalone_rational_series.wls"}];
gate["same standalone reference implementation", referenceSeriesParent["ReferenceSourceHash"] === FileHash[referenceSeriesStandalonePath, "SHA256"]];
Do[gate["same accepted scalar master " <> stage,
  referenceSeriesParent["InputHashes"][library["Library"][stage]["File"]] === inputHashes[library["Library"][stage]["File"]]],
  {stage, {"s08", "s10", "s15"}}];
referenceSeriesComparisonText = Import[referenceSeriesComparisonPath, "Text"];
referenceSeriesPredicateStart = "\nzeroCoefficient[value_] := ";
referenceSeriesPredicateEnd = "\ncheckedRationalSeries[";
gate["unique executed recurrence predicate", StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateStart] === 1 &&
  StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateEnd] === 1];
referenceSeriesPredicate = referenceSeriesPredicateStart <>
  First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesComparisonText, referenceSeriesPredicateStart]], referenceSeriesPredicateEnd]];
gate["native recurrence predicate syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesPredicate]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesPredicate, InputForm];
DownValues[rationalSeries] = referenceSeriesParent["RationalDefinitions"];
DownValues[checkedRationalSeries] = referenceSeriesParent["CheckedRationalDefinitions"];
DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct] = referenceSeriesParent["ProductDefinitions"];
DownValues[candidateOrdinary] = referenceSeriesParent["CandidateDefinitions"];
gate["exact executed recurrence definitions installed",
  DownValues[rationalSeries] === referenceSeriesParent["RationalDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[checkedRationalSeries] === referenceSeriesParent["CheckedRationalDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct] === referenceSeriesParent["ProductDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[candidateOrdinary] === referenceSeriesParent["CandidateDefinitions"]];
referenceSeriesControlCode = "referenceOriginalOrdinary[component_] := Module[{coefficients,terms,ordinary},\n" <>
  "coefficients=Select[component[\"ReducedCoefficients\"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;\n" <>
  referenceSeriesOldCall <> "\nordinary];";
gate["original ordinary coefficient calculation syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesControlCode]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesControlCode, InputForm];
referenceSeriesIndices = Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]], # =!= 0 &] &];
gate["own nonzero ordinary control available", referenceSeriesIndices =!= {}];
referenceSeriesControlIndex = First[MinimalBy[referenceSeriesIndices,
  ByteCount[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]] &]];
referenceSeriesControl = mapped["Components"][[referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
referenceSeriesControlHash = Hash[referenceSeriesControl, "SHA256"];
referenceSeriesStudyDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_reference_series_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory], CreateDirectory[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
referenceSeriesStudyPath = FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
referenceSeriesStudy = If[FileExistsQ[referenceSeriesStudyPath], Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath], <||>];
referenceSeriesBinding = Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], inputHash,
  FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], referenceSeriesControlHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
If[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Binding", None] === referenceSeriesBinding &&

  Length[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]],

  ClearSystemCache[];
  {referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, referenceSeriesControlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl, referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
  gate["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced", bounded[
    zeroCoefficient[Expand[referenceSeriesControlValue - referenceSeriesOriginalValue, eps]], "own ordinary reference comparison"]];
  referenceSeriesStudy = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-own-reference-series-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "Binding" -> referenceSeriesBinding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SourceHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], "ParentProofHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex" -> referenceSeriesControlIndex, "ControlHash" -> referenceSeriesControlHash,
    "ControlCoefficients" -> referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"], "CandidateValue" -> referenceSeriesControlValue,
    "OriginalValue" -> referenceSeriesOriginalValue, "OriginalSeconds" -> referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds,
    "CandidateSeconds" -> referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  referenceSeriesSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[referenceSeriesStudy], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded own recurrence comparison output", StringLength[referenceSeriesSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesSerialized, "Text"];
  gate["exact own recurrence comparison reload", Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp"] === referenceSeriesStudy];
  RenameFile[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesStudyPath, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
gate["own reference recurrence comparison accepted", TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Accepted"]] &&
  TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced"]]];
Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_ACCEPTED ", channel, " ", InputForm[KeyTake[referenceSeriesStudy,
  {"ControlIndex", "OriginalSeconds", "CandidateSeconds"}]]];
referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_, index_] := If[index === referenceSeriesControlIndex,
  gate["reused own ordinary coefficient exact task", Hash[component, "SHA256"] === referenceSeriesControlHash];
  referenceSeriesControlValue, candidateOrdinary[component, index]];
referenceSeriesDistribute = "DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
referenceSeriesOutput = "put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
referenceSeriesChanges = {
  referenceSeriesDistribute -> (referenceSeriesDistribute <>
    "rationalSeries,checkedRationalSeries,ordinaryMasterProduct,candidateOrdinary,zeroCoefficient,referenceSeriesOrdinary,referenceSeriesControlIndex,referenceSeriesControlHash,referenceSeriesControlValue,"),
  referenceSeriesOutput -> ("AssociateTo[result,{\"ReferenceSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,\"SHA256\"],\"OwnReferenceSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesStudyPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n" <> referenceSeriesOutput)};
gate["unique unchanged integration worker and output interfaces", And @@ (StringCount[referenceSeriesTail, First[#]] === 1 & /@ referenceSeriesChanges)];
referenceSeriesRunTail = StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail, referenceSeriesChanges];
gate["complete original integration tail retained", StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail, Reverse /@ referenceSeriesChanges] === referenceSeriesTail && SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesRunTail]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesRunTail, InputForm];
```

## common/s12_assemble_real_regulator.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-386", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3415, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_regulator.wls", "sha256": "13546e04edf3441fa2a10bb9ae2b2dbfa406c67598f68a517955eabd1233ac4a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Use the verified regulator series in the unchanged real-integration pipeline. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
regulatorDispatchPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_regulator.wls"}];
regulatorBaselinePath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[regulatorBaselinePath,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243",Quit[1]];
regulatorText=Import[regulatorBaselinePath,"Text"];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[regulatorDispatchPath,"Text"]]||StringCount[regulatorText,"\nslots="]=!=1,Quit[1]];
regulatorBoundary=First[First[StringPosition[regulatorText,"\nslots="]]];
regulatorPrefix=StringTake[regulatorText,regulatorBoundary-1];
regulatorTail=StringDrop[regulatorText,regulatorBoundary-1];
regulatorOldCall="epsilonSeries[(c/.D->4-2eps)regions[\"OrdinaryMasters\"][m],0,";
If[StringCount[regulatorPrefix,regulatorOldCall]=!=1,Quit[1]];
regulatorPrefix=StringReplace[regulatorPrefix,regulatorOldCall->
  "regulatorMasterSeries[c,regions[\"OrdinaryMasters\"][m],0,"];
If[!SyntaxQ[regulatorPrefix]||!SyntaxQ[regulatorTail],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[regulatorPrefix,InputForm];
regulatorProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_regulator_result","s12_result.wl"}];
regulatorReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_regulator_result","s12_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted regulator comparison receipt",TrueQ[regulatorReceipt["passed"]]&&
  regulatorReceipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s12_regulator_result/s12_result.wl"]===
    IntegerString[FileHash[regulatorProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
regulatorProof=Get[regulatorProofPath];
gate["accepted complete regulator comparison",
  regulatorProof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-regulator-series-check-v1"&&
  TrueQ[regulatorProof["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[regulatorProof["Checks"]]&&
  Lookup[regulatorProof["ControlRows"],"Index"]===Range[6]];
gate["regulator comparison source and native version",
  regulatorProof["OriginalSourceHash"]===sourceHash&&regulatorProof["NativeVersion"]===$Version&&
  regulatorProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_check_regulator_series.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
gate["regulator comparison exact production inputs",channel==="Hqqprime"&&
  regulatorProof["Channel"]===channel&&regulatorProof["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
  regulatorProof["InputHashes"]===inputHashes];
DownValues[regulatorMasterSeries]=regulatorProof["Definitions"];
gate["executed regulator series installed",DownValues[regulatorMasterSeries]===regulatorProof["Definitions"]];
regulatorDistribute="DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
regulatorOutput="put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
gate["unique unchanged worker and output interfaces",
  StringCount[regulatorTail,regulatorDistribute]===1&&StringCount[regulatorTail,regulatorOutput]===1];
regulatorProgram=StringReplace[regulatorTail,{
  regulatorDistribute->"DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,regulatorMasterSeries,",
  regulatorOutput->("result=Join[result,<|\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[regulatorDispatchPath,\"SHA256\"],"<>
    "\"RegulatorComparisonHash\"->FileHash[regulatorProofPath,\"SHA256\"]|>];\n"<>regulatorOutput)}];
gate["complete regulator integration syntax",SyntaxQ[regulatorProgram]];
ToExpression[regulatorProgram,InputForm];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-387", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8979, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_retained_series.wls", "sha256": "ebbb1a516ab4852aa1cbe0c328c4b4303cce46641369614c33eaa0a906d4bab1"} -->
```wolfram
(* Keep the standalone recurrence and check its required residual coefficients directly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
retainedPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_retained_series.wls"}];
retainedBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_transverse_endpoint.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[retainedBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "c35d4ac121e8a962a986ba07670971ed78e5ac5d6a7daae4be5fb51fb207f3c7",Quit[1]];
retainedBaseText=Import[retainedBase,"Text"];
retainedBoundary="\nreferenceSeriesTail=transverseOutputTail;\nToExpression[transverseEndpointRun,InputForm];";
If[StringCount[retainedBaseText,retainedBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[retainedPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[retainedBaseText,retainedBoundary]],InputForm];
retainedOriginalDefinitions=DownValues[checkedRationalSeries];
retainedStart="\ncheckedRationalSeries[";retainedEnd="\nordinaryMasterProduct[";
gate["unique original rational check definition",StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText,retainedStart]===1 &&
  StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText,retainedEnd]===1];
retainedDefinition=retainedStart<>First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesComparisonText,retainedStart]],retainedEnd]];
gate["original rational check syntax",SyntaxQ[retainedDefinition]];
ToExpression[retainedDefinition,InputForm];
gate["same accepted rational check implementation",DownValues[checkedRationalSeries]===retainedOriginalDefinitions];
retainedChanges={
  "  If[!bounded[zeroCoefficient[residual], \"rational numerator zero identity\"],"->"  If[residual =!= 0,",
  "    gate[\"integer rational identity coverage\", IntegerQ[first] && IntegerQ[last]];\n    gate[\"complete truncated rational numerator reconstruction\", And @@ Table[\n      bounded[zeroCoefficient[Coefficient[residual, eps, power]], \"rational residual coefficient\"], {power, first, last}]]];"->
    "    If[IntegerQ[first] && IntegerQ[last],\n      gate[\"integer rational identity coverage\", True];\n      gate[\"complete truncated rational numerator reconstruction\", And @@ Table[\n        bounded[zeroCoefficient[Coefficient[residual, eps, power]], \"rational residual coefficient\"], {power, first, last}]],\n      gate[\"reference exact zero for empty regulator support\",\n        bounded[zeroCoefficient[residual], \"rational numerator zero identity\"]]]];",
  "first, last, seconds},"->"first, last, seconds, checkStarted=AbsoluteTime[]},",
  "  value];"->"  Print[\"RETAINED_SERIES_CHECK \",description,\" total_seconds \",AbsoluteTime[]-checkStarted,\" residual_bytes \",ByteCount[residual]];\n  value];"};
gate["unique retained-check interfaces",And@@(StringCount[retainedDefinition,First[#]]===1&/@retainedChanges)];
retainedCandidateDefinition=StringReplace[retainedDefinition,retainedChanges];
gate["unchanged recurrence and retained identities",SyntaxQ[retainedCandidateDefinition] &&
  StringReplace[retainedCandidateDefinition,Reverse/@retainedChanges]===retainedDefinition];
ToExpression[retainedCandidateDefinition,InputForm];
retainedControlPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_0043.wl"}];
gate["bound own accepted ordinary control",IntegerString[FileHash[retainedControlPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "124fb11cb9867052bd0229f19f9a8e869679e3f1b9119203f6781bc464f85471"];
retainedControl=Get[retainedControlPath];
gate["accepted own control input and checks",TrueQ[retainedControl["Accepted"]] &&
  retainedControl["InputHash"]===inputHash && And@@Values[retainedControl["Checks"]]];
retainedIdentity={"Sector","Kind","Index"};
retainedControlIndex=First[FirstPosition[KeyTake[#,retainedIdentity]&/@mapped["Components"],
  KeyTake[retainedControl,retainedIdentity]]];
retainedTask=mapped["Components"][[retainedControlIndex]];
retainedDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_retained_series_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[retainedDirectory],CreateDirectory[retainedDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
retainedProofPath=FileNameJoin[{retainedDirectory,"s12_result.wl"}];
retainedBinding=Hash[{FileHash[retainedPath,"SHA256"],FileHash[retainedBase,"SHA256"],
  FileHash[retainedControlPath,"SHA256"],Hash[retainedTask,"SHA256"],inputHash,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
retainedProof=If[FileExistsQ[retainedProofPath],Get[retainedProofPath],<||>];
If[Lookup[retainedProof,"Binding",None]=!=retainedBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[retainedProof,"Accepted",False]],
  retainedResidualPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_retained_residual_result","s12_result.wl"}];
  gate["bound actual empty-support regression input",IntegerString[FileHash[retainedResidualPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
    "6cdf81ba17c53cd39c35a383ac8bae3edfb0a4ba5da07cc789a5dbe921704c4f"];
  retainedResidual=Get[retainedResidualPath];
  retainedRegressionTask=mapped["Components"][[retainedResidual["ComponentIndex"]]];
  gate["actual regression component unchanged",retainedResidual["InputHash"]===inputHash &&
    retainedResidual["ComponentHash"]===Hash[retainedRegressionTask,"SHA256"]];
  retainedRegressionRows=Select[retainedResidual["Rows"],!IntegerQ[#["First"]] || !IntegerQ[#["Last"]]&];
  gate["actual empty-support case covered",Length[retainedRegressionRows]>0];
  retainedRegression=Table[
    retainedRegressionMaster=retainedRegressionRow["Master"];
    retainedRegressionCoefficient=(retainedRegressionTask["ReducedCoefficients"][retainedRegressionMaster]/.transverseRule)/.D->4-2eps;
    retainedRegressionOrder=-Exponent[Expand[Normal[regions["OrdinaryMasters"][retainedRegressionMaster]],eps],eps,Min];
    gate["actual regression depth unchanged",retainedRegressionOrder===retainedRegressionRow["Order"]];
    retainedRegressionValue=checkedRationalSeries[retainedRegressionCoefficient,retainedRegressionOrder,
      {retainedResidual["ComponentIndex"],retainedRegressionMaster}];
    retainedRegressionOriginal=Block[{checkedRationalSeries},ToExpression[retainedDefinition,InputForm];
      checkedRationalSeries[retainedRegressionCoefficient,retainedRegressionOrder,"original empty-support case"]];
    gate["actual empty-support output exactly matches reference",retainedRegressionValue===retainedRegressionOriginal];
    <|"Master"->retainedRegressionMaster,"Order"->retainedRegressionOrder,
      "Original"->retainedRegressionOriginal,"Candidate"->retainedRegressionValue|>,
    {retainedRegressionRow,retainedRegressionRows}];
  {retainedSeconds,retainedValue}=AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[retainedTask,retainedControlIndex]];
  gate["entire own ordinary coefficient exactly unchanged",retainedValue===retainedControl["Ordinary"] ||
    bounded[zeroCoefficient[Expand[retainedValue-retainedControl["Ordinary"],eps]],"own retained-series comparison"]];
  retainedProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-retained-series-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[retainedPath,"SHA256"],"BaseSourceHash"->FileHash[retainedBase,"SHA256"],
    "Binding"->retainedBinding,"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "ControlIndex"->retainedControlIndex,"ControlHash"->FileHash[retainedControlPath,"SHA256"],
    "ControlTaskHash"->Hash[retainedTask,"SHA256"],"OriginalOrdinary"->retainedControl["Ordinary"],
    "CandidateOrdinary"->retainedValue,"CandidateSeconds"->retainedSeconds,
    "EmptySupportInputHash"->FileHash[retainedResidualPath,"SHA256"],"EmptySupportRegression"->retainedRegression,
    "OriginalDefinitions"->retainedOriginalDefinitions,"CandidateDefinitions"->DownValues[checkedRationalSeries],
    "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  retainedSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[retainedProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded retained-series proof",StringLength[retainedSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[retainedProofPath<>".tmp",retainedSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact retained-series proof reload",Get[retainedProofPath<>".tmp"]===retainedProof];
  RenameFile[retainedProofPath<>".tmp",retainedProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["complete retained-series comparison accepted",retainedProof["Binding"]===retainedBinding &&
  TrueQ[retainedProof["Accepted"]] && And@@Values[retainedProof["Checks"]]];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_RETAINED_COMPARISON_ONLY"]==="1",Print["PASS: s12_retained_series_comparison"];Quit[0]];
retainedOutputNeedle="put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
retainedOutputReplacement="AssociateTo[result,{\"RetainedSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[retainedPath,\"SHA256\"],\"RetainedSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[retainedProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n"<>retainedOutputNeedle;
gate["single retained-series output interface",StringCount[transverseOutputTail,retainedOutputNeedle]===1];
referenceSeriesTail=StringReplace[transverseOutputTail,retainedOutputNeedle->retainedOutputReplacement];
gate["unchanged remaining integration equations",SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesTail] &&
  StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail,retainedOutputReplacement->retainedOutputNeedle]===transverseOutputTail];
ToExpression[transverseEndpointRun,InputForm];

```

## common/s12_assemble_real_spin.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-388", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 14518, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_spin.wls", "sha256": "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243"} -->
```wolfram
(* Integrate the spin tensors with the pinned GitHub cut-master assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0; root=Directory[];
sourcePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"]; checks=<||>;
gate[name_,test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,name],Print["PASS: ",name]];AssociateTo[checks,name->True],
  Print["FAIL: ",name];If[TrueQ[$KernelID>0],Throw[$Failed,"S12Failure"],CloseKernels[];Quit[1]]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath,"Text"]]];
put[value_,file_] := (Put[value,file<>".tmp"];RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True]);
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[label<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,gate[label<>" memory limit",False]];
configPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_inputs.json"}];
config=Import[configPath,"RawJSON"];
referencePath=FileNameJoin[{root,config["reference_source"]}];
gate["pinned GitHub real assembly",IntegerString[FileHash[referencePath,"SHA256"],16,64]===config["reference_sha256"]];
mapPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s08_result","s08_result.wl"}];
libraryPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s06_result","s06_result.wl"}];
mapped=Get[mapPath];library=Get[libraryPath];
gate["accepted real scalar map",mapped["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-real-scalar-map-v1"&&
  mapped["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[mapped["MappingAccepted"]]&&And@@Values[mapped["Checks"]]];
gate["complete real reduction coverage",TrueQ[mapped["ReductionCoverageComplete"]]&&mapped["MissingTargets"]==={}];
gate["accepted unchanged scalar library",library["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1"&&And@@Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row,path},row=library["Library"][stage];path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["File"]}];
  gate[stage<>" unchanged scalar input",IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["SHA256"]];Get[path]];
inputsOriginal=readLibrary["s08"];evaluationsOriginal=readLibrary["s10"];regionsOriginal=readLibrary["s15"];
gate["accepted cut values and regions",TrueQ[inputsOriginal["AcceptedRepresentations"]]&&
  TrueQ[evaluationsOriginal["CutNormalizationAccepted"]]&&TrueQ[regionsOriginal["AcceptedCutMasterRegions"]]];
Do[stage=StringTake[key,3];
  gate["region input identity "<>key,KeyExistsQ[library["Library"],stage]&&
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,library["Library"][stage]["File"]}],"SHA256"]===regionsOriginal["InputHashes"][key]],
  {key,{"s08_result.wl","s10_result.wl"}}];
(* The region receipt also binds the old unpolarized coefficient manifest.
   New spin coefficients establish their own expansion depth below. *)
regionCoefficientProvenance=regionsOriginal["InputHashes"]["s11_result.wl"];
gate["recorded scalar coordinate conversion",mapped["ScalarConventionRules"]==={Q2->Q^2,w->s23}];
inputs=inputsOriginal/.mapped["ScalarConventionRules"];
evaluations=evaluationsOriginal/.mapped["ScalarConventionRules"];
regions=regionsOriginal/.mapped["ScalarConventionRules"];
gate["every required master has its unchanged value",Complement[
  Union[Flatten[Keys[#["ReducedCoefficients"]]&/@mapped["Components"]]],Keys[regions["OrdinaryMasters"]]]==={}];
sourceHash=FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"];
inputPaths=Join[{configPath,referencePath,mapPath,libraryPath},
  FileNameJoin[{root,library["Library"][#]["File"]}]&/@{"s08","s10","s15"}];
inputHashes=Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@inputPaths];
inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,inputHashes,$Version},"SHA256"];
cache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s12",channel,IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache],CreateDirectory[cache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
transverseRule=mapped["TransverseSubstitution"];
branchAssumptions[sign_] := Q>0&&s>0&&omega>0&&B>0&&
  -Q^2-s<sign omega-s<0&&SUNN>1&&Nc>1;
reduce[value_,assumptions_] := Module[{refined,functions},
  refined=Refine[value,assumptions];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[refined,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  Collect[Expand[refined],functions,Factor]];
epsilonSeries[value_,order_,label_] := Module[{series},
  series=bounded[Series[value,{eps,0,order}],label];
  gate[label<>" regulator coverage",FreeQ[series,eps|_SeriesData|_Series]||(MatchQ[series,_SeriesData]&&series[[5]]>order)];
  Normal[series]];
endpointIntegral=Integrate[rr^(-1-kap ep),{rr,0,B},
  Assumptions->kap>0&&ep<0&&B>0,GenerateConditions->False];
gate["regulated endpoint integral evaluated",FreeQ[endpointIntegral,_Integrate|_ConditionalExpression]];
logKernel=Normal[Series[Exp[-kap ep ellLog],{ep,0,2}]];
laurentProduct[laurent_,kernel_,order_] := Module[{polynomial=Expand[laurent],first,last},
  If[polynomial===0,Return[0]];
  first=Exponent[polynomial,eps,Min];last=Exponent[polynomial,eps];
  Total@Table[eps^n Coefficient[polynomial,eps,n] Normal[Series[kernel,{eps,0,order-n}]],{n,first,last}]];

softPieces[master_,sign_] := softPieces[master,sign]=Module[
  {data,metadata,assumptions,replacement,power,prefactor,value,pieces={},entry,
   definition,parameterRules,lambdaForm,lambdaPower,lambdaRegular,totalPower,regular},
  data=inputs["Masters"][master];metadata=regions["Masters"][master];
  assumptions=branchAssumptions[sign]&&s23>0;
  replacement=t->sign omega-s;
  power=metadata["PrefactorSoftPower"];
  prefactor=bounded[FullSimplify[(data["RegulatedPrefactor"]/s23^power)/.replacement,
    assumptions&&Element[eps,Reals]],"remove regulated cut recoil power"];
  If[metadata["DivergentParameters"]==={},
    value=(evaluations["Classes"][data["Class"]]["Series"]/.SubTropica`eps->eps)/.
      data["PhysicalSubstitutions"]/.replacement;
    Return[{<|"Power"->power,"Regular"->prefactor value|>}]];
  definition=regions["RegionMasterMap"][master]["ParameterDefinition"];
  parameterRules=Solve[First[definition]==Last[definition],SubTropica`\[Lambda]];
  gate["unique physical soft-region parameter",Length[parameterRules]===1];
  lambdaForm=Factor[SubTropica`\[Lambda]/.First[parameterRules]/.data["PhysicalSubstitutions"]/.replacement];
  lambdaPower=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[s23 D[lambdaForm,s23]/lambdaForm,s23->0,
    Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],"region recoil valuation"];
  gate["region recoil valuation is a positive integer",IntegerQ[lambdaPower]&&lambdaPower>0];
  lambdaRegular=Factor[lambdaForm/s23^lambdaPower];
  gate["region expansion remains on its positive physical side",
    FullSimplify[Limit[lambdaRegular,s23->0,Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]]>0,
      branchAssumptions[sign]]];
  Do[
    value=regions["RegionValues"][entry["IntegralID"]]["Series"];
    If[value===0,Continue[]];
    totalPower=Expand[power+lambdaPower(entry["LambdaPower"]/.SubTropica`eps->eps)];
    regular=prefactor lambdaRegular^(entry["LambdaPower"]/.SubTropica`eps->eps) value;
    AppendTo[pieces,<|"Power"->totalPower,"Regular"->regular,"Region"->entry["Region"]|>],
    {entry,regions["RegionMasterMap"][master]["Entries"]}];pieces];

pieceEndpoint[piece_,sign_] := pieceEndpoint[piece,sign]=bounded[
  FullSimplify[Limit[piece["Regular"],s23->0,Direction->"FromAbove",
    Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]&&Element[eps,Reals]],
    branchAssumptions[sign]&&Element[eps,Reals]],"regular master endpoint"];
softRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_] := Module[
  {power=piece["Power"],integerPower,kappa,rational,valuation,firstPower,leading,value},
  integerPower=power/.eps->0;kappa=-Coefficient[power,eps];
  gate["regulated soft power is affine with integer recoil degree",
    IntegerQ[integerPower]&&PolynomialQ[power,eps]&&Exponent[power,eps]<=1];
  rational=Cancel[coefficient/.t->sign omega-s];
  valuation=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[s23 D[rational,s23]/rational,s23->0,
    Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],
    "spin coefficient recoil valuation"];
  gate["spin coefficient has integer recoil valuation",IntegerQ[valuation]];
  firstPower=valuation+integerPower;
  If[firstPower>=0,Return[{}]];
  gate["measured recoil degree needs only a leading endpoint coefficient",firstPower===-1];
  leading=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[s23^(-valuation)rational,s23->0,
    Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],
    "physical spin endpoint coefficient"];
  gate["rational endpoint coefficient is finite",FreeQ[leading,s23|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity|_DirectedInfinity]];
  value=epsilonSeries[(leading/.D->4-2eps)pieceEndpoint[piece,sign],1,"leading soft epsilon coefficient"];
  value=bounded[reduce[value,branchAssumptions[sign]],"leading endpoint collection"];
  gate["endpoint coefficients are fully evaluated",FreeQ[value,s23|_Limit|_Derivative|_Series|_SeriesData|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
  If[value===0,{},{{kappa,firstPower,value}}]];

assemble[component_,index_] := Catch[Block[{checks=<||>},Module[
  {file,saved,coefficients,ordinary,terms,branches,rows,groups,combined,assumptions,
   endpoints,delta,plus,regular,result,master,started=AbsoluteTime[]},
  file=FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[index,10,4]<>".wl"}];
  saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];
  If[Lookup[saved,"InputHash",None]===inputHash&&TrueQ[Lookup[saved,"Accepted",False]],Return[saved]];
  Print["REAL_ASSEMBLY ",channel," ",index," ",component["Sector"]," ",component["Kind"]," ",component["Index"]];
  coefficients=Select[component["ReducedCoefficients"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;
  gate["physical transverse coordinate inserted",FreeQ[coefficients,First[transverseRule]]];
  terms=KeyValueMap[Function[{m,c},epsilonSeries[(c/.D->4-2eps)regions["OrdinaryMasters"][m],0,
    "ordinary cut coefficient"]],coefficients];
  ordinary=Total[terms];
  gate["ordinary cut contraction is symbolic and evaluated",FreeQ[ordinary,
    _CutIntegral|_SeriesData|_Series|_Integrate|_Missing|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
  branches=Association@Table[
    Print["REAL_ENDPOINT ",channel," ",index," branch ",sign];
    assumptions=branchAssumptions[sign];rows={};
    Do[rows=Join[rows,Flatten[softRows[coefficients[master],#,sign]&/@softPieces[master,sign],1]],
      {master,Keys[coefficients]}];
    groups=GatherBy[rows,Take[#,2]&];
    combined=Table[{group[[1,1]],group[[1,2]],bounded[reduce[Total[group[[All,3]]],assumptions],
      "combine recoil coefficients"]},{group,groups}];
    Do[If[row[[2]]<-1,gate["stronger recoil singularities cancel",
      bounded[FullSimplify[row[[3]],assumptions],"stronger recoil cancellation"]===0]],{row,combined}];
    endpoints=Select[combined,#[[2]]===-1&&Last[#]=!=0&];
    gate["endpoint regulator has the defining convergence orientation",And@@(TrueQ[#[[1]]>0]&/@endpoints)];
    delta=bounded[reduce[Total[laurentProduct[#[[3]],endpointIntegral/.{kap->#[[1]],ep->eps},0]&/@endpoints],
      assumptions],"delta coefficient"];
    plus=Table[bounded[reduce[Total[laurentProduct[#[[3]],B^(-#[[1]]eps)
      (Coefficient[logKernel,ellLog,n]/.{kap->#[[1]],ep->eps}),0]&/@endpoints],assumptions],
      "plus coefficient"],{n,0,2}];
    gate["no higher logarithmic plus distribution survives",Factor[plus[[3]]]===0];
    regular=(ordinary/.t->sign omega-s)-Total[laurentProduct[#[[3]],s23^(-1-#[[1]]eps),0]&/@endpoints];
    sign-><|"Delta"->delta,"L0"->plus[[1]],"L1"->plus[[2]],"Regular"->regular,
      "SoftCoefficients"->endpoints,"Assumptions"->assumptions|>,{sign,{1,-1}}];
  result=Join[KeyTake[component,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}],<|"Ordinary"->ordinary,"Branches"->branches,
    "InputHash"->inputHash,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"ElapsedSeconds"->AbsoluteTime[]-started|>];
  put[result,file];ClearSystemCache[];Print["REAL_ASSEMBLY_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",index];result]],"S12Failure"];
slots=Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]],1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots]||slots<1,slots=1];CloseKernels[];
If[slots>1,TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost","KernelCommand"->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel","KernelCount"->Min[4,slots],"TimeConstraint"->60]],60,$Failed]];
workers=Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers>0,
  gate["workers share compute allocation",And@@(SameQ[#, $MachineName]&/@ParallelEvaluate[$MachineName])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength=0;checks=<||>;
    PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
    $FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,
    softPieces,pieceEndpoint,softRows,assemble,root,inputHash,sourceHash,inputs,evaluations,regions,
    endpointIntegral,logKernel,cache,channel,transverseRule]];
$DistributedContexts=None;
tasks=MapIndexed[{#1,First[#2]}&,mapped["Components"]];
values=If[workers>0,ParallelMap[assemble@@#&,tasks,Method->"FinestGrained"],assemble@@#&/@tasks];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all real spin components integrated",FreeQ[values,$Failed|$Aborted]&&Length[values]===Length[tasks]&&
  AllTrue[values,AssociationQ]&&And@@Lookup[values,"Accepted"]];
gate["all component checks accepted",And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@values]];
result=Join[KeyTake[mapped,{"Channel","Bookkeeping","PhotonLabels","SpinLabels","IndexOrder",
  "CutMomenta","CutEnergySupport","Gamma5Scheme","CouplingsRemoved"}],
  <|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-real-distributions-v1","Components"->values,
    "Measure"->inputs["MasterMeasure"],"PlusDefinition"->"Ln=[Log[s23/B]^n/s23]_+ on [0,B]",
    "BranchMap"->(t->sign omega-s),"Regulator"->eps,"CutMeasureIntegrated"->True,
    "MasterExpansionDepthChecked"->True,"PhaseAndWeightsApplied"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False,
    "RegionReferenceCoefficientHash"->regionCoefficientProvenance,
    "SourceHash"->sourceHash,"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"Checks"->checks|>];
resultDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir],CreateDirectory[resultDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,"s12_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir,"s12_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,
  "component_count"->Length[values],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s12_assemble_real_spin"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s12_assemble_real_symbolic_transverse.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-389", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4311, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_symbolic_transverse.wls", "sha256": "34e832952e9c85462a216c6d5e8a112d9d0ad46132ee2adda08f03c0b952290b"} -->
```wolfram
(* Retain the native transverse coordinate until after the regulator recurrence. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
symbolicPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_symbolic_transverse.wls"}];
symbolicBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_retained_series.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[symbolicBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "ebbb1a516ab4852aa1cbe0c328c4b4303cce46641369614c33eaa0a906d4bab1",Quit[1]];
symbolicBaseText=Import[symbolicBase,"Text"];
symbolicBoundary="\nretainedControlPath=";
If[StringCount[symbolicBaseText,symbolicBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[symbolicPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[symbolicBaseText,symbolicBoundary]],InputForm];
symbolicOriginalOrdinary=DownValues[candidateOrdinary];
DownValues[symbolicPriorOrdinary]=symbolicOriginalOrdinary/.HoldPattern[candidateOrdinary]->symbolicPriorOrdinary;
gate["prior ordinary caller retained exactly",(DownValues[symbolicPriorOrdinary]/.HoldPattern[symbolicPriorOrdinary]->candidateOrdinary)===symbolicOriginalOrdinary];
Clear[candidateOrdinary];
candidateOrdinary[component_,index_] := Module[{coefficients,ordinary,value,seconds},
  coefficients=Select[component["ReducedCoefficients"],#=!=0&];
  gate["transverse substitution independent of regulator",FreeQ[Last[transverseRule],eps|D]];
  gate["ordinary masters independent of transverse placeholder",And@@
    (FreeQ[regions["OrdinaryMasters"][#],First[transverseRule]]&/@Keys[coefficients])];
  {seconds,ordinary}=AbsoluteTiming[Total[KeyValueMap[ordinaryMasterProduct[#2/.D->4-2eps,
    regions["OrdinaryMasters"][#1],0,{index,#1}]&,coefficients]]];
  value=ordinary/.transverseRule;
  gate["physical transverse coordinate restored after recurrence",FreeQ[value,First[transverseRule]]];
  Print["SYMBOLIC_TRANSVERSE_ORDINARY ",index," seconds ",seconds,
    " symbolic_input_bytes ",ByteCount[coefficients]," physical_input_bytes ",ByteCount[coefficients/.transverseRule],
    " symbolic_output_bytes ",ByteCount[ordinary]," physical_output_bytes ",ByteCount[value]];
  value];
symbolicRegressionCode="  symbolicRegression=Table[\n"<>
  "    symbolicRegressionTask=Join[retainedRegressionTask,<|\"ReducedCoefficients\"->KeyTake[retainedRegressionTask[\"ReducedCoefficients\"],{symbolicRegressionRow[\"Master\"]}]|>];\n"<>
  "    symbolicRegressionOriginal=symbolicPriorOrdinary[symbolicRegressionTask,retainedResidual[\"ComponentIndex\"]];\n"<>
  "    symbolicRegressionValue=candidateOrdinary[symbolicRegressionTask,retainedResidual[\"ComponentIndex\"]];\n"<>
  "    gate[\"deferred substitution matches actual empty-support product\",symbolicRegressionValue===symbolicRegressionOriginal || bounded[zeroCoefficient[Expand[symbolicRegressionValue-symbolicRegressionOriginal,eps]],\"actual deferred substitution comparison\"]];\n"<>
  "    <|\"Master\"->symbolicRegressionRow[\"Master\"],\"Original\"->symbolicRegressionOriginal,\"Candidate\"->symbolicRegressionValue|>,\n"<>
  "    {symbolicRegressionRow,retainedRegressionRows}];\n";
symbolicTail=symbolicBoundary<>Last[StringSplit[symbolicBaseText,symbolicBoundary]];
symbolicChanges={
  "\"s12_retained_series_result\""->"\"s12_symbolic_transverse_result\"",
  "  {retainedSeconds,retainedValue}="->(symbolicRegressionCode<>"  {retainedSeconds,retainedValue}="),
  "\"polarized-sidis-retained-series-comparison-v1\""->"\"polarized-sidis-symbolic-transverse-comparison-v1\"",
  "    \"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\"Checks\"->checks,\"Accepted\"->True|>;"->
    "    \"OrdinaryDefinitions\"->DownValues[candidateOrdinary],\"DeferredSubstitutionRegression\"->symbolicRegression,\n    \"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\"Checks\"->checks,\"Accepted\"->True|>;",
  "PASS: s12_retained_series_comparison"->"PASS: s12_symbolic_transverse_comparison",
  "RetainedSeriesSourceHash"->"SymbolicTransverseSourceHash",
  "RetainedSeriesComparisonHash"->"SymbolicTransverseComparisonHash"};
gate["unique symbolic transverse interfaces",And@@(StringCount[symbolicTail,First[#]]===1&/@symbolicChanges)];
symbolicRun=StringReplace[symbolicTail,symbolicChanges];
gate["unchanged integration and comparison gates",SyntaxQ[symbolicRun] &&
  StringReplace[symbolicRun,Reverse/@symbolicChanges]===symbolicTail];
retainedPath=symbolicPath;
ToExpression[symbolicRun,InputForm];
```

## common/s12_assemble_real_transverse_endpoint.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-390", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 14894, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_assemble_real_transverse_endpoint.wls", "sha256": "c35d4ac121e8a962a986ba07670971ed78e5ac5d6a7daae4be5fb51fb207f3c7"} -->
```wolfram
(* Separate the measured transverse root before the pinned polynomial endpoint. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
transverseEndpointPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_transverse_endpoint.wls"}];
transverseEndpointBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_reference_recoil.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[transverseEndpointBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!="9fb68f329aac43cf66ebfbf23f9b9fb4f590bd255dc78743840eb0093850ac42",Quit[1]];
transverseEndpointText=Import[transverseEndpointBase,"Text"];
transverseEndpointBoundary="\nToExpression[referenceRecoilRun,InputForm];";
If[StringCount[transverseEndpointText,transverseEndpointBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[transverseEndpointPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[transverseEndpointText,transverseEndpointBoundary]],InputForm];
gate["single inherited transverse-coordinate rule",MatchQ[transverseRule,_Rule] && MatchQ[Last[transverseRule],_Power]];
transverseEndpointSymbol=First[transverseRule];transverseEndpointRoot=Last[transverseRule];
transverseEndpointOriginal=DownValues[softRows];
DownValues[transverseEndpointPriorRows]=transverseEndpointOriginal/.HoldPattern[softRows]->transverseEndpointPriorRows;
gate["unchanged unsupported endpoint fallback",(DownValues[transverseEndpointPriorRows]/.HoldPattern[transverseEndpointPriorRows]->softRows)===transverseEndpointOriginal];
transverseRootData[sign_] := transverseRootData[sign] = Module[{rootValue,endpoint,valuation},
  rootValue=transverseEndpointRoot/.t->sign omega-s;
  endpoint=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[rootValue,s23->0,Direction->"FromAbove",
    Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],"transverse root endpoint"];
  valuation=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[s23 D[rootValue,s23]/rootValue,s23->0,
    Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],"transverse root valuation"];
  gate["transverse root is finite positive and nonvanishing at endpoint",
    FreeQ[endpoint,s23|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity|_DirectedInfinity|_Limit] &&
    bounded[FullSimplify[endpoint>0,branchAssumptions[sign]],"positive transverse root endpoint"]];
  gate["transverse root has zero recoil valuation",valuation===0];
  Print["TRANSVERSE_ROOT_ENDPOINT ",sign," ",InputForm[endpoint]," valuation ",valuation];
  <|"Root"->rootValue,"Endpoint"->endpoint,"Valuation"->valuation|>];
transverseCandidateInput[coefficient_,sign_] := Module[
  {powers,inverse,numerator,denominator,ndegree,ddegree,power,rational,data,endpointFactor,candidate,branch},
  powers=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[coefficient,Power[b_,e_]/;!IntegerQ[e]:>Power[b,e],Infinity]];
  If[powers=!={transverseEndpointRoot},Return[Missing["UnsupportedRoot"]]];
  inverse=coefficient/.transverseEndpointRoot->transverseEndpointSymbol;
  gate["exact reversible transverse-coordinate extraction",(inverse/.transverseRule)===coefficient];
  numerator=Numerator[inverse];denominator=Denominator[inverse];
  If[!PolynomialQ[numerator,transverseEndpointSymbol] || !PolynomialQ[denominator,transverseEndpointSymbol],
    Return[Missing["NonpolynomialTransverseCoordinate"]]];
  ndegree=Exponent[numerator,transverseEndpointSymbol];ddegree=Exponent[denominator,transverseEndpointSymbol];
  If[ndegree=!=Exponent[numerator,transverseEndpointSymbol,Min] ||
     ddegree=!=Exponent[denominator,transverseEndpointSymbol,Min],Return[Missing["NonhomogeneousTransverseCoordinate"]]];
  power=ndegree-ddegree;
  gate["transverse factor degree derived from actual coefficient",IntegerQ[power]];
  rational=bounded[Cancel[inverse/transverseEndpointSymbol^power],"extract transverse factor"];
  gate["transverse factor removes the only nonpolynomial support",FreeQ[rational,transverseEndpointSymbol] &&
    FreeQ[rational,Power[_,e_]/;!IntegerQ[e]]];
  gate["exact transverse factor reconstruction",bounded[
    zeroCoefficient[inverse-transverseEndpointSymbol^power rational],"transverse factor reconstruction"]];
  data=transverseRootData[sign];
  endpointFactor=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[data["Root"]^power,s23->0,Direction->"FromAbove",
    Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],"transverse factor endpoint"];
  gate["transverse factor power endpoint exact",bounded[FullSimplify[
    endpointFactor==data["Endpoint"]^power,branchAssumptions[sign]],"transverse power endpoint comparison"]];
  candidate=rational endpointFactor;
  gate["transverse factor endpoint independent of recoil",FreeQ[endpointFactor,s23|_Limit|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
  branch=referenceRecoilRational[candidate,sign];
  gate["extracted coefficient has native polynomial recoil support",
    PolynomialQ[Numerator[branch],s23] && PolynomialQ[Denominator[branch],s23]];
  candidate];
transverseEndpointLastKey=None;transverseEndpointLastInput=Missing["Empty"];
Clear[softRows];
softRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_] := Module[{key,candidate,answer,seconds,preparationSeconds},
  key=Hash[{coefficient,sign},"SHA256"];
  {preparationSeconds,candidate}=AbsoluteTiming[If[key=!=transverseEndpointLastKey,
    transverseEndpointLastInput=transverseCandidateInput[coefficient,sign];transverseEndpointLastKey=key];transverseEndpointLastInput];
  candidate=transverseEndpointLastInput;
  If[MissingQ[candidate],Return[transverseEndpointPriorRows[coefficient,piece,sign]]];
  gate["transverse endpoint uses pinned polynomial code",True];
  {seconds,answer}=AbsoluteTiming[referenceNativeSoftRows[candidate,piece,sign]];
  Print["TRANSVERSE_REFERENCE_RECOIL_ROW branch ",sign," input_bytes ",ByteCount[coefficient],
    " preparation_seconds ",preparationSeconds," endpoint_seconds ",seconds];
  answer];
transverseEndpointWorkerNeedle="recoilData,rationalSeries,";
transverseEndpointWorkerText="transverseCandidateInput,transverseRootData,transverseEndpointPriorRows,transverseEndpointSymbol,transverseEndpointRoot,transverseEndpointLastKey,transverseEndpointLastInput,"<>transverseEndpointWorkerNeedle;
gate["single inherited transverse worker interface",StringCount[referenceRecoilRun,transverseEndpointWorkerNeedle]===1];
transverseEndpointRun=StringReplace[referenceRecoilRun,transverseEndpointWorkerNeedle->transverseEndpointWorkerText];
gate["unchanged full integration equations for transverse workers",SyntaxQ[transverseEndpointRun] &&
  StringReplace[transverseEndpointRun,transverseEndpointWorkerText->transverseEndpointWorkerNeedle]===referenceRecoilRun];
transverseOutputNeedle="put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
transverseOutputText="AssociateTo[result,{\"TransverseEndpointSourceHash\"->FileHash[transverseEndpointPath,\"SHA256\"],\"TransverseEndpointComparisonHash\"->FileHash[transverseEndpointProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n"<>transverseOutputNeedle;
gate["single inherited transverse provenance export",StringCount[referenceSeriesTail,transverseOutputNeedle]===1];
transverseOutputTail=StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail,transverseOutputNeedle->transverseOutputText];
gate["unchanged integration with extra transverse provenance",SyntaxQ[transverseOutputTail] &&
  StringReplace[transverseOutputTail,transverseOutputText->transverseOutputNeedle]===referenceSeriesTail];
transverseControlIndices=Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[#,10,4]<>".wl"}]] &&
  AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]],
    !FreeQ[#/.transverseRule,transverseEndpointRoot]&]&];
gate["own accepted component with actual transverse root available",transverseControlIndices=!={}];
transverseSavedComparisonPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_endpoint_root_comparison_result","s12_result.wl"}];
transverseSavedComparison=Get[transverseSavedComparisonPath];
transverseControlIndex=SelectFirst[transverseControlIndices,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[#,10,4]<>".wl"}],"SHA256"]===
    transverseSavedComparison["OriginalHash"]&,Missing["PinnedControlAbsent"]];
gate["own control fixed by accepted comparison input",IntegerQ[transverseControlIndex]];
transverseControlTask=mapped["Components"][[transverseControlIndex]];
transverseControlOld=Get[FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[transverseControlIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}]];
gate["own accepted transverse control provenance",AssociationQ[transverseControlOld] &&
  TrueQ[transverseControlOld["Accepted"]] && transverseControlOld["InputHash"]===inputHash &&
  And@@Values[transverseControlOld["Checks"]] &&
  KeyTake[transverseControlOld,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]===KeyTake[transverseControlTask,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]];
transverseEndpointDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_transverse_endpoint_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[transverseEndpointDirectory],CreateDirectory[transverseEndpointDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
transverseEndpointProofPath=FileNameJoin[{transverseEndpointDirectory,"s12_result.wl"}];
transverseEqualityPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_endpoint_equivalence.wl"}];
gate["complete physical comparison syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[transverseEqualityPath,"Text"]]];
Get[transverseEqualityPath];
transversePriorSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_result","reference","s12_transverse_endpoint_before_physical_comparison.wls"}];
gate["unchanged compared endpoint calculation",IntegerString[FileHash[transversePriorSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "f2b8c5f8d8a9ca0f71512c18be743bbc17c8f8f53eaf487a74dab93df3cd68cc" &&
  First[StringSplit[Import[transversePriorSource,"Text"],"transverseControlIndices="]]===
    First[StringSplit[Import[transverseEndpointPath,"Text"],"transverseControlIndices="]]];
gate["accepted same-input physical comparison",TrueQ[transverseSavedComparison["AllPhysicalDifferencesZero"]] &&
  transverseSavedComparison["InputHash"]===inputHash &&
  transverseSavedComparison["HelperHash"]===FileHash[transverseEqualityPath,"SHA256"] &&
  transverseSavedComparison["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_compare_endpoint_roots.wls"}],"SHA256"] &&
  transverseSavedComparison["OriginalHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{cache,
    "component_"<>IntegerString[transverseControlIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}],"SHA256"]];
transverseSavedCandidates=Select[FileNames["component_"<>IntegerString[transverseControlIndex,10,4]<>".wl",
  FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s12_transverse_endpoint",channel}],Infinity],
  FileHash[#,"SHA256"]===transverseSavedComparison["CandidateHash"]&];
gate["unique exact saved endpoint candidate",Length[transverseSavedCandidates]===1];
transverseEndpointBinding=Hash[{FileHash[transverseEndpointPath,"SHA256"],FileHash[transverseEqualityPath,"SHA256"],
  FileHash[transverseSavedComparisonPath,"SHA256"],inputHash,transverseControlIndex,
  Hash[transverseControlTask,"SHA256"],Hash[transverseControlOld,"SHA256"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
transverseEndpointProof=If[FileExistsQ[transverseEndpointProofPath],Get[transverseEndpointProofPath],<||>];
transverseEndpointFresh=False;
If[Lookup[transverseEndpointProof,"Binding",None]=!=transverseEndpointBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[transverseEndpointProof,"Accepted",False]],
  transverseEndpointFresh=True;
  transverseControlNew=Get[First[transverseSavedCandidates]];
  transverseControlSeconds=transverseControlNew["ElapsedSeconds"];
  gate["own transverse endpoint control fully accepted",TrueQ[transverseControlNew["Accepted"]] &&
    transverseControlNew["InputHash"]===inputHash && And@@Values[transverseControlNew["Checks"]] &&
    TrueQ[transverseControlNew["Checks"]["transverse endpoint uses pinned polynomial code"]]];
  gate["own transverse ordinary coefficient unchanged",bounded[zeroCoefficient[
    transverseControlNew["Ordinary"]-transverseControlOld["Ordinary"]],"transverse ordinary control"]];
  Do[
    gate["own transverse branch assumptions unchanged",transverseControlNew["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]===
      transverseControlOld["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own transverse full distribution "<>ToString[{sign,key}],TrueQ[bounded[endpointPhysicalComparison[
      transverseControlNew["Branches"][sign][key]-transverseControlOld["Branches"][sign][key],
      transverseControlOld["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]],"transverse distribution control"]["Equivalent"]]],
      {key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
    transverseRows=transverseControlNew["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    transverseOldRows=transverseControlOld["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own transverse soft support unchanged",(Take[#,2]&/@transverseRows)===(Take[#,2]&/@transverseOldRows)];
    gate["own transverse soft coefficients unchanged",And@@MapThread[TrueQ[bounded[
      endpointPhysicalComparison[Last[#1]-Last[#2],transverseControlOld["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]],
      "transverse soft control"]["Equivalent"]]&,{transverseRows,transverseOldRows}]],{sign,{1,-1}}];
  transverseEndpointProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-transverse-endpoint-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[transverseEndpointPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "Binding"->transverseEndpointBinding,"ControlIndex"->transverseControlIndex,"ControlTaskHash"->Hash[transverseControlTask,"SHA256"],
    "OriginalControl"->transverseControlOld,"CompleteControl"->transverseControlNew,"ControlSeconds"->transverseControlSeconds,
    "ControlReused"->True,"PhysicalComparisonHash"->FileHash[transverseSavedComparisonPath,"SHA256"],
    "EqualitySourceHash"->FileHash[transverseEqualityPath,"SHA256"],
    "OriginalDefinitions"->transverseEndpointOriginal,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  transverseSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[transverseEndpointProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded complete transverse comparison",StringLength[transverseSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[transverseEndpointProofPath<>".tmp",transverseSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact transverse comparison reload",Get[transverseEndpointProofPath<>".tmp"]===transverseEndpointProof];
  RenameFile[transverseEndpointProofPath<>".tmp",transverseEndpointProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["own complete transverse endpoint comparison accepted",transverseEndpointProof["Binding"]===transverseEndpointBinding &&
  TrueQ[transverseEndpointProof["Accepted"]] && And@@Values[transverseEndpointProof["Checks"]]];
If[transverseEndpointFresh || !FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{transverseEndpointDirectory,"s12_checks.json"}]],
Export[FileNameJoin[{transverseEndpointDirectory,"s12_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"channel"->channel,
  "control_index"->transverseEndpointProof["ControlIndex"],"control_seconds"->transverseEndpointProof["ControlSeconds"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"]];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_TRANSVERSE_COMPARISON_ONLY"]==="1",Print["PASS: s12_transverse_endpoint_comparison"];Quit[0]];
referenceSeriesTail=transverseOutputTail;
ToExpression[transverseEndpointRun,InputForm];

```

## common/s12_capture_recoil_valuation.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-391", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5575, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_capture_recoil_valuation.wls", "sha256": "640b0932364422ef595b381aad7a3a959f1c0206f33641417128bf6bf7fd3c7d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reproduce the exact failed endpoint valuation without altering production. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
capturePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_capture_recoil_valuation.wls"}];
captureBasePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[captureBasePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243", Quit[1]];
captureText = Import[captureBasePath, "Text"];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[capturePath, "Text"]] || StringCount[captureText, "\nslots="] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
capturePrefix = First[StringSplit[captureText, "\nslots="]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
capturePrefix = StringReplace[capturePrefix, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[capturePrefix], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[capturePrefix, InputForm];
gate["failure capture owns current channel", channel === "Hqqbar"];
captureIndex = FromDigits[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_RECOIL_COMPONENT"]];
gate["actual failed component index", IntegerQ[captureIndex] && 1 <= captureIndex <= Length[mapped["Components"]]];
captureOriginalDefinitions = DownValues[softRows];
captureStart = "\nsoftRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_]";
captureEnd = "\nassemble[component_,index_]";
gate["unique original endpoint definition", StringCount[captureText, captureStart] === 1 && StringCount[captureText, captureEnd] === 1];
captureDefinition = captureStart <> First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[captureText, captureStart]], captureEnd]];
captureGate = "gate[\"spin coefficient has integer recoil valuation\",IntegerQ[valuation]];";
captureReturn = "Return[<|\"Coefficient\"->coefficient,\"Rational\"->rational,\"Valuation\"->valuation,\"IntegerPredicate\"->IntegerQ[valuation],\"Piece\"->piece,\"Branch\"->sign|>];";
gate["unique actual valuation gate", StringCount[captureDefinition, captureGate] === 1];
captureInstrumented = StringReplace[captureDefinition, captureGate -> captureReturn];
gate["original valuation equations unchanged", StringReplace[captureInstrumented, captureReturn -> captureGate] === captureDefinition];
gate["complete capture definition syntax", SyntaxQ[captureInstrumented]];
ToExpression[captureInstrumented, InputForm];
captureComponent = mapped["Components"][[captureIndex]];
captureCoefficients = Select[captureComponent["ReducedCoefficients"], # =!= 0 &] /. transverseRule;
gate["original measured coefficient substitution", FreeQ[captureCoefficients, First[transverseRule]]];
captureEvaluations = {};
captureFailure = Catch[
  Do[
    capturePieces = softPieces[captureMaster, captureSign];
    Do[
      {captureSeconds, captureValue} = AbsoluteTiming[softRows[captureCoefficients[captureMaster], capturePiece, captureSign]];
      gate["native valuation capture returned", AssociationQ[captureValue]];
      captureValue = Join[captureValue, <|"Master" -> captureMaster, "Seconds" -> captureSeconds|>];
      Print["RECOIL_VALUATION_CAPTURE ", captureIndex, " ", InputForm[captureMaster], " branch ", captureSign,
        " integer ", captureValue["IntegerPredicate"], " seconds ", captureSeconds,
        " returned_bytes ", ByteCount[captureValue["Valuation"]]];
      If[!TrueQ[captureValue["IntegerPredicate"]], Throw[captureValue, "CapturedValuation"]];
      AppendTo[captureEvaluations, KeyDrop[captureValue, {"Coefficient", "Rational", "Piece"}]],
      {capturePiece, capturePieces}],
    {captureSign, {1, -1}}, {captureMaster, Keys[captureCoefficients]}]; Missing["FailureNotReproduced"],
  "CapturedValuation"];
gate["actual noninteger valuation reproduced", AssociationQ[captureFailure] && !TrueQ[captureFailure["IntegerPredicate"]]];
captureDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_recoil_valuation_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[captureDirectory], CreateDirectory[captureDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
captureResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-recoil-valuation-capture-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[capturePath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "ComponentIndex" -> captureIndex, "Task" -> KeyTake[captureComponent, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}],
  "OriginalDefinitions" -> captureOriginalDefinitions, "PriorEvaluations" -> captureEvaluations,
  "Failure" -> captureFailure, "Checks" -> checks, "ProductionCorrectionAccepted" -> False|>;
captureFile = FileNameJoin[{captureDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
captureSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[captureResult], "capture compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["capture native file below bound", StringLength[captureSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[captureFile <> ".tmp", captureSerialized, "Text"];
gate["capture exact native reload", bounded[Get[captureFile <> ".tmp"] === captureResult, "capture reload"]];
RenameFile[captureFile <> ".tmp", captureFile, OverwriteTarget -> True];
captureEquations = StringRiffle[KeyValueMap[ToString[#1] <> " = " <> ToString[#2, InputForm] &, captureFailure], "\n\n"] <> "\n";
gate["readable actual equations below bound", StringLength[captureEquations] < 128*1024^2];
Export[FileNameJoin[{captureDirectory, "s12_equations.txt"}], captureEquations, "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{captureDirectory, "s12_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "component" -> captureIndex, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "production_correction_accepted" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s12_capture_recoil_valuation"]; Quit[0];

```
