```wolfram
(* Test the standalone rational-series routine on the actual SIDIS master products. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
comparisonPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243", Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
boundary = "\nassemble[component_,index_]";
If[StringCount[productionText, boundary] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
initialization = StringReplace[First[StringSplit[productionText, boundary]], "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[initialization], Quit[1]]; ToExpression[initialization, InputForm];
gate["complete rational product comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[comparisonPath, "Text"]]];
gate["own rational product comparison channel", channel === "Hqqbar"];
comparisonConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_rational_series_inputs.json"}];
comparisonConfig = Import[comparisonConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
KeyValueMap[gate["comparison input " <> #1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === #2] &, comparisonConfig["files"]];
standalonePath = FileNameJoin[{root, comparisonConfig["reference"]}];
standaloneText = Import[standalonePath, "Text"];
beginMarker = "rationalSeries[rat[numerator_, denominator_], maximumPower_Integer] :=";
endMarker = "\ncanonicalCoefficient[expression_]";
gate["unique complete standalone rational definition", StringCount[standaloneText, beginMarker] === 1 &&
  StringCount[standaloneText, endMarker] === 1];
referenceDefinition = beginMarker <> First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[standaloneText, beginMarker]], endMarker]];
convertedDefinition = StringReplace[referenceDefinition, RegularExpression["\\bep\\b"] -> "eps"];
gate["standalone regulator conversion is reversible", StringReplace[convertedDefinition,
  RegularExpression["\\beps\\b"] -> "ep"] === referenceDefinition && SyntaxQ[convertedDefinition]];
ToExpression[convertedDefinition, InputForm];
originalDefinitions = {DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct], DownValues[softRows],
  DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint]};
zeroCoefficient[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
checkedRationalSeries[coefficient_, order_, description_] := Module[
  {rational, numerator, denominator, value, residual, first, last, seconds},
  rational = bounded[Together[coefficient], "rational master coefficient"];
  numerator = Numerator[rational]; denominator = Denominator[rational];
  gate["rational coefficient has polynomial regulator support", PolynomialQ[numerator, eps] &&
    PolynomialQ[denominator, eps] && denominator =!= 0];
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[rationalSeries[rat[numerator, denominator], order], "reference rational recurrence"]];
  residual = bounded[Expand[denominator value - numerator, eps], "rational series numerator identity"];
  If[!bounded[zeroCoefficient[residual], "rational numerator zero identity"],
    first = Exponent[residual, eps, Min]; last = order + Exponent[denominator, eps, Min];
    gate["integer rational identity coverage", IntegerQ[first] && IntegerQ[last]];
    gate["complete truncated rational numerator reconstruction", And @@ Table[
      bounded[zeroCoefficient[Coefficient[residual, eps, power]], "rational residual coefficient"], {power, first, last}]]];
  Print["RATIONAL_MASTER_SERIES ", description, " order ", order, " seconds ", seconds,
    " input bytes ", ByteCount[coefficient], " output bytes ", ByteCount[value]];
  value];
ordinaryMasterProduct[coefficient_, master_, order_, description_] := Module[
  {polynomial, first, last, powers, coefficients, reconstruction, rationalPart, answer, direct, residual,
   rational, valuation, coverage, productIdentity},
  If[coefficient === 0, Return[0]];
  gate["native master retains its regulator remainder", MatchQ[master, _SeriesData] &&
    master[[1]] === eps && master[[2]] === 0 && master[[6]] === 1];
  rational = bounded[Together[coefficient], "coefficient regulator valuation"];
  If[rational === 0, Return[0]];
  gate["coefficient valuation is rational", PolynomialQ[Numerator[rational], eps] && PolynomialQ[Denominator[rational], eps]];
  valuation = Exponent[Numerator[rational], eps, Min] - Exponent[Denominator[rational], eps, Min];
  gate["integer coefficient regulator valuation", IntegerQ[valuation]];
  coverage = eps^valuation master;
  gate["actual coefficient preserves required master depth", MatchQ[coverage, _SeriesData] && coverage[[5]]/coverage[[6]] > order];
  polynomial = bounded[Expand[Normal[master], eps], "master Laurent polynomial"];
  If[polynomial === 0, Return[0]];
  first = Exponent[polynomial, eps, Min]; last = Exponent[polynomial, eps];
  gate["integer master Laurent support", IntegerQ[first] && IntegerQ[last] && first <= last];
  powers = Range[first, last]; coefficients = Coefficient[polynomial, eps, #] & /@ powers;
  gate["master Laurent coefficients independent of regulator", FreeQ[coefficients, eps]];
  reconstruction = Total[MapThread[Times, {coefficients, eps^powers}]];
  gate["complete master Laurent reconstruction", bounded[Expand[Normal[master] - reconstruction] === 0, "master reconstruction"]];
  rationalPart = checkedRationalSeries[rational, order - first, description];
  answer = bounded[laurentProduct[polynomial, rationalPart, order], "reference master Laurent product"];
  direct = bounded[Normal[Series[polynomial rationalPart, {eps, 0, order}]], "native polynomial master product"];
  residual = bounded[Expand[answer - direct, eps], "master product difference"];
  productIdentity = bounded[zeroCoefficient[residual], "complete master polynomial product identity"];
  If[!TrueQ[productIdentity], Print["MASTER_PRODUCT_RESIDUAL ", StringTake[ToString[residual, InputForm], UpTo[4000]]]];
  gate["complete product matches native polynomial Series", productIdentity];
  answer];
candidateOrdinary[component_, index_] := Module[{coefficients},
  coefficients = Select[component["ReducedCoefficients"], # =!= 0 &] /. transverseRule;
  gate["candidate preserves transverse substitution", FreeQ[coefficients, First[transverseRule]]];
  Total[KeyValueMap[ordinaryMasterProduct[#2 /. D -> 4 - 2 eps,
    regions["OrdinaryMasters"][#1], 0, {index, #1}] &, coefficients]]];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, comparisonConfig["control"]}]; control = Get[controlPath];
gate["complete accepted own integration control", control["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
  TrueQ[control["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]]];
componentIdentity = {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"};
controlIndex = First[FirstPosition[(KeyTake[#, componentIdentity] &) /@ mapped["Components"], KeyTake[control, componentIdentity]]];
gate["own complete control belongs to scalar map", IntegerQ[controlIndex]];
unfinished = Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  !FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[#, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]] &];
targetIndex = If[unfinished === {}, controlIndex, First[unfinished]];
{controlSeconds, controlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[mapped["Components"][[controlIndex]], controlIndex]];
controlResidual = bounded[Expand[controlValue - control["Ordinary"], eps], "own complete ordinary difference"];
gate["complete own accepted ordinary contribution reproduced",
  bounded[zeroCoefficient[controlResidual], "own complete ordinary comparison"]];
{candidateSeconds, candidateValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[mapped["Components"][[targetIndex]], targetIndex]];
gate["reference endpoint and series definitions unchanged", originalDefinitions ===
  {DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct], DownValues[softRows], DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint]}];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-rational-master-product-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[comparisonPath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "ConfigurationHash" -> FileHash[comparisonConfigPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "ReferenceSourceHash" -> FileHash[standalonePath, "SHA256"], "ReferenceDefinition" -> referenceDefinition,
  "ControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], "ControlIndex" -> controlIndex, "ControlSeconds" -> controlSeconds,
  "ControlValue" -> controlValue, "TargetIndex" -> targetIndex, "CandidateSeconds" -> candidateSeconds,
  "CandidateValue" -> candidateValue, "OriginalDefinitions" -> originalDefinitions,
  "RationalDefinitions" -> DownValues[rationalSeries], "CheckedRationalDefinitions" -> DownValues[checkedRationalSeries],
  "ProductDefinitions" -> DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct], "CandidateDefinitions" -> DownValues[candidateOrdinary],
  "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_rational_series_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDirectory], CreateDirectory[resultDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[result], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded complete rational comparison output", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["exact native rational comparison reload", Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s12_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "control_index" -> controlIndex, "control_seconds" -> controlSeconds, "target_index" -> targetIndex,
  "candidate_seconds" -> candidateSeconds, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s12_check_rational_master_product"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Verify exact preprocessing of the original recoil limit on actual inputs. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
recoilSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_check_recoil_factorization.wls"}];
recoilAdapterPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_rational.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[recoilAdapterPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "25de9eb8201f602b83e3e6757adc8adf88c58e3583e01f5dfb1a9188ff836f6f", Quit[1]];
recoilAdapterText = Import[recoilAdapterPath, "Text"];
recoilBoundary = "\nToExpression[rationalProgram, InputForm];";
If[StringCount[recoilAdapterText, recoilBoundary] =!= 1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[recoilSourcePath, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
recoilInitialization = First[StringSplit[recoilAdapterText, recoilBoundary]];
If[StringCount[recoilInitialization, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
recoilInitialization = StringReplace[recoilInitialization, "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[recoilInitialization], Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
ToExpression[recoilInitialization, InputForm];
gate["recoil comparison channel", channel === "Hqqbar"];
recoilConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_recoil_factorization_inputs.json"}];
recoilConfig = Import[recoilConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
KeyValueMap[gate["recoil comparison input " <> #1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === #2] &, recoilConfig["files"]];
recoilCapturePath = FileNameJoin[{root, recoilConfig["capture"]}];
recoilCapture = Get[recoilCapturePath];
recoilReceipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[recoilCapturePath], "s12_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact recoil capture", TrueQ[recoilReceipt["passed"]] &&
  recoilReceipt["result_sha256"][recoilConfig["capture"]] === recoilConfig["files"][recoilConfig["capture"]] &&
  recoilCapture["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-recoil-valuation-capture-v1" &&
  recoilCapture["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[recoilCapture["Checks"]] &&
  recoilCapture["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash && recoilCapture["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
  recoilCapture["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && recoilCapture["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
  recoilCapture["OriginalDefinitions"] === DownValues[softRows]];
recoilOriginalDefinitions = {DownValues[softRows], DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint],
  DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct], DownValues[assemble]};
recoilData[coefficient_, sign_] := recoilData[coefficient, sign] = Module[
  {original, rational, derivative, ratio, valuation, seconds},
  original = Cancel[coefficient /. t -> sign omega - s];
  {seconds, rational} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[Factor[original], "factor actual recoil coefficient"]];
  gate["exact factored recoil coefficient", bounded[Factor[Together[rational - original]] === 0,
    "factored recoil reconstruction"]];
  derivative = s23 D[rational, s23]/rational;
  ratio = bounded[Factor[Together[derivative]], "reduce actual logarithmic derivative"];
  gate["exact reduced logarithmic derivative", bounded[Factor[Together[ratio - derivative]] === 0,
    "logarithmic derivative reconstruction"]];
  valuation = bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[ratio, s23 -> 0, Direction -> "FromAbove",
    Assumptions -> branchAssumptions[sign]], branchAssumptions[sign]], "factored recoil valuation"];
  gate["factored recoil valuation is an unconditional integer", IntegerQ[valuation]];
  Print["RECOIL_FACTORIZATION branch ", sign, " factor_seconds ", seconds,
    " original_bytes ", ByteCount[original], " factored_bytes ", ByteCount[rational],
    " derivative_bytes ", ByteCount[derivative], " reduced_bytes ", ByteCount[ratio],
    " valuation ", InputForm[valuation]];
  <|"Rational" -> rational, "Valuation" -> valuation, "ReducedDerivative" -> ratio|>];
softRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_] := Module[
  {power=piece["Power"],integerPower,kappa,recoil,rational,valuation,firstPower,leading,value},
  integerPower=power/.eps->0;kappa=-Coefficient[power,eps];
  gate["regulated soft power is affine with integer recoil degree",
    IntegerQ[integerPower]&&PolynomialQ[power,eps]&&Exponent[power,eps]<=1];
  recoil=recoilData[coefficient,sign];rational=recoil["Rational"];valuation=recoil["Valuation"];
  gate["spin coefficient has integer recoil valuation",IntegerQ[valuation]];
  firstPower=valuation+integerPower;
  If[firstPower>=0,Return[{}]];
  gate["measured recoil degree needs only a leading endpoint coefficient",firstPower===-1];
  leading=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[s23^(-valuation)rational,s23->0,
    Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],
    "physical spin endpoint coefficient"];
  gate["rational endpoint coefficient is finite",FreeQ[leading,s23|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity|_DirectedInfinity]];
  value=epsilonSeries[(leading/.D->4-2eps)pieceEndpoint[piece,sign],1,"leading soft epsilon coefficient"];
  value=bounded[reduce[value,branchAssumptions[sign]],"leading endpoint collection"];
  gate["endpoint coefficients are fully evaluated",FreeQ[value,s23|_Limit|_Derivative|_Series|_SeriesData|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
  If[value===0,{},{{kappa,firstPower,value}}]];
recoilHelperDefinitions = DownValues[recoilData]; recoilRowDefinitions = DownValues[softRows];
recoilFailure = recoilCapture["Failure"];
gate["captured recoil substitution exact", Cancel[recoilFailure["Coefficient"] /.
  t -> recoilFailure["Branch"] omega - s] === recoilFailure["Rational"]];
{recoilSeconds, recoilCorrected} = AbsoluteTiming[recoilData[recoilFailure["Coefficient"], recoilFailure["Branch"]]];
recoilOld = recoilFailure["Valuation"];
gate["captured conditional valuation structure", MatchQ[recoilOld, _ConditionalExpression]];
gate["same valuation on original returned domain", bounded[FullSimplify[
  recoilCorrected["Valuation"] == recoilOld[[1]], branchAssumptions[recoilFailure["Branch"]] && recoilOld[[2]]],
  "captured conditional valuation comparison"]];
Print["RECOIL_FAILURE_COMPARISON seconds ", recoilSeconds, " original_seconds ", recoilFailure["Seconds"]];
recoilCanonicalCache = cache;
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s12_recoil_factorization", channel,
  IntegerString[Hash[{inputHash, FileHash[recoilSourcePath, "SHA256"], FileHash[recoilConfigPath, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"], 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
recoilControls = Association[KeyValueMap[FromDigits[#1] -> Get[FileNameJoin[{root, #2}]] &, recoilConfig["controls"]]];
KeyValueMap[gate["accepted recoil control " <> ToString[#1], AssociationQ[#2] && TrueQ[#2["Accepted"]] &&
  #2["InputHash"] === inputHash && And @@ Values[#2["Checks"]] &&
  KeyTake[#2, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}] === KeyTake[mapped["Components"][[#1]], {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}]] &, recoilControls];
recoilCompare[value_, control_, index_] := Module[{actualRows, oldRows},
  gate["own complete ordinary control " <> ToString[index], bounded[zeroCoefficient[value["Ordinary"] - control["Ordinary"]], "recoil ordinary control"]];
  Do[
    gate["own branch assumptions unchanged", value["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"] === control["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own complete branch control " <> ToString[{index, sign, key}], bounded[
      zeroCoefficient[value["Branches"][sign][key] - control["Branches"][sign][key]], "recoil branch control"]],
      {key, {"Delta", "L0", "L1", "Regular"}}];
    actualRows = value["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"]; oldRows = control["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own complete soft support", Length[actualRows] === Length[oldRows] &&
      (Take[#, 2] & /@ actualRows) === (Take[#, 2] & /@ oldRows)];
    gate["own complete soft coefficients", And @@ MapThread[
      bounded[zeroCoefficient[Last[#1] - Last[#2]], "recoil soft control"] &, {actualRows, oldRows}]],
    {sign, {1, -1}}]];
recoilValues = <||>; recoilTimings = <||>;
Do[
  {recoilElapsed, recoilValue} = AbsoluteTiming[assemble[mapped["Components"][[recoilIndex]], recoilIndex]];
  gate["complete candidate recoil component", AssociationQ[recoilValue] && TrueQ[recoilValue["Accepted"]] &&
    And @@ Values[recoilValue["Checks"]] && recoilValue["InputHash"] === inputHash];
  If[KeyExistsQ[recoilControls, recoilIndex], recoilCompare[recoilValue, recoilControls[recoilIndex], recoilIndex]];
  AssociateTo[recoilValues, recoilIndex -> recoilValue]; AssociateTo[recoilTimings, recoilIndex -> recoilElapsed],
  {recoilIndex, Join[Keys[recoilControls], recoilConfig["targets"]]}];
gate["original integration and master definitions retained", Rest[recoilOriginalDefinitions] ===
  {Select[DownValues[softPieces], !FreeQ[First[#], _Pattern] &],
   Select[DownValues[pieceEndpoint], !FreeQ[First[#], _Pattern] &],
   DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct], DownValues[assemble]}];
recoilResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-recoil-factorization-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[recoilSourcePath, "SHA256"], "AdapterSourceHash" -> FileHash[recoilAdapterPath, "SHA256"],
  "ProductionSourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "ConfigurationHash" -> FileHash[recoilConfigPath, "SHA256"], "CaptureHash" -> FileHash[recoilCapturePath, "SHA256"],
  "RationalProofHash" -> FileHash[rationalProofPath, "SHA256"], "OriginalDefinitions" -> recoilOriginalDefinitions,
  "HelperDefinitions" -> recoilHelperDefinitions, "RowDefinitions" -> recoilRowDefinitions,
  "CapturedComparison" -> recoilCorrected, "CapturedSeconds" -> recoilSeconds,
  "ComponentHashes" -> Association[(# -> Hash[mapped["Components"][[#]], "SHA256"]) & /@ Keys[recoilValues]],
  "Components" -> recoilValues, "ComponentSeconds" -> recoilTimings, "Cache" -> cache,
  "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
recoilDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_recoil_factorization_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[recoilDirectory], CreateDirectory[recoilDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
recoilFile = FileNameJoin[{recoilDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
recoilSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[bounded[Compress[recoilResult], "recoil proof compression"], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded complete recoil proof", StringLength[recoilSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[recoilFile <> ".tmp", recoilSerialized, "Text"];
gate["exact native recoil proof reload", bounded[Get[recoilFile <> ".tmp"] === recoilResult, "recoil proof reload"]];
RenameFile[recoilFile <> ".tmp", recoilFile, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{recoilDirectory, "s12_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "components" -> Keys[recoilValues], "captured_seconds" -> recoilSeconds, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s12_check_recoil_factorization"]; Quit[0];
```

## common/s12_check_regulator_series.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-394", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6165, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_check_regulator_series.wls", "sha256": "65872969e0cb1617ec0a8c75e30b17e6eae94957f7eac668555741214c2f0a4a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Compare a regulator-polynomial series with the accepted real integration. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
proofRoot=Directory[];
proofSource=FileNameJoin[{proofRoot,"common","s12_check_regulator_series.wls"}];
originalSource=FileNameJoin[{proofRoot,"common","s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[originalSource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243",Quit[1]];
originalText=Import[originalSource,"Text"];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[proofSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
If[StringCount[originalText,"\nslots="]=!=1,Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[originalText,"\nslots="]]];
gate["series comparison channel",channel==="Hqqprime"];
gate["accepted coefficient file identity",
  IntegerString[FileHash[mapPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "e262ce55f59c1a4a1e8ddd3acfbb487536106af566b373922bd09f8e6e73d3ec"];

regulatorMasterSeries[coefficient_,masterValue_,order_,label_] := Module[
  {numerator,denominator,dimensionCoefficients,weights,formalNumerator,
   formalSeries,normalSeries,kernels,reconstructed,result},
  gate[label<>" coefficient is regulator free",FreeQ[coefficient,eps]];
  numerator=Numerator[coefficient];denominator=Denominator[coefficient];
  gate[label<>" rational dimension dependence",
    PolynomialQ[numerator,D]&&PolynomialQ[denominator,D]];
  dimensionCoefficients=bounded[CoefficientList[numerator,D],label<>" dimension coefficients"];
  gate[label<>" dimension coefficients are constant in the regulator",
    FreeQ[dimensionCoefficients,D|eps]];
  weights=Table[Unique["regulatorWeight$"],{Length[dimensionCoefficients]}];
  formalNumerator=Sum[weights[[j]] D^(j-1),{j,Length[weights]}];
  reconstructed=formalNumerator/.Thread[weights->dimensionCoefficients];
  gate[label<>" exact dimension polynomial reconstruction",
    bounded[Expand[numerator-reconstructed],label<>" dimension reconstruction"]===0];
  formalSeries=bounded[Series[(formalNumerator/denominator/.D->4-2eps)masterValue,
    {eps,0,order}],label<>" formal regulator series"];
  gate[label<>" regulator coverage",FreeQ[formalSeries,eps|_SeriesData|_Series]||
    (MatchQ[formalSeries,_SeriesData]&&formalSeries[[5]]>order)];
  normalSeries=Normal[formalSeries];
  kernels=Coefficient[normalSeries,#]&/@weights;
  gate[label<>" exact linear formal series reconstruction",
    bounded[Expand[normalSeries-Total[MapThread[Times,{weights,kernels}]]],
      label<>" formal linearity"]===0];
  gate[label<>" formal kernels independent of abbreviations",FreeQ[kernels,Alternatives@@weights]];
  result=Total[MapThread[Times,{dimensionCoefficients,kernels}]];
  gate[label<>" restored symbolic series evaluated",
    FreeQ[result,Alternatives@@Join[weights,{_SeriesData,_Series,_Missing,$Failed,$Aborted}]]];
  result];

Print["REGULATOR_SERIES_COMPARISON_START"];
controlRows=Table[
  controlFile=FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[controlIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}];
  gate["own completed integration checkpoint exists "<>ToString[controlIndex],FileExistsQ[controlFile]];
  control=Get[controlFile];
  gate["own completed integration checkpoint identity "<>ToString[controlIndex],
    control["InputHash"]===inputHash&&TrueQ[control["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[control["Checks"]]];

  coefficients=Select[component["ReducedCoefficients"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;
  measured=AbsoluteTiming[Total[KeyValueMap[
    regulatorMasterSeries[#2,regions["OrdinaryMasters"][#1],0,
      "control "<>ToString[controlIndex]<>" "<>ToString[#1,InputForm]]&,coefficients]]];
  gate["own accepted ordinary integral equality "<>ToString[controlIndex],
    bounded[Together[measured[[2]]-control["Ordinary"]],"own accepted series equality"]===0];
  Print["REGULATOR_CONTROL_ACCEPTED ",controlIndex," seconds ",measured[[1]]];
  <|"Index"->controlIndex,"Checkpoint"->StringDrop[controlFile,StringLength[root]+1],

    "InputBytes"->ByteCount[coefficients],"OutputBytes"->ByteCount[measured[[2]]]|>,
  {controlIndex,Range[6]}];

stressIndex=7;
component=mapped["Components"][[stressIndex]];
coefficients=Select[component["ReducedCoefficients"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;
stressRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{master,coefficient},Module[{timed},

    "OutputBytes"->ByteCount[timed[[2]]],"Value"->timed[[2]]|>]],coefficients];

  "InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"NativeVersion"->$Version,
  "Definitions"->DownValues[regulatorMasterSeries],"ControlRows"->controlRows,
  "StressComponentIndex"->stressIndex,"StressComponent"->KeyTake[component,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}],
  "StressRows"->stressRows,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;

Export[FileNameJoin[{proofDirectory,"s12_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,
  "control_count"->Length[controlRows],"stress_component"->stressIndex,
```

## common/s12_compare_endpoint_roots.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-395", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 2804, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_compare_endpoint_roots.wls", "sha256": "40b0bcffffc14c84ae98eba017f6e98295306cdc9cd9d37b4916d0415677a126"} -->
```wolfram
(* Compare actual saved endpoint coefficients using proved small root identities. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
If[!StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]], Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
r = Directory[];
p = FileNameJoin[{r, "common", "s12_compare_endpoint_roots.wls"}];
helper = FileNameJoin[{r, "common", "s12_endpoint_equivalence.wl"}];
If[!TrueQ[And @@ (SyntaxQ[Import[#, "Text"]] & /@ {p, helper})], Quit[1]];
Get[helper];
oldFiles = FileNames["component_0025.wl", FileNameJoin[{r, "cache", "s12", "Hqq"}], Infinity];
newFiles = FileNames["component_0025.wl", FileNameJoin[{r, "cache", "s12_transverse_endpoint", "Hqq"}], Infinity];
If[Length[oldFiles] =!= 1 || Length[newFiles] =!= 1, Print["FAIL: unique saved own comparison"]; Quit[1]];
old = Get[First[oldFiles]]; new = Get[First[newFiles]];
If[old["InputHash"] =!= new["InputHash"] ||
   KeyTake[old, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}] =!= KeyTake[new, {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}],
  Print["FAIL: own comparison provenance"]; Quit[1]];
rows = Association@Table[
  assumptions = old["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"];
  If[assumptions =!= new["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"], Print["FAIL: branch assumptions"]; Quit[1]];
  values = Association@Table[
    Print["COMPARE_SAVED_DISTRIBUTION ", InputForm[{sign, key}]];
    key -> endpointPhysicalComparison[new["Branches"][sign][key] - old["Branches"][sign][key], assumptions],
    {key, {"Delta", "L0", "L1", "Regular"}}];
  oldSoft = old["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
  newSoft = new["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
  If[(Take[#, 2] & /@ oldSoft) =!= (Take[#, 2] & /@ newSoft), Print["FAIL: soft support"]; Quit[1]];
  soft = MapThread[endpointPhysicalComparison[Last[#1] - Last[#2], assumptions] &, {newSoft, oldSoft}];
  sign -> <|"Assumptions" -> assumptions, "Distributions" -> values, "Soft" -> soft|>,
  {sign, {1, -1}}];
comparisons = Flatten[Join[Values[#["Distributions"]], #["Soft"]] & /@ Values[rows]];
result = <|"SourceHash" -> FileHash[p, "SHA256"], "HelperHash" -> FileHash[helper, "SHA256"],
  "OriginalHash" -> FileHash[First[oldFiles], "SHA256"], "CandidateHash" -> FileHash[First[newFiles], "SHA256"],
  "InputHash" -> old["InputHash"], "Rows" -> rows,
  "AllPhysicalDifferencesZero" -> AllTrue[comparisons, TrueQ[#["Equivalent"]] &]|>;
dir = FileNameJoin[{r, "Hqq", "s12_endpoint_root_comparison_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[dir], CreateDirectory[dir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
file = FileNameJoin[{dir, "s12_result.wl"}]; Put[result, file];
If[Get[file] =!= result, Print["FAIL: root comparison reload"]; Quit[1]];
If[!TrueQ[result["AllPhysicalDifferencesZero"]], Print["FAIL: endpoint root comparison"]; Quit[1]];
Print["PASS: exact endpoint root comparison"]; Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
  recoilCompletionProof["ConfigurationHash"] === FileHash[recoilCompletionConfigPath, "SHA256"] &&
  recoilCompletionProof["CaptureHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, recoilCompletionConfig["capture"]}], "SHA256"] &&
  recoilCompletionProof["RationalProofHash"] === FileHash[rationalProofPath, "SHA256"] &&

gate["original recoil consumer definitions", recoilCompletionProof["OriginalDefinitions"] ===

  recoilTargetFile = FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[recoilTarget, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}];

    Put[recoilCompleted, recoilTargetFile <> ".tmp"];

    RenameFile[recoilTargetFile <> ".tmp", recoilTargetFile]];
  Print["REUSED_ACCEPTED_RECOIL_COMPONENT ", recoilTarget],
  {recoilTarget, recoilCompletionConfig["targets"]}];
gate["unique original completed real export", StringCount[rationalProgram, rationalOutput] === 1];
recoilCompletionProgram = StringReplace[rationalProgram, rationalOutput ->
```

## common/s12_endpoint_equivalence.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-397", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 1845, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_endpoint_equivalence.wl", "sha256": "92ccb10b7a74d99b65ea7229b7527d6bc01ed78950dac5509dc27d163632a7a9"} -->
```wolfram
(* Exact endpoint comparison using only native-proved radical identities. *)
Clear[endpointPhysicalComparison];
endpointPhysicalComparison[value_, assumptions_] := Module[
  {difference, roots, base, relations = {}, rules = {}, ratio, replacement,
   proof, normalized, simplified, seconds},
  {seconds, simplified} = AbsoluteTiming[
    difference = Together[value];
    If[difference === 0, 0,
      roots = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[difference,
        Power[b_, e_Rational] /; !IntegerQ[e] :> Power[b, e], Infinity]];
      If[roots =!= {},
        base = First[MinimalBy[roots, LeafCount]];
        Do[
          ratio = MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[
            FullSimplify[atom/base, assumptions], 60, $Aborted], 1024^3, $Aborted];
          If[ratio =!= $Aborted && FreeQ[ratio, Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity | _DirectedInfinity],
            replacement = base ratio;
            proof = MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[
              FullSimplify[atom == replacement, assumptions], 60, $Aborted], 1024^3, $Aborted];
            AppendTo[relations, <|"Original" -> atom, "Replacement" -> replacement,
              "Assumptions" -> assumptions, "IdentityProved" -> TrueQ[proof]|>];
            If[TrueQ[proof], AppendTo[rules, atom -> replacement]]],
          {atom, roots}]];
      normalized = difference /. rules;
      simplified = Factor[Together[normalized]];
      If[simplified === 0, 0,
        MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[FullSimplify[simplified, assumptions],
          60, $Aborted], 1024^3, $Aborted]]]];
  Print["ENDPOINT_ROOT_RELATIONS ", InputForm[relations]];
  Print["ENDPOINT_COMPARISON_RESULT ", InputForm[{simplified === 0, seconds}]];
  <|"Difference" -> difference, "Relations" -> relations,
    "SimplifiedDifference" -> simplified, "Seconds" -> seconds,
    "Equivalent" -> (simplified === 0)|>];

```

```wolfram
(* Read and compare the saved endpoint equations under their recorded assumptions. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
If[!StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]],Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
r=Directory[];p=FileNameJoin[{r,"common","s12_read_endpoint_comparison.wls"}];

oldFiles=FileNames["component_0025.wl",FileNameJoin[{r,"cache","s12","Hqq"}],Infinity];
newFiles=FileNames["component_0025.wl",FileNameJoin[{r,"cache","s12_transverse_endpoint","Hqq"}],Infinity];
If[Length[oldFiles]=!=1 || Length[newFiles]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique saved own comparison"];Quit[1]];
old=Get[First[oldFiles]];new=Get[First[newFiles]];
If[old["InputHash"]=!=new["InputHash"] || KeyTake[old,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]=!=KeyTake[new,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}],
 Print["FAIL: own comparison provenance"];Quit[1]];
rows=Association@Table[
 assumptions=old["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"];
 If[assumptions=!=new["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"],Print["FAIL: branch assumptions"];Quit[1]];
 Print["ORIGINAL_DELTA ",sign," ",InputForm[old["Branches"][sign]["Delta"]]];
 Print["CANDIDATE_DELTA ",sign," ",InputForm[new["Branches"][sign]["Delta"]]];
 values=Association@Table[
  difference=Together[new["Branches"][sign][key]-old["Branches"][sign][key]];
  Print["COMPARISON_EQUATION ",InputForm[{sign,key,difference,assumptions}]];
  {seconds,simplified}=AbsoluteTiming[MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[
    FullSimplify[difference,assumptions],1200,$Aborted],2*1024^3,$Aborted]];
  Print["PHYSICAL_COMPARISON ",InputForm[{sign,key,simplified,seconds}]];
  key-><|"Difference"->difference,"SimplifiedDifference"->simplified,"Seconds"->seconds|>,
  {key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
 sign-><|"Assumptions"->assumptions,"OriginalDelta"->old["Branches"][sign]["Delta"],
   "CandidateDelta"->new["Branches"][sign]["Delta"],"Comparisons"->values|>,{sign,{1,-1}}];
result=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[p,"SHA256"],"OriginalFile"->First[oldFiles],"OriginalHash"->FileHash[First[oldFiles],"SHA256"],
 "CandidateFile"->First[newFiles],"CandidateHash"->FileHash[First[newFiles],"SHA256"],"InputHash"->old["InputHash"],
 "Rows"->rows,"AllPhysicalDifferencesZero"->AllTrue[Flatten[Values[#["Comparisons"]]&/@Values[rows]],#["SimplifiedDifference"]===0&]|>;
dir=FileNameJoin[{r,"Hqq","s12_endpoint_comparison_equations_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[dir],CreateDirectory[dir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
file=FileNameJoin[{dir,"s12_result.wl"}];Put[result,file];
```

```wolfram
residualSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_read_retained_residual.wls"}];
residualBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_retained_series.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[residualBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "a6c7321e5aba5cc0754323ea5fb369646e6ba95d1039301ec26ab019903f3346",Quit[1]];
residualText=Import[residualBase,"Text"];
residualBoundary="\nretainedControlPath=";
If[StringCount[residualText,residualBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[residualSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[residualText,residualBoundary]],InputForm];
residualIndex=44;residualTask=mapped["Components"][[residualIndex]];
residualCoefficients=Select[residualTask["ReducedCoefficients"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;
residualMasters=Keys[residualCoefficients];
Print["ACTUAL_COMPONENT ",InputForm[KeyTake[residualTask,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]]];
Print["ORDERED_MASTERS ",InputForm[residualMasters]];
residualRows=Table[
  residualCoefficient=residualCoefficients[master]/.D->4-2eps;
  residualMaster=regions["OrdinaryMasters"][master];
  residualOrder=-Exponent[Expand[Normal[residualMaster],eps],eps,Min];
  residualRational=bounded[Together[residualCoefficient],"actual residual input"];
  residualNumerator=Numerator[residualRational];residualDenominator=Denominator[residualRational];
  residualValue=bounded[rationalSeries[rat[residualNumerator,residualDenominator],residualOrder],"actual recurrence"];
  residualEquation=bounded[Expand[residualDenominator residualValue-residualNumerator,eps],"actual reconstruction residual"];
  residualFirst=Exponent[residualEquation,eps,Min];
  residualLast=residualOrder+Exponent[residualDenominator,eps,Min];
  residualOriginalZero=bounded[zeroCoefficient[residualEquation],"original reference residual predicate"];
  Print["ACTUAL_RESIDUAL ",InputForm[{master,residualEquation}]];
  Print["ACTUAL_RESIDUAL_SUPPORT ",InputForm[{master,residualOrder,residualFirst,residualLast,residualOriginalZero}]];
  <|"Master"->master,"Order"->residualOrder,"Denominator"->residualDenominator,
    "Residual"->residualEquation,"First"->residualFirst,"Last"->residualLast,
    "OriginalReferenceZero"->residualOriginalZero|>,{master,Drop[residualMasters,2]}];
residualResult=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[residualSource,"SHA256"],"BaseHash"->FileHash[residualBase,"SHA256"],
  "InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"ComponentIndex"->residualIndex,
  "ComponentHash"->Hash[residualTask,"SHA256"],"Rows"->residualRows|>;
residualDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_retained_residual_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[residualDirectory],CreateDirectory[residualDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
residualOutput=FileNameJoin[{residualDirectory,"s12_result.wl"}];
Put[residualResult,residualOutput];gate["exact residual equation reload",Get[residualOutput]===residualResult];
Print["PASS: actual retained residual read"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s12_result/reference/s12_check_rational_master_product_before_zero_identity.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-404", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10062, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_result/reference/s12_check_rational_master_product_before_zero_identity.wls", "sha256": "f04001b8a0d7f42e3823d598ddd66eedd38d1f7d74881748daa691e3c428cec7"} -->
```wolfram
(* Test the standalone rational-series routine on the actual SIDIS master products. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
comparisonPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}];
productionPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[productionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243", Quit[1]];
productionText = Import[productionPath, "Text"];
boundary = "\nassemble[component_,index_]";
If[StringCount[productionText, boundary] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
initialization = StringReplace[First[StringSplit[productionText, boundary]], "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]" -> "Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[initialization], Quit[1]]; ToExpression[initialization, InputForm];
gate["complete rational product comparison syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[comparisonPath, "Text"]]];
gate["own rational product comparison channel", channel === "Hqqbar"];
comparisonConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s12_rational_series_inputs.json"}];
comparisonConfig = Import[comparisonConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
KeyValueMap[gate["comparison input " <> #1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === #2] &, comparisonConfig["files"]];
standalonePath = FileNameJoin[{root, comparisonConfig["reference"]}];
standaloneText = Import[standalonePath, "Text"];
beginMarker = "rationalSeries[rat[numerator_, denominator_], maximumPower_Integer] :=";
endMarker = "\ncanonicalCoefficient[expression_]";
gate["unique complete standalone rational definition", StringCount[standaloneText, beginMarker] === 1 &&
  StringCount[standaloneText, endMarker] === 1];
referenceDefinition = beginMarker <> First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[standaloneText, beginMarker]], endMarker]];
convertedDefinition = StringReplace[referenceDefinition, RegularExpression["\\bep\\b"] -> "eps"];
gate["standalone regulator conversion is reversible", StringReplace[convertedDefinition,
  RegularExpression["\\beps\\b"] -> "ep"] === referenceDefinition && SyntaxQ[convertedDefinition]];
ToExpression[convertedDefinition, InputForm];
originalDefinitions = {DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct], DownValues[softRows],
  DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint]};
zeroCoefficient[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
checkedRationalSeries[coefficient_, order_, description_] := Module[
  {rational, numerator, denominator, value, residual, first, last, seconds},
  rational = bounded[Together[coefficient], "rational master coefficient"];
  numerator = Numerator[rational]; denominator = Denominator[rational];
  gate["rational coefficient has polynomial regulator support", PolynomialQ[numerator, eps] &&
    PolynomialQ[denominator, eps] && denominator =!= 0];
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[rationalSeries[rat[numerator, denominator], order], "reference rational recurrence"]];
  residual = bounded[Expand[denominator value - numerator, eps], "rational series numerator identity"];
  If[residual =!= 0,
    first = Exponent[residual, eps, Min]; last = order + Exponent[denominator, eps, Min];
    gate["integer rational identity coverage", IntegerQ[first] && IntegerQ[last]];
    gate["complete truncated rational numerator reconstruction", And @@ Table[
      bounded[zeroCoefficient[Coefficient[residual, eps, power]], "rational residual coefficient"], {power, first, last}]]];
  Print["RATIONAL_MASTER_SERIES ", description, " order ", order, " seconds ", seconds,
    " input bytes ", ByteCount[coefficient], " output bytes ", ByteCount[value]];
  value];
ordinaryMasterProduct[coefficient_, master_, order_, description_] := Module[
  {polynomial, first, last, powers, coefficients, reconstruction, rationalPart, answer, direct, residual,
   rational, valuation, coverage},
  If[coefficient === 0, Return[0]];
  gate["native master retains its regulator remainder", MatchQ[master, _SeriesData] &&
    master[[1]] === eps && master[[2]] === 0 && master[[6]] === 1];
  rational = bounded[Together[coefficient], "coefficient regulator valuation"];
  If[rational === 0, Return[0]];
  gate["coefficient valuation is rational", PolynomialQ[Numerator[rational], eps] && PolynomialQ[Denominator[rational], eps]];
  valuation = Exponent[Numerator[rational], eps, Min] - Exponent[Denominator[rational], eps, Min];
  gate["integer coefficient regulator valuation", IntegerQ[valuation]];
  coverage = eps^valuation master;
  gate["actual coefficient preserves required master depth", MatchQ[coverage, _SeriesData] && coverage[[5]]/coverage[[6]] > order];
  polynomial = bounded[Expand[Normal[master], eps], "master Laurent polynomial"];
  If[polynomial === 0, Return[0]];
  first = Exponent[polynomial, eps, Min]; last = Exponent[polynomial, eps];
  gate["integer master Laurent support", IntegerQ[first] && IntegerQ[last] && first <= last];
  powers = Range[first, last]; coefficients = Coefficient[polynomial, eps, #] & /@ powers;
  gate["master Laurent coefficients independent of regulator", FreeQ[coefficients, eps]];
  reconstruction = Total[MapThread[Times, {coefficients, eps^powers}]];
  gate["complete master Laurent reconstruction", bounded[Expand[Normal[master] - reconstruction] === 0, "master reconstruction"]];
  rationalPart = checkedRationalSeries[rational, order - first, description];
  answer = bounded[laurentProduct[polynomial, rationalPart, order], "reference master Laurent product"];
  direct = bounded[Normal[Series[polynomial rationalPart, {eps, 0, order}]], "native polynomial master product"];
  residual = bounded[Expand[answer - direct, eps], "master product difference"];
  gate["complete product matches native polynomial Series", residual === 0 || And @@ Table[
    bounded[zeroCoefficient[Coefficient[residual, eps, power]], "master product coefficient identity"],
    {power, Exponent[residual, eps, Min], Exponent[residual, eps]}]];
  answer];
candidateOrdinary[component_, index_] := Module[{coefficients},
  coefficients = Select[component["ReducedCoefficients"], # =!= 0 &] /. transverseRule;
  gate["candidate preserves transverse substitution", FreeQ[coefficients, First[transverseRule]]];
  Total[KeyValueMap[ordinaryMasterProduct[#2 /. D -> 4 - 2 eps,
    regions["OrdinaryMasters"][#1], 0, {index, #1}] &, coefficients]]];
controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, comparisonConfig["control"]}]; control = Get[controlPath];
gate["complete accepted own integration control", control["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
  TrueQ[control["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]]];
componentIdentity = {"Sector", "Kind", "Index"};
controlIndex = First[FirstPosition[(KeyTake[#, componentIdentity] &) /@ mapped["Components"], KeyTake[control, componentIdentity]]];
gate["own complete control belongs to scalar map", IntegerQ[controlIndex]];
unfinished = Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  !FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[#, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]] &];
targetIndex = If[unfinished === {}, controlIndex, First[unfinished]];
{controlSeconds, controlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[mapped["Components"][[controlIndex]], controlIndex]];
controlResidual = bounded[Expand[controlValue - control["Ordinary"], eps], "own complete ordinary difference"];
gate["complete own accepted ordinary contribution reproduced", controlResidual === 0 || And @@ Table[
  bounded[zeroCoefficient[Coefficient[controlResidual, eps, power]], "own complete ordinary comparison"],
  {power, Exponent[controlResidual, eps, Min], Exponent[controlResidual, eps]}]];
{candidateSeconds, candidateValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[mapped["Components"][[targetIndex]], targetIndex]];
gate["reference endpoint and series definitions unchanged", originalDefinitions ===
  {DownValues[epsilonSeries], DownValues[laurentProduct], DownValues[softRows], DownValues[softPieces], DownValues[pieceEndpoint]}];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-rational-master-product-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[comparisonPath, "SHA256"], "ProductionSourceHash" -> sourceHash,
  "ConfigurationHash" -> FileHash[comparisonConfigPath, "SHA256"], "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "ReferenceSourceHash" -> FileHash[standalonePath, "SHA256"], "ReferenceDefinition" -> referenceDefinition,
  "ControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], "ControlIndex" -> controlIndex, "ControlSeconds" -> controlSeconds,
  "ControlValue" -> controlValue, "TargetIndex" -> targetIndex, "CandidateSeconds" -> candidateSeconds,
  "CandidateValue" -> candidateValue, "OriginalDefinitions" -> originalDefinitions,
  "RationalDefinitions" -> DownValues[rationalSeries], "CheckedRationalDefinitions" -> DownValues[checkedRationalSeries],
  "ProductDefinitions" -> DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct], "CandidateDefinitions" -> DownValues[candidateOrdinary],
  "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
resultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s12_rational_series_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDirectory], CreateDirectory[resultDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
resultPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
serialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[result], InputForm] <> "]\n";
gate["bounded complete rational comparison output", StringLength[serialized] < 128*1024^2];
Export[resultPath <> ".tmp", serialized, "Text"];
gate["exact native rational comparison reload", Get[resultPath <> ".tmp"] === result];
RenameFile[resultPath <> ".tmp", resultPath, OverwriteTarget -> True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s12_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks,
  "control_index" -> controlIndex, "control_seconds" -> controlSeconds, "target_index" -> targetIndex,
  "candidate_seconds" -> candidateSeconds, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s12_check_rational_master_product"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s12_result/reference/s12_reference_recoil_before_resume_metadata.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-405", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10029, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_result/reference/s12_reference_recoil_before_resume_metadata.wls", "sha256": "cde27a8c89576b6264528e83f1526c6d488f56a78eebc33dfe0c9b7384fee537"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse the pinned reference endpoint code only on its native polynomial support. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
referenceRecoilPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_reference_recoil.wls"}];
referenceRecoilBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_factored_series.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[referenceRecoilBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!="7bbecbad4109fd3a2cef0f1d69aeaf8e6050c488427327e941bcaa096be0b44f",Quit[1]];
referenceRecoilText=Import[referenceRecoilBase,"Text"];
referenceRecoilBoundary="\nreferenceSeriesDistribute =";
If[StringCount[referenceRecoilText,referenceRecoilBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[referenceRecoilPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
referenceRecoilPrefix=First[StringSplit[referenceRecoilText,referenceRecoilBoundary]];
referenceRecoilTail=referenceRecoilBoundary<>Last[StringSplit[referenceRecoilText,referenceRecoilBoundary]];
If[!SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilTail],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilPrefix,InputForm];
referenceRecoilReference=Import[referencePath,"Text"];
referenceRecoilStart="\nsoftRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_]";
referenceRecoilEnd="\nassemble[channel_,key_,component_,channelHash_]";
gate["unique pinned native reference endpoint definition",StringCount[referenceRecoilReference,referenceRecoilStart]===1 &&
  StringCount[referenceRecoilReference,referenceRecoilEnd]===1];
referenceRecoilDefinition=referenceRecoilStart<>First[StringSplit[
  Last[StringSplit[referenceRecoilReference,referenceRecoilStart]],referenceRecoilEnd]];
referenceRecoilConverted=StringReplace[referenceRecoilDefinition,{
  RegularExpression["\\bsoftRows\\b"]->"referenceNativeSoftRows",RegularExpression["\\bw\\b"]->"s23"}];
gate["exact reversible native endpoint conversion",SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilConverted] &&
  StringReplace[referenceRecoilConverted,{RegularExpression["\\breferenceNativeSoftRows\\b"]->"softRows",
  RegularExpression["\\bs23\\b"]->"w"}]===referenceRecoilDefinition];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilConverted,InputForm];
referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions=DownValues[softRows];
DownValues[referencePriorSoftRows]=referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions/.HoldPattern[softRows]->referencePriorSoftRows;
gate["exact original nonpolynomial endpoint fallback",
  (DownValues[referencePriorSoftRows]/.HoldPattern[referencePriorSoftRows]->softRows)===referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions];
referenceRecoilLastKey=None;referenceRecoilLastRational=0;
referenceRecoilNativeCount=0;referenceRecoilFallbackCount=0;
referenceRecoilRational[coefficient_,sign_] := Module[{key=Hash[{coefficient,sign},"SHA256"]},
  If[key=!=referenceRecoilLastKey,
    referenceRecoilLastRational=bounded[Cancel[coefficient/.t->sign omega-s],"native reference recoil input"];
    referenceRecoilLastKey=key];referenceRecoilLastRational];
referenceRecoilNativeCall="  rational=Cancel[coefficient/.t->sign omega-s];";
referenceRecoilCachedCall="  rational=referenceRecoilRational[coefficient,sign];";
gate["single native recoil input reuse boundary",StringCount[referenceRecoilConverted,referenceRecoilNativeCall]===1];
referenceRecoilCached=StringReplace[referenceRecoilConverted,referenceRecoilNativeCall->referenceRecoilCachedCall];
gate["all reference endpoint equations retained",SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilCached] &&
  StringReplace[referenceRecoilCached,referenceRecoilCachedCall->referenceRecoilNativeCall]===referenceRecoilConverted];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilCached,InputForm];
Clear[softRows];
softRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_] := Module[{rational,eligible,answer,seconds},
  rational=referenceRecoilRational[coefficient,sign];
  eligible=rational=!=0 && PolynomialQ[Numerator[rational],s23] && PolynomialQ[Denominator[rational],s23];
  {seconds,answer}=AbsoluteTiming[If[eligible,referenceRecoilNativeCount++;gate["native reference polynomial support accepted",True];referenceNativeSoftRows[coefficient,piece,sign],
    referenceRecoilFallbackCount++;referencePriorSoftRows[coefficient,piece,sign]]];
  Print["REFERENCE_RECOIL_ROW branch ",sign," polynomial ",eligible," input_bytes ",ByteCount[coefficient],
    " seconds ",seconds];answer];
referenceRecoilWorkerBoundary="recoilData,rationalSeries,";
referenceRecoilWorkerReplacement="referenceRecoilRational,referenceRecoilLastKey,referenceRecoilLastRational,referenceRecoilNativeCount,referenceRecoilFallbackCount,referenceNativeSoftRows,referencePriorSoftRows,recoilData,rationalSeries,";
referenceRecoilOutputBoundary="\\\"FactoredInputComparisonHash\\\"->FileHash[factoredProofPath,\\\"SHA256\\\"]";
referenceRecoilOutputReplacement=referenceRecoilOutputBoundary<>",\\\"ReferenceRecoilComparisonHash\\\"->FileHash[referenceRecoilProofPath,\\\"SHA256\\\"],\\\"ReferenceRecoilSourceHash\\\"->FileHash[referenceRecoilPath,\\\"SHA256\\\"]";
referenceRecoilChanges={referenceRecoilWorkerBoundary->referenceRecoilWorkerReplacement,
  referenceRecoilOutputBoundary->referenceRecoilOutputReplacement};
gate["unique remaining reference-recoil interfaces",And@@(StringCount[referenceRecoilTail,First[#]]===1&/@referenceRecoilChanges)];
referenceRecoilRun=StringReplace[referenceRecoilTail,referenceRecoilChanges];
gate["all remaining integration equations retained",SyntaxQ[referenceRecoilRun] &&
  StringReplace[referenceRecoilRun,Reverse/@referenceRecoilChanges]===referenceRecoilTail];
referenceRecoilDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_reference_recoil_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[referenceRecoilDirectory],CreateDirectory[referenceRecoilDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
referenceRecoilProofPath=FileNameJoin[{referenceRecoilDirectory,"s12_result.wl"}];
referenceRecoilBinding=Hash[{FileHash[referenceRecoilPath,"SHA256"],inputHash,
  FileHash[referencePath,"SHA256"],factoredControlBinding,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
referenceRecoilProof=If[FileExistsQ[referenceRecoilProofPath],Get[referenceRecoilProofPath],<||>];
If[Lookup[referenceRecoilProof,"Binding",None]=!=referenceRecoilBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[referenceRecoilProof,"Accepted",False]],
  referenceRecoilControlCache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s12_reference_recoil",channel,IntegerString[referenceRecoilBinding,16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[referenceRecoilControlCache],CreateDirectory[referenceRecoilControlCache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
  {referenceRecoilSeconds,referenceRecoilControl}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=referenceRecoilControlCache},
    assemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]];
  gate["own complete reference-recoil component accepted",AssociationQ[referenceRecoilControl] &&
    TrueQ[referenceRecoilControl["Accepted"]] && referenceRecoilControl["InputHash"]===inputHash &&
    And@@Values[referenceRecoilControl["Checks"]]];
  gate["own comparison exercises native rational endpoint code",TrueQ[Lookup[referenceRecoilControl["Checks"],
    "native reference polynomial support accepted",False]]];
  gate["own reference-recoil ordinary unchanged",bounded[zeroCoefficient[
    referenceRecoilControl["Ordinary"]-factoredControl["Ordinary"]],"reference recoil ordinary comparison"]];
  Do[
    gate["own reference-recoil branch assumptions unchanged",referenceRecoilControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]===
      factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own reference-recoil distribution "<>ToString[{sign,key}],bounded[zeroCoefficient[
      referenceRecoilControl["Branches"][sign][key]-factoredControl["Branches"][sign][key]],"reference recoil distribution comparison"]],
      {key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
    referenceRecoilRows=referenceRecoilControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    referenceRecoilOldRows=factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own reference-recoil soft support unchanged",Length[referenceRecoilRows]===Length[referenceRecoilOldRows] &&
      (Take[#,2]&/@referenceRecoilRows)===(Take[#,2]&/@referenceRecoilOldRows)];
    gate["own reference-recoil soft values unchanged",And@@MapThread[bounded[zeroCoefficient[Last[#1]-Last[#2]],
      "reference recoil soft comparison"]&,{referenceRecoilRows,referenceRecoilOldRows}]],{sign,{1,-1}}];
  referenceRecoilProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-reference-recoil-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
    "Binding"->referenceRecoilBinding,"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[referenceRecoilPath,"SHA256"],"ReferenceHash"->FileHash[referencePath,"SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex"->factoredControlIndex,"ControlHash"->Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
    "OriginalControl"->factoredControl,"CompleteControl"->referenceRecoilControl,"ControlSeconds"->referenceRecoilSeconds,
    "NativeRows"->referenceRecoilNativeCount,"FallbackRows"->referenceRecoilFallbackCount,
    "OriginalDefinitions"->referenceRecoilOriginalDefinitions,"NativeDefinition"->referenceRecoilDefinition,
    "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
  referenceRecoilSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[referenceRecoilProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded reference-recoil comparison",StringLength[referenceRecoilSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[referenceRecoilProofPath<>".tmp",referenceRecoilSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact reference-recoil comparison reload",Get[referenceRecoilProofPath<>".tmp"]===referenceRecoilProof];
  RenameFile[referenceRecoilProofPath<>".tmp",referenceRecoilProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["own complete reference-recoil comparison accepted",referenceRecoilProof["Binding"]===referenceRecoilBinding &&
  TrueQ[referenceRecoilProof["Accepted"]] && And@@Values[referenceRecoilProof["Checks"]]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{referenceRecoilDirectory,"s12_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "channel"->channel,"control_index"->referenceRecoilProof["ControlIndex"],
  "control_seconds"->referenceRecoilProof["ControlSeconds"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_RECOIL_COMPARISON_ONLY"]==="1",Print["PASS: s12_reference_recoil_comparison"];Quit[0]];
ToExpression[referenceRecoilRun,InputForm];

```

## common/s12_result/reference/s12_retained_series_before_empty_support.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-406", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6134, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_result/reference/s12_retained_series_before_empty_support.wls", "sha256": "a6c7321e5aba5cc0754323ea5fb369646e6ba95d1039301ec26ab019903f3346"} -->
```wolfram
(* Keep the standalone recurrence and check its required residual coefficients directly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
retainedPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_retained_series.wls"}];
retainedBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_transverse_endpoint.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[retainedBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "c35d4ac121e8a962a986ba07670971ed78e5ac5d6a7daae4be5fb51fb207f3c7",Quit[1]];
retainedBaseText=Import[retainedBase,"Text"];
retainedBoundary="\nreferenceSeriesTail=transverseOutputTail;\nToExpression[transverseEndpointRun,InputForm];";
If[StringCount[retainedBaseText,retainedBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[retainedPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[retainedBaseText,retainedBoundary]],InputForm];
retainedOriginalDefinitions=DownValues[checkedRationalSeries];
retainedStart="\ncheckedRationalSeries[";retainedEnd="\nordinaryMasterProduct[";
gate["unique original rational check definition",StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText,retainedStart]===1 &&
  StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText,retainedEnd]===1];
retainedDefinition=retainedStart<>First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesComparisonText,retainedStart]],retainedEnd]];
gate["original rational check syntax",SyntaxQ[retainedDefinition]];
ToExpression[retainedDefinition,InputForm];
gate["same accepted rational check implementation",DownValues[checkedRationalSeries]===retainedOriginalDefinitions];
retainedChanges={
  "  If[!bounded[zeroCoefficient[residual], \"rational numerator zero identity\"],"->"  If[residual =!= 0,",
  "first, last, seconds},"->"first, last, seconds, checkStarted=AbsoluteTime[]},",
  "  value];"->"  Print[\"RETAINED_SERIES_CHECK \",description,\" total_seconds \",AbsoluteTime[]-checkStarted,\" residual_bytes \",ByteCount[residual]];\n  value];"};
gate["unique retained-check interfaces",And@@(StringCount[retainedDefinition,First[#]]===1&/@retainedChanges)];
retainedCandidateDefinition=StringReplace[retainedDefinition,retainedChanges];
gate["unchanged recurrence and retained identities",SyntaxQ[retainedCandidateDefinition] &&
  StringReplace[retainedCandidateDefinition,Reverse/@retainedChanges]===retainedDefinition];
ToExpression[retainedCandidateDefinition,InputForm];
retainedControlPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_0043.wl"}];
gate["bound own accepted ordinary control",IntegerString[FileHash[retainedControlPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "124fb11cb9867052bd0229f19f9a8e869679e3f1b9119203f6781bc464f85471"];
retainedControl=Get[retainedControlPath];
gate["accepted own control input and checks",TrueQ[retainedControl["Accepted"]] &&
  retainedControl["InputHash"]===inputHash && And@@Values[retainedControl["Checks"]]];
retainedIdentity={"Sector","Kind","Index"};
retainedControlIndex=First[FirstPosition[KeyTake[#,retainedIdentity]&/@mapped["Components"],
  KeyTake[retainedControl,retainedIdentity]]];
retainedTask=mapped["Components"][[retainedControlIndex]];
retainedDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_retained_series_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[retainedDirectory],CreateDirectory[retainedDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
retainedProofPath=FileNameJoin[{retainedDirectory,"s12_result.wl"}];
retainedBinding=Hash[{FileHash[retainedPath,"SHA256"],FileHash[retainedBase,"SHA256"],
  FileHash[retainedControlPath,"SHA256"],Hash[retainedTask,"SHA256"],inputHash,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
retainedProof=If[FileExistsQ[retainedProofPath],Get[retainedProofPath],<||>];
If[Lookup[retainedProof,"Binding",None]=!=retainedBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[retainedProof,"Accepted",False]],
  {retainedSeconds,retainedValue}=AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[retainedTask,retainedControlIndex]];
  gate["entire own ordinary coefficient exactly unchanged",retainedValue===retainedControl["Ordinary"] ||
    bounded[zeroCoefficient[Expand[retainedValue-retainedControl["Ordinary"],eps]],"own retained-series comparison"]];
  retainedProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-retained-series-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[retainedPath,"SHA256"],"BaseSourceHash"->FileHash[retainedBase,"SHA256"],
    "Binding"->retainedBinding,"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "ControlIndex"->retainedControlIndex,"ControlHash"->FileHash[retainedControlPath,"SHA256"],
    "ControlTaskHash"->Hash[retainedTask,"SHA256"],"OriginalOrdinary"->retainedControl["Ordinary"],
    "CandidateOrdinary"->retainedValue,"CandidateSeconds"->retainedSeconds,
    "OriginalDefinitions"->retainedOriginalDefinitions,"CandidateDefinitions"->DownValues[checkedRationalSeries],
    "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  retainedSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[retainedProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded retained-series proof",StringLength[retainedSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[retainedProofPath<>".tmp",retainedSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact retained-series proof reload",Get[retainedProofPath<>".tmp"]===retainedProof];
  RenameFile[retainedProofPath<>".tmp",retainedProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["complete retained-series comparison accepted",retainedProof["Binding"]===retainedBinding &&
  TrueQ[retainedProof["Accepted"]] && And@@Values[retainedProof["Checks"]]];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_RETAINED_COMPARISON_ONLY"]==="1",Print["PASS: s12_retained_series_comparison"];Quit[0]];
retainedOutputNeedle="put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s12_result.wl\"}]];";
retainedOutputReplacement="AssociateTo[result,{\"RetainedSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[retainedPath,\"SHA256\"],\"RetainedSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[retainedProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n"<>retainedOutputNeedle;
gate["single retained-series output interface",StringCount[transverseOutputTail,retainedOutputNeedle]===1];
referenceSeriesTail=StringReplace[transverseOutputTail,retainedOutputNeedle->retainedOutputReplacement];
gate["unchanged remaining integration equations",SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesTail] &&
  StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail,retainedOutputReplacement->retainedOutputNeedle]===transverseOutputTail];
ToExpression[transverseEndpointRun,InputForm];

```
