## common/s12_result/reference/s12_standalone_rational_series.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-407", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 15009, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_result/reference/s12_standalone_rational_series.wls", "sha256": "0685ea2e148fa2691b61c9cd0bebec67d7befb76eb681bd429bd1d9fbba298cd"} -->
```wolfram
(* Construct the production annihilation real-emission Laurent ledger from
   FORM/Kira coefficients and the locked SubTropica master candidates.

   The validation-only FeynCalc ledger is used only through a preconstruction
   SHA-256 equality gate.  It never supplies a production coefficient. *)

ClearAll[fail, pass, sha256, rationalSeries, canonicalCoefficient,
  canonicalMasterPolynomial, laurentTuple];
fail[msg_, detail_: Null] := (
  Print["FAIL: ", msg];
  If[detail =!= Null, Print["DETAIL=", InputForm[detail]]];
  Quit[1]
);
pass[msg_] := Print["PASS: ", msg];
sha256[path_] := IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64];

rationalSeries[rat[numerator_, denominator_], maximumPower_Integer] :=
 Module[{nMinimum, dMinimum, leadingPower, count, d0, quotient = {},
     order, numeratorCoefficient, correction},
  If[numerator === 0, Return[0]];
  nMinimum = Exponent[numerator, ep, Min];
  dMinimum = Exponent[denominator, ep, Min];
  leadingPower = nMinimum - dMinimum;
  count = maximumPower - leadingPower;
  If[count < 0, Return[0]];
  d0 = Coefficient[denominator, ep, dMinimum];
  Do[
    numeratorCoefficient = Coefficient[numerator, ep, nMinimum + order];
    correction = Sum[
      Coefficient[denominator, ep, dMinimum + index] *
        quotient[[order - index + 1]], {index, 1, order}];
    AppendTo[quotient, (numeratorCoefficient - correction)/d0],
    {order, 0, count}];
  Sum[quotient[[order + 1]] ep^(leadingPower + order),
    {order, 0, count}]
];
canonicalCoefficient[expression_] := Factor[Together[expression]];
canonicalMasterPolynomial[expression_] := Module[{rules},
  If[! PolynomialQ[expression, masterVariables],
    fail["Laurent coefficient is not polynomial in the master basis"]];
  rules = CoefficientRules[expression, masterVariables];
  Total @ Map[
    Function[rule, canonicalCoefficient[Last[rule]] *
      Times @@ MapThread[Power, {masterVariables, First[rule]}]], rules]
];
laurentTuple[expression_, label_] := Module[{series, tuple, elapsed},
  elapsed = First @ AbsoluteTiming[
    series = Normal @ Series[expression, {ep, 0, 1}];
    tuple = Association @ Table[
      order -> canonicalMasterPolynomial[Coefficient[series, ep, order]],
      {order, {-1, 0, 1}}]
  ];
  Print[label, "_LAURENT_SECONDS=", N[elapsed, 6]];
  tuple
];

scriptDirectory = DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
root = ExpandFileName @ FileNameJoin[{scriptDirectory, ".."}];
reducedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "real_kira",
  "real_kira_reduced.m"}];
oracleReducedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "real_kira_oracle",
  "real_kira_reduced.m"}];
familyManifestPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "real_families",
  "manifest.json"}];
formPolarizedPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "real",
  "math_RealP.m"}];
subtropicaRoot = FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "subtropica",
  "qqbar_annihilation_real_shifted_masters_v1"}];
subtropicaManifestPath = FileNameJoin[{subtropicaRoot, "manifest.json"}];
candidateDirectory = FileNameJoin[{subtropicaRoot, "candidates"}];
configuredOutput = Environment["QQBAR_REAL_LAURENT_OUTPUT_ROOT"];
outputDirectory = If[StringQ[configuredOutput] &&
    StringLength[configuredOutput] > 0, ExpandFileName[configuredOutput],
  FileNameJoin[{root, "build", "real_nlo"}]];

requiredInputs = {reducedPath, oracleReducedPath, familyManifestPath,
  formPolarizedPath, subtropicaManifestPath};
If[! And @@ (FileExistsQ /@ requiredInputs),
  fail["a Laurent construction input is missing"]];
If[sha256[reducedPath] =!= sha256[oracleReducedPath],
  fail["production and validation-only Kira ledgers differ"]];
familyManifest = Import[familyManifestPath, "RawJSON"];
If[Lookup[familyManifest, "polarized_source_role", ""] =!=
      "production FORM BMHV" ||
    Lookup[Lookup[familyManifest, "source_sha256", <||>],
      "polarized", ""] =!= sha256[formPolarizedPath],
  fail["production Kira ledger is not bound to finalized FORM BMHV"]];
pass["production FORM source and validation-only Kira equality gates pass"];

loadSeconds = First @ AbsoluteTiming[reducedRaw = Get[reducedPath]];
If[! ListQ[reducedRaw] || Length[reducedRaw] =!= 5,
  fail["unexpected FORM/Kira ledger structure"]];
If[! FreeQ[reducedRaw /. _rat -> 0, ep],
  fail["epsilon dependence escaped the FORM rat coefficients"]];
Print["KIRA_LEDGER_LOAD_SECONDS=", N[loadSeconds, 6]];

ratExpansionSeconds = First @ AbsoluteTiming[
  reducedU = reducedRaw[[1]] /.
    coefficient_rat :> rationalSeries[coefficient, 2];
  reducedPOrdinary = reducedRaw[[2]] /.
    coefficient_rat :> rationalSeries[coefficient, 2];
  reducedPHatNormalized = reducedRaw[[5]] /.
    coefficient_rat :> rationalSeries[coefficient, 1]
];
If[! FreeQ[{reducedU, reducedPOrdinary, reducedPHatNormalized}, rat],
  fail["an unexpanded FORM rational function survived"]];
Print["FORM_RAT_EXPANSION_SECONDS=", N[ratExpansionSeconds, 6]];

subtropicaManifest = Quiet @ Check[
  Import[subtropicaManifestPath, "RawJSON"], $Failed];
If[! AssociationQ[subtropicaManifest] ||
    Lookup[subtropicaManifest, "passed", False] =!= True ||
    Lookup[subtropicaManifest, "registry_id", ""] =!=
      "qqbar_annihilation_real_shifted_masters_v1" ||
    Lookup[subtropicaManifest, "backend", ""] =!= "SubTropica" ||
    Lookup[subtropicaManifest, "backend_version", ""] =!= "1.2.10",
  fail["unexpected SubTropica manifest identity"]];

loadCandidate[id_] := Module[{path, held, expectedHash},
  path = FileNameJoin[{candidateDirectory, id <> ".normalized.wl"}];
  expectedHash = subtropicaManifest["normalized_candidate_sha256"][id];
  If[! FileExistsQ[path] || sha256[path] =!= expectedHash,
    fail["SubTropica candidate hash mismatch", id]];
  held = Get[path];
  If[Head[held] =!= HoldComplete || ! FreeQ[held, _Total],
    fail["SubTropica candidate is not a frozen scalar", id]];
  ReleaseHold[held] /. eps -> ep /. Global`z -> z
];
uD = loadCandidate["universal_angular_d0"];
uD2 = loadCandidate["universal_angular_d2"];
uDOracle = -2/(ep z) + (4 + 2 Log[z])/z +
  ep/z (-4 Log[z] - Log[z]^2 - 2 PolyLog[2, 1 - z]);
uD2Oracle = -6 Log[z]/(1 - z);
If[canonicalCoefficient[uD - uDOracle] =!= 0 ||
    canonicalCoefficient[uD2 - uD2Oracle] =!= 0,
  fail["SubTropica angular-master normalization changed"]];
pass["frozen D and D+2 angular masters have the required Laurent depth"];

s23 = s + t + u;
axisData = <|
  "ab" -> {{-(s + t), -(s + u)}, s s23/((s + t) (s + u))},
  "aA" -> {{-(s + t), -(t + u)},
    1 - (-t) s23/((s + t) (-t - u))},
  "ac" -> {{-(s + t), t + u},
    (-t) s23/((s + t) (-t - u))},
  "bA" -> {{-(s + u), -(t + u)},
    1 - (-u) s23/((s + u) (-t - u))},
  "bc" -> {{-(s + u), t + u},
    (-u) s23/((s + u) (-t - u))}
|>;
topSign = <|"ab" -> 1, "aA" -> 1, "ac" -> -1,
  "bA" -> 1, "bc" -> -1|>;
names = {"ab", "aA", "ac", "bA", "bc"};
logSymbols = AssociationThread[names, {lab, laA, lac, lbA, lbc}];
dilogSymbols = AssociationThread[names, {qab, qaA, qac, qbA, qbc}];
masterVariables = Join[Values[logSymbols], Values[dilogSymbols]];
topCandidate[name_, universal_] := Module[
  {scales = axisData[name][[1]], argument = axisData[name][[2]]},
  topSign[name] (universal /. z -> argument)/
    (scales[[1]] scales[[2]])
];
uDPlaceholder[name_] := -2/(ep z) +
  (4 + 2 logSymbols[name])/z +
  ep/z (-4 logSymbols[name] - logSymbols[name]^2 -
    2 dilogSymbols[name]);
uD2Placeholder[name_] := -6 logSymbols[name]/(1 - z);
dRules = {
  abD[1, 1, 0, 0] -> 1,
  abD[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["ab", uDPlaceholder["ab"]],
  aAD[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["aA", uDPlaceholder["aA"]],
  acD[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["ac", uDPlaceholder["ac"]],
  bAD[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["bA", uDPlaceholder["bA"]],
  bcD[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["bc", uDPlaceholder["bc"]]
};
d2Rules = {
  abD2[1, 1, 0, 0] -> 1,
  abD2[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["ab", uD2Placeholder["ab"]],
  aAD2[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["aA", uD2Placeholder["aA"]],
  acD2[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["ac", uD2Placeholder["ac"]],
  bAD2[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["bA", uD2Placeholder["bA"]],
  bcD2[1, 1, 1, 1] -> topCandidate["bc", uD2Placeholder["bc"]]
};
expectedOrdinaryAtoms = First /@ dRules;
expectedShiftedAtoms = First /@ d2Rules;
ordinaryAtoms = DeleteDuplicates @ Cases[reducedU + reducedPOrdinary,
  _abD | _aAD | _acD | _bAD | _bcD, Infinity];
shiftedAtoms = DeleteDuplicates @ Cases[reducedPHatNormalized,
  _abD2 | _aAD2 | _acD2 | _bAD2 | _bcD2, Infinity];
If[Sort[ordinaryAtoms] =!= Sort[expectedOrdinaryAtoms] ||
    Sort[shiftedAtoms] =!= Sort[expectedShiftedAtoms],
  fail["unexpected master support in the Laurent input",
    {ordinaryAtoms, shiftedAtoms}]];

regulatorValuation[expression_] := Module[{cancelled},
  cancelled = Cancel[Together[expression]];
  Exponent[Numerator[cancelled], ep, Min] -
    Exponent[Denominator[cancelled], ep, Min]
];
ordinaryTopValuations = Association @ Map[
  Function[atom, ToString[InputForm[atom]] -> Min[
    regulatorValuation[Coefficient[reducedU, atom]],
    regulatorValuation[Coefficient[reducedPOrdinary, atom]]]],
  Rest[expectedOrdinaryAtoms]];
shiftedTopValuations = Association @ Map[
  Function[atom, ToString[InputForm[atom]] ->
    regulatorValuation[Coefficient[reducedPHatNormalized, atom]]],
  Rest[expectedShiftedAtoms]];
If[Min[Values[ordinaryTopValuations]] < 0 ||
    Min[Values[shiftedTopValuations]] < 1,
  fail["master Laurent depth is insufficient for a Kira coefficient",
    {ordinaryTopValuations, shiftedTopValuations}]];
pass["actual Kira coefficient valuations certify the master truncation"];

kinematicRules = {t -> -s (1 - v), u -> -s v w};
constructionSeconds = First @ AbsoluteTiming[
  angularU = (reducedU /. dRules) /. kinematicRules;
  angularPOrdinary = (reducedPOrdinary /. dRules) /. kinematicRules;
  angularPHat = (reducedPHatNormalized /. d2Rules) /. kinematicRules
];
Print["MASTER_INSERTION_SECONDS=", N[constructionSeconds, 6]];
If[! FreeQ[{angularU, angularPOrdinary, angularPHat},
    _abD | _aAD | _acD | _bAD | _bcD |
    _abD2 | _aAD2 | _acD2 | _bAD2 | _bcD2 | rat],
  fail["a Kira master survived insertion"]];

unpolarizedPlaceholder = laurentTuple[angularU, "UNPOLARIZED"];
polarizedOrdinaryPlaceholder =
  laurentTuple[angularPOrdinary, "POLARIZED_ORDINARY"];
polarizedHatPlaceholder =
  laurentTuple[angularPHat, "POLARIZED_HAT_TARASOV"];
polarizedPlaceholder = Association @ Table[
  order -> canonicalMasterPolynomial[
    polarizedOrdinaryPlaceholder[order] +
      polarizedHatPlaceholder[order]], {order, {-1, 0, 1}}];

masterArguments = Association @ Map[
  Function[name, name -> Together[axisData[name][[2]] /. kinematicRules]],
  names];
specialRules = Flatten @ Map[
  Function[name, {
    logSymbols[name] -> FunctionExpand[Log[masterArguments[name]]],
    dilogSymbols[name] ->
      FunctionExpand[PolyLog[2, 1 - masterArguments[name]]]
  }], names];
materialize[tuple_] := Map[(# /. specialRules) &, tuple];
unpolarized = materialize[unpolarizedPlaceholder];
polarizedOrdinary = materialize[polarizedOrdinaryPlaceholder];
polarizedHat = materialize[polarizedHatPlaceholder];
polarized = materialize[polarizedPlaceholder];
polarizedSectors = <|"ordinary" -> polarizedOrdinary,
  "hat_tarasov" -> polarizedHat|>;

If[polarizedHat[-1] =!= 0 || polarizedHat[0] === 0,
  fail["unexpected BMHV hat/Tarasov Laurent structure"]];
If[! FreeQ[{unpolarized, polarized, polarizedSectors},
    ep | Gamma | Hypergeometric2F1 | EulerGamma |
    _abD | _aAD | _acD | _bAD | _bcD |
    _abD2 | _aAD2 | _acD2 | _bAD2 | _bcD2],
  fail["regulator or unexpanded master survived the Laurent tuples"]];

If[! DirectoryQ[outputDirectory],
  CreateDirectory[outputDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
poleFinite = <|
  "unpolarized" -> <|-1 -> unpolarized[-1], 0 -> unpolarized[0]|>,
  "polarized_total" -> <|-1 -> polarized[-1], 0 -> polarized[0]|>,
  "polarized_ordinary" ->
    <|-1 -> polarizedOrdinary[-1], 0 -> polarizedOrdinary[0]|>,
  "polarized_hat_tarasov" ->
    <|-1 -> polarizedHat[-1], 0 -> polarizedHat[0]|>
|>;
standardRows = Flatten @ {
  Table[<|"component" -> "unpolarized", "sector" -> "ordinary",
    "order" -> order, "coefficient" -> unpolarized[order]|>,
    {order, {-1, 0, 1}}],
  Table[<|"component" -> "polarized", "sector" -> "ordinary",
    "order" -> order, "coefficient" -> polarizedOrdinary[order]|>,
    {order, {-1, 0, 1}}],
  Table[<|"component" -> "polarized", "sector" -> "hat_tarasov",
    "order" -> order, "coefficient" -> polarizedHat[order]|>,
    {order, {-1, 0, 1}}],
  Table[<|"component" -> "polarized", "sector" -> "total",
    "order" -> order, "coefficient" -> polarized[order]|>,
    {order, {-1, 0, 1}}]
};
outputPaths = <|
  "unpolarized" -> FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory,
    "unpolarized_real_angular_laurent.wl"}],
  "polarized" -> FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory,
    "polarized_real_angular_laurent.wl"}],
  "polarized_sectors" -> FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory,
    "polarized_real_angular_sector_laurent.wl"}],
  "pole_finite" -> FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory,
    "real_angular_pole_finite.wl"}],
  "standard_rows" -> FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory,
    "real_angular_standard_basis_rows.wl"}]
|>;
Export[outputPaths["unpolarized"],
  ToString[InputForm[unpolarized]], "Text"];
Export[outputPaths["polarized"],
  ToString[InputForm[polarized]], "Text"];
Export[outputPaths["polarized_sectors"],
  ToString[InputForm[polarizedSectors]], "Text"];
Export[outputPaths["pole_finite"],
  ToString[InputForm[poleFinite]], "Text"];
Export[outputPaths["standard_rows"],
  ToString[InputForm[standardRows]], "Text"];

manifest = <|
  "schema_version" -> 1,
  "contract" -> "qqbar-annihilation-real-angular-laurent-v1",
  "source_role" -> "production FORM BMHV",
  "kinematics" -> <|
    "invariant_map" -> "t=-s(1-v), u=-s v w",
    "physical_region" -> "s>0, 0<v<1, 0<w<1"|>,
  "coupling_symbol" -> "gs",
  "color_symbol" -> "Nc",
  "orders" -> {-1, 0, 1},
  "sectors" -> {"unpolarized", "polarized_ordinary",
    "polarized_hat_tarasov", "polarized_total"},
  "production_kira_sha256" -> sha256[reducedPath],
  "validation_oracle_kira_sha256" -> sha256[oracleReducedPath],
  "production_equals_validation_oracle" -> True,
  "form_polarized_sha256" -> sha256[formPolarizedPath],
  "subtropica_manifest_sha256" -> sha256[subtropicaManifestPath],
  "ordinary_top_valuations" -> ordinaryTopValuations,
  "shifted_top_valuations" -> shiftedTopValuations,
  "hat_shift" -> "ep(s+t+u)/(2(3-2ep))",
  "endpoint_or_factorization_included" -> False,
  "artifact_sha256" -> Map[sha256, outputPaths],
  "passed" -> True
|>;
Export[FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory, "manifest.json"}], manifest,
  "RawJSON"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{outputDirectory, "real_laurent_receipt.wl"}],
  ToString[InputForm[<|
    "manifest" -> manifest,
    "families" -> names,
    "master_arguments" -> masterArguments,
    "polarized_total_is_ordinary_plus_hat" -> True,
    "validation_scope" ->
      "same-target live FeynCalc is validation-only; production coefficients originate in FORM"
  |>]], "Text"];
pass["exported production real angular Laurent ledger through ep^1"];
Quit[0];

```

## common/s12_result/reference/s12_transverse_endpoint_accepted_14822951.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-408", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 14532, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s12_result/reference/s12_transverse_endpoint_accepted_14822951.wls", "sha256": "c92ce6bc629f18493619dbbf850267fded825d3a6683c96a3c6df70a27ad1fbe"} -->
```wolfram
(* Separate the measured transverse root before the pinned polynomial endpoint. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
transverseEndpointPath=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_transverse_endpoint.wls"}];
transverseEndpointBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s12_assemble_real_reference_recoil.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[transverseEndpointBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!="9fb68f329aac43cf66ebfbf23f9b9fb4f590bd255dc78743840eb0093850ac42",Quit[1]];
transverseEndpointText=Import[transverseEndpointBase,"Text"];
transverseEndpointBoundary="\nToExpression[referenceRecoilRun,InputForm];";
If[StringCount[transverseEndpointText,transverseEndpointBoundary]=!=1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[transverseEndpointPath,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[transverseEndpointText,transverseEndpointBoundary]],InputForm];
gate["single inherited transverse-coordinate rule",MatchQ[transverseRule,_Rule] && MatchQ[Last[transverseRule],_Power]];
transverseEndpointSymbol=First[transverseRule];transverseEndpointRoot=Last[transverseRule];
transverseEndpointOriginal=DownValues[softRows];
DownValues[transverseEndpointPriorRows]=transverseEndpointOriginal/.HoldPattern[softRows]->transverseEndpointPriorRows;
gate["unchanged unsupported endpoint fallback",(DownValues[transverseEndpointPriorRows]/.HoldPattern[transverseEndpointPriorRows]->softRows)===transverseEndpointOriginal];
transverseRootData[sign_] := transverseRootData[sign] = Module[{rootValue,endpoint,valuation},
  rootValue=transverseEndpointRoot/.t->sign omega-s;

referenceSeriesTail=transverseOutputTail;
ToExpression[transverseEndpointRun,InputForm];
```

## common/s12_result/reference/s17_assemble_real.wl

```wolfram
Get[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[$InputFileName],"..","common","s22_paths.wl"}]];
(* Assemble the new real cut integrals in the inherited distribution convention. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
root=sidisRoot;
gate[name_,test_] := If[!TrueQ[test],Print["FAIL: ",name];
  If[$KernelID>0,Throw[$Failed,"S17Failure"],CloseKernels[];Quit[1]]];
put[value_,file_] := (Put[value,file<>".tmp"];RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True]);
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[label<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,gate[label<>" memory limit",False]];
inputs=sidisGet[sidisPath[{root,"s08_result.wl"}]];
evaluations=sidisGet[sidisPath[{root,"s10_result.wl"}]];
manifest=sidisGet[sidisPath[{root,"s11_result.wl"}]];
regions=sidisGet[sidisPath[{root,"s15_result.wl"}]];
gate["accepted new cut evaluations and regions",TrueQ[inputs["AcceptedRepresentations"]]&&
  TrueQ[evaluations["CutNormalizationAccepted"]]&&TrueQ[manifest["Accepted"]]&&
  TrueQ[regions["AcceptedCutMasterRegions"]]];
sourceHash=sidisHash[$InputFileName,"SHA256"];
inputHashes=Association@Table[name->sidisHash[sidisPath[{root,name}],"SHA256"],
  {name,{"s08_result.wl","s10_result.wl","s11_result.wl","s15_result.wl"}}];
gate["region inputs match the current cut evaluations",KeyTake[inputHashes,Keys[regions["InputHashes"]]]===regions["InputHashes"]];
inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,inputHashes},"SHA256"];
branchAssumptions[sign_] := Q2>0&&s>0&&omega>0&&B>0&&
  -Q2-s<sign omega-s<0&&SUNN>1&&Nc>1;
reduce[value_,assumptions_] := Module[{refined,functions},
  refined=Refine[value,assumptions];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[refined,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  Collect[Expand[refined],functions,Factor]];
epsilonSeries[value_,order_,label_] := Module[{series},
  series=bounded[Series[value,{eps,0,order}],label];
  gate[label<>" regulator coverage",FreeQ[series,eps|_SeriesData|_Series]||(MatchQ[series,_SeriesData]&&series[[5]]>order)];
  Normal[series]];
endpointIntegral=Integrate[rr^(-1-kap ep),{rr,0,B},
  Assumptions->kap>0&&ep<0&&B>0,GenerateConditions->False];
gate["regulated endpoint integral evaluated",FreeQ[endpointIntegral,_Integrate|_ConditionalExpression]];
logKernel=Normal[Series[Exp[-kap ep ellLog],{ep,0,2}]];
laurentProduct[laurent_,kernel_,order_] := Module[{polynomial=Expand[laurent],first,last},
  If[polynomial===0,Return[0]];
  first=Exponent[polynomial,eps,Min];last=Exponent[polynomial,eps];
  Total@Table[eps^n Coefficient[polynomial,eps,n] Normal[Series[kernel,{eps,0,order-n}]],{n,first,last}]];

softPieces[master_,sign_] := softPieces[master,sign]=Module[
  {data,metadata,assumptions,replacement,power,prefactor,value,pieces={},entry,
   definition,parameterRules,lambdaForm,lambdaPower,lambdaRegular,totalPower,regular},
  data=inputs["Masters"][master];metadata=regions["Masters"][master];
  assumptions=branchAssumptions[sign]&&w>0;
  replacement=t->sign omega-s;
  power=metadata["PrefactorSoftPower"];
  prefactor=bounded[FullSimplify[(data["RegulatedPrefactor"]/w^power)/.replacement,
    assumptions&&Element[eps,Reals]],"remove regulated cut recoil power"];
  If[metadata["DivergentParameters"]==={},
    value=(evaluations["Classes"][data["Class"]]["Series"]/.SubTropica`eps->eps)/.
      data["PhysicalSubstitutions"]/.replacement;
    Return[{<|"Power"->power,"Regular"->prefactor value|>}]];
  definition=regions["RegionMasterMap"][master]["ParameterDefinition"];
  parameterRules=Solve[First[definition]==Last[definition],SubTropica`\[Lambda]];
  gate["unique physical soft-region parameter",Length[parameterRules]===1];
  lambdaForm=Factor[SubTropica`\[Lambda]/.First[parameterRules]/.data["PhysicalSubstitutions"]/.replacement];
  lambdaPower=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[w D[lambdaForm,w]/lambdaForm,w->0,
    Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]],branchAssumptions[sign]],"region recoil valuation"];
  gate["region recoil valuation is a positive integer",IntegerQ[lambdaPower]&&lambdaPower>0];
  lambdaRegular=Factor[lambdaForm/w^lambdaPower];
  gate["region expansion remains on its positive physical side",
    FullSimplify[Limit[lambdaRegular,w->0,Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]]>0,
      branchAssumptions[sign]]];
  Do[
    value=regions["RegionValues"][entry["IntegralID"]]["Series"];
    If[value===0,Continue[]];
    totalPower=Expand[power+lambdaPower(entry["LambdaPower"]/.SubTropica`eps->eps)];
    regular=prefactor lambdaRegular^(entry["LambdaPower"]/.SubTropica`eps->eps) value;
    AppendTo[pieces,<|"Power"->totalPower,"Regular"->regular,"Region"->entry["Region"]|>],
    {entry,regions["RegionMasterMap"][master]["Entries"]}];pieces];

pieceEndpoint[piece_,sign_] := pieceEndpoint[piece,sign]=bounded[
  FullSimplify[Limit[piece["Regular"],w->0,Direction->"FromAbove",
    Assumptions->branchAssumptions[sign]&&Element[eps,Reals]],
    branchAssumptions[sign]&&Element[eps,Reals]],"regular master endpoint"];
softRows[coefficient_,piece_,sign_] := Module[
  {power=piece["Power"],integerPower,kappa,rational,valuation,firstPower,leading,value},
  integerPower=power/.eps->0;kappa=-Coefficient[power,eps];
  gate["regulated soft power is affine with integer recoil degree",
    IntegerQ[integerPower]&&PolynomialQ[power,eps]&&Exponent[power,eps]<=1];
  rational=Cancel[coefficient/.t->sign omega-s];
  valuation=Exponent[Numerator[rational],w,Min]-Exponent[Denominator[rational],w,Min];
  firstPower=valuation+integerPower;
  If[firstPower>=0,Return[{}]];
  gate["measured recoil degree needs only a leading endpoint coefficient",firstPower===-1];
  leading=Factor[Cancel[w^(-valuation)rational]/.w->0];
  gate["rational endpoint coefficient is finite",FreeQ[leading,w|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity|_DirectedInfinity]];
  value=epsilonSeries[(leading/.D->4-2eps)pieceEndpoint[piece,sign],1,"leading soft epsilon coefficient"];
  value=bounded[reduce[value,branchAssumptions[sign]],"leading endpoint collection"];
  gate["endpoint coefficients are fully evaluated",FreeQ[value,w|_Limit|_Derivative|_Series|_SeriesData|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
  If[value===0,{},{{kappa,firstPower,value}}]];

assemble[channel_,key_,component_,channelHash_] := Catch[Module[
  {hash,directory,file,saved,coefficients,ordinary,terms,branches,sign,rows,groups,combined,
   assumptions,endpoints,delta,plus,regular,value,result,master},
  hash=Hash[{inputHash,channelHash,key},"SHA256"];
  directory=sidisPath[{root,channel,"s17_cache",IntegerString[hash,16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
  file=sidisPath[{directory,"s17_result.wl"}];
  If[FileExistsQ[file],saved=sidisGet[file];If[saved["InputHash"]===hash&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]],Return[saved]]];
  Print["REAL_ASSEMBLY ",channel," ",key," kernel ",$KernelID];
  coefficients=Select[component["Coefficients"],#=!=0&];
  terms=KeyValueMap[Function[{m,c},epsilonSeries[(c/.D->4-2eps)regions["OrdinaryMasters"][m],0,
    "ordinary cut coefficient"]],coefficients];
  ordinary=Total[terms];
  gate["ordinary cut contraction is symbolic and evaluated",FreeQ[ordinary,_CutIntegral|_SeriesData|_Series|_Integrate|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
  branches=Association@Table[
    Print["REAL_ENDPOINT ",channel," ",key," branch ",sign];
    assumptions=branchAssumptions[sign];rows={};
    Do[rows=Join[rows,Flatten[softRows[coefficients[master],#,sign]& /@softPieces[master,sign],1]],
      {master,Keys[coefficients]}];
    groups=GatherBy[rows,Take[#,2]&];
    combined=Table[{group[[1,1]],group[[1,2]],bounded[reduce[Total[group[[All,3]]],assumptions],
      "combine recoil coefficients"]},{group,groups}];
    put[<|"Rows"->rows,"Combined"->combined,"InputHash"->hash|>,
      sidisPath[{directory,"s17_soft_"<>ToString[sign]<>".wl"}]];
    Do[If[row[[2]]<-1,gate["stronger recoil singularities cancel",
      bounded[FullSimplify[row[[3]],assumptions],"stronger recoil cancellation"]===0]],{row,combined}];
    endpoints=Select[combined,#[[2]]===-1&&Last[#]=!=0&];
    gate["endpoint regulator has the defining convergence orientation",And@@(TrueQ[#[[1]]>0]& /@endpoints)];
    delta=bounded[reduce[Total[laurentProduct[#[[3]],endpointIntegral/.{kap->#[[1]],ep->eps},0]& /@endpoints],
      assumptions],"delta coefficient"];
    plus=Table[bounded[reduce[Total[laurentProduct[#[[3]],B^(-#[[1]]eps)
      (Coefficient[logKernel,ellLog,n]/.{kap->#[[1]],ep->eps}),0]& /@endpoints],assumptions],
      "plus coefficient"],{n,0,2}];
    gate["no higher logarithmic plus distribution survives",Factor[plus[[3]]]===0];
    regular=(ordinary/.t->sign omega-s)-Total[laurentProduct[#[[3]],w^(-1-#[[1]]eps),0]& /@endpoints];
    value=<|"Delta"->delta,"L0"->plus[[1]],"L1"->plus[[2]],"Regular"->regular,
      "SoftCoefficients"->endpoints,"Assumptions"->assumptions|>;
    put[value,sidisPath[{directory,"s17_branch_"<>ToString[sign]<>".wl"}]];
    sign->value,{sign,{1,-1}}];
  result=<|"Channel"->channel,"TensorKey"->key,"Ordinary"->ordinary,"Branches"->branches,
    "InputHash"->hash,"CoefficientHash"->channelHash,"SourceHash"->sourceHash,"Accepted"->True|>;
  put[result,file];ClearSystemCache[];Print["REAL_ASSEMBLY_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",key];result],"S17Failure"];
slots=Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]],1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots]||slots<1,slots=1];CloseKernels[];
If[slots>1,LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost","KernelCommand"->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel","KernelCount"->Min[4,slots],"TimeConstraint"->60]]];
workers=Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers>0,ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength=0];DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,
  branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,softPieces,pieceEndpoint,softRows,assemble,
  root,inputHash,sourceHash,inputs,evaluations,regions,endpointIntegral,logKernel]];
$DistributedContexts=None;outputs=<||>;
Do[
  file=sidisPath[{root,channel,"s11_result.wl"}];data=sidisGet[file];
  hash=sidisHash[file,"SHA256"];
  gate[channel<>" coefficient identity",TrueQ[data["Accepted"]]&&hash===manifest["Channels"][channel]["Hash"]];
  tasks=KeyValueMap[{channel,#1,#2,hash}&,data["Components"]];
  values=If[workers>0,ParallelMap[assemble@@#&,tasks,Method->"FinestGrained"],assemble@@#& /@tasks];
  gate[channel<>" all real components assembled",FreeQ[values,$Failed|$Aborted]&&And@@Lookup[values,"Accepted"]];
  result=<|"Channel"->channel,"Real"->AssociationThread[Keys[data["Components"]],values],
    "Measure"->inputs["MasterMeasure"],"PhaseAndWeightsApplied"->False,
    "PlusDefinition"->"Ln=[Log[w/B]^n/w]_+ on [0,B]","BranchMap"->(t->sign omega-s),
    "Regulator"->eps,"SourceHash"->sourceHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"Accepted"->True|>;
  file=sidisPath[{root,channel,"s17_result.wl"}];put[result,file];
  AssociateTo[outputs,channel-><|"File"->channel<>"/s17_result.wl","Hash"->sidisHash[file,"SHA256"]|>];
  Clear[data,tasks,values,result];ClearSystemCache[],{channel,Keys[manifest["Channels"]]}];
CloseKernels[];
put[<|"Channels"->outputs,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"SourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "AcceptedCutDistributions"->True,"FinalHatsAssembled"->False|>,sidisPath[{root,"s17_result.wl"}]];
Print["S17_SUCCESS: new cut-measure real distributions assembled for all six channels."];
Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
(* Preserve the accepted virtual pipeline; refine its exact UV residual. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
refinedSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s13_assemble_virtual_refined.wls"}];
refinedBaseline = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[refinedBaseline, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
 "44bc4684e7aa164e7d9e0928bb2572c7f7ea146e8215653516fef6bf1e729989", Quit[1]];
refinedText = Import[refinedBaseline, "Text"];
refinedBoundary = StringPosition[refinedText, "\nkeys = Keys[mapped[\"Components\"]];"];
If[Length[refinedBoundary] =!= 1 || !SyntaxQ[Import[refinedSource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
refinedPrefix = StringTake[refinedText, First[First[refinedBoundary]] - 1];
refinedTail = StringDrop[refinedText, First[First[refinedBoundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[refinedPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[refinedTail], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[refinedPrefix, InputForm];
refinedProofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqg", "s13_branch_result", "s13_result.wl"}];
refinedReceipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqg", "s13_branch_result", "s13_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
gate["accepted residual refinement receipt", TrueQ[refinedReceipt["passed"]] &&
 refinedReceipt["result_sha256"]["Hqg/s13_branch_result/s13_result.wl"] === IntegerString[FileHash[refinedProofPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64]];
refinedProof = Get[refinedProofPath];
gate["accepted physical residual refinement", refinedProof["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-uv-branch-comparison-v1" &&
 TrueQ[refinedProof["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[refinedProof["Checks"]] &&
 refinedProof["RefinedOriginalResidual"] === 0 && refinedProof["RefinedSumResidual"] === 0];
gate["refinement source and physical conventions", refinedProof["BaselineSourceHash"] === FileHash[refinedBaseline, "SHA256"] &&
 IntegerString[refinedProof["SourceHash"], 16, 64] === "55494a9171c36213d476b2f518a748d7f8023921e98dc51124c6461dd7f5348a" &&
 refinedProof["PhysicalConditions"] === physical && refinedProof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
gate["refinement uses these exact Hqg inputs", channel === refinedProof["Channel"] && refinedProof["InputHashes"] === inputHashes];
DownValues[refineUVResidual] = refinedProof["Definitions"];
gate["executed residual refinement installed", DownValues[refineUVResidual] === refinedProof["Definitions"]];
refinedGate = "      gate[\"complete UV cancellation \" <> ToString[key, InputForm], residual === 0];";
refinedMetadata = "put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, \"s13_result.wl\"}]];";
gate["unique original residual gate and output", StringCount[refinedTail, refinedGate] === 1 && StringCount[refinedTail, refinedMetadata] === 1];
refinedProgram = StringReplace[refinedTail, {
 refinedGate -> ("      residual = bounded[refineUVResidual[residual], {key, \"physical UV residual refinement\"}];\n" <> refinedGate),
 refinedMetadata -> ("result = Join[result, <|\"DispatchSourceHash\" -> FileHash[refinedSource, \"SHA256\"], \"ResidualRefinementHash\" -> FileHash[refinedProofPath, \"SHA256\"]|>];\n" <> refinedMetadata)}];
gate["complete refined assembly syntax", SyntaxQ[refinedProgram]];
ToExpression[refinedProgram, InputForm];
```

## common/s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-412", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 34551, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls", "sha256": "44bc4684e7aa164e7d9e0928bb2572c7f7ea146e8215653516fef6bf1e729989"} -->
```wolfram
(* Physical loop integration and the reference auxiliary-mass UV subtraction. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
validationOnly = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VALIDATE_ONLY"] === "1";
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; If[TrueQ[$KernelID > 0], Throw[$Failed, "S13Failure"], CloseKernels[]; Quit[1]]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
(* BEGIN VIRTUAL RESOURCE LIMIT *)
virtualTimeSetting = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VIRTUAL_SECONDS"];
If[virtualTimeSetting === $Failed || virtualTimeSetting === "", virtualTimeLimit = 1200,
  gate["integer virtual operation time limit", StringQ[virtualTimeSetting] && StringMatchQ[virtualTimeSetting, DigitCharacter ..]];
  virtualTimeLimit = FromDigits[virtualTimeSetting]];
gate["bounded virtual operation time limit", IntegerQ[virtualTimeLimit] && 0 < virtualTimeLimit <= 10800];
Print["VIRTUAL_RESOURCE_LIMIT_SECONDS ", virtualTimeLimit];
(* END VIRTUAL RESOURCE LIMIT *)
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, virtualTimeLimit,
  gate["time bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_inputs.json"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
Do[gate["pinned assembly input " <> row["destination"], IntegerString[
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, row["destination"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]], {row, config["files"]}];
referenceRoot = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_result", "reference"}];
referenceVirtual = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "Hqq_virtual.wl"}]];
physicalMasters = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s19_masters.wl"}]];
originalAssemblyHash = FileHash[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s19_assemble_virtual.wl"}], "SHA256"];
gate["accepted original physical assembly", TrueQ[referenceVirtual["Accepted"]] &&
  referenceVirtual["SourceHash"] === originalAssemblyHash &&
  referenceVirtual["MasterFile"] === config["original_master_file"]];
gate["physical master input binding", physicalMasters["InputHash"] ===
  Hash[{originalAssemblyHash, referenceVirtual["InputHashes"]}, "SHA256"]];
gate["accepted physical continuation records", AllTrue[physicalMasters["ContinuationRecords"],
  TrueQ[#["Accepted"]] && #["SourceHash"] === originalAssemblyHash &&
    #["InputHash"] === physicalMasters["InputHash"] &&
    #["Series"] === physicalMasters["Masters"][#["Master"]] &]];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
library = Get[libraryPath];
gate["accepted scalar library", library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
geometry = readLibrary["s02"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
parents = readLibrary["s12"];
uv = readLibrary["s14"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
Do[gate["physical assembly original input " <> stage,
  referenceVirtual["InputHashes"][stage <> "_result.wl"] ===
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"][stage]["File"]}], "SHA256"]],
  {stage, {"s12", "s13", "s14"}}];
uvReduction = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s14_reduction.wl"}]] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
masterValues = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s14_master_values.wl"}]] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
gate["unchanged master parent inventory", Sort[Keys[physicalMasters["Masters"]]] === Sort[Keys[parents["VirtualMasterParents"]]]];
gate["accepted auxiliary UV reduction", TrueQ[uvReduction["Accepted"]] &&
  uvReduction["InputHash"] === uv["InputHash"] && uvReduction["SourceHash"] === uv["SourceHash"]];
gate["complete auxiliary master values", Sort[Keys[masterValues]] === Sort[uvReduction["Masters"]] &&
  AllTrue[Values[masterValues], MatchQ[#, _SeriesData] &]];
virtualConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s07_inputs.json"}];
virtualConfig = Import[virtualConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["core virtual channel", KeyExistsQ[virtualConfig["channels"], channel]];
referencePath = FileNameJoin[{root, virtualConfig["channels"][channel]["destination"]}];
gate["pinned original virtual integrands", IntegerString[FileHash[referencePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  virtualConfig["channels"][channel]["sha256"]];
reference = Get[referencePath];
gate["accepted original virtual map", TrueQ[reference["Accepted"]]];
physical = Q > 0 && s > 0 && t < 0 && Q^2 + s + t > 0 && mu > 0 && SUNN > 1;
reduce[value_] := Module[{refined, functions},
  refined = Refine[value, physical];
  functions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[refined, _Log | _PolyLog | _Re | _Im, Infinity]];
  Collect[Expand[refined], functions, Factor]];

(* BEGIN UNCHANGED REFERENCE UV MAP *)
external={p,q,k1};externalGram=geometry["CommonGram"][[1;;3,1;;3]] /. w->0;
setKinematics[] := (FCClearScalarProducts[];
  Do[With[{left=external[[i]],right=external[[j]],value=externalGram[[i,j]]},
    SPD[left,right]=value],{i,Length[external]},{j,i,Length[external]}]);
setKinematics[];
loopProducts=FCI[SPD[ell,#]]& /@ Prepend[external,ell];
loopVariables=Array[uvx,Length[loopProducts]];
scalarRules=Thread[loopProducts->loopVariables];
coordinateVariables=Array[uvz,Length[loopProducts]];
families=<|
  "OS"-><|"Momenta"->{ell,ell+p,ell+q,ell+k1},"Masses"->{0,0,0,0}|>,
  "SE"-><|"Momenta"->{ell,ell+q,ell+p,ell+k1},"Masses"->{0,0,0,0}|>,
  "UV"-><|"Momenta"->{ell,ell+p,ell+q,ell+k1},"Masses"->{M2,M2,M2,M2}|>|>;
familyMaps=Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{id,data},Module[{polynomials,solution},
  polynomials=MapThread[ExpandScalarProduct[FCI[SPD[#1,#1]]]-#2 &,
    {data["Momenta"],data["Masses"]}] /. scalarRules;
  solution=Solve[Thread[polynomials==coordinateVariables],loopVariables];
  gate[id<>" unique loop scalar coordinate map",Length[solution]===1];
  id-><|"Polynomials"->polynomials,"Rules"->First[solution]|>]],families];
mapScalar[expression_,id_] := Module[{mapped,terms,coefficient,powers,values,reconstructed},
  If[expression===0,Return[<||>]];
  mapped=Expand[Cancel[expression /. familyMaps[id]["Rules"]]];
  terms=If[Head[mapped]===Plus,List@@mapped,{mapped}];
  values=Map[Function[term,
    powers=Table[Exponent[Numerator[Together[term]],z]-Exponent[Denominator[Together[term]],z],
      {z,coordinateVariables}];
    coefficient=Factor[term/(Times@@(coordinateVariables^powers))];
    gate[id<>" scalar coefficient has no loop coordinates",FreeQ[coefficient,Alternatives@@coordinateVariables]];
    GLI[id,-powers]->coefficient],terms];
  values=Map[Factor[Together[#]]&,Merge[Association /@ values,Total]];
  reconstructed=Total[KeyValueMap[#2 Times@@(familyMaps[id]["Polynomials"]^(-#1[[2]]))&,values]];
  gate[id<>" exact scalar-integrand reconstruction",zero[reconstructed-expression]];values];
toScalars[value_] := Factor[Together[ExpandScalarProduct[FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit[value]] /. scalarRules]];
uvExpansion[value_,label_] := Module[{rational,scaling,series,firstPower,pieces,regularized},
  rational=toScalars[value];If[rational===0,Return[<||>]];
  gate[label<>" closed scalar loop integrand",FreeQ[rational,_Pair|_FeynAmpDenominator|ell]];
  scaling=Thread[loopVariables->MapIndexed[#1 lam^(-If[First[#2]===1,2,1])&,loopVariables]];
  series=bounded[Normal[Series[rational /. scaling,{lam,0,4}]],label<>" UV expansion"];
  If[series===0,Return[<||>]];
  firstPower=Exponent[series,lam,Min];
  pieces=Association@Table[power->Factor[Coefficient[series,lam,power]],{power,firstPower,4}];
  regularized=Map[Function[piece,Expand[piece] /.
    Power[uvx[1],n_Integer /; n<0] :> (uvx[1]-M2)^n],pieces];
  gate[label<>" auxiliary mass leaves logarithmic asymptotics unchanged",
    zero[Coefficient[Normal[Series[(regularized[4]-pieces[4]) /. scaling,{lam,0,4}]],lam,4]]];
  Association@KeyValueMap[#1->mapScalar[#2,"UV"]&,regularized]];
(* END UNCHANGED REFERENCE UV MAP *)

uvSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "reference", "sources", "s14_uv_residues.wl"}];
originalUVText = Import[uvSource, "Text"];
originalUVBlock = StringTake[originalUVText, {First[First[StringPosition[originalUVText, "external={p,q,k1};"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[originalUVText, "(* Generate the two-point functions"]]] - 1}];
ownText = Import[sourcePath, "Text"];
(* BEGIN VIRTUAL RESOURCE VERIFICATION *)
resourcePreviousPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_result", "reference", "s13_assemble_virtual_spin_before_resource_resume.wls"}];
gate["pinned pre-resource virtual implementation", IntegerString[FileHash[resourcePreviousPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  "cb690814cc4ae374503ac0f6af01a435e0f37a6076cc6cac081e483fee867c7f"];
resourceSlice[text_, start_, end_] := StringTake[text,
  {First[First[StringPosition[text, start]]], Last[First[StringPosition[text, end]]]}];
resourceSetupBlock = resourceSlice[ownText, "\n(* BEGIN VIRTUAL RESOURCE LIMIT *)", "\n(* END VIRTUAL RESOURCE LIMIT *)"];

  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s13_assemble_virtual_spin"]; Quit[0];

```

<a id="source-413"></a>

## common/s13_check_uv_branches.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-413", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3751, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s13_check_uv_branches.wls", "sha256": "55494a9171c36213d476b2f518a748d7f8023921e98dc51124c6461dd7f5348a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Check physical-domain simplification on the exported failed UV equation. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[]; checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test], Print["PASS: ", name]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
source = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_check_uv_branches.wls"}];
baseline = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls"}];
inspectionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqg", "s13_uv_inspection_result", "s13_result.wl"}];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[source, "Text"]]];
gate["pinned production source", IntegerString[FileHash[baseline, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "44bc4684e7aa164e7d9e0928bb2572c7f7ea146e8215653516fef6bf1e729989"];
gate["pinned actual failed equation", IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "91c455e0a0e7e246a37d3ecb526dc3e2d172e5f179692f7f61b125b95a37cca5"];
inspection = Get[inspectionPath]; terms = inspection["Terms"];
gate["accepted inspection", TrueQ[inspection["InspectionComplete"]] && And @@ Values[inspection["Checks"]]];
physicalLine = Select[StringSplit[Import[baseline, "Text"], "\n"], StringStartsQ[#, "physical = "] &];
gate["unique inherited physical assumptions", Length[physicalLine] === 1];
ToExpression[First[physicalLine], InputForm];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 300, gate["time bound " <> label, False]], 2*1024^3, gate["memory bound " <> label, False]];
refineUVResidual[value_] := FullSimplify[Refine[Factor[Together[value]], physical], physical, TimeConstraint -> 120];
{seconds, originalResidual} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[refineUVResidual[terms["Residual"]], "original UV residual"]];
Print["ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_RESIDUAL ", InputForm[originalResidual]];
gate["original residual is zero on physical domain", originalResidual === 0];
actualSum = Coefficient[Expand[(terms["HermitianUV"] + terms["ExternalUV"] + terms["CountertermUV"])/epsUV], epsUV, -1] /. eps -> 0;
initialResidual = bounded[FullSimplify[actualSum, physical], "unchanged initial UV simplification"];
refinedSumResidual = bounded[refineUVResidual[initialResidual], "complete actual UV sum"];
Print["ACTUAL_COMPLETE_UV_RESIDUAL ", InputForm[refinedSumResidual]];
gate["actual Hermitian and counterterm sum vanishes", refinedSumResidual === 0];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-uv-branch-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> "Hqg", "Key" -> inspection["Key"],
 "OriginalResidual" -> terms["Residual"], "RefinedOriginalResidual" -> originalResidual,
 "InitialSumResidual" -> initialResidual, "RefinedSumResidual" -> refinedSumResidual,
 "Definitions" -> DownValues[refineUVResidual], "PhysicalConditions" -> physical, "ElapsedSeconds" -> seconds,
 "SourceHash" -> FileHash[source, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[baseline, "SHA256"],
 "InspectionHash" -> FileHash[inspectionPath, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inspection["InputHashes"],
 "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
directory = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqg", "s13_branch_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
path = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s13_result.wl"}]; Put[result, path];
gate["exact native reload", Get[path] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s13_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "accepted" -> True|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s13_check_uv_branches"]; Quit[0];

```
<!-- END SOURCE -->

<a id="source-414"></a>

## common/s13_extend_uv_reduction.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-414", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 16111, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s13_extend_uv_reduction.wls", "sha256": "d04c5cc50a2cf597c35e2d2952a83a066d86d45700dfce33f0c02de38e53a0e2"} -->
```wolfram
(* Extend the original auxiliary UV reduction for recorded polarized targets. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[]; checks = <||>;
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_extend_uv_reduction.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  gate["time bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"]; RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s13_uv_reduction_result"}];
configPath = FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_inputs.json"}];
settings = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["owned extension inputs", settings["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-uv-extension-inputs-v1" && settings["channel"] === channel];
Do[gate["pinned missing-target packet " <> row["file"],
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, row["file"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]], {row, settings["files"]}];
packets = Get[FileNameJoin[{root, #["file"]}]] & /@ settings["files"];
gate["recorded missing targets", Length[packets] > 0 && AllTrue[packets,
  AssociationQ[#] && MatchQ[#["MissingTargets"], {__GLI}] && AssociationQ[#["Coefficients"]] &]];
mappingInputHashes = DeleteDuplicates[Lookup[packets, "InputHash"]];
gate["one exact source calculation", Length[mappingInputHashes] === 1 && IntegerQ[First[mappingInputHashes]]];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
library = Get[libraryPath];
gate["accepted scalar library", library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
geometry = readLibrary["s02"]; uv = readLibrary["s14"];
assemblyConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_inputs.json"}];
assemblyConfig = Import[assemblyConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
Do[gate["pinned UV reference " <> row["destination"], IntegerString[
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, row["destination"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]], {row, assemblyConfig["files"]}];
baselinePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_result", "reference", "s14_reduction.wl"}];
mastersPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_result", "reference", "s14_master_values.wl"}];
baseline = Get[baselinePath]; masterValues = Get[mastersPath];
originalSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "reference", "sources", "s14_uv_residues.wl"}];
gate["accepted original auxiliary reduction", TrueQ[baseline["Accepted"]] && baseline["InputHash"] === uv["InputHash"] &&
  baseline["SourceHash"] === uv["SourceHash"] && uv["SourceHash"] === FileHash[originalSource, "SHA256"]];
gate["accepted original auxiliary masters", Sort[Keys[masterValues]] === Sort[baseline["Masters"]] &&
  AllTrue[Values[masterValues], MatchQ[#, _SeriesData] &]];
families = baseline["Families"]; names = Sort[Keys[families]];
gate["unchanged recorded auxiliary families", AllTrue[packets,
  #["Families"] === Map[KeyTake[#, {"Momenta", "Masses"}] &, families] &]];
external = geometry["ExternalMomenta"];
externalGram = Take[geometry["CommonGram"], {1, Length[external]}, {1, Length[external]}] /. w -> 0;
additionalTargets = Union[Flatten[Lookup[packets, "MissingTargets"]]];
targets = Union[baseline["Targets"], First /@ baseline["Rules"], baseline["Masters"], additionalTargets];
gate["recorded coefficient target coverage", AllTrue[packets, Complement[Keys[#["Coefficients"]], targets] === {} &]];
gate["inherited target families", Complement[targets[[All, 1]], names] === {}];
kira = settings["kira"]["path"]; fermat = settings["fermat"]["path"];
Do[gate["reviewed executable " <> name, IntegerString[FileHash[settings[name]["path"], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === settings[name]["sha256"]],
  {name, {"kira", "fermat"}}];
SetEnvironment["FERMATPATH" -> fermat];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputPaths = Join[{configPath, libraryPath, assemblyConfigPath, baselinePath, mastersPath, originalSource},
  (FileNameJoin[{root, #["file"]}] &) /@ settings["files"],
  (FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"][#]["File"]}] &) /@ {"s02", "s14"}];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ inputPaths];
inputHash = Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes, FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"]}, "SHA256"];
mapWork = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s13_uv_extension", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
work = FileNameJoin[{mapWork, "s14_kira"}]; config = FileNameJoin[{work, "config"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[config], CreateDirectory[config, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[<|"Packets" -> packets, "Families" -> families, "Targets" -> targets, "InputHash" -> inputHash,
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash|>, FileNameJoin[{mapWork, "s14_scalar_maps.wl"}]];
originalText = Import[originalSource, "Text"]; ownText = Import[sourcePath, "Text"];
originalBlock = StringTake[originalText, {First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "text[expression_] :="]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "\nreduction=<|"]]] - 1}];
ownBlock = StringTake[ownText, {Last[First[StringPosition[ownText, "\n(* BEGIN REFERENCE UV KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n"]]] + 1,
  First[First[StringPosition[ownText, "\n(* END REFERENCE UV KIRA WORKFLOW *)\n"]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged complete UV Kira configuration and reader", StringTrim[originalBlock] === StringTrim[ownBlock]];
(* BEGIN REFERENCE UV KIRA WORKFLOW *)
text[expression_] := StringReplace[ToString[InputForm[expression]], Whitespace -> ""];
csv[list_] := "[" <> StringRiffle[text /@ list, ","] <> "]";
integralText[integral_] := integral[[1]] <> csv[integral[[2]]];
invariants = Union[{M2},Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[externalGram,
  symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]]]];
(* Fermat requires lower-case variable names. This is a name change only. *)
exportRules = {Q2 -> q2,M2->m2};
importRules = Reverse /@ exportRules;
gate["invariant rename is invertible", (invariants /. exportRules /. importRules) === invariants];
kinematics = {"kinematics:", "  incoming_momenta: " <> csv[external],
  "  outgoing_momenta: []", "  kinematic_invariants:"};
kinematics = Join[kinematics, ("    - [" <> text[# /. exportRules] <> ", 2]" & /@ invariants),
  {"  scalarproduct_rules:"}, Flatten[Table[
    "    - [[" <> text[external[[i]]] <> "," <> text[external[[j]]] <> "], " <>
      text[externalGram[[i, j]] /. exportRules] <> "]",
    {i, Length[external]}, {j, i, Length[external]}]]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "kinematics.yaml"}], StringRiffle[kinematics, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
familyLines = {"integralfamilies:"};
reductions = {};
preferred = {};
bounds = <||>;
globalR = Max[Total[Select[#, #>0 &]] & /@ targets[[All,2]]] + Length[First[Values[families]]["LoopMomenta"]];
globalS = Max[-Total[Select[#, #<0 &]] & /@ targets[[All,2]]] + Length[First[Values[families]]["LoopMomenta"]];
Do[
  spec = families[name];
  actual = Select[targets, #[[1]] === name &][[All, 2]];
  positiveSums = Total[Select[#, # > 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  negativeSums = -Total[Select[#, # < 0 &]] & /@ actual;
  sectors = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Total[MapIndexed[
    If[#1 > 0, 2^(First[#2] - 1), 0] &, #]] & /@ actual]];
  topSectors = Select[sectors, Function[sector, !AnyTrue[DeleteCases[sectors, sector],
    BitAnd[sector, #] === sector &]]];
  rBound = globalR;
  sBound = globalS;
  AssociateTo[bounds, name -> <|"r" -> rBound, "s" -> sBound,
    "Sectors" -> sectors, "TopSectors" -> topSectors, "TargetCount" -> Length[actual]|>];
  familyLines = Join[familyLines, {"  - name: " <> name,
    "    loop_momenta: " <> csv[spec["LoopMomenta"]],
    "    top_level_sectors: " <> csv[topSectors], "    propagators:"},
    MapThread["      - [\"" <> text[#1] <> "\", " <> text[#2 /. exportRules] <> "]" &,
      {spec["PropagatorMomenta"], spec["PropagatorMassesSquared"]}],
    {}];
  AppendTo[reductions, "        - {topologies: [" <> name <> "], sectors: " <>
    csv[topSectors] <> ", r: " <> text[rBound] <> ", s: " <> text[sBound] <> "}"];
  preferred = Join[preferred, Table[GLI[name,
    Table[If[MemberQ[support, i], 1, 0], {i,Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]}]],
    {support, Subsets[Range[Length[spec["PropagatorMomenta"]]]]}]],
  {name, names}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{config, "integralfamilies.yaml"}], StringRiffle[familyLines, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "targets"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ targets, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "preferred"}], StringRiffle[integralText /@ preferred, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
jobs = Join[{"jobs:", "  - reduce_sectors:", "      reduce:"}, reductions,
  {"      select_integrals:", "        select_mandatory_list:", "          - [targets]",
   "      preferred_masters: preferred", "      run_initiate: true",
   "      run_triangular: true", "      run_back_substitution: true",
   "  - kira2math:", "      target:", "        - [targets]"}];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "jobs.yaml"}], StringRiffle[jobs, "\n"] <> "\n", "Text"];
put[<|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "Bounds" -> bounds,
  "Families" -> families, "Targets" -> targets, "PreferredCandidates" -> preferred,
  "ExportRules" -> exportRules, "ImportRules" -> importRules,
  "ScalarMapFile" -> "../s14_scalar_maps.wl"|>, FileNameJoin[{work, "s14_configuration.wl"}]];
Print["KIRA_START ", work, " target count ", Length[targets], " bounds ", InputForm[bounds]];
run = RunProcess[{kira, "--parallel=2", "jobs.yaml"}, All, ProcessDirectory -> work];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s14_kira_stdout.log"}], run["StandardOutput"], "Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{work, "s14_kira_stderr.log"}], run["StandardError"], "Text"];
Print[StringTake[run["StandardOutput"], -Min[12000, StringLength[run["StandardOutput"]]]]];
If[run["StandardError"] =!= "", Print[run["StandardError"]]];
gate["Kira completed", run["ExitCode"] === 0];
ruleFiles = Sort[FileNames["kira_*.m", FileNameJoin[{work, "results"}], Infinity]];
gate["Kira exported symbolic rules", Length[ruleFiles] > 0];
rules = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ ruleFiles]];
gate["Kira output consists of rules", MatchQ[rules, {__Rule}]];
heads = Symbol /@ names;
toIntegral[expression_] := expression /. (HoldPattern[h_[indices__Integer]] /; MemberQ[heads, h]) :>
  GLI[SymbolName[h], {indices}];
masterFile = FileNameJoin[{work, "tmp", Last[names], "masters"}];
gate["final Kira master inventory exists", FileExistsQ[masterFile]];
declaredMasters = toIntegral[ToExpression /@ StringCases[Import[masterFile, "Text"],
  RegularExpression["[A-Z]+\\[[0-9, -]+\\]"]]];
gate["nonempty final Kira master inventory", MatchQ[declaredMasters, {__GLI}]];
rules = toIntegral[rules] /. importRules /. d -> D;
missingTargets = Complement[targets, First /@ rules];
gate["targets without explicit rules are declared masters",
  Complement[missingTargets, declaredMasters] === {}];
rules = Join[rules, (# -> # & /@ missingTargets)];
gate["each target has a reduction rule", Complement[targets, First /@ rules] === {}];
gate["rules have unique targets", DuplicateFreeQ[First /@ rules]];
masters = Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules, _GLI, Infinity]]];
closureFiles={};closurePass=0;
missingMasters=Complement[masters,declaredMasters];
While[missingMasters=!={} && closurePass<5,
  closurePass++;
  closureName="closure_"<>ToString[closurePass];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,closureName}],StringRiffle[integralText /@ missingMasters,"\n"]<>"\n","Text"];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,closureName<>".yaml"}],
    "jobs:\n  - kira2math:\n      target:\n        - ["<>closureName<>"]\n","Text"];
  Print["KIRA_EXPORT_CLOSURE ",InputForm[missingMasters]];
  closureRun=RunProcess[{kira,closureName<>".yaml"},All,ProcessDirectory->work];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{work,"s14_"<>closureName<>".log"}],closureRun["StandardOutput"]<>closureRun["StandardError"],"Text"];
  gate["Kira intermediate-integral export completed",closureRun["ExitCode"]===0];
  files=FileNames["kira_"<>closureName<>".m",FileNameJoin[{work,"results"}],Infinity];
  gate["Kira exported the needed intermediate rules",Length[files]>0];
  closureRules=toIntegral[DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[Get /@ files]]] /. importRules /. d->D;
  gate["every intermediate has a non-identity Kira rule",Complement[missingMasters,First /@ closureRules]==={} &&
    And@@(First[#]=!=Last[#]& /@ closureRules)];
  rules=(First[#]->Expand[Last[#] /. closureRules]& /@ rules);
  closureFiles=Join[closureFiles,files];
  masters=Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last /@ rules,_GLI,Infinity]]];
  missingMasters=Complement[masters,declaredMasters]];
put[<|"ExportedMasters" -> masters,"FinalInventory" -> declaredMasters,
  "MissingFromInventory" -> Complement[masters,declaredMasters]|>,FileNameJoin[{work,"s14_master_inventory.wl"}]];
gate["every rule ends in Kira's final master inventory",
  Complement[masters, declaredMasters] === {}];
gate["final virtual basis consists of scalar unit-index masters",
  And @@ (Complement[#[[2]],{0,1}] === {} & /@ masters)];
gate["rule coefficients are rational in symbolic dimension and invariants",
  FreeQ[rules, _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
(* END REFERENCE UV KIRA WORKFLOW *)
gate["unchanged auxiliary master basis", Sort[masters] === Sort[baseline["Masters"]]];
Do[gate["original UV rule " <> ToString[First[row], InputForm],
  bounded[zero[(First[row] /. rules) - Last[row]], {"original UV rule comparison", First[row]}]], {row, baseline["Rules"]}];
gate["recorded new targets reduced", Complement[additionalTargets, First /@ rules] === {}];
completedPackets = Map[Function[packet, Module[{value},
  value = bounded[Factor[Together[Total[KeyValueMap[Times, packet["Coefficients"]]] /. (rules /. Q2 -> Q^2)]], "recorded UV coefficient map"];
  gate["recorded coefficient map contains only accepted masters", Complement[Union[Cases[value, _GLI, Infinity]], masters] === {}];
  <|"Coefficients" -> packet["Coefficients"], "Reduced" -> value|>]], packets];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-uv-reduction-extension-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Rules" -> rules, "Masters" -> masters, "Targets" -> targets, "AdditionalTargets" -> additionalTargets,
  "Families" -> families, "Bounds" -> bounds, "CompletedPackets" -> completedPackets,
  "MappingInputHash" -> First[mappingInputHashes], "BaselineReductionHash" -> FileHash[baselinePath, "SHA256"],
  "MasterValuesHash" -> FileHash[mastersPath, "SHA256"], "OriginalSourceHash" -> FileHash[originalSource, "SHA256"],
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "KiraHash" -> FileHash[kira, "SHA256"], "FermatHash" -> FileHash[fermat, "SHA256"],
  "WorkDirectory" -> work, "RuleFiles" -> ruleFiles, "ClosureRuleFiles" -> closureFiles,
  "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_result.wl"}]];
gate["exact saved UV extension roundtrip", Get[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_result.wl"}]] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "additional_target_count" -> Length[additionalTargets], "master_count" -> Length[masters],
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s13_extend_uv_reduction"]; Quit[0];

```

## common/s13_inspect_uv_residual.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-416", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4545, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s13_inspect_uv_residual.wls", "sha256": "d513a7fde3927ff07f6228a1c4226db703a275abd36576de2a47e9952488358e"} -->
```wolfram
(* Inspect a failed UV assembly component using the unchanged accepted inputs. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
inspectionSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s13_inspect_uv_residual.wls"}];
inspectionBaseline = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionBaseline, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "44bc4684e7aa164e7d9e0928bb2572c7f7ea146e8215653516fef6bf1e729989", Quit[1]];
inspectionText = Import[inspectionBaseline, "Text"];
inspectionBoundary = StringPosition[inspectionText, "\nkeys = Keys[mapped[\"Components\"]];"];
If[Length[inspectionBoundary] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
inspectionPrefix = StringTake[inspectionText, First[First[inspectionBoundary]] - 1];
If[!SyntaxQ[inspectionPrefix] || !SyntaxQ[Import[inspectionSource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[inspectionPrefix, InputForm];
inspectionConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_uv_inspection_inputs.json"}];
inspectionConfig = Import[inspectionConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["UV inspection channel", channel === inspectionConfig["channel"]];
inspectionKey = inspectionConfig["key"];
gate["failed component exists in actual map", KeyExistsQ[mapped["Components"], inspectionKey]];
gate["failed component UV sum exists", KeyExistsQ[spinUV, inspectionKey]];
gate["same Born and virtual transverse conventions", born["TransverseSubstitution"] === spin["TransverseSubstitution"] &&
  born["TransverseConstraint"] === spin["TransverseConstraint"]];
key = inspectionKey;
coefficients = mapped["Components"][key];
pre = bounded[reduce[integrateComponent[coefficients, key] /. spin["TransverseSubstitution"]], {key, "physical loop sum"}];
hermitian = bounded[reduce[ComplexExpand[pre + Conjugate[pre], TargetFunctions -> {Re, Im}]], {key, "Hermitian interference"}];
residue = spinUV[key] /. spin["TransverseSubstitution"];
fullUV = Factor[ComplexExpand[residue + Conjugate[residue]]];
separated = hermitian + fullUV (1/epsUV - 1/eps);
gate["UV separation preserves tensor", Expand[(separated /. epsUV -> eps) - hermitian] === 0];
bornD = bornComponent[key] /. D -> 4 - 2 eps;
counterterm = book["CouplingWeight"] uv["CouplingResidue"] (uv["MSPole"] /. eps -> epsUV) bornD;
complete = separated + externalInterference bornD + counterterm;
residual = bounded[FullSimplify[Coefficient[Expand[complete], epsUV, -1] /. eps -> 0, physical], {key, "UV cancellation"}];
inspectionTerms = <|"PreHermitianUV" -> residue, "HermitianUV" -> fullUV,
  "BornD" -> bornD, "BornD4" -> (bornD /. eps -> 0),
  "ExternalUV" -> Coefficient[Expand[externalInterference bornD], epsUV, -1],
  "CountertermUV" -> Coefficient[Expand[counterterm], epsUV, -1],
  "Residual" -> residual,
  "FactoredResidual" -> bounded[Factor[Together[residual]], "factored actual UV residual"],
  "TransverseSubstitution" -> spin["TransverseSubstitution"],
  "TransverseConstraint" -> spin["TransverseConstraint"], "FieldBookkeeping" -> book,
  "CouplingResidue" -> uv["CouplingResidue"], "MSPole" -> uv["MSPole"]|>;
KeyValueMap[Print["ACTUAL_UV_EQUATION ", #1, " ", InputForm[#2]] &, inspectionTerms];
inspectionDiagramUV = KeyTake[#, {"Label", "Value"}] & /@ Select[uvValues, #["Key"] === key &];
Print["ACTUAL_DIAGRAM_UV ", InputForm[inspectionDiagramUV]];
inspectionResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-uv-residual-inspection-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Key" -> key, "Terms" -> inspectionTerms, "DiagramUV" -> inspectionDiagramUV,
  "SourceHash" -> FileHash[inspectionSource, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[inspectionBaseline, "SHA256"],
  "ConfigurationHash" -> FileHash[inspectionConfigPath, "SHA256"], "ProductionInputHash" -> inputHash,
  "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "Checks" -> checks, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "InspectionComplete" -> True, "UVCancellationPassed" -> (residual === 0), "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
inspectionDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s13_uv_inspection_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[inspectionDir], CreateDirectory[inspectionDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
inspectionPath = FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s13_result.wl"}];
put[inspectionResult, inspectionPath];
gate["UV inspection exact native reload", Get[inspectionPath] === inspectionResult];
Export[FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir, "s13_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "key" -> key,
  "checks" -> checks, "uv_cancellation_passed" -> (residual === 0), "inspection_complete" -> True,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s13_inspect_uv_residual"]; Quit[0];

```
