## common/s13_result/reference/s13_assemble_virtual_spin_before_uv_extension.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-420", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 28744, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s13_result/reference/s13_assemble_virtual_spin_before_uv_extension.wls", "sha256": "0d332c9cd7011cadc7a0d40dc4234382023a1f2c419fd616bab3aa4d6f1e0dd2"} -->
```wolfram
(* Physical loop integration and the reference auxiliary-mass UV subtraction. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls"}];
channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
validationOnly = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VALIDATE_ONLY"] === "1";
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; If[TrueQ[$KernelID > 0], Throw[$Failed, "S13Failure"], CloseKernels[]; Quit[1]]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  gate["time bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_inputs.json"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
Do[gate["pinned assembly input " <> row["destination"], IntegerString[
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, row["destination"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]], {row, config["files"]}];
referenceRoot = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_result", "reference"}];
referenceVirtual = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "Hqq_virtual.wl"}]];
physicalMasters = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s19_masters.wl"}]];
originalAssemblyHash = FileHash[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s19_assemble_virtual.wl"}], "SHA256"];
gate["accepted original physical assembly", TrueQ[referenceVirtual["Accepted"]] &&
  referenceVirtual["SourceHash"] === originalAssemblyHash &&
  referenceVirtual["MasterFile"] === config["original_master_file"]];
gate["physical master input binding", physicalMasters["InputHash"] ===
  Hash[{originalAssemblyHash, referenceVirtual["InputHashes"]}, "SHA256"]];
gate["accepted physical continuation records", AllTrue[physicalMasters["ContinuationRecords"],
  TrueQ[#["Accepted"]] && #["SourceHash"] === originalAssemblyHash &&
    #["InputHash"] === physicalMasters["InputHash"] &&
    #["Series"] === physicalMasters["Masters"][#["Master"]] &]];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
library = Get[libraryPath];
gate["accepted scalar library", library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
geometry = readLibrary["s02"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
parents = readLibrary["s12"];
uv = readLibrary["s14"] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
Do[gate["physical assembly original input " <> stage,
  referenceVirtual["InputHashes"][stage <> "_result.wl"] ===
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"][stage]["File"]}], "SHA256"]],
  {stage, {"s12", "s13", "s14"}}];
uvReduction = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s14_reduction.wl"}]] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
masterValues = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s14_master_values.wl"}]] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
gate["unchanged master parent inventory", Sort[Keys[physicalMasters["Masters"]]] === Sort[Keys[parents["VirtualMasterParents"]]]];
gate["accepted auxiliary UV reduction", TrueQ[uvReduction["Accepted"]] &&
  uvReduction["InputHash"] === uv["InputHash"] && uvReduction["SourceHash"] === uv["SourceHash"]];
gate["complete auxiliary master values", Sort[Keys[masterValues]] === Sort[uvReduction["Masters"]] &&
  AllTrue[Values[masterValues], MatchQ[#, _SeriesData] &]];
virtualConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s07_inputs.json"}];
virtualConfig = Import[virtualConfigPath, "RawJSON"];
gate["core virtual channel", KeyExistsQ[virtualConfig["channels"], channel]];
referencePath = FileNameJoin[{root, virtualConfig["channels"][channel]["destination"]}];
gate["pinned original virtual integrands", IntegerString[FileHash[referencePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  virtualConfig["channels"][channel]["sha256"]];
reference = Get[referencePath];
gate["accepted original virtual map", TrueQ[reference["Accepted"]]];
physical = Q > 0 && s > 0 && t < 0 && Q^2 + s + t > 0 && mu > 0 && SUNN > 1;
reduce[value_] := Module[{refined, functions},
  refined = Refine[value, physical];
  functions = DeleteDuplicates[Cases[refined, _Log | _PolyLog | _Re | _Im, Infinity]];
  Collect[Expand[refined], functions, Factor]];

(* BEGIN UNCHANGED REFERENCE UV MAP *)
external={p,q,k1};externalGram=geometry["CommonGram"][[1;;3,1;;3]] /. w->0;
setKinematics[] := (FCClearScalarProducts[];
  Do[With[{left=external[[i]],right=external[[j]],value=externalGram[[i,j]]},
    SPD[left,right]=value],{i,Length[external]},{j,i,Length[external]}]);
setKinematics[];
loopProducts=FCI[SPD[ell,#]]& /@ Prepend[external,ell];
loopVariables=Array[uvx,Length[loopProducts]];
scalarRules=Thread[loopProducts->loopVariables];
coordinateVariables=Array[uvz,Length[loopProducts]];
families=<|
  "OS"-><|"Momenta"->{ell,ell+p,ell+q,ell+k1},"Masses"->{0,0,0,0}|>,
  "SE"-><|"Momenta"->{ell,ell+q,ell+p,ell+k1},"Masses"->{0,0,0,0}|>,
  "UV"-><|"Momenta"->{ell,ell+p,ell+q,ell+k1},"Masses"->{M2,M2,M2,M2}|>|>;
familyMaps=Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{id,data},Module[{polynomials,solution},
  polynomials=MapThread[ExpandScalarProduct[FCI[SPD[#1,#1]]]-#2 &,
    {data["Momenta"],data["Masses"]}] /. scalarRules;
  solution=Solve[Thread[polynomials==coordinateVariables],loopVariables];
  gate[id<>" unique loop scalar coordinate map",Length[solution]===1];
  id-><|"Polynomials"->polynomials,"Rules"->First[solution]|>]],families];
mapScalar[expression_,id_] := Module[{mapped,terms,coefficient,powers,values,reconstructed},
  If[expression===0,Return[<||>]];
  mapped=Expand[Cancel[expression /. familyMaps[id]["Rules"]]];
  terms=If[Head[mapped]===Plus,List@@mapped,{mapped}];
  values=Map[Function[term,
    powers=Table[Exponent[Numerator[Together[term]],z]-Exponent[Denominator[Together[term]],z],
      {z,coordinateVariables}];
    coefficient=Factor[term/(Times@@(coordinateVariables^powers))];
    gate[id<>" scalar coefficient has no loop coordinates",FreeQ[coefficient,Alternatives@@coordinateVariables]];
    GLI[id,-powers]->coefficient],terms];
  values=Map[Factor[Together[#]]&,Merge[Association /@ values,Total]];
  reconstructed=Total[KeyValueMap[#2 Times@@(familyMaps[id]["Polynomials"]^(-#1[[2]]))&,values]];
  gate[id<>" exact scalar-integrand reconstruction",zero[reconstructed-expression]];values];
toScalars[value_] := Factor[Together[ExpandScalarProduct[FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit[value]] /. scalarRules]];
uvExpansion[value_,label_] := Module[{rational,scaling,series,firstPower,pieces,regularized},
  rational=toScalars[value];If[rational===0,Return[<||>]];
  gate[label<>" closed scalar loop integrand",FreeQ[rational,_Pair|_FeynAmpDenominator|ell]];
  scaling=Thread[loopVariables->MapIndexed[#1 lam^(-If[First[#2]===1,2,1])&,loopVariables]];
  series=bounded[Normal[Series[rational /. scaling,{lam,0,4}]],label<>" UV expansion"];
  If[series===0,Return[<||>]];
  firstPower=Exponent[series,lam,Min];
  pieces=Association@Table[power->Factor[Coefficient[series,lam,power]],{power,firstPower,4}];
  regularized=Map[Function[piece,Expand[piece] /.
    Power[uvx[1],n_Integer /; n<0] :> (uvx[1]-M2)^n],pieces];
  gate[label<>" auxiliary mass leaves logarithmic asymptotics unchanged",
    zero[Coefficient[Normal[Series[(regularized[4]-pieces[4]) /. scaling,{lam,0,4}]],lam,4]]];
  Association@KeyValueMap[#1->mapScalar[#2,"UV"]&,regularized]];
(* END UNCHANGED REFERENCE UV MAP *)

uvSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "reference", "sources", "s14_uv_residues.wl"}];
originalUVText = Import[uvSource, "Text"];
originalUVBlock = StringTake[originalUVText, {First[First[StringPosition[originalUVText, "external={p,q,k1};"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[originalUVText, "(* Generate the two-point functions"]]] - 1}];
ownText = Import[sourcePath, "Text"];
ownUVBlock = StringTake[ownText, {Last[First[StringPosition[ownText, "(* BEGIN UNCHANGED REFERENCE UV MAP *)"]]] + 1,
  First[First[StringPosition[ownText, "(* END UNCHANGED REFERENCE UV MAP *)"]]] - 1}];
gate["byte-identical reference UV expansion", StringTrim[originalUVBlock] === StringTrim[ownUVBlock]];
gate["original UV source identity", FileHash[uvSource, "SHA256"] === uv["SourceHash"]];
ruleMap = Association[uvReduction["Rules"]];
measure = uv["Measure"];
gate["virtual and UV measures coincide", zero[(reference["Measure"] /. Epsilon -> eps) - measure]];
reduceMap[coefficients_] := Module[{missing, value},
  missing = Complement[Keys[coefficients], Keys[ruleMap]];
  If[missing =!= {}, put[<|"MissingTargets" -> missing, "Coefficients" -> coefficients,
    "Families" -> families, "InputHash" -> inputHash|>, FileNameJoin[{cache, "missing_uv_targets_" <> ToString[$KernelID] <> ".wl"}]]];
  gate["auxiliary Kira target coverage", missing === {}];
  value = Factor[Together[Total[KeyValueMap[#2 ruleMap[#1] &, coefficients]]]];
  gate["auxiliary reduction master coverage", Complement[Union[Cases[value, _GLI, Infinity]], Keys[masterValues]] === {}];
  value];
uvPole[coefficients_] := Module[{integrated, series},
  integrated = reduceMap[coefficients] /. D -> 4 - 2 eps /. Normal[masterValues];
  series = Series[measure integrated, {eps, 0, 0}];
  gate["UV residue expansion depth", series === 0 || (MatchQ[series, _SeriesData] && series[[5]] > -1)];
  Factor[Coefficient[Normal[series], eps, -1]]];
uvFromPowers[powers_, label_] := Module[{residues, physicalResidues},
  If[Length[powers] === 0, Return[0]];
  residues = Map[uvPole, powers];
  physicalResidues = Map[FullSimplify[Limit[#, M2 -> 0, Direction -> "FromAbove"], physical] &, residues];
  KeyValueMap[If[#1 < 4, gate[label <> " power-divergent auxiliary terms vanish", #2 === 0]] &, physicalResidues];
  gate[label <> " logarithmic residue independent of auxiliary mass", FreeQ[Lookup[residues, 4, 0], M2]];
  Factor[Total[Values[physicalResidues]]]];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
parallelValidationOnly = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_UV_PARALLEL_VALIDATE_ONLY"] === "1";
serialPath = FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s13_assemble_virtual_spin_before_parallel_uv.wls"}];
calculationSourceHash = FileHash[serialPath, "SHA256"];
gate["pinned serial calculation", IntegerString[calculationSourceHash, 16, 64] ===
  "930cb13c80514b51fbd2ae017feee7b1adac813651670e779258156f161aae6f"];
serialText = Import[serialPath, "Text"];
sourceSection[text_, start_, end_] := StringTake[text,
  {First[First[StringPosition[text, start]]], First[First[StringPosition[text, end]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged complete virtual and UV definitions", StringTake[ownText,
    First[First[StringPosition[ownText, "\nsourceHash = FileHash"]]] - 1] ===
  StringReplace[StringTake[serialText, First[First[StringPosition[serialText, "\nsourceHash = FileHash"]]] - 1], {
    "Print[\"FAIL: \", name]; Quit[1]];" ->
      "Print[\"FAIL: \", name]; If[TrueQ[$KernelID > 0], Throw[$Failed, \"S13Failure\"], CloseKernels[]; Quit[1]]];",
    "\"missing_uv_targets.wl\"" -> "\"missing_uv_targets_\" <> ToString[$KernelID] <> \".wl\""}]];
gate["unchanged inputs and checkpoint identity",
  sourceSection[ownText, "\ninputPaths = Join[", "\nuvTask[value_, label_]"] ===
    StringReplace[sourceSection[serialText, "\ninputPaths = Join[", "\nuvTask[value_, label_]"],
      "Hash[{sourceHash, inputHashes," -> "Hash[{calculationSourceHash, inputHashes,"]];
gate["unchanged task and reference comparison implementation",
  sourceSection[ownText, "\nuvTask[value_, label_]", "\nspinLoopRules ="] ===
    sourceSection[serialText, "\nuvTask[value_, label_]", "\nspinLoopRules ="]];
gate["unchanged complete final virtual assembly",
  sourceSection[ownText, "\nDo[gate[\"new-spin CDR UV residue", "\nresultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s13_result\"}]"] ===
    StringReplace[sourceSection[serialText, "\nDo[gate[\"new-spin CDR UV residue", "\nresultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s13_result\"}]"],
      "\"SourceHash\" -> sourceHash, \"InputHash\" -> inputHash" ->
        "\"SourceHash\" -> sourceHash, \"CalculationSourceHash\" -> calculationSourceHash, \"ParallelValidationHash\" -> parallelValidationHash, \"InputHash\" -> inputHash"]];

inputPaths = Join[{configPath, libraryPath, virtualConfigPath, referencePath, uvSource},
  (FileNameJoin[{root, #["destination"]}] &) /@ config["files"],
  (FileNameJoin[{root, library["Library"][#]["File"]}] &) /@ {"s02", "s12", "s14"}];
If[!validationOnly,
  spinPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s07_result", "s07_result.wl"}];
  mapRelative = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VIRTUAL_MAP"];
  If[!StringQ[mapRelative] || mapRelative === "", mapRelative = channel <> "/s09_result/s09_result.wl"];
  gate["owned virtual reduction input", MemberQ[{channel <> "/s09_result/s09_result.wl",
    channel <> "/s09_reduction_result/s09_result.wl"}, mapRelative]];
  mapPath = FileNameJoin[{root, mapRelative}];
  bornPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s03_result", "s03_result.wl"}];
  basisPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s02_result", "s02_result.wl"}];
  spin = Get[spinPath]; mapped = Get[mapPath]; born = Get[bornPath]; basis = Get[basisPath];
  gate["accepted spin and Born tensors", spin["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-virtual-response-v1" &&
    born["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-born-response-v2" && And @@ Values[spin["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[born["Checks"]]];
  gate["accepted complete virtual reduction", mapped["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-virtual-scalar-map-v1" &&
    TrueQ[mapped["MappingAccepted"]] && TrueQ[mapped["ReductionCoverageComplete"]] &&
    TrueQ[mapped["MasterExpansionDepthSufficient"]] && And @@ Values[mapped["Checks"]]];
  gate["mapped inputs unchanged", And @@ KeyValueMap[
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}], "SHA256"] === #2 &, mapped["InputHashes"]]];
  gate["mapped spin input identity", mapped["InputHashes"][channel <> "/s07_result/s07_result.wl"] === FileHash[spinPath, "SHA256"]];
  gate["accepted photon and spin basis", And @@ Values[basis["Checks"]]];
  inputPaths = Join[inputPaths, {spinPath, mapPath, bornPath, basisPath}]];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ DeleteDuplicates[inputPaths]];
inputHash = Hash[{calculationSourceHash, inputHashes, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s13", channel, IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
uvTask[value_, label_] := Module[{file, saved, result},
  file = FileNameJoin[{cache, "uv_" <> IntegerString[Hash[{label, value}, "SHA256"], 16] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[file], Get[file], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] === inputHash, Return[saved["Value"]]];
  Print["VIRTUAL_UV ", label];
  result = bounded[uvFromPowers[uvExpansion[value, label], label], label];
  put[<|"Value" -> result, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "Label" -> label|>, file]; result];
referenceResidues = Association@Table[mode -> Factor[Total[Table[
  uvTask[diagram["ContractedIntegrand"] /. Q2 -> Q^2, "reference " <> mode <> " " <> ToString[diagram["Diagram"]]],
  {diagram, Select[reference["DiagramMaps"], #["Mode"] === mode &]}]]], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
Do[gate["original UV residue " <> mode, zero[referenceResidues[mode] - uv["VirtualUVResidues"][channel][mode]]],
  {mode, Keys[referenceResidues]}];
If[validationOnly,
  resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s13_validation_result"}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  put[<|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-virtual-assembly-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "ReferenceUVResidues" -> referenceResidues, "PhysicalMasterCount" -> Length[physicalMasters["Masters"]],
    "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_result.wl"}]];
  Print["PASS: s13_virtual_assembly_validation"]; Quit[0]];

spinLoopRules = Thread[spin["LoopScalarProducts"][[All, 3]] -> loopVariables];
uvTasks = {};
Do[
  tasks = {};
  MapIndexed[Function[{value, position}, If[value =!= 0,
    AppendTo[tasks, <|"Key" -> {"ExtendedResponse", position}, "Value" -> value|>]]], diagram["ExtendedResponse"], {3}];
  AppendTo[tasks, <|"Key" -> {"PhotonMetricD", {}}, "Value" -> diagram["PhotonMetricD"]|>];
  Do[AppendTo[tasks, <|"Key" -> {"CDR", {mode}}, "Value" -> diagram["CDRContractions"][mode]|>], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
  Do[AppendTo[uvTasks, <|"Key" -> task["Key"], "Value" -> (task["Value"] /. spinLoopRules),
    "Label" -> ("spin " <> ToString[diagram["Diagram"]] <> " " <> ToString[task["Key"], InputForm])|>],
    {task, tasks}], {diagram, spin["Diagrams"]}];
uvCacheFile[task_] := FileNameJoin[{cache,
  "uv_" <> IntegerString[Hash[{task["Label"], task["Value"]}, "SHA256"], 16] <> ".wl"}];
gate["independent UV task checkpoints", DuplicateFreeQ[uvCacheFile /@ uvTasks]];
runUVTask[task_, fresh_:False] := Catch[Block[{checks = <||>}, Module[{value, seconds},
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[If[TrueQ[fresh],
    bounded[uvFromPowers[uvExpansion[task["Value"], task["Label"]], task["Label"]], task["Label"]],
    uvTask[task["Value"], task["Label"]]]];
  <|"Key" -> task["Key"], "Label" -> task["Label"], "Value" -> value,
    "Checks" -> checks, "ElapsedSeconds" -> seconds, "Accepted" -> True|>]], "S13Failure"];
slots = Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]], 1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1]; CloseKernels[];
If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[8, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];
workers = Length[Kernels[]]; Print["Independent UV worker count = ", workers];
If[workers > 0,
  gate["workers share compute allocation", And @@ (SameQ[#, $MachineName] & /@ ParallelEvaluate[$MachineName])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; checks = <||>;
    PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
    $FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate, bounded, put, zero, setKinematics, external, externalGram, loopProducts,
    loopVariables, scalarRules, coordinateVariables, families, familyMaps, mapScalar, toScalars,
    uvExpansion, reduceMap, uvPole, uvFromPowers, uvTask, runUVTask,
    ruleMap, masterValues, measure, physical, inputHash, cache];
  ParallelEvaluate[setKinematics[]];
  gate["worker native versions agree", And @@ (SameQ[#, {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}] & /@
    ParallelEvaluate[{$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}])]];
$DistributedContexts = None;
parallelValidationPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s13_parallel_result", "s13_result.wl"}];
If[parallelValidationOnly,
  gate["parallel comparison allocated workers", workers > 0];
  selectedTask = SelectFirst[uvTasks, Function[task, Module[{file, saved}, file = uvCacheFile[task];
    If[!FileExistsQ[file], Return[False]]; saved = Get[file];
    Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] === inputHash && Lookup[saved, "Value", 0] =!= 0]], Missing["NoSerialCheckpoint"]];
  gate["accepted nonzero serial comparison exists", AssociationQ[selectedTask]];
  selectedFile = uvCacheFile[selectedTask]; serialValue = Get[selectedFile];
  comparison = First[ParallelMap[runUVTask[#, True] &, {selectedTask}, Method -> "FinestGrained"]];
  gate["fresh worker accepted", AssociationQ[comparison] && TrueQ[comparison["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[comparison["Checks"]]];
  gate["fresh worker reproduces accepted serial checkpoint", bounded[zero[comparison["Value"] - serialValue["Value"]], "worker comparison"]];
  CloseKernels[];
  resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s13_parallel_result"}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  put[<|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-virtual-uv-parallel-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "CalculationSourceHash" -> calculationSourceHash,
    "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SerialCheckpoint" -> StringDrop[selectedFile, StringLength[root] + 1],
    "SerialCheckpointHash" -> FileHash[selectedFile, "SHA256"], "TaskCount" -> Length[uvTasks],
    "Comparison" -> KeyDrop[comparison, "Value"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>,
    FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_result.wl"}]];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
    "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "comparison_seconds" -> comparison["ElapsedSeconds"],
    "task_count" -> Length[uvTasks]|>, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s13_virtual_uv_parallel_validation"]; Quit[0]];
parallelValidation = Get[parallelValidationPath];
gate["accepted parallel UV comparison", parallelValidation["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-virtual-uv-parallel-validation-v1" &&
  TrueQ[parallelValidation["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[parallelValidation["Checks"]] &&
  parallelValidation["SourceHash"] === sourceHash && parallelValidation["CalculationSourceHash"] === calculationSourceHash &&
  parallelValidation["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
parallelValidationHash = FileHash[parallelValidationPath, "SHA256"];
uvValues = If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[runUVTask, uvTasks, Method -> "FinestGrained"], runUVTask /@ uvTasks];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all independent UV tasks accepted", Length[uvValues] === Length[uvTasks] &&
  AllTrue[uvValues, AssociationQ] && And @@ Lookup[uvValues, "Accepted"] &&
  And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ uvValues]];
gate["UV component order preserved", Lookup[uvValues, "Label"] === Lookup[uvTasks, "Label"]];
spinUV = <||>;
Do[key = item["Key"]; value = item["Value"];
  AssociateTo[spinUV, key -> Factor[value + If[KeyExistsQ[spinUV, key], spinUV[key], 0]]], {item, uvValues}];
Do[gate["new-spin CDR UV residue " <> mode, zero[(spinUV[{"CDR", {mode}}] - referenceResidues[mode]) /.
    spin["TransverseSubstitution"]]], {mode, {"Pg", "Ppp"}}];
fieldSplits = Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{field, residue}, Module[{solution},
  solution = Solve[(residue/epsUV + ir/eps /. epsUV -> eps) == 0, ir];
  gate["unique scaleless UV/IR field split", Length[solution] === 1];
  field -> (residue/epsUV + (ir /. First[solution])/eps)]], uv["FieldUVResidues"]];
book = uv["FieldBookkeeping"][channel];
gate["vanishing bare on-shell residue", book["BareOnShellResidue"] === 0];
fields = Flatten[KeyValueMap[ConstantArray[#1, #2] &, book["FieldCounts"]]];
fieldFactor = Times @@ (Sqrt[1 + ord fieldSplits[#]] & /@ fields);
externalInterference = Coefficient[Normal[Series[fieldFactor^2, {ord, 0, 1}]], ord];
gate["external UV bookkeeping", zero[Coefficient[Expand[externalInterference], epsUV, -1] - book["ExternalUVResidue"]]];
gate["bare external contribution vanishes", zero[externalInterference /. epsUV -> eps]];
inVariables = {"U" -> 1, "X" -> xIn, "Y" -> yIn, "H" -> hIn, "E" -> eIn};
outVariables = {"U" -> 1, "X" -> xOut, "Y" -> yOut, "H" -> hOut, "E" -> eOut};
bornMetric = Tr[basis["PhotonMetric"].born["PhotonMatrix"]] + Sum[
  born["EvanescentPhotonResponse"][[j, i]] (born["ExtendedIncomingLabels"][[i]] /. inVariables)
    (born["ExtendedOutgoingLabels"][[j]] /. outVariables),
  {j, Length[born["ExtendedOutgoingLabels"]]}, {i, Length[born["ExtendedIncomingLabels"]]}];
bornComponent[key_] := Switch[First[key],
  "ExtendedResponse", Extract[born["ExtendedResponse"], Last[key]],
  "PhotonMetricD", bornMetric, "PhotonWardLeft", 0];
integrateComponent[coefficients_, key_] := Module[{terms},
  terms = KeyValueMap[Function[{master, coefficient}, Module[{series, value},
    gate["physical master exists", KeyExistsQ[physicalMasters["Masters"], master]];
    series = physicalMasters["Masters"][master] /. Q2 -> Q^2;
    value = bounded[Series[(mapped["Measure"] /. Epsilon -> eps)
      (coefficient /. D -> 4 - 2 eps) series, {eps, 0, 0}], {key, master, "loop integral"}];
    gate["new virtual coefficient epsilon depth", value === 0 || (MatchQ[value, _SeriesData] && value[[5]] > 0)];
    Normal[value]]], coefficients];
  Total[terms]];
keys = Keys[mapped["Components"]];
MapIndexed[Function[{value, position}, If[value =!= 0, AppendTo[keys, {"ExtendedResponse", position}]]], born["ExtendedResponse"], {3}];
keys = DeleteDuplicates[keys];
components = <||>;
Do[
  file = FileNameJoin[{cache, "assembled_" <> IntegerString[Hash[key, "SHA256"], 16] <> ".wl"}];
  saved = If[FileExistsQ[file], Get[file], <||>];
  If[Lookup[saved, "InputHash", None] =!= inputHash,
    Print["VIRTUAL_ASSEMBLE ", key];
    coefficients = If[KeyExistsQ[mapped["Components"], key], mapped["Components"][key], <||>];
    pre = bounded[reduce[integrateComponent[coefficients, key] /. spin["TransverseSubstitution"]], {key, "physical loop sum"}];
    If[First[key] === "PhotonWardLeft",
      gate["integrated photon Ward " <> ToString[key, InputForm], bounded[FullSimplify[pre, physical], key] === 0];
      hermitian = 0; residual = 0; value = 0,
      hermitian = bounded[reduce[ComplexExpand[pre + Conjugate[pre], TargetFunctions -> {Re, Im}]], {key, "Hermitian interference"}];
      residue = If[KeyExistsQ[spinUV, key], spinUV[key], 0] /. spin["TransverseSubstitution"];
      fullUV = Factor[ComplexExpand[residue + Conjugate[residue]]];
      separated = hermitian + fullUV (1/epsUV - 1/eps);
      gate["UV separation preserves tensor", Expand[(separated /. epsUV -> eps) - hermitian] === 0];
      bornD = bornComponent[key] /. D -> 4 - 2 eps;
      counterterm = book["CouplingWeight"] uv["CouplingResidue"] (uv["MSPole"] /. eps -> epsUV) bornD;
      complete = separated + externalInterference bornD + counterterm;
      residual = bounded[FullSimplify[Coefficient[Expand[complete], epsUV, -1] /. eps -> 0, physical], {key, "UV cancellation"}];
      gate["complete UV cancellation " <> ToString[key, InputForm], residual === 0];
      value = bounded[reduce[Normal[Series[complete /. epsUV -> eps, {eps, 0, 0}]]], {key, "renormalized series"}]];
    gate["explicit renormalized virtual expression", FreeQ[value,
      _GLI | _PaVe | _Integrate | _Limit | _Series | _SeriesData | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted | epsUV | Indeterminate | ComplexInfinity]];
    saved = <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "Key" -> key, "PreHermitian" -> pre,
      "RenormalizedVirtual" -> value, "UVResidual" -> residual, "ChecksPassed" -> True|>;
    put[saved, file]; ClearSystemCache[]];
  AssociateTo[components, key -> saved], {key, keys}];
gate["complete virtual component inventory", Keys[components] === keys && AllTrue[Values[components], TrueQ[#["ChecksPassed"]] &]];
result = Join[KeyTake[mapped, {"Channel", "PhotonLabels", "SpinLabels", "IncomingSpinLabels", "OutgoingSpinLabels", "IndexOrder",
    "CouplingsRemoved", "Measure", "LoopPrescription", "InterferenceConvention", "Gamma5Scheme"}],
  <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-renormalized-virtual-v1", "Components" -> components,
    "VirtualUVResidues" -> spinUV, "FieldSplits" -> fieldSplits, "ExternalInterference" -> externalInterference,
    "CouplingResidue" -> uv["CouplingResidue"], "CouplingWeight" -> book["CouplingWeight"],
    "MSPole" -> uv["MSPole"], "Regulator" -> eps, "PhysicalConditions" -> physical,
    "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "CalculationSourceHash" -> calculationSourceHash, "ParallelValidationHash" -> parallelValidationHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "Checks" -> checks,
    "LoopIntegrated" -> True, "UVRenormalized" -> True, "IntegratedWardChecksPassed" -> True,
    "FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>];
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s13_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s13_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s13_assemble_virtual_spin"]; Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
(* Check physical-domain simplification on the exported failed UV equation. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[]; checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test], Print["PASS: ", name]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
source = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_check_uv_branches.wls"}];
baseline = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s13_assemble_virtual_spin.wls"}];
inspectionPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqg", "s13_uv_inspection_result", "s13_result.wl"}];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[source, "Text"]]];
gate["pinned production source", IntegerString[FileHash[baseline, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "44bc4684e7aa164e7d9e0928bb2572c7f7ea146e8215653516fef6bf1e729989"];
gate["pinned actual failed equation", IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "91c455e0a0e7e246a37d3ecb526dc3e2d172e5f179692f7f61b125b95a37cca5"];
inspection = Get[inspectionPath]; terms = inspection["Terms"];
gate["accepted inspection", TrueQ[inspection["InspectionComplete"]] && And @@ Values[inspection["Checks"]]];
physicalLine = Select[StringSplit[Import[baseline, "Text"], "\n"], StringStartsQ[#, "physical = "] &];
gate["unique inherited physical assumptions", Length[physicalLine] === 1];
ToExpression[First[physicalLine], InputForm];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 300, gate["time bound " <> label, False]], 2*1024^3, gate["memory bound " <> label, False]];
physicalUVHermitian[value_] := Factor[Refine[value + Conjugate[value], physical]];
{seconds, candidate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[physicalUVHermitian[terms["PreHermitianUV"]], "physical Hermitian residue"]];
Print["ACTUAL_CANDIDATE ", InputForm[candidate]];
candidateResidual = bounded[FullSimplify[Factor[Together[candidate + terms["ExternalUV"] + terms["CountertermUV"]]] /. eps -> 0, physical, TimeConstraint -> 120], "candidate UV residual"];
Print["ACTUAL_CANDIDATE_RESIDUAL ", InputForm[candidateResidual]];
originalResidual = bounded[FullSimplify[Refine[terms["FactoredResidual"], physical], physical, TimeConstraint -> 120], "original UV residual"];
Print["ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_RESIDUAL ", InputForm[originalResidual]];
gate["actual counterterms cancel candidate residue", candidateResidual === 0];
gate["original residual is zero on physical domain", originalResidual === 0];
definitionResidual = bounded[FullSimplify[candidate - (terms["PreHermitianUV"] + Conjugate[terms["PreHermitianUV"]]), physical, TimeConstraint -> 120], "Hermitian definition"];
gate["exact defining Hermitian sum", definitionResidual === 0];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-uv-branch-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> "Hqg", "Key" -> inspection["Key"],
 "OriginalResidual" -> terms["Residual"], "RefinedOriginalResidual" -> originalResidual,
 "CandidateHermitianUV" -> candidate, "CandidateResidual" -> candidateResidual, "DefinitionResidual" -> definitionResidual,
 "Definitions" -> DownValues[physicalUVHermitian], "PhysicalConditions" -> physical, "ElapsedSeconds" -> seconds,
 "SourceHash" -> FileHash[source, "SHA256"], "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[baseline, "SHA256"],
 "InspectionHash" -> FileHash[inspectionPath, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inspection["InputHashes"],
 "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
directory = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqg", "s13_branch_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
path = FileNameJoin[{directory, "s13_result.wl"}]; Put[result, path];
gate["exact native reload", Get[path] === result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s13_checks.json"}], <|"checks" -> checks, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"], "accepted" -> True|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s13_check_uv_branches"]; Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
   GLI["UV", {3, -2, 0, -1}] -> (2*Q2 + 2*s + 2*t)*GLI["UV", {1, 0, 0, 0}], 
   GLI["UV", {3, -2, 0, 0}] -> GLI["UV", {1, 0, 0, 0}],
```

## common/s13_result/reference/s19_assemble_virtual.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-424", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10115, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s13_result/reference/s19_assemble_virtual.wl", "sha256": "f0e6bfb7831c6fcfc21e27e5ce21626ba33635f9cb3c955dbc270565dc35e7dc"} -->
```wolfram
(* Physical continuation and renormalization using only newly evaluated masters. *)
$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
root=DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
gate[name_,test_] := If[!TrueQ[test],Print["FAIL: ",name];
  If[$KernelID>0,Throw[$Failed,"S19Failure"],CloseKernels[];Quit[1]]];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[$InputFileName,"Text"]]];
put[value_,file_] := (Block[{$ContextPath={"System`","Global`"}},Put[value,file<>".tmp"]];
  RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True]);
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[label<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,gate[label<>" memory limit",False]];
parents=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s12_result.wl"}]];
evaluations=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s13_result.wl"}]];
uv=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s14_result.wl"}]];
manifest=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s18_result.wl"}]];
gate["accepted fresh virtual evaluation inputs",TrueQ[parents["Accepted"]]&&
  TrueQ[evaluations["AcceptedEuclideanParents"]]&&TrueQ[uv["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[manifest["Accepted"]]];
gate["virtual parent input identity",evaluations["InputFileHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"s12_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]];
sourceHash=FileHash[$InputFileName,"SHA256"];
inputHashes=Association@Table[name->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,name}],"SHA256"],
  {name,{"s12_result.wl","s13_result.wl","s14_result.wl","s18_result.wl"}}];
inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,inputHashes},"SHA256"];
work=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s19_virtual",IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[work],CreateDirectory[work,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
physical=Q2>0&&s>0&&t<0&&Q2+s+t>0&&mu>0&&SUNN>1;
reduce[value_] := Module[{refined,functions},
  refined=Refine[value,physical];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[refined,_Log|_PolyLog|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  Collect[Expand[refined],functions,Factor]];
continueMaster[master_,data_] := Catch[Module[
  {file,saved,parent,series,coefficients,polynomials,polynomial,signs,sign,shift,
   imaginary,functions,limits,rules,value,rawCoefficients,continued,result},
  file=FileNameJoin[{work,"s19_master_"<>IntegerString[Hash[master,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
  If[FileExistsQ[file],saved=Get[file];If[saved["InputHash"]===inputHash&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]],Return[saved]]];
  Print["VIRTUAL_CONTINUATION ",InputForm[master]," kernel ",$KernelID];
  parent=parents["ParentInputs"][data["ParentID"]];
  series=evaluations["Parents"][data["ParentID"]]["Series"]/.SubTropica`eps->eps;
  gate["virtual master has all required epsilon coefficients",MatchQ[series,_SeriesData]&&
    series[[5]]>manifest["RequiredOrders"][master]&&Length[series[[3]]]>0];
  coefficients=parent["SubTropicaInput"][[4]];
  polynomials=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[parent["Representation"][[1]],
    Power[base_,exponent_]/;!FreeQ[exponent,eps]&&AnyTrue[coefficients,!FreeQ[base,#]&]:>base,Infinity]];
  gate["one explicit kinematic Feynman polynomial",Length[polynomials]===1];
  polynomial=First[polynomials];
  signs=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[parent["Representation"][[4,3]],StandardPropagatorDenominator[_,_,_,{_,i0_}]:>i0,Infinity]];
  gate["one inherited Feynman pole prescription",Length[signs]===1&&MemberQ[{-1,1},First[signs]]];
  sign=First[signs];shift=(First[#]->Last[#]-I sign eta)& /@data["PhysicalSubstitutions"];
  imaginary=ComplexExpand[Im[polynomial/.shift]];
  gate["physical deformation stays on the inherited Feynman sheet",bounded[
    FullSimplify[sign imaginary<0,physical&&eta>0&&And@@(#>0& /@parent["Representation"][[3]])],
    "Feynman polynomial imaginary sign"]];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Normal[series],_Log|_PolyLog,Infinity]];
  limits=Table[
    value=bounded[FullSimplify[Limit[function/.shift,eta->0,Direction->"FromAbove",
      Assumptions->physical],physical],"physical logarithm or dilogarithm boundary"];
    gate["physical special-function boundary is evaluated",FreeQ[value,eta|_Limit|_ConditionalExpression|_Real|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
    function->value,{function,functions}];
  rawCoefficients=series[[3]];
  continued=Map[bounded[reduce[(#/.limits)/.data["PhysicalSubstitutions"]],"continued master coefficient"]&,rawCoefficients];
  value=Apply[SeriesData,ReplacePart[List@@series,3->continued]];
  gate["continued master has no Euclidean parameters",FreeQ[value,Alternatives@@coefficients]];
  result=<|"Master"->master,"Series"->value,"FunctionLimits"->limits,"FeynmanDeformation"->shift,
    "FeynmanPolynomial"->polynomial,"ImaginaryPart"->imaginary,"Conditions"->physical,
    "InputHash"->inputHash,"SourceHash"->sourceHash,"Accepted"->True|>;
  put[result,file];ClearSystemCache[];Print["VIRTUAL_MASTER_CONTINUED ",InputForm[master]];result],"S19Failure"];
slots=Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]],1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots]||slots<1,slots=1];CloseKernels[];
If[slots>1,LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost","KernelCommand"->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel","KernelCount"->Min[4,slots],"TimeConstraint"->60]]];
workers=Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers>0,ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength=0];DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,
  continueMaster,reduce,parents,evaluations,manifest,inputHash,sourceHash,work,physical]];
$DistributedContexts=None;
tasks=KeyValueMap[List,parents["VirtualMasterParents"]];
values=If[workers>0,ParallelMap[continueMaster@@#&,tasks,Method->"FinestGrained"],continueMaster@@#& /@tasks];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all new masters continued",FreeQ[values,$Failed|$Aborted]&&And@@Lookup[values,"Accepted"]];
masterValues=AssociationThread[Keys[parents["VirtualMasterParents"]],Lookup[values,"Series"]];
put[<|"Masters"->masterValues,"ContinuationRecords"->values,"InputHash"->inputHash|>,FileNameJoin[{work,"s19_masters.wl"}]];
fieldSplits=Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{field,residue},Module[{solution},
  solution=Solve[(residue/epsUV+ir/eps/.epsUV->eps)==0,ir];
  gate["bare field has a unique IR residue consistent with the scaleless integral",Length[solution]===1];
  field->(residue/epsUV+(ir/.First[solution])/eps)]],uv["FieldUVResidues"]];
channelResults=<||>;
Do[
  file=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s18_result.wl"}];data=Get[file];
  gate[channel<>" virtual coefficient identity",TrueQ[data["Accepted"]]&&FileHash[file,"SHA256"]===manifest["Channels"][channel]["Hash"]];
  born=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s01_inputs","s02_result.wl"}]];
  book=uv["FieldBookkeeping"][channel];
  gate[channel<>" Kira establishes the vanishing bare on-shell residue",book["BareOnShellResidue"]===0];
  fields=Flatten[KeyValueMap[ConstantArray[#1,#2]&,book["FieldCounts"]]];
  fieldFactor=Times@@(Sqrt[1+ord fieldSplits[#]]& /@fields);
  externalInterference=Coefficient[Normal[Series[fieldFactor^2,{ord,0,1}]],ord];
  gate[channel<>" external UV bookkeeping agrees with fresh residues",
    Factor[Coefficient[Expand[externalInterference],epsUV,-1]-book["ExternalUVResidue"]]===0];
  gate[channel<>" bare external contribution vanishes in the common regulator",
    Factor[externalInterference/.epsUV->eps]===0];
  pre=<||>;renormalized=<||>;uvResiduals=<||>;
  Do[
    Print["VIRTUAL_RENORMALIZE ",channel," ",mode];
    terms=KeyValueMap[Function[{master,coefficient},Module[{value},
      value=bounded[Series[(data["Measure"]/.Epsilon->eps)(coefficient/.D->4-2eps)masterValues[master],
        {eps,0,0}],"virtual loop measure and master multiplication"];
      gate["virtual product has the required regulator depth",value===0||(MatchQ[value,_SeriesData]&&value[[5]]>0)];
      Normal[value]]],data["Components"][mode]["Coefficients"]];
    interference=Total[terms];AssociateTo[pre,mode->interference];
    put[<|"Channel"->channel,"Mode"->mode,"PreHermitian"->interference,"InputHash"->inputHash|>,
      FileNameJoin[{work,"s19_pre_"<>channel<>"_"<>mode<>".wl"}]];
    Print["VIRTUAL_HERMITIAN ",channel," ",mode];
    hermitian=bounded[reduce[ComplexExpand[interference+Conjugate[interference],
      TargetFunctions->{Re,Im}]],"Hermitian interference"];
    fullUV=Factor[ComplexExpand[uv["VirtualUVResidues"][channel][mode]+
      Conjugate[uv["VirtualUVResidues"][channel][mode]]]];
    separated=hermitian+fullUV(1/epsUV-1/eps);
    gate["UV separation preserves the common-regulator tensor",Expand[(separated/.epsUV->eps)-hermitian]===0];
    bornD=born["Born"<>mode]/.D->4-2eps;
    counterterm=book["CouplingWeight"]uv["CouplingResidue"](uv["MSPole"]/.eps->epsUV)bornD;
    complete=separated+externalInterference bornD+counterterm;
    residual=Factor[Coefficient[Expand[complete],epsUV,-1]/.eps->0];
    AssociateTo[uvResiduals,mode->residual];
    gate[channel<>mode<>" complete UV cancellation",residual===0];
    value=bounded[Normal[Series[complete/.epsUV->eps,{eps,0,0}]],"renormalized virtual Laurent series"];
    gate["renormalized tensor has no unresolved integral or boundary",FreeQ[value,
      _GLI|_PaVe|_Integrate|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|epsUV|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
```

## common/s14_Hgg_native_subtraction.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-427", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4180, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_Hgg_native_subtraction.wls", "sha256": "ccc131fe8384d11d3df00d923c43e80364239c54c08acea97ea81735ae9130bd"} -->
```wolfram
(* Keep the accepted assembly and consume Hgg's native MS subtraction. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
hggNativeSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_Hgg_native_subtraction.wls"}];
hggNativeBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_compact_inputs.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0e87dc4d088369ad3cd9754e31c5aedd4e6a80db2f18b3d318abb345cd68a613"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[hggNativeSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
hggNativeAdapt[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];";
 new="gate[\"own native-subtraction assembly\",channel===\"Hgg\"&&!core];"<>
  "subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"];"<>
  "hggNativeReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,\"common\",\"s11_Hgg_native_routes.wls\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeReceipt=Import[hggNativeReceiptPath,\"RawJSON\"];"<>
  "gate[\"bound accepted native subtraction\",TrueQ[hggNativeReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&"<>
   "hggNativeReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],16,64]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"SourceHash\"]===FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionSource,\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"AcceptedForProduction\"]]&&TrueQ[subtraction[\"OwnAcceptedSubtractionComparison\"]]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"]]&&And@@Values[subtraction[\"Checks\"]]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"OriginalSubtractionHash\"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "FreeQ[subtraction[\"NativeCountertermDifference\"],eps|D|_SeriesData|$Failed|$Aborted]];"<>
  "inputPaths=Join[inputPaths,{hggNativeSource,hggNativeBase,hggNativeReceiptPath,hggNativeSubtractionSource}];";
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique Hgg subtraction input"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,
  Print["FAIL: unchanged full Hgg assembly prefix"];Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeInitialization[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="ToExpression[phaseRunPrefix,InputForm];";
 new="phaseRunPrefix=hggNativeAdapt[phaseRunPrefix];"<>old;
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique native assembly prefix handoff"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeText=StringTrim[Import[hggNativeBase,"Text"]];hggNativeTerminal="ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[hggNativeText,hggNativeTerminal],Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefix=StringDrop[hggNativeText,-StringLength[hggNativeTerminal]];
hggNativeEntry="ToExpression[compactAssemblyInitialization,InputForm];";
hggNativeChangedEntry="compactAssemblyInitialization=hggNativeInitialization[compactAssemblyInitialization];"<>hggNativeEntry;
If[StringCount[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry]=!=1,Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefixCandidate=StringReplace[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry->hggNativeChangedEntry];
If[!SyntaxQ[hggNativePrefixCandidate]||StringReplace[hggNativePrefixCandidate,hggNativeChangedEntry->hggNativeEntry]=!=hggNativePrefix,Quit[1]];
ToExpression[hggNativePrefixCandidate,InputForm];
hggNativeExport="compactAssemblyWrite[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
hggNativeExportCandidate="AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[hggNativeSource,\"SHA256\"],"<>
 "\"SubtractionResultHash\"->FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"->True}];"<>hggNativeExport;
gate["unique native Hgg finite export",StringCount[phaseRunTail,hggNativeExport]===1];
hggNativeFinal=StringReplace[phaseRunTail,hggNativeExport->hggNativeExportCandidate];
gate["all original final Hgg gates retained",SyntaxQ[hggNativeFinal]&&
 StringReplace[hggNativeFinal,hggNativeExportCandidate->hggNativeExport]===phaseRunTail];
ToExpression[hggNativeFinal,InputForm];

```

## common/s14_analyze_saved_pole.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-432", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5209, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_analyze_saved_pole.wls", "sha256": "59e452c30aee9a5bb60d3eef313dc2414aac3bde05ab8e7ff42967ff04c29cb8"} -->
```wolfram
(* Analyze the native failed Laurent record without modifying assembly inputs. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
root=Directory[];checks=<||>;
gate[label_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,label->True];Print["PASS: ",label],Print["FAIL: ",label];Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,300,gate["time "<>label,False]],2*1024^3,gate["memory "<>label,False]];
source=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_analyze_saved_pole.wls"}];
parent=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
input=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s14","Hqg","47e69226250f205317044df52dc3a4b6a756cabf6996d9f92b772464c140c584","finite_6fcb2f9004c78e81fb9b7b4216a945e6266355c36373a07beda4124fb49f9f10.wl"}];
gate["source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[source,"Text"]]];
gate["exact reviewed assembly",IntegerString[FileHash[parent,"SHA256"],16,64]==="9f511361187996d8fef88f8897ba2b40018032d9d4e789ec2cd17d445939a94a"];
gate["exact saved failed input",IntegerString[FileHash[input,"SHA256"],16,64]==="21588f5e5cc51db69a7e4e7764d840c3b2a3368f60acdd182433197c7deb8340"];
parentText=Import[parent,"Text"];
domainText=StringCases[parentText,RegularExpression["softPhysical=[^;]+;"]];
gate["one original endpoint domain",Length[domainText]===1&&SyntaxQ[First[domainText]]];
ToExpression[First[domainText],InputForm];
saved=Get[input];label=saved["Label"];
gate["failed delta record with three original parts",AssociationQ[saved]&&saved["Accepted"]===False&&Last[label]==="Delta"&&Length[saved["InputParts"]]===3];
domain=(softPhysical/.t->label[[2]] omega-s)&&omega>0;
gate["resolved original physical domain",FreeQ[domain,t|s23|_Missing]];
powers=Keys[saved["PoleResiduals"]];
parts=AssociationThread[{"Real","Virtual","Subtraction"},saved["InputParts"]];
partPoles=Association@KeyValueMap[Function[{name,value},name->Association@Table[n->Coefficient[Expand[value,eps],eps,n],{n,powers}]],parts];
radicals=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[{partPoles,saved["PoleResiduals"]},Power[base_,exponent_Rational]:>Power[base,exponent],Infinity]];
atomRows=Table[Module[{candidate,proof,seconds},
 {seconds,candidate}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[FullSimplify[PowerExpand[radical,Assumptions->domain],domain,TimeConstraint->{1,15}],"radical reduction"]];
 proof=bounded[FullSimplify[radical==candidate,domain,TimeConstraint->{1,15}],"radical equality"];
 Print["RADICAL_REDUCTION ",index,"/",Length[radicals]," exact ",TrueQ[proof]];
 <|"Original"->radical,"Candidate"->candidate,"Exact"->TrueQ[proof],"Seconds"->seconds|>],{index,Length[radicals]},{radical,{radicals[[index]]}}];
atomRows=Flatten[atomRows,1];
rules=(#["Original"]->#["Candidate"])&/@Select[atomRows,TrueQ[#["Exact"]]&];
canonical[value_]:=bounded[FullSimplify[Factor[Together[Refine[PowerExpand[value/.rules,Assumptions->domain],domain]]],domain,TimeConstraint->{1,90}],"pole canonicalization"];
canonicalParts=Map[canonical,partPoles,{2}];
directPoles=Association@Table[n->Total[#[n]&/@Values[partPoles]],{n,powers}];
canonicalDirect=Map[canonical,directPoles];
canonicalSaved=Map[canonical,saved["PoleResiduals"]];
canonicalSum=Association@Table[n->canonical[Total[#[n]&/@Values[canonicalParts]]],{n,powers}];
variables=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[{domain,partPoles},v_Symbol/;Context[v]==="Global`",Infinity]];
variables=DeleteCases[variables,eps];
pointVariables=Select[variables,!FreeQ[domain,#]&];
pointRules=bounded[FindInstance[domain,pointVariables,Reals,3],"physical points"];
gate["native physical point construction",Length[pointRules]>0&&AllTrue[pointRules,TrueQ[domain/.#]&]];
numericRows=Table[<|"Rules"->point,"OriginalPoles"->N[directPoles/.point,60],
 "SavedPoles"->N[saved["PoleResiduals"]/.point,60],"CanonicalPoles"->N[canonicalDirect/.point,60],
 "SeparateParts"->N[partPoles/.point,60]|>,{point,pointRules}];
Print["CANONICAL_DIRECT ",canonicalDirect];Print["CANONICAL_SAVED ",canonicalSaved];Print["CANONICAL_SEPARATE_SUM ",canonicalSum];
Print["PHYSICAL_POINT_VALUES ",numericRows];
out=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s14_pole_analysis_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out]];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-saved-pole-analysis-v1","Channel"->"Hqg","Label"->label,
 "Domain"->domain,"OriginalDomainSource"->First[domainText],"OriginalInputHash"->saved["InputHash"],
 "Parts"->partPoles,"SavedResiduals"->saved["PoleResiduals"],"RadicalCertificates"->atomRows,
 "CanonicalParts"->canonicalParts,"CanonicalDirect"->canonicalDirect,"CanonicalSaved"->canonicalSaved,
 "CanonicalSeparateSum"->canonicalSum,"PhysicalPoints"->numericRows,
 "AllDirectPolesStructurallyZero"->AllTrue[Values[canonicalDirect],#===0&],
 "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False,"SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"ParentHash"->FileHash[parent,"SHA256"],
 "InputFileHash"->FileHash[input,"SHA256"],"NativeVersion"->$Version,"Checks"->checks|>;
Put[result,FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_result.wl"}]];
gate["native exact output round trip",Get[FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_result.wl"}]]===result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->"Hqg","checks"->checks,"all_direct_poles_structurally_zero"->result["AllDirectPolesStructurallyZero"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_analyze_saved_pole"];Quit[0];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-433", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8091, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_assemble_Hgq_finite_update.wls", "sha256": "1a1a93a147c5a6988f1eed039554949ab03b7cf2423b97408878ef24700d0dca"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse accepted Laurent coefficients after an explicitly finite subtraction change. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
updateSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_Hgq_finite_update.wls"}];
updateLegacySource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_Hgq_roots.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[updateLegacySource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "4f695976bf5320e47df51bc3d8def722c573d2988be5c3afd412c794068d73c8",Quit[1]];
updateLegacyText=Import[updateLegacySource,"Text"];
updateEntry="ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[StringTrim[updateLegacyText],updateEntry]||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[updateSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
updatePrefix=StringTake[updateLegacyText,
  First[Last[StringPosition[updateLegacyText,updateEntry]]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[updatePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[updatePrefix,InputForm];
gate["own finite-update channel",channel==="Hgq"&&core];
updateOldCache=cache;updateOldInputHash=inputHash;updateOldInputHashes=inputHashes;
updateOldCounterterms=subtraction["Counterterms"];
updateOriginalAssembly=DownValues[assemble];
updateOldControl=assemble[First[poleRunProof["ControlLabel"]]];
gate["own accepted assembly control retained",TrueQ[updateOldControl["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateOldControl["Checks"]]];
updateRelative=channel<>"/s11_msbar_result/s11_result.wl";
updateSubtractionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,updateRelative}];
updateReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_msbar_result","s11_execution.json"}];
updateComparisonPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_msbar_result","s11_comparison.wl"}];
updateSubtractionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s11_finalize_Hgq_subtraction.wls"}];
updateReceipt=Import[updateReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
updateSubtraction=Get[updateSubtractionPath];updateComparison=Get[updateComparisonPath];
gate["accepted finite MS subtraction execution",TrueQ[updateReceipt["passed"]]&&
  updateReceipt["result_sha256"][updateRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[updateSubtractionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  updateSubtraction["SourceHash"]===FileHash[updateSubtractionSource,"SHA256"]&&
  updateSubtraction["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[updateSubtraction["AcceptedForProduction"]]&&
  TrueQ[updateSubtraction["FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateSubtraction["Checks"]]];
gate["complete native subtraction comparison",TrueQ[updateComparison["AcceptedForProduction"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateComparison["Checks"]]&&AllTrue[updateComparison["Comparisons"],TrueQ[#["Equal"]]&]&&
  updateSubtraction["ConvolutionComparisonHash"]===FileHash[updateComparisonPath,"SHA256"]&&
  updateComparison["OriginalAssemblyInputHash"]===updateOldInputHash&&
  updateComparison["OriginalSubtractionHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","s11_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]];
gate["same physical subtraction basis",updateSubtraction["PhotonLabels"]===subtraction["PhotonLabels"]&&
  updateSubtraction["SpinLabels"]===subtraction["SpinLabels"]&&
  updateSubtraction["Prefactor"]===subtraction["Prefactor"]&&
  updateSubtraction["MSPole"]===subtraction["MSPole"]];
updateDifference=Association@Table[distribution->Map[Factor,
  updateSubtraction["Counterterms"][distribution]-updateOldCounterterms[distribution],{3}],
  {distribution,Keys[updateOldCounterterms]}];
gate["actual full-spin counterterm difference is finite",FreeQ[updateDifference,
  eps|D|_Missing|_Integrate|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
gate["exact subtraction difference from native comparison",And@@Flatten[
  Map[Together[#]===0&,Values[updateDifference]-Values[updateComparison["Correction"]],{4}]]];
updateNormalization=eq^2 couplingSquare^2 hardNormalization;
updateCheckpointHashes=<||>;
updateAssemble[index_,difference_] := Block[{checks=<||>},Module[
  {branches,label,path,saved,change,value},
  branches=Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[
    label={index,sign,distribution};path=FileNameJoin[{updateOldCache,
      "finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
    gate["required own accepted finite checkpoint",FileExistsQ[path]];
    saved=Get[path];
    gate["bound own finite checkpoint",TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&
      saved["InputHash"]===updateOldInputHash&&saved["Label"]===label&&AssociationQ[saved["PoleResiduals"]]];
    AssociateTo[updateCheckpointHashes,StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[path,"SHA256"]];
    change=If[KeyExistsQ[difference,distribution],Extract[difference[distribution],index],0]/.t->sign omega-s;
    value=updateNormalization (saved["Finite"]+change);
    gate["finite updated physical component",FreeQ[value,eps|D|gs|_Missing|_FeynCalc`GLI|_CutIntegral|_FeynCalc`PaVe|
      _Integrate|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
    distribution->value,{distribution,distributions}],{sign,{1,-1,0}}];
  <|"Index"->index,"Branches"->branches,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>]];
updateZeroDifference=Map[ConstantArray[0,Dimensions[#]]&,updateDifference];
updateReusedControl=updateAssemble[updateOldControl["Index"],updateZeroDifference];
gate["own accepted complete output comparison",updateReusedControl["Branches"]===updateOldControl["Branches"]];
Clear[updateOldControl,updateReusedControl];
updateIndices=Tuples[{Range[Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]]],
  Range[Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]],Range[Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]]}];
updateControlIndex=SelectFirst[updateIndices,Function[index,
  AnyTrue[Values[updateDifference],Function[tensor,Extract[tensor,index]=!=0]]]];
gate["a changed physical component is available",MemberQ[updateIndices,updateControlIndex]];
subtraction=updateSubtraction;
inputPaths=DeleteDuplicates[Join[inputPaths,{updateSource,updateLegacySource,updateSubtractionPath,
  updateReceiptPath,updateComparisonPath,updateSubtractionSource}]];
inputHashes=Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@inputPaths];
inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,inputHashes,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
cache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s14",channel,IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache],CreateDirectory[cache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
Print["DIRECT_FINITE_UPDATE_CONTROL ",InputForm[updateControlIndex]];
{updateDirectSeconds,updateDirectControl}=AbsoluteTiming[assemble[updateControlIndex]];
gate["direct updated assembly control accepted",TrueQ[updateDirectControl["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateDirectControl["Checks"]]];
{updateReuseSeconds,updateReuseControl}=AbsoluteTiming[updateAssemble[updateControlIndex,updateDifference]];
gate["updated complete component equals direct assembly",And@@Flatten[Table[
  zero[updateDirectControl["Branches"][sign][distribution]-updateReuseControl["Branches"][sign][distribution],
    (If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->sign omega-s)&&If[sign===0,True,omega>0]],
  {sign,{1,-1,0}},{distribution,distributions}]]];
updateEvidence=<|"Index"->updateControlIndex,"DirectSeconds"->updateDirectSeconds,
  "ReuseSeconds"->updateReuseSeconds,"OwnAcceptedOutputComparison"->True,
  "DirectUpdatedComponentComparison"->True,"FiniteCountertermDifference"->True|>;
Print["FINITE_UPDATE_COMPARISON ",InputForm[updateEvidence]];
Clear[updateDirectControl,updateReuseControl,updateSubtraction,updateOldCounterterms];ClearSystemCache[];
Clear[assemble];assemble[index_] := updateAssemble[index,updateDifference];
updateExportAnchor="poleFinalPut[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
gate["unique original final finite export",StringCount[phaseRunTail,updateExportAnchor]===1];
updateExportCode="AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[updateSource,\"SHA256\"],"<>
  "\"SubtractionResultHash\"->FileHash[updateSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],"<>
  "\"FiniteUpdateEvidence\"->updateEvidence,\"PreviousAssemblyInputHash\"->updateOldInputHash,"<>
  "\"PreviousCheckpointHashes\"->updateCheckpointHashes}];"<>updateExportAnchor;
phaseRunTail=StringReplace[phaseRunTail,updateExportAnchor->updateExportCode];
gate["complete updated finite assembly syntax",SyntaxQ[phaseRunTail]];
ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];
```

## common/s14_assemble_Hgq_reference_reuse.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-434", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9498, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_assemble_Hgq_reference_reuse.wls", "sha256": "0b6399010d47c35f475cc42993989f00235c6694826f9752925175a2eed74ee3"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse executed reference reductions after exact reconstruction of the new hats. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
certificateSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_Hgq_reference_reuse.wls"}];
certificateBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_Hgq_finite_update.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[certificateBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "1a1a93a147c5a6988f1eed039554949ab03b7cf2423b97408878ef24700d0dca",Quit[1]];
certificateText=Import[certificateBase,"Text"];
certificateEntry="ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[StringTrim[certificateText],certificateEntry]||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[certificateSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
certificatePrefix=StringTake[certificateText,
  First[Last[StringPosition[certificateText,certificateEntry]]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[certificatePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[certificatePrefix,InputForm];

certificateRead[relative_] := Module[{path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}]},
  gate["accepted comparison input "<>relative,
    KeyExistsQ[updateComparison["InputHashes"],relative]&&
    FileHash[path,"SHA256"]===updateComparison["InputHashes"][relative]];
  AppendTo[inputPaths,path];Get[path]];
certificateResidual=certificateRead[channel<>"/s11_resolved_gluon_result/s11_result.wl"];
certificateInspection=certificateRead[channel<>"/s14_reference_residual_result/s14_result.wl"];
certificateTerms=certificateRead[channel<>"/s14_reference_terms_result/s14_result.wl"];
certificateOld=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","s11_result.wl"}]];
certificateMS=Get[updateSubtractionPath];
certificateResidualSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s11_check_Hgq_resolved_gluon.wls"}];
gate["same executed reference reducer",certificateResidual["SourceHash"]===
  FileHash[certificateResidualSource,"SHA256"]&&
  FileHash[certificateResidualSource,"SHA256"]===
    updateComparison["InputHashes"]["common/s11_check_Hgq_resolved_gluon.wls"]&&
  StringCount[Import[certificateResidualSource,"Text"],
    "candidate=normalization photonWeights[[First[FirstPosition[Keys[referenceHats],name]]]].(values+change);"]===1];
gate["same complete reference calculation",channel==="Hgq"&&core&&flavorDomain===True&&
  certificateResidual["Channel"]===channel&&
  certificateResidual["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&
  certificateResidual["OriginalAssemblyInputHash"]===updateOldInputHash&&
  certificateInspection["InputHash"]===updateOldInputHash&&
  And@@Values[certificateResidual["Checks"]]&&
  certificateResidual["CheckpointHashes"]===updateComparison["CheckpointHashes"]&&
  certificateInspection["PhotonWeights"]===hatPhotonWeights&&
  Factor[certificateTerms["Normalization"]-updateNormalization]===0];
Do[gate["unchanged reference equation input "<>relative,
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"]===updateComparison["InputHashes"][relative]],
  {relative,Keys[updateComparison["InputHashes"]]}];
certificateZeroArray[value_] := And@@(Together[#]===0&/@Flatten[{value}]);
certificatePreviousChange=Association@Table[distribution->Map[Factor,
  certificateResidual["Counterterms"][distribution]-certificateOld["Counterterms"][distribution],{3}],
  {distribution,Keys[certificateOld["Counterterms"]]}];
certificateExtra=Association@Table[distribution->Map[Factor,
  certificateMS["Counterterms"][distribution]-certificateResidual["Counterterms"][distribution],{3}],
  {distribution,Keys[certificateMS["Counterterms"]]}];
gate["same actual finite scheme change",certificateZeroArray[
  Values[certificateExtra]-Values[updateComparison["ExtraCounterterms"]]]&&
  certificateZeroArray[Values[updateDifference]-Values[certificateExtra]-Values[certificatePreviousChange]]];
certificateRows=<||>;certificateControl=False;
certificateCompare[value_,conditions_] := Module[
  {key={name,sign,distribution},weights,oldValues,oldChange,newChange,extraChange,
   reconstructed,variables,before,after,projectedChange,row,accepted,residual,seconds},
  weights=hatPhotonWeights[[First[FirstPosition[Keys[referenceHats],name]]]];
  gate["same current reference domain",conditions===
    ((If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->sign omega-s)&&
      If[sign===0,True,omega>0]&&flavorDomain)];
  row=SelectFirst[certificateResidual["Comparisons"],
    Lookup[#,{"Hat","Branch","Distribution"}]===key&];
  accepted=SelectFirst[updateComparison["Comparisons"],
    Lookup[#,{"Hat","Branch","Distribution"}]===key&];
  gate["exact accepted reference row",AssociationQ[row]&&AssociationQ[accepted]&&
    TrueQ[accepted["Equal"]]&&accepted["Residual"]===0];
  oldValues=Table[Module[{label={{a,uPosition,uPosition},sign,distribution},path,saved,relative},
    path=FileNameJoin[{updateOldCache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
    relative=StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1];
    gate["same coefficient used by executed reference reduction",
      FileHash[path,"SHA256"]===certificateResidual["CheckpointHashes"][relative]&&
      updateCheckpointHashes[relative]===certificateResidual["CheckpointHashes"][relative]];
    saved=Get[path];
    gate["same accepted finite coefficient",TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&
      saved["InputHash"]===updateOldInputHash&&saved["Label"]===label];saved["Finite"]],
    {a,Length[weights]}];
  oldChange=If[KeyExistsQ[certificatePreviousChange,distribution],
    certificatePreviousChange[distribution][[All,uPosition,uPosition]],ConstantArray[0,Length[weights]]]/.t->sign omega-s;
  newChange=If[KeyExistsQ[updateDifference,distribution],
    updateDifference[distribution][[All,uPosition,uPosition]],ConstantArray[0,Length[weights]]]/.t->sign omega-s;
  extraChange=If[KeyExistsQ[certificateExtra,distribution],
    certificateExtra[distribution][[All,uPosition,uPosition]],ConstantArray[0,Length[weights]]]/.t->sign omega-s;
  reconstructed=Sum[weights[[a]]updateNormalization(oldValues[[a]]+newChange[[a]]),{a,Length[weights]}];
  gate["actual assembled coefficient reconstructed exactly",
    reconstructed===hats[name]["NLO"][sign][distribution][[uPosition,uPosition]]&&
    value===reconstructed-referenceHats[name]["NLO"][sign][distribution]];
  variables=Table[Unique["finiteCoefficient"],{Length[weights]}];
  before=certificateTerms["Normalization"]weights.(variables+oldChange);
  after=Sum[weights[[a]]updateNormalization(variables[[a]]+newChange[[a]]),{a,Length[weights]}];
  projectedChange=certificateTerms["Normalization"]weights.extraChange;
  gate["native projection update identity",Together[Expand[after-before-projectedChange]]===0];
  {seconds,residual}=AbsoluteTiming[Factor[Together[row["Residual"]+projectedChange]]];
  gate["executed residual plus actual update matches",residual===accepted["Residual"]];
  AssociateTo[certificateRows,ToString[key,InputForm]-><|"Hat"->name,"Branch"->sign,
    "Distribution"->distribution,"ActualResidualHash"->Hash[value,"SHA256"],
    "ExactCoefficientReconstruction"->True,"NativeProjectionIdentity"->True,
    "Residual"->residual,"ReductionSeconds"->seconds|>];True];
certificateZero[value_,conditions_] := Module[{direct,reused,seconds},
  If[name===First[Keys[referenceHats]]&&sign===1&&distribution==="Delta",
    {seconds,direct}=AbsoluteTiming[poleReferenceZero[value,conditions]];
    reused=certificateCompare[value,conditions];
    gate["own complete accepted reference output comparison",TrueQ[direct]&&direct===reused];
    certificateControl=<|"Label"->{name,sign,distribution},"DirectSeconds"->seconds,
      "ExactOwnOutputComparison"->True|>;Return[direct]];
  If[distribution==="Regular",
    gate["own direct reference comparison passed",AssociationQ[certificateControl]];
    Return[certificateCompare[value,conditions]]];
  poleReferenceZero[value,conditions]];
certificateTail=phaseRunTail;
gate["same complete final reference interface",StringCount[certificateTail,"bounded[poleReferenceZero["]===2];
phaseRunTail=StringReplace[certificateTail,"bounded[poleReferenceZero["->"bounded[certificateZero["];
gate["complete original assembly preserved",StringReplace[phaseRunTail,
  "bounded[certificateZero["->"bounded[poleReferenceZero["]===certificateTail];
inputPaths=DeleteDuplicates[Join[inputPaths,{certificateSource,certificateBase,certificateResidualSource},
  FileNameJoin[{root,#}]&/@Keys[updateComparison["InputHashes"]]]];
inputHashes=Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@inputPaths];
inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,inputHashes,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
certificateExport="poleFinalPut[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
gate["unique final certified export",StringCount[phaseRunTail,certificateExport]===1];
certificateExportCode=
  "gate[\"all regular reference rows certified\",AssociationQ[certificateControl]&&Sort[Lookup[#,{\"Hat\",\"Branch\",\"Distribution\"}]&/@Select[Values[certificateRows],#[\"Distribution\"]===\"Regular\"&]]===Sort[Lookup[#,{\"Hat\",\"Branch\",\"Distribution\"}]&/@Select[updateComparison[\"Comparisons\"],#[\"Distribution\"]===\"Regular\"&]]];"<>
  "AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[certificateSource,\"SHA256\"],\"FiniteUpdateDispatchHash\"->FileHash[certificateBase,\"SHA256\"],\"ReferenceReuseCertificate\"-><|\"OwnControl\"->certificateControl,\"Rows\"->certificateRows,\"AcceptedComparisonHash\"->FileHash[updateComparisonPath,\"SHA256\"]|>}];"<>certificateExport;
phaseRunTail=StringReplace[phaseRunTail,certificateExport->certificateExportCode];
gate["complete certified assembly syntax",SyntaxQ[phaseRunTail]];
ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];

```

```wolfram
(* Original finite assembly with the accepted reference Laurent-product routine. *)

  "9f511361187996d8fef88f8897ba2b40018032d9d4e789ec2cd17d445939a94a"||
  IntegerString[FileHash[phaseRunProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "2aec26ba5852ad86bf22f5bbbc797e071005d8916de3202923d4bee33fbf74a9",Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];

    "checkedPhaseProduct[strongFactor realBranch[index,sign,distribution],phase,0,{index,sign,distribution}]",
  "epsSeries[phase strongFactor commonReal[distribution]]"->
    "checkedPhaseProduct[strongFactor commonReal[distribution],phase,0,{index,0,distribution}]",
  "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"Null"};
If[!And@@(StringCount[phaseRunPrefix,First[#]]===1&/@phaseRunReplacements),Quit[1]];

ToExpression[phaseRunPrefix,InputForm];
phaseRunProof=Get[phaseRunProofPath];
gate["accepted reference phase implementation",TrueQ[phaseRunProof["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[phaseRunProof["Checks"]]&&phaseRunProof["BaselineSourceHash"]===sourceHash&&
  phaseRunProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_phase_series.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  phaseRunProof["LaurentSourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  phaseRunProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];

phaseMonomialCheck[kernel_,power_,order_] := Module[{key,actual,expected},
  key=Hash[{kernel,power,order},"SHA256"];
```

```wolfram
poleFinalPut[value_,path_] := Module[{serialized,temporary=path<>".tmp"},
```

```wolfram
(* Use the accepted own regulator-only Laurent product in unchanged finite assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;

If[IntegerString[FileHash[finiteRegulatorParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0ffae5e7a1a813a5f3537d3159784d2bde2490d5c8937888a6b35c16575bd39b"||

 receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s14_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted own regulator phase receipt",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
   receipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s14_regulator_phase_result/s14_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 proof=Get[path];

   proof["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[proof["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[proof["Checks"]]&&
   And@@(#===0&/@Values[proof["Residuals"]])&&proof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
   proof["InputHash"]===inputHash&&proof["InputHashes"]===inputHashes&&
   proof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_regulator_phase.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
   proof["ParentHash"]===FileHash[finiteRegulatorParent,"SHA256"]&&

 DownValues[laurentProduct]=proof["CandidateDefinitions"]/.regulatorLaurentProduct->laurentProduct;

   (proof["CandidateDefinitions"]/.regulatorLaurentProduct->laurentProduct)];
 finiteRegulatorEvidence=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[finiteRegulatorSource,"SHA256"],"ComparisonHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],
   "Control"->proof["Control"],"OriginalSeconds"->proof["OriginalSeconds"],"CandidateSeconds"->proof["CandidateSeconds"]|>;
```
