```wolfram
(* Componentwise adaptation of the pinned GitHub S20 assembly.
   This stage retains the minimally subtracted BMHV scheme explicitly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
sourcePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];checks=<||>;
gate[name_,test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,name],Print["PASS: ",name]];AssociateTo[checks,name->True],
  Print["FAIL: ",name];If[TrueQ[$KernelID>0],Throw[$Failed,"S14Failure"],CloseKernels[];Quit[1]]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath,"Text"]]];
put[value_,file_] := (Put[value,file<>".tmp"];RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True]);
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" memory limit",False]];
configPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_inputs.json"}];config=Import[configPath,"RawJSON"];
basePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s01_inputs.json"}];base=Import[basePath,"RawJSON"];
gate["known assembly channel",KeyExistsQ[config["channels"],channel]];
core=base["channel_contracts"][channel]["amplitude_schema"]==="core";
inputPaths={configPath,basePath};
readPinned[relative_] := Module[{row,path},
  row=SelectFirst[config["files"],#["destination"]===relative&];path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
  gate["pinned "<>relative,IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
  AppendTo[inputPaths,path];If[StringEndsQ[path,".json"],Import[path,"RawJSON"],Get[path]]];
referenceSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_result","reference","s20_final_hats.wl"}];
referenceRow=SelectFirst[config["files"],#["destination"]==="common/s14_result/reference/s20_final_hats.wl"&];
gate["pinned original final assembly",IntegerString[FileHash[referenceSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===referenceRow["sha256"]];
AppendTo[inputPaths,referenceSource];
loadResult[relative_] := Module[{path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}]},
  gate["required input "<>relative,FileExistsQ[path]];AppendTo[inputPaths,path];Get[path]];
basis=loadResult["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"];
library=loadResult["common/s06_result/s06_result.wl"];
gate["accepted spin basis and scalar library",And@@Values[basis["Checks"]]&&And@@Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row=library["Library"][stage],path,value},
  path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["File"]}];gate[stage<>" pinned library geometry",
    IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["SHA256"]];
  AppendTo[inputPaths,path];value=Get[path];value/.{Q2->Q^2,w->s23}];
geometry=readLibrary["s02"];cutGeometry=readLibrary["s08"];
real=loadResult[channel<>"/s12_result/s12_result.wl"];
spinReal=loadResult[channel<>"/s05_result/s05_result.wl"];
subtraction=loadResult[channel<>"/s11_result/s11_result.wl"];
gate["accepted integrated real tensor",real["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-real-distributions-v1"&&
  real["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[real["CutMeasureIntegrated"]]&&TrueQ[real["MasterExpansionDepthChecked"]]&&
  And@@Values[real["Checks"]]&&AllTrue[real["Components"],TrueQ[#["Accepted"]]&]];
gate["accepted real tensor and subtraction",spinReal["Channel"]===channel&&subtraction["Channel"]===channel&&
  And@@Values[spinReal["Checks"]]&&And@@Values[subtraction["Checks"]]];
gate["same physical spin and photon bases",real["PhotonLabels"]===basis["PhotonLabels"]&&
  real["SpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]&&subtraction["PhotonLabels"]===real["PhotonLabels"]&&
  subtraction["SpinLabels"]===real["SpinLabels"]];
gate["matching explicit regulator scheme",real["Gamma5Scheme"]==="BMHV"&&subtraction["Gamma5Scheme"]==="BMHV"];
physical=Q>0&&s>s23>0&&s23-Q^2-s<t<-Q^2 s23/s&&mu>0&&mu2>0&&B>0&&SUNN>1;
softPhysical=Q>0&&s>0&&t<0&&Q^2+s+t>0&&mu>0&&mu2>0&&B>0&&SUNN>1;
dimension=4-2eps;
stateNormalization=(2Pi)^D Times@@Table[(2Pi)^(-(D-1)),{momentum,geometry["CutMomenta"]}];
stateNormalization=FullSimplify[stateNormalization/.D->dimension];
angularJacobian=FullSimplify[cutGeometry["RadialPrefactor"]
  (cutGeometry["SphereAreaDefinition"]/.nn->D-1-Length[{theta,phi}]/.D->dimension)];
hardNormalization=(2Pi)^(-Limit[dimension,eps->0]);
couplingSquare=Factor[gs^2/.First[Solve[gs^2==4Pi alphaS,gs]]];
phaseInput=readPinned[config["channels"][channel]["phase"]];
sourcePhase=ToExpression[phaseInput["DefinitionExpression"]]/.{Q2->Q^2,w->s23};
projectorReference=readPinned[config["channels"][channel]["projectors"]];
referenceHats=Map[readPinned,config["channels"][channel]["unpolarized_hats"]]/.{Q2->Q^2,w->s23,Nc->SUNN};
gate["reference hat symbols match inherited conventions",FreeQ[referenceHats,Q2|w|Nc|Global`SUNN|Global`Nf]];
projectorDefinitions=If[core,
  ({f1,f2}/.projectorReference["ProjectorsEpsilon"]/.eps->0/.projectorReference["BornKinematics"])/.
    {hg->metricContraction,hpp->incomingContraction},
  ({f1,f2}/.projectorReference["Projectors"])/.
    {D->4,xh->Q^2/(s+Q^2),Hg->metricContraction,Hpp->incomingContraction}]/.Q2->Q^2;
gate["original projectors fully resolved",FreeQ[projectorDefinitions,f1|f2|hg|hpp|Hg|Hpp|xh|eps|D|_Missing]];
projectorWeights=Table[Coefficient[expression,symbol],{expression,projectorDefinitions},
  {symbol,{metricContraction,incomingContraction}}];
gate["linear original scalar projectors",Expand[projectorDefinitions-
  projectorWeights.{metricContraction,incomingContraction}]===ConstantArray[0,Length[projectorDefinitions]]];
photonAxes={eL,eX,eY};
realFrame=spinReal["Frame"];
frameMatrix=Transpose[realFrame/@Append[photonAxes,q]];
incomingExpansion=LinearSolve[frameMatrix,realFrame[p]];
gate["incoming vector reconstructed in photon frame",Expand[frameMatrix.incomingExpansion-realFrame[p]]===
  ConstantArray[0,Length[realFrame[p]]]];
incomingComponents=Take[incomingExpansion,Length[photonAxes]];
metricWeights=Tr[basis["PhotonMetric"].#]&/@basis["PhotonBasis"];
incomingWeights=Factor[incomingComponents.#.incomingComponents]&/@basis["PhotonBasis"];
hatPhotonWeights=Map[Factor,projectorWeights.{metricWeights,incomingWeights},{2}];
gate["original hat weights are independent of recoil and branch",FreeQ[hatPhotonWeights,t|s23|omega]];
flavorDomain=True;weights=<||>;bookkeeping=<||>;strongFactor=1;
If[core,
  virtual=loadResult[channel<>"/s13_result/s13_result.wl"];
  born=loadResult[channel<>"/s03_result/s03_result.wl"];
  gate["accepted renormalized virtual and Born tensors",virtual["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-renormalized-virtual-v1"&&
    virtual["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[virtual["UVRenormalized"]]&&TrueQ[virtual["IntegratedWardChecksPassed"]]&&
    virtual["Gamma5Scheme"]==="BMHV"&&And@@Values[virtual["Checks"]]&&And@@Values[born["Checks"]]];
  gate["core counterterm normalization",subtraction["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-collinear-convolutions-v1"&&
    !TrueQ[Lookup[subtraction,"CountertermsIncludePhaseAndCouplings",False]]];
  definitions=readPinned[config["channels"][channel]["bookkeeping"]];bookkeeping=definitions["Bookkeeping"];
  phase=mu^(2eps)stateNormalization;
  gate["original core phase normalization",bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[
    phase angularJacobian-sourcePhase s23^-eps],physical&&Element[eps,Reals]],"core normalization"]===0];
  If[channel==="Hqq",
    ranges=DeleteDuplicates[#[[2]]&/@Values[bookkeeping["OtherChargeMomentDefinitions"]]];
    gate["one inherited flavor range",Length[ranges]===1];range=First[ranges];
    flavorDomain=Reduce[Element[range[[3]],Integers]&&range[[2]]<=bookkeeping["ObservedFlavor"]<=range[[3]],range[[3]],Integers];
    originalCount=bookkeeping["DistinctFlavorMultiplicity"];
    canonicalCount=If[Head[originalCount]===Piecewise,originalCount[[1,1,1]],originalCount];
    gate["original flavor count on its complete domain",Reduce[flavorDomain&&originalCount!=canonicalCount,range[[3]],Integers]===False];
    weights=Map[FullSimplify[#["FlavorWeight"]/.originalCount->canonicalCount,flavorDomain]&,bookkeeping["Components"]]],
  gate["small counterterm normalization",subtraction["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-small-collinear-convolutions-v1"&&
    TrueQ[subtraction["CountertermsIncludePhaseAndCouplings"]]];
  generated=loadResult[base["channel_contracts"][channel]["amplitude_file"]];
  fields=Lookup[generated,"outgoing_fields",Missing["ReadGeneratedProcess"]];
  If[MissingQ[fields],options=List@@Head[generated["graphs"]];
    fields=FirstCase[options,HoldPattern[Rule[key_Symbol,process_Rule]]/;SymbolName[key]==="Process":>Last[process],Missing["ProcessFields"]]];
  gate["generated fields match momenta",ListQ[fields]&&Length[fields]===Length[generated["outgoing"]]];
  observed=Position[generated["outgoing"],k1];gate["one tagged momentum",Length[observed]===1];
  spectators=Delete[fields,observed];weight=1/(Times@@(Factorial/@Values[Counts[spectators]]));
  gate["one small-channel sector",Length[Keys[real["Bookkeeping"]]]===1];
  sectorBook=First[Values[real["Bookkeeping"]]];
  gate["spectator weight matches contracted tensor",weight===sectorBook["TagWeight"]&&!TrueQ[sectorBook["TagWeightAppliedToTensor"]]];
  sourcePhase=sourcePhase/.symmetryWeight->weight;
  phase=weight mu2^(2eps)hardNormalization stateNormalization;
  gate["original small-channel phase normalization",bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[
    phase angularJacobian-sourcePhase/Pi],physical&&Element[eps,Reals]],"small normalization"]===0];
  strongFactor=Times@@Table[gs^Last[sectorBook["AmplitudeCouplingPowers"]],{factor,{"amplitude","conjugate amplitude"}}];
  gate["real and subtraction coupling degrees match",Exponent[strongFactor,gs]===
    Exponent[subtraction["PhaseCT"]subtraction["BornCoupling"],gs]]];
gate["no mixed color symbol contexts",FreeQ[{real,subtraction,bookkeeping},Global`SUNN|Global`Nf]];
sourceHash=FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"];
inputHashes=Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@DeleteDuplicates[inputPaths]];
inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,inputHashes,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
cache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s14",channel,IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache],CreateDirectory[cache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
reduce[value_,assumptions_] := Module[{expression,functions},
  expression=Refine[value,assumptions];
  expression=PowerExpand[expression/.Log[arg_]:>Log[Factor[arg]],Assumptions->assumptions];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[expression,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  Collect[Expand[expression],functions,Factor]];
zero[value_,assumptions_] := Module[{expression=reduce[value,assumptions]},expression===0||FullSimplify[expression,assumptions]===0];
epsSeries[value_] := Normal[Series[value,{eps,0,0}]];
boundary[value_,assumptions_] := bounded[reduce[Limit[value,omega->0,
  Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->assumptions],assumptions],"common branch boundary"];
weighted[expression_,sector_] := If[channel=!= "Hqq",expression,Module[{rows,monomials,names},
  gate["polynomial distinct-flavor charge dependence",PolynomialQ[expression,chargeRatio]];
  rows=CoefficientRules[expression,{chargeRatio}];monomials=chargeRatio^First[First[#]]&/@rows;
  gate["exact charge decomposition",Expand[expression-Total[MapThread[Times,{Last/@rows,monomials}]]]===0];
  names=(sector<>"_Charge"<>ToString[First[First[#]]])&/@rows;
  gate["all charge components have inherited weights",AllTrue[names,KeyExistsQ[weights,#]&]];
  Total[MapThread[Times,{Last/@rows,weights/@names}]]]];
physicalComponents=Select[real["Components"],#["Kind"]==="ExtendedResponse"&&
  And@@Thread[Rest[#["Index"]]<=Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]]&];
componentKeys={#["Sector"],#["Index"]}&/@physicalComponents;
gate["unique integrated physical components",DuplicateFreeQ[componentKeys]];
componentRows[index_] := Select[physicalComponents,#["Index"]===index&];
realBranch[index_,sign_,distribution_] := Total[weighted[#["Branches"][sign][distribution],#["Sector"]]&/@componentRows[index]];
realOrdinary[index_] := Total[weighted[#["Ordinary"],#["Sector"]]&/@componentRows[index]];
virtualValue[index_] := If[!core,0,With[{key={"ExtendedResponse",index}},
  If[KeyExistsQ[virtual["Components"],key],2Pi virtual["Components"][key]["RenormalizedVirtual"]/.virtual["Regulator"]->eps,0]]];
subtractionValue[index_,distribution_] := If[distribution==="L1",0,Extract[subtraction["Counterterms"][distribution],index]];
finitePart[parts_,label_,assumptions_] := Module[{file,saved,combined,powers,residues,value},
  file=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
  saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];
  If[Lookup[saved,"InputHash",None]===inputHash&&TrueQ[Lookup[saved,"Accepted",False]],Return[saved["Finite"]]];
  Print["POLE_ASSEMBLY ",label];
  gate["finite symbolic input parts",FreeQ[parts,_Integrate|_Series|_SeriesData|_Limit|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
  combined=Expand[Total[parts],eps];
  powers=Range[Min[Append[Cases[combined,Power[eps,n_Integer]/;n<0:>n,Infinity],0]],-1];
  gate["evaluated Laurent polynomial",PolynomialQ[Expand[eps^(-Min[Append[powers,0]])combined],eps]];
  residues=Association@Table[n->bounded[reduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions],{label,"pole simplification",n}],{n,powers}];
  put[<|"Label"->label,"PoleResiduals"->residues,"InputParts"->parts,"InputHash"->inputHash,"Accepted"->False|>,file];
  Do[gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" pole "<>ToString[n],bounded[zero[residues[n],assumptions],{label,"pole cancellation",n}]],{n,powers}];
  value=Coefficient[combined,eps,0];
  gate["finite evaluated tensor",FreeQ[value,eps|_Integrate|_Series|_SeriesData|_Limit|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
  put[<|"Label"->label,"PoleResiduals"->Map[Factor,residues],"Finite"->value,"InputHash"->inputHash,"Accepted"->True|>,file];value];
distributions={"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"};
assemble[index_] := Catch[Block[{checks=<||>},Module[
  {branches,middle,assumptions,virtualBoundary,limits,commonReal,value,normalization},
  branches=Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[
    assumptions=(If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->sign omega-s)&&omega>0&&flavorDomain;
    value=finitePart[{bounded[epsSeries[phase strongFactor realBranch[index,sign,distribution]],{index,"real phase"}],
      If[distribution==="Delta",virtualValue[index],0]/.t->sign omega-s,
      subtractionValue[index,distribution]/.t->sign omega-s},{index,sign,distribution},assumptions];
    distribution->value,{distribution,distributions}],{sign,{1,-1}}];
  virtualBoundary=boundary[virtualValue[index]/.t->omega-s,
    (softPhysical/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain&&Element[eps,Reals]&&eps!=0];
  limits=Association@Table[distribution->Table[boundary[realBranch[index,sign,distribution],
    (softPhysical/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain],{sign,{1,-1}}],{distribution,{"Delta","L0","L1"}}];
  KeyValueMap[gate["real endpoint branches share a boundary",zero[Subtract@@#2,(softPhysical/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain]]&,limits];
  commonReal=Map[First,limits];
  AssociateTo[commonReal,"Regular"->((realOrdinary[index]/.t->-s)-commonReal["L0"]/s23-commonReal["L1"]Log[s23/B]/s23)];
  middle=Association@Table[assumptions=(If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain;
    distribution->finitePart[{bounded[epsSeries[phase strongFactor commonReal[distribution]],{index,"boundary real phase"}],
      If[distribution==="Delta",virtualBoundary,0],subtractionValue[index,distribution]/.t->-s},
      {index,0,distribution},assumptions],{distribution,distributions}];
  branches=Join[branches,<|0->middle|>];
  normalization=If[core,eq^2 couplingSquare^2 hardNormalization,1];
  branches=Map[Function[branch,Map[normalization #&,branch]],branches];
  If[!core,branches=branches/.gs->Sqrt[couplingSquare];
    If[channel==="Hgg",branches=branches/.eq^2->chargeSum];
    If[channel==="Hqqbar",branches=branches/.eq^2->eq2]];
  gate["finite physical component",FreeQ[branches,eps|gs|_GLI|_CutIntegral|_PaVe|_Integrate|_Series|_Limit|_Real|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
  <|"Index"->index,"Branches"->branches,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>]],"S14Failure"];
indices=Tuples[{Range[Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]]],Range[Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]],Range[Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]]}];
values=assemble/@indices;
gate["all physical components finite",FreeQ[values,$Failed|$Aborted]&&AllTrue[values,AssociationQ]&&And@@Lookup[values,"Accepted"]];
gate["all component checks accepted",And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@values]];
componentValues=AssociationThread[Lookup[values,"Index"],Lookup[values,"Branches"]];
dimensions={Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]],Length[basis["SpinLabels"]],Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]};
leadingResponse=If[core,eq^2 couplingSquare 2Pi hardNormalization born["ResponseD4"],ConstantArray[0,dimensions]];
finiteResponse=Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[distribution->Table[
  componentValues[{a,j,i}][sign][distribution],{a,dimensions[[1]]},{j,dimensions[[2]]},{i,dimensions[[3]]}],
  {distribution,distributions}],{sign,{1,-1,0}}];
hats=AssociationThread[{"F1","F2"},Table[<|"LODelta"->Table[
  Sum[hatPhotonWeights[[hatIndex,a]]leadingResponse[[a,j,i]],{a,dimensions[[1]]}],
  {j,dimensions[[2]]},{i,dimensions[[3]]}],
  "NLO"->Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[distribution->Table[
    Sum[hatPhotonWeights[[hatIndex,a]]finiteResponse[sign][distribution][[a,j,i]],{a,dimensions[[1]]}],
    {j,dimensions[[2]]},{i,dimensions[[3]]}],{distribution,distributions}],{sign,{1,-1,0}}]|>,
  {hatIndex,Length[projectorDefinitions]}]];
gate["finite original hat projections",FreeQ[hats,eps|gs|f1|f2|metricContraction|incomingContraction|
  _Missing|_GLI|_CutIntegral|_PaVe|_Integrate|_Series|_Limit|_Real|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
uPosition=First[FirstPosition[basis["SpinLabels"],"U"]];
Do[
  expectedLeading=If[core,referenceHats[name]["LODelta"],0];
  gate[name<>" original unpolarized Born hat",bounded[zero[
    hats[name]["LODelta"][[uPosition,uPosition]]-expectedLeading,softPhysical&&flavorDomain],
    name<>" Born hat comparison"]];
  Do[expected=If[core,referenceHats[name]["NLO"][sign][distribution],
      If[distribution==="Regular",referenceHats[name]/.t->sign omega-s,0]];
    assumptions=(If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->sign omega-s)&&
      If[sign===0,True,omega>0]&&flavorDomain;
    gate[name<>" original unpolarized finite hat "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm],bounded[zero[
      hats[name]["NLO"][sign][distribution][[uPosition,uPosition]]-expected,assumptions],
      {name,sign,distribution,"original finite hat comparison"}]],
    {sign,{1,-1,0}},{distribution,distributions}],{name,Keys[hats]}];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-finite-bmhv-response-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "PhotonLabels"->basis["PhotonLabels"],"SpinLabels"->basis["SpinLabels"],"IndexOrder"->real["IndexOrder"],
  "Components"->values,"LODeltaResponse"->leadingResponse,"NLOResponse"->finiteResponse,
  "FhatsBMHV"->hats,"FhatPhotonWeights"->hatPhotonWeights,"ProjectorDefinitions"->projectorDefinitions,
  "PhysicalFrame"->KeyTake[realFrame,Join[{p,q,k1},photonAxes,{eOutX,eOutY}]],
  "Bookkeeping"->bookkeeping,"RealPhase"->phase,"RestoredRealCoupling"->strongFactor,
  "HardNormalization"->hardNormalization,"PlusDefinition"->real["PlusDefinition"],
  "BranchConvention"->"sign=+1/-1 means t=sign omega-s, omega>0; sign=0 means t=-s",
  "PhysicalConditions"->physical,"FlavorDomain"->flavorDomain,"Gamma5Scheme"->"BMHV",
  "SubtractionScheme"->"Minimal subtraction with the recorded MSbar pole and unconverted BMHV spin operators",
  "CompletePoleCancellationChecked"->True,"UnpolarizedFinalReferenceComparisonPassed"->True,
  "FiniteMinimalSubtractionCoefficientsComputed"->True,
  "FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False,
  "SourceHash"->sourceHash,"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"Checks"->checks|>;
resultDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir],CreateDirectory[resultDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,"s14_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,
  "component_count"->Length[values],"finite_minimal_subtraction_coefficients_computed"->True,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_assemble_finite_spin"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Install the accepted compact charge/phase equations in the finite assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
finiteStructuralSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_structural.wls"}];
finiteStructuralParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_cached_parts.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[finiteStructuralParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0ffae5e7a1a813a5f3537d3159784d2bde2490d5c8937888a6b35c16575bd39b"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[finiteStructuralSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
finiteStructuralText=StringTrim[Import[finiteStructuralParent,"Text"]];
finiteStructuralTerminal="ToExpression[cachedPartsRun,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[finiteStructuralText,finiteStructuralTerminal],Quit[1]];
finiteStructuralPrefix=StringDrop[finiteStructuralText,-StringLength[finiteStructuralTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[finiteStructuralPrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[finiteStructuralPrefix,InputForm];

finiteStructuralInstall[] := Module[{directory,receipt,chargeProof,phaseProof,source,phaseDefinitions,
 checkedDefinitions,originalChecked,actualCoefficient,actualValue,weightSeconds,phaseSeconds,anchor,replacement,old},
 directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_structural_weight_result"}];
 receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted own structural comparison receipt",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]];
 KeyValueMap[gate["bound structural comparison "<>#1,
   IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,receipt["result_sha256"]];
 chargeProof=Get[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_charge_comparison.wl"}]];
 phaseProof=Get[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_result.wl"}]];
 source=FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_structural_weight.wls"}],"SHA256"];
 gate["same accepted structural sources inputs and native versions",AllTrue[{chargeProof,phaseProof},
   #["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[#["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[#["Checks"]]&&
   #["SourceHash"]===source&&#["InputHash"]===inputHash&&#["InputHashes"]===inputHashes&&
   #["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&]];
 gate["complete own charge and phase comparison identities",
   chargeProof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-structural-charge-comparison-v1"&&
   phaseProof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-structural-phase-comparison-v1"&&phaseProof["OwnResidual"]===0&&
   AllTrue[chargeProof["Evidence"],TrueQ[#["Accepted"]]&&And@@(#===0&/@#["ExactResiduals"])&]&&
   chargeProof["OriginalDefinitions"]===DownValues[weighted]&&chargeProof["Weights"]===weights&&
   phaseProof["OriginalDefinitions"]===DownValues[phaseProduct]&&
   phaseProof["LaurentDefinitions"]===DownValues[laurentProduct]&&phaseProof["ActualKernel"]===phase&&
   phaseProof["ParentHash"]===FileHash[finiteStructuralParent,"SHA256"]];
 DownValues[structuralChargeRows]=chargeProof["CoefficientDefinitions"];
 DownValues[weighted]=chargeProof["CandidateDefinitions"];
 gate["exact accepted charge equations installed",DownValues[weighted]===chargeProof["CandidateDefinitions"]&&
   DownValues[structuralChargeRows]===chargeProof["CoefficientDefinitions"]];
 phaseDefinitions=phaseProof["CandidateDefinitions"]/.structuralPhaseProduct->phaseProduct;
 gate["single reconstructed Laurent product interface",Count[phaseDefinitions,_laurentProduct,Infinity]===1];
 checkedDefinitions=phaseDefinitions/.laurentProduct->finiteStructuralLaurent;
 gate["phase equations retain exact accepted form",(checkedDefinitions/.finiteStructuralLaurent->laurentProduct)===phaseDefinitions];
 DownValues[phaseProduct]=checkedDefinitions;
 originalChecked=DownValues[checkedPhaseProduct];
 gate["original complete phase caller has one product and support expansion",
   Count[originalChecked,_phaseProduct,Infinity]===1&&Count[originalChecked,_phaseMonomialCheck,Infinity]===1&&
   Count[originalChecked,_Expand,Infinity]===1];
 Clear[checkedPhaseProduct];
 checkedPhaseProduct[coefficient_,kernel_,order_,label_] := phaseProduct[coefficient,kernel,order,label];
 {weightSeconds,actualCoefficient}=AbsoluteTiming[strongFactor (realBranch@@phaseProof["ActualLabel"])];
 gate["entire actual compact weighted input reproduced",actualCoefficient===phaseProof["ActualCoefficient"]];
 {phaseSeconds,actualValue}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
   checkedPhaseProduct[actualCoefficient,phase,0,phaseProof["ActualLabel"]],"own complete structural caller"]];
 gate["entire accepted actual phase output reproduced",actualValue===phaseProof["ActualValue"]];
 gate["original Laurent equations unchanged",DownValues[laurentProduct]===phaseProof["LaurentDefinitions"]];
 finiteStructuralEvidence=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[finiteStructuralSource,"SHA256"],
   "ChargeComparisonHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_charge_comparison.wl"}],"SHA256"],
   "PhaseComparisonHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],
   "ReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_execution.json"}],"SHA256"],
   "ActualLabel"->phaseProof["ActualLabel"],"OwnInputAndOutputEqual"->True,

 anchor="compactAssemblyWrite[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
 replacement="AssociateTo[result,\"StructuralComparison\"->finiteStructuralEvidence];"<>anchor;
 gate["unique structural evidence export",StringCount[phaseRunTail,anchor]===1];
 old=phaseRunTail;phaseRunTail=StringReplace[old,anchor->replacement];
 gate["all final finite acceptance gates retained",SyntaxQ[phaseRunTail]&&StringReplace[phaseRunTail,replacement->anchor]===old]];

finiteStructuralLaurent[polynomial_,kernel_,order_] := Module[{first,last},
 first=Exponent[polynomial,eps,Min];last=Exponent[polynomial,eps];
 Scan[phaseMonomialCheck[kernel,#,order]&,Range[first,last]];
 laurentProduct[polynomial,kernel,order]];
finiteStructuralAnchor="cachedPartsRecord[];ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
finiteStructuralReplacement="cachedPartsRecord[];finiteStructuralInstall[];ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[StringCount[cachedPartsRun,finiteStructuralAnchor]=!=1,Quit[1]];
finiteStructuralRun=StringReplace[cachedPartsRun,finiteStructuralAnchor->finiteStructuralReplacement];
If[!SyntaxQ[finiteStructuralRun]||StringReplace[finiteStructuralRun,finiteStructuralReplacement->finiteStructuralAnchor]=!=cachedPartsRun,Quit[1]];
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse the accepted residual refinement on the actual failed assembly pole. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
poleRoot=Directory[];

poleConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{poleRoot,"common","s14_Hgq_pole_factorization_inputs.json"}];
poleSettings=Import[poleConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
poleBaseline=FileNameJoin[{poleRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[poleBaseline,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=poleSettings["baseline_sha256"],Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
poleText=Import[poleBaseline,"Text"];
If[StringCount[poleText,"\nindices=Tuples"]=!=1,Quit[1]];

polePrefix=StringReplace[polePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"Null"];
poleFrameAnchor="realFrame=spinReal[\"Frame\"];";
poleFrameRelease=poleFrameAnchor<>"Clear[spinReal];ClearSystemCache[];";

If[StringReplace[polePrefix,poleFrameRelease->poleFrameAnchor]=!=poleUnreleasedPrefix,Quit[1]];
If[!SyntaxQ[polePrefix]||!SyntaxQ[Import[poleSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[polePrefix,InputForm];
gate["own pole comparison channel",channel===poleSettings["channel"]&&channel==="Hgq"&&core];
KeyValueMap[gate["bound pole comparison input "<>#1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,poleSettings["files"]];
poleFailedPath=FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["failed_checkpoint"]}];
poleControlPath=FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["control_checkpoint"]}];
poleFailed=Get[poleFailedPath];poleControl=Get[poleControlPath];
gate["failed checkpoint retains exact assembly inputs",poleFailed["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
  !TrueQ[poleFailed["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[poleFailed,"InputParts"]&&
  Length[poleFailed["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
gate["own accepted control identity",poleControl["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
  TrueQ[poleControl["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[poleControl,"Finite"]&&
  Length[poleControl["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
poleReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["failed_receipt"]}],"RawJSON"];
gate["failed execution binds the unchanged assembly",poleReceipt["job_id"]===poleSettings["failed_job_id"]&&
  !TrueQ[poleReceipt["passed"]]&&poleReceipt["exit_code"]===1&&
  poleReceipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"]===poleSettings["baseline_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[gate["failed execution input unchanged "<>#1,
  poleReceipt["reviewed_sha256"][#1]===IntegerString[#2,16,64]]&,inputHashes];
poleUV=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_result.wl"}]];
poleUVReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted existing residual routine",TrueQ[poleUVReceipt["passed"]]&&TrueQ[poleUV["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[poleUV["Checks"]]&&poleUV["RefinedOriginalResidual"]===0&&poleUV["RefinedSumResidual"]===0&&
  poleUV["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s13_check_uv_branches.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  poleUV["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
DownValues[refineUVResidual]=poleUV["Definitions"];
gate["exact existing residual routine installed",DownValues[refineUVResidual]===poleUV["Definitions"]];
poleFactorCertificates=<||>;
poleInheritedPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqqbar","s14_pole_factorization_result","s14_result.wl"}];
poleInherited=Get[poleInheritedPath];
poleInheritedReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[poleInheritedPath],"s14_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted inherited assembly refinement",TrueQ[poleInheritedReceipt["passed"]]&&
  poleInheritedReceipt["job_id"]==="14806606"&&TrueQ[poleInherited["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[poleInherited["Checks"]]&&
  poleInheritedReceipt["result_sha256"]["Hqqbar/s14_pole_factorization_result/s14_result.wl"]===
    IntegerString[FileHash[poleInheritedPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  poleInherited["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_pole_factorization.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  poleInherited["BaselineSourceHash"]===sourceHash&&poleInherited["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&
  AllTrue[poleInherited["Rows"],#["Refined"]===0&&#["InputSumRefined"]===0&]&&
  AllTrue[poleInherited["ControlRows"],#["Refined"]===0&]];
gate["unchanged original predicates and refinement definitions",
  DownValues[zero]===poleInherited["OriginalZeroDefinitions"]&&
  DownValues[finitePart]===poleInherited["OriginalFinitePartDefinitions"]&&
  DownValues[refineUVResidual]===poleInherited["RefinementDefinitions"]];
DownValues[refineAssemblyPole]=poleInherited["Definitions"];
gate["exact accepted assembly refinement installed",DownValues[refineAssemblyPole]===poleInherited["Definitions"]];

poleConditions[label_] := (If[Last[label]==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->label[[2]]omega-s)&&
  If[label[[2]]===0,True,omega>0]&&flavorDomain;
SetAttributes[poleBounded,HoldFirst];
poleBounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,300,
  gate["pole comparison time bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],2*1024^3,
  gate["pole comparison memory bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
poleControlConditions=poleConditions[poleControl["Label"]];
poleControlRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},
  gate["own original pole predicate "<>ToString[power],poleBounded[zero[value,poleControlConditions],"original control"]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[value,poleControlConditions],"refined control"]];
  gate["own accepted pole unchanged "<>ToString[power],Last[timed]===0];
  <|"Power"->power,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Refined"->Last[timed]|>],poleControl["PoleResiduals"]];
poleActualConditions=poleConditions[poleFailed["Label"]];
poleCombined=Expand[Total[poleFailed["InputParts"]],eps];
poleRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},
  factored=poleBounded[Factor[Together[value]],"actual saved residue factorization"];
  Print["ACTUAL_FACTORED_POLE ",power," ",InputForm[factored]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[value,poleActualConditions],"actual saved residue refinement"]];
  sumTimed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[
    actual=reduce[Coefficient[poleCombined,eps,power],poleActualConditions];
    gate["original input reduction exactly reproduces saved residue "<>ToString[power],
      actual===value||Together[actual-value]===0];
    Last[timed],"complete original input pole"]];

  Print["ACTUAL_REFINED_POLE ",power," ",InputForm[Last[timed]]," INPUT_SUM ",InputForm[Last[sumTimed]]];

    "InputSumRefined"->Last[sumTimed],"InputSumMethod"->"OriginalReductionAndExactSavedResidueEquality","Seconds"->First[timed],"InputSumSeconds"->First[sumTimed]|>],poleFailed["PoleResiduals"]];

  "ControlRows"->poleControlRows,"Rows"->poleRows,"FactorCertificates"->poleFactorCertificates,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
```

```wolfram
(* Compare the saved finite residual with the executed dimensional counterterm change. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];checks=<||>;

  Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",channel==="Hgq"&&StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath,"Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" memory limit",False]];
inspectionRelative=channel<>"/s14_reference_residual_result/s14_result.wl";
inspectionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,inspectionRelative}];inspection=Get[inspectionPath];
receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[inspectionPath],"s14_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact residual input",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&receipt["job_id"]==="14815618"&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][inspectionRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  inspection["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-reference-residual-inspection-v1"&&inspection["Channel"]===channel&&
  inspection["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_inspect_Hgq_reference_residual.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  inspection["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&And@@Values[inspection["Checks"]]];
basePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];baseText=Import[basePath,"Text"];
gate["unchanged original assembly",inspection["BaselineSourceHash"]===FileHash[basePath,"SHA256"]];
normalizationDefinitions=StringRiffle[{
  "dimension=4-2eps;",
  "hardNormalization=(2Pi)^(-Limit[dimension,eps->0]);",
  "couplingSquare=Factor[gs^2/.First[Solve[gs^2==4Pi alphaS,gs]]];"},"\n"];
gate["exact original normalization definitions",And@@(StringCount[baseText,#]===1&/@StringSplit[normalizationDefinitions,"\n"])];
ToExpression[normalizationDefinitions,InputForm];
core=True;branches=<|1-><|"Delta"->1|>|>;
gate["inherited component normalization syntax",SyntaxQ[inspection["NormalizationSource"]]];
ToExpression[inspection["NormalizationSource"],InputForm];
normalizationFactor=branches[1]["Delta"];
basisPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s02_result","s02_result.wl"}];basis=Get[basisPath];
currentPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","s11_result.wl"}];current=Get[currentPath];
previousPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","reference","before_dimensional_completion","s11_result.wl"}];
previous=Get[previousPath];
gate["same accepted subtraction input",FileHash[currentPath,"SHA256"]===inspection["InputHashes"][channel<>"/s11_result/s11_result.wl"]&&
  current["Channel"]===channel&&previous["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[current["Checks"]]&&And@@Values[previous["Checks"]]&&
  current["PreviousSubtractionHash"]===FileHash[previousPath,"SHA256"]&&
  current["PhotonLabels"]===basis["PhotonLabels"]&&current["SpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]&&
  FileHash[basisPath,"SHA256"]===inspection["InputHashes"]["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"]];
u=First[FirstPosition[basis["SpinLabels"],"U"]];
difference=Map[Factor,current["Counterterms"]["Delta"]-previous["Counterterms"]["Delta"],{3}];
gate["actual saved dimensional correction",difference===current["CountertermDifference"]["Delta"]&&FreeQ[difference,eps|D]];
assumptions=inspection["PhysicalConditions"];
reduceTerms[value_]:=bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[value,assumptions],assumptions],"saved finite equation"];
rows=Table[
  input=inspection["Rows"][[n]];
  correction=(normalizationFactor inspection["PhotonWeights"][[n]].difference[[All,u,u]])/.
    t->input["Branch"] omega-s;
  gate["same branch variables "<>input["Hat"],FreeQ[correction,t]];
  residual=reduceTerms[input["Residual"]];
  remaining=reduceTerms[input["Residual"]-correction];
  Print["REFERENCE_TERM_COMPARISON ",input["Hat"]," residual ",InputForm[residual]];
  Print["REFERENCE_MINUS_DIMENSIONAL_CHANGE ",input["Hat"]," ",InputForm[remaining]];
  <|"Hat"->input["Hat"],"Branch"->input["Branch"],"Distribution"->input["Distribution"],
    "Residual"->residual,"DimensionalCountertermCorrection"->correction,
    "ResidualWithoutDimensionalChange"->remaining,"DimensionalChangeExplainsResidual"->(remaining===0)|>,
  {n,Length[inspection["Rows"]]}];
gate["finite evaluated comparison",FreeQ[rows,_Integrate|_Series|_Limit|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-reference-term-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"],"InspectionHash"->FileHash[inspectionPath,"SHA256"],
  "SubtractionHash"->FileHash[currentPath,"SHA256"],"PreviousSubtractionHash"->FileHash[previousPath,"SHA256"],
  "AssemblySourceHash"->FileHash[basePath,"SHA256"],"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "PhysicalConditions"->assumptions,"Normalization"->normalizationFactor,"Rows"->rows,"Checks"->checks,
  "ProductionChanged"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
out=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_terms_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
file=FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_result.wl"}];
text=ToString[result,InputForm]<>"\n";gate["bounded readable comparison",StringLength[text]<128*1024^2];
Export[file<>".tmp",text,"Text"];gate["exact native comparison reload",Get[file<>".tmp"]===result];
RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "dimensional_change_explains_residual"->Lookup[rows,"DimensionalChangeExplainsResidual"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_check_Hgq_reference_terms"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse the accepted residual refinement on the actual failed assembly pole. *)

gate["accepted inherited assembly refinement",TrueQ[poleInheritedReceipt["passed"]]&&

normalizeAssemblyRoots[value_,conditions_] := Module[
```

```wolfram
ownPoleRefine[value_,conditions_] := Module[{roots,degree,factorRows,factors,signs,positiveFactors,
 basisFactors,variables,restore,constraints,rules,normalized,identity,answer,rows={},base,row,
 signProduct,monomial,exponent,whole,fraction,positive,index,rational,num,den,division,
 reconstruction,started=AbsoluteTime[]},
 roots=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value,power:Power[_,_Rational]:>power,{0,Infinity}]];
 If[roots==={},Return[Factor[Together[value]]]];
 degree=LCM@@(Denominator[#[[2]]]&/@roots);
 factorRows=Map[Function[power,
   base=Together[power[[1]]];
   gate["rational root argument",FreeQ[base,Power[_,_Rational]]];
   row=Join[FactorList[Numerator[base]],({First[#],-Last[#]}&/@FactorList[Denominator[base]])];
   gate["native root factorization reconstructed",Together[base-(Times@@(Power@@#&/@row))]===0];row],roots];
 factors=DeleteDuplicates[First/@Flatten[factorRows,1]];
 signs=FullSimplify[Sign[#],conditions,TimeConstraint->20]&/@factors;
 Print["OWN_ROOT_FACTOR_SIGNS ",InputForm[Thread[factors->signs]]];
 gate["every root factor has a proved real nonzero sign",AllTrue[signs,MemberQ[{-1,1},#]&]];
 positiveFactors=MapThread[Expand[#1 #2]&,{factors,signs}];
 basisFactors=DeleteDuplicates[Select[positiveFactors,#=!=1&]];
 variables=Table[Unique["sidisPositiveRoot"],{Length[basisFactors]}];
 restore=Thread[variables->(Power[#,1/degree]&/@basisFactors)];
 constraints=MapThread[#1^degree-#2&,{variables,basisFactors}];
 rules=MapThread[Function[{power,parts},
   signProduct=Times@@Map[Function[part,

   monomial=signProduct^power[[2]] (Times@@Map[Function[part,
     index=First[FirstPosition[factors,First[part],Missing["Factor"],{1}]];positive=positiveFactors[[index]];
     exponent=Last[part]power[[2]];
     If[positive===1,1,
       whole=Floor[exponent];fraction=degree(exponent-whole);
       gate["derived root monomial has integer support",IntegerQ[fraction]&&0<=fraction<degree];
       positive^whole variables[[First[FirstPosition[basisFactors,positive,Missing["PositiveFactor"],{1}]]]]^fraction]],parts]);
   identity=FullSimplify[power-(monomial/.restore),conditions,TimeConstraint->20];
   Print["OWN_CANONICAL_ROOT_EQUATION ",InputForm[power]," -> ",InputForm[monomial/.restore]," residual ",InputForm[identity]];
   gate["exact own physical root identity",identity===0];
   AppendTo[rows,<|"Original"->power,"Monomial"->monomial,"Residual"->identity|>];
   power->monomial],{roots,factorRows}];
 Print["OWN_POLE_ROOT_BASIS ",InputForm[<|"Degree"->degree,"Restore"->restore,"Constraints"->constraints,"Rows"->rows|>]];
 normalized=value/.rules;

 rational=Together[normalized];num=Numerator[rational];den=Denominator[rational];

 gate["exact full root reduction identity",reconstruction===0];
 answer=Factor[Last[division]];

 controlConditions,actualConditions,controlRows,actualRows,combined,timed,sumTimed,original,priorSeconds,
 result,directory,path,serialized},
 settingsPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_Hqq_pole_inputs.json"}];

 uvPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_result.wl"}];uv=Get[uvPath];
 receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[uvPath],"s13_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted exact existing residual routine",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&TrueQ[uv["Accepted"]]&&
   And@@Values[uv["Checks"]]&&uv["RefinedOriginalResidual"]===0&&uv["RefinedSumResidual"]===0&&

 DownValues[refineUVResidual]=uv["Definitions"];

 ownPoleRootEvidence=<||>;

   {priorSeconds,original}=AbsoluteTiming[ownPoleBounded[zero[value,controlConditions],"original own control"]];

   <|"Power"->power,"OriginalSeconds"->priorSeconds,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Residual"->Last[timed]|>],control["PoleResiduals"]];

   gate["actual original contribution pole vanishes",Last[sumTimed]===0];
   Print["OWN_ACTUAL_POLE_REFINED ",power," seconds ",First[timed]," sum_seconds ",First[sumTimed]];
   <|"Power"->power,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Residual"->Last[timed],

 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-own-pole-refinement-v1","Channel"->channel,"Accepted"->True,
```

```wolfram
(* Inspect the exact saved first-component charge polynomials used by S14. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];checks=<||>;
source=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_charge_reconstruction.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_] := If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[source,"Text"]]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
path=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_result","s12_result.wl"}];
receiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_result","s12_execution.json"}];receipt=Import[receiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted own integrated result",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===receipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s12_result/s12_result.wl"]];
real=Get[path];gate["accepted real schema",real["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-real-distributions-v1"&&
  real["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[real["Checks"]]];
physicalRows=Select[real["Components"],#["Kind"]==="ExtendedResponse"&];
index=First[physicalRows]["Index"];rows=Select[physicalRows,#["Index"]===index&];
saved=Flatten[Table[Join[
  Flatten[Table[<|"Sector"->row["Sector"],"Index"->index,"Branch"->sign,"Distribution"->dist,
    "Expression"->row["Branches"][sign][dist]|>,{sign,{1,-1}},{dist,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}]],
  {<|"Sector"->row["Sector"],"Index"->index,"Branch"->"Ordinary","Distribution"->"Ordinary","Expression"->row["Ordinary"]|>}],{row,rows}]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];bounded[value_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,600,$Aborted],2*1024^3,$Aborted];
inspect[row_] := Module[{expression=row["Expression"],rules,monomials,reconstruction,residual,original,seconds,reduced},
  gate["polynomial distinct-flavor charge dependence",PolynomialQ[expression,chargeRatio]];
  rules=CoefficientRules[expression,{chargeRatio}];monomials=chargeRatio^First[First[#]]&/@rules;
  reconstruction=Total[MapThread[Times,{Last/@rules,monomials}]];
  residual=bounded[Expand[expression-reconstruction]];original=residual===0;
  {seconds,reduced}=AbsoluteTiming[If[original,0,bounded[Together[residual]]]];
  If[!original,Print["ACTUAL_CHARGE_RECONSTRUCTION ",InputForm[Join[KeyDrop[row,"Expression"],
    <|"Expression"->expression,"Rules"->rules,"ExpandedResidual"->residual,"TogetherResidual"->reduced|>]]]];
  gate["own exact charge reconstruction",reduced===0];
  Join[KeyDrop[row,"Expression"],<|"InputHash"->Hash[expression,"SHA256"],"InputBytes"->ByteCount[expression],
    "OriginalPredicatePassed"->original,"TogetherSeconds"->seconds,"ExactResidual"->reduced,
    "Expression"->expression,"CoefficientRules"->rules,"ExpandedResidual"->residual,"Accepted"->True|>]];
values=inspect/@saved;gate["complete own input comparisons",Length[values]===Length[saved]&&And@@Lookup[values,"Accepted"]];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-charge-reconstruction-v1","Channel"->channel,"Index"->index,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"RealHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],
  "ProducerReceiptHash"->FileHash[receiptPath,"SHA256"],"Comparisons"->values,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_charge_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
output=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_result.wl"}];serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded native result",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[output<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
gate["exact native reload",Get[output<>".tmp"]===result];RenameFile[output<>".tmp",output,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"comparison_count"->Length[values],
  "original_predicate_failures"->Count[Lookup[values,"OriginalPredicatePassed"],False],"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_check_charge_reconstruction"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Locate the reference residual using the saved dimensional contractions. *)
$HistoryLength=0;diagnosticRoot=Directory[];

If[IntegerString[FileHash[diagnosticPhaseSource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "cb02337e0b7b4e6734a6d34fe452f90af7fbf29c40a0b6f38e076fad778176ce",Quit[1]];

ToExpression[diagnosticPrefix,InputForm];
gate["dimensional diagnostic real-only quark channel",channel==="Hqqprime"&&!core];
diagnosticResidualPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_residual_result","s14_result.wl"}];
gate["accepted residual inspection identity",IntegerString[FileHash[diagnosticResidualPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "a92ec00fbd123a2c27126eeb077e1086991cec9332753667e5ae30cd0818f28a"];
diagnosticResidual=Get[diagnosticResidualPath];
gate["same assembly inputs",diagnosticResidual["InputHash"]===inputHash&&And@@Values[diagnosticResidual["Checks"]]];
diagnosticU=First[FirstPosition[basis["SpinLabels"],"U"]];
diagnosticAssumptions=diagnosticResidual["PhysicalConditions"];
diagnosticNormalize[value_] := Block[{branches,normalization},
  branches=<|1-><|"Regular"->value|>|>;
  ToExpression[diagnosticResidual["NormalizationSource"],InputForm];
  branches[1]["Regular"]];
diagnosticHatResiduals=Lookup[diagnosticResidual["Rows"],"Residual"];
diagnosticContractionResiduals=Map[Factor,LinearSolve[projectorWeights,diagnosticHatResiduals]];
gate["exact inverse scalar projections",Map[Factor,projectorWeights.diagnosticContractionResiduals-
  diagnosticHatResiduals]===ConstantArray[0,Length[diagnosticHatResiduals]]];
diagnosticPhysicalCT=diagnosticNormalize[({metricWeights,incomingWeights}.
  subtraction["Counterterms"]["Regular"][[All,diagnosticU,diagnosticU]])/.t->omega-s];
diagnosticCDRCT=Table[diagnosticNormalize[bounded[epsSeries[subtraction["PhaseCT"]
  (subtraction["ReferenceConvolutions"][mode]/.D->dimension)],{"CDR counterterm",mode}]/.t->omega-s],
  {mode,{"g","pp"}}];
diagnosticCTDifference=Map[Factor[Coefficient[Expand[#,eps],eps,0]]&,
  diagnosticPhysicalCT-diagnosticCDRCT];
diagnosticPPRemaining=Factor[diagnosticContractionResiduals[[2]]-diagnosticCTDifference[[2]]];
Print["DIMENSIONAL_PP_COUNTERTERM_EXPLAINS_RESIDUAL ",diagnosticPPRemaining===0];
Print["DIMENSIONAL_PP_REMAINING ",InputForm[diagnosticPPRemaining]];
diagnosticSector=First[Values[spinReal["Sectors"]]];
gate["no external dimensional gluon state",diagnosticSector["IncomingSpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]&&
  diagnosticSector["OutgoingSpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]];
diagnosticSpinSource=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s05_real_spin_response.wls"}],"Text"];
diagnosticVariableRows=StringCases[diagnosticSpinSource,
  RegularExpression["(?m)^  (inVariables|outVariables) = [^;]+;"]];
gate["two inherited spin-variable definitions",Length[diagnosticVariableRows]===2];
diagnosticSpinVariables=Block[{incomingQuark=True,outgoingQuark=True,inVariables,outVariables},
  ToExpression[StringRiffle[diagnosticVariableRows,"\n"],InputForm];Join[Rest[inVariables],Rest[outVariables]]];
gate["physical spin-variable inventory",Length[diagnosticSpinVariables]===
  Total[Length[#]-1&/@{diagnosticSector["IncomingSpinLabels"],diagnosticSector["OutgoingSpinLabels"]}]&&
  DuplicateFreeQ[diagnosticSpinVariables]];
diagnosticMetricRows=Select[real["Components"],#["Kind"]==="PhotonMetricD"&];
gate["one accepted dimensional metric",Length[diagnosticMetricRows]===1&&TrueQ[First[diagnosticMetricRows]["Accepted"]]];
diagnosticMetricReal=First[diagnosticMetricRows]["Branches"][1]["Regular"]/.
  Thread[diagnosticSpinVariables->0];
Print["DIMENSIONAL_METRIC_PHASE_BEGIN bytes ",ByteCount[diagnosticMetricReal]];
diagnosticMetricTimed=AbsoluteTiming[phaseProduct[strongFactor diagnosticMetricReal,phase,0,"dimensional metric"]];

diagnosticResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-dimensional-contraction-diagnostic-v1","Channel"->channel,

  "ResidualInspectionHash"->FileHash[diagnosticResidualPath,"SHA256"],
  "ReferenceContractionResiduals"->diagnosticContractionResiduals,"CountertermDifferences"->diagnosticCTDifference,
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-463", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6395, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_check_phase_series.wls", "sha256": "cb02337e0b7b4e6734a6d34fe452f90af7fbf29c40a0b6f38e076fad778176ce"} -->
```wolfram
(* Check the reference Laurent product on actual integrated spin components. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
phaseProofRoot=Directory[];
phaseProofSource=FileNameJoin[{phaseProofRoot,"common","s14_check_phase_series.wls"}];
phaseBaseline=FileNameJoin[{phaseProofRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
phaseLaurentSource=FileNameJoin[{phaseProofRoot,"common","s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[phaseBaseline,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "9f511361187996d8fef88f8897ba2b40018032d9d4e789ec2cd17d445939a94a"||
  IntegerString[FileHash[phaseLaurentSource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243",Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
phaseBaselineText=Import[phaseBaseline,"Text"];
If[StringCount[phaseBaselineText,"\nindices=Tuples"]=!=1||!SyntaxQ[Import[phaseProofSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
phasePrefix=First[StringSplit[phaseBaselineText,"\nindices=Tuples"]];
If[StringCount[phasePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
phasePrefix=StringReplace[phasePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[phasePrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[phasePrefix,InputForm];
gate["phase comparison channel",channel==="Hqqprime"];
phaseLaurentText=Import[phaseLaurentSource,"Text"];
phaseLaurentStart=First[First[StringPosition[phaseLaurentText,"laurentProduct[laurent_"]]];
phaseLaurentEnd=First[First[StringPosition[phaseLaurentText,"\n\nsoftPieces["]]];
phaseLaurentBlock=StringTake[phaseLaurentText,{phaseLaurentStart,phaseLaurentEnd-1}];
gate["reference Laurent product syntax",SyntaxQ[phaseLaurentBlock]];
ToExpression[phaseLaurentBlock,InputForm];
phaseProduct[coefficient_,kernel_,order_,label_] := Module[
  {polynomial,first,last,rows,reconstruction,answer},
  polynomial=bounded[Expand[coefficient,eps],{label,"Laurent collection"}];
  If[polynomial===0,Return[0]];
  first=Exponent[polynomial,eps,Min];last=Exponent[polynomial,eps];
  gate["integer finite Laurent support",IntegerQ[first]&&IntegerQ[last]&&first<=last];
  gate["complete Laurent polynomial",PolynomialQ[Expand[eps^(-first)polynomial,eps],eps]];
  rows=Table[Coefficient[polynomial,eps,n],{n,first,last}];
  gate["regulator-independent Laurent coefficients",FreeQ[rows,eps]];
  reconstruction=Total[MapThread[Times,{rows,eps^Range[first,last]}]];
  gate["exact Laurent polynomial reconstruction",
    bounded[Expand[polynomial-reconstruction],{label,"Laurent reconstruction"}]===0];
  gate["phase kernel has no truncated input series",FreeQ[kernel,_SeriesData|_Series]];
  answer=bounded[laurentProduct[polynomial,kernel,order],{label,"reference Laurent product"}];
  gate["reference phase product evaluated",FreeQ[answer,
    _SeriesData|_Series|_Integrate|_Limit|_Missing|_Real|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity|$Failed|$Aborted]];
  answer];

phaseControlLabels={{{1,1,1},1,"Regular"},{{1,4,4},-1,"Regular"},{{3,4,4},-1,"Regular"}};
phaseControlRows=Table[
  phaseControlPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
  gate["own accepted assembly checkpoint exists",FileExistsQ[phaseControlPath]];
  saved=Get[phaseControlPath];
  gate["own accepted assembly checkpoint identity",TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["InputHash"]===inputHash&&saved["Label"]===label];
  index=label[[1]];sign=label[[2]];distribution=label[[3]];
  assumptions=(physical/.t->sign omega-s)&&omega>0&&flavorDomain;
  phaseTimed=AbsoluteTiming[phaseProduct[strongFactor realBranch[index,sign,distribution],phase,0,label]];
  phaseCombined=Expand[phaseTimed[[2]]+(subtractionValue[index,distribution]/.t->sign omega-s),eps];
  gate["own accepted finite coefficient equality "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
    bounded[zero[Coefficient[phaseCombined,eps,0]-saved["Finite"],assumptions],{label,"accepted finite equality"}]];
  phaseMinimum=Min[Append[Cases[phaseCombined,Power[eps,n_Integer]/;n<0:>n,Infinity],0]];
  Do[gate["own accepted pole equality "<>ToString[{label,n},InputForm],
    bounded[zero[Coefficient[phaseCombined,eps,n]-Lookup[saved["PoleResiduals"],n,0],assumptions],
      {label,"accepted pole equality",n}]],{n,phaseMinimum,-1}];
  Print["PHASE_CONTROL_ACCEPTED ",label," seconds ",phaseTimed[[1]]];
  <|"Label"->label,"Checkpoint"->StringDrop[phaseControlPath,StringLength[root]+1],
    "SHA256"->FileHash[phaseControlPath,"SHA256"],"Seconds"->phaseTimed[[1]]|>,{label,phaseControlLabels}];

phaseActualLabel={{4,1,1},1,"Regular"};
phaseActualCoefficient=strongFactor realBranch[phaseActualLabel[[1]],phaseActualLabel[[2]],phaseActualLabel[[3]]];
Print["ACTUAL_PHASE=",InputForm[phase]];
Print["ACTUAL_PHASE_COEFFICIENT_BYTES=",ByteCount[phaseActualCoefficient]];
phaseActualTimed=AbsoluteTiming[phaseProduct[phaseActualCoefficient,phase,0,phaseActualLabel]];
Print["ACTUAL_PHASE_PRODUCT_SECONDS=",phaseActualTimed[[1]]];
phaseProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-phase-series-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[phaseProofSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "LaurentSourceHash"->FileHash[phaseLaurentSource,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Definitions"->DownValues[phaseProduct],
  "LaurentDefinitions"->DownValues[laurentProduct],"Controls"->phaseControlRows,
  "ActualLabel"->phaseActualLabel,"ActualSeconds"->phaseActualTimed[[1]],
  "ActualValue"->phaseActualTimed[[2]],"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
phaseProofDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_phase_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[phaseProofDir],CreateDirectory[phaseProofDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
phaseProofOutput=FileNameJoin[{phaseProofDir,"s14_result.wl"}];
phaseSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[phaseProof],"phase proof compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["phase proof file bound",StringLength[phaseSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[phaseProofOutput<>".tmp",phaseSerialized,"Text"];
gate["phase proof exact native reload",Get[phaseProofOutput<>".tmp"]===phaseProof];
RenameFile[phaseProofOutput<>".tmp",phaseProofOutput,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{phaseProofDir,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,
  "control_count"->Length[phaseControlRows],"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_check_phase_series"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s14_check_pole_factorization.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-464", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9743, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_check_pole_factorization.wls", "sha256": "adfb5f8c877b57b191a08514488580907bc221008dab61e24ebee6d196cee14f"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse the accepted residual refinement on the actual failed assembly pole. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
poleRoot=Directory[];
poleSource=FileNameJoin[{poleRoot,"common","s14_check_pole_factorization.wls"}];
poleConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{poleRoot,"common","s14_pole_factorization_inputs.json"}];
poleSettings=Import[poleConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
poleBaseline=FileNameJoin[{poleRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[poleBaseline,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=poleSettings["baseline_sha256"],Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
poleText=Import[poleBaseline,"Text"];
If[StringCount[poleText,"\nindices=Tuples"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
polePrefix=First[StringSplit[poleText,"\nindices=Tuples"]];
If[StringCount[polePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
polePrefix=StringReplace[polePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[polePrefix]||!SyntaxQ[Import[poleSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[polePrefix,InputForm];
gate["own pole comparison channel",channel===poleSettings["channel"]&&!core];
KeyValueMap[gate["bound pole comparison input "<>#1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,poleSettings["files"]];
poleFailedPath=FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["failed_checkpoint"]}];
poleControlPath=FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["control_checkpoint"]}];
poleFailed=Get[poleFailedPath];poleControl=Get[poleControlPath];
gate["failed checkpoint retains exact assembly inputs",poleFailed["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
  !TrueQ[poleFailed["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[poleFailed,"InputParts"]&&
  Length[poleFailed["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
gate["own accepted control identity",poleControl["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
  TrueQ[poleControl["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[poleControl,"Finite"]&&
  Length[poleControl["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
poleReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["failed_receipt"]}],"RawJSON"];
gate["failed execution binds the unchanged assembly",poleReceipt["job_id"]===poleSettings["failed_job_id"]&&
  !TrueQ[poleReceipt["passed"]]&&poleReceipt["exit_code"]===1&&
  poleReceipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"]===poleSettings["baseline_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[gate["failed execution input unchanged "<>#1,
  poleReceipt["reviewed_sha256"][#1]===IntegerString[#2,16,64]]&,inputHashes];
poleUV=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_result.wl"}]];
poleUVReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted existing residual routine",TrueQ[poleUVReceipt["passed"]]&&TrueQ[poleUV["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[poleUV["Checks"]]&&poleUV["RefinedOriginalResidual"]===0&&poleUV["RefinedSumResidual"]===0&&
  poleUV["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s13_check_uv_branches.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  poleUV["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
DownValues[refineUVResidual]=poleUV["Definitions"];
gate["exact existing residual routine installed",DownValues[refineUVResidual]===poleUV["Definitions"]];
poleFactorCertificates=<||>;
refineAssemblyPole[value_,conditions_] := Module[{factored,factors,candidates,index,refined,key,variables,counterDomain,domainStatement,domainDecision},
  key=Hash[{value,conditions},"SHA256"];
  factored=Factor[Together[value]];
  gate["exact pole factorization "<>ToString[key],Together[value-factored]===0];
  If[factored===0,AssociateTo[poleFactorCertificates,key-><|"Method"->"ExactTogether",
    "OriginalHash"->Hash[value,"SHA256"],"Conditions"->conditions,"Result"->0|>];Return[0]];
  factors=If[Head[factored]===Times,List@@factored,{factored}];
  gate["complete factor product "<>ToString[key],Times@@factors===factored];
  candidates=Select[Range[Length[factors]],!FreeQ[factors[[#]],Power[_,_Rational]]&];
  Do[
    refined=If[TrueQ[zero[factors[[index]],conditions]],0,
      Block[{physical=conditions},refineUVResidual[factors[[index]]]]];
    variables={};counterDomain=Missing["NotRequired"];
    If[refined=!=0,
      variables=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[{factors[[index]],conditions},
        symbol_Symbol/;MemberQ[{"Global`","FeynCalc`"},Context[symbol]],Infinity]];
      gate["factor variables real on original domain "<>ToString[key],
        Refine[Element[variables,Reals],conditions]===True];
      domainStatement=With[{boundVariables=variables,boundConditions=conditions},
        Exists[boundVariables,boundConditions]];
      domainDecision=Resolve[domainStatement,Reals];
      Print["EXACT_FACTOR_DOMAIN ",InputForm[variables]," ",InputForm[conditions],
        " EXISTS ",InputForm[domainStatement]," RESULT ",InputForm[domainDecision]];
      gate["original factor domain nonempty "<>ToString[key],domainDecision===True];
      counterDomain=Reduce[conditions&&factors[[index]]!=0,variables,Reals];
      Print["EXACT_FACTOR_COUNTERDOMAIN ",InputForm[factors[[index]]]," ",InputForm[counterDomain]];
      If[counterDomain===False,refined=0]];
    If[refined===0,
      gate["certified zero factor "<>ToString[key],
        (Times@@ReplacePart[factors,index->refined])===0];
      AssociateTo[poleFactorCertificates,key-><|"Method"->"ExactZeroFactor",
        "OriginalHash"->Hash[value,"SHA256"],"Conditions"->conditions,"Factored"->factored,
        "FactorIndex"->index,"OriginalFactor"->factors[[index]],"RefinedFactor"->refined,
        "RealVariables"->variables,"NonzeroDomain"->counterDomain,"Result"->0|>];
      Print["CERTIFIED_POLE_FACTOR ",InputForm[factors[[index]]]," -> ",refined];Break[]],
    {index,candidates}];
  If[refined===0,0,Block[{physical=conditions},refineUVResidual[value]]]];
poleConditions[label_] := (If[Last[label]==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->label[[2]]omega-s)&&
  If[label[[2]]===0,True,omega>0]&&flavorDomain;
SetAttributes[poleBounded,HoldFirst];
poleBounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,300,
  gate["pole comparison time bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],2*1024^3,
  gate["pole comparison memory bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
poleControlConditions=poleConditions[poleControl["Label"]];
poleControlRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},
  gate["own original pole predicate "<>ToString[power],poleBounded[zero[value,poleControlConditions],"original control"]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[value,poleControlConditions],"refined control"]];
  gate["own accepted pole unchanged "<>ToString[power],Last[timed]===0];
  <|"Power"->power,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Refined"->Last[timed]|>],poleControl["PoleResiduals"]];
poleActualConditions=poleConditions[poleFailed["Label"]];
poleCombined=Expand[Total[poleFailed["InputParts"]],eps];
poleRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},
  factored=poleBounded[Factor[Together[value]],"actual saved residue factorization"];
  Print["ACTUAL_FACTORED_POLE ",power," ",InputForm[factored]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[value,poleActualConditions],"actual saved residue refinement"]];
  actual=Coefficient[poleCombined,eps,power];
  sumTimed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[actual,poleActualConditions],"complete original input pole"]];
  Print["ACTUAL_REFINED_POLE ",power," ",InputForm[Last[timed]]," INPUT_SUM ",InputForm[Last[sumTimed]]];
  <|"Power"->power,"Original"->value,"Factored"->factored,"Refined"->Last[timed],
    "InputSumRefined"->Last[sumTimed],"Seconds"->First[timed],"InputSumSeconds"->First[sumTimed]|>],poleFailed["PoleResiduals"]];
poleResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-assembly-pole-refinement-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[poleSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "ConfigHash"->FileHash[poleConfigPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"OriginalZeroDefinitions"->DownValues[zero],
  "OriginalFinitePartDefinitions"->DownValues[finitePart],"Definitions"->DownValues[refineAssemblyPole],
  "RefinementDefinitions"->DownValues[refineUVResidual],"ExistingProofHash"->
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],
  "FailedCheckpoint"->poleFailed,"FailedCheckpointHash"->FileHash[poleFailedPath,"SHA256"],
  "PhysicalConditions"->poleActualConditions,"ControlLabel"->poleControl["Label"],
  "ControlHash"->FileHash[poleControlPath,"SHA256"],"ControlFiniteHash"->Hash[poleControl["Finite"],"SHA256"],
  "ControlRows"->poleControlRows,"Rows"->poleRows,"FactorCertificates"->poleFactorCertificates,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
poleDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_pole_factorization_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[poleDirectory],CreateDirectory[poleDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
put[poleResult,FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_unaccepted.wl"}]];
gate["every actual saved residue vanishes",And@@(#["Refined"]===0&/@poleRows)];
gate["every original input-sum pole vanishes",And@@(#["InputSumRefined"]===0&/@poleRows)];
AssociateTo[poleResult,{"Accepted"->True,"Checks"->checks}];
polePath=FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_result.wl"}];
poleSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[poleBounded[Compress[poleResult],"proof compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["pole proof file bound",StringLength[poleSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[polePath<>".tmp",poleSerialized,"Text"];
gate["pole proof exact native reload",Get[polePath<>".tmp"]===poleResult];
RenameFile[polePath<>".tmp",polePath,OverwriteTarget->True];
DeleteFile[FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_unaccepted.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "accepted"->True,"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_check_pole_factorization"];Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
(* Compare regulator-only expansion with the complete own original phase input. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
regulatorPhaseSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_check_regulator_phase.wls"}];
regulatorPhaseParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_cached_parts.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[regulatorPhaseParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0ffae5e7a1a813a5f3537d3159784d2bde2490d5c8937888a6b35c16575bd39b"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[regulatorPhaseSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
regulatorPhaseText=StringTrim[Import[regulatorPhaseParent,"Text"]];
regulatorPhaseTerminal="ToExpression[cachedPartsRun,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[regulatorPhaseText,regulatorPhaseTerminal],Quit[1]];
regulatorPhasePrefix=StringDrop[regulatorPhaseText,-StringLength[regulatorPhaseTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[regulatorPhasePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[regulatorPhasePrefix,InputForm];
regulatorPhaseCompare[] := Module[{text,start,end,definition,candidateDefinition,records,control=None,
 label,index,sign,distribution,coefficient,original,candidate,originalSeconds,candidateSeconds,comparisonSeconds,
 first,last,powers,residuals,result,directory,path,serialized},
 gate["own phase comparison channel",channel==="Hqq"];
 text=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}],"Text"];
 start=First[First[StringPosition[text,"laurentProduct[laurent_"]]];
 end=First[First[StringPosition[text,"\n\nsoftPieces["]]];
 definition=StringTake[text,{start,end-1}];
 gate["one native Laurent expansion",StringCount[definition,"polynomial=Expand[laurent]"]===1];
 candidateDefinition=StringReplace[definition,{"laurentProduct[laurent_"->"regulatorLaurentProduct[laurent_",
   "polynomial=Expand[laurent]"->"polynomial=Expand[laurent,eps]"}];
 gate["unchanged Laurent powers and kernel product",SyntaxQ[candidateDefinition]&&
  StringReplace[candidateDefinition,{"regulatorLaurentProduct[laurent_"->"laurentProduct[laurent_",
    "polynomial=Expand[laurent,eps]"->"polynomial=Expand[laurent]"}]===definition];
 ToExpression[candidateDefinition,InputForm];
 Do[records=Get[file];
   If[Lookup[records,"InputHash",None]===inputHash&&TrueQ[Lookup[records,"Accepted",False]]&&
     Lookup[records,"Finite",0]=!=0&&MemberQ[{"Delta","L0"},Last[records["Label"]]]&&MemberQ[{1,-1},records["Label"][[2]]],
     control=Join[records,<|"File"->file,"FileHash"->FileHash[file,"SHA256"]|>];Break[]],
   {file,FileNames["finite_*.wl",cache]}];
 gate["own accepted nonzero endpoint phase control",AssociationQ[control]];
 label=control["Label"];{index,sign,distribution}=label;
 coefficient=strongFactor realBranch[index,sign,distribution];
 Print["REGULATOR_PHASE_CONTROL ",InputForm[<|"Label"->label,"CoefficientBytes"->ByteCount[coefficient],"Kernel"->phase,"Coefficient"->coefficient|>]];
 {originalSeconds,original}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[phaseProduct[coefficient,phase,0,label],"own original phase product"]];
 {candidateSeconds,candidate}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[Block[{laurentProduct},
   DownValues[laurentProduct]=DownValues[regulatorLaurentProduct]/.regulatorLaurentProduct->laurentProduct;
   phaseProduct[coefficient,phase,0,label]],"own regulator phase product"]];
 first=Min[Exponent[Expand[original,eps],eps,Min],Exponent[Expand[candidate,eps],eps,Min]];
 last=Max[Exponent[Expand[original,eps],eps],Exponent[Expand[candidate,eps],eps]];
 gate["same finite integer phase support",IntegerQ[first]&&IntegerQ[last]&&first<=last];powers=Range[first,last];
 {comparisonSeconds,residuals}=AbsoluteTiming[Association@Table[n->bounded[
   Factor[Together[Coefficient[Expand[candidate-original,eps],eps,n]]],{"own full phase coefficient",n}],{n,powers}]];
 gate["complete own original phase product reproduced",And@@(#===0&/@Values[residuals])];
 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-regulator-phase-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,"Accepted"->True,
   "SourceHash"->FileHash[regulatorPhaseSource,"SHA256"],"ParentHash"->FileHash[regulatorPhaseParent,"SHA256"],
   "InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},
   "Control"->KeyTake[control,{"Label","File","FileHash"}],"Coefficient"->coefficient,"Kernel"->phase,
   "OriginalValue"->original,"CandidateValue"->candidate,"Residuals"->residuals,
   "OriginalDefinitions"->DownValues[laurentProduct],"CandidateDefinitions"->DownValues[regulatorLaurentProduct],
   "OriginalSeconds"->originalSeconds,"CandidateSeconds"->candidateSeconds,"ComparisonSeconds"->comparisonSeconds,
   "Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
 directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_regulator_phase_result"}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 path=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_result.wl"}];serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n";
 gate["bounded phase comparison file",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[path<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
 gate["exact phase comparison native reload",Get[path<>".tmp"]===result];RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True];
 Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,"label"->label,
   "original_seconds"->originalSeconds,"candidate_seconds"->candidateSeconds,"comparison_seconds"->comparisonSeconds,
   "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];Print["PASS: s14_check_regulator_phase"];Quit[0]];
regulatorPhaseAnchor="cachedPartsRecord[];ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
regulatorPhaseReplacement="cachedPartsRecord[];regulatorPhaseCompare[];";
If[StringCount[cachedPartsRun,regulatorPhaseAnchor]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique phase comparison boundary"];Quit[1]];
regulatorPhaseRun=StringReplace[cachedPartsRun,regulatorPhaseAnchor->regulatorPhaseReplacement];
If[!SyntaxQ[regulatorPhaseRun]||StringReplace[regulatorPhaseRun,regulatorPhaseReplacement->regulatorPhaseAnchor]=!=cachedPartsRun,Quit[1]];
ToExpression[regulatorPhaseRun,InputForm];
```

## common/s14_check_structural_phase.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-466", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7480, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_check_structural_phase.wls", "sha256": "1ababffa4cca48ed12f2cb3fef25ad619b84385597d683f11dafbcaa25f2f277"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve exact regulator-independent coefficients through the original phase product. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
structuralPhaseSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_check_structural_phase.wls"}];
structuralPhaseParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_cached_parts.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[structuralPhaseParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0ffae5e7a1a813a5f3537d3159784d2bde2490d5c8937888a6b35c16575bd39b"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[structuralPhaseSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
structuralPhaseText=StringTrim[Import[structuralPhaseParent,"Text"]];
structuralPhaseTerminal="ToExpression[cachedPartsRun,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[structuralPhaseText,structuralPhaseTerminal],Quit[1]];
structuralPhasePrefix=StringDrop[structuralPhaseText,-StringLength[structuralPhaseTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[structuralPhasePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[structuralPhasePrefix,InputForm];

  "OwnSeconds"->ownSeconds,"ActualLabel"->actualLabel,"ActualCoefficient"->actualCoefficient,
```
