```wolfram
(* Derive charge coefficients without expanding their independent kinematics. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
structuralWeightSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_check_structural_weight.wls"}];
structuralWeightParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_check_structural_phase.wls"}];
structuralWeightText=StringTrim[Import[structuralWeightParent,"Text"]];
structuralWeightTerminal="ToExpression[structuralPhaseRun,InputForm];";
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[structuralWeightSource,"Text"]]||!StringEndsQ[structuralWeightText,structuralWeightTerminal],Quit[1]];
structuralWeightPrefix=StringDrop[structuralWeightText,-StringLength[structuralWeightTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[structuralWeightPrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[structuralWeightPrefix,InputForm];

structuralChargeRows[expression_] := Module[{pattern=chargeRatio,replacements={},atom,shrink,opaque,rows,monomials},
 atom[value_] := atom[value] = Module[{symbol=Unique["sidisChargeCoefficient"]},AppendTo[replacements,symbol->value];symbol];
 shrink[value_] := If[FreeQ[value,pattern],If[AtomQ[value],value,atom[value]],Map[shrink,value]];
 opaque=shrink[expression];
 gate["exact charge-independent coefficient restoration",FreeQ[Last/@replacements,chargeRatio]&&(opaque/.replacements)===expression];
 gate["native structural charge polynomial",PolynomialQ[opaque,chargeRatio]];
 rows=CoefficientRules[opaque,{chargeRatio}];monomials=chargeRatio^First[First[#]]&/@rows;
 gate["exact abstract charge decomposition",Expand[opaque-Total[MapThread[Times,{Last/@rows,monomials}]]]===0];
 <|"Rules"->(rows/.replacements),"Accepted"->True,"InputBytes"->ByteCount[expression],
   "AbstractBytes"->ByteCount[opaque],"CoefficientCount"->Length[replacements]|>];

structuralWeightInstall[] := Module[{path,receiptPath,receipt,proof,ownRows,packet,seconds,equalitySeconds,
 residuals,evidence={},start,end,definition,edits,candidate,originalDefinitions,result,directory,out,serialized},
 path=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_charge_result","s14_result.wl"}];
 receiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s14_execution.json"}];receipt=Import[receiptPath,"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted own charge-rule receipt",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s14_charge_result/s14_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 proof=Get[path];
 gate["same complete own accepted charge inputs",proof["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[proof["Accepted"]]&&
  proof["RealHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_result","s12_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]&&
  proof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&And@@Values[proof["Checks"]]&&
  And@@Lookup[proof["Comparisons"],"Accepted"]];
 Do[
  {seconds,packet}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[structuralChargeRows[row["Expression"]],"own structural charge coefficients"]];
  ownRows=packet["Rules"];
  gate["same complete own charge powers",First/@ownRows===First/@row["CoefficientRules"]];
  {equalitySeconds,residuals}=AbsoluteTiming[MapThread[If[#1===#2,0,bounded[Factor[Together[#1-#2]],"own charge coefficient equality"]]&,
    {Last/@ownRows,Last/@row["CoefficientRules"]}]];
  gate["entire own accepted charge coefficients reproduced",And@@(#===0&/@residuals)];
  AppendTo[evidence,Join[KeyTake[row,{"Sector","Index","Branch","Distribution","InputHash"}],KeyDrop[packet,"Rules"],
    <|"Seconds"->seconds,"EqualitySeconds"->equalitySeconds,"ExactResiduals"->residuals|>]];
  Print["STRUCTURAL_CHARGE_COMPARISON ",InputForm[Last[evidence]]],{row,proof["Comparisons"]}];
 originalDefinitions=DownValues[weighted];
 start=First[First[StringPosition[phaseRunPrefix,"weighted[expression_,sector_]"]]];
 end=First[First[StringPosition[phaseRunPrefix,"\nphysicalComponents="]]];
 definition=StringTake[phaseRunPrefix,{start,end-1}];
 edits={"{rows,monomials,names}"->"{rows,monomials,names,packet}",
  "  gate[\"polynomial distinct-flavor charge dependence\",PolynomialQ[expression,chargeRatio]];"->
   "  packet=structuralChargeRows[expression];gate[\"polynomial distinct-flavor charge dependence\",TrueQ[packet[\"Accepted\"]]];",
  "rows=CoefficientRules[expression,{chargeRatio}];"->"rows=packet[\"Rules\"];",
  "exactChargeZero[expression-Total[MapThread[Times,{Last/@rows,monomials}]]]"->"TrueQ[packet[\"Accepted\"]]"};
 gate["unique charge weighting implementation edits",And@@(StringCount[definition,First[#]]===1&/@edits)];
 candidate=StringReplace[definition,edits];
 gate["all charge names and inherited weighting equations retained",SyntaxQ[candidate]&&StringReplace[candidate,Reverse/@edits]===definition];
 ToExpression[candidate,InputForm];
 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-structural-charge-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,"Accepted"->True,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[structuralWeightSource,"SHA256"],"OriginalProofHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],
  "InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},
  "OriginalDefinitions"->originalDefinitions,"CandidateDefinitions"->DownValues[weighted],
  "CoefficientDefinitions"->DownValues[structuralChargeRows],"Weights"->weights,"Evidence"->evidence,"Checks"->checks|>;
 directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_structural_weight_result"}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 out=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_charge_comparison.wl"}];serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n";
 gate["bounded structural charge proof",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[out<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
 gate["exact structural charge proof reload",Get[out<>".tmp"]===result];RenameFile[out<>".tmp",out,OverwriteTarget->True];
 structuralWeightProofHash=FileHash[out,"SHA256"];
 Print["PASS: complete own structural charge comparison"]];

structuralWeightAnchor="cachedPartsRecord[];structuralPhaseCompare[];";
structuralWeightReplacement="cachedPartsRecord[];structuralWeightInstall[];structuralPhaseCompare[];";
```

## common/s14_complete_saved_finite_export.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-468", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10535, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_complete_saved_finite_export.wls", "sha256": "69705aae403f337f39b2aaf6845895543dc62e5f1eaad6f72dd9aea4124bba5d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Validate the completed native export in a clean allocation without repeating its algebra. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];checks=<||>;
recoverySource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_complete_saved_finite_export.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,name],Print["PASS: ",name]];AssociateTo[checks,name->True],
  Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete recovery syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[recoverySource,"Text"]]];
recovery=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_export_recovery_inputs.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["bound own export recovery",recovery["schema"]==="polarized-sidis-saved-finite-export-recovery-v1"&&
  recovery["channel"]===channel&&channel==="Hqqbar"];
path[relative_] := FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
hexHash[relative_] := IntegerString[FileHash[path[relative],"SHA256"],16,64];
parent=Import[path[recovery["parent_receipt"]],"RawJSON"];
gate["recorded completed-algebra export failure",parent["job_id"]===recovery["parent_job_id"]&&
  parent["passed"]===False&&parent["reason"]==="normal_exit"&&
  hexHash[recovery["parent_receipt"]]===recovery["files"][recovery["parent_receipt"]]];
KeyValueMap[gate["unchanged producer input "<>#1,hexHash[#1]===#2]&,parent["reviewed_sha256"]];
gate["bound complete native export",hexHash[recovery["pending_result"]]===recovery["files"][recovery["pending_result"]]&&
  FileByteCount[path[recovery["pending_result"]]]<128*1024^2];
gate["bound producer log",hexHash[recovery["parent_log"]]===recovery["files"][recovery["parent_log"]]];
parentLog=Import[path[recovery["parent_log"]],"Text"];
gate["producer reached its bounded complete export",StringContainsQ[parentLog,"bounded complete finite result file"]&&
  StringContainsQ[parentLog,"No more memory available."]&&!StringContainsQ[parentLog,"FAIL:"]];
Clear[parentLog];
Print["RECOVERY_LOAD_BEGIN memory ",MemoryInUse[]];
raw=Get[path[recovery["pending_result"]]];
Print["RECOVERY_LOAD_COMPLETE memory ",MemoryInUse[]];
Share[];ClearSystemCache[];
gate["accepted complete saved BMHV schema",AssociationQ[raw]&&
  raw["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-finite-bmhv-response-v1"&&raw["Channel"]===channel&&
  And@@Values[raw["Checks"]]&&TrueQ[raw["CompletePoleCancellationChecked"]]&&
  TrueQ[raw["UnpolarizedFinalReferenceComparisonPassed"]]&&
  TrueQ[raw["FiniteMinimalSubtractionCoefficientsComputed"]]&&
  raw["FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied"]===False&&raw["FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"]===False];
producerPath=path["common/s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"];
gate["unchanged mathematical and dispatch sources",raw["SourceHash"]===FileHash[producerPath,"SHA256"]&&
  raw["DispatchSourceHash"]===FileHash[path["common/s14_assemble_finite_refined.wls"],"SHA256"]];
KeyValueMap[gate["unchanged saved physical input "<>#1,FileHash[path[#1],"SHA256"]===#2]&,raw["InputHashes"]];
gate["same native input identity",raw["InputHash"]===Hash[
  {raw["SourceHash"],raw["InputHashes"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]];
basis=Get[path["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"]];
base=Import[path["common/s01_inputs.json"],"RawJSON"];
gate["same accepted physical basis",And@@Values[basis["Checks"]]&&
  raw["PhotonLabels"]===basis["PhotonLabels"]&&raw["SpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]];
core=base["channel_contracts"][channel]["amplitude_schema"]==="core";
gate["own real-only normalization contract",!core];
producerText=Import[producerPath,"Text"];
section[start_,finish_] := Module[{begin,end},
  gate["unique producer section "<>start,StringCount[producerText,start]===1];
  begin=First[First[StringPosition[producerText,start]]];
  end=Select[StringPosition[producerText,finish],First[#]>begin&];
  gate["producer section endpoint "<>start,Length[end]>0];
  StringTake[producerText,{begin,First[First[end]]-1}]];
couplingCode=section["couplingSquare=Factor[","\nphaseInput="];
distributionCode=section["distributions={","\nassemble["];
normalizationCode=section["  normalization=If[core,","\n  gate[\"finite physical component\""];
leadingCode=section["leadingResponse=If[core,","\nfiniteResponse="];
gate["unchanged saved-normalization syntax",And@@(SyntaxQ/@
  {couplingCode,distributionCode,normalizationCode,leadingCode})];
ToExpression[couplingCode,InputForm];ToExpression[distributionCode,InputForm];
normalizeSaved[value_] := Block[{branches=value,normalization},ToExpression[normalizationCode,InputForm];branches];
comparisonEvidence={};
sameSaved[left_,right_,label_] := Module[{difference,seconds,diagnostic,diagnosticPath},
  If[left===right,Return[True]];
  If[AssociationQ[left]||AssociationQ[right],
    If[!(AssociationQ[left]&&AssociationQ[right]),
      Print["SAVED_ASSOCIATION_HEADS ",InputForm[{label,Head[left],Head[right]}]];Return[False]];
    If[Keys[left]=!=Keys[right],
      Print["SAVED_ASSOCIATION_KEYS ",InputForm[{label,Keys[left],Keys[right]}]];Return[False]];
    Return[And@@Table[sameSaved[left[key],right[key],Append[label,key]],{key,Keys[left]}]]];
  If[ListQ[left]||ListQ[right],Return[ListQ[left]&&ListQ[right]&&Length[left]===Length[right]&&
    And@@Table[sameSaved[left[[entry]],right[[entry]],Append[label,entry]],{entry,Length[left]}]]];
  Print["SAVED_SCALAR_COMPARISON ",InputForm[label]," bytes ",ByteCount[{left,right}]];
  {seconds,difference}=AbsoluteTiming[TimeConstrained[
    MemoryConstrained[Together[left-right],2*1024^3,$Failed],600,$Aborted]];
  AppendTo[comparisonEvidence,<|"Label"->label,"Seconds"->seconds,"ExactZero"->(difference===0)|>];
  If[difference=!=0,
    diagnostic=<|"Label"->label,"CheckpointExpression"->left,"SavedExpression"->right,
      "Difference"->difference,"NormalizationCode"->normalizationCode,
      "CouplingSquare"->couplingSquare,"InputHash"->raw["InputHash"],
      "SourceHash"->FileHash[recoverySource,"SHA256"]|>;
    diagnosticPath=path[channel<>"/s14_result/s14_export_comparison.wl"];
    diagnostic="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[diagnostic],InputForm]<>"]\n";
    gate["bounded export-comparison equations",StringLength[diagnostic]<128*1024^2];
    Export[diagnosticPath,diagnostic,"Text"];
    If[ByteCount[difference]<16384,Print["SAVED_SCALAR_DIFFERENCE ",InputForm[difference]]]];
  difference===0];
dimensions={Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]],Length[basis["SpinLabels"]],Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]};
indices=Tuples[Range/@dimensions];signs={1,-1,0};
gate["complete physical component inventory",Lookup[raw["Components"],"Index"]===indices&&
  AllTrue[raw["Components"],TrueQ[#["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[#["Checks"]]&]&&
  Keys[raw["NLOResponse"]]===signs&&AllTrue[Values[raw["NLOResponse"]],Keys[#]===distributions&]];
cache=path["cache/s14/"<>channel<>"/"<>IntegerString[raw["InputHash"],16]];
Do[component=raw["Components"][[position]];index=component["Index"];
  candidate=Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[
    label={index,sign,distribution};
    checkpointPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
    relative=StringDrop[checkpointPath,StringLength[root]+1];
    gate["every own finite checkpoint is bound",KeyExistsQ[recovery["files"],relative]];
    saved=Get[checkpointPath];
    gate["accepted own finite checkpoint schema",saved["InputHash"]===raw["InputHash"]&&
      TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["Label"]===label];
    distribution->saved["Finite"],{distribution,distributions}],{sign,signs}];
  candidate=normalizeSaved[candidate];
  gate["entire saved finite component "<>ToString[index,InputForm],sameSaved[candidate,component["Branches"],{index}]];
  Do[gate["complete tensor embedding "<>ToString[index,InputForm],
    Extract[raw["NLOResponse"][sign][distribution],index]===component["Branches"][sign][distribution]],
    {sign,signs},{distribution,distributions}];
  Clear[candidate,saved,component];ClearSystemCache[],{position,Length[indices]}];
ToExpression[leadingCode,InputForm];
gate["original own leading response",leadingResponse===raw["LODeltaResponse"]];
hatNames=Keys[raw["FhatsBMHV"]];
config=Import[path["common/s14_inputs.json"],"RawJSON"];
gate["complete original projector inventory",hatNames===Keys[config["channels"][channel]["unpolarized_hats"]]&&
  Length[hatNames]===Length[raw["FhatPhotonWeights"]]];
Do[name=hatNames[[hatIndex]];
  gate[name<>" accepted original Born reference check",TrueQ[raw["Checks"][name<>" original unpolarized Born hat"]]];
  Do[gate[name<>" exact saved Born projector",Sum[raw["FhatPhotonWeights"][[hatIndex,a]]leadingResponse[[a,j,i]],
    {a,dimensions[[1]]}]===raw["FhatsBMHV"][name]["LODelta"][[j,i]]],
    {j,dimensions[[2]]},{i,dimensions[[3]]}];
  Do[gate[name<>" accepted original reference "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm],
      TrueQ[raw["Checks"][name<>" original unpolarized finite hat "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm]]]];
    Do[gate[name<>" exact saved tensor projector "<>ToString[{sign,distribution,j,i},InputForm],
      Sum[raw["FhatPhotonWeights"][[hatIndex,a]]raw["NLOResponse"][sign][distribution][[a,j,i]],
        {a,dimensions[[1]]}]===raw["FhatsBMHV"][name]["NLO"][sign][distribution][[j,i]]],
      {j,dimensions[[2]]},{i,dimensions[[3]]}],{sign,signs},{distribution,distributions}],
  {hatIndex,Length[hatNames]}];
gate["finite reloaded tensor and hats",FreeQ[{raw["NLOResponse"],raw["FhatsBMHV"]},
  eps|D|gs|_Missing|_GLI|_CutIntegral|_PaVe|_Integrate|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|
  _ConditionalExpression|_Piecewise|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
resultPath=path[channel<>"/s14_result/s14_result.wl"];
CopyFile[path[recovery["pending_result"]],resultPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
gate["published bytes equal the completely validated native export",
  IntegerString[FileHash[resultPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===recovery["files"][recovery["pending_result"]]];
Export[path[channel<>"/s14_result/s14_checks.json"],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,
  "component_count"->Length[indices],"finite_minimal_subtraction_coefficients_computed"->True,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False,"parent_job_id"->parent["job_id"],
  "scalar_comparison_evidence"->(ToString[#,InputForm]&/@comparisonEvidence),
  "recovery_source_sha256"->IntegerString[FileHash[recoverySource,"SHA256"],16,64],
  "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_complete_saved_finite_export"];Quit[0];
```

<a id="source-471"></a>

## common/s14_inspect_Hgq_reference_residual.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-471", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7008, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_inspect_Hgq_reference_residual.wls", "sha256": "74550c5f904b2d8b5a410565dd1fc17520d7edaecdd8868f3ecc539ec7c5f758"} -->
```wolfram
(* Inspect the actual failed reference comparison from accepted pole checkpoints. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
inspectionRoot=Directory[];
inspectionSource=FileNameJoin[{inspectionRoot,"common","s14_inspect_Hgq_reference_residual.wls"}];
inspectionBase=FileNameJoin[{inspectionRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "9f511361187996d8fef88f8897ba2b40018032d9d4e789ec2cd17d445939a94a",Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
inspectionText=Import[inspectionBase,"Text"];
If[!SyntaxQ[Import[inspectionSource,"Text"]]||StringCount[inspectionText,"\nindices=Tuples"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
inspectionPrefix=First[StringSplit[inspectionText,"\nindices=Tuples"]];
If[StringCount[inspectionPrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
inspectionPrefix=StringReplace[inspectionPrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"Null"];
inspectionFrameAnchor="realFrame=spinReal[\"Frame\"];";
inspectionFrameRelease=inspectionFrameAnchor<>"Clear[spinReal];ClearSystemCache[];";
If[StringCount[inspectionPrefix,inspectionFrameAnchor]=!=1,Quit[1]];
inspectionUnreleasedPrefix=inspectionPrefix;
inspectionPrefix=StringReplace[inspectionPrefix,inspectionFrameAnchor->inspectionFrameRelease];
If[StringReplace[inspectionPrefix,inspectionFrameRelease->inspectionFrameAnchor]=!=inspectionUnreleasedPrefix,Quit[1]];
If[!SyntaxQ[inspectionPrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[inspectionPrefix,InputForm];
gate["inspected failed core channel",channel==="Hgq"&&core];
inspectionReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_residual_result","s14_failed_execution.json"}];
inspectionReceipt=Import[inspectionReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["failed comparison execution source identity",!TrueQ[inspectionReceipt["passed"]]&&
  inspectionReceipt["job_id"]==="14815403"&&inspectionReceipt["exit_code"]===1&&
  inspectionReceipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"]===
    IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionBase,"SHA256"],16,64]];
inspectionU=First[FirstPosition[basis["SpinLabels"],"U"]];
inspectionSign=First[{1,-1,0}];inspectionDistribution="Delta";
inspectionFiles=<||>;
inspectionFinite=Table[
  label={{a,inspectionU,inspectionU},inspectionSign,inspectionDistribution};
  path=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
  gate["own pole checkpoint exists "<>ToString[a],FileExistsQ[path]];
  saved=Get[path];
  gate["own pole checkpoint source input and label "<>ToString[a],
    saved["InputHash"]===inputHash&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["Label"]===label];
  AssociateTo[inspectionFiles,StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[path,"SHA256"]];
  saved["Finite"],{a,Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]]}];
inspectionNormalizationStart=StringPosition[inspectionText,"  normalization=If[core,"];
inspectionNormalizationEnd=StringPosition[inspectionText,"  gate[\"finite physical component\""];
gate["unique unchanged final normalization",Length[inspectionNormalizationStart]===1&&Length[inspectionNormalizationEnd]===1];
inspectionNormalization=StringTake[inspectionText,{First[First[inspectionNormalizationStart]],First[First[inspectionNormalizationEnd]]-1}];
gate["unchanged normalization syntax",SyntaxQ[inspectionNormalization]];
inspectionPhysical=Table[
  branches=<|inspectionSign-><|inspectionDistribution->value|>|>;
  ToExpression[inspectionNormalization,InputForm];
  branches[inspectionSign][inspectionDistribution],{value,inspectionFinite}];
inspectionAssumptions=(If[inspectionDistribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.
  t->inspectionSign omega-s)&&omega>0&&flavorDomain;
inspectionRows=Table[
  name={"F1","F2"}[[hatIndex]];
  candidate=Sum[hatPhotonWeights[[hatIndex,a]]inspectionPhysical[[a]],{a,Length[inspectionPhysical]}];
  expected=referenceHats[name]["NLO"][inspectionSign][inspectionDistribution];
  Print["REFERENCE_RESIDUAL_BEGIN ",name," input bytes ",ByteCount[candidate-expected]];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[candidate-expected,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  prepared=bounded[If[functions==={},Factor[candidate-expected],
    Collect[candidate-expected,functions,Factor]],{name,"reference precollection"}];
  gate["exact original reference precollection "<>name,Together[candidate-expected-prepared]===0];
  timing=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[reduce[prepared,inspectionAssumptions],{name,"actual reference residual"}]];
  residual=timing[[2]];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[residual,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  Print["REFERENCE_RESIDUAL ",name," bytes ",ByteCount[residual]," functions ",Length[functions]," seconds ",timing[[1]]];
  Print["REFERENCE_RESIDUAL_EXPRESSION ",name," ",StringTake[ToString[residual,InputForm],UpTo[12000]]];
  <|"Hat"->name,"Branch"->inspectionSign,"Distribution"->inspectionDistribution,
    "Candidate"->candidate,"Expected"->expected,"Residual"->residual,"Functions"->functions,"Seconds"->timing[[1]],
    "StructuralZero"->(residual===0)|>,{hatIndex,Length[hatPhotonWeights]}];
inspectionResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-reference-residual-inspection-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[inspectionSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"CheckpointHashes"->inspectionFiles,
  "FailedExecutionHash"->FileHash[inspectionReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "NormalizationSource"->inspectionNormalization,"PhotonWeights"->hatPhotonWeights,
  "PhysicalConditions"->inspectionAssumptions,"Rows"->inspectionRows,"Checks"->checks,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
inspectionDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_residual_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[inspectionDir],CreateDirectory[inspectionDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
inspectionPath=FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir,"s14_result.wl"}];
Do[
  plainPath=FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir,"s14_residual_"<>row["Hat"]<>".wl"}];
  plainText=ToString[row["Residual"],InputForm]<>"\n";
  gate["bounded readable residual "<>row["Hat"],StringLength[plainText]<128*1024^2];
  Export[plainPath<>".tmp",plainText,"Text"];
  gate["exact readable residual reload "<>row["Hat"],Get[plainPath<>".tmp"]===row["Residual"]];
  RenameFile[plainPath<>".tmp",plainPath,OverwriteTarget->True],{row,inspectionRows}];

inspectionSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[inspectionResult],"residual inspection compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["residual inspection file bound",StringLength[inspectionSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[inspectionPath<>".tmp",inspectionSerialized,"Text"];
gate["residual inspection exact native reload",Get[inspectionPath<>".tmp"]===inspectionResult];
RenameFile[inspectionPath<>".tmp",inspectionPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_inspect_Hgq_reference_residual"];Quit[0];

```
<!-- END SOURCE -->

```wolfram
If[!SyntaxQ[inspectionPrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[inspectionPrefix,InputForm];
gate["inspected failed small channel",channel==="Hqqprime"&&!core];
inspectionReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_result","s14_execution.json"}];
inspectionReceipt=Import[inspectionReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["failed comparison execution source identity",!TrueQ[inspectionReceipt["passed"]]&&
  inspectionReceipt["job_id"]==="14797221"&&inspectionReceipt["exit_code"]===1&&
  inspectionReceipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"]===
    IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionBase,"SHA256"],16,64]];
inspectionU=First[FirstPosition[basis["SpinLabels"],"U"]];
inspectionSign=First[{1,-1,0}];inspectionDistribution="Regular";
inspectionFiles=<||>;
inspectionFinite=Table[
  label={{a,inspectionU,inspectionU},inspectionSign,inspectionDistribution};
  path=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
  gate["own pole checkpoint exists "<>ToString[a],FileExistsQ[path]];
  saved=Get[path];
  gate["own pole checkpoint source input and label "<>ToString[a],
    saved["InputHash"]===inputHash&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["Label"]===label];
  AssociateTo[inspectionFiles,StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[path,"SHA256"]];
  saved["Finite"],{a,Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]]}];
inspectionNormalizationStart=StringPosition[inspectionText,"  normalization=If[core,"];
inspectionNormalizationEnd=StringPosition[inspectionText,"  gate[\"finite physical component\""];
gate["unique unchanged final normalization",Length[inspectionNormalizationStart]===1&&Length[inspectionNormalizationEnd]===1];
inspectionNormalization=StringTake[inspectionText,{First[First[inspectionNormalizationStart]],First[First[inspectionNormalizationEnd]]-1}];
gate["unchanged normalization syntax",SyntaxQ[inspectionNormalization]];
inspectionPhysical=Table[
  branches=<|inspectionSign-><|inspectionDistribution->value|>|>;
  ToExpression[inspectionNormalization,InputForm];
  branches[inspectionSign][inspectionDistribution],{value,inspectionFinite}];
inspectionAssumptions=(physical/.t->inspectionSign omega-s)&&omega>0&&flavorDomain;
inspectionRows=Table[
  name={"F1","F2"}[[hatIndex]];
  candidate=Sum[hatPhotonWeights[[hatIndex,a]]inspectionPhysical[[a]],{a,Length[inspectionPhysical]}];
  expected=referenceHats[name]/.t->inspectionSign omega-s;
  Print["REFERENCE_RESIDUAL_BEGIN ",name," input bytes ",ByteCount[candidate-expected]];
  timing=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[reduce[candidate-expected,inspectionAssumptions],{name,"actual reference residual"}]];
  residual=timing[[2]];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[residual,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  Print["REFERENCE_RESIDUAL ",name," bytes ",ByteCount[residual]," functions ",Length[functions]," seconds ",timing[[1]]];
  Print["REFERENCE_RESIDUAL_EXPRESSION ",name," ",StringTake[ToString[residual,InputForm],UpTo[12000]]];
  <|"Hat"->name,"Branch"->inspectionSign,"Distribution"->inspectionDistribution,
    "Candidate"->candidate,"Expected"->expected,"Residual"->residual,"Functions"->functions,"Seconds"->timing[[1]],
    "StructuralZero"->(residual===0)|>,{hatIndex,Length[hatPhotonWeights]}];
inspectionResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-reference-residual-inspection-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[inspectionSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"CheckpointHashes"->inspectionFiles,
  "FailedExecutionHash"->FileHash[inspectionReceiptPath,"SHA256"],"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "NormalizationSource"->inspectionNormalization,"PhotonWeights"->hatPhotonWeights,
  "PhysicalConditions"->inspectionAssumptions,"Rows"->inspectionRows,"Checks"->checks,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
inspectionDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_residual_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[inspectionDir],CreateDirectory[inspectionDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
inspectionPath=FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir,"s14_result.wl"}];
inspectionSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[inspectionResult],"residual inspection compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["residual inspection file bound",StringLength[inspectionSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[inspectionPath<>".tmp",inspectionSerialized,"Text"];
gate["residual inspection exact native reload",Get[inspectionPath<>".tmp"]===inspectionResult];
RenameFile[inspectionPath<>".tmp",inspectionPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{inspectionDir,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_inspect_reference_residual"];Quit[0];

```

## common/s14_project_real_frame.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-475", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3270, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_project_real_frame.wls", "sha256": "503ef2168287d2e0309c42704de529c395af605a9c8a99111fb59f31deea5cb5"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve exactly the saved real-tensor fields read by finite assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
sourcePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_project_real_frame.wls"}];checks=<||>;
gate[name_,value_] := If[TrueQ[value],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated native runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
gate["complete projection syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath,"Text"]]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
producerRelative=channel<>"/s05_result/s05_result.wl";
producerPath=FileNameJoin[{root,producerRelative}];
receiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s05_result","s05_execution.json"}];
producerReceipt=Import[receiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted real producer",TrueQ[producerReceipt["passed"]]];
KeyValueMap[gate["bound producer result "<>#1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,producerReceipt["result_sha256"]];
memoryBefore=MemoryInUse[];
{readSeconds,full}=AbsoluteTiming[Get[producerPath]];
gate["accepted own real tensor",AssociationQ[full] && full["Channel"]===channel &&
  AssociationQ[full["Checks"]] && And@@Values[full["Checks"]]];
retainedKeys={"Channel","Checks","Frame"};
gate["complete finite-assembly frame interface",And@@(KeyExistsQ[full,#]&/@retainedKeys) && AssociationQ[full["Frame"]]];
projection=KeyTake[full,retainedKeys];
gate["exact saved consumer fields",And@@(projection[#]===full[#]&/@retainedKeys)];
evidence=<|"SourceBytes"->ByteCount[full],"ProjectionBytes"->ByteCount[projection],
  "MemoryBefore"->memoryBefore,"MemoryLoaded"->MemoryInUse[],"ReadSeconds"->readSeconds|>;
Print["ACTUAL_REAL_FRAME ",InputForm[projection["Frame"]]];
Clear[full];ClearSystemCache[];
AssociateTo[evidence,{"MemoryAfterRelease"->MemoryInUse[],"NativePeakMemory"->MaxMemoryUsed[]}];
Print["REAL_FRAME_PROJECTION_EVIDENCE ",InputForm[evidence]];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-real-frame-projection-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"],"ProducerResultHash"->FileHash[producerPath,"SHA256"],
  "ProducerReceiptHash"->FileHash[receiptPath,"SHA256"],"ProducerResultHashes"->producerReceipt["result_sha256"],
  "RetainedKeys"->retainedKeys,"Projection"->projection,"Evidence"->evidence,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_frame_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
path=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_result.wl"}];
serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded frame record",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[path<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
gate["exact native frame reload",Get[path<>".tmp"]===result];
RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"evidence"->evidence,
  "channel"->channel,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_project_real_frame"];Quit[0];

```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-476", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8073, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_result/reference/s14_Hgq_finite_update_before_native_context.wls", "sha256": "d4e520c04d161745552eeae999815ad45ebcfd6c73665b4060debf8d75571770"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse accepted Laurent coefficients after an explicitly finite subtraction change. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
updateSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_Hgq_finite_update.wls"}];
updateLegacySource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_Hgq_roots.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[updateLegacySource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "4f695976bf5320e47df51bc3d8def722c573d2988be5c3afd412c794068d73c8",Quit[1]];
updateLegacyText=Import[updateLegacySource,"Text"];
updateEntry="ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[StringTrim[updateLegacyText],updateEntry]||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[updateSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
updatePrefix=StringTake[updateLegacyText,
  First[Last[StringPosition[updateLegacyText,updateEntry]]]-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[updatePrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[updatePrefix,InputForm];
gate["own finite-update channel",channel==="Hgq"&&core];
updateOldCache=cache;updateOldInputHash=inputHash;updateOldInputHashes=inputHashes;
updateOldCounterterms=subtraction["Counterterms"];
updateOriginalAssembly=DownValues[assemble];
updateOldControl=assemble[First[poleRunProof["ControlLabel"]]];
gate["own accepted assembly control retained",TrueQ[updateOldControl["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateOldControl["Checks"]]];
updateRelative=channel<>"/s11_msbar_result/s11_result.wl";
updateSubtractionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,updateRelative}];
updateReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_msbar_result","s11_execution.json"}];
updateComparisonPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_msbar_result","s11_comparison.wl"}];
updateSubtractionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s11_finalize_Hgq_subtraction.wls"}];
updateReceipt=Import[updateReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
updateSubtraction=Get[updateSubtractionPath];updateComparison=Get[updateComparisonPath];
gate["accepted finite MS subtraction execution",TrueQ[updateReceipt["passed"]]&&
  updateReceipt["result_sha256"][updateRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[updateSubtractionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  updateSubtraction["SourceHash"]===FileHash[updateSubtractionSource,"SHA256"]&&
  updateSubtraction["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[updateSubtraction["AcceptedForProduction"]]&&
  TrueQ[updateSubtraction["FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateSubtraction["Checks"]]];
gate["complete native subtraction comparison",TrueQ[updateComparison["AcceptedForProduction"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateComparison["Checks"]]&&AllTrue[updateComparison["Comparisons"],TrueQ[#["Equal"]]&]&&
  updateSubtraction["ConvolutionComparisonHash"]===FileHash[updateComparisonPath,"SHA256"]&&
  updateComparison["OriginalAssemblyInputHash"]===updateOldInputHash&&
  updateComparison["OriginalSubtractionHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","s11_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]];
gate["same physical subtraction basis",updateSubtraction["PhotonLabels"]===subtraction["PhotonLabels"]&&
  updateSubtraction["SpinLabels"]===subtraction["SpinLabels"]&&
  updateSubtraction["Prefactor"]===subtraction["Prefactor"]&&
  updateSubtraction["MSPole"]===subtraction["MSPole"]];
updateDifference=Association@Table[distribution->Map[Factor,
  updateSubtraction["Counterterms"][distribution]-updateOldCounterterms[distribution],{3}],
  {distribution,Keys[updateOldCounterterms]}];
gate["actual full-spin counterterm difference is finite",FreeQ[updateDifference,
  eps|D|_Missing|_Integrate|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
gate["exact subtraction difference from native comparison",And@@Flatten[
  Map[Together[#]===0&,Values[updateDifference]-Values[updateComparison["Correction"]],{4}]]];
updateNormalization=eq^2 couplingSquare^2 hardNormalization;
updateCheckpointHashes=<||>;
updateAssemble[index_,difference_] := Block[{checks=<||>},Module[
  {branches,label,path,saved,change,value},
  branches=Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[
    label={index,sign,distribution};path=FileNameJoin[{updateOldCache,
      "finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
    gate["required own accepted finite checkpoint",FileExistsQ[path]];
    saved=Get[path];
    gate["bound own finite checkpoint",TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&
      saved["InputHash"]===updateOldInputHash&&saved["Label"]===label&&AssociationQ[saved["PoleResiduals"]]];
    AssociateTo[updateCheckpointHashes,StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[path,"SHA256"]];
    change=If[KeyExistsQ[difference,distribution],Extract[difference[distribution],index],0]/.t->sign omega-s;
    value=updateNormalization (saved["Finite"]+change);
    gate["finite updated physical component",FreeQ[value,eps|D|gs|_Missing|_GLI|_CutIntegral|_PaVe|
      _Integrate|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
    distribution->value,{distribution,distributions}],{sign,{1,-1,0}}];
  <|"Index"->index,"Branches"->branches,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>]];
updateZeroDifference=Map[ConstantArray[0,Dimensions[#]]&,updateDifference];
updateReusedControl=updateAssemble[updateOldControl["Index"],updateZeroDifference];
gate["own accepted complete output comparison",updateReusedControl["Branches"]===updateOldControl["Branches"]];
Clear[updateOldControl,updateReusedControl];
updateIndices=Tuples[{Range[Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]]],
  Range[Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]],Range[Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]]}];
updateControlIndex=SelectFirst[updateIndices,Function[index,
  AnyTrue[Values[updateDifference],Function[tensor,Extract[tensor,index]=!=0]]]];
gate["a changed physical component is available",MemberQ[updateIndices,updateControlIndex]];
subtraction=updateSubtraction;
inputPaths=DeleteDuplicates[Join[inputPaths,{updateSource,updateLegacySource,updateSubtractionPath,
  updateReceiptPath,updateComparisonPath,updateSubtractionSource}]];
inputHashes=Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@inputPaths];
inputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,inputHashes,$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
cache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s14",channel,IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache],CreateDirectory[cache,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
Print["DIRECT_FINITE_UPDATE_CONTROL ",InputForm[updateControlIndex]];
{updateDirectSeconds,updateDirectControl}=AbsoluteTiming[assemble[updateControlIndex]];
gate["direct updated assembly control accepted",TrueQ[updateDirectControl["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[updateDirectControl["Checks"]]];
{updateReuseSeconds,updateReuseControl}=AbsoluteTiming[updateAssemble[updateControlIndex,updateDifference]];
gate["updated complete component equals direct assembly",And@@Flatten[Table[
  zero[updateDirectControl["Branches"][sign][distribution]-updateReuseControl["Branches"][sign][distribution],
    (If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->sign omega-s)&&If[sign===0,True,omega>0]],
  {sign,{1,-1,0}},{distribution,distributions}]]];
updateEvidence=<|"Index"->updateControlIndex,"DirectSeconds"->updateDirectSeconds,
  "ReuseSeconds"->updateReuseSeconds,"OwnAcceptedOutputComparison"->True,
  "DirectUpdatedComponentComparison"->True,"FiniteCountertermDifference"->True|>;
Print["FINITE_UPDATE_COMPARISON ",InputForm[updateEvidence]];
Clear[updateDirectControl,updateReuseControl,updateSubtraction,updateOldCounterterms];ClearSystemCache[];
Clear[assemble];assemble[index_] := updateAssemble[index,updateDifference];
updateExportAnchor="poleFinalPut[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
gate["unique original final finite export",StringCount[phaseRunTail,updateExportAnchor]===1];
updateExportCode="AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[updateSource,\"SHA256\"],"<>
  "\"SubtractionResultHash\"->FileHash[updateSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],"<>
  "\"FiniteUpdateEvidence\"->updateEvidence,\"PreviousAssemblyInputHash\"->updateOldInputHash,"<>
  "\"PreviousCheckpointHashes\"->updateCheckpointHashes}];"<>updateExportAnchor;
phaseRunTail=StringReplace[phaseRunTail,updateExportAnchor->updateExportCode];
gate["complete updated finite assembly syntax",SyntaxQ[phaseRunTail]];
ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];
```

## common/s14_result/reference/s14_assemble_finite_refined_before_bounded_storage_check.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-478", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7108, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_result/reference/s14_assemble_finite_refined_before_bounded_storage_check.wls", "sha256": "e64ffae7bb5d1a59ca7c81edb557f8cbac706d8a08c23a180647ca511d7ba024"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve the accepted finite assembly and certify factored pole residuals. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
poleRunRoot=Directory[];
poleRunSource=FileNameJoin[{poleRunRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_refined.wls"}];
polePhaseSource=FileNameJoin[{poleRunRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_phase_series.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[polePhaseSource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "313f46987aa90ae14205aabec53154b72a96d1cceb5be5dcbca3d7ce770afcf2",Quit[1]];
polePhaseText=Import[polePhaseSource,"Text"];
polePhaseBoundary="\nphaseRunTail=\"indices=Tuples\"";
If[StringCount[polePhaseText,polePhaseBoundary]=!=1||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[poleRunSource,"Text"]],
  Print["FAIL: reviewed finite-assembly entry boundary or source syntax"];Quit[1]];
polePhasePosition=First[First[StringPosition[polePhaseText,polePhaseBoundary]]];
polePhasePrefix=StringTake[polePhaseText,polePhasePosition-1];
If[!SyntaxQ[polePhasePrefix],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[polePhasePrefix,InputForm];
poleRunProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_pole_factorization_result","s14_result.wl"}];
poleRunReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_pole_factorization_result","s14_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted own pole-refinement execution",TrueQ[poleRunReceipt["passed"]]&&
  poleRunReceipt["result_sha256"][channel<>"/s14_pole_factorization_result/s14_result.wl"]===
    IntegerString[FileHash[poleRunProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
poleRunProof=Get[poleRunProofPath];
gate["accepted saved and original input-sum poles",poleRunProof["Schema"]===
  "polarized-sidis-assembly-pole-refinement-v1"&&TrueQ[poleRunProof["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[poleRunProof["Checks"]]&&Length[poleRunProof["Rows"]]>0&&
  AllTrue[poleRunProof["Rows"],#["Refined"]===0&&#["InputSumRefined"]===0&]&&
  AllTrue[poleRunProof["ControlRows"],#["Refined"]===0&]];
gate["own exact pole-refinement inputs",channel===poleRunProof["Channel"]&&
  inputHash===poleRunProof["InputHash"]&&inputHashes===poleRunProof["InputHashes"]&&
  sourceHash===poleRunProof["BaselineSourceHash"]&&
  poleRunProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
gate["reviewed pole-refinement source",IntegerString[poleRunProof["SourceHash"],16,64]===
  "adfb5f8c877b57b191a08514488580907bc221008dab61e24ebee6d196cee14f"&&
  poleRunProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_pole_factorization.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
```

```wolfram
poleActualConditions=poleConditions[poleFailed["Label"]];

  "ControlHash"->FileHash[poleControlPath,"SHA256"],"ControlFiniteHash"->Hash[poleControl["Finite"],"SHA256"],

poleDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_pole_factorization_result"}];

gate["every actual saved residue vanishes",And@@(#["Refined"]===0&/@poleRows)];
gate["every original input-sum pole vanishes",And@@(#["InputSumRefined"]===0&/@poleRows)];
AssociateTo[poleResult,{"Accepted"->True,"Checks"->checks}];
polePath=FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_result.wl"}];

gate["pole proof file bound",StringLength[poleSerialized]<128*1024^2];
```

```wolfram
poleOriginalAssemblyDefinitions=DownValues[refineAssemblyPole];
DownValues[refineOriginalAssemblyPole]=poleOriginalAssemblyDefinitions/.
  refineAssemblyPole->refineOriginalAssemblyPole;
normalizeAssemblyRoots[value_,conditions_] := Module[
  {powers,rules={},certificates={},variables,domain,radical,candidate,decision,
   normalized,seconds,key},
  key=Hash[{value,conditions},"SHA256"];
  variables=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[{value,conditions},
    symbol_Symbol/;MemberQ[{"Global`","FeynCalc`"},Context[symbol]],Infinity]];
  gate["root variables real "<>ToString[key],Refine[Element[variables,Reals],conditions]===True];
  domain=With[{v=variables,c=conditions},Resolve[Exists[v,c],Reals]];
  gate["root normalization domain nonempty "<>ToString[key],domain===True];
  powers=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value,power:Power[_,_Rational]:>power,{0,Infinity}]];
  {seconds,normalized}=AbsoluteTiming[
    Do[
      candidate=Refine[PowerExpand[radical,Assumptions->True],conditions];
      If[candidate===radical,Continue[]];
      If[!FreeQ[candidate,$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity],Continue[]];
      decision=FullSimplify[radical==candidate,conditions,TimeConstraint->15];

      AppendTo[rules,radical->candidate];
      AppendTo[certificates,<|"Original"->radical,"Candidate"->candidate,
        "Conditions"->conditions,"ExactEquality"->True|>];
      Print["CERTIFIED_ROOT ",InputForm[radical]," -> ",InputForm[candidate]],
      {radical,powers}];
    Together[Expand[value/.rules]]];

    "NormalizedBytes"->ByteCount[normalized],"Powers"->Length[powers],
    "CertifiedRules"->Length[rules],"Seconds"->seconds,"ExactZero"->(normalized===0)|>]];

  <|"Power"->power,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Refined"->Last[timed]|>],poleControl["PoleResiduals"]];

poleRootControlRows=Map[Function[row,

    Last[timed],"complete original input pole"]];

poleResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-assembly-pole-refinement-v1","Channel"->channel,

  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"OriginalZeroDefinitions"->DownValues[zero],

  "RootNormalizationDefinitions"->DownValues[normalizeAssemblyRoots],
  "OriginalAssemblyFallbackDefinitions"->DownValues[refineOriginalAssemblyPole],
  "RootControlRows"->poleRootControlRows,
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse the accepted factor certificate on Hqg's exact saved assembly inputs. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];checks=<||>;
```

## common/s14_result/reference/s14_check_Hqg_reference_terms_before_async_inspection.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-486", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6036, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_result/reference/s14_check_Hqg_reference_terms_before_async_inspection.wls", "sha256": "e7ace4db364957e21ba1cb518d80466943a9dcd69e5229d75e771683892f3bee"} -->
```wolfram
(* Compare the saved finite residual with the executed dimensional counterterm change. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];checks=<||>;
sourcePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_Hqg_reference_terms.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],
  Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",channel==="Hqg"&&StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath,"Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" memory limit",False]];
inspectionRelative=channel<>"/s14_reference_residual_result/s14_result.wl";
inspectionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,inspectionRelative}];inspection=Get[inspectionPath];
receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[inspectionPath],"s14_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact residual input",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&receipt["job_id"]==="14884507"&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][inspectionRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[inspectionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  inspection["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-reference-residual-inspection-v1"&&inspection["Channel"]===channel&&
  inspection["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_inspect_Hqg_reference_residual.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  inspection["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&And@@Values[inspection["Checks"]]];
basePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];baseText=Import[basePath,"Text"];
gate["unchanged original assembly",inspection["BaselineSourceHash"]===FileHash[basePath,"SHA256"]];
normalizationDefinitions=StringRiffle[{
  "dimension=4-2eps;",
  "hardNormalization=(2Pi)^(-Limit[dimension,eps->0]);",
  "couplingSquare=Factor[gs^2/.First[Solve[gs^2==4Pi alphaS,gs]]];"},"\n"];
gate["exact original normalization definitions",And@@(StringCount[baseText,#]===1&/@StringSplit[normalizationDefinitions,"\n"])];
ToExpression[normalizationDefinitions,InputForm];
core=True;branches=<|1-><|"Delta"->1|>|>;
gate["inherited component normalization syntax",SyntaxQ[inspection["NormalizationSource"]]];
ToExpression[inspection["NormalizationSource"],InputForm];
normalizationFactor=branches[1]["Delta"];
basisPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s02_result","s02_result.wl"}];basis=Get[basisPath];
currentPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","s11_result.wl"}];current=Get[currentPath];
previousPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","reference","before_dimensional_completion","s11_result.wl"}];
previous=Get[previousPath];
gate["same accepted subtraction input",FileHash[currentPath,"SHA256"]===inspection["InputHashes"][channel<>"/s11_result/s11_result.wl"]&&
  current["Channel"]===channel&&previous["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[current["Checks"]]&&And@@Values[previous["Checks"]]&&
  current["PreviousSubtractionHash"]===FileHash[previousPath,"SHA256"]&&
  current["PhotonLabels"]===basis["PhotonLabels"]&&current["SpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]&&
  FileHash[basisPath,"SHA256"]===inspection["InputHashes"]["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"]];
u=First[FirstPosition[basis["SpinLabels"],"U"]];
difference=Map[Factor,current["Counterterms"]["Delta"]-previous["Counterterms"]["Delta"],{3}];
gate["actual saved dimensional correction",difference===current["CountertermDifference"]["Delta"]&&FreeQ[difference,eps|D]];
assumptions=inspection["PhysicalConditions"];
reduceTerms[value_]:=bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[value,assumptions],assumptions],"saved finite equation"];
rows=Table[
  input=inspection["Rows"][[n]];
  correction=(normalizationFactor inspection["PhotonWeights"][[n]].difference[[All,u,u]])/.
    t->input["Branch"] omega-s;
  gate["same branch variables "<>input["Hat"],FreeQ[correction,t]];
  residual=reduceTerms[input["Residual"]];
  remaining=reduceTerms[input["Residual"]-correction];
  Print["REFERENCE_TERM_COMPARISON ",input["Hat"]," residual ",InputForm[residual]];
  Print["REFERENCE_MINUS_DIMENSIONAL_CHANGE ",input["Hat"]," ",InputForm[remaining]];
  <|"Hat"->input["Hat"],"Branch"->input["Branch"],"Distribution"->input["Distribution"],
    "Residual"->residual,"DimensionalCountertermCorrection"->correction,
    "ResidualWithoutDimensionalChange"->remaining,"DimensionalChangeExplainsResidual"->(remaining===0)|>,
  {n,Length[inspection["Rows"]]}];
gate["finite evaluated comparison",FreeQ[rows,_Integrate|_Series|_Limit|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-reference-term-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"],"InspectionHash"->FileHash[inspectionPath,"SHA256"],
  "SubtractionHash"->FileHash[currentPath,"SHA256"],"PreviousSubtractionHash"->FileHash[previousPath,"SHA256"],
  "AssemblySourceHash"->FileHash[basePath,"SHA256"],"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "PhysicalConditions"->assumptions,"Normalization"->normalizationFactor,"Rows"->rows,"Checks"->checks,
  "ProductionChanged"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
out=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_terms_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
file=FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_result.wl"}];
text=ToString[result,InputForm]<>"\n";gate["bounded readable comparison",StringLength[text]<128*1024^2];
Export[file<>".tmp",text,"Text"];gate["exact native comparison reload",Get[file<>".tmp"]===result];
RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "dimensional_change_explains_residual"->Lookup[rows,"DimensionalChangeExplainsResidual"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_check_Hqg_reference_terms"];Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
reduceTerms[value_]:=bounded[FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[value,assumptions],assumptions],"saved finite equation"];
rows=Table[
  input=inspection["Rows"][[n]];
  correction=(normalizationFactor inspection["PhotonWeights"][[n]].difference[[All,u,u]])/.
    t->input["Branch"] omega-s;
  gate["same branch variables "<>input["Hat"],FreeQ[correction,t]];
  residual=reduceTerms[input["Residual"]];
  remaining=reduceTerms[input["Residual"]-correction];
  Print["REFERENCE_TERM_COMPARISON ",input["Hat"]," residual ",InputForm[residual]];
  Print["REFERENCE_MINUS_DIMENSIONAL_CHANGE ",input["Hat"]," ",InputForm[remaining]];
  <|"Hat"->input["Hat"],"Branch"->input["Branch"],"Distribution"->input["Distribution"],
    "Residual"->residual,"DimensionalCountertermCorrection"->correction,
    "ResidualWithoutDimensionalChange"->remaining,"DimensionalChangeExplainsResidual"->(remaining===0)|>,
  {n,Length[inspection["Rows"]]}];
gate["finite evaluated comparison",FreeQ[rows,_Integrate|_Series|_Limit|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-reference-term-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"],"InspectionHash"->FileHash[inspectionPath,"SHA256"],
  "SubtractionHash"->FileHash[currentPath,"SHA256"],"PreviousSubtractionHash"->FileHash[previousPath,"SHA256"],
  "AssemblySourceHash"->FileHash[basePath,"SHA256"],"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
  "PhysicalConditions"->assumptions,"Normalization"->normalizationFactor,"Rows"->rows,"Checks"->checks,
  "ProductionChanged"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
out=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_terms_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
file=FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_result.wl"}];
text=ToString[result,InputForm]<>"\n";gate["bounded readable comparison",StringLength[text]<128*1024^2];
Export[file<>".tmp",text,"Text"];gate["exact native comparison reload",Get[file<>".tmp"]===result];
RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "dimensional_change_explains_residual"->Lookup[rows,"DimensionalChangeExplainsResidual"],
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_check_Hqg_reference_terms"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
 gate["own pole time bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],2*1024^3,
 gate["own pole memory bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
ownPoleRefine[value_,conditions_] := Module[{roots,rules,normalized,identity,answer,rows={},started=AbsoluteTime[]},
 roots=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value,power:Power[_,_Rational]:>power,{0,Infinity}]];
 rules=Map[Function[power,
   normalized=Refine[PowerExpand[Factor[power[[1]]]^power[[2]],Assumptions->conditions],conditions];
   identity=If[normalized===power,0,FullSimplify[power-normalized,conditions,TimeConstraint->20]];
   gate["exact own physical root identity",identity===0];
   AppendTo[rows,<|"Original"->power,"Normalized"->normalized,"Residual"->identity|>];

 normalized=value/.rules;
 answer=Factor[Together[normalized]];

ownPoleConditions[label_] := (If[Last[label]==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->label[[2]]omega-s)&&

ownPoleCompare[] := Module[{settingsPath,settings,actualPath,controlPath,actual,control,uvPath,uv,receipt,
 controlConditions,actualConditions,controlRows,actualRows,combined,timed,sumTimed,original,priorSeconds,
 result,directory,path,serialized},
 settingsPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_Hqq_pole_inputs.json"}];
 settings=Import[settingsPath,"RawJSON"];
 gate["own pole channel",channel===settings["channel"]];
 KeyValueMap[gate["own bound pole input "<>#1,
   IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,settings["files"]];
 actualPath=FileNameJoin[{root,settings["actual"]}];controlPath=FileNameJoin[{root,settings["control"]}];
 actual=Get[actualPath];control=Get[controlPath];
 gate["same actual scientific input",actual["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
   !TrueQ[actual["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[actual,"InputParts"]&&Length[actual["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
 gate["same accepted own control input",control["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
   TrueQ[control["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[control,"Finite"]&&Length[control["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
 uvPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_result.wl"}];uv=Get[uvPath];
 receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[uvPath],"s13_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];

   uv["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s13_check_uv_branches.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
   uv["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
   receipt["result_sha256"]["Hqg/s13_branch_result/s13_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[uvPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 DownValues[refineUVResidual]=uv["Definitions"];
 gate["exact existing equations installed",DownValues[refineUVResidual]===uv["Definitions"]];
 ownPoleRootEvidence=<||>;

 controlRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},

   gate["original own accepted control predicate",TrueQ[original]];
   timed=AbsoluteTiming[ownPoleBounded[ownPoleRefine[value,controlConditions],"refined own control"]];
   gate["complete own accepted pole unchanged",Last[timed]===0];
   <|"Power"->power,"OriginalSeconds"->priorSeconds,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Residual"->Last[timed]|>],control["PoleResiduals"]];
 combined=Expand[Total[actual["InputParts"]],eps];
 actualRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},
   Print["OWN_ACTUAL_POLE_BEGIN ",power," bytes ",ByteCount[value]];
   timed=AbsoluteTiming[ownPoleBounded[ownPoleRefine[value,actualConditions],"actual saved pole"]];
   gate["actual saved pole vanishes",Last[timed]===0];
   sumTimed=AbsoluteTiming[ownPoleBounded[ownPoleRefine[Coefficient[combined,eps,power],actualConditions],"actual original sum pole"]];
   gate["actual original contribution pole vanishes",Last[sumTimed]===0];
   Print["OWN_ACTUAL_POLE_REFINED ",power," seconds ",First[timed]," sum_seconds ",First[sumTimed]];
   <|"Power"->power,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Residual"->Last[timed],
     "InputSumSeconds"->First[sumTimed],"InputSumResidual"->Last[sumTimed]|>],actual["PoleResiduals"]];
 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-own-pole-refinement-v1","Channel"->channel,"Accepted"->True,
   "SourceHash"->FileHash[ownPoleSource,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
   "NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"ConfigHash"->FileHash[settingsPath,"SHA256"],
   "OriginalZeroDefinitions"->DownValues[zero],"OriginalFinitePartDefinitions"->DownValues[finitePart],
   "Definitions"->DownValues[ownPoleRefine],"RefinementDefinitions"->DownValues[refineUVResidual],
   "ExistingProofHash"->FileHash[uvPath,"SHA256"],"ActualCheckpointHash"->FileHash[actualPath,"SHA256"],
   "ControlCheckpointHash"->FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"],"ControlFiniteHash"->Hash[control["Finite"],"SHA256"],
   "ActualLabel"->actual["Label"],"ControlLabel"->control["Label"],"ControlConditions"->controlConditions,
   "ActualConditions"->actualConditions,"ControlRows"->controlRows,"ActualRows"->actualRows,
   "RootEvidence"->ownPoleRootEvidence,"Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
 directory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_pole_refinement_result"}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 path=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_result.wl"}];serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n";
 gate["bounded own pole proof",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[path<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
 gate["exact own pole proof reload",Get[path<>".tmp"]===result];RenameFile[path<>".tmp",path,OverwriteTarget->True];
 Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"accepted"->True,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
 Print["PASS: s14_check_Hqq_pole_refinement"];Quit[0]];
ownPoleAnchor="cachedPartsRecord[];ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
ownPoleReplacement="cachedPartsRecord[];ownPoleCompare[];";
If[StringCount[cachedPartsRun,ownPoleAnchor]=!=1,Quit[1]];
ownPoleRun=StringReplace[cachedPartsRun,ownPoleAnchor->ownPoleReplacement];
If[!SyntaxQ[ownPoleRun]||StringReplace[ownPoleRun,ownPoleReplacement->ownPoleAnchor]=!=cachedPartsRun,Quit[1]];
ToExpression[ownPoleRun,InputForm];
```

## common/s14_result/reference/s14_check_phase_series_before_single_initialization.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-490", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6153, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_result/reference/s14_check_phase_series_before_single_initialization.wls", "sha256": "01a230018882e7b8ac178b1dd7d646df76c73b8dc1fdc3670b7050449e0aea47"} -->
```wolfram
(* Check the reference Laurent product on actual integrated spin components. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
phaseProofRoot=Directory[];
phaseProofSource=FileNameJoin[{phaseProofRoot,"common","s14_check_phase_series.wls"}];
phaseBaseline=FileNameJoin[{phaseProofRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
phaseLaurentSource=FileNameJoin[{phaseProofRoot,"common","s12_assemble_real_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[phaseBaseline,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "9f511361187996d8fef88f8897ba2b40018032d9d4e789ec2cd17d445939a94a"||
  IntegerString[FileHash[phaseLaurentSource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "ca3777035d3d220b3fb8fcddb8131348f0d7c97f8fd9b8d54703337c93daa243",Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
phaseBaselineText=Import[phaseBaseline,"Text"];
If[StringCount[phaseBaselineText,"\nindices=Tuples"]=!=1||!SyntaxQ[Import[phaseProofSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[First[StringSplit[phaseBaselineText,"\nindices=Tuples"]],InputForm];
gate["phase comparison channel",channel==="Hqqprime"];
phaseLaurentText=Import[phaseLaurentSource,"Text"];
phaseLaurentStart=First[First[StringPosition[phaseLaurentText,"laurentProduct[laurent_"]]];
phaseLaurentEnd=First[First[StringPosition[phaseLaurentText,"\n\nsoftPieces["]]];
phaseLaurentBlock=StringTake[phaseLaurentText,{phaseLaurentStart,phaseLaurentEnd-1}];
gate["reference Laurent product syntax",SyntaxQ[phaseLaurentBlock]];
ToExpression[phaseLaurentBlock,InputForm];
phaseProduct[coefficient_,kernel_,order_,label_] := Module[
  {polynomial,first,last,rows,reconstruction,answer},
  polynomial=bounded[Expand[coefficient,eps],{label,"Laurent collection"}];
  If[polynomial===0,Return[0]];
  first=Exponent[polynomial,eps,Min];last=Exponent[polynomial,eps];
  gate["integer finite Laurent support",IntegerQ[first]&&IntegerQ[last]&&first<=last];
  gate["complete Laurent polynomial",PolynomialQ[Expand[eps^(-first)polynomial,eps],eps]];
  rows=Table[Coefficient[polynomial,eps,n],{n,first,last}];
  gate["regulator-independent Laurent coefficients",FreeQ[rows,eps]];
  reconstruction=Total[MapThread[Times,{rows,eps^Range[first,last]}]];
  gate["exact Laurent polynomial reconstruction",
    bounded[Expand[polynomial-reconstruction],{label,"Laurent reconstruction"}]===0];
  gate["phase kernel has no truncated input series",FreeQ[kernel,_SeriesData|_Series]];
  answer=bounded[laurentProduct[polynomial,kernel,order],{label,"reference Laurent product"}];
  gate["reference phase product evaluated",FreeQ[answer,_SeriesData|_Series|_Integrate|_Missing|$Failed|$Aborted]];
  answer];

phaseControlLabels={{{1,1,1},1,"Regular"},{{1,4,4},-1,"Regular"},{{3,4,4},-1,"Regular"}};
phaseControlRows=Table[
  phaseControlPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
  gate["own accepted assembly checkpoint exists",FileExistsQ[phaseControlPath]];
  saved=Get[phaseControlPath];
  gate["own accepted assembly checkpoint identity",TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["InputHash"]===inputHash&&saved["Label"]===label];
  index=label[[1]];sign=label[[2]];distribution=label[[3]];
  assumptions=(physical/.t->sign omega-s)&&omega>0&&flavorDomain;
  phaseTimed=AbsoluteTiming[phaseProduct[strongFactor realBranch[index,sign,distribution],phase,0,label]];
  phaseCombined=Expand[phaseTimed[[2]]+(subtractionValue[index,distribution]/.t->sign omega-s),eps];
  gate["own accepted finite coefficient equality "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
    bounded[zero[Coefficient[phaseCombined,eps,0]-saved["Finite"],assumptions],{label,"accepted finite equality"}]];
  phaseMinimum=Min[Append[Cases[phaseCombined,Power[eps,n_Integer]/;n<0:>n,Infinity],0]];
  Do[gate["own accepted pole equality "<>ToString[{label,n},InputForm],
    bounded[zero[Coefficient[phaseCombined,eps,n]-Lookup[saved["PoleResiduals"],n,0],assumptions],
      {label,"accepted pole equality",n}]],{n,phaseMinimum,-1}];
  Print["PHASE_CONTROL_ACCEPTED ",label," seconds ",phaseTimed[[1]]];
  <|"Label"->label,"Checkpoint"->StringDrop[phaseControlPath,StringLength[root]+1],
    "SHA256"->FileHash[phaseControlPath,"SHA256"],"Seconds"->phaseTimed[[1]]|>,{label,phaseControlLabels}];

phaseActualLabel={{4,1,1},1,"Regular"};
phaseActualCoefficient=strongFactor realBranch[phaseActualLabel[[1]],phaseActualLabel[[2]],phaseActualLabel[[3]]];
Print["ACTUAL_PHASE=",InputForm[phase]];
Print["ACTUAL_PHASE_COEFFICIENT_BYTES=",ByteCount[phaseActualCoefficient]];
phaseActualTimed=AbsoluteTiming[phaseProduct[phaseActualCoefficient,phase,0,phaseActualLabel]];
Print["ACTUAL_PHASE_PRODUCT_SECONDS=",phaseActualTimed[[1]]];
phaseProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-phase-series-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[phaseProofSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "LaurentSourceHash"->FileHash[phaseLaurentSource,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Definitions"->DownValues[phaseProduct],
  "LaurentDefinitions"->DownValues[laurentProduct],"Controls"->phaseControlRows,
  "ActualLabel"->phaseActualLabel,"ActualSeconds"->phaseActualTimed[[1]],
  "ActualValue"->phaseActualTimed[[2]],"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
phaseProofDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_phase_result"}];
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse the accepted residual refinement on the actual failed assembly pole. *)

poleBaseline=FileNameJoin[{poleRoot,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[poleBaseline,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=poleSettings["baseline_sha256"],Quit[1]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
poleText=Import[poleBaseline,"Text"];
If[StringCount[poleText,"\nindices=Tuples"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
polePrefix=First[StringSplit[poleText,"\nindices=Tuples"]];
If[StringCount[polePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"]=!=1,Quit[1]];
polePrefix=StringReplace[polePrefix,"Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"Null"];
If[!SyntaxQ[polePrefix]||!SyntaxQ[Import[poleSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[polePrefix,InputForm];
gate["own pole comparison channel",channel===poleSettings["channel"]&&!core];
KeyValueMap[gate["bound pole comparison input "<>#1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,poleSettings["files"]];
poleFailedPath=FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["failed_checkpoint"]}];
poleControlPath=FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["control_checkpoint"]}];
poleFailed=Get[poleFailedPath];poleControl=Get[poleControlPath];
gate["failed checkpoint retains exact assembly inputs",poleFailed["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
  !TrueQ[poleFailed["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[poleFailed,"InputParts"]&&
  Length[poleFailed["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
gate["own accepted control identity",poleControl["InputHash"]===inputHash&&
  TrueQ[poleControl["Accepted"]]&&KeyExistsQ[poleControl,"Finite"]&&
  Length[poleControl["PoleResiduals"]]>0];
poleReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,poleSettings["failed_receipt"]}],"RawJSON"];
gate["failed execution binds the unchanged assembly",poleReceipt["job_id"]===poleSettings["failed_job_id"]&&
  !TrueQ[poleReceipt["passed"]]&&poleReceipt["exit_code"]===1&&
  poleReceipt["reviewed_sha256"]["common/s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"]===poleSettings["baseline_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[gate["failed execution input unchanged "<>#1,
  poleReceipt["reviewed_sha256"][#1]===IntegerString[#2,16,64]]&,inputHashes];
poleUV=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_result.wl"}]];
poleUVReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted existing residual routine",TrueQ[poleUVReceipt["passed"]]&&TrueQ[poleUV["Accepted"]]&&
  And@@Values[poleUV["Checks"]]&&poleUV["RefinedOriginalResidual"]===0&&poleUV["RefinedSumResidual"]===0&&
  poleUV["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s13_check_uv_branches.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
  poleUV["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
DownValues[refineUVResidual]=poleUV["Definitions"];
gate["exact existing residual routine installed",DownValues[refineUVResidual]===poleUV["Definitions"]];
poleFactorCertificates=<||>;
refineAssemblyPole[value_,conditions_] := Module[{factored,factors,candidates,index,refined,key,variables,counterDomain},
  key=Hash[{value,conditions},"SHA256"];
  factored=Factor[Together[value]];
  gate["exact pole factorization "<>ToString[key],Together[value-factored]===0];
  If[factored===0,AssociateTo[poleFactorCertificates,key-><|"Method"->"ExactTogether",
    "OriginalHash"->Hash[value,"SHA256"],"Conditions"->conditions,"Result"->0|>];Return[0]];
  factors=If[Head[factored]===Times,List@@factored,{factored}];
  gate["complete factor product "<>ToString[key],Times@@factors===factored];
  candidates=Select[Range[Length[factors]],!FreeQ[factors[[#]],Power[_,_Rational]]&];
  Do[
    refined=If[TrueQ[zero[factors[[index]],conditions]],0,
      Block[{physical=conditions},refineUVResidual[factors[[index]]]]];
    variables={};counterDomain=Missing["NotRequired"];
    If[refined=!=0,
      variables=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[{factors[[index]],conditions},
        symbol_Symbol/;MemberQ[{"Global`","FeynCalc`"},Context[symbol]],Infinity]];
      gate["factor variables real on original domain "<>ToString[key],
        Refine[Element[variables,Reals],conditions]===True];
      gate["original factor domain nonempty "<>ToString[key],
        Resolve[Exists[variables,conditions],Reals]===True];
      counterDomain=Reduce[conditions&&factors[[index]]!=0,variables,Reals];
      Print["EXACT_FACTOR_COUNTERDOMAIN ",InputForm[factors[[index]]]," ",InputForm[counterDomain]];
      If[counterDomain===False,refined=0]];
    If[refined===0,
      gate["certified zero factor "<>ToString[key],
        (Times@@ReplacePart[factors,index->refined])===0];
      AssociateTo[poleFactorCertificates,key-><|"Method"->"ExactZeroFactor",
        "OriginalHash"->Hash[value,"SHA256"],"Conditions"->conditions,"Factored"->factored,
        "FactorIndex"->index,"OriginalFactor"->factors[[index]],"RefinedFactor"->refined,
        "RealVariables"->variables,"NonzeroDomain"->counterDomain,"Result"->0|>];
      Print["CERTIFIED_POLE_FACTOR ",InputForm[factors[[index]]]," -> ",refined];Break[]],
    {index,candidates}];
  If[refined===0,0,Block[{physical=conditions},refineUVResidual[value]]]];
poleConditions[label_] := (If[Last[label]==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->label[[2]]omega-s)&&
  If[label[[2]]===0,True,omega>0]&&flavorDomain;
SetAttributes[poleBounded,HoldFirst];
poleBounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,300,
  gate["pole comparison time bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],2*1024^3,
  gate["pole comparison memory bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
poleControlConditions=poleConditions[poleControl["Label"]];
poleControlRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},
  gate["own original pole predicate "<>ToString[power],poleBounded[zero[value,poleControlConditions],"original control"]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[value,poleControlConditions],"refined control"]];
  gate["own accepted pole unchanged "<>ToString[power],Last[timed]===0];
  <|"Power"->power,"Seconds"->First[timed],"Refined"->Last[timed]|>],poleControl["PoleResiduals"]];
poleActualConditions=poleConditions[poleFailed["Label"]];
poleCombined=Expand[Total[poleFailed["InputParts"]],eps];
poleRows=KeyValueMap[Function[{power,value},
  factored=poleBounded[Factor[Together[value]],"actual saved residue factorization"];
  Print["ACTUAL_FACTORED_POLE ",power," ",InputForm[factored]];
  timed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[value,poleActualConditions],"actual saved residue refinement"]];
  actual=Coefficient[poleCombined,eps,power];
  sumTimed=AbsoluteTiming[poleBounded[refineAssemblyPole[actual,poleActualConditions],"complete original input pole"]];
  Print["ACTUAL_REFINED_POLE ",power," ",InputForm[Last[timed]]," INPUT_SUM ",InputForm[Last[sumTimed]]];
  <|"Power"->power,"Original"->value,"Factored"->factored,"Refined"->Last[timed],
    "InputSumRefined"->Last[sumTimed],"Seconds"->First[timed],"InputSumSeconds"->First[sumTimed]|>],poleFailed["PoleResiduals"]];
poleResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-assembly-pole-refinement-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[poleSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "ConfigHash"->FileHash[poleConfigPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"OriginalZeroDefinitions"->DownValues[zero],
  "OriginalFinitePartDefinitions"->DownValues[finitePart],"Definitions"->DownValues[refineAssemblyPole],
  "RefinementDefinitions"->DownValues[refineUVResidual],"ExistingProofHash"->
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hqg","s13_branch_result","s13_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],
  "FailedCheckpoint"->poleFailed,"FailedCheckpointHash"->FileHash[poleFailedPath,"SHA256"],
  "PhysicalConditions"->poleActualConditions,"ControlLabel"->poleControl["Label"],
  "ControlHash"->FileHash[poleControlPath,"SHA256"],"ControlFiniteHash"->Hash[poleControl["Finite"],"SHA256"],
  "ControlRows"->poleControlRows,"Rows"->poleRows,"FactorCertificates"->poleFactorCertificates,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->False,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
poleDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_pole_factorization_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[poleDirectory],CreateDirectory[poleDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
put[poleResult,FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_unaccepted.wl"}]];
gate["every actual saved residue vanishes",And@@(#["Refined"]===0&/@poleRows)];
gate["every original input-sum pole vanishes",And@@(#["InputSumRefined"]===0&/@poleRows)];
AssociateTo[poleResult,{"Accepted"->True,"Checks"->checks}];
polePath=FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_result.wl"}];
poleSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[poleBounded[Compress[poleResult],"proof compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["pole proof file bound",StringLength[poleSerialized]<128*1024^2];
Export[polePath<>".tmp",poleSerialized,"Text"];
gate["pole proof exact native reload",Get[polePath<>".tmp"]===poleResult];
RenameFile[polePath<>".tmp",polePath,OverwriteTarget->True];
DeleteFile[FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_unaccepted.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{poleDirectory,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"],
  "accepted"->True,"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_check_pole_factorization"];Quit[0];
```
