```wolfram
(* Validate the completed native export in a clean allocation without repeating its algebra. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];checks=<||>;
recoverySource=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_complete_saved_finite_export.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,name],Print["PASS: ",name]];AssociateTo[checks,name->True],
  Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete recovery syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[recoverySource,"Text"]]];
recovery=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_export_recovery_inputs.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["bound own export recovery",recovery["schema"]==="polarized-sidis-saved-finite-export-recovery-v1"&&
  recovery["channel"]===channel&&channel==="Hqqbar"];
path[relative_] := FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
hexHash[relative_] := IntegerString[FileHash[path[relative],"SHA256"],16,64];
parent=Import[path[recovery["parent_receipt"]],"RawJSON"];
gate["recorded completed-algebra export failure",parent["job_id"]===recovery["parent_job_id"]&&
  parent["passed"]===False&&parent["reason"]==="normal_exit"&&
  hexHash[recovery["parent_receipt"]]===recovery["files"][recovery["parent_receipt"]]];
KeyValueMap[gate["unchanged producer input "<>#1,hexHash[#1]===#2]&,parent["reviewed_sha256"]];
gate["bound complete native export",hexHash[recovery["pending_result"]]===recovery["files"][recovery["pending_result"]]&&
  FileByteCount[path[recovery["pending_result"]]]<128*1024^2];
gate["bound producer log",hexHash[recovery["parent_log"]]===recovery["files"][recovery["parent_log"]]];
parentLog=Import[path[recovery["parent_log"]],"Text"];
gate["producer reached its bounded complete export",StringContainsQ[parentLog,"bounded complete finite result file"]&&
  StringContainsQ[parentLog,"No more memory available."]&&!StringContainsQ[parentLog,"FAIL:"]];
Clear[parentLog];
Print["RECOVERY_LOAD_BEGIN memory ",MemoryInUse[]];
raw=Get[path[recovery["pending_result"]]];
Print["RECOVERY_LOAD_COMPLETE memory ",MemoryInUse[]];
Share[];ClearSystemCache[];
gate["accepted complete saved BMHV schema",AssociationQ[raw]&&
  raw["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-finite-bmhv-response-v1"&&raw["Channel"]===channel&&
  And@@Values[raw["Checks"]]&&TrueQ[raw["CompletePoleCancellationChecked"]]&&
  TrueQ[raw["UnpolarizedFinalReferenceComparisonPassed"]]&&
  TrueQ[raw["FiniteMinimalSubtractionCoefficientsComputed"]]&&
  raw["FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied"]===False&&raw["FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"]===False];
producerPath=path["common/s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"];
gate["unchanged mathematical and dispatch sources",raw["SourceHash"]===FileHash[producerPath,"SHA256"]&&
  raw["DispatchSourceHash"]===FileHash[path["common/s14_assemble_finite_refined.wls"],"SHA256"]];
KeyValueMap[gate["unchanged saved physical input "<>#1,FileHash[path[#1],"SHA256"]===#2]&,raw["InputHashes"]];
gate["same native input identity",raw["InputHash"]===Hash[
  {raw["SourceHash"],raw["InputHashes"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]];
basis=Get[path["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"]];
base=Import[path["common/s01_inputs.json"],"RawJSON"];
gate["same accepted physical basis",And@@Values[basis["Checks"]]&&
  raw["PhotonLabels"]===basis["PhotonLabels"]&&raw["SpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]];
core=base["channel_contracts"][channel]["amplitude_schema"]==="core";
gate["own real-only normalization contract",!core];
producerText=Import[producerPath,"Text"];
section[start_,finish_] := Module[{begin,end},
  gate["unique producer section "<>start,StringCount[producerText,start]===1];
  begin=First[First[StringPosition[producerText,start]]];
  end=Select[StringPosition[producerText,finish],First[#]>begin&];
  gate["producer section endpoint "<>start,Length[end]>0];
  StringTake[producerText,{begin,First[First[end]]-1}]];
couplingCode=section["couplingSquare=Factor[","\nphaseInput="];
distributionCode=section["distributions={","\nassemble["];
normalizationCode=section["  normalization=If[core,","\n  gate[\"finite physical component\""];
leadingCode=section["leadingResponse=If[core,","\nfiniteResponse="];
gate["unchanged saved-normalization syntax",And@@(SyntaxQ/@
  {couplingCode,distributionCode,normalizationCode,leadingCode})];
ToExpression[couplingCode,InputForm];ToExpression[distributionCode,InputForm];
normalizeSaved[value_] := Block[{branches=value,normalization},ToExpression[normalizationCode,InputForm];branches];
dimensions={Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]],Length[basis["SpinLabels"]],Length[basis["SpinLabels"]]};
indices=Tuples[Range/@dimensions];signs={1,-1,0};
gate["complete physical component inventory",Lookup[raw["Components"],"Index"]===indices&&
  AllTrue[raw["Components"],TrueQ[#["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[#["Checks"]]&]&&
  Keys[raw["NLOResponse"]]===signs&&AllTrue[Values[raw["NLOResponse"]],Keys[#]===distributions&]];
cache=path["cache/s14/"<>channel<>"/"<>IntegerString[raw["InputHash"],16]];
Do[component=raw["Components"][[position]];index=component["Index"];
  candidate=Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[
    label={index,sign,distribution};
    checkpointPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
    relative=StringDrop[checkpointPath,StringLength[root]+1];
    gate["every own finite checkpoint is bound",KeyExistsQ[recovery["files"],relative]];
    saved=Get[checkpointPath];
    gate["accepted own finite checkpoint schema",saved["InputHash"]===raw["InputHash"]&&
      TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["Label"]===label];
    distribution->saved["Finite"],{distribution,distributions}],{sign,signs}];
  candidate=normalizeSaved[candidate];
  gate["entire saved finite component "<>ToString[index,InputForm],candidate===component["Branches"]];
  Do[gate["complete tensor embedding "<>ToString[index,InputForm],
    Extract[raw["NLOResponse"][sign][distribution],index]===candidate[sign][distribution]],
    {sign,signs},{distribution,distributions}];
  Clear[candidate,saved,component];ClearSystemCache[],{position,Length[indices]}];
ToExpression[leadingCode,InputForm];
gate["original own leading response",leadingResponse===raw["LODeltaResponse"]];
hatNames=Keys[raw["FhatsBMHV"]];
config=Import[path["common/s14_inputs.json"],"RawJSON"];
gate["complete original projector inventory",hatNames===Keys[config["channels"][channel]["unpolarized_hats"]]&&
  Length[hatNames]===Length[raw["FhatPhotonWeights"]]];
Do[name=hatNames[[hatIndex]];
  gate[name<>" accepted original Born reference check",TrueQ[raw["Checks"][name<>" original unpolarized Born hat"]]];
  Do[gate[name<>" exact saved Born projector",Sum[raw["FhatPhotonWeights"][[hatIndex,a]]leadingResponse[[a,j,i]],
    {a,dimensions[[1]]}]===raw["FhatsBMHV"][name]["LODelta"][[j,i]]],
    {j,dimensions[[2]]},{i,dimensions[[3]]}];
  Do[gate[name<>" accepted original reference "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm],
      TrueQ[raw["Checks"][name<>" original unpolarized finite hat "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm]]]];
    Do[gate[name<>" exact saved tensor projector "<>ToString[{sign,distribution,j,i},InputForm],
      Sum[raw["FhatPhotonWeights"][[hatIndex,a]]raw["NLOResponse"][sign][distribution][[a,j,i]],
        {a,dimensions[[1]]}]===raw["FhatsBMHV"][name]["NLO"][sign][distribution][[j,i]]],
      {j,dimensions[[2]]},{i,dimensions[[3]]}],{sign,signs},{distribution,distributions}],
  {hatIndex,Length[hatNames]}];
gate["finite reloaded tensor and hats",FreeQ[{raw["NLOResponse"],raw["FhatsBMHV"]},
  eps|D|gs|_Missing|_GLI|_CutIntegral|_PaVe|_Integrate|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|
  _ConditionalExpression|_Piecewise|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
resultPath=path[channel<>"/s14_result/s14_result.wl"];
CopyFile[path[recovery["pending_result"]],resultPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
gate["published bytes equal the completely validated native export",
  IntegerString[FileHash[resultPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===recovery["files"][recovery["pending_result"]]];
Export[path[channel<>"/s14_result/s14_checks.json"],<|"channel"->channel,"checks"->checks,
  "component_count"->Length[indices],"finite_minimal_subtraction_coefficients_computed"->True,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False,"parent_job_id"->parent["job_id"],
  "recovery_source_sha256"->IntegerString[FileHash[recoverySource,"SHA256"],16,64],
  "job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_complete_saved_finite_export"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Keep all S14 equations; compare exact rational charge reconstruction canonically. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
exactChargeSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_exact_charge.wls"}];
exactChargeParent=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_projected_frame.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[exactChargeParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "c5abaf703fb0e4e749ff4ff17d9be0c85e3d84adc405ccd05d893d9e5ab78754"||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[exactChargeSource,"Text"]],Print["FAIL: exact charge source identity"];Quit[1]];
exactChargeProofLoaded=False;
exactChargeZero[value_] := Module[{residual},
  If[!TrueQ[exactChargeProofLoaded],
    exactChargeProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_charge_result","s14_result.wl"}];
    exactChargeReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_charge_result","s14_execution.json"}];
    exactChargeReceipt=Import[exactChargeReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
    gate["accepted own charge comparison receipt",TrueQ[exactChargeReceipt["passed"]]];
    KeyValueMap[gate["bound charge comparison "<>#1,
      IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,exactChargeReceipt["result_sha256"]];
    exactChargeProof=Get[exactChargeProofPath];
    gate["accepted actual failed-expression reconstruction",exactChargeProof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-charge-reconstruction-v1"&&
      exactChargeProof["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[exactChargeProof["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[exactChargeProof["Checks"]]&&
      exactChargeProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&
      exactChargeProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_check_charge_reconstruction.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
      exactChargeProof["RealHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_result","s12_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]&&
      exactChargeProof["ProducerReceiptHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s12_result","s12_execution.json"}],"SHA256"]&&
      Count[Lookup[exactChargeProof["Comparisons"],"OriginalPredicatePassed"],False]>0&&

exactChargePrefix[] := Module[{anchor,replacement,original},
  anchor="gate[\"exact charge decomposition\",Expand[expression-Total[MapThread[Times,{Last/@rows,monomials}]]]===0];";
  replacement="gate[\"exact charge decomposition\",exactChargeZero[expression-Total[MapThread[Times,{Last/@rows,monomials}]]]];";
```

```wolfram
$HistoryLength=0;

projectedLoadReal[relative_] := Module[{original,path,receiptPath,receipt,proof,producerPath,producer,fields},
  original=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];
  gate["projected input is the original channel tensor",relative===channel<>"/s05_result/s05_result.wl"&&FileExistsQ[original]];
  path=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_frame_result","s14_result.wl"}];
  receiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_frame_result","s14_execution.json"}];
  receipt=Import[receiptPath,"RawJSON"];
  gate["accepted exact frame extraction",AssociationQ[receipt]&&TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]];
  KeyValueMap[gate["bound frame extraction result "<>#1,
    IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,receipt["result_sha256"]];
  proof=Get[path];
  gate["accepted native frame record",proof["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-real-frame-projection-v1"&&
    proof["Channel"]===channel&&TrueQ[proof["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[proof["Checks"]]&&
    proof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}];
  gate["unchanged exact projection implementation",proof["SourceHash"]===
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_project_real_frame.wls"}],"SHA256"]&&
    IntegerString[proof["SourceHash"],16,64]===
      "503ef2168287d2e0309c42704de529c395af605a9c8a99111fb59f31deea5cb5"];
  producerPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s05_result","s05_execution.json"}];
  producer=Import[producerPath,"RawJSON"];
  gate["same accepted complete tensor producer",TrueQ[producer["passed"]]&&
    proof["ProducerResultHash"]===FileHash[original,"SHA256"]&&
    proof["ProducerReceiptHash"]===FileHash[producerPath,"SHA256"]&&
    proof["ProducerResultHashes"]===producer["result_sha256"]];
  KeyValueMap[gate["bound original tensor result "<>#1,
    IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,producer["result_sha256"]];
  fields=proof["Projection"];
  gate["complete unchanged finite consumer fields",proof["RetainedKeys"]==={"Channel","Checks","Frame"}&&
    Sort[Keys[fields]]===Sort[proof["RetainedKeys"]]&&fields["Channel"]===channel&&
    AssociationQ[fields["Frame"]]&&And@@Values[fields["Checks"]]];
  AppendTo[inputPaths,original];
  projectedInputEvidence=<|"SourceHash"->FileHash[projectedSource,"SHA256"],
    "ProjectionHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],"ProjectionReceiptHash"->FileHash[receiptPath,"SHA256"],
    "ProducerResultHash"->proof["ProducerResultHash"],"ProducerReceiptHash"->proof["ProducerReceiptHash"],
    "RetainedKeys"->proof["RetainedKeys"],"Evidence"->proof["Evidence"]|>;
  Print["S14_PROJECTED_INPUT ",InputForm[projectedInputEvidence]];fields];
projectedReplaceInput[] := Module[{anchor,replacement,original},
  anchor="spinReal=loadResult[channel<>\"/s05_result/s05_result.wl\"];";
  replacement="spinReal=projectedLoadReal[channel<>\"/s05_result/s05_result.wl\"];";
  If[StringCount[phaseRunPrefix,anchor]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique complete tensor reader"];Quit[1]];
  original=phaseRunPrefix;phaseRunPrefix=StringReplace[phaseRunPrefix,anchor->replacement];

projectedInstallReader[] := Module[{anchor,replacement,original},
  anchor="ToExpression[phaseRunPrefix,InputForm];";

  original=compactAssemblyInitialization;

  If[StringReplace[compactAssemblyInitialization,replacement->anchor]=!=original||!SyntaxQ[compactAssemblyInitialization],
    Print["FAIL: unchanged compact assembly initialization"];Quit[1]]];
projectedRecordEvidence[] := Module[{anchor,replacement,original},
  anchor="compactAssemblyWrite[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
  replacement="AssociateTo[result,\"RealFrameProjection\"->projectedInputEvidence];"<>anchor;
  gate["unique projected assembly evidence boundary",StringCount[phaseRunTail,anchor]===1];
  original=phaseRunTail;phaseRunTail=StringReplace[phaseRunTail,anchor->replacement];
  gate["unchanged finite assembly and export gates",StringReplace[phaseRunTail,replacement->anchor]===original&&SyntaxQ[phaseRunTail]]];
projectedParentText=Import[projectedParent,"Text"];
projectedInsertions={
  "ToExpression[compactAssemblyInitialization,InputForm];"->
    "projectedInstallReader[];ToExpression[compactAssemblyInitialization,InputForm];",
  "\nToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];"->

If[!And@@(StringCount[projectedParentText,First[#]]===1&/@projectedInsertions),
  Print["FAIL: unique original compact assembly entries"];Quit[1]];
projectedRunText=StringReplace[projectedParentText,projectedInsertions];
If[StringReplace[projectedRunText,Reverse/@projectedInsertions]=!=projectedParentText||!SyntaxQ[projectedRunText],

ToExpression[projectedRunText,InputForm];
```

```wolfram
  Do[gate[name<>" original reference comparison was executed "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm],
```

## common/s14_result/reference/s20_final_hats.wl

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-499", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 16852, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s14_result/reference/s20_final_hats.wl", "sha256": "c56f0f20deca9c2100218304eadbfdecb139826c6d36dd2e06bf31b6895a36fa"} -->
```wolfram
(* Assemble the six channels from the new integral evaluations. *)
$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
root=DirectoryName[$InputFileName];
gate[name_,test_] := If[!TrueQ[test],Print["FAIL: ",name];
  If[$KernelID>0,Throw[$Failed,"S20Failure"],CloseKernels[];Quit[1]]];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[$InputFileName,"Text"]]];
put[value_,file_] := (Block[{$ContextPath={"System`","Global`"}},Put[value,file<>".tmp"]];
  RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True]);
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[label<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,gate[label<>" memory limit",False]];
realManifest=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s17_result.wl"}]];
virtualManifest=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s19_result.wl"}]];
gate["accepted new real and virtual tensors",TrueQ[realManifest["AcceptedCutDistributions"]]&&TrueQ[virtualManifest["Accepted"]]];
geometry=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s02_result.wl"}]];
cutGeometry=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"s08_result.wl"}]];
sourceHash=FileHash[$InputFileName,"SHA256"];
physical=Q2>0&&s>w>0&&w-Q2-s<t<-Q2 w/s&&mu>0&&mu2>0&&B>0&&SUNN>1&&Nc>1;
softPhysical=Q2>0&&s>0&&t<0&&Q2+s+t>0&&mu>0&&mu2>0&&B>0&&SUNN>1&&Nc>1;
dimension=4-2eps;
stateNormalization=(2Pi)^D Times@@Table[(2Pi)^(-(D-1)),{momentum,geometry["CutMomenta"]}];
stateNormalization=FullSimplify[stateNormalization/.D->dimension];
angularJacobian=FullSimplify[cutGeometry["RadialPrefactor"]
  (cutGeometry["SphereAreaDefinition"]/.nn->D-1-Length[{theta,phi}]/.D->dimension)];
hardNormalization=(2Pi)^(-Limit[dimension,eps->0]);
couplingSquare=Factor[gs^2/.First[Solve[gs^2==4Pi alphaS,gs]]];
reduce[value_,assumptions_] := Module[{expression,functions},
  expression=Refine[value,assumptions];
  expression=PowerExpand[expression/.Log[arg_]:>Log[Factor[arg]],Assumptions->assumptions];
  functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[expression,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im,Infinity]];
  Collect[Expand[expression],functions,Factor]];
zero[value_,assumptions_] := Module[{expression=reduce[value,assumptions]},
  expression===0||FullSimplify[expression,assumptions]===0];
epsSeries[value_] := Normal[Series[value,{eps,0,0}]];
finitePart[parts_,label_,assumptions_,directory_,hash_] := Module[
  {file,saved,combined,powers,residues,value},
  file=FileNameJoin[{directory,"s20_"<>label<>".wl"}];
  If[FileExistsQ[file],saved=Get[file];If[saved["InputHash"]===hash&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]],Return[saved["Finite"]]]];
  Print["POLE_ASSEMBLY ",label];
  gate[label<>" finite symbolic input parts",
    FreeQ[parts,_Integrate|_Series|_SeriesData|_Limit|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
  combined=Expand[Total[parts],eps];
  powers=Range[Min[Append[Cases[combined,Power[eps,n_Integer]/;n<0:>n,Infinity],0]],-1];
  gate[label<>" is an evaluated Laurent polynomial",PolynomialQ[Expand[eps^(-Min[Append[powers,0]])combined],eps]];
  residues=Association@Table[n->bounded[reduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions],label<>" pole simplification"],{n,powers}];
  put[<|"PoleResiduals"->residues,"InputParts"->parts,"InputHash"->hash,"Accepted"->False|>,file];
  Do[gate[label<>" pole "<>ToString[n],bounded[zero[residues[n],assumptions],label<>" exact pole cancellation"]],{n,powers}];
  value=Coefficient[combined,eps,0];
  gate[label<>" finite evaluated tensor",FreeQ[value,eps|_Integrate|_Series|_SeriesData|_Limit|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
  put[<|"PoleResiduals"->Map[Factor,residues],"Finite"->value,"InputHash"->hash,"Accepted"->True|>,file];value];
boundary[value_,assumptions_] := bounded[reduce[Limit[value,omega->0,
  Direction->"FromAbove",Assumptions->assumptions],assumptions],"common branch boundary"];

coreChannel[channel_] := Catch[Module[
  {channelRoot,real,virtual,born,subtraction,bookkeeping,hashes,hash,directory,sourcePhase,phase,
   tensorKeys,weights,flavorDomain=True,ranges,range,originalCount,canonicalCount,modeKeys,weighted,
   branches,finite,branch,assumptions,parts,result,projectors,leading,hats,middle,limits,commonReal,
   ordinary,virtualPart,virtualBoundary,subtractionPart,mode,sign,distribution,coefficient},
  channelRoot=FileNameJoin[{root,channel}];
  real=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s17_result.wl"}]];
  virtual=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s19_result.wl"}]];
  born=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s01_inputs","s02_result.wl"}]];
  subtraction=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s01_inputs",If[channel==="Hqg","s10_result.wl","s08_result.wl"]}]];
  bookkeeping=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s02_result.wl"}]]["Bookkeeping"];
  gate[channel<>" consistent color and flavor symbol contexts",
    FreeQ[{real,virtual,born,subtraction,bookkeeping},Global`SUNN|Global`Nf]];
  gate[channel<>" new tensor identities",TrueQ[real["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[virtual["Accepted"]]&&
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s17_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]===realManifest["Channels"][channel]["Hash"]&&
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s19_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]===virtualManifest["Channels"][channel]["Hash"]];
  hashes=Association@Table[name->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,name}],"SHA256"],
    {name,{"s17_result.wl","s19_result.wl","s20_phase_input.json","s02_result.wl","s01_inputs/s02_result.wl",
      If[channel==="Hqg","s01_inputs/s10_result.wl","s01_inputs/s08_result.wl"]}}];
  hash=Hash[{sourceHash,hashes},"SHA256"];
  directory=FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_cache",IntegerString[hash,16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
  sourcePhase=ToExpression[Import[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_phase_input.json"}],"RawJSON"]["DefinitionExpression"]];
  phase=mu^(2eps)stateNormalization;
  gate[channel<>" phase normalization matches its source definition",bounded[FullSimplify[
    FunctionExpand[phase angularJacobian-sourcePhase w^-eps],physical&&Element[eps,Reals]],"cut-to-phase normalization"]===0];
  tensorKeys=Keys[real["Real"]];
  If[channel==="Hqq",
    ranges=DeleteDuplicates[#[[2]]& /@Values[bookkeeping["OtherChargeMomentDefinitions"]]];
    gate["one inherited flavor range",Length[ranges]===1];range=First[ranges];
    flavorDomain=Reduce[Element[range[[3]],Integers]&&range[[2]]<=bookkeeping["ObservedFlavor"]<=range[[3]],range[[3]],Integers];
    originalCount=bookkeeping["DistinctFlavorMultiplicity"];
    canonicalCount=If[Head[originalCount]===Piecewise,originalCount[[1,1,1]],originalCount];
    gate["inherited flavor count on its complete domain",Reduce[flavorDomain&&originalCount!=canonicalCount,range[[3]],Integers]===False];
    weights=Map[FullSimplify[#["FlavorWeight"]/.originalCount->canonicalCount,flavorDomain]&,bookkeeping["Components"]]];
  weighted[mode_,sign_,distribution_] := If[channel==="Hqq",
    Total[weights[First[StringSplit[#,"__"]]]real["Real"][#]["Branches"][sign][distribution]& /@
      Select[tensorKeys,Last[StringSplit[#,"__"]]===mode&]],
    real["Real"][mode]["Branches"][sign][distribution]];
  ordinary[mode_] := If[channel==="Hqq",Total[
    weights[First[StringSplit[#,"__"]]]real["Real"][#]["Ordinary"]& /@
      Select[tensorKeys,Last[StringSplit[#,"__"]]===mode&]],real["Real"][mode]["Ordinary"]];
  finite=Association@Table[mode->Association@Table[sign->Association@Table[
    assumptions=(If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->sign omega-s)&&omega>0&&flavorDomain;
    virtualPart=If[distribution==="Delta",2Pi virtual["RenormalizedVirtual"][mode],0]/.virtual["Regulator"]->eps;
    subtractionPart=If[distribution==="L1",0,subtraction["Counterterms"][mode][distribution]]/.
      subtraction["Regulator"]->eps/.s23->w;
    parts={bounded[epsSeries[phase weighted[mode,sign,distribution]],"real phase multiplication"],
      virtualPart/.t->sign omega-s,subtractionPart/.t->sign omega-s};
    distribution->finitePart[parts,StringRiffle[{channel,mode,ToString[sign],distribution},"_"],assumptions,directory,hash],
    {distribution,{"L1","L0","Regular","Delta"}}],{sign,{1,-1}}],{mode,{"Pg","Ppp"}}];
  middle=<||>;
  Do[
    Print["VIRTUAL_BOUNDARY ",channel," ",mode];
    virtualBoundary=boundary[2Pi virtual["RenormalizedVirtual"][mode]/.
      virtual["Regulator"]->eps/.t->omega-s,(softPhysical/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain&&Element[eps,Reals]&&eps!=0];
    gate[channel<>" "<>mode<>" evaluated virtual boundary",
      FreeQ[virtualBoundary,omega|_Limit|_Series|_SeriesData|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
    limits=Association@Table[distribution->Table[boundary[weighted[mode,sign,distribution],
      (softPhysical/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain],{sign,{1,-1}}],{distribution,{"Delta","L0","L1"}}];
    KeyValueMap[gate["real endpoint branches share a common boundary",zero[Subtract@@#2,(softPhysical/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain]]&,limits];
    commonReal=Map[First,limits];
    AssociateTo[commonReal,"Regular"->((ordinary[mode]/.t->-s)-commonReal["L0"]/w-commonReal["L1"]Log[w/B]/w)];
    AssociateTo[middle,mode->Association@Table[
      assumptions=(If[distribution==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->-s)&&flavorDomain;
      virtualPart=If[distribution==="Delta",virtualBoundary,0];
      subtractionPart=If[distribution==="L1",0,subtraction["Counterterms"][mode][distribution]]/.
        subtraction["Regulator"]->eps/.s23->w/.t->-s;
      distribution->finitePart[{epsSeries[phase commonReal[distribution]],virtualPart,subtractionPart},
        StringRiffle[{channel,mode,"0",distribution},"_"],assumptions,directory,hash],
      {distribution,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}]],{mode,{"Pg","Ppp"}}];
  Do[AssociateTo[finite,mode->Join[finite[mode],<|0->middle[mode]|>]],{mode,{"Pg","Ppp"}}];
  projectors=born["ProjectorsEpsilon"]/.eps->0/.born["BornKinematics"];
  leading=Association@Table[item[[1]]->Factor[eq^2 couplingSquare 2Pi hardNormalization
    (item[[2]]/.projectors/.{hg->born["BornPg"],hpp->born["BornPpp"]}/.D->4)],{item,{{"F1",f1},{"F2",f2}}}];
  hats=Association@Table[item[[1]]-><|"LODelta"->leading[item[[1]]],"NLO"->Association@Table[
    sign->Association@Table[distribution->eq^2 couplingSquare^2 hardNormalization
      (item[[2]]/.projectors/.{hg->finite["Pg"][sign][distribution],hpp->finite["Ppp"][sign][distribution]}),
      {distribution,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}],{sign,{1,-1,0}}]|>,{item,{{"F1",f1},{"F2",f2}}}];
  result=<|"Channel"->channel,"Fhats"->hats,"FiniteContractions"->finite,
    "BranchConvention"->"sign=+1/-1 with t=sign omega-s, omega>0; sign=0 means t=-s",
    "PlusDefinition"->real["PlusDefinition"],"PhysicalConditions"->physical,"FlavorDomain"->flavorDomain,
    "Bookkeeping"->KeyTake[bookkeeping,{"Components","OtherChargeMomentDefinitions","TagWeights","ObservedFlavor"}],
    "RealPhase"->phase,"HardNormalization"->hardNormalization,"InputHashes"->hashes,
    "SourceHash"->sourceHash,"PoleCache"->directory,"Accepted"->True|>;
  put[result,FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_result.wl"}]];
  KeyValueMap[put[#2,FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_"<>#1<>"_hat.wl"}]]&,hats];
  Print["FINAL_HATS_ACCEPTED ",channel];<|"Channel"->channel,"Hash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],"Accepted"->True|>],"S20Failure"];

simpleChannel[channel_] := Catch[Module[
  {channelRoot,real,subtraction,generated,fields,options,observed,spectators,weight,
   sourcePhase,phase,hashes,hash,directory,finite,parts,ordinary,poles,projectors,hard,hats,result},
  channelRoot=FileNameJoin[{root,channel}];real=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s17_result.wl"}]];
  subtraction=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s16_result.wl"}]];
  generated=Get[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s01_inputs","s01_result","real.wl"}]];
  gate[channel<>" consistent color and flavor symbol contexts",
    FreeQ[{real,subtraction,generated},Global`SUNN|Global`Nf]];
  gate[channel<>" accepted new tensors and subtraction",TrueQ[real["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[subtraction["AcceptedSubtractionInputs"]]&&
    FileHash[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s17_result.wl"}],"SHA256"]===realManifest["Channels"][channel]["Hash"]];
  hashes=Association@Table[name->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,name}],"SHA256"],
    {name,{"s17_result.wl","s16_result.wl","s20_phase_input.json","s01_inputs/s01_result/real.wl"}}];
  hash=Hash[{sourceHash,hashes},"SHA256"];
  directory=FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_cache",IntegerString[hash,16]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
  fields=Lookup[generated,"outgoing_fields",Missing["ReadGeneratedProcess"]];
  If[MissingQ[fields],options=List@@Head[generated["graphs"]];
    fields=FirstCase[options,HoldPattern[Rule[key_Symbol,process_Rule]]/;SymbolName[key]==="Process":>Last[process],Missing["ProcessFields"]]];
  gate["generated outgoing fields match their momenta",ListQ[fields]&&Length[fields]===Length[generated["outgoing"]]];
  observed=Position[generated["outgoing"],k1];gate["one tagged outgoing momentum",Length[observed]===1];
  spectators=Delete[fields,observed];weight=1/(Times@@(Factorial /@Values[Counts[spectators]]));
  If[KeyExistsQ[generated,"symmetry_weight"],gate["measured spectator weight matches this channel's generated record",weight===generated["symmetry_weight"]]];
  sourcePhase=ToExpression[Import[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_phase_input.json"}],"RawJSON"]["DefinitionExpression"]]/.
    Global`symmetryWeight->weight;
  phase=weight mu2^(2eps) hardNormalization stateNormalization;
  gate[channel<>" phase normalization matches its source definition",bounded[FullSimplify[
    FunctionExpand[phase angularJacobian-sourcePhase/Pi],physical&&Element[eps,Reals]],"real-only phase normalization"]===0];
  Do[Do[gate[channel<>" no endpoint distribution "<>dist,
    bounded[zero[real["Real"][mode]["Branches"][sign][dist],(softPhysical/.t->sign omega-s)&&omega>0],"real-only endpoint cancellation"]],
    {mode,Keys[real["Real"]]},{sign,{1,-1}}],{dist,{"Delta","L0","L1"}}];
  finite=Association@Table[
    ordinary=real["Real"][mode]["Ordinary"];
    parts={bounded[epsSeries[phase ordinary],"real-only phase multiplication"],
      bounded[epsSeries[subtraction["PhaseCT"](subtraction["Convolutions"][mode]/.D->dimension)],"collinear subtraction multiplication"]};
    mode->finitePart[parts,channel<>"_"<>mode<>"_Regular",physical,directory,hash],{mode,Keys[real["Real"]]}];
  hard=finite/.gs->Sqrt[couplingSquare];
  If[channel==="Hgg",hard=hard/.eq^2->chargeSum];
  If[channel==="Hqqbar",hard=hard/.eq^2->eq2];
  projectors=subtraction["Projectors"];
  hats=AssociationThread[{"F1","F2"},({f1,f2}/.projectors/.
    {D->4,xh->Q2/(s+Q2),Hg->hard["g"],Hpp->hard["pp"]})];
  gate[channel<>" finite exact F hats",FreeQ[hats,eps|gs|_GLI|_PaVe|_Integrate|_Series|_Limit|_Real|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity]];
  result=<|"Channel"->channel,"Fhats"->hats,"FiniteContractions"->hard,
    "Delta"->Map[Function[value,0],hats],"L0"->Map[Function[value,0],hats],"L1"->Map[Function[value,0],hats],
    "PhysicalConditions"->physical,"SpectatorFields"->spectators,"SpectatorWeight"->weight,
    "RealPhase"->phase,"InputHashes"->hashes,"SourceHash"->sourceHash,"PoleCache"->directory,"Accepted"->True|>;
  put[result,FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_result.wl"}]];
  KeyValueMap[put[#2,FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_"<>#1<>"_hat.wl"}]]&,hats];
  Print["FINAL_HATS_ACCEPTED ",channel];<|"Channel"->channel,"Hash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{channelRoot,"s20_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],"Accepted"->True|>],"S20Failure"];

slots=Quiet[Check[ToExpression[Environment["NSLOTS"]],1]];
If[!IntegerQ[slots]||slots<1,slots=1];CloseKernels[];
If[slots>1,LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost","KernelCommand"->
  "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel","KernelCount"->Min[4,slots],"TimeConstraint"->60]]];
workers=Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers>0,ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"]];DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,
  reduce,zero,epsSeries,finitePart,boundary,coreChannel,simpleChannel,root,sourceHash,
  realManifest,virtualManifest,physical,softPhysical,dimension,stateNormalization,
  angularJacobian,hardNormalization,couplingSquare]];
$DistributedContexts=None;
channels={"Hgg","Hqqbar","Hqqprime","Hqq","Hqg","Hgq"};
channelTask[channel_] := If[MemberQ[{"Hgg","Hqqbar","Hqqprime"},channel],simpleChannel[channel],coreChannel[channel]];
If[workers>0,DistributeDefinitions[channelTask]];
values=If[workers>0,ParallelMap[channelTask,channels,Method->"FinestGrained"],channelTask /@channels];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all six channel F hats accepted",FreeQ[values,$Failed|$Aborted]&&And@@Lookup[values,"Accepted"]];
put[<|"Channels"->AssociationThread[channels,values],"SourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "Method"->"Reverse unitarity, Kira IBP, SubTropica masters; no Package-X loop values",
  "Accepted"->True|>,FileNameJoin[{root,"s20_result.wl"}]];
Print["S20_SUCCESS: all six channels' symbolic F hats passed their pole gates."];
Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
(* Reuse unchanged integrated pieces after the checked S11 correction. *)
$HistoryLength=0;resumeRoot=Directory[];
resumeSource=FileNameJoin[{resumeRoot,"common","s14_resume_corrected_subtraction.wls"}];
resumePhaseSource=FileNameJoin[{resumeRoot,"common","s14_check_phase_series.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[resumePhaseSource,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
  "cb02337e0b7b4e6734a6d34fe452f90af7fbf29c40a0b6f38e076fad778176ce",Quit[1]];
resumePrefix=First[StringSplit[Import[resumePhaseSource,"Text"],"\nphaseControlLabels="]];
If[!SyntaxQ[resumePrefix]||!SyntaxQ[Import[resumeSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[resumePrefix,InputForm];
gate["corrected subtraction continuation channel",channel==="Hqqprime"&&!core];
resumeResidualPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_reference_residual_result","s14_result.wl"}];
gate["original checkpoint identity source",IntegerString[FileHash[resumeResidualPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "a92ec00fbd123a2c27126eeb077e1086991cec9332753667e5ae30cd0818f28a"];
resumeResidual=Get[resumeResidualPath];
resumeSubtractionRelative=channel<>"/s11_result/s11_result.wl";
gate["only subtraction input changed",KeyDrop[inputHashes,resumeSubtractionRelative]===
  KeyDrop[resumeResidual["InputHashes"],resumeSubtractionRelative]&&sourceHash===resumeResidual["BaselineSourceHash"]];
resumePreviousPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_result","reference","before_dimensional_completion","s11_result.wl"}];
gate["exact preceding subtraction",FileHash[resumePreviousPath,"SHA256"]===
  resumeResidual["InputHashes"][resumeSubtractionRelative]&&
  subtraction["PreviousSubtractionHash"]===FileHash[resumePreviousPath,"SHA256"]];
resumePrevious=Get[resumePreviousPath];
resumeCompletionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s11_dimensional_result","s11_result.wl"}];
gate["accepted completion proof identity",IntegerString[FileHash[resumeCompletionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "3c76ab221bf3c99ba7c35223b26ca10ec527596dc2f60307d5cc7e508dbc411c"&&
  subtraction["DimensionalCompletionValidationHash"]===FileHash[resumeCompletionPath,"SHA256"]];
resumeCompletion=Get[resumeCompletionPath];
gate["executed complete finite correction",TrueQ[resumeCompletion["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[resumeCompletion["Checks"]]];
resumeDifferences=Association@Table[distribution->If[distribution==="L1",
  ConstantArray[0,Dimensions[subtraction["Counterterms"]["Regular"]]],
  Map[Factor,subtraction["Counterterms"][distribution]-resumePrevious["Counterterms"][distribution],{3}]],
  {distribution,distributions}];
gate["every counterterm difference is finite",FreeQ[resumeDifferences,eps|D|_Missing|_Series|_SeriesData|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
gate["correction equals complete executed spin comparison",And@@
  (Factor[Together[#]]===0&/@Flatten[resumeDifferences["Regular"]-resumeCompletion["CountertermCorrection"]])];
resumeOldHash=resumeResidual["InputHash"];
resumeOldCache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s14_before_dimensional",channel,IntegerString[resumeOldHash,16]}];
gate["prior finite values isolated from current cache",DirectoryQ[resumeOldCache]&&resumeOldCache=!=cache];
resumeFile[directory_,label_] := FileNameJoin[{directory,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];
resumeAssumptions[label_] := (If[Last[label]==="Regular",physical,softPhysical]/.t->label[[2]]omega-s)&&
  If[label[[2]]===0,True,omega>0]&&flavorDomain;
resumeOld[label_] := Module[{path,saved},path=resumeFile[resumeOldCache,label];
  gate["old component checkpoint exists",FileExistsQ[path]];saved=Get[path];
  gate["old component input label and pole acceptance",saved["InputHash"]===resumeOldHash&&
    saved["Label"]===label&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]];
  gate["old component poles exactly zero",And@@(bounded[zero[#,resumeAssumptions[label]],
    {label,"prior pole verification"}]&/@Values[saved["PoleResiduals"]])];saved];
resumeValue[label_,saved_] := saved["Finite"]+
  (Extract[resumeDifferences[Last[label]],First[label]]/.t->label[[2]]omega-s);
resumeControlLabels={{{1,1,1},1,"Regular"},{{1,4,4},-1,"Regular"},{{3,4,4},-1,"Regular"}};
resumeControls=Table[
  saved=resumeOld[label];index=First[label];sign=label[[2]];distribution=Last[label];
  assumptions=resumeAssumptions[label];Print["CORRECTED_ASSEMBLY_CONTROL ",label];
  timing=AbsoluteTiming[finitePart[{phaseProduct[strongFactor realBranch[index,sign,distribution],phase,0,label],
    subtractionValue[index,distribution]/.t->sign omega-s},label,assumptions]];
  gate["fresh corrected assembly equals transferred finite value",bounded[
    zero[timing[[2]]-resumeValue[label,saved],assumptions],{label,"corrected assembly comparison"}]];
  <|"Label"->label,"Seconds"->timing[[1]],"CurrentCheckpointHash"->FileHash[resumeFile[cache,label],"SHA256"]|>,
  {label,resumeControlLabels}];
resumeAssemblyText=Import[sourcePath,"Text"];
resumeIndexDefinition=StringCases[resumeAssemblyText,RegularExpression["(?m)^indices=Tuples[^\\n]+;"]];
gate["unique original index inventory",Length[resumeIndexDefinition]===1];
ToExpression[First[resumeIndexDefinition],InputForm];
resumeLabels=Flatten[Table[{index,sign,distribution},{index,indices},{sign,{1,-1,0}},{distribution,distributions}],2];
resumeRows=Table[
  saved=resumeOld[label];value=resumeValue[label,saved];
  gate["corrected checkpoint is finite",FreeQ[value,eps|_Missing|_Series|_SeriesData|_Integrate|_Limit|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
  path=resumeFile[cache,label];oldPath=resumeFile[resumeOldCache,label];
  If[FileExistsQ[path],current=Get[path];
    gate["existing corrected checkpoint identity",current["InputHash"]===inputHash&&current["Label"]===label&&TrueQ[current["Accepted"]]];
    gate["existing corrected checkpoint value",bounded[zero[current["Finite"]-value,resumeAssumptions[label]],label]],
    put[<|"Label"->label,"InputHash"->inputHash,"Accepted"->True,"Finite"->value,
      "PoleResiduals"->saved["PoleResiduals"],"PreviousCheckpointHash"->FileHash[oldPath,"SHA256"],
      "SubtractionCompletionHash"->FileHash[resumeCompletionPath,"SHA256"]|>,path]];
  <|"Label"->label,"PreviousHash"->FileHash[oldPath,"SHA256"],"CurrentHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"]|>,
  {label,resumeLabels}];
SetAttributes[finitePart,HoldFirst];
resumeProbeLabel=First[resumeControlLabels];resumeTouched=False;
resumeProbe=finitePart[(resumeTouched=True;$Failed),resumeProbeLabel,resumeAssumptions[resumeProbeLabel]];
gate["validated cached parts are read before recomputation",!resumeTouched&&
  resumeProbe===Get[resumeFile[cache,resumeProbeLabel]]["Finite"]];
resumeProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-corrected-subtraction-resume-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[resumeSource,"SHA256"],"BaselineSourceHash"->sourceHash,
  "PreviousInputHash"->resumeOldHash,"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
  "PreviousSubtractionHash"->FileHash[resumePreviousPath,"SHA256"],
  "CompletionHash"->FileHash[resumeCompletionPath,"SHA256"],"Controls"->resumeControls,"CheckpointRows"->resumeRows,
  "Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
resumeDirectory=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_resume_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resumeDirectory],CreateDirectory[resumeDirectory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
resumeProofPath=FileNameJoin[{resumeDirectory,"s14_result.wl"}];put[resumeProof,resumeProofPath];
gate["exact corrected resume record reload",Get[resumeProofPath]===resumeProof];
Print["CORRECTED_SUBTRACTION_CHECKPOINTS_ACCEPTED ",Length[resumeRows]];
resumeTail="indices=Tuples"<>Last[StringSplit[resumeAssemblyText,"\nindices=Tuples"]];
resumeExport="put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
gate["unique original export",StringCount[resumeTail,resumeExport]===1];
resumeTail=StringReplace[resumeTail,resumeExport->
  "AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[resumeSource,\"SHA256\"],\"SubtractionResumeHash\"->FileHash[resumeProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];"<>resumeExport];
gate["unchanged final assembly tail syntax",SyntaxQ[resumeTail]];
ToExpression[resumeTail,InputForm];
```

```wolfram
(* Validate the native output completed before the scheduler killed its supervisor. *)
$HistoryLength=0;root=Directory[];checks=<||>;
sourcePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_verify_completed_assembly.wls"}];
gate[name_,test_] := If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation",StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,"login"]];
gate["isolated runtime",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>"/"]];
PrependTo[$Path,"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax",SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath,"Text"]]];
channel=Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];gate["completed assembly channel",channel==="Hqqprime"];
path=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_result","s14_result.wl"}];
gate["exact completed native assembly",IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===
  "531cb108c8933cc8351693f2b6a3d831d5e212b66244f3d4c1d6d2df1fd94e75"];
raw=Get[path];
gate["complete accepted native schema",AssociationQ[raw]&&raw["Channel"]===channel&&
  raw["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-finite-bmhv-response-v1"&&And@@Values[raw["Checks"]]&&
  TrueQ[raw["CompletePoleCancellationChecked"]]&&TrueQ[raw["UnpolarizedFinalReferenceComparisonPassed"]]&&
  TrueQ[raw["FiniteMinimalSubtractionCoefficientsComputed"]]];
gate["original assembly source",raw["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
gate["executed dispatch source",raw["DispatchSourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_resume_corrected_subtraction.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
Do[gate["unchanged input "<>name,FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,name}],"SHA256"]===raw["InputHashes"][name]],
  {name,Keys[raw["InputHashes"]]}];
gate["complete native input identity",raw["InputHash"]===Hash[{raw["SourceHash"],raw["InputHashes"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]];
proofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_resume_result","s14_result.wl"}];proof=Get[proofPath];
gate["complete executed subtraction continuation",raw["SubtractionResumeHash"]===FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"]&&
  proof["InputHash"]===raw["InputHash"]&&And@@Values[proof["Checks"]]];
basis=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s02_result","s02_result.wl"}]];
gate["same accepted physical basis",And@@Values[basis["Checks"]]&&raw["PhotonLabels"]===basis["PhotonLabels"]&&raw["SpinLabels"]===basis["SpinLabels"]];
dims=Length/@{basis["PhotonLabels"],basis["SpinLabels"],basis["SpinLabels"]};
indices=Tuples[Range/@dims];components=raw["Components"];
gate["complete component inventory",Lookup[components,"Index"]===indices&&And@@Lookup[components,"Accepted"]&&
  And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@components]];
distributions={"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"};
Do[gate["component response reconstruction "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm],
  ArrayReshape[#["Branches"][sign][distribution]&/@components,dims]===raw["NLOResponse"][sign][distribution]],
  {sign,{1,-1,0}},{distribution,distributions}];
Do[name=Keys[raw["FhatsBMHV"]][[h]];
  gate[name<>" Born reference comparison was executed",TrueQ[raw["Checks"][name<>" original unpolarized Born hat"]]];
  Do[gate[name<>" original reference comparison was executed "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm],
      TrueQ[raw["Checks"][name<>" original unpolarized finite hat "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm]]]];
    projected=Table[Sum[raw["FhatPhotonWeights"][[h,a]]raw["NLOResponse"][sign][distribution][[a,j,i]],
      {a,dims[[1]]}],{j,dims[[2]]},{i,dims[[3]]}];
    gate[name<>" saved projection reconstruction "<>ToString[{sign,distribution},InputForm],
      projected===raw["FhatsBMHV"][name]["NLO"][sign][distribution]],
    {sign,{1,-1,0}},{distribution,distributions}],{h,Length[raw["FhatsBMHV"]]}];
gate["entire export finite",FreeQ[{raw["NLOResponse"],raw["FhatsBMHV"]},eps|D|gs|_Missing|_GLI|_CutIntegral|_PaVe|_Integrate|_Series|_SeriesData|_Limit|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|Indeterminate|_DirectedInfinity]];
assemblyText=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}],"Text"];
zeroStart=First[First[StringPosition[assemblyText,"reduce[value_,assumptions_]"]]];
zeroEnd=First[First[StringPosition[assemblyText,"epsSeries[value_]"]]];
zeroCode=StringTake[assemblyText,{zeroStart,zeroEnd-1}];
softCode=StringCases[assemblyText,RegularExpression["(?m)^softPhysical=[^\\n]+;"]];
gate["unique original domain and zero predicate",Length[softCode]===1&&SyntaxQ[zeroCode]&&SyntaxQ[First[softCode]]];
ToExpression[zeroCode,InputForm];ToExpression[First[softCode],InputForm];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,
  gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" memory limit",False]];
checkpointAssumptions[label_] := (If[Last[label]==="Regular",raw["PhysicalConditions"],softPhysical]/.t->label[[2]]omega-s)&&
  If[label[[2]]===0,True,omega>0]&&raw["FlavorDomain"];
cache=FileNameJoin[{root,"cache","s14",channel,IntegerString[raw["InputHash"],16]}];
labels=Flatten[Table[{index,sign,distribution},{index,indices},{sign,{1,-1,0}},{distribution,distributions}],2];
gate["complete continuation checkpoint inventory",Lookup[proof["CheckpointRows"],"Label"]===labels];
Do[file=FileNameJoin[{cache,"finite_"<>IntegerString[Hash[label,"SHA256"],16]<>".wl"}];saved=Get[file];
  If[!(AssociationQ[saved]&&saved["InputHash"]===raw["InputHash"]&&saved["Label"]===label&&TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&
    FileHash[file,"SHA256"]===proof["CheckpointRows"][[n]]["CurrentHash"]&&
    And@@(bounded[zero[#,checkpointAssumptions[label]],{label,"original pole predicate"}]&/@Values[saved["PoleResiduals"]])),gate["checkpoint "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],
  {n,Length[labels]},{label,{labels[[n]]}}];
gate["all executed pole checkpoints verified",True];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-completed-assembly-validation-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[sourcePath,"SHA256"],"ResultHash"->FileHash[path,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->raw["InputHash"],
  "Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
out=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s14_recovery_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
Put[result,FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_result.wl"}]];
gate["validation output reload",Get[FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_result.wl"}]]===result];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s14_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"job_id"->Environment["JOB_ID"]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s14_verify_completed_assembly"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
  First[First[StringPosition[gluonCompactText,gluonFinalEntry]]]-1];

gluonFinalReplacements={
  "subtraction = readInput[channel <> \"/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];"->

  "subtractionSource = FileNameJoin[{root, \"common\", If[core,\n  \"s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls\", \"s11_small_collinear_spin.wls\"]}];"->
    "subtractionSource = FileNameJoin[{root,\"common\",\"s11_Hgg_native_routes.wls\"}];",
  "schemeDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s15_scheme_result\"}];"->
    "previousScheme=readInput[channel<>\"/s15_scheme_result/reference/before_dimensional_completion/s15_result.wl\"];gate[\"same previously accepted helicity conversion\",And@@Values[previousScheme[\"Checks\"]]&&previousScheme[\"SelectedRoutes\"]===scheme[\"SelectedRoutes\"]&&zeroArray[previousScheme[\"RegularCorrection\"]-scheme[\"RegularCorrection\"]]];schemeDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s15_native_scheme_result\"}];",
  "gate[\"same final photon and spin basis\","->
    "finalAssemblyReceipt=readInput[channel<>\"/s14_result/s14_execution.json\"];gate[\"bound accepted updated finite assembly\",TrueQ[finalAssemblyReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&finalAssemblyReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][channel<>\"/s14_result/s14_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[rawPath,\"SHA256\"],16,64]&&raw[\"SubtractionResultHash\"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"]&&TrueQ[raw[\"UnpolarizedFinalReferenceComparisonPassed\"]]];gate[\"same final photon and spin basis\",",
  "result = Join["->
    "inputHashes=Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,\"SHA256\"])&/@DeleteDuplicates[inputPaths]];result = Join[",
  "AssociateTo[result,\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[compactFinalSource,\"SHA256\"]];"->
    "AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[gluonFinalSource,\"SHA256\"],\"StorageSourceHash\"->FileHash[compactFinalSource,\"SHA256\"],\"SubtractionResultHash\"->raw[\"SubtractionResultHash\"],\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"->True}];"};
If[!And@@(StringCount[compactFinalCode,First[#]]===1&/@gluonFinalReplacements),

If[StringReplace[gluonFinalCode,Reverse/@gluonFinalReplacements]=!=compactFinalCode||
```

<a id="source-505"></a>

## common/s15_finalize_spin_coefficients.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-505", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 13195, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s15_finalize_spin_coefficients.wls", "sha256": "54838cdee6222b75e578a242a940bdb79bd1517d41e098cbd9ca18fd369463f8"} -->
```wolfram
(* Conventional helicity-scheme conversion and final partonic export. *)
$HistoryLength = 0; root = Directory[]; channel = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s15_finalize_spin_coefficients.wls"}]; checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
gate["isolated runtime", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> "/"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  gate[ToString[label, InputForm] <> " time limit", False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate[ToString[label, InputForm] <> " memory limit", False]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"]; RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
zeroArray[value_] := And @@ (zero /@ Flatten[{value}]);
inputPaths = {};
readInput[relative_] := Module[{path = FileNameJoin[{root, relative}]},
  gate["required input " <> relative, FileExistsQ[path]]; AppendTo[inputPaths, path];
  If[StringEndsQ[path, ".json"], Import[path, "RawJSON"], Get[path]]];
config = readInput["common/s15_inputs.json"];
gate["explicit helicity scheme definition", config["schema"] === "polarized-sidis-helicity-scheme-definition-v1"];
Do[path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["destination"]}];
  gate["pinned scheme reference " <> row["destination"], IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]];
  AppendTo[inputPaths, path], {row, config["files"]}];
base = readInput["common/s01_inputs.json"];
gate["known channel", KeyExistsQ[base["channel_contracts"], channel]];
core = base["channel_contracts"][channel]["amplitude_schema"] === "core";
basis = readInput["common/s02_result/s02_result.wl"];
kernels = readInput["common/s10_result/s10_result.wl"];
subtraction = readInput[channel <> "/s11_result/s11_result.wl"];
gate["accepted basis kernels and subtraction", And @@ Values[basis["Checks"]] &&
  And @@ Values[kernels["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[subtraction["Checks"]]];
gate["accepted channel subtraction schema", subtraction["Channel"] === channel &&
  subtraction["Schema"] === If[core, "polarized-sidis-collinear-convolutions-v1", "polarized-sidis-small-collinear-convolutions-v1"]];
subtractionSource = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", If[core,
  "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls", "s11_small_collinear_spin.wls"]}];
gate["accepted subtraction source binding", subtraction["SourceHash"] === FileHash[subtractionSource, "SHA256"]];
AppendTo[inputPaths, subtractionSource];
gate["unconverted BMHV subtraction", subtraction["Gamma5Scheme"] === "BMHV" &&
  subtraction["FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied"] === False];
labels = basis["SpinLabels"];
gate["same physical basis", kernels["SpinLabels"] === labels && subtraction["SpinLabels"] === labels &&
  subtraction["PhotonLabels"] === basis["PhotonLabels"]];
uPosition = First[FirstPosition[labels, "U"]]; hPosition = First[FirstPosition[labels, "H"]];
colorRelative = base["channel_contracts"]["Hqq"]["unpolarized_born_file"];
color = readInput[colorRelative];
gate["pinned color normalization", IntegerString[FileHash[Last[inputPaths], "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
  SelectFirst[base["files"], #["destination"] === colorRelative &]["sha256"]];
colorCF = color["ColorConstants"]["CF"];
qqDefinition = ToExpression[config["definitions"]["qq_regular"]];
epsilonDifference = ToExpression[config["definitions"]["epsilon_difference"]];
schemeKernel = ToExpression[config["definitions"]["scheme_kernel"]];
physicalPrefactor = ToExpression[config["definitions"]["physical_convolution_prefactor"]];
couplingSquare = Factor[gs^2 /. First[Solve[ToExpression[config["definitions"]["coupling_relation"]], gs]]];
gate["scheme kernel restores the defined epsilon difference", zero[Limit[epsilonDifference/eps, eps -> 0] + schemeKernel]];
standaloneText = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s15_result", "reference", "s54_factorization_contract.wls"}], "Text"];
gate["inherited hard-counterterm sign", StringContainsQ[standaloneText,
  "hvbmHardCountertermTuple = -hvbmSchemeKernelTuple;"]];
kernelRatio = Factor[kernels["Responses"]["qq"]["RealKernel"][[uPosition, uPosition]]/qqDefinition];
gate["derived constant reference kernel normalization", FreeQ[kernelRatio, z | eps | _Missing | _Real] && kernelRatio =!= 0];
hardKernel = Factor[-kernelRatio schemeKernel];
gate["regular endpoint-vanishing finite kernel", FreeQ[hardKernel, _kernelPlus | _kernelDelta | eps] && Limit[hardKernel, z -> 1] === 0];
dimensions = {Length[basis["PhotonLabels"]], Length[labels], Length[labels]};
regular = ConstantArray[0, dimensions]; routeResults = <||>;
physical = Q > 0 && s > s23 > 0 && s23 - Q^2 - s < t < -Q^2 s23/s && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
endpointRegion = Q > 0 && s > 0 && -Q^2 - s < t < 0 && B > 0 && SUNN > 1;
simplify[value_] := FullSimplify[value, Assumptions -> physical];
selectedRoutes = Select[subtraction["Routes"], MemberQ[{"qq", "aqaq"}, #[If[core, "KernelKey", "Kernel"]]] &];
If[core,
  gate["inherited subtraction prefactor", subtraction["Prefactor"] === kernels["ReferenceSubtractionPrefactor"]];
  originalAssembly = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s14_result", "reference", "s20_final_hats.wl"}], "Text"];
  gate["inherited Born delta normalization", StringContainsQ[originalAssembly, "eq^2 couplingSquare 2Pi hardNormalization"]];
  hardNormalization = ToExpression[First[StringSplit[subtraction["HardTensorNormalization"], " applied at final assembly"]]];
  leadingNormalization = eq^2 couplingSquare 2Pi hardNormalization;
  nextNormalization = eq^2 couplingSquare^2 hardNormalization;
  gate["reference prefactor matches physical convolution convention", zero[
    nextNormalization subtraction["Prefactor"] kernelRatio - leadingNormalization physicalPrefactor]];
  convolutionText = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s11_collinear_spin_convolutions.wls"}], "Text"];
  begin = First[First[StringPosition[convolutionText, "endpointBranchComparisons = {};"]]];
  finish = First[First[Select[StringPosition[convolutionText, "distributions = {"], First[#] > begin &]]];
  convolutionCode = StringTake[convolutionText, {begin, finish - 1}]; ToExpression[convolutionCode];
  roots = <|"PDF" -> subtraction["IncomingRoot"], "FF" -> subtraction["OutgoingRoot"]|>;
  weights = <|"PDF" -> subtraction["IncomingJacobian"]/roots["PDF"],
    "FF" -> subtraction["OutgoingJacobian"]/roots["FF"]^2|>;
  kernelMatrix = Normal[SparseArray[{{hPosition, hPosition} -> hardKernel}, {Length[labels], Length[labels]}]];
  Do[key = route["BornChannel"]; side = route["Side"]; name = route["ReferenceName"];
    born = readInput[key <> "/s03_result/s03_result.wl"];
    gate[name <> " accepted Born", born["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-born-response-v2" &&
      born["Channel"] === key && And @@ Values[born["Checks"]]];
    bornResponse = born["ResponseD4"];
    mappedResponse = bounded[simplify[bornResponse /. subtraction["ScaledInvariantRules"][side]], name <> " mapped Born"];
    pieces = Table[terms = Table[
      kernel = If[side === "PDF", kernelMatrix[[k, i]], kernelMatrix[[j, k]]] /. z -> x;
      endpoint = If[side === "PDF", bornResponse[[a, j, k]], bornResponse[[a, k, i]]];
      mapped = If[side === "PDF", mappedResponse[[a, j, k]], mappedResponse[[a, k, i]]];
      If[kernel === 0 || (endpoint === 0 && mapped === 0), <|"Delta" -> 0, "L0" -> 0, "Regular" -> 0|>,
        bounded[convolution[endpoint, kernel, roots[side], simplify[weights[side] mapped]], {name, a, j, i, k}]],
      {k, Length[labels]}]; Merge[terms, Factor[Total[#]] &],
      {a, dimensions[[1]]}, {j, dimensions[[2]]}, {i, dimensions[[3]]}];
    gate[name <> " no finite endpoint distributions", zeroArray[Map[Lookup[#, {"Delta", "L0"}] &, pieces, {3}]]];
    value = Map[#["Regular"] &, pieces, {3}];
    gate[name <> " only the selected helicity leg changes", zeroArray[If[side === "PDF",
      value[[All, All, DeleteCases[Range[Length[labels]], hPosition]]],
      value[[All, DeleteCases[Range[Length[labels]], hPosition], All]]]]];
    AssociateTo[routeResults, name -> (nextNormalization subtraction["Prefactor"] value)], {route, selectedRoutes}];
  If[routeResults =!= <||>, regular = Map[Factor, Total[Values[routeResults]], {3}]],
  gate["no diagonal quark scheme route in the real-only channel", selectedRoutes === {}]];
gate["exact finite scheme tensor", FreeQ[regular, eps | D | gs | _Pair | _Missing | _Integrate | _Limit |
  _Series | _SeriesData | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
gate["unpolarized coefficient preserved", zeroArray[regular[[All, uPosition, uPosition]]]];
sourceHash = FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"];
inputHashes = Association[(StringDrop[#, StringLength[root] + 1] -> FileHash[#, "SHA256"]) & /@ DeleteDuplicates[inputPaths]];
scheme = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-finite-helicity-conversion-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "PhotonLabels" -> basis["PhotonLabels"], "SpinLabels" -> labels, "RegularCorrection" -> regular,
  "RouteCorrections" -> routeResults, "SelectedRoutes" -> selectedRoutes, "KernelNormalizationRatio" -> kernelRatio,
  "SchemeKernelDefinition" -> schemeKernel, "HardKernelInReferenceConvention" -> hardKernel,
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
schemeDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s15_scheme_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[schemeDirectory], CreateDirectory[schemeDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
schemePath = FileNameJoin[{schemeDirectory, "s15_result.wl"}]; put[scheme, schemePath];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_SCHEME_ONLY"] === "1",
  Export[FileNameJoin[{schemeDirectory, "s15_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
    "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s15_helicity_scheme"]; Quit[0]];
rawPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s14_result", "s14_result.wl"}]; raw = Get[rawPath];
gate["accepted componentwise finite BMHV tensor", raw["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-finite-bmhv-response-v1" &&
  raw["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[raw["Checks"]] && TrueQ[raw["CompletePoleCancellationChecked"]] &&
  TrueQ[raw["FiniteMinimalSubtractionCoefficientsComputed"]] && raw["FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied"] === False];
gate["same final photon and spin basis", raw["PhotonLabels"] === scheme["PhotonLabels"] && raw["SpinLabels"] === labels];
response = Association@Table[sign -> Association@Table[distribution ->
  (raw["NLOResponse"][sign][distribution] + If[distribution === "Regular", regular /. t -> sign omega - s, 0]),
  {distribution, {"Delta", "L0", "L1", "Regular"}}], {sign, {1, -1, 0}}];
hatNames = Keys[raw["FhatsBMHV"]];
hats = AssociationThread[hatNames, Table[With[{name = hatNames[[index]]}, <|"LODelta" -> raw["FhatsBMHV"][name]["LODelta"],
  "NLO" -> Association@Table[sign -> Association@Table[distribution -> Table[
    Sum[(raw["FhatPhotonWeights"][[index, a]] /. t -> sign omega - s) response[sign][distribution][[a, j, i]],
      {a, dimensions[[1]]}], {j, dimensions[[2]]}, {i, dimensions[[3]]}],
    {distribution, {"Delta", "L0", "L1", "Regular"}}], {sign, {1, -1, 0}}]|>],
  {index, Length[hatNames]}]];
gate["complete finite partonic export", FreeQ[{response, hats}, eps | D | gs | _Missing | _GLI | _CutIntegral |
  _PaVe | _Integrate | _Limit | _Series | _SeriesData | _ConditionalExpression | _Piecewise | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
result = Join[KeyTake[raw, {"Channel", "PhotonLabels", "SpinLabels", "IndexOrder", "LODeltaResponse", "PhysicalFrame",
    "FhatPhotonWeights", "ProjectorDefinitions", "Bookkeeping", "PlusDefinition", "BranchConvention", "PhysicalConditions", "FlavorDomain"}],
  <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-finite-partonic-coefficients-v1", "NLOResponse" -> response, "Fhats" -> hats,
    "Gamma5Scheme" -> "BMHV with finite helicity restoration", "FactorizationScheme" -> config["scheme"],
    "FiniteAxialSchemeConversionApplied" -> True, "CompletePoleCancellationChecked" -> True,
    "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> True, "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "BMHVResultHash" -> FileHash[rawPath, "SHA256"],
    "SchemeResultHash" -> FileHash[schemePath, "SHA256"], "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "Checks" -> checks|>];
resultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s15_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDirectory], CreateDirectory[resultDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
put[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s15_result.wl"}]];
KeyValueMap[put[#2, FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s15_" <> #1 <> "_hat.wl"}]] &, hats];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDirectory, "s15_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> True, "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: s15_finalize_spin_coefficients"]; Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
  "54838cdee6222b75e578a242a940bdb79bd1517d41e098cbd9ca18fd369463f8",Quit[1]];
```
