## common/s15_result/reference/s54_factorization_contract.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-508", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 21017, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s15_result/reference/s54_factorization_contract.wls", "sha256": "21fc30cc2cfd4386457dc7ab7ce1b1d22b4456460e4c0bbdc86dfbb446c23f6c"} -->
```wolfram
#!/usr/bin/env wolframscript

(*
  Independent polarized q -> q pole/factorization contract.

  This regression consumes only the reviewed internal real and virtual
  artifacts, the project Born normalization, and universal factorization
  conventions.  It does not read a published coefficient function.  The
  virtual coefficients are extracted from the reviewed Kira/SubTropica
  physical assembly and its separately frozen external-leg UV/IR ledger.
*)

ClearAll["Global`*"];

fail[msg_] := (
  Print["Polarized q->q factorization pole contract: FAIL: " <>
    ToString[msg, InputForm]];
  Exit[1]
);
env[name_] := Module[{value = Environment[name]},
  If[!StringQ[value] || StringLength[value] == 0,
    fail["missing environment variable " <> name]
  ];
  ExpandFileName[value]
];
sha256[file_] := IntegerString[FileHash[file, "SHA256"], 16, 64];
exactHeld[file_, label_] := Module[{held = Check[Get[file], $Failed]},
  If[Head[held] =!= HoldComplete || !FreeQ[held, _Real] ||
     !FreeQ[held, _Total], fail[label <> " is not an exact frozen object"]];
  ReleaseHold[held]
];
readManifest[file_, contract_: None] := Module[
  {value = Check[Import[file, "RawJSON"], $Failed]},
  If[!AssociationQ[value] || Lookup[value, "passed", False] =!= True,
    fail["manifest did not pass: " <> file]
  ];
  If[contract =!= None && Lookup[value, "contract", ""] =!= contract,
    fail["manifest contract changed: " <> file]
  ];
  value
];
sameQ[actual_, expected_, label_] := Module[
  {difference = physicalReduce[actual - expected]},
  If[!(TrueQ[difference === 0] ||
       (ListQ[difference] && And @@ (TrueQ[# === 0] & /@ Flatten[difference]))),
    fail[label <> ": " <> ToString[difference, InputForm]]
  ]
];

scriptFile = ExpandFileName[$InputFileName];
buildRoot = env["NLO_EQA_BUILD_ROOT"];
sourceRoot = env["NLO_EQA_SOURCE_ROOT"];
physicalRoot = FileNameJoin[{buildRoot, "kira_bundle", "assembled", "physical"}];
normalizationRoot = FileNameJoin[{buildRoot, "physical_real_pole_normalization"}];
realDistributionRoot = FileNameJoin[{buildRoot, "real_distributions"}];
virtualPhysicalRoot = FileNameJoin[{buildRoot, "virtual_kira_bundle", "assembled", "physical"}];
outputRoot = FileNameJoin[{buildRoot, "factorization_pole_contract"}];

physicalManifestFile = FileNameJoin[{physicalRoot, "manifest.json"}];
physicalPoleFile = FileNameJoin[{physicalRoot,
  "polarized_real_fixed_interior_pole.wl"}];
physicalFiniteFile = FileNameJoin[{physicalRoot,
  "polarized_real_fixed_interior_finite.wl"}];
normalizationManifestFile = FileNameJoin[{normalizationRoot, "manifest.json"}];
normalizationOuterFile = FileNameJoin[{normalizationRoot,
  "paper_outer_vw_coefficient.wl"}];
realDistributionManifestFile = FileNameJoin[{realDistributionRoot,
  "manifest.json"}];
realDoubleDeltaFile = FileNameJoin[{realDistributionRoot,
  "real_double_delta.wl"}];
realPoleRegularFile = FileNameJoin[{realDistributionRoot,
  "real_pole_regular.wl"}];
realPoleD0File = FileNameJoin[{realDistributionRoot, "real_pole_D0.wl"}];
realPoleDeltaFile = FileNameJoin[{realDistributionRoot,
  "real_pole_delta.wl"}];
realDistributionGeneratorFile = FileNameJoin[{sourceRoot, "mathematica", "50_distribute_real_poles.wls"}];
virtualReviewFile = FileNameJoin[{buildRoot, "feyncalc_virtual_reviewed.json"}];
virtualKiraManifestFile = FileNameJoin[{buildRoot, "virtual_kira_bundle", "assembled", "manifest.json"}];
virtualPhysicalManifestFile = FileNameJoin[{virtualPhysicalRoot,
  "manifest.json"}];
virtualDeltaFile = FileNameJoin[{virtualPhysicalRoot,
  "paper_normalized_virtual_delta.wl"}];
virtualExternalLedgerFile = FileNameJoin[{virtualPhysicalRoot,
  "external_self_energy_uv_ir_ledger.wl"}];
bornSourceFile = FileNameJoin[{sourceRoot, "mathematica", "13_born_hvbm.wl"}];
virtualSourceFile = FileNameJoin[{sourceRoot, "mathematica", "14_virtual_hvbm.wl"}];
countertermSourceFile = FileNameJoin[{sourceRoot, "mathematica", "17_real_counterterms.wl"}];
universalVirtualSourceFile = FileNameJoin[{sourceRoot, "mathematica", "18_virtual_qcd.wl"}];

requiredFiles = {physicalManifestFile, physicalPoleFile, physicalFiniteFile,
  normalizationManifestFile, normalizationOuterFile,
  realDistributionManifestFile, realDoubleDeltaFile, realPoleRegularFile,
  realPoleD0File, realPoleDeltaFile, realDistributionGeneratorFile,
  virtualReviewFile,
  virtualKiraManifestFile, virtualPhysicalManifestFile, virtualDeltaFile,
  virtualExternalLedgerFile, bornSourceFile, virtualSourceFile,
  countertermSourceFile, universalVirtualSourceFile};
If[!And @@ (FileExistsQ /@ requiredFiles), fail["a required input is missing"]];

physicalManifest = readManifest[physicalManifestFile,
  "polarized-q-to-q-fixed-interior-real-laurent-v1"];
normalizationManifest = readManifest[normalizationManifestFile,
  "polarized-q-to-q-physical-real-pole-normalization-v1"];
realDistributionManifest = readManifest[realDistributionManifestFile,
  "polarized-q-to-q-bare-real-distribution-poles-v1"];
virtualReview = Check[Import[virtualReviewFile, "RawJSON"], $Failed];
virtualKiraManifest = readManifest[virtualKiraManifestFile];
virtualPhysicalManifest = readManifest[virtualPhysicalManifestFile,
  "polarized-q-to-q-physical-virtual-laurent-v1"];
If[Lookup[realDistributionManifest, "generator_sha256", ""] =!=
     sha256[realDistributionGeneratorFile] ||
   Lookup[realDistributionManifest, "analytic_branch_policy", ""] =!=
     "preserve logarithms of positive physical cross-ratios; PowerExpand forbidden" ||
   Lookup[realDistributionManifest, "publication_comparison_performed", True] =!=
     False,
  fail["real distribution generator or branch contract changed"]
];
If[!AssociationQ[virtualReview] ||
   Lookup[Lookup[virtualReview, "review", <||>], "status", ""] =!= "reviewed" ||
   Lookup[Lookup[virtualReview, "derivation", <||>],
     "published_coefficients_used", True] =!= False,
  fail["reviewed polarized virtual source contract changed"]
];
If[Lookup[virtualKiraManifest, "kira_version", ""] =!= "3.1" ||
   Lookup[virtualKiraManifest, "uv_ir_ledger_status", ""] =!=
     "zero only after the separate UV/IR ledger",
  fail["polarized virtual Kira boundary changed"]
];
If[Lookup[virtualPhysicalManifest, "pipeline", {}] =!=
     {"Mathematica 15", "FeynArts", "FeynCalc", "Kira 3.1",
       "SubTropica 1.2.10"} ||
   Lookup[virtualPhysicalManifest, "published_coefficient_functions_used", True] =!=
     False ||
   Lookup[virtualPhysicalManifest, "distribution_support", ""] =!=
     "delta(1-w) only",
  fail["physical virtual pipeline or publication boundary changed"]
];
If[Lookup[physicalManifest["outputs"], FileNameTake[physicalPoleFile], ""] =!=
     sha256[physicalPoleFile] ||
   Lookup[physicalManifest["outputs"], FileNameTake[physicalFiniteFile], ""] =!=
     sha256[physicalFiniteFile],
  fail["physical real output hash mismatch"]
];
If[Lookup[normalizationManifest["outputs"],
     FileNameTake[normalizationOuterFile], ""] =!= sha256[normalizationOuterFile],
  fail["normalization output hash mismatch"]
];
realDistributionFiles = {realDoubleDeltaFile, realPoleRegularFile,
  realPoleD0File, realPoleDeltaFile};
If[!And @@ Map[
    Lookup[realDistributionManifest["outputs"], FileNameTake[#], ""] ===
      sha256[#] &,
    realDistributionFiles],
  fail["real distribution output hash mismatch"]
];
virtualPhysicalFiles = {virtualDeltaFile, virtualExternalLedgerFile};
If[!And @@ Map[
    Lookup[virtualPhysicalManifest["outputs"], FileNameTake[#], ""] ===
      sha256[#] &,
    virtualPhysicalFiles],
  fail["physical virtual output hash mismatch"]
];

fixedPole = exactHeld[physicalPoleFile, "physical real pole"];
fixedFinite = exactHeld[physicalFiniteFile, "physical real finite coefficient"];
frozenOuterPole = exactHeld[normalizationOuterFile,
  "paper outer-vw real pole"];
frozenRealDoubleDelta = exactHeld[realDoubleDeltaFile,
  "real double-delta coefficient"];
frozenRealPoleTuple = {
  exactHeld[realPoleRegularFile, "real regular simple pole"],
  exactHeld[realPoleD0File, "real D0 simple pole"],
  exactHeld[realPoleDeltaFile, "real delta simple pole"]
} /. mu2 -> muR2;
frozenVirtualDelta = exactHeld[virtualDeltaFile,
  "paper-normalized physical virtual delta"] /. mu2 -> muR2;
physicalExternalLedger = exactHeld[virtualExternalLedgerFile,
  "physical external-leg UV/IR ledger"];

physicalAssumptions = s > 0 && muR2 > 0 && 0 < v < 1 && 0 < w < 1;
physicalReduce[expr_] := FullSimplify[FunctionExpand[expr],
  Assumptions -> physicalAssumptions];

r = 1 - v;
d = r + v w;
rho = 1 - v w;
beta = (1 + v)/r;
yGamma = r/rho;
LReal = Log[4 Pi muR2/(s v r)] - EulerGamma;
LVirtual = Log[4 Pi muR2/(s r)] - EulerGamma;
vwMap = {t -> -s r, s4 -> s v (1 - w)};

(* Strip alpha_s/pi and CF alpha_em^2 e_q^2/(s v w). *)
outerPole = physicalReduce[
  (2 Pi s v w fixedPole/(CF ee^4 eq^2 gs^2)) /. vwMap
];
outerFinite = physicalReduce[
  (2 Pi s v w (fixedFinite + fixedPole Log[muR2])/
    (CF ee^4 eq^2 gs^2)) /. vwMap
];
sameQ[outerPole, frozenOuterPole, "independent outer-vw normalization"];

(* Endpoint expansion of the frozen bare real object.  B_1 is deliberately
   not inferred from a fixed-interior finite coefficient. *)
Bminus1 = physicalReduce[Limit[(1 - w) outerPole, w -> 1,
  Direction -> "FromBelow"]];
B0 = physicalReduce[Limit[
  (1 - w) outerFinite + 2 Bminus1 Log[1 - w], w -> 1,
  Direction -> "FromBelow"]];
sameQ[Bminus1, -4 beta, "polarized Born soft residue B_-1"];
sameQ[B0, -4 beta LReal, "endpoint coefficient B_0"];

realDoubleDelta = -Bminus1/2;
realPoleTuple = physicalReduce[{
  outerPole - Bminus1/(1 - w),
  Bminus1,
  -B0/2
}];
sameQ[realDoubleDelta, frozenRealDoubleDelta,
  "frozen real double-delta coefficient"];
sameQ[realPoleTuple, frozenRealPoleTuple,
  "independent reconstruction of frozen real pole tuple"];

(* Positive bare-to-renormalized pole insertions.  A tuple is
   {regular,D0,delta} inside the common paper prefactor N_A/(v w).
   The regular entries include the canonicalization induced by the outer
   1/w multiplying D0. *)
j0 = physicalReduce[(r + 2 v w)/(r d)];
jEndpoint = beta;
ffFullRegular = physicalReduce[
  (2 (j0 - jEndpoint)/(1 - w))/v - j0 (1 + d)
];

pdfPoleTuple = physicalReduce[{
  -beta (1 + w),
  2 beta,
  3 beta/2
}];
ffPoleTuple = physicalReduce[{
  v w ffFullRegular - 2 beta,
  2 beta,
  beta (2 Log[v] + 3/2)
}];
leptonPoleTuple = physicalReduce[{
  (2 - yGamma) (1 - v^2 w^2)/r,
  0,
  0
}];

(* Multiplication by the common outer 1/(v w) is itself distributional:
   (1/w) D0 = D0 + 1/w.  This map checks the outer tuples against the
   ordinary full-w-density convolution transforms. *)
outerToFullTuple[tuple_] := physicalReduce[{
  (tuple[[1]] + tuple[[2]])/(v w),
  tuple[[2]]/v,
  tuple[[3]]/v
}];
sameQ[outerToFullTuple[pdfPoleTuple], {
  beta (1 - w)/(v w), 2 beta/v, 3 beta/(2 v)},
  "incoming polarized PDF convolution normalization"];
sameQ[outerToFullTuple[ffPoleTuple], {
  ffFullRegular, 2 beta/v, beta (2 Log[v] + 3/2)/v},
  "outgoing unpolarized FF convolution normalization"];
sameQ[outerToFullTuple[leptonPoleTuple], {
  (2 - yGamma) (1 - v^2 w^2)/(r v w), 0, 0},
  "lepton-collinear convolution normalization"];

(* The ordinary photon row is independently fixed by regular pole closure
   and must also factor into Delta P_{gamma/l}=2-y times the polarized
   four-dimensional Compton numerator 1-(v w)^2. *)
leptonFromClosure = physicalReduce[
  -realPoleTuple[[1]] - pdfPoleTuple[[1]] - ffPoleTuple[[1]]
];
sameQ[leptonPoleTuple[[1]], leptonFromClosure,
  "lepton-collinear row from local closure"];
sameQ[leptonPoleTuple[[1]],
  (1 + v w) (1 + v - 2 v w)/r,
  "polarized photon-kernel factorization"];

(* Extract the virtual double and single poles from the physical
   Kira/SubTropica delta artifact rather than assuming them from closure. *)
virtualDoubleDelta = physicalReduce[
  Limit[eps^2 frozenVirtualDelta, eps -> 0]
];
virtualSingleDelta = physicalReduce[
  Limit[eps (frozenVirtualDelta - virtualDoubleDelta/eps^2), eps -> 0]
];
virtualSingleTuple = {0, 0, virtualSingleDelta};
sameQ[virtualDoubleDelta, -2 beta,
  "physical virtual double pole"];
sameQ[virtualSingleDelta, -beta (3 + 2 LVirtual),
  "physical virtual single pole"];
sameQ[realDoubleDelta + virtualDoubleDelta, 0,
  "real-virtual double pole"];
sameQ[realPoleTuple[[3]] + virtualSingleTuple[[3]],
  -beta (3 + 2 Log[v]), "real-plus-virtual single delta row"];
sameQ[realPoleTuple + virtualSingleTuple + pdfPoleTuple + ffPoleTuple +
  leptonPoleTuple, {0, 0, 0}, "complete simple-pole closure"];

(* First verify the separately frozen active external-leg UV/IR ledger. *)
If[!AssociationQ[physicalExternalLedger] ||
   Lookup[physicalExternalLedger, "columns", {}] =!=
     {"UV1", "IR2", "IR1", "finite"} ||
   Lookup[physicalExternalLedger, "normalization", ""] =!=
     "aLoop=CF alphaS/(4 Pi) at amplitude level" ||
   Lookup[physicalExternalLedger, "bare_external_self_energy", {}] +
       Lookup[physicalExternalLedger, "counterterm_subtraction", {}] =!=
     Lookup[physicalExternalLedger, "renormalized_external_residue", {}],
  fail["physical external-leg UV/IR ledger did not close"]
];

(* The same reviewed polarized vector-current projector permits the complete
   amplitude-level form-factor ledger.  After conversion to the outer paper
   normalization, each entry below includes beta and the columns are
   {UV,IR^2,IR}. *)
fullFormFactorLedger = <|
  "bare_1PI_vertex" -> beta {1, -2, -4},
  "MSbar_quark_field" -> beta {-1, 0, 0},
  "external_LSZ_residue" -> beta {0, 0, 1},
  "total_before_scale_expansion" -> beta {0, -2, -3}
|>;
sameQ[fullFormFactorLedger["bare_1PI_vertex"] +
  fullFormFactorLedger["MSbar_quark_field"] +
  fullFormFactorLedger["external_LSZ_residue"],
  fullFormFactorLedger["total_before_scale_expansion"],
  "complete polarized form-factor UV/IR ledger"];
uvIrLedger = <|
  "physical_external_self_energy" -> physicalExternalLedger,
  "paper_outer_full_form_factor" -> fullFormFactorLedger
|>;

(* In hep-ph/0211007 Eqs. (20)--(21), the factorized hard part receives
   -Delta H_qq convolution Born.  Since Eq. (23) fixes the finite scheme
   kernel Delta f_qq=-4 CF(1-z), its contribution to the hard part is
   -Delta f_qq convolution Born=+4 CF(1-z) convolution Born.  Keep the
   scheme-kernel sign distinct from the hard-counterterm sign.  Neither has
   a plus or delta component. *)
hvbmSplittingEpsilonTuple = {4 beta (1 - w), 0, 0};
hvbmSchemeKernelTuple = {-4 beta (1 - w), 0, 0};
hvbmRawCollinearEvanescentTuple = -hvbmSplittingEpsilonTuple;
hvbmHardCountertermTuple = -hvbmSchemeKernelTuple;
sameQ[hvbmSplittingEpsilonTuple + hvbmSchemeKernelTuple, {0, 0, 0},
  "primitive HVBM splitting-kernel restoration"];
sameQ[-hvbmSchemeKernelTuple, hvbmHardCountertermTuple,
  "finite HVBM hard-counterterm sign"];
sameQ[hvbmRawCollinearEvanescentTuple + hvbmHardCountertermTuple,
  {0, 0, 0}, "hard-level HVBM helicity restoration"];

If[!DirectoryQ[outputRoot],
  CreateDirectory[outputRoot, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
writeFrozen[name_, value_] := Module[{file = FileNameJoin[{outputRoot, name}]},
  With[{frozen = value}, Put[HoldComplete[frozen], file]];
  FileNameTake[file] -> sha256[file]
];
outputs = Association[
  writeFrozen["real_pole_outer_tuple.wl", realPoleTuple],
  writeFrozen["virtual_poles_outer.wl", <|
    "double_delta" -> virtualDoubleDelta,
    "single_tuple" -> virtualSingleTuple|>],
  writeFrozen["pdf_pole_outer_tuple.wl", pdfPoleTuple],
  writeFrozen["ff_pole_outer_tuple.wl", ffPoleTuple],
  writeFrozen["lepton_pole_outer_tuple.wl", leptonPoleTuple],
  writeFrozen["hvbm_finite_outer_tuple.wl", hvbmHardCountertermTuple],
  writeFrozen["uv_ir_ledger_outer.wl", uvIrLedger]
];

manifest = <|
  "schema_version" -> 1,
  "contract" -> "polarized-q-to-q-factorization-pole-closure-v2",
  "generated_by" -> "Mathematica 15 exact internal factorization audit",
  "normalization" -> <|
    "N_A" -> "CF alpha_em^2 e_q^2 alpha_s/(pi s)",
    "common_outer_prefactor" -> "N_A/(v w)",
    "tuple_order" -> {"regular", "D0", "delta"},
    "D0" -> "[1/(1-w)]_+ on [0,1]",
    "outer_to_full_tuple" ->
      "{R,C0,Cdelta} -> {(R+C0)/(v w),C0/v,Cdelta/v}",
    "hard_counterterm_convention" ->
      "dDelta sigma_fact=dDelta sigma_bare-(alpha_s/pi) Delta H convolution dDelta sigma_Born",
    "finite_scheme_kernel" -> "Delta f_qq(z)=-4 CF(1-z)",
    "finite_hard_insertion" -> "-Delta f_qq convolution Born=+4 CF(1-z) convolution Born",
    "raw_collinear_evanescent_hard_term" ->
      "-[Delta P_qq-P_qq]/epsilon convolution Born=-4 CF(1-z) convolution Born"
  |>,
  "method_reference" -> <|
    "arxiv" -> "hep-ph/0211007v1",
    "source_archive_sha256" ->
      "36dfb04ce689bb7f1fe195546c763f69b657f2bce2996ba520c07841b594b07d",
    "source_member" -> "hadnlo-final.tex",
```

## common/s16_check_Hgq_reference_sign.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-510", "appendix": "common/README_sources.md", "bytes": 11980, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "common/s16_check_Hgq_reference_sign.wls", "sha256": "f6a7f974bcaa3ef8cad8e15bd43408b369bf4d216656552cd3ef2503ad473b3c"} -->
```wolfram
(* Complete the existing independent real-projector comparison with reference pair contractions. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
root = Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s16_check_Hgq_reference_sign.wls"}];
referenceRoot = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s16_result", "reference"}];
out = DirectoryName[referenceRoot];
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test], AssociateTo[checks, name -> True]; Print["PASS: ", name],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; If[TrueQ[$KernelID > 0], Throw[$Failed, "StageFailure"], CloseKernels[]; Quit[1]]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[work_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[work, 1800,
  gate["time limit " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 2*1024^3,
  gate["memory limit " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
sha[path_] := IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  gate["exact native checkpoint reload", Get[path <> ".tmp"] === value];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
manifestPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s16_Hgq_reference_sign_inputs.json"}];
manifest = Import[manifestPath, "RawJSON"];
KeyValueMap[gate["pinned " <> #1, sha[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}]] === #2] &, manifest];
generated = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s01_result.wl"}]];
born = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s02_result.wl"}]];
saved = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s03_result.wl"}]];
sample = Import[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s03_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
local = Import[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s04_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
metadata = Import[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s01_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
gate["unchanged original source identities", And @@ Table[packet[[1]]["SourceHash"] ===
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", packet[[2]]}], "SHA256"],
  {packet, {{generated, "s01_generate_amplitudes.wl"}, {born, "s02_born_and_projectors.wl"},
    {saved, "s03_contract_real.wl"}}}]];
gate["unchanged independent sample and normalization", sample["SourceSHA256"] ===
  sha[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s03_sample_madgraph.py"}]] && sample["InputManifestSHA256"] ===
  sha[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s01_result.json"}]] && local["SourceSHA256"] ===
  sha[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s04_evaluate_local.wl"}]] && local["SampleSHA256"] ===
  sha[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s03_result.json"}]]];
point = SelectFirst[sample["Rows"], #["Kind"] === "real" &];
prior = SelectFirst[local["Rows"], #["ID"] === point["ID"] &];
momenta = Map[Function[vector, Map[Function[component, Rationalize[component, 0]], vector]],
  point["HadronMomenta"]];
gate["every sampled coordinate converted to exact input", AssociationQ[momenta] &&
  FreeQ[Values[momenta], _Real] && AllTrue[Values[momenta], VectorQ[#, NumberQ] &]];
metric = DiagonalMatrix[{1, -1, -1, -1}];
dot[a_, b_] := a.metric.b;
vectors = AssociationThread[{p, q, k1, k2, k3}, Lookup[momenta, {"p", "q", "k1", "k2", "k3"}]];
rules = {Q2 -> -dot[vectors[q], vectors[q]], s -> dot[vectors[p] + vectors[q], vectors[p] + vectors[q]],
  t -> dot[vectors[q] - vectors[k1], vectors[q] - vectors[k1]],
  s23 -> dot[vectors[k2] + vectors[k3], vectors[k2] + vectors[k3]],
  a12 -> dot[vectors[k1] + vectors[k2], vectors[k1] + vectors[k2]],
  u3 -> dot[vectors[p] - vectors[k3], vectors[p] - vectors[k3]]};
residuals = Table[With[{direct = dot[vectors[row[[1]]], vectors[row[[2]]]], stored = row[[3]] /. rules},
  Abs[direct - stored]/Max[1, Sqrt[(vectors[row[[1]]].vectors[row[[1]]])*
    (vectors[row[[2]]].vectors[row[[2]]])], Abs[direct], Abs[stored]]], {row, born["RealScalarProducts"]}];
gate["original invariants reproduce saved four-vector products", Max[residuals] < 10^-12];
Do[gate["sample mass shell " <> ToString[v], Abs[dot[vectors[v], vectors[v]]]/
  Max[1, vectors[v].vectors[v]] < 10^-12], {v, {p, k1, k2, k3}}];
realScalarProducts = born["RealScalarProducts"] /. rules;
initialize[] := (FCClearScalarProducts[];
  Scan[Function[row, With[{a = row[[1]], b = row[[2]], v = row[[3]]}, SPD[a, b] = v; SP[a, b] = v]], realScalarProducts]);
initialize[];
realAmplitudes = generated["Real"] /. {SMP["e"] -> 1, SMP["g_s"] -> 1};
initialAverage = born["InitialAverages"]["Hgq"];
chargeSquared = born["ModelChargeSquared"];
finalSpecies = generated["OutgoingSpecies"]["Real"];
tagWeight = Count[finalSpecies, generated["ObservedSpecies"]]/Times @@ (Factorial /@ Values[Counts[finalSpecies]]);
gate["original measured species and normalization", tagWeight === saved["TagWeight"] &&
  chargeSquared === saved["ModelChargeSquared"] && initialAverage === saved["InitialAverage"]];
(* This definition is copied verbatim from the bound original S03. *)
scalarPair[left_, right_, mode_] := Module[{a = left, b = right, value},
  Switch[mode,
    "Ppp", a = a /. Polarization[q, ___] -> p; b = b /. Polarization[q, ___] -> p,
    "PhotonWard", a = a /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q; b = b /. Polarization[q, ___] -> q,
    "GluonPWard", a = a /. Polarization[p, ___] -> p; b = b /. Polarization[p, ___] -> p,
    "Gluon3Ward", a = a /. Polarization[k3, ___] -> k3; b = b /. Polarization[k3, ___] -> k3];
  value = FermionSpinSum[a ComplexConjugate[b], ExtraFactor -> initialAverage];
  value = SUNSimplify[value, Explicit -> True, SUNNToCACF -> False];
  If[MemberQ[{"Pg", "GluonPWard", "Gluon3Ward"}, mode],
    value = -DoPolarizationSums[value, q, 0, VirtualBoson -> True]];
  If[mode =!= "GluonPWard", value = DoPolarizationSums[value, p, k1]];
  If[mode =!= "Gluon3Ward", value = DoPolarizationSums[value, k3, p]];
  value = Contract[DiracSimplify[value, DiracTraceEvaluate -> True]];
  Factor[ExpandScalarProduct[FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit[value]]]];
originalText = Import[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s03_contract_real.wl"}], "Text"];
definitionText = "scalarPair[left_, right_, mode_] :=" <>
  First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[originalText, "scalarPair[left_, right_, mode_] :="]], "\ncachedPair["]];
gate["unchanged original pair function", StringContainsQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"], StringTrim[definitionText]]];
inputHash = Hash[{FileHash[sourcePath, "SHA256"], FileHash[manifestPath, "SHA256"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s16_Hgq_reference_sign", IntegerString[inputHash, 16]}];
If[!DirectoryQ[cache], CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
pairTask[pair_] := Catch[Module[{i = First[pair], j = Last[pair], file, record, value, seconds},
  file = FileNameJoin[{cache, "Ppp_" <> IntegerString[i, 10, 2] <> "_" <> IntegerString[j, 10, 2] <> ".wl"}];
  If[FileExistsQ[file], record = Get[file]; gate["saved pair binding", record["InputHash"] === inputHash && record["Pair"] === pair]; Return[record]];
  Print["REFERENCE_PAIR_START ", pair, " kernel ", $KernelID];
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[scalarPair[realAmplitudes[[i]], realAmplitudes[[j]], "Ppp"], pair]];
  If[i != j, value = Factor[ComplexExpand[value + Conjugate[value]]]];
  value = Factor[tagWeight value/chargeSquared];
  gate["pair is scalar and exact", FreeQ[value, _Spinor | _DiracTrace | _DiracGamma | _SUNTF | _SUNTrace | _Pair | _Polarization | _Real | $Failed | $Aborted]];
  record = <|"InputHash" -> inputHash, "Pair" -> pair, "Value" -> value, "Seconds" -> seconds|>;
  put[record, file]; Print["REFERENCE_PAIR_COMPLETE ", pair, " seconds ", seconds]; record], "StageFailure"];
pairs = Flatten[Table[{i, j}, {i, Length[realAmplitudes]}, {j, i, Length[realAmplitudes]}], 1];
control = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "Ppp_01_01.wl"}]];
gate["own accepted pair input identity", control["InputHash"] === Hash[{
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s03_contract_real.wl"}], "SHA256"],
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s01_result.wl"}], "SHA256"],
  FileHash[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s02_result.wl"}], "SHA256"], $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"]];
controlFresh = pairTask[First[pairs]];
gate["entire own accepted pair exactly reproduced", AssociationQ[controlFresh] &&
  bounded[Factor[controlFresh["Value"] - (control["Value"] /. rules)] === 0, "own exact accepted pair"]];
slots = FromDigits[Environment["NSLOTS"]];
workers = Min[8, slots, $ProcessorCount, $MaxLicenseSubprocesses];
CloseKernels[]; If[workers > 1, LaunchKernels[workers]];
workerCount = Length[Kernels[]];
If[workerCount > 0,
  gate["workers share native runtime", And @@ (#[[1]] === $MachineName && #[[2]] === $Version & /@
    ParallelEvaluate[{$MachineName, $Version}])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
    $FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate, bounded, put, scalarPair, pairTask, realAmplitudes, initialAverage,
    chargeSquared, tagWeight, inputHash, cache, realScalarProducts, initialize];
  ParallelEvaluate[initialize[]]];
$DistributedContexts = None;
records = If[workerCount > 0, ParallelMap[pairTask, pairs, Method -> "FinestGrained"], pairTask /@ pairs];
CloseKernels[];
gate["complete generated pair coverage", AllTrue[records, AssociationQ] && Lookup[records, "Pair"] === pairs];
unit = bounded[Factor[Total[Lookup[records, "Value"]]], "reference pair total"];
colorSolutions = Solve[{SUNSimplify[SUNFDelta[ci, ci], SUNNToCACF -> False] ==
  Abs[metadata["Particles"]["u"]["color"]], SUNSimplify[SUNDelta[ca, ca], SUNNToCACF -> False] ==
  Abs[metadata["Particles"]["g"]["color"]], SUNN > 0}, {SUNN}, Reals];
gate["unique positive model color dimension", Length[colorSolutions] === 1];
colorDimension = SUNN /. First[colorSolutions];
dimensions = {D -> Length[metric], SUNN -> colorDimension};
originalDifference = bounded[Factor[unit - (saved["Contractions"]["Ppp"] /. rules)], "complete saved reference difference"];
n = Map[Function[text, Rationalize[ToExpression[text], 0]], local["Normalization"]["real"]];
gate["exact normalization before numerical evaluation", FreeQ[Values[n], _Real]];
prefactor = Abs[n["AmplitudeCoupling"] n["ChargeAmplitude"] (-I/dot[vectors[q], vectors[q]])]^2;
fresh = bounded[N[prefactor unit /. dimensions, 40], "fresh scaled projector"];
gate["fresh finite real scalar", NumberQ[fresh] && FreeQ[fresh, Indeterminate | _DirectedInfinity] &&
  Abs[Im[fresh]] < 10^-25 Max[1, Abs[Re[fresh]]]];
fresh = Re[fresh];
relative[a_, b_] := Abs[a - b]/Max[Abs[a], Abs[b]];
report = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-reference-sign-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> "Hgq",
  "SourceSHA256" -> sha[sourcePath], "ManifestSHA256" -> sha[manifestPath], "Point" -> point["ID"],
  "PairCount" -> Length[pairs], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "MaximumScalarProductResidual" -> N[Max[residuals], 17],
  "OwnAcceptedPairExactlyReproduced" -> True, "CompleteSavedReferenceExactlyReproduced" -> (originalDifference === 0),
  "FreshScaledPpp" -> N[fresh, 17], "StoredScaledPpp" -> prior["LocalScaledPpp"],
  "MadGraphScaledPpp" -> point["MadGraphScaledPpp"],
  "FreshVsStoredRelativeDifference" -> N[relative[fresh, prior["LocalScaledPpp"]], 17],
  "FreshVsMadGraphRelativeDifference" -> N[relative[fresh, point["MadGraphScaledPpp"]], 17],
  "Checks" -> checks, "ProductionCoefficientsChanged" -> False|>;
put[<|"Report" -> report, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "PairRecords" -> records,
  "ExactTotal" -> unit, "ExactSavedReferenceDifference" -> originalDifference|>, FileNameJoin[{out, "s16_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s16_checks.json"}], report, "RawJSON"];
gate["comparison JSON reload", Import[FileNameJoin[{out, "s16_checks.json"}], "RawJSON"]["SourceSHA256"] === sha[sourcePath]];
Print[InputForm[report]];
Print["PASS: s16_check_Hgq_reference_sign"]; Quit[0];

```

```wolfram
(* Correct the signed-model-label interface in the independent Hgq comparison. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;

out = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s17_result"}];
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test], AssociateTo[checks, name -> True]; Print["PASS: ", name], Print["FAIL: ", name]; Quit[1]];
gate["compute allocation", StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"]];
PrependTo[$Path, "/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications"];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[work_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[work, 180,
  gate["time bound " <> label, False]], 2*1024^3, gate["memory bound " <> label, False]];
sha[path_] := IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64];
manifestPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s16_Hgq_reference_sign_inputs.json"}];
manifest = Import[manifestPath, "RawJSON"];
KeyValueMap[gate["pinned " <> #1, sha[FileNameJoin[{root, #1}]] === #2] &, manifest];
metadata = Import[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s01_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
samples = Import[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s03_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
original = Import[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "s04_result.json"}], "RawJSON"];
born = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s02_result.wl"}]];
real = Get[FileNameJoin[{referenceRoot, "inputs", "s03_result.wl"}]];
nativePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hgq", "s16_result", "native_contractions_14818476", "s16_result.wl"}];
native = Get[nativePath];
gate["saved exact native contraction accepted", sha[nativePath] ===
  "ff6681d1d06cbdabd5935107c0a5e5d2a0c38d39a605c3d7194e64cf259333a2" &&
  TrueQ[native["Report"]["OwnAcceptedPairExactlyReproduced"]] &&
  TrueQ[native["Report"]["CompleteSavedReferenceExactlyReproduced"]] &&
  native["Report"]["ManifestSHA256"] === sha[manifestPath] &&
  native["Report"]["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}];
fundamental = SUNSimplify[SUNFDelta[ci, ci], SUNNToCACF -> False];
adjoint = SUNSimplify[SUNDelta[ca, ca], SUNNToCACF -> False];
colorSolutions = Solve[{fundamental == Abs[metadata["Particles"]["u"]["color"]],
  adjoint == Abs[metadata["Particles"]["g"]["color"]], SUNN > 0}, {SUNN}, Reals];
gate["unique positive model color dimension", Length[colorSolutions] === 1];
colorDimension = SUNN /. First[colorSolutions];
gate["native color traces and reference dimensions agree", IntegerQ[colorDimension] && colorDimension > 0 &&
  (born["FundamentalDimension"] /. SUNN -> colorDimension) === Abs[metadata["Particles"]["u"]["color"]] &&
  (born["AdjointDimension"] /. SUNN -> colorDimension) === Abs[metadata["Particles"]["g"]["color"]]];
Print["COLOR_DIMENSION ", InputForm[<|"SignedModelLabel" -> metadata["Particles"]["u"]["color"],
  "DerivedPositiveDimension" -> colorDimension|>]];
metric = DiagonalMatrix[{1, -1, -1, -1}];
dot[a_, b_] := a.metric.b;
exactNumbers[value_] := Rationalize[value, 0];
exactMomenta[value_] := Map[Function[vector, Map[exactNumbers, vector]], value];
close[a_, b_] := Abs[a - b] <= 10^-25 + 10^-8 Max[Abs[a], Abs[b]];
relative[a_, b_] := If[Max[Abs[a], Abs[b]] === 0, 0, Abs[a - b]/Max[Abs[a], Abs[b]]];
invariants[mom_, kind_] := Module[{pin = mom["p"], photon = mom["q"], tagged = mom["k1"],
  quark = mom["k2"], spectator, rules},
  rules = {Q2 -> -dot[photon, photon], s -> dot[pin + photon, pin + photon], t -> dot[photon - tagged, photon - tagged]};
  If[kind === "real", spectator = mom["k3"];
    rules = Join[rules, {s23 -> dot[quark + spectator, quark + spectator],
      a12 -> dot[tagged + quark, tagged + quark], u3 -> dot[pin - spectator, pin - spectator]}]]; rules];
rows = {}; nativeComparison = <||>;
Do[
  kind = point["Kind"]; id = point["ID"];
  mom = exactMomenta[point["HadronMomenta"]];
  gate[id <> " exact coordinate inputs", FreeQ[Values[mom], _Real]];
  rules = invariants[mom, kind];
  normalization = Map[Function[text, exactNumbers[ToExpression[text]]], original["Normalization"][kind]];
  gate[id <> " exact normalization inputs", FreeQ[Values[normalization], _Real]];
  prefactor = Abs[normalization["AmplitudeCoupling"] normalization["ChargeAmplitude"] (-I/dot[mom["q"], mom["q"]])]^2;
  expressions = If[kind === "born", normalization["TagWeight"] {born["BornPg"], born["BornPpp"]},
    Lookup[real["Contractions"], {"Pg", "Ppp"}]];
  oldRow = SelectFirst[original["Rows"], #["ID"] === id &];
  oldValues = bounded[N[(prefactor expressions /. {D -> Length[metric],
    SUNN -> metadata["Particles"]["u"]["color"]}) /. rules, 40], id <> " original comparison"];
  gate[id <> " entire old comparison reproduced", And @@ MapThread[close,
    {oldValues, Lookup[oldRow, {"LocalScaledPg", "LocalScaledPpp"}]}]];
  values = bounded[N[(prefactor expressions /. {D -> Length[metric], SUNN -> colorDimension}) /. rules, 40], id <> " corrected comparison"];
  gate[id <> " finite real projectors", AllTrue[values, NumberQ[#] && FreeQ[#, Indeterminate | _DirectedInfinity] && Im[#] === 0 &]];
  external = Lookup[point, {"MadGraphScaledPg", "MadGraphScaledPpp"}];
  projectorPass = MapThread[close, {values, external}];
  averages = exactNumbers[point["LeptonWeights"]].values;
  averagePass = MapThread[close, {averages, point["TaggedAzimuthAverages"]}];
  gate[id <> " both MadGraph projectors", And @@ projectorPass];
  gate[id <> " all lepton-setting averages", And @@ averagePass];
  AppendTo[rows, <|"ID" -> id, "Kind" -> kind, "OriginalColorLabel" -> metadata["Particles"]["u"]["color"],
    "DerivedColorDimension" -> colorDimension, "OriginalValues" -> N[oldValues, 17], "CorrectedValues" -> N[values, 17],
    "MadGraphValues" -> external, "RelativeDifferences" -> N[MapThread[relative, {values, external}], 17],
    "ProjectorsPass" -> projectorPass, "AzimuthAveragesPass" -> averagePass|>];
  If[id === native["Report"]["Point"],
    fresh = bounded[N[prefactor (native["ExactTotal"] /. {D -> Length[metric], SUNN -> colorDimension}), 40], "saved fresh exact contraction"];
    gate["fresh exact contraction equals corrected reference", close[fresh, Last[values]]];
    gate["fresh exact contraction equals MadGraph", close[fresh, Last[external]]];
    nativeComparison = <|"Point" -> id, "FreshScaledPpp" -> N[fresh, 17], "CorrectedStoredPpp" -> N[Last[values], 17],
      "MadGraphScaledPpp" -> Last[external], "RelativeDifference" -> N[relative[fresh, Last[external]], 17]|>],
  {point, samples["Rows"]}];
gate["complete existing sample inventory", Lookup[rows, "ID"] === Lookup[samples["Rows"], "ID"] && Length[nativeComparison] > 0];
report = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-corrected-reference-color-comparison-v1", "Channel" -> "Hgq",
  "SourceSHA256" -> sha[sourcePath], "InputManifestSHA256" -> sha[manifestPath],
  "NativeContractionSHA256" -> sha[nativePath], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
  "SignedModelColorLabel" -> metadata["Particles"]["u"]["color"], "DerivedColorDimension" -> colorDimension,
  "PointCount" -> Length[rows], "ProjectorComparisonCount" -> Total[Length[#["ProjectorsPass"]] & /@ rows],
  "AllProjectorsPass" -> And @@ Flatten[Lookup[rows, "ProjectorsPass"]],
  "AllAzimuthAveragesPass" -> And @@ Flatten[Lookup[rows, "AzimuthAveragesPass"]],
  "MaximumRelativeDifference" -> Max[Flatten[Lookup[rows, "RelativeDifferences"]]],
  "NativeComparison" -> nativeComparison, "Rows" -> rows, "Checks" -> checks,
  "ProductionCoefficientsChanged" -> False|>;
If[!DirectoryQ[out], CreateDirectory[out, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
Put[report, FileNameJoin[{out, "s17_result.wl"}]];
gate["complete native report reload", Get[FileNameJoin[{out, "s17_result.wl"}]] === report];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out, "s17_checks.json"}], report, "RawJSON"];
gate["complete JSON report reload", Import[FileNameJoin[{out, "s17_checks.json"}], "RawJSON"]["AllProjectorsPass"] === True];
Print[InputForm[KeyDrop[report, {"Rows", "Checks"}]]]; Print["PASS: s17_check_Hgq_color_dimension"]; Quit[0];
```
